teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who follows a teacher or religious leader and learns from their teachings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 跟随某位老师或宗教领袖，学习并遵循其教导的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ssegwi għalliem jew mexxej reliġjuż u titgħallem mit-tagħlim tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学习并遵循某位老师或宗教领袖教导的门徒或弟子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dixxiplu huwa persuna li ssegwi għalliem jew mexxej reliġjuż u tipprova tgħix skont it-tagħlim tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A disciple is someone who follows a teacher or religious leader and accepts their teachings.

formal.mt: Fit-test, id-dixxiplu jisma' t-tagħlim tal-imgħallem tiegħu u jipprova japplikah fil-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: In the text, the disciple listens to his master's teachings and tries to apply them in everyday life.
formal.zh: 在文中，这名弟子聆听老师的教导，并尝试将其运用于日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser dixxiplu? Pawlu: Xi ħadd li jsegwi għalliem u jitgħallem minnu, speċjalment f'kuntest reliġjuż.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does dixxiplu mean? Pawlu: Someone who follows a teacher and learns from him, especially in a religious context.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：dixxiplu 是什么意思？保罗：指跟随老师并向他学习的人，尤其用于宗教语境。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: dixxiplu 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does dixxiplu mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd li jsegwi għalliem u jitgħallem minnu, speċjalment f'kuntest reliġjuż.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd li jsegwi għalliem u jitgħallem minnu, speċjalment f'kuntest reliġjuż.
messages.zh: 指跟随老师并向他学习的人，尤其用于宗教语境。
messages.en: Someone who follows a teacher and learns from him, especially in a religious context.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dixxiplu 想成坐在老师身旁、认真学习并实践教导的弟子，用这个画面记住“门徒”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of separating connected things so that they no longer depend directly on each other.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将原本相互连接或依赖的事物分开，使它们不再直接相互依赖的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih affarijiet marbuta flimkien jiġu separati sabiex ma jibqgħux jiddependu direttament minn xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解除两个事物之间原有的连接或直接依赖关系，即解耦或脱钩。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-diżakkoppjament huwa l-proċess li bih titneħħa r-rabta bejn żewġ affarijiet sabiex ikunu jistgħu jiffunzjonaw b'mod indipendenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Decoupling is the process of separating connected things so that each can function independently.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将援助或补贴与原先决定其发放的因素脱钩；在农业语境中，指解除补贴与产量之间的直接联系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-diżakkoppjament tal-għajnuna huwa t-tneħħija tar-rabta diretta bejn l-għajnuna u fattur li qabel kien jiddetermina l-ħlas tagħha, bħall-kwantità prodotta fl-agrikoltura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Decoupling of aid means removing the direct link between financial support and a factor such as agricultural output.

formal.mt: Wara d-diżakkoppjament, iż-żewġ sistemi jistgħu jaħdmu b'mod indipendenti.
formal.en: After decoupling, the two systems can operate independently.
formal.zh: 解耦之后，两个系统可以独立运行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għandna bżonn id-diżakkoppjament? Mark: Biex kull sistema tkun tista' taħdem waħedha, anki jekk l-oħra tieqaf.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do we need decoupling? Mark: So that each system can work on its own, even if the other stops.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：为什么需要解耦？马克：这样每个系统都能独立工作，即使另一个停止运行也可以。

messages.speaker: Lara (学员)
messages.zh: 为什么需要解耦？
messages.en: Why do we need decoupling?

messages.speaker: Mark (培训老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex kull sistema tkun tista' taħdem waħedha, anki jekk l-oħra tieqaf.
messages.mt_standard: Biex kull sistema tkun tista' taħdem waħedha, anki jekk l-oħra tieqaf.
messages.zh: 这样每个系统都能独立工作，即使另一个停止运行也可以。
messages.en: So that each system can work on its own, even if the other stops.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个原本相连的齿轮分开后各自转动，用这个画面记住 diżakkoppjament 的“解耦、脱钩”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The removal of a direct link between financial aid and a factor previously used to determine it, such as production.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 解除财政援助或补贴与原先决定其发放的因素之间的直接联系，例如使农业补贴与产量脱钩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tneħħija tar-rabta diretta bejn għajnuna finanzjarja u fattur li qabel kien jiddetermina l-ħlas tagħha, bħall-produzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脱钩，即解除事物之间原有的直接联系；本词组指解除涉及援助的这种联系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-diżakkoppjament huwa t-tneħħija ta' rabta diretta bejn affarijiet; f'din l-espressjoni, ir-rabta tkun tinvolvi l-għajnuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Decoupling is the removal of a direct connection, here involving the conditions attached to financial aid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 援助或补贴脱钩，指使其不再直接取决于某项原有因素，尤其是农业生产数量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-diżakkoppjament tal-għajnuna jfisser li l-għajnuna ma tibqax tiddependi direttament minn fattur partikolari, speċjalment il-kwantità tal-produzzjoni agrikola.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Decoupling of aid occurs when support payments cease to depend directly on a factor such as the quantity produced.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif id-diżakkoppjament tal-għajnuna jneħħi r-rabta diretta bejn il-pagamenti u l-kwantità prodotta.
formal.en: The report explains how aid decoupling removes the direct link between payments and the quantity produced.
formal.zh: 该报告解释了援助脱钩如何解除补贴支付与生产数量之间的直接联系。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Bid-diżakkoppjament tal-għajnuna, il-pagament jibqa' jiddependi minn kemm nipproduċi? Rita: Le, f'dan il-każ il-pagament mhuwiex marbut mal-kwantità prodotta.
colloquial.en: Toni: With aid decoupling, does the payment still depend on how much I produce? Rita: No, in this case the payment is not linked to the quantity produced.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：援助脱钩以后，补贴金额还取决于我的产量吗？丽塔：不，在这种情况下，补贴金额与生产数量没有挂钩。

messages.speaker: Toni (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Bid-diżakkoppjament tal-għajnuna, il-pagament jibqa' jiddependi minn kemm nipproduċi?
messages.mt_standard: Bid-diżakkoppjament tal-għajnuna, il-pagament jibqa' jiddependi minn kemm nipproduċi?
messages.zh: 援助脱钩以后，补贴金额还取决于我的产量吗？
messages.en: With aid decoupling, does the payment still depend on how much I produce?

messages.speaker: Rita (农业顾问)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, f'dan il-każ il-pagament mhuwiex marbut mal-kwantità prodotta.
messages.mt_standard: Le, f'dan il-każ il-pagament mhuwiex marbut mal-kwantità prodotta.
messages.zh: 不，在这种情况下，补贴金额与生产数量没有挂钩。
messages.en: No, in this case the payment is not linked to the quantity produced.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“补贴金额”和“生产数量”写在两张卡片上，再移开连接线，以此记住整个词组表示“援助或补贴脱钩”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unhappy because something did not happen or turn out as you hoped or expected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因事情没有发生或结果不如希望、预期而感到失望的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss dispjaċir għax xi ħaġa ma seħħitx jew ma rnexxietx kif xtaq jew stenna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因希望或期待未能实现而感到失望的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna tkun diżappuntata meta tħoss dispjaċir għax ir-riżultat ta' xi ħaġa ma jkunx kif xtaqet jew stenniet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are disappointed, you feel unhappy because something has failed to meet your hopes or expectations.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因发现某人或某事并不如原先所想的美好而幻想破灭、失去信任或热情的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna tkun diżappuntata f'dan is-sens meta titlef il-fiduċja jew l-ammirazzjoni lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa għax tiskopri li r-realtà mhijiex kif kienet temmen.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are disillusioned, you lose your trust or enthusiasm after discovering that someone or something is less admirable than you believed.

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, Mark qal li kien diżappuntat bir-riżultat, għax kien stenna titjib akbar.
formal.en: In his letter, Mark said that he was disappointed with the result because he had expected greater improvement.
formal.zh: 马克在信中表示，他对结果感到失望，因为他原本期待更大的进步。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex int diżappuntat? Mark: Ħsibt li se mmorru flimkien, imma l-ħarġa tħassret.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why are you disappointed? Mark: I thought we were going together, but the outing was cancelled.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你为什么感到失望？马克：我以为我们会一起去，但这次出游取消了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么感到失望？
messages.en: Why are you disappointed?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħsibt li se mmorru flimkien, imma l-ħarġa tħassret.
messages.mt_standard: Ħsibt li se mmorru flimkien, imma l-ħarġa tħassret.
messages.zh: 我以为我们会一起去，但这次出游取消了。
messages.en: I thought we were going together, but the outing was cancelled.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象期待已久的出游突然取消时垂下的肩膀，记住 diżappuntat 表示“失望的”；若连原有信任也失去，则可联系“幻想破灭的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The amount of electrical power required by users at a particular time or during a particular period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用户在某一时刻或某一时段所需要的电力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ammont ta' enerġija elettrika li l-utenti jkollhom bżonn f'ħin partikolari jew matul perjodu partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 需求；在本词组中指用户对电力的需要。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħtieġa għal xi ħaġa, li f'din l-espressjoni tirreferi għall-elettriku li jkollhom bżonn l-utenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Demand is the need for something, here specifically the electricity that users require.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电力需求，即用户在特定时间所需要的电力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħtieġa tal-utenti għall-elettriku f'ħin partikolari jew matul perjodu partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Electric demand is the amount of electrical power that users require at a particular time.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri li d-domanda elettrika żdiedet matul il-ġranet sħan, meta aktar utenti xegħlu l-arja kkundizzjonata.
formal.en: The report shows that electricity demand increased during the hot days, when more users switched on their air conditioning.
formal.zh: 报告显示，在炎热的日子里，更多用户开启空调，电力需求随之增加。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex id-domanda elettrika hija daqshekk għolja llum? Pawlu: Għax ħafna nies qed jużaw l-arja kkundizzjonata fl-istess ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is electricity demand so high today? Pawlu: Because many people are using their air conditioning at the same time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天的电力需求为什么这么高？保罗：因为很多人同时在用空调。

messages.speaker: Maja (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex id-domanda elettrika hija daqshekk għolja llum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex id-domanda elettrika hija daqshekk għolja llum?
messages.zh: 今天的电力需求为什么这么高？
messages.en: Why is electricity demand so high today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ħafna nies qed jużaw l-arja kkundizzjonata fl-istess ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ħafna nies qed jużaw l-arja kkundizzjonata fl-istess ħin.
messages.zh: 因为很多人同时在用空调。
messages.en: Because many people are using their air conditioning at the same time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词和“大家同时开空调”的画面联系起来：需要供给的电力越多，domanda elettrika 就越高。

gloss_zh: 内部用电负荷；设施自身的用电需求

teaching_sense.en_definition: The electrical load required for the internal operation of a building, facility, or system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建筑、设施或系统为维持自身内部运行而需要的电力负荷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tagħbija elettrika meħtieġa għat-tħaddim intern ta' bini, faċilità jew sistema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 内部用电负荷，即建筑或设施自身运行所需的电力负荷。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tagħbija elettrika li tinħoloq mill-apparat u mis-servizzi meħtieġa għat-tħaddim intern ta' bini jew faċilità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An in-house load is the electrical load needed to operate equipment and services within a building or facility.

collocations.en: the calculation of the in-house load
the reduction of the in-house load
the monitoring of the in-house load

formal.mt: Il-kalkolu tad-domanda interna tal-faċilità jinkludi l-elettriku meħtieġ għad-dawl, għall-ventilazzjoni u għat-tagħmir tal-kontroll.
formal.en: The calculation of the facility's in-house load includes the electricity needed for lighting, ventilation, and control equipment.
formal.zh: 该设施内部用电负荷的计算包括照明、通风和控制设备所需的电力。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jinkludi l-kalkolu tad-domanda interna ta' dan il-bini? Mark: Jinkludi d-dawl tal-kurituri, il-ventilazzjoni u l-apparat l-ieħor li jintuża ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the calculation of this building's in-house load include? Mark: It includes corridor lighting, ventilation, and the other equipment used inside.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这栋楼的内部用电负荷计算包括哪些项目？马克：包括走廊照明、通风和楼内使用的其他设备。

messages.speaker: Lara (楼宇管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jinkludi l-kalkolu tad-domanda interna ta' dan il-bini?
messages.mt_standard: X'jinkludi l-kalkolu tad-domanda interna ta' dan il-bini?
messages.zh: 这栋楼的内部用电负荷计算包括哪些项目？
messages.en: What does the calculation of this building's in-house load include?

messages.speaker: Mark (电气技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jinkludi d-dawl tal-kurituri, il-ventilazzjoni u l-apparat l-ieħor li jintuża ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Jinkludi d-dawl tal-kurituri, il-ventilazzjoni u l-apparat l-ieħor li jintuża ġewwa.
messages.zh: 包括走廊照明、通风和楼内使用的其他设备。
messages.en: It includes corridor lighting, ventilation, and the other equipment used inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一栋设施画进方框，框内照明、通风和控制设备都要用电；把这些内部需要合起来记作 domanda interna。

gloss_zh: 重新接通后的用电需求；恢复接入的电力负荷

teaching_sense.en_definition: Electrical demand from users or equipment that have been connected to the supply again after disconnection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用户或设备断开供电后重新接通时，恢复接入供电系统的用电需求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-domanda għall-elettriku ta' utenti jew apparat li jkunu reġgħu tqabbdu mal-provvista wara li kienu ġew skonnettjati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重新接通供电后恢复接入系统的用电需求或电力负荷。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-domanda għall-elettriku li terġa' tkun imqabbda mas-sistema meta utenti jew apparat jerġgħu jingħataw il-provvista wara skonnessjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Reconnected demand is the electrical demand brought back onto a supply system when disconnected users or equipment are connected again.

collocations.zh: 恢复接入的用电需求的测量
恢复接入的电力负荷的监测
恢复接入的用电需求水平

formal.mt: Wara li reġgħet ingħatat il-provvista liż-żona, l-operatur kejjel id-domanda rikonnessa biex jevalwa t-tagħbija fuq is-sistema.
formal.en: After the electricity supply to the area was restored, the operator measured the reconnected demand to assess the load on the system.
formal.zh: 该地区恢复供电后，操作员测量了恢复接入的用电需求，以评估系统所承受的负荷。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Issa li dawk il-binjiet reġgħu għandhom id-dawl, qed tkejjel id-domanda rikonnessa? David: Iva, qed niċċekkja kemm qed jitolbu elettriku wara li reġgħu tqabbdu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Now that those buildings have power again, are you measuring the reconnected demand? David: Yes, I am checking how much electricity they are demanding after being connected again.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那些楼现在恢复供电了，你在测量恢复接入的用电需求吗？戴维：对，我在检查它们重新接通后需要多少电力。

messages.speaker: Nina (值班主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa li dawk il-binjiet reġgħu għandhom id-dawl, qed tkejjel id-domanda rikonnessa?
messages.mt_standard: Issa li dawk il-binjiet reġgħu għandhom id-dawl, qed tkejjel id-domanda rikonnessa?
messages.zh: 那些楼现在恢复供电了，你在测量恢复接入的用电需求吗？
messages.en: Now that those buildings have power again, are you measuring the reconnected demand?

messages.speaker: David (电力技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed niċċekkja kemm qed jitolbu elettriku wara li reġgħu tqabbdu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed niċċekkja kemm qed jitolbu elettriku wara li reġgħu tqabbdu.
messages.zh: 对，我在检查它们重新接通后需要多少电力。
messages.en: Yes, I am checking how much electricity they are demanding after being connected again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“断开供电、重新接通、负荷回到系统”的三步画面记忆；最后重新出现的用电需求就是 domanda rikonnessa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The total quantity of a product or service that buyers in a market are willing and able to purchase at a given price during a particular period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在特定时期和价格条件下，市场中的购买者愿意且有能力购买的某种商品或服务的总量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwantità totali ta' prodott jew servizz li x-xerrejja f'suq ikunu lesti u kapaċi jixtru bi prezz partikolari matul perjodu partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 需求；在市场语境中指购买者对商品或服务的购买意愿及相应购买能力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħtieġa għal prodott jew servizz, flimkien mar-rieda u l-kapaċità tax-xerrejja li jħallsu għalih fil-kuntest tas-suq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Demand is the desire for a product or service supported by the ability to pay for it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 市场需求，即某一市场的全部购买者在特定时期和价格条件下愿意且能够购买的商品或服务总量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kwantità totali ta' prodott jew servizz li x-xerrejja kollha f'suq ikunu lesti u kapaċi jixtru bi prezz partikolari matul perjodu partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Market demand is the total quantity of a product or service that all buyers in a market are willing and able to purchase under specified conditions.

formal.mt: Qabel iżżid il-produzzjoni, il-kumpanija se tanalizza d-domanda tas-suq biex tistma kemm jistgħu jixtru l-klijenti bil-prezz propost.
formal.en: Before increasing production, the company will analyse market demand to estimate how much customers may purchase at the proposed price.
formal.zh: 公司将在扩大生产前分析市场需求，以估计客户按拟定价格可能购买的数量。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandna nordnaw aktar minn dawn il-basktijiet? Toni: Ejja niċċekkjaw id-domanda tas-suq l-ewwel; din il-ġimgħa l-klijenti xtraw biss ftit minnhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Should we order more of these bags? Toni: Let's check market demand first; customers bought only a few of them this week.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们要再订一些这种包吗？托尼：先看看市场需求吧，这周顾客只买了几个。

messages.speaker: Sara (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna nordnaw aktar minn dawn il-basktijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna nordnaw aktar minn dawn il-basktijiet?
messages.zh: 我们要再订一些这种包吗？
messages.en: Should we order more of these bags?

messages.speaker: Toni (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja niċċekkjaw id-domanda tas-suq l-ewwel; din il-ġimgħa l-klijenti xtraw biss ftit minnhom.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja niċċekkjaw id-domanda tas-suq l-ewwel; din il-ġimgħa l-klijenti xtraw biss ftit minnhom.
messages.zh: 先看看市场需求吧，这周顾客只买了几个。
messages.en: Let's check market demand first; customers bought only a few of them this week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象市场里所有愿意买、也付得起钱的顾客，把他们在同一价格下想买的数量加起来，就记住了 domanda tas-suq。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A right to end an agreement or withdraw from a commitment under the applicable conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照适用条件终止协议，或从已经作出的承诺、订立的协议中退出的权利。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dritt li persuna ttemm ftehim jew tirtira minn impenn skont il-kundizzjonijiet applikabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 终止协议或现有约定关系的权利。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-dritt li parti ttemm ftehim jew relazzjoni stabbilita permezz ta' ftehim.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A right of termination allows a party to bring an existing agreement to an end.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撤回先前作出的同意，或退出已经订立的协议、作出的承诺的权利。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-dritt li persuna tirtira l-kunsens li tkun tat jew toħroġ minn ftehim jew impenn li tkun daħlet għalih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A right of withdrawal allows someone to withdraw consent or step back from an agreement or commitment.

collocations.en: the exercise of the right of withdrawal
the conditions governing the right of withdrawal

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jispjega d-dritt ta' rtirar u l-proċedura li għandha ssegwi l-persuna li tixtieq teżerċitah.
formal.en: The agreement explains the right of withdrawal and the procedure that a person wishing to exercise it should follow.
formal.zh: 该协议说明了撤回权，以及希望行使该权利的人应当遵循的程序。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser id-dritt ta' rtirar f'dan il-ftehim? Mark: Ifisser li tista' tirtira mill-ftehim skont il-kundizzjonijiet miktuba fih.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the right of withdrawal mean in this agreement? Mark: It means you can withdraw from the agreement under the conditions written in it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这份协议中的撤回权是什么意思？Mark：意思是你可以按照协议中写明的条件退出协议。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser id-dritt ta' rtirar f'dan il-ftehim?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser id-dritt ta' rtirar f'dan il-ftehim?
messages.zh: 这份协议中的撤回权是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the right of withdrawal mean in this agreement?

messages.speaker: Mark (工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li tista' tirtira mill-ftehim skont il-kundizzjonijiet miktuba fih.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li tista' tirtira mill-ftehim skont il-kundizzjonijiet miktuba fih.
messages.zh: 意思是你可以按照协议中写明的条件退出协议。
messages.en: It means you can withdraw from the agreement under the conditions written in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语想成协议旁的一扇退出门：强调结束现有协议时记“终止权”，强调撤回同意或退出承诺时记“撤回权”。

exact_key: dritt ta' trażmissjoni ta' terminu twil

teaching_sense.en_definition: A right to carry out transmission over an extended period under specified conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照规定条件，在较长期间内进行传输的权利。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dritt li ssir trażmissjoni għal perjodu twil skont kundizzjonijiet speċifikati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在规定的较长期间内进行传输的权利。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dritt li jippermetti li ssir trażmissjoni matul perjodu twil speċifikat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A long-term transmission right permits transmission over a specified extended period.

collocations.mt: talba għal dritt ta' trażmissjoni ta' terminu twil
collocations.en: an application for a long-term transmission right

collocations.mt: il-kundizzjonijiet ta' dritt ta' trażmissjoni ta' terminu twil
collocations.en: the conditions of a long-term transmission right

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi d-dritt ta' trażmissjoni ta' terminu twil u jispeċifika meta jibda u meta jintemm.
formal.en: The document describes the long-term transmission right and specifies when it begins and ends.
formal.zh: 该文件说明了长期传输权，并明确了其开始和终止的时间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan id-dritt ta' trażmissjoni ta' terminu twil kemm idum? Pawlu: Id-dati tal-bidu u tat-tmiem jinsabu fid-dokument; ejja narawhom flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: How long does this long-term transmission right last? Pawlu: The start and end dates are in the document; let's look at them together.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这项长期传输权持续多久？Pawlu：文件里有开始和结束的日期，我们一起看看。

messages.speaker: Sara (项目助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-dritt ta' trażmissjoni ta' terminu twil kemm idum?
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-dritt ta' trażmissjoni ta' terminu twil kemm idum?
messages.zh: 这项长期传输权持续多久？
messages.en: How long does this long-term transmission right last?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (项目同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-dati tal-bidu u tat-tmiem jinsabu fid-dokument; ejja narawhom flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Id-dati tal-bidu u tat-tmiem jinsabu fid-dokument; ejja narawhom flimkien.
messages.zh: 文件里有开始和结束的日期，我们一起看看。
messages.en: The start and end dates are in the document; let's look at them together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“权利—传输—长期”三个意义块记忆，再想象一张标有起止日期的传输许可，帮助记住整个长短语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A substance that affects the body or mind, including a medicine or an illicit substance, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够影响身体或精神状态的物质；根据语境，可指药物，也可指毒品或非法药物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza li taffettwa l-ġisem jew il-moħħ u li, skont il-kuntest, tista' tkun mediċina jew sustanza illeċita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能影响身体机能或精神状态的药物或其他物质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sustanza li tbiddel il-mod kif jaħdem il-ġisem jew il-moħħ, u li tista' tintuża wkoll bħala mediċina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A drug is a substance that affects bodily or mental functions and may be used as a medicine.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法律禁止持有、使用或供应的物质；在此指毒品或非法药物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sustanza li l-pussess, l-użu jew il-provvista tagħha huma pprojbiti mil-liġi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An illicit substance is a drug whose possession, use, or supply is prohibited by law.

collocations.zh: 药物的作用；毒品的影响

formal.mt: F'dan ir-rapport, il-kelma droga tirreferi għal sustanza illeċita, u mhux għal mediċina.
formal.en: In this report, the word droga refers to an illicit substance rather than a medicine.
formal.zh: 在这份报告中，droga 一词指非法药物，而不是治疗用药。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawnhekk droga tfisser mediċina jew sustanza illegali? Toni: F'dan l-artiklu tfisser sustanza illegali; is-sentenza titkellem dwar it-traffikar tad-droga.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does droga mean a medicine or an illegal substance here? Toni: In this article it means an illegal substance; the sentence is about drug trafficking.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这里的 droga 是指药品还是非法物质？Toni：在这篇文章里是指非法物质，这句话讲的是贩毒。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk droga tfisser mediċina jew sustanza illegali?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk droga tfisser mediċina jew sustanza illegali?
messages.zh: 这里的 droga 是指药品还是非法物质？
messages.en: Does droga mean a medicine or an illegal substance here?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan l-artiklu tfisser sustanza illegali; is-sentenza titkellem dwar it-traffikar tad-droga.
messages.mt_standard: F'dan l-artiklu tfisser sustanza illegali; is-sentenza titkellem dwar it-traffikar tad-droga.
messages.zh: 在这篇文章里是指非法物质，这句话讲的是贩毒。
messages.en: In this article it means an illegal substance; the sentence is about drug trafficking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 droga 放进两个语境框记忆：身体作用框里可译“药物”，违法交易框里译“毒品”；先读上下文再选中文义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A drug that reduces pain or sensation and may cause sleepiness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够减轻疼痛或降低感觉，并可能引起困倦的麻醉性药物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Droga li tnaqqas l-uġigħ jew is-sensazzjoni u li tista' ġġib in-ngħas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有减轻疼痛、降低感觉或引起困倦作用的麻醉性药物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sustanza li taġixxi fuq is-sistema nervuża u tista' tnaqqas l-uġigħ, tnaqqas is-sensazzjoni jew iġġib in-ngħas.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A narcotic drug acts on the nervous system to reduce pain or sensation and may cause sleepiness.

collocations.en: the effects of a narcotic drug
the use of a narcotic drug

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi l-effetti ta' droga narkotika fuq is-sistema nervuża, fosthom it-tnaqqis tal-uġigħ u n-ngħas.
formal.en: The text describes the effects of a narcotic drug on the nervous system, including pain reduction and sleepiness.
formal.zh: 该文本描述了麻醉性药物对神经系统的作用，包括减轻疼痛和引起困倦。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser droga narkotika f'din is-sentenza? David: Tfisser droga li tista' tnaqqas l-uġigħ jew is-sensazzjoni u ġġib in-ngħas.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does droga narkotika mean in this sentence? David: It means a drug that can reduce pain or sensation and cause sleepiness.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这句话中的 droga narkotika 是什么意思？David：指能够减轻疼痛或降低感觉，并引起困倦的药物。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser droga narkotika f'din is-sentenza?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser droga narkotika f'din is-sentenza?
messages.zh: 这句话中的 droga narkotika 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does droga narkotika mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser droga li tista' tnaqqas l-uġigħ jew is-sensazzjoni u ġġib in-ngħas.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser droga li tista' tnaqqas l-uġigħ jew is-sensazzjoni u ġġib in-ngħas.
messages.zh: 指能够减轻疼痛或降低感觉，并引起困倦的药物。
messages.en: It means a drug that can reduce pain or sensation and cause sleepiness.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用 droga 记住“药物”，再把 narkotika 与“痛觉降低、感觉减弱、可能困倦”的课堂画面相连，合起来记“麻醉性药物”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A downward bend or hanging position of something that would otherwise be more upright.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物原本较为挺立的部分向下弯曲或低垂的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Liwi 'l isfel jew qagħda mdendla ta' xi ħaġa li normalment tkun aktar dritta jew merfugħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下垂；物体某部分向下弯垂的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qagħda li fiha xi ħaġa jew parti minnha titgħawweġ jew tiddendel 'l isfel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A droop is a downward bend or hanging position in something that would usually stand more upright.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi droop ħafif fil-weraq tal-pjanta, li jidher aktar ċar fir-ritratt.
formal.en: The report describes a slight droop in the plant's leaves, which is more clearly visible in the photograph.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这株植物叶片轻微下垂的情况，照片中可以看得更清楚。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tara dan id-droop fil-weraq? Pawlu: Iva, il-weraq qed jitgħawweġ 'l isfel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you see this droop in the leaves? Pawlu: Yes, the leaves are bending downwards.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看到叶片这样下垂了吗？Pawlu：看到了，叶片正在向下弯。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到叶片这样下垂了吗？
messages.en: Can you see this droop in the leaves?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，叶片正在向下弯。
messages.en: Yes, the leaves are bending downwards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象原本挺立的叶片慢慢垂下，把 droop 这个名词与“下垂的状态”一起记；搭配 ħafif 可表达“轻微下垂”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A DSO whose specified role concerns the connection of reserves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 其指定职责涉及储备连接的DSO；此处保留缩写DSO，不扩展其全称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: DSO li r-rwol speċifikat tiegħu jikkonċerna l-konnessjoni tar-riservi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责储备连接的DSO。
sense_translations.mt_definition: DSO li għandu rwol fil-konnessjoni tar-riservi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reserve connecting DSO is a DSO with a role in connecting reserves.

collocations.en: the role of the reserve connecting DSO
collocations.zh: 负责储备连接的DSO的职责

collocations.en: contact with the reserve connecting DSO
collocations.zh: 与负责储备连接的DSO联系

formal.mt: Id-dokument għandu jidentifika d-DSO tal-konnessjoni tar-riservi u jiddeskrivi r-rwol tiegħu b'mod ċar.
formal.en: The document should identify the reserve connecting DSO and clearly describe its role.
formal.zh: 文件应明确指出负责储备连接的DSO，并清楚说明其职责。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min hu d-DSO tal-konnessjoni tar-riservi f'dan il-każ? David: Għadni ma nafx; ejja niċċekkjaw id-dokument.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who is the reserve connecting DSO in this case? David: I don't know yet; let's check the document.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这个案例中，负责储备连接的DSO是谁？David：我还不知道，我们查一下文件吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu d-DSO tal-konnessjoni tar-riservi f'dan il-każ?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu d-DSO tal-konnessjoni tar-riservi f'dan il-każ?
messages.zh: 这个案例中，负责储备连接的DSO是谁？
messages.en: Who is the reserve connecting DSO in this case?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma nafx; ejja niċċekkjaw id-dokument.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma nafx; ejja niċċekkjaw id-dokument.
messages.zh: 我还不知道，我们查一下文件吧。
messages.en: I don't know yet; let's check the document.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按短语顺序记忆：先保留 DSO，再把 konnessjoni 对应“连接”、riservi 对应“储备”，合起来理解为“负责储备连接的DSO”，不猜缩写全称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small fly associated with fruit, especially ripe or decaying fruit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 常见于水果附近，尤其是成熟或腐烂水果周围的小型蝇类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' dubbien żgħir li spiss jinstab qrib il-frott, speċjalment frott misjur jew imħassar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 果蝇，常聚集在成熟或腐烂水果周围的小型蝇类。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-dubbien tal-frott huwa tip ta' dubbien żgħir li spiss jinġabar madwar frott misjur jew imħassar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fruit fly is a small fly that is often found around ripe or decaying fruit.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema għandhom ineħħu l-frott imħassar biex inaqqsu d-dubbien tal-frott fil-maħżen.
formal.en: Workers should remove decaying fruit to reduce the number of fruit flies in the storeroom.
formal.zh: 工作人员应清除腐烂的水果，以减少储藏室内的果蝇。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Qed nara d-dubbien tal-frott ħdejn il-banana. Pawlu: Ejja nneħħu l-frott imħassar u nnaddfu l-mejda.
colloquial.en: Marija: I can see fruit flies near the bananas. Pawlu: Let's remove the decaying fruit and clean the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我看到香蕉旁边有果蝇。保罗：我们把烂水果清走，再擦干净桌子吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nara d-dubbien tal-frott ħdejn il-banana.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nara d-dubbien tal-frott ħdejn il-banana.
messages.zh: 我看到香蕉旁边有果蝇。
messages.en: I can see fruit flies near the bananas.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nneħħu l-frott imħassar u nnaddfu l-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nneħħu l-frott imħassar u nnaddfu l-mejda.
messages.zh: 我们把烂水果清走，再擦干净桌子吧。
messages.en: Let's remove the decaying fruit and clean the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词和“熟香蕉旁飞着小果蝇”的画面一起记，看到 frott 就联想到水果，再用整组词说出“果蝇”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Uncertain or doubtful, open to question, or insufficiently clear, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可表示人心存怀疑、事情值得质疑，或说法含糊不清，具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil min ikollu dubji, xi ħaġa li tqajjem dubji, jew kliem li ma jkunx ċar biżżejjed, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怀疑的，表示对某事是否真实、正确或能够发生没有把握。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Min ikun dubbjuż ma jkunx ċert minn xi ħaġa u jkollu dubji dwarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are doubtful about something, you are not sure whether it is true, correct, or likely to happen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可疑的；值得质疑的，指真实性、可靠性或正当性存在疑问。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa dubbjuża tqajjem dubji dwar jekk hijiex vera, ta' min joqgħod fuqha, jew aċċettabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is questionable, there are reasons to doubt its truth, reliability, or acceptability.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含糊的，不够清楚或具体，因而难以确定其意思或细节。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kliem jew tagħrif dubbjuż ma jkunx ċar jew preċiż biżżejjed biex wieħed jifhem eżatt x'inhu maħsub.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a statement or description is vague, it does not express its meaning or details clearly enough.

formal.mt: L-awtur jibqa' dubbjuż dwar il-konklużjoni, għax id-data ġejja minn sors dubbjuż.
formal.en: The author remains doubtful about the conclusion because the data comes from a questionable source.
formal.zh: 作者仍对这一结论心存疑虑，因为数据来自可靠性存疑的来源。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Jien għadni dubbjuż dwar dan ir-rapport. Pawlu: Għaliex? Mark: Is-sors huwa dubbjuż, u d-deskrizzjoni hija dubbjuża wkoll; ma tgħidx eżatt x'ġara.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm still doubtful about this report. Pawlu: Why? Mark: The source is questionable, and the description is vague too; it doesn't say exactly what happened.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我还是对这份报告有疑虑。保罗：为什么？马克：来源可疑，描述也含糊，没有准确说明发生了什么。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien għadni dubbjuż dwar dan ir-rapport.
messages.mt_standard: Jien għadni dubbjuż dwar dan ir-rapport.
messages.zh: 我还是对这份报告有疑虑。
messages.en: I'm still doubtful about this report.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 为什么？
messages.en: Why?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sors huwa dubbjuż, u d-deskrizzjoni hija dubbjuża wkoll; ma tgħidx eżatt x'ġara.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sors huwa dubbjuż, u d-deskrizzjoni hija dubbjuża wkoll; ma tgħidx eżatt x'ġara.
messages.zh: 来源可疑，描述也含糊，没有准确说明发生了什么。
messages.en: The source is questionable, and the description is vague too; it doesn't say exactly what happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个问号记三个义项：人心里打问号是“怀疑”，来源让人打问号是“可疑”，描述看完仍有问号是“含糊”。再配对记忆 sors dubbjuż 与 deskrizzjoni dubbjuża，留意形容词的性别变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large fruit with a thick green rind and sweet, watery flesh.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种外皮厚而通常呈绿色、果肉甜且水分丰富的大型水果，即西瓜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta kbira b'qoxra ħoxna li ġeneralment tkun ħadra u b'laħam ħelu mimli ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 西瓜，一种通常有厚绿皮、果肉甜而多汁的大型水果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dulliegħa hija frotta kbira b'qoxra ħoxna ħadra u b'laħam ħelu u mmerraq li spiss ikun aħmar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A watermelon is a large fruit with a thick green rind and sweet, juicy flesh that is usually red.

formal.mt: Wara l-ikla, ġie servut porzjon dulliegħa friska lil kull mistieden.
formal.en: After the meal, each guest was served a portion of chilled watermelon.
formal.zh: 用餐后，每位客人都获提供了一份冰凉的西瓜。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid ftit dulliegħa? Paul: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Kemm hi ħelwa!
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like some watermelon? Paul: Yes, please. It's so sweet!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你要吃点西瓜吗？保罗：好的，谢谢。真甜啊！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要吃点西瓜吗？
messages.en: Would you like some watermelon?

messages.speaker: Paul (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Kemm hi ħelwa!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Kemm hi ħelwa!
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢。真甜啊！
messages.en: Yes, please. It's so sweet!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 dulliegħa 时想象切开一个绿皮西瓜，红色果肉汁水丰富；把词形和整个西瓜的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose work is making or selling sweets and confectionery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以制作或售卖糖果、甜食和糕点为业的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tagħmel jew tbigħ ħelu u pasti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 制作或售卖糖果、甜食和糕点的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dulċier huwa persuna li tagħmel jew tbigħ ħelu u pasti bħala xogħol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A confectioner is someone whose job is making or selling sweets and other confectionery.

collocations.zh: 技艺娴熟的糖果糕点师
糖果糕点师经营的店铺

formal.mt: Il-lukanda impjegat dulċier tas-sengħa biex jipprepara l-ħelu għar-riċeviment.
formal.en: The hotel employed a skilled confectioner to prepare the sweets for the reception.
formal.zh: 酒店聘请了一位技艺娴熟的糖果糕点师，为招待会制作甜食。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min għamel dawn il-pasti? Mark: Dulċier mill-belt. Għandu ħanut ħdejn il-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who made these pastries? Mark: A confectioner from town. He has a shop beside the square.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些糕点是谁做的？马克：城里的一位糖果糕点师。他在广场旁边开了一家店。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些糕点是谁做的？
messages.en: Who made these pastries?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dulċier mill-belt. Għandu ħanut ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.mt_standard: Dulċier mill-belt. Għandu ħanut ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.zh: 城里的一位糖果糕点师。他在广场旁边开了一家店。
messages.en: A confectioner from town. He has a shop beside the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dulċier 放进甜点店的画面里记：柜台后制作糖果和糕点的那个人，就是这个词指的人。

gloss_zh: 多明我会的；属于多明我会的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the Dominican religious order or describing someone who belongs to it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与天主教多明我会有关的，或形容某人属于该修会的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Ordni Dumnikan jew li jiddeskrivi persuna li tagħmel parti minn dan l-ordni reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多明我会的；与该天主教修会及其成员有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Ordni Dumnikan, mal-membri tiegħu jew mal-ħajja reliġjuża tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something Dominican is connected with the Dominican religious order or with the people who belong to it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容某人是多明我会成员的；属于多明我会的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta jintuża dwar persuna, jindika li dik il-persuna tagħmel parti mill-Ordni Dumnikan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person described as Dominican belongs to the religious order known as the Dominican Order.

formal.mt: Patri dumnikan ta taħdita dwar il-ħajja fil-kunvent.
formal.en: A Dominican friar gave a talk about life in the convent.
formal.zh: 一位多明我会会士作了一场关于修院生活的讲座。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dak il-patri dumnikan? David: Iva, jagħmel parti mill-Ordni Dumnikan.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is that friar Dominican? David: Yes, he belongs to the Dominican Order.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：那位会士属于多明我会吗？戴维：是的，他是多明我会的成员。

messages.speaker: Anna (参观者)
messages.zh: 那位会士属于多明我会吗？
messages.en: Is that friar Dominican?

messages.speaker: David (导览员)
messages.zh: 是的，他是多明我会的成员。
messages.en: Yes, he belongs to the Dominican Order.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 patri dumnikan 这个搭配记忆：先想到一位会士，再用 dumnikan 说明他属于多明我会。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sale of goods in a foreign market at prices below their normal value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以低于正常价值的价格在外国市场销售商品的行为，即倾销。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bejgħ ta' oġġetti f'suq barrani bi prezzijiet aktar baxxi mill-valur normali tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾销，指以低于正常价值的价格向外国市场销售商品的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-dumping huwa l-bejgħ ta' oġġetti f'suq barrani bi prezzijiet taħt il-valur normali tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dumping occurs when goods are sold in a foreign market at prices below their normal value.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾销做法，指经营者采用低于正常价值的出口售价销售商品的贸易做法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prattika ta' dumping hija prattika kummerċjali li fiha negozju jbigħ oġġetti f'suq barrani bi prezzijiet taħt il-valur normali tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dumping practice is a trading practice in which a business sells goods abroad at prices below their normal value.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport eżamina jekk il-bejgħ tal-prodotti fis-suq barrani kienx jikkostitwixxi dumping.
formal.en: The report examined whether sales of the products in the foreign market constituted dumping.
formal.zh: 报告审查了这些产品在外国市场的销售是否构成倾销。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Prezz baxx dejjem ifisser dumping? Karl: Le. Biex tgħid li hemm dumping, trid teżamina wkoll il-valur normali tal-prodott.
colloquial.en: Marta: Does a low price always mean dumping? Karl: No. To say that dumping is taking place, you also need to examine the product's normal value.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：价格低就一定意味着倾销吗？卡尔：不是。要说存在倾销，还得考察产品的正常价值。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 价格低就一定意味着倾销吗？
messages.en: Does a low price always mean dumping?

messages.speaker: Karl (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le. Biex tgħid li hemm dumping, trid teżamina wkoll il-valur normali tal-prodott.
messages.mt_standard: Le. Biex tgħid li hemm dumping, trid teżamina wkoll il-valur normali tal-prodott.
messages.zh: 不是。要说存在倾销，还得考察产品的正常价值。
messages.en: No. To say that dumping is taking place, you also need to examine the product's normal value.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dumping 和“外国市场、售价、正常价值”三个提示连起来记；本条学习的是贸易中的倾销。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dumping that occurs occasionally or at irregular intervals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 偶尔发生、时间不规律的倾倒行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rimi ta' materjal li jseħħ kultant jew f'intervalli mhux regolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 并非持续发生，而是偶尔或零星出现的倾倒行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rimi ta' materjal li ma jseħħx kontinwament, iżda minn żmien għal żmien b'mod mhux regolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sporadic dumping occurs occasionally, with no regular or continuous pattern.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każijiet ta' dumping sporadiku ta' skart qrib it-triq.
formal.en: The report describes cases of sporadic waste dumping near the road.
formal.zh: 报告描述了道路附近零星倾倒废物的情况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Jarmu l-iskart hawn kuljum? Pawlu: Le, kultant biss. Huwa dumping sporadiku.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do they dump waste here every day? Pawlu: No, only occasionally. It is sporadic dumping.
colloquial.zh: Lara：他们每天都在这里倾倒废物吗？Pawlu：没有，只是偶尔。这是零星倾倒。

messages.speaker: Lara (居民)
messages.zh: 他们每天都在这里倾倒废物吗？
messages.en: Do they dump waste here every day?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kultant biss. Huwa dumping sporadiku.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kultant biss. Huwa dumping sporadiku.
messages.zh: 没有，只是偶尔。这是零星倾倒。
messages.en: No, only occasionally. It is sporadic dumping.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把倾倒事件想成日历上零散的几个点：dumping 是倾倒，sporadiku 提醒你关注偶发、不规律。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To break something into small pieces, or to break apart into small pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物弄成小碎块，或自身碎成小块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfarrak xi ħaġa f'biċċiet żgħar, jew titfarrak f'biċċiet żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物碎成小块；某物自行碎裂。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmel xi ħaġa biċċiet żgħar billi tfarrakha, jew tinqasam hekk f'biċċiet żgħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something crumbles, or you crumble it, it breaks into small pieces.

formal.mt: L-istruzzjoni 'dunno l-gallettini' tindika li l-gallettini għandhom jitfarrku f'biċċiet żgħar.
formal.en: The instruction 'crumble the biscuits' indicates that the biscuits should be broken into small pieces.
formal.zh: “把饼干弄碎”这条指令表示，应将饼干弄成小碎块。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'dunno l-ħobż'? Mark: Tfisser li tfarrak il-ħobż f'biċċiet żgħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'crumble the bread' mean? Mark: It means breaking the bread into small pieces.
colloquial.zh: Maja：“把面包弄碎”是什么意思？Mark：就是把面包弄成小碎块。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: “把面包弄碎”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'crumble the bread' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li tfarrak il-ħobż f'biċċiet żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li tfarrak il-ħobż f'biċċiet żgħar.
messages.zh: 就是把面包弄成小碎块。
messages.en: It means breaking the bread into small pieces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 dunno 就想象手指把饼干捏成碎屑，用“整块变小碎块”的动作画面记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lion, a large wild cat whose adult male usually has a mane.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 狮子，一种大型野生猫科动物，成年雄性通常长有鬃毛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal selvaġġ kbir tal-familja tal-qtates, li r-raġel adult tiegħu normalment ikollu kriniera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狮子，成年雄性通常具有明显鬃毛的大型猫科动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal kbir u selvaġġ mill-familja tal-qtates, magħruf għall-kriniera li normalment ikollu r-raġel adult.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lion is a large wild cat, and adult males usually have a mane.

formal.mt: Fl-istampa jidher durbies adult bi kriniera kbira.
formal.en: The picture shows an adult lion with a large mane.
formal.zh: 图片中是一头长着浓密鬃毛的成年狮子。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'annimal hemm fl-istampa? David: Dak durbies. Ara l-kriniera tiegħu!
colloquial.en: Sara: What animal is in the picture? David: That is a lion. Look at its mane!
colloquial.zh: Sara：图片里是什么动物？David：那是狮子。看它的鬃毛！

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 图片里是什么动物？
messages.en: What animal is in the picture?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.zh: 那是狮子。看它的鬃毛！
messages.en: That is a lion. Look at its mane!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 durbies 配上一张雄狮鬃毛环绕头部的图片，把词形与“狮子”这一具体形象一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tree of the oak species known as the sessile oak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无梗花栎，栎属的一种树木。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' siġra tal-ballut li l-ġandar tagħha jkun imqabbad mal-fergħa mingħajr zokk jew b'zokk qasir ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无梗花栎，一种橡树，其橡果无梗或梗极短。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' siġra tal-ballut li tipproduċi ġandar mingħajr zokk jew b'zokk qasir ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sessile oak is an oak tree whose acorns have very short stalks or none.

collocations.en: the leaves of the sessile oak
the acorns of the sessile oak

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-weraq u l-ġandar tad-durmast waqt il-lezzjoni dwar is-siġar.
formal.en: The students observed the leaves and acorns of the sessile oak during the lesson on trees.
formal.zh: 在关于树木的课堂上，学生们观察了无梗花栎的叶子和橡果。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'siġra hi din? Toni: Din durmast, tip ta' ballut. Nina: U dawn huma l-ġandar tagħha? Toni: Iva, dawn il-ġandar tagħha.
colloquial.en: Nina: What tree is this? Toni: This is a sessile oak, a type of oak. Nina: And are these its acorns? Toni: Yes, these are its acorns.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这是什么树？Toni：这是无梗花栎，是一种橡树。Nina：这些是它的橡果吗？Toni：对，这些就是它的橡果。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这是什么树？
messages.en: What tree is this?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.zh: 这是无梗花栎，是一种橡树。
messages.en: This is a sessile oak, a type of oak.

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这些是它的橡果吗？
messages.en: And are these its acorns?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.zh: 对，这些就是它的橡果。
messages.en: Yes, these are its acorns.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 durmast 写在无梗花栎的图卡上，圈出贴近枝条的橡果，用“橡果几乎无梗”的画面帮助记忆。

gloss_zh: 教义；学说；儿童基督教教理课程

teaching_sense.en_definition: A system of beliefs or principles, especially religious ones; also Christian religious instruction given to children.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一套信仰或原则，尤指宗教教义；也指向儿童讲授基督教教义的教理课程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' twemmin jew prinċipji, speċjalment reliġjużi; il-kelma tintuża wkoll għat-tagħlim Nisrani li jingħata lit-tfal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某种宗教、思想体系或团体所持的一套教义、学说或原则。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Duttrina hija ġabra ta' twemmin jew prinċipji li tħaddan reliġjon, skola ta' ħsieb jew organizzazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A doctrine is a set of beliefs or principles taught or accepted by a religion, school of thought, or organization.

sense_translations.en_definition: lessons in Christian doctrine given to children
sense_translations.zh_definition: 面向儿童、讲授基督教信仰与教义的教理课程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-duttrina hija tagħlim dwar il-fidi u t-twemmin Nisrani li jingħata lit-tfal f'lezzjonijiet apposta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When children attend duttrina, they receive lessons about Christian beliefs and religious teaching.

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jispjega l-prinċipji ewlenin tad-duttrina Nisranija u kif jiġu mgħallma lit-tfal.
formal.en: The chapter explains the main principles of Christian doctrine and how they are taught to children.
formal.zh: 本章阐述基督教教义的主要原则，以及如何向儿童讲授这些原则。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn sejjer wara l-iskola? Pawlu: Sejjer għad-duttrina. Illum għandna lezzjoni dwar il-maħfra.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where are you going after school? Pawlu: I'm going to Christian doctrine class. Today we have a lesson about forgiveness.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：放学后你去哪里？保罗：我去上教理课。今天我们有一堂关于宽恕的课。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 放学后你去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going after school?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejjer għad-duttrina. Illum għandna lezzjoni dwar il-maħfra.
messages.mt_standard: Sejjer għad-duttrina. Illum għandna lezzjoni dwar il-maħfra.
messages.zh: 我去上教理课。今天我们有一堂关于宽恕的课。
messages.en: I'm going to Christian doctrine class. Today we have a lesson about forgiveness.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 duttrina 连到两个画面：书中的一套教义，以及孩子去上的教理课；看到“去上”这类语境，就优先想到课程义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cloth placed over a table to protect its surface or decorate it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 铺在桌面上、用来保护或装饰桌子的布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dvalja hija biċċa drapp li titqiegħed fuq mejda biex tipproteġi l-wiċċ tagħha jew iżżejjinha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铺盖在桌面上以保护桌面或作装饰用的桌布。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dvalja hija għata tad-drapp li titqiegħed fuq il-mejda biex iżżommha nadifa, tipproteġiha jew iżżejjinha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tablecloth is a piece of fabric spread over a table to protect or decorate it.

formal.mt: Qabel jaslu l-mistednin, għandha titqiegħed dvalja nadifa fuq kull mejda.
formal.en: Before the guests arrive, a clean tablecloth should be placed on each table.
formal.zh: 客人到来之前，应在每张桌子上铺好干净的桌布。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qabel nieklu, tista' tbiddel id-dvalja? Mark: Iva, din għandha tebgħa. Inġib waħda nadifa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Before we eat, can you change the tablecloth? Mark: Yes, this one has a stain. I'll get a clean one.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：吃饭前，你能换一下桌布吗？马克：可以，这块有污渍。我去拿块干净的。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 吃饭前，你能换一下桌布吗？
messages.en: Before we eat, can you change the tablecloth?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, din għandha tebgħa. Inġib waħda nadifa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, din għandha tebgħa. Inġib waħda nadifa.
messages.zh: 可以，这块有污渍。我去拿块干净的。
messages.en: Yes, this one has a stain. I'll get a clean one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 dvalja 时想象铺桌布的动作：先铺平，再摆盘，弄脏后再换洗；把词与整张桌面上的布联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where people buy and drink alcoholic drinks, sometimes with food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人购买和饮用酒类、有时也供应食物的酒馆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dverna hija post fejn jinbiegħ u jinxtorob l-alkoħol, u fejn xi drabi jiġi servut ukoll l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供应酒类、供顾客饮酒聚谈，有时也提供食物的酒馆。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dverna hija stabbiliment fejn in-nies jistgħu jixtru u jixorbu xorb alkoħoliku, u xi drabi jieklu wkoll.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tavern is a place where people gather to buy and drink alcohol, sometimes with food.

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont jiddeskrivi dverna żgħira fejn il-vjaġġaturi jieqfu biex jistrieħu u jieħdu xi ħaġa x'jixorbu.
formal.en: The story describes a small tavern where travellers stop to rest and have something to drink.
formal.zh: 故事描写了一家小酒馆，旅人在那里停下来休息，喝点东西。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn se niltaqgħu llejla? Ġużeppi: Fid-dverna ħdejn il-pjazza. Hemm nistgħu noqogħdu nitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where shall we meet tonight? Ġużeppi: At the tavern near the square. We can sit and talk there.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：今晚我们在哪里见面？朱塞佩：在广场附近的酒馆。我们可以在那里坐着聊天。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 今晚我们在哪里见面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet tonight?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fid-dverna ħdejn il-pjazza. Hemm nistgħu noqogħdu nitkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Fid-dverna ħdejn il-pjazza. Hemm nistgħu noqogħdu nitkellmu.
messages.zh: 在广场附近的酒馆。我们可以在那里坐着聊天。
messages.en: At the tavern near the square. We can sit and talk there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dverna 记成一个场景：走进小酒馆，点杯饮料，与朋友坐下聊天；重点记住它表示聚饮的场所。

gloss_zh: 电子海关；电子海关系统

teaching_sense.en_definition: Customs administration carried out electronically, or the digital system used for customs procedures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过电子方式办理的海关业务，或用于处理海关手续的电子系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dwana elettronika hija l-amministrazzjoni tal-proċeduri doganali b'mezzi elettroniċi, jew is-sistema diġitali li tintuża għal dawn il-proċeduri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子海关，即利用电子服务办理和管理海关业务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-dwana elettronika hija l-użu ta' servizzi elettroniċi biex jitwettqu u jiġu amministrati proċeduri doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The term eCustoms refers to customs services and procedures managed through electronic technology.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以电子方式提交、处理和管理报关等手续的海关业务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-dwana elettronika hija t-twettiq ta' xogħol doganali permezz ta' mezzi elettroniċi, inklużi s-sottomissjoni u l-ipproċessar tad-dikjarazzjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Electronic customs involves submitting and processing customs information through digital services.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于电子提交报关资料、处理申报和管理海关手续的信息系统。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema tad-dwana elettronika hija sistema diġitali li tintuża biex jiġu sottomessi dikjarazzjonijiet doganali u jiġu pproċessati l-informazzjoni u l-proċeduri relatati magħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An electronic customs system is a digital platform used to submit declarations and manage customs procedures.

formal.mt: L-importatur issottometta d-dikjarazzjoni doganali permezz tas-sistema tad-dwana elettronika u rċieva konferma elettronika.
formal.en: The importer submitted the customs declaration through the electronic customs system and received electronic confirmation.
formal.zh: 进口商通过电子海关系统提交了报关单，并收到了电子确认。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għadni rrid nibgħat id-dikjarazzjoni doganali. Daniel: Tista' tibgħatha permezz tas-sistema tad-dwana elettronika. Sara: Tajjeb, se nidħol fis-sistema issa.
colloquial.en: Sara: I still need to send the customs declaration. Daniel: You can send it through the electronic customs system. Sara: Good, I'll log into the system now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我还得提交报关单。丹尼尔：你可以通过电子海关系统提交。萨拉：好，我现在就登录系统。

messages.speaker: Sara (进口业务员)
messages.zh: 我还得提交报关单。
messages.en: I still need to send the customs declaration.

messages.speaker: Daniel (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tibgħatha permezz tas-sistema tad-dwana elettronika.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tibgħatha permezz tas-sistema tad-dwana elettronika.
messages.zh: 你可以通过电子海关系统提交。
messages.en: You can send it through the electronic customs system.

messages.speaker: Sara (进口业务员)
messages.zh: 好，我现在就登录系统。
messages.en: Good, I'll log into the system now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dwana elettronika 想成电脑里的海关窗口：登录、提交报关资料、收到确认；将整个短语与电子办理海关手续联系起来。

gloss_zh: 孤立的房屋；独处一隅的住宅

teaching_sense.en_definition: A house that stands apart from other houses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 远离其他房屋、单独坐落的住宅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dar li tinsab waħedha, 'il bogħod minn djar oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与其他房屋相隔较远、单独坐落的一所住宅。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dar li tinsab waħedha f'post maqtugħ minn djar oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dwerja is a house that stands on its own, away from other houses.

collocations.en: an isolated house in the countryside
to live in an isolated house
collocations.zh: 住在独处一隅的房子里

formal.mt: Il-familja kienet tgħix f'dwerja fil-kampanja, 'il bogħod mill-eqreb raħal.
formal.en: The family lived in an isolated house in the countryside, far from the nearest village.
formal.zh: 这家人住在乡间一所孤立的房屋里，离最近的村庄很远。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn toqgħod iz-zija tiegħek? Mark: Toqgħod f'dwerja ħdejn l-għelieqi. Maja: Mela ma għandhiex djar oħra fil-qrib?
colloquial.en: Maja: Where does your aunt live? Mark: She lives in an isolated house by the fields. Maja: So there aren't any other houses nearby?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你姑妈住在哪里？Mark：她住在田地旁一所孤立的房子里。Maja：那她家附近没有别的房子吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你姑妈住在哪里？
messages.en: Where does your aunt live?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 她住在田地旁一所孤立的房子里。
messages.en: She lives in an isolated house by the fields.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ma għandhiex djar oħra fil-qrib?
messages.mt_standard: Mela ma għandhiex djar oħra fil-qrib?
messages.zh: 那她家附近没有别的房子吗？
messages.en: So there aren't any other houses nearby?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象田野中央只有一所房屋，周围没有邻居，用这个画面记住 dwerja 的孤立住宅义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: People belonging to the group known as the Hebrews.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 称为希伯来人的群体成员，为复数名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuni li jagħmlu parti mill-poplu magħruf bħala l-poplu Ebrajk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 希伯来人，指这一族群的多名成员或其整体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-persuni li jappartjenu għall-poplu Ebrajk, imsemmija bħala grupp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The Hebrews are the people who belong to the group known by that name.

formal.mt: Dan il-kapitlu jiddeskrivi l-ħajja tal-Ebrej kif tidher fit-test studjat.
formal.en: This chapter describes the lives of the Hebrews as presented in the text being studied.
formal.zh: 本章描述了所研读文本中呈现的希伯来人的生活。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fuq min qed taqra? Mark: Fuq l-Ebrej; għada għandna lezzjoni dwarhom. Sara: Nista' nara l-ktieb?
colloquial.en: Sara: Who are you reading about? Mark: The Hebrews; we have a lesson about them tomorrow. Sara: Can I have a look at the book?
colloquial.zh: Sara：你在读关于哪些人的内容？Mark：希伯来人；明天我们有一节关于他们的课。Sara：我可以看看这本书吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你在读关于哪些人的内容？
messages.en: Who are you reading about?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq l-Ebrej; għada għandna lezzjoni dwarhom.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq l-Ebrej; għada għandna lezzjoni dwarhom.
messages.zh: 希伯来人；明天我们有一节关于他们的课。
messages.en: The Hebrews; we have a lesson about them tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 我可以看看这本书吗？
messages.en: Can I have a look at the book?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ebrej 和一群希伯来人的画面配对记忆，重点记住这里指人，而且是复数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who regards pleasure as a central aim in life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把获得快乐或享受视为人生重要目标的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqis il-pjaċir bħala għan ewlieni fil-ħajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 享乐主义者；认为快乐或享受应在人生中占据核心地位的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Edonista huwa persuna li tagħti importanza kbira lill-pjaċir u tqisu bħala għan ewlieni tal-ħajja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hedonist is someone who considers pleasure a central aim of life.

collocations.zh: 以享乐主义者的方式生活

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tar-rumanz, l-awtriċi tiddeskrivi lill-protagonist bħala edonista li jqiegħed il-pjaċir qabel kull għan ieħor.
formal.en: In her analysis of the novel, the author describes the protagonist as a hedonist who places pleasure before every other aim.
formal.zh: 在对这部小说的分析中，作者把主人公描述为一个将享乐置于其他一切目标之上的享乐主义者。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex issejjaħ lilek innifsek edonista? Mark: Għax għalija l-pjaċir huwa wieħed mill-aktar affarijiet importanti fil-ħajja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you call yourself a hedonist? Mark: Because, for me, pleasure is one of the most important things in life.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么称自己为享乐主义者？马克：因为对我来说，享乐是人生中最重要的事情之一。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么称自己为享乐主义者？
messages.en: Why do you call yourself a hedonist?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għalija l-pjaċir huwa wieħed mill-aktar affarijiet importanti fil-ħajja.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għalija l-pjaċir huwa wieħed mill-aktar affarijiet importanti fil-ħajja.
messages.zh: 因为对我来说，享乐是人生中最重要的事情之一。
messages.en: Because, for me, pleasure is one of the most important things in life.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 edonista 配上一张人物卡：卡上的人把“享受快乐”写在人生目标首位。用人物记住“享乐主义者”，再与表示观念的 edoniżmu 对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The belief that pleasure is a central aim or guiding principle of life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把快乐或享受视为人生核心目标或行为指导原则的观念。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fehma li l-pjaċir huwa għan ewlieni jew prinċipju li jiggwida l-ħajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 享乐主义；主张以获得快乐或享受作为人生重要目标或行为原则的思想。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-edoniżmu huwa fehma li tqis il-pjaċir bħala għan ewlieni tal-ħajja jew bħala prinċipju li għandu jiggwida l-għażliet tal-bniedem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Hedonism is the belief that pleasure should be a central aim or guiding principle in life.

formal.mt: L-esej jeżamina l-edoniżmu u jistaqsi jekk il-pjaċir għandux ikun il-prinċipju ewlieni li jiggwida l-għażliet tagħna.
formal.en: The essay examines hedonism and asks whether pleasure should be the main principle guiding our choices.
formal.zh: 这篇文章探讨享乐主义，并提出一个问题：快乐是否应当成为指导我们作出选择的首要原则。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed taqra dwar l-edoniżmu? Pawlu: Iva, dwar il-fehma li l-pjaċir għandu jkun għan ewlieni fil-ħajja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you reading about hedonism? Pawlu: Yes, about the belief that pleasure should be a central aim in life.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你在读关于享乐主义的内容吗？保罗：是的，就是认为享乐应当成为人生核心目标的一种观念。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你在读关于享乐主义的内容吗？
messages.en: Are you reading about hedonism?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dwar il-fehma li l-pjaċir għandu jkun għan ewlieni fil-ħajja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dwar il-fehma li l-pjaċir għandu jkun għan ewlieni fil-ħajja.
messages.zh: 是的，就是认为享乐应当成为人生核心目标的一种观念。
messages.en: Yes, about the belief that pleasure should be a central aim in life.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 edoniżmu 写在一本“人生观念”笔记本封面上，内页写“以快乐为核心目标”。与人物卡 edonista 成对记忆：一个是观念，一个是持有观念的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Behaving respectfully towards others, or having received education.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容待人有礼貌的，或接受过教育的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib ruħu b'rispett u manjieri tajbin ma' ħaddieħor, jew li rċieva edukazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有礼貌的；言行尊重他人、举止得体的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Min hu edukat f'dan is-sens iġib ruħu b'rispett lejn ħaddieħor u juża manjieri tajbin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is polite behaves respectfully towards others and shows good manners.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受过教育的；通过学习或教育获得知识的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Min hu edukat f'dan is-sens ikun irċieva edukazzjoni u kiseb għarfien permezz tat-tagħlim.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is educated has received education and acquired knowledge through learning.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi lil David bħala bniedem edukat li għandu għarfien wiesa' miksub matul snin ta' studju.
formal.en: The report describes David as an educated person with broad knowledge acquired over years of study.
formal.zh: 报告把戴维描述为一位受过教育的人，他经过多年学习，获得了广博的知识。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm kien edukat dak it-tifel! Sara: Veru, qal grazzi u stenna sakemm spiċċajna nitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Maja: That boy was so polite! Sara: Yes, he said thank you and waited until we had finished speaking.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个男孩真有礼貌！萨拉：是啊，他说了谢谢，还等我们说完话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个男孩真有礼貌！
messages.en: That boy was so polite!

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, qal grazzi u stenna sakemm spiċċajna nitkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, qal grazzi u stenna sakemm spiċċajna nitkellmu.
messages.zh: 是啊，他说了谢谢，还等我们说完话。
messages.en: Yes, he said thank you and waited until we had finished speaking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 edukat 画两幅提示图：一幅是孩子说“谢谢”，提示“有礼貌”；另一幅是学生读书，提示“受过教育”。遇到这个词，先用上下文判断是哪幅图。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money used to pay for things or kept for future spending.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来支付物品或服务的金钱，也可指留作日后使用的钱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Flus li jintużaw biex jitħallsu oġġetti jew servizzi, jew li jinżammu għal ħtiġijiet futuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钱；可用于购买物品、支付服务或储蓄的金钱。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-efarju huwa flus li bihom wieħed jista' jixtri oġġetti, iħallas għal servizzi jew ifaddal għal aktar tard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Money is what people use to pay for goods and services or save for future needs.

formal.mt: Qabel ma jibda l-proġett, il-kumitat għandu jiżgura li hemm efarju biżżejjed biex jitħallsu l-ispejjeż kollha.
formal.en: Before the project begins, the committee should ensure that there is enough money to cover all the expenses.
formal.zh: 在项目开始之前，委员会应确保有足够的钱支付全部费用。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek efarju biżżejjed għall-biljetti? Rita: Iva, faddalt biżżejjed biex nixtrihom it-tnejn.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have enough money for the tickets? Rita: Yes, I saved enough to buy both of them.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你有足够的钱买票吗？丽塔：有，我存的钱足够买两张票。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有足够的钱买票吗？
messages.en: Do you have enough money for the tickets?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, faddalt biżżejjed biex nixtrihom it-tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, faddalt biżżejjed biex nixtrihom it-tnejn.
messages.zh: 有，我存的钱足够买两张票。
messages.en: Yes, I saved enough to buy both of them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 efarju 写在钱包图案旁，再联想“买票需要钱，存钱为了以后用”。连同 efarju biżżejjed 一起记，把词义固定在“足够的钱”这个具体场景中。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An effect that causes harm or damage to someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对人或事物造成伤害、损坏或其他不良后果的作用或影响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Effett li jikkawża ħsara lil persuna jew lil xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人或事物受到伤害或损害的影响。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Konsegwenza jew influwenza li tagħmel ħsara lil persuna jew lil xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An injurious effect is a consequence that causes harm or damage to a person or thing.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega l-effett dannuż tat-tniġġis fuq is-saħħa tar-residenti.
formal.en: The report explains the harmful effect of pollution on residents' health.
formal.zh: 报告说明了污染对居民健康的有害影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-istorbju għandu effett dannuż fuq l-irqad tiegħi. Pawlu: Ejja nagħlqu t-tieqa biex ikun hemm inqas storbju.
colloquial.en: Maja: This noise has a harmful effect on my sleep. Pawlu: Let's close the window so there is less noise.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这些噪声对我的睡眠有害。Pawlu：我们把窗户关上，让噪声小一点吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-istorbju għandu effett dannuż fuq l-irqad tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-istorbju għandu effett dannuż fuq l-irqad tiegħi.
messages.zh: 这些噪声对我的睡眠有害。
messages.en: This noise has a harmful effect on my sleep.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nagħlqu t-tieqa biex ikun hemm inqas storbju.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nagħlqu t-tieqa biex ikun hemm inqas storbju.
messages.zh: 我们把窗户关上，让噪声小一点吧。
messages.en: Let's close the window so there is less noise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语联想成“影响旁边画着受损标记”：看到 effett dannuż，就想到会造成伤害的影响，并用“对健康有害”练习搭配。

gloss_zh: 扭曲效应；导致失真的影响

teaching_sense.en_definition: An effect that makes something appear or operate differently from its true or normal state.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事物偏离真实状态或正常运作方式，造成失真或扭曲的作用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Effett li jġiegħel xi ħaġa tidher jew taħdem b'mod differenti mill-istat veru jew normali tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使事物的呈现、理解或运作发生扭曲的作用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Influwenza li tbiddel il-mod kif xi ħaġa tidher, tinftiehem jew taħdem, u tbegħedha mill-istat veru jew normali tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A distorting effect changes how something appears, is understood, or operates, making it less faithful to its true or normal state.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有造成失真或扭曲作用的影响。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Effett li għandu t-tendenza li joħloq distorsjoni fil-preżentazzjoni, fil-fehim jew fit-tħaddim ta' xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A distortive effect is an influence that tends to produce a misleading representation or an abnormal result.

collocations.en: a distorting effect on the image

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina jekk is-sussidju għandux effett distorsiv fuq il-kompetizzjoni bejn il-kumpaniji.
formal.en: The study examines whether the subsidy has a distortive effect on competition between companies.
formal.zh: 该研究考察这项补贴是否对企业之间的竞争产生扭曲效应。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex wiċċi jidher daqshekk twil fir-ritratt? Mark: Dan il-filtru għandu effett distorsiv. Ipprova neħħih.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does my face look so long in the photo? Mark: This filter has a distorting effect. Try removing it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：为什么照片里我的脸显得这么长？Mark：这个滤镜会造成失真。试着把它去掉。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex wiċċi jidher daqshekk twil fir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex wiċċi jidher daqshekk twil fir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 为什么照片里我的脸显得这么长？
messages.en: Why does my face look so long in the photo?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-filtru għandu effett distorsiv. Ipprova neħħih.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-filtru għandu effett distorsiv. Ipprova neħħih.
messages.zh: 这个滤镜会造成失真。试着把它去掉。
messages.en: This filter has a distorting effect. Try removing it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象滤镜把一张正常的脸拉长：这种“让原样变形”的作用就是 effett distorsiv。再把画面迁移到竞争或信息被扭曲的语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An effect caused by the presence of a border or boundary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由于边界或边境的存在而产生的影响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Effett li jirriżulta mill-preżenza ta' fruntiera jew ta' linja li tifred żewġ żoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 边界或边境的存在对相关地区、活动或相互联系所产生的影响。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Influwenza li l-preżenza ta' fruntiera għandha fuq iż-żoni li tifred, fuq l-attivitajiet fihom jew fuq ir-rabtiet bejniethom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A border effect is an influence that the presence of a boundary has on nearby areas or on interactions across it.

collocations.zh: 边境对贸易产生的影响

collocations.en: an analysis of the border effect

formal.mt: Ir-riċerka tanalizza l-effett fruntiera billi tqabbel il-kummerċ bejn reġjuni fl-istess pajjiż mal-kummerċ bejn reġjuni f'pajjiżi differenti.
formal.en: The research analyses the border effect by comparing trade between regions in the same country with trade between regions in different countries.
formal.zh: 该研究比较同一国家内地区之间的贸易与不同国家地区之间的贸易，以分析边境效应。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'jiġifieri effett fruntiera f'dan l-eżempju? Samwel: Jiġifieri l-influwenza tal-fruntiera fuq il-kummerċ bejn iż-żewġ naħat.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does border effect mean in this example? Samwel: It means the influence of the border on trade between the two sides.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个例子里的边境效应是什么意思？Samwel：就是边境对两边贸易产生的影响。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这个例子里的边境效应是什么意思？
messages.en: What does border effect mean in this example?

messages.speaker: Samwel (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri l-influwenza tal-fruntiera fuq il-kummerċ bejn iż-żewġ naħat.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri l-influwenza tal-fruntiera fuq il-kummerċ bejn iż-żewġ naħat.
messages.zh: 就是边境对两边贸易产生的影响。
messages.en: It means the influence of the border on trade between the two sides.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在地图上画一条分界线，再问“这条线带来了什么影响”：把线与影响连起来，就能记住 effett fruntiera 的边界效应含义。

gloss_zh: 他们实施了；他们完成了；他们促成了

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form used to say that people carried out an action or brought about a result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于表示他们已经实施某项行动、完成某事或促成某种结果的形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma li tindika li huma wettqu azzjoni jew ġabu riżultat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示他们实施了某项行动，或使某项变化、结果得以实现。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Forma li tesprimi li huma wettqu xi ħaġa jew wasslu biex isseħħ bidla jew jinkiseb riżultat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If people effected something, they carried it out or caused it to happen.

formal.mt: L-uffiċjali effettwaw il-ħlas wara li vverifikaw id-dokumenti kollha meħtieġa.
formal.en: The officials made the payment after verifying all the required documents.
formal.zh: 工作人员核验所有所需文件后完成了付款。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-klijenti effettwaw il-ħlas? David: Iva, ħallsu dalgħodu u bagħtu l-konferma.
colloquial.en: Rita: Have the customers made the payment? David: Yes, they paid this morning and sent the confirmation.
colloquial.zh: Rita：客户已经完成付款了吗？David：是的，他们今天早上付了款，还发来了确认。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 客户已经完成付款了吗？
messages.en: Have the customers made the payment?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħallsu dalgħodu u bagħtu l-konferma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħallsu dalgħodu u bagħtu l-konferma.
messages.zh: 是的，他们今天早上付了款，还发来了确认。
messages.en: Yes, they paid this morning and sent the confirmation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几个人一起把待办事项打上完成勾，再说“他们实施了、他们办成了”。用 effettwaw il-ħlas 记住“他们完成了付款”的完整场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a change that has been brought about or an action that has been carried out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某项改变已经实现，或某项行动已经执行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi bidla li saret jew azzjoni li twettqet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已促成的；已实现的，指改变或结果已经成为事实。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi tibdil jew riżultat li nġieb fis-seħħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A change described as effected has been brought about and is now a reality.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已执行的；已完成的，用于描述行动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi azzjoni li twettqet jew li ġiet eżegwita.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An action described as effected has actually been carried out.

collocations.en: a payment that has been made

formal.mt: It-tibdil effetwat fil-proċedura naqqas iż-żmien ta' stennija.
formal.en: The changes implemented in the procedure reduced the waiting time.
formal.zh: 程序中已落实的改动缩短了等候时间。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Sar il-ħlas? Lara: Iva, hawn miktub li l-ħlas ġie effetwat dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Has the payment been made? Lara: Yes, it says here that the payment was made this morning.
colloquial.zh: 马克：付款完成了吗？拉拉：完成了，这里写着今天早上已经付款。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 付款完成了吗？
messages.en: Has the payment been made?

messages.speaker: Lara (职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn miktub li l-ħlas ġie effetwat dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn miktub li l-ħlas ġie effetwat dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 完成了，这里写着今天早上已经付款。
messages.en: Yes, it says here that the payment was made this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词放进“改动已落实、付款已完成”两个场景中记忆，抓住事情已经办成这一共同点。

gloss_zh: 短暂之物；转瞬即逝的事物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that lasts only a short time and soon disappears.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 只存在很短时间、很快便会消逝的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li jdum għal żmien qasir biss u malajr jgħaddi jew jisparixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 短暂之物；存在时间很短、转瞬即逝的事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li teżisti għal ftit żmien biss u li ma tibqax.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The ephemeral consists of things that exist briefly and soon pass away.

formal.mt: Il-wirja tesplora l-ġmiel tal-effimeru permezz ta' ritratti ta' fjuri li jdumu miftuħa għal ġurnata waħda biss.
formal.en: The exhibition explores the beauty of the ephemeral through photographs of flowers that remain open for only one day.
formal.zh: 展览通过只开放一天的花朵的照片，探索短暂之物的美。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tieħu ritratt tas-sħab? Pawlu: Għax jogħġobni l-ġmiel tal-effimeru; dalwaqt jinbidel kollox.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you taking a photograph of the clouds? Pawlu: Because I like the beauty of the ephemeral; everything will change soon.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么在拍云？保罗：因为我喜欢转瞬即逝之物的美；一会儿一切就变样了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在拍云？
messages.en: Why are you taking a photograph of the clouds?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (摄影爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jogħġobni l-ġmiel tal-effimeru; dalwaqt jinbidel kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jogħġobni l-ġmiel tal-effimeru; dalwaqt jinbidel kollox.
messages.zh: 因为我喜欢转瞬即逝之物的美；一会儿一切就变样了。
messages.en: Because I like the beauty of the ephemeral; everything will change soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刚拍下的云马上变了形，用“留得住照片，留不住瞬间”记住短暂之物这一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who puts their own interests first and gives little consideration to other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把自身利益放在首位，很少顾及他人需要或感受的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqiegħed l-interessi tagħha l-ewwel u ftit tagħti kas tal-bżonnijiet jew tas-sentimenti ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利己主义者；以自身利益为主要考虑的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tqis l-interess tagħha bħala l-aktar ħaġa importanti meta tieħu deċiżjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An egoist is someone who regards their own interests as more important than those of others.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自私的人；只顾自己而不顾他人需要或感受的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taħseb fiha nfisha u ma tagħtix kas biżżejjed tal-bżonnijiet jew tas-sentimenti ta' ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A selfish person cares mainly about their own wishes and gives too little consideration to others.

collocations.en: to act like a selfish person

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru prinċipali huwa egoist li jfittex il-vantaġġ tiegħu anki meta jagħmel ħsara lil ħaddieħor.
formal.en: In the novel, the main character is an egoist who pursues his own advantage even when it harms others.
formal.zh: 小说中的主人公是个利己主义者，即使会伤害他人，也要追求自身利益。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħallejt xi kejk għalina? Mark: Le, kiltu kollu. Sara: Kemm int egoist! Aħna wkoll ridna biċċa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you leave any cake for us? Mark: No, I ate it all. Sara: You're so selfish! We wanted a piece too.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你给我们留蛋糕了吗？马克：没有，我全吃了。萨拉：你真自私！我们也想吃一块。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你给我们留蛋糕了吗？
messages.en: Did you leave any cake for us?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，我全吃了。
messages.en: No, I ate it all.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm int egoist! Aħna wkoll ridna biċċa.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm int egoist! Aħna wkoll ridna biċċa.
messages.zh: 你真自私！我们也想吃一块。
messages.en: You're so selfish! We wanted a piece too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人独吞整块蛋糕、不给朋友留一口，把这个词与“只顾自己的人”绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The attitude or quality of putting your own interests before the needs and feelings of other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把自己的利益置于他人需要和感受之上的态度或品质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attitudni jew il-kwalità li wieħed iqiegħed l-interessi tiegħu qabel il-bżonnijiet u s-sentimenti ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利己主义；以自身利益为首要考虑的观念或态度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attitudni li tqis l-interess personali bħala l-ewwel prijorità fid-deċiżjonijiet u fl-imġiba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Egoism is an attitude in which a person gives priority to their own interests.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自私；只顾自己的愿望和利益，缺乏对他人的体谅。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kwalità li wieħed jaħseb fih innifsu u ma jagħtix kas biżżejjed tal-bżonnijiet jew tas-sentimenti ta' ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Selfishness is the quality of caring about your own wishes without enough concern for other people.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi d-deċiżjoni li jinżammu r-riżorsi kollha għal grupp wieħed bħala att ta' egoiżmu.
formal.en: The report describes the decision to keep all the resources for one group as an act of selfishness.
formal.zh: 报告将把全部资源留给单一群体的决定描述为一种自私行为。
