colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ħadt l-aħħar żewġ biċċiet mingħajr ma staqsejt? Pawlu: Għandek raġun, dak kien egoiżmu min-naħa tiegħi. Ħu waħda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you take the last two pieces without asking? Pawlu: You're right, that was selfishness on my part. Have one.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么不问一声就拿走最后两块？保罗：你说得对，是我自私了。给你一块。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħadt l-aħħar żewġ biċċiet mingħajr ma staqsejt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħadt l-aħħar żewġ biċċiet mingħajr ma staqsejt?
messages.zh: 你为什么不问一声就拿走最后两块？
messages.en: Why did you take the last two pieces without asking?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun, dak kien egoiżmu min-naħa tiegħi. Ħu waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun, dak kien egoiżmu min-naħa tiegħi. Ħu waħda.
messages.zh: 你说得对，是我自私了。给你一块。
messages.en: You're right, that was selfishness on my part. Have one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用人物与态度配对记忆：egoist 指自私的人，egoiżmu 指这个人表现出的自私或利己态度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a church, its institutions, or its official affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与教会、教会机构或教会正式事务有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Knisja, mal-istituzzjonijiet tagħha jew mal-ħidma uffiċjali tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 教会的；与教会组织、制度或正式事务有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-Knisja bħala istituzzjoni, l-organizzazzjoni tagħha jew l-affarijiet uffiċjali tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ecclesiastical matters are connected with a church, its organization, or its official activities.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi r-rwol tat-tribunal ekkleżjastiku fl-organizzazzjoni tal-Knisja.
formal.en: The report describes the role of the ecclesiastical tribunal within the organization of the Church.
formal.zh: 报告说明了教会法庭在教会组织中的作用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser 'ekkleżjastiku' f'dan it-test? Mark: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Knisja jew mal-affarijiet tagħha.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'ecclesiastical' mean in this text? Mark: It means relating to the Church or its affairs.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这篇文章里的“ekkleżjastiku”是什么意思？马克：意思是与教会或教会事务有关的。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的“ekkleżjastiku”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ecclesiastical' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Knisja jew mal-affarijiet tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Knisja jew mal-affarijiet tagħha.
messages.zh: 意思是与教会或教会事务有关的。
messages.en: It means relating to the Church or its affairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ekkleżjastiku 写在“教会事务”文件夹的标签上，再联想教会法和教会法庭，帮助记住它表示所属领域。

gloss_zh: 协作消费；协作经济；共享经济

teaching_sense.en_definition: An economic model in which people share access to goods, services, or other resources through cooperation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们通过合作，共享物品、服务或其他资源使用机会的经济模式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mudell ekonomiku li fih in-nies jikkooperaw biex jaqsmu l-użu ta' oġġetti, servizzi jew riżorsi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 协作消费；人们通过共享、借用或交换等方式，合作满足物品或服务使用需求的消费方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mod ta' konsum li fih in-nies jissodisfaw il-ħtiġijiet tagħhom billi jaqsmu, jissellfu jew ipartu oġġetti jew servizzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Collaborative consumption is a way of meeting people's needs through shared access, borrowing, or exchange of goods and services.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 协作经济；个人或组织通过合作，提供、使用或交换资源、产品与服务的经济模式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mudell ekonomiku li fih individwi jew organizzazzjonijiet jaħdmu flimkien biex jipprovdu, jużaw jew jiskambjaw riżorsi, prodotti u servizzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A collaborative economy involves people or organizations cooperating to provide, use, or exchange resources, products, and services.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 共享经济；让不同使用者共享物品或服务使用机会、提高资源利用程度的经济模式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mudell ekonomiku li jippermetti lil persuni differenti jaqsmu l-aċċess għal oġġetti jew servizzi biex ir-riżorsi jintużaw aħjar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sharing economy enables different people to access and use shared goods or services.

formal.mt: Il-proġett juża mudell ta' ekonomija kollaborattiva biex ir-residenti jkunu jistgħu jaqsmu l-użu tal-għodod.
formal.en: The project uses a collaborative economy model to enable residents to share the use of tools.
formal.zh: 该项目采用协作经济模式，让居民能够共享工具的使用权。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi bżonn sellum, imma għal ġurnata biss. Toni: Fuq din il-pjattaforma tal-ekonomija kollaborattiva tista' tissellef wieħed mingħand ġar.
colloquial.en: Lara: I need a ladder, but only for one day. Toni: On this sharing economy platform, you can borrow one from a neighbour.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我需要一把梯子，不过只用一天。托尼：在这个共享经济平台上，你可以向邻居借一把。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonn sellum, imma għal ġurnata biss.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonn sellum, imma għal ġurnata biss.
messages.zh: 我需要一把梯子，不过只用一天。
messages.en: I need a ladder, but only for one day.

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq din il-pjattaforma tal-ekonomija kollaborattiva tista' tissellef wieħed mingħand ġar.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq din il-pjattaforma tal-ekonomija kollaborattiva tista' tissellef wieħed mingħand ġar.
messages.zh: 在这个共享经济平台上，你可以向邻居借一把。
messages.en: On this sharing economy platform, you can borrow one from a neighbour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一栋楼的邻居轮流借用同一把梯子：从个人消费看是协作消费，从整体安排看是协作或共享经济，用这个场景记住整个词组。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The living organisms in an area together with their physical environment and the interactions between them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一定区域内的生物、它们所处的非生物环境以及彼此相互作用所组成的系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sistema magħmula mill-ħlejjaq ħajjin f'żona, mill-ambjent fiżiku tagħhom u mill-interazzjonijiet bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生态系统；由一定区域内的生物群落、非生物环境及其相互作用构成的整体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħlejjaq ħajjin ta' żona flimkien mal-elementi mhux ħajjin tal-ambjent tagħhom u r-relazzjonijiet li jgħaqqduhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An ecosystem consists of the living things in an area and the physical environment with which they interact.

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina kif it-tniġġis tal-ilma jaffettwa l-pjanti u l-annimali f'din l-ekosistema.
formal.en: The study examines how water pollution affects the plants and animals in this ecosystem.
formal.zh: 该研究考察水污染如何影响这一生态系统中的植物和动物。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din l-għadira żgħira hi ekosistema wkoll? David: Iva, għax il-ħlejjaq li jgħixu fiha jinteraġixxu ma' xulxin u mal-ilma u t-tajn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this little pond an ecosystem too? David: Yes, because the living things in it interact with one another and with the water and mud.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个小池塘也是一个生态系统吗？戴维：是的，因为里面的生物彼此相互作用，也与水和泥相互作用。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Din l-għadira żgħira hi ekosistema wkoll?
messages.mt_standard: Din l-għadira żgħira hi ekosistema wkoll?
messages.zh: 这个小池塘也是一个生态系统吗？
messages.en: Is this little pond an ecosystem too?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax il-ħlejjaq li jgħixu fiha jinteraġixxu ma' xulxin u mal-ilma u t-tajn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax il-ħlejjaq li jgħixu fiha jinteraġixxu ma' xulxin u mal-ilma u t-tajn.
messages.zh: 是的，因为里面的生物彼此相互作用，也与水和泥相互作用。
messages.en: Yes, because the living things in it interact with one another and with the water and mud.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一个池塘，把鱼、水草、水和泥用箭头连起来；生物加环境再加相互作用，合起来就是 ekosistema。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The network of people, organizations, resources, and conditions that supports the creation and growth of businesses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由创业者、机构、资源及相关环境条件构成，支持企业创立和发展的相互联系的体系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-netwerk ta' nies, organizzazzjonijiet, riżorsi u kundizzjonijiet li jgħinu biex jinħolqu u jikbru n-negozji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 创业生态系统；由创业者及支持企业创立和发展的机构、资源与环境构成的网络。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ekosistema intraprenditorjali hija netwerk ta' intraprendituri, istituzzjonijiet, riżorsi u servizzi li flimkien jappoġġjaw il-ħolqien u t-tkabbir tan-negozji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An entrepreneurial ecosystem is a network of people, organizations, and resources that helps businesses start and develop.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 创业生态系统；使创业活动得以开展和持续发展的相互关联的参与者、资源及条件的整体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ekosistema intraprenditorjali hija l-ġabra ta' parteċipanti, riżorsi u kundizzjonijiet marbuta ma' xulxin li jippermettu u jsostnu l-attività intraprenditorjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An entrepreneurship ecosystem consists of the connected participants and conditions that enable entrepreneurial activity to develop.

collocations.en: the development of an entrepreneurial ecosystem

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza li ekosistema intraprenditorjali b'saħħitha teħtieġ kollaborazzjoni bejn l-universitajiet, l-investituri u n-negozji.
formal.en: The report emphasizes that a strong entrepreneurial ecosystem requires collaboration among universities, investors, and businesses.
formal.zh: 报告强调，强健的创业生态系统需要大学、投资者与企业之间的合作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed naħseb biex niftaħ negozju, imma ma nafx minn fejn nibda. Mark: Hawn ekosistema intraprenditorjali tajba; nista' nlaqqgħek ma' xi ħadd li jgħinek.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm thinking of starting a business, but I don't know where to begin. Mark: There's a good entrepreneurial ecosystem here; I can introduce you to someone who can help.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我在考虑创业，但不知道从哪里开始。Mark：这里的创业生态系统不错，我可以介绍一个能帮你的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (准备创业的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naħseb biex niftaħ negozju, imma ma nafx minn fejn nibda.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naħseb biex niftaħ negozju, imma ma nafx minn fejn nibda.
messages.zh: 我在考虑创业，但不知道从哪里开始。
messages.en: I'm thinking of starting a business, but I don't know where to begin.

messages.speaker: Mark (有创业经验的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ekosistema intraprenditorjali tajba; nista' nlaqqgħek ma' xi ħadd li jgħinek.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ekosistema intraprenditorjali tajba; nista' nlaqqgħek ma' xi ħadd li jgħinek.
messages.zh: 这里的创业生态系统不错，我可以介绍一个能帮你的人。
messages.en: There's a good entrepreneurial ecosystem here; I can introduce you to someone who can help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把创业者、大学和投资者想成彼此连接的支援网络；整张网络就是 ekosistema intraprenditorjali，连同“创业生态系统”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A label indicating that a product meets specified environmental criteria.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表明产品符合特定环境要求的标签。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikketta li tindika li prodott jissodisfa ċerti kriterji ambjentali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 环保标签；用来标示产品符合有关环境友好性要求的标签。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ekotikketta hija tikketta li tindika li prodott jissodisfa ċerti rekwiżiti dwar il-ħarsien tal-ambjent.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An eco-friendly label indicates that a product meets particular requirements intended to reduce environmental harm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生态标签；用于标示产品符合特定环境标准的标识。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ekotikketta hija marka fuq prodott li turi li dan jissodisfa kriterji ambjentali speċifiċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An eco-label is a mark identifying a product as meeting specified environmental criteria.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 环境友好标签；表明产品符合有关减少环境损害要求的标签。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ekotikketta hija tikketta li turi li prodott jilħaq ċerti kriterji maħsuba biex inaqqsu l-ħsara lill-ambjent.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An environment-friendly label shows that a product satisfies particular criteria concerning its impact on the environment.

formal.mt: Qabel jixtru l-prodott, il-konsumaturi għandhom jaqraw x'tindika l-ekotikketta dwar il-karatteristiċi ambjentali tiegħu.
formal.en: Before buying the product, consumers should read what the eco-label indicates about its environmental characteristics.
formal.zh: 购买产品前，消费者应阅读环保标签，了解它所说明的产品环境特性。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan is-sapun għandu ekotikketta? Pawlu: Iva, ara din il-marka fuq il-pakkett.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this soap have an eco-label? Pawlu: Yes, look at this mark on the packaging.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这款肥皂有环保标签吗？Pawlu：有，你看包装上的这个标识。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这款肥皂有环保标签吗？
messages.en: Does this soap have an eco-label?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara din il-marka fuq il-pakkett.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara din il-marka fuq il-pakkett.
messages.zh: 有，你看包装上的这个标识。
messages.en: Yes, look at this mark on the packaging.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象购物时先看包装上的环保标识，再默念 ekotikketta；把“产品上的环保标签”这一完整画面与词形绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The imaginary line around the Earth at equal distances from the North and South Poles, dividing it into northern and southern hemispheres.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 环绕地球、与南北两极等距的假想线，将地球分为南北半球。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-linja immaġinarja madwar id-Dinja li tinsab f'distanza ugwali miż-żewġ poli u taqsamha f'emisferu tat-Tramuntana u emisferu tan-Nofsinhar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赤道；环绕地球、与南北两极等距并划分南北半球的假想线。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ekwatur huwa l-linja immaġinarja madwar id-Dinja, f'distanza ugwali mill-Pol tat-Tramuntana u mill-Pol tan-Nofsinhar, li tifred iż-żewġ emisferi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The equator is an imaginary line around the Earth that lies equally far from both poles and separates the northern and southern hemispheres.

formal.mt: Fuq il-mappa, l-ekwatur huwa mmarkat bħala l-linja ta' latitudni żero.
formal.en: On the map, the equator is marked as the line of zero degrees latitude.
formal.zh: 地图上将赤道标为零度纬线。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hu l-ekwatur fuq dan il-globu? David: Ara din il-linja fin-nofs; din hi l-ekwatur.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is the equator on this globe? David: Look at this line in the middle; that's the equator.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个地球仪上的赤道在哪里？David：看中间这条线，这就是赤道。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-ekwatur fuq dan il-globu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-ekwatur fuq dan il-globu?
messages.zh: 这个地球仪上的赤道在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the equator on this globe?

messages.speaker: David (地理老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara din il-linja fin-nofs; din hi l-ekwatur.
messages.mt_standard: Ara din il-linja fin-nofs; din hi l-ekwatur.
messages.zh: 看中间这条线，这就是赤道。
messages.en: Look at this line in the middle; that's the equator.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把地球想成系着一条中间腰带的球体，腰带位置就是赤道；指着这条线读 ekwatur，帮助建立词义画面。

gloss_zh: 全体船员；全体机组人员

teaching_sense.en_definition: The group of people who work together to operate a ship, aircraft, or similar vehicle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 共同负责船舶、飞机等交通工具运行及相关工作的全体工作人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-grupp ta' nies li jaħdmu flimkien biex imexxu vapur, ajruplan jew vettura simili u jagħmlu x-xogħol meħtieġ abbord.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 船舶、飞机等交通工具上的全体工作人员，如全体船员或机组人员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ekwipaġġ huwa l-grupp kollu ta' persuni li jaħdmu abbord vapur, ajruplan jew vettura simili biex imexxuh u jieħdu ħsieb is-servizzi meħtieġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The crew of a ship or aircraft consists of the people who work on board to operate it and provide the necessary services.

formal.mt: Qabel it-tluq, l-ekwipaġġ tal-vapur wettaq il-kontrolli tas-sigurtà meħtieġa.
formal.en: Before departure, the ship's crew carried out the required safety checks.
formal.zh: 出发前，船上的全体船员完成了必要的安全检查。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ma nafx fejn hu s-siġġu tiegħi. Toni: Staqsi lil xi ħadd mill-ekwipaġġ; jgħinek issibu.
colloquial.en: Sara: I don't know where my seat is. Toni: Ask someone from the crew; they'll help you find it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我不知道我的座位在哪里。Toni：问一位机组人员吧，对方会帮你找到。

messages.speaker: Sara (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx fejn hu s-siġġu tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx fejn hu s-siġġu tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我不知道我的座位在哪里。
messages.en: I don't know where my seat is.

messages.speaker: Toni (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsi lil xi ħadd mill-ekwipaġġ; jgħinek issibu.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsi lil xi ħadd mill-ekwipaġġ; jgħinek issibu.
messages.zh: 问一位机组人员吧，对方会帮你找到。
messages.en: Ask someone from the crew; they'll help you find it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象船上或飞机上的工作人员集合报到：整个工作团队叫 ekwipaġġ，其中一位成员叫 membru tal-ekwipaġġ，用整体与成员的对照来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Equipment consists of the tools, machines, or other items needed for a particular activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进行某项活动或工作所需的工具、机器及其他器材的统称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ekwippment huwa s-sett ta' għodod, magni u oġġetti oħra meħtieġa għal xogħol jew attività partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于特定工作、活动或用途的设备、工具及器材。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ekwippment jinkludi l-għodod, il-magni u l-oġġetti l-oħra li jintużaw biex isir xogħol jew titwettaq attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Equipment is the collection of tools, machines, and other items that you need for a particular purpose.

formal.mt: Qabel jibda x-xogħol, il-persunal għandu jiċċekkja li l-ekwippment kollu jkun f'kundizzjoni tajba.
formal.en: Before work begins, staff must check that all the equipment is in good condition.
formal.zh: 工作开始前，员工必须检查所有设备是否状态良好。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandna l-ekwippment kollu għat-taħriġ? Pawlu: Iva, il-blalen u l-koni qegħdin fil-borża.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have we got all the equipment for training? Pawlu: Yes, the balls and cones are in the bag.
colloquial.zh: Lara：训练要用的器材都齐了吗？Pawlu：齐了，球和标志锥都在包里。

messages.speaker: Lara (教练)
messages.zh: 训练要用的器材都齐了吗？
messages.en: Have we got all the equipment for training?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (助教)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-blalen u l-koni qegħdin fil-borża.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-blalen u l-koni qegħdin fil-borża.
messages.zh: 齐了，球和标志锥都在包里。
messages.en: Yes, the balls and cones are in the bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ekwippment 联想成训练前清点的一整套器材：球、标志锥和工具一起归入“装备设备”。

gloss_zh: 等值的；相当的；等同的事物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something equivalent has the same value, meaning, effect, or function as something else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示与另一事物在价值、意义、效果或功能上相等或相当，也可指这样的对应事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa ekwivalenti għandha l-istess valur, tifsira, effett jew funzjoni bħal xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与另一事物在价值、意义、效果或功能上相等或相当的；具有这种对应关系的事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kelma ekwivalenti tindika li xi ħaġa għandha l-istess valur, tifsira, effett jew funzjoni bħal oħra, jew tirreferi għal ħaġa li għandha din ir-relazzjoni ma' oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If one thing is equivalent to another, it has the same value, meaning, effect, or function in the relevant context.

formal.mt: Għall-kalkolu tal-ħin, siegħa hija ekwivalenti għal sittin minuta.
formal.en: For calculating time, one hour is equivalent to sixty minutes.
formal.zh: 计算时间时，一小时等于六十分钟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mitt ċentimetru huma ekwivalenti għal metru? Mark: Iva, huma l-istess tul.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are one hundred centimetres equivalent to one metre? Mark: Yes, they are the same length.
colloquial.zh: Maja：一百厘米等于一米吗？Mark：对，长度是一样的。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mitt ċentimetru huma ekwivalenti għal metru?
messages.mt_standard: Mitt ċentimetru huma ekwivalenti għal metru?
messages.zh: 一百厘米等于一米吗？
messages.en: Are one hundred centimetres equivalent to one metre?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 对，长度是一样的。
messages.en: Yes, they are the same length.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象天平两边分别写着“一米”和“一百厘米”：写法不同，量值相等，用 ekwivalenti 连接。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Eczema is a skin condition that causes itching, inflammation, and often dry or cracked skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种使皮肤发痒、出现炎症，并常伴有干燥或皲裂的皮肤病。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ekżema hija kundizzjoni tal-ġilda li tikkawża ħakk u infjammazzjoni, u ħafna drabi tagħmel il-ġilda niexfa jew maqsuma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 湿疹，一种以皮肤瘙痒和炎症为主要表现、常伴干燥或皲裂的皮肤病。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ekżema hija kundizzjoni li fiha l-ġilda tkun infjammata u tħokk, u tista' ssir niexfa jew tinqasam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Eczema is a skin condition in which areas of skin become inflamed and itchy, often with dryness or cracking.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ ta' ekżema fl-idejn, b'ħakk u ġilda niexfa.
formal.en: The report describes a case of hand eczema with itching and dry skin.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一例手部湿疹，症状包括瘙痒和皮肤干燥。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed togħrok idejk? Karl: Għandi l-ekżema u llum idejja qed iħokku ħafna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you rubbing your hands? Karl: I have eczema, and my hands are very itchy today.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么一直搓手？Karl：我有湿疹，今天手特别痒。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么一直搓手？
messages.en: Why are you rubbing your hands?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi l-ekżema u llum idejja qed iħokku ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi l-ekżema u llum idejja qed iħokku ħafna.
messages.zh: 我有湿疹，今天手特别痒。
messages.en: I have eczema, and my hands are very itchy today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ekżema 配上“皮肤发痒、干燥”的画面记忆；虽然中文叫湿疹，也要记住它可伴皮肤干燥。

gloss_zh: 精心设计的；详尽的；繁复的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something elaborate is carefully developed and contains many details or connected parts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过精心构思或制作，包含许多细节或相互关联部分的；可形容设计、计划或说明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa elaborata tkun maħsuba jew magħmula b'ħafna dettalji u b'attenzjoni kbira, u jista' jkollha ħafna partijiet marbuta flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精心构思、制作或展开，具有许多细节或复杂组成部分的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kelma elaborat tiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li fiha ħafna dettalji u li tkun ġiet żviluppata jew magħmula b'ħafna ħsieb u attenzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An elaborate design, plan, or explanation contains many carefully developed details and may be complex in its arrangement.

collocations.zh: 精心制作、细节丰富的模型

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ippreżenta pjan elaborat għaċ-ċerimonja, b'ħinijiet preċiżi u rwoli ċari għal kull parteċipant.
formal.en: The committee presented an elaborate plan for the ceremony, with precise timings and clear roles for every participant.
formal.zh: 委员会提交了一份周密详尽的典礼计划，为每位参与者规定了准确的时间安排和明确的职责。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ara dan il-kejk! Għandu disinn elaborat ħafna. Luqa: Veru, kull fjura għandha dettalji żgħar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Look at this cake! It has such an elaborate design. Luqa: It really does; every flower has tiny details.
colloquial.zh: Sara：看这个蛋糕！它的设计真精细。Luqa：确实，每朵花都有细小的细节。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dan il-kejk! Għandu disinn elaborat ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Ara dan il-kejk! Għandu disinn elaborat ħafna.
messages.zh: 看这个蛋糕！它的设计真精细。
messages.en: Look at this cake! It has such an elaborate design.

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, kull fjura għandha dettalji żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, kull fjura għandha dettalji żgħar.
messages.zh: 确实，每朵花都有细小的细节。
messages.en: It really does; every flower has tiny details.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个连花瓣纹路都精心做出的蛋糕，用 elaborat 记住“细节丰富、精心设计”的感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to stretch and return to its original shape when released.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指材料能够被拉伸，并在拉力消失后恢复原来形状的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jiġġebbed u jerġa' jieħu l-għamla oriġinali tiegħu meta titneħħa l-forza li tkun qed tiġbdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有弹性的，能够拉伸后恢复原状的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi materjal li jiġġebbed meta jinġibed u jerġa' lura għall-għamla oriġinali tiegħu meta jinħeles.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An elastic material stretches when you pull it and returns to its original shape when you release it.

formal.mt: Għal dan l-ilbies sportiv, għandu jintuża drapp elastiku li jippermetti moviment komdu.
formal.en: Elastic fabric that allows comfortable movement should be used for this sportswear.
formal.zh: 这款运动服应使用能够让人舒适活动的弹性面料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan id-drapp elastiku? Mark: Iva, iġġebbed ftit u mbagħad jerġa' lura kif kien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this fabric elastic? Mark: Yes, it stretches a little and then goes back to how it was.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这块布有弹性吗？马克：有，拉开一点后，它就会恢复原状。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这块布有弹性吗？
messages.en: Is this fabric elastic?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iġġebbed ftit u mbagħad jerġa' lura kif kien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iġġebbed ftit u mbagħad jerġa' lura kif kien.
messages.zh: 有，拉开一点后，它就会恢复原状。
messages.en: Yes, it stretches a little and then goes back to how it was.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拉伸运动服后松手，布料恢复原状；把这个动作与 drapp elastiku 一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Attractive and graceful in appearance, style, or manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指外表、风格或举止优美得体，给人雅致感觉的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu dehra, stil jew imġiba sabiħa u raffinata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 优雅的，指外表、设计或举止优美而有格调。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna, ħaġa jew imġiba li tidher sabiħa, raffinata u ta' togħma tajba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is elegant has a graceful appearance or a refined and attractive style.

formal.mt: Is-sala għandha disinn eleganti, b'kuluri ċari u għamara sempliċi.
formal.en: The hall has an elegant design, with light colours and simple furniture.
formal.zh: 大厅的设计雅致，采用浅色调和简洁的家具。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif tidher din il-libsa? Nina: Eleganti ħafna! Tmur tajjeb għaċ-ċena ta' għada.
colloquial.en: Sara: How does this dress look? Nina: Very elegant! It would be great for tomorrow's dinner.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这条连衣裙看起来怎么样？妮娜：很优雅！很适合明天的晚餐。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这条连衣裙看起来怎么样？
messages.en: How does this dress look?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Eleganti ħafna! Tmur tajjeb għaċ-ċena ta' għada.
messages.mt_standard: Eleganti ħafna! Tmur tajjeb għaċ-ċena ta' għada.
messages.zh: 很优雅！很适合明天的晚餐。
messages.en: Very elegant! It would be great for tomorrow's dinner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 eleganti 与英语 elegant 对照记忆，再想象一条剪裁得体的裙子，联想“优雅、雅致”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An individual part or feature that contributes to a larger whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 构成一个整体，或对其性质和运作产生作用的单个部分或特征。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti jew karatteristika individwali li tifforma parti minn ħaġa sħiħa jew tikkontribwixxi għaliha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 要素，构成整体或影响整体的一个部分或特征。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Wieħed mill-partijiet jew mill-aspetti li flimkien jiffurmaw ħaġa sħiħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An element of something is one of the individual parts or features that make up the whole.

formal.mt: Il-komunikazzjoni ċara hija element ewlieni fil-ħidma ta' tim.
formal.en: Clear communication is a main element of teamwork.
formal.zh: 清晰的沟通是团队合作的主要要素。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jonqos fil-pjan tagħna? Pawlu: Element importanti: min se jagħmel kull biċċa xogħol.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's missing from our plan? Pawlu: An important element: who will do each task.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们的计划还缺什么？保罗：一个重要要素：每项任务由谁来做。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 我们的计划还缺什么？
messages.en: What's missing from our plan?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Element importanti: min se jagħmel kull biċċa xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Element importanti: min se jagħmel kull biċċa xogħol.
messages.zh: 一个重要要素：每项任务由谁来做。
messages.en: An important element: who will do each task.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一个计划拆成时间、人员和任务，每一部分都是一个 element；用“整体中的一部分”来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An individual unit or component within a grid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 构成网格的一个独立单元或组成部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità jew parti individwali li tagħmel parti minn grilja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 网格中的一个单元或组成部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Waħda mill-unitajiet jew mill-partijiet li flimkien jiffurmaw grilja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A grid element is an individual unit or component within a grid.

collocations.en: the value of a grid element

formal.mt: Kull element tal-grilja għandu numru biex ikun jista' jiġi identifikat faċilment.
formal.en: Each grid element has a number so that it can be identified easily.
formal.zh: 每个网格元素都有一个编号，以便轻松识别。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema element tal-grilja għandi nagħżel? Mark: Agħżel dak fin-nofs.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which grid element should I select? Mark: Select the one in the middle.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我应该选哪个网格元素？马克：选中间那个。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 我应该选哪个网格元素？
messages.en: Which grid element should I select?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 选中间那个。
messages.en: Select the one in the middle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张网格图，把其中一个单元圈起来：element 表示这个组成部分，tal-grilja 说明它属于网格，整句记作“网格中的一个元素”。

gloss_zh: 相关的网格元素；与当前事项有关的网格单元

teaching_sense.en_definition: A grid element that is pertinent to the task, question, or information being considered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与当前任务、问题或所讨论信息有关的网格元素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità jew parti ta' grilja li għandha x'taqsam mal-kompitu, mal-mistoqsija jew mal-informazzjoni li tkun qed tiġi kkunsidrata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与当前任务、问题或分析内容相关的网格元素。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Element ta' grilja li għandu x'jaqsam mal-kwistjoni jew mal-kompitu li jkun qed jiġi eżaminat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A relevant grid element is a unit within a grid that relates to the matter being considered.

collocations.en: the value of the relevant grid element

formal.mt: Għal kull mistoqsija, identifika l-element tal-grilja rilevanti u ikteb il-valur tiegħu.
formal.en: For each question, identify the relevant grid element and write down its value.
formal.zh: 针对每个问题，识别相关的网格元素并写下它的值。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Sibt l-element tal-grilja rilevanti għal din il-mistoqsija? Pawlu: Iva, hu dak li fih in-numru tnax.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you found the relevant grid element for this question? Pawlu: Yes, it is the one containing the number twelve.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你找到与这道题相关的网格元素了吗？保罗：找到了，就是里面有数字十二的那个。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt l-element tal-grilja rilevanti għal din il-mistoqsija?
messages.mt_standard: Sibt l-element tal-grilja rilevanti għal din il-mistoqsija?
messages.zh: 你找到与这道题相关的网格元素了吗？
messages.en: Have you found the relevant grid element for this question?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu dak li fih in-numru tnax.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu dak li fih in-numru tnax.
messages.zh: 找到了，就是里面有数字十二的那个。
messages.en: Yes, it is the one containing the number twelve.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记“网格元素”，再把 rilevanti 想成题目旁的一支指示箭头：箭头指向与当前问题有关的那个单元，因此整组词表示“相关的网格元素”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Materials or media carried from one location to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过运输或传送，从一个地点移至另一个地点的介质或材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjali jew mezzi li jinġarru minn post għal ieħor permezz tat-trasport.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被输送的介质，即通过运输或传送从一处移至另一处的材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-materjali jew il-mezzi li jiġu mċaqalqa minn post għal ieħor permezz ta' proċess ta' trasport.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Transported media are materials or media that are carried from one place to another.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tip u l-kwantità ta' elementi ttrasportati minn post għal ieħor.
formal.en: The report describes the type and quantity of media transported from one location to another.
formal.zh: 报告描述了从一处输送至另一处的介质的类型和数量。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Xi jfisser 'elementi ttrasportati' hawn? Ġużeppi: Il-materjali li nġarru minn post għal ieħor.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does 'transported media' mean here? Ġużeppi: The materials that were carried from one place to another.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这里的“被输送介质”是什么意思？朱塞佩：就是从一个地方运到另一个地方的材料。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的“被输送介质”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'transported media' mean here?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-materjali li nġarru minn post għal ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Il-materjali li nġarru minn post għal ieħor.
messages.zh: 就是从一个地方运到另一个地方的材料。
messages.en: The materials that were carried from one place to another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两个地点和一支连接箭头，把沿箭头移动的介质标为 elementi ttrasportati，整组记成“被输送的介质”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Chosen by voting to hold an office or serve as a representative.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过投票被选出担任某个职务或代表的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun intgħażel permezz ta' votazzjoni biex jaqdi kariga jew iservi bħala rappreżentant.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过选举或投票选出的；当选的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun intgħażel b'votazzjoni biex jokkupa kariga jew jirrappreżenta lil grupp ta' nies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is elected has been chosen by voting to hold a position or represent others.

collocations.zh: 经选举产生的主席或总统
民选代表；经投票选出的代表

formal.mt: Il-president elett tal-għaqda rringrazzja lill-membri għall-fiduċja tagħhom.
formal.en: The association's elected president thanked the members for their confidence.
formal.zh: 协会当选主席感谢会员们对他的信任。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu r-rappreżentant elett tal-klassi? David: Hu Mark; il-votazzjoni saret dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is the class's elected representative? David: It is Mark; the vote took place this morning.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：班里投票选出的代表是谁？戴维：是马克，今天上午投的票。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 班里投票选出的代表是谁？
messages.en: Who is the class's elected representative?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 是马克，今天上午投的票。
messages.en: It is Mark; the vote took place this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 elett 和“投票后举手宣布当选”的画面联系起来。记忆重点是人已经经过投票被选出，可用 president elett“当选主席”整组练习。

gloss_zh: 升高的；高的；高贵的；显贵的

teaching_sense.en_definition: High or raised in position or level, or distinguished in status or character.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位置或水平较高的、被抬高的；也可指身份、品格等高贵或显著出众的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab f'pożizzjoni jew f'livell għoli, jew li għandu qagħda jew karattru distint u ta' prestiġju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 位置被抬高的或处于高处的；水平、程度较高的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun merfugħ jew li jinsab f'pożizzjoni, f'livell jew fi grad għoli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is elevated is raised above its surroundings or is at a high level.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身份、地位或品格高贵的；具有显著声望或尊贵气质的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu qagħda, karattru jew kwalitajiet distinti li jagħtuh prestiġju u dinjità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something described as distinguished has qualities or standing that command respect and admiration.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika livell elevat ta' storbju fil-viċinanza tal-istazzjon.
formal.en: The report indicates an elevated level of noise near the station.
formal.zh: 报告指出，车站附近的噪声水平较高。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex għażilt dan il-post għall-piknik? Toni: Għax hu post elevat u minn hawn naraw il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you choose this spot for the picnic? Toni: Because it is an elevated location and we can see the sea from here.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么选这里野餐？托尼：因为这里地势高，从这儿能看到海。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么选这里野餐？
messages.en: Why did you choose this spot for the picnic?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu post elevat u minn hawn naraw il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu post elevat u minn hawn naraw il-baħar.
messages.zh: 因为这里地势高，从这儿能看到海。
messages.en: Because it is an elevated location and we can see the sea from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“高”串联两个义项：看地形或数值时想“位置高、水平高”，看身份或品格时想“地位尊贵、品格高尚”。这是语义联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 武器禁运；武器出口禁令

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official prohibition on selling, supplying, or transferring weapons to a particular country or group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 禁止向特定国家或团体出售、供应或转移武器的官方措施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Projbizzjoni uffiċjali fuq il-bejgħ, il-provvista jew it-trasferiment ta' armi lil pajjiż jew grupp partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 禁止向特定国家或团体出售、供应或转移武器的禁运措施。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Miżura uffiċjali li tipprojbixxi l-bejgħ, il-provvista jew it-trasferiment ta' armi lil pajjiż jew grupp partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An arms embargo is an official measure that prohibits supplying weapons to a particular country or group.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 禁止向指定目的地出口武器的官方禁令。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Projbizzjoni uffiċjali li ma tippermettix l-esportazzjoni ta' armi lejn destinazzjoni speċifikata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An embargo on arms exports officially prevents weapons from being exported to a specified destination.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jirrakkomanda li jinżamm l-embargo fuq l-armi sakemm jitwettqu l-kundizzjonijiet stabbiliti.
formal.en: The report recommends maintaining the arms embargo until the specified conditions are met.
formal.zh: 报告建议维持武器禁运，直至规定条件得到满足。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser embargo fuq l-armi? Mark: Ifisser li ma jistgħux jinbiegħu jew jintbagħtu armi lil pajjiż jew grupp partikolari.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does an arms embargo mean? Mark: It means weapons cannot be sold or sent to a particular country or group.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：武器禁运是什么意思？马克：就是不能向某个特定国家或团体出售或运送武器。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 武器禁运是什么意思？
messages.en: What does an arms embargo mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li ma jistgħux jinbiegħu jew jintbagħtu armi lil pajjiż jew grupp partikolari.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li ma jistgħux jinbiegħu jew jintbagħtu armi lil pajjiż jew grupp partikolari.
messages.zh: 就是不能向某个特定国家或团体出售或运送武器。
messages.en: It means weapons cannot be sold or sent to a particular country or group.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句想成武器运输箱前的一道禁行栏杆：embargo 表示禁运，fuq l-armi 点明禁运针对武器。

gloss_zh: 武器出口禁运；武器出口禁令

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official prohibition on exporting weapons to a particular destination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 禁止向特定目的地出口武器的官方措施，明确针对武器出口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miżura uffiċjali li tipprojbixxi l-esportazzjoni ta' armi lejn destinazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 武器禁运；此词组明确指通过禁止武器出口来实施的禁运措施。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Projbizzjoni uffiċjali fuq il-provvista ta' armi lil pajjiż jew grupp, espressa hawn bħala projbizzjoni fuq l-esportazzjoni tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An arms embargo restricts the supply of weapons, here specifically by prohibiting their export.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 禁止向指定目的地出口武器的官方禁令。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Projbizzjoni uffiċjali li twaqqaf l-esportazzjoni ta' armi lejn destinazzjoni speċifikata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An embargo on arms exports is an official prohibition against exporting weapons to a specified destination.

collocations.en: impose an embargo on arms exports
lift an embargo on arms exports

formal.mt: Id-deċiżjoni testendi l-embargo fuq l-esportazzjoni tal-armi lejn il-pajjiż imsemmi għal sena oħra.
formal.en: The decision extends the embargo on arms exports to the named country for another year.
formal.zh: 该决定将针对所述国家的武器出口禁运再延长一年。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex waqqfu dik il-konsenja? Pawlu: Għax hemm embargo fuq l-esportazzjoni tal-armi lejn dak il-pajjiż.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did they stop that shipment? Pawlu: Because there is an embargo on arms exports to that country.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他们为什么拦下那批货？保罗：因为对那个国家实施了武器出口禁运。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 他们为什么拦下那批货？
messages.en: Why did they stop that shipment?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hemm embargo fuq l-esportazzjoni tal-armi lejn dak il-pajjiż.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hemm embargo fuq l-esportazzjoni tal-armi lejn dak il-pajjiż.
messages.zh: 因为对那个国家实施了武器出口禁运。
messages.en: Because there is an embargo on arms exports to that country.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按三块记忆：embargo 是禁运，l-esportazzjoni 是出口，tal-armi 是武器的；想象武器箱在出口关卡被拦下。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Changed to correct, improve, or update its content, especially when describing a text, proposal, or document.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 内容已作修改以纠正、改进或更新的，常用于描述文本、提案或文件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li sar tibdil fih biex jiġi kkoreġut, imtejjeb jew aġġornat, speċjalment meta jingħad għal test, proposta jew dokument.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已作修订或修改的，尤指文本、文件或提案的内容经过调整。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun inbidel biex jiġu kkoreġuti żbalji jew biex il-kontenut tiegħu jiġi mtejjeb jew aġġornat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An amended text or document has been changed to correct, improve, or update its content.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat approva t-test emendat wara li eżamina l-bidliet proposti.
formal.en: The committee approved the amended text after examining the proposed changes.
formal.zh: 委员会审查拟议修改后，批准了修订后的文本。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan hu d-dokument emendat? David: Iva, ikkoreġejt id-data u żidt il-paragrafu li kien nieqes.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this the amended document? David: Yes, I corrected the date and added the missing paragraph.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这是修改后的文件吗？戴维：对，我改正了日期，还补上了缺少的那一段。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 这是修改后的文件吗？
messages.en: Is this the amended document?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ikkoreġejt id-data u żidt il-paragrafu li kien nieqes.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ikkoreġejt id-data u żidt il-paragrafu li kien nieqes.
messages.zh: 对，我改正了日期，还补上了缺少的那一段。
messages.en: Yes, I corrected the date and added the missing paragraph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 emendat 和 test emendat 一起记，想象文本上的修改已被采纳，旁边盖着“已修订”的印章。

gloss_zh: 紧急情况；突发危急事件

teaching_sense.en_definition: A serious or dangerous situation that requires immediate action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 需要立即采取行动处理的严重或危险情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni serja jew perikoluża li teħtieġ azzjoni immedjata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 必须立即应对的严重或危险情况；紧急事件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni ta' periklu jew diffikultà serja li tkun teħtieġ intervent minnufih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An emergency is a serious or dangerous situation in which action must be taken immediately.

formal.mt: F'każ ta' emerġenza, il-persunal għandu jsegwi l-proċeduri ta' evakwazzjoni tal-bini.
formal.en: In an emergency, staff must follow the building's evacuation procedures.
formal.zh: 遇到紧急情况时，工作人员必须遵循该建筑的疏散程序。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex tlaqt mil-laqgħa daqshekk malajr? Mark: Kien hemm emerġenza d-dar, imma issa kollox sew.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you leave the meeting so quickly? Mark: There was an emergency at home, but everything is fine now.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么那么匆忙地离开会议？马克：家里出了紧急情况，不过现在一切都好了。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么那么匆忙地离开会议？
messages.en: Why did you leave the meeting so quickly?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm emerġenza d-dar, imma issa kollox sew.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm emerġenza d-dar, imma issa kollox sew.
messages.zh: 家里出了紧急情况，不过现在一切都好了。
messages.en: There was an emergency at home, but everything is fine now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 emerġenza 就联想警报响起、必须马上行动的场景；配合 f'każ ta' emerġenza 记住“遇到紧急情况时”。

gloss_zh: calleya（所给释义，具体所指未说明）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun supplied with the gloss 'calleya', whose specific referent is not described.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给释义为“calleya”的名词；现有材料未说明其具体所指。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li hawn jingħata t-tifsira 'calleya', mingħajr spjegazzjoni ta' dak li jirreferi għalih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: calleya；材料未提供足以确定具体所指的信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nom mogħti bħala 'calleya', iżda l-informazzjoni disponibbli ma tispeċifikax x'inhu dak li jissejjaħ hekk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Emesia is supplied with the gloss 'calleya', although the available information does not identify its specific referent.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, Emesia tingħata bit-tifsira 'calleya', iżda ma jingħatawx aktar dettalji dwar dak li tirreferi għalih.
formal.en: In this exercise, Emesia is given the gloss 'calleya', but no further details identify what it refers to.
formal.zh: 本练习将 Emesia 释为“calleya”，但没有进一步说明其具体所指。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'tifsira hemm ħdejn Emesia? Pawlu: Hemm 'calleya', imma m'hemmx spjegazzjoni oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: What gloss is given beside Emesia? Pawlu: It says 'calleya', but there is no further explanation.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：Emesia 旁边给了什么释义？保罗：写着“calleya”，但没有进一步解释。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: Emesia 旁边给了什么释义？
messages.en: What gloss is given beside Emesia?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 写着“calleya”，但没有进一步解释。
messages.en: It says 'calleya', but there is no further explanation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 Emesia 与所给释义 calleya 配对记忆；具体所指尚不明确，不自行联想成某种人物、植物或物品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A condition involving attacks of severe headache, which may occur with nausea or sensitivity to light and sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种以反复发作的剧烈头痛为特征的病症，可伴有恶心或对光线、声音敏感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li ġġib attakki ta' wġigħ qawwi ta' ras, li jistgħu jkunu akkumpanjati minn dardir jew sensittività għad-dawl u għall-ħsejjes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偏头痛，一种可反复发作、并可能伴有恶心及畏光或畏声的头痛病症。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni b'attakki ta' wġigħ qawwi ta' ras, kultant flimkien ma' dardir jew sensittività għad-dawl u għall-ħsejjes.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone has a migraine, they experience an attack of severe headache that may also involve nausea or sensitivity to light and sound.

formal.mt: L-istudenta ma setgħetx tattendi l-lezzjoni minħabba attakk ta' emikranja.
formal.en: The student could not attend the lesson because of a migraine attack.
formal.zh: 这名学生因偏头痛发作而无法上课。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandi attakk ta' emikranja u se nibqa' d-dar illum. Ġanni: Tajjeb, nistgħu niltaqgħu darb'oħra.
colloquial.en: Marija: I'm having a migraine attack, so I'm staying home today. Ġanni: All right, we can meet another time.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我偏头痛发作了，今天打算待在家里。詹尼：好，我们可以改天再见。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi attakk ta' emikranja u se nibqa' d-dar illum.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi attakk ta' emikranja u se nibqa' d-dar illum.
messages.zh: 我偏头痛发作了，今天打算待在家里。
messages.en: I'm having a migraine attack, so I'm staying home today.

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我们可以改天再见。
messages.en: All right, we can meet another time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 emikranja 放进 attakk ta' emikranja 整块记忆：想到“偏头痛又发作了”的情景，就联想到这个表达。

gloss_zh: 获授权的发行人；获授权的签发机构

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or organisation officially permitted to issue a particular document, instrument, or other item.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经正式授权，可以发行或签发某类文件、票据或其他项目的个人或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li għandha permess uffiċjali biex toħroġ dokument, strument jew ħaġa oħra ta' tip partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 获授权的发行人或签发机构，即正式获准发行或签发特定项目的个人或组织。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tkun ingħatat awtorizzazzjoni uffiċjali biex toħroġ ċerti dokumenti, strumenti jew oġġetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An authorised issuer is a person or organisation that has official permission to issue a particular type of document or item.

collocations.zh: 获授权的证书签发机构

collocations.en: a document issued by an authorised issuer
collocations.zh: 由获授权的签发机构出具的文件

formal.mt: Għal dan l-eżerċizzju, iċ-ċertifikat għandu jinħareġ minn emittent awtorizzat.
formal.en: For this exercise, the certificate must be issued by an authorised issuer.
formal.zh: 按照本练习的设定，证书须由获授权的签发机构出具。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min jista' joħroġ dan iċ-ċertifikat? Rita: Għandek bżonn emittent awtorizzat; nista' nurik il-lista.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who can issue this certificate? Rita: You need an authorised issuer; I can show you the list.
colloquial.zh: 马克：谁能签发这份证书？丽塔：你需要找获授权的签发机构；我可以把名单给你看。

messages.speaker: Mark (申请人)
messages.zh: 谁能签发这份证书？
messages.en: Who can issue this certificate?

messages.speaker: Rita (服务人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek bżonn emittent awtorizzat; nista' nurik il-lista.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek bżonn emittent awtorizzat; nista' nurik il-lista.
messages.zh: 你需要找获授权的签发机构；我可以把名单给你看。
messages.en: You need an authorised issuer; I can show you the list.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“谁来签发、是否获准”两个问题记住整个短语：emittent 对应发行或签发者，awtorizzat 补充“已获授权”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have confidence in someone's reliability or ability, or in the value of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 相信某人可靠或有能力，或对某事物的价值抱有信心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollok fiduċja f'xi ħadd, fil-ħila jew fl-affidabbiltà tiegħu, jew fil-valur ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 信任某人，相信其可靠或有能力；也可表示对某事物抱有信心。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikollok fiduċja li persuna tkun ta' min joqgħod fuqha jew li jkollha l-ħila meħtieġa, jew ikollok fiduċja fil-valur ta' xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you trust someone, you feel confident that they are reliable or capable of doing what is needed.

collocations.zh: 我信任你；我对你有信心

collocations.en: to have confidence in her ability
we believe in the value of education

formal.mt: Il-maniġer jemmen fit-tim tiegħu u jafdalu r-responsabbiltà tal-proġett.
formal.en: The manager has confidence in his team and entrusts it with responsibility for the project.
formal.zh: 经理信任自己的团队，并将项目责任交给团队承担。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Taħseb li nista' nagħmel din il-preżentazzjoni? Luqa: Iva, nemmen fik. Ħejjejtha sew.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you think I can give this presentation? Luqa: Yes, I have confidence in you. You've prepared it well.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你觉得我能做好这次演示吗？卢卡：能，我对你有信心。你准备得很充分。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li nista' nagħmel din il-preżentazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li nista' nagħmel din il-preżentazzjoni?
messages.zh: 你觉得我能做好这次演示吗？
messages.en: Do you think I can give this presentation?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同事)
messages.zh: 能，我对你有信心。你准备得很充分。
messages.en: Yes, I have confidence in you. You've prepared it well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nemmen fik 想成上台前朋友说的“我相信你”。连着记住动词与介词搭配，fik 在这里表达“对你”的信任。

gloss_zh: 实证的；基于观察或实验的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Based on observation, experience, or experiment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以观察、实际经验或实验所得的证据为依据的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ibbażat fuq osservazzjonijiet, esperjenza jew esperimenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 实证的，即依据观察、经验或实验取得的证据的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li huwa bbażat fuq evidenza miksuba mill-osservazzjoni, mill-esperjenza jew mill-esperimenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An empirical study or conclusion is based on observation or experiment.

formal.mt: L-istudju empiriku jibbaża l-konklużjonijiet tiegħu fuq osservazzjonijiet u kejl.
formal.en: The empirical study bases its conclusions on observations and measurements.
formal.zh: 这项实证研究以观察和测量结果作为结论的依据。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan l-istudju huwa empiriku? David: Iva, ir-riċerkaturi ġabru data permezz ta' esperimenti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this study empirical? David: Yes, the researchers collected data through experiments.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这是一项实证研究吗？戴维：是的，研究人员通过实验收集了数据。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这是一项实证研究吗？
messages.en: Is this study empirical?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ir-riċerkaturi ġabru data permezz ta' esperimenti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ir-riċerkaturi ġabru data permezz ta' esperimenti.
messages.zh: 是的，研究人员通过实验收集了数据。
messages.en: Yes, the researchers collected data through experiments.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 empiriku 和“观察、实验、数据”三个画面连起来记：结论有实际证据支撑，就是“实证的”。

gloss_zh: 含义未明的形式（原标签为 calleya）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form marked 'part' and associated with the label 'calleya'; its precise meaning is not specified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 词性标记为 part、对应原标签 calleya 的形式；所给材料未说明其确切含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma mmarkata 'part' u marbuta mat-tikketta 'calleya'; l-informazzjoni mogħtija ma tiċċarax it-tifsira preċiża tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义仅为 calleya；所给材料不足以确定其准确中文含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa mogħtija hija biss 'calleya', u l-informazzjoni disponibbli ma tippermettix li tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira preċiża tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied label 'calleya' does not establish a clear meaning for this form.

formal.mt: Il-forma 'emsia' hija mmarkata 'part' u marbuta mat-tikketta 'calleya'; it-tifsira tagħha ma tistax tiġi stabbilita minn din l-informazzjoni biss.
formal.en: The form 'emsia' is marked 'part' and associated with the label 'calleya'; its meaning cannot be established from this information alone.
formal.zh: “emsia”这一形式标记为 part，并对应标签 calleya；仅凭这些信息无法确定其含义。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Xi tfisser 'emsia'? Paul: Il-pakkett jagħti biss it-tikketta 'calleya'; ma jiċċarax it-tifsira.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does 'emsia' mean? Paul: The packet gives only the label 'calleya'; it does not clarify the meaning.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：“emsia”是什么意思？保罗：资料包只给出了 calleya 这个标签，没有说明含义。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: “emsia”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'emsia' mean?

messages.speaker: Paul (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-pakkett jagħti biss it-tikketta 'calleya'; ma jiċċarax it-tifsira.
messages.mt_standard: Il-pakkett jagħti biss it-tikketta 'calleya'; ma jiċċarax it-tifsira.
messages.zh: 资料包只给出了 calleya 这个标签，没有说明含义。
messages.en: The packet gives only the label 'calleya'; it does not clarify the meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 emsia 暂记成一张“词义待核实”的词卡：保留拼写和 calleya 标签，不把未知标签硬译成具体词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hard, smooth coating on an object, or the hard outer covering of a tooth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体表面的坚硬光滑釉层，如珐琅或搪瓷釉层；也指牙齿外层的牙釉质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kisja iebsa u lixxa fuq oġġett, jew is-saff iebes li jgħatti l-parti ta' barra tas-snien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 珐琅或搪瓷等坚硬光滑的表面釉层；也指覆盖牙齿外表的牙釉质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjal li jifforma kisja iebsa u lixxa fuq oġġett; il-kelma tirreferi wkoll għas-saff iebes ta' barra tas-snien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Enamel is a hard, smooth surface coating, and also the hard outer covering of teeth.

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi t-tazza bħala oġġett tal-metall b'kisja lixxa ta' enamel.
formal.en: The catalogue describes the cup as a metal object with a smooth coating of enamel.
formal.zh: 目录将这只杯子描述为表面覆有光滑搪瓷釉层的金属制品。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din it-tazza hija tal-metall? Mark: Iva, u għandha kisja tal-enamel fuq barra.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this cup made of metal? Mark: Yes, and it has an enamel coating on the outside.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个杯子是金属做的吗？马克：是的，而且外面有一层搪瓷釉。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个杯子是金属做的吗？
messages.en: Is this cup made of metal?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għandha kisja tal-enamel fuq barra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għandha kisja tal-enamel fuq barra.
messages.zh: 是的，而且外面有一层搪瓷釉。
messages.en: Yes, and it has an enamel coating on the outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象搪瓷杯表面和牙齿表面都有一层坚硬外衣：用“坚硬光滑的外层”串起 enamel 的两个常见意思。

gloss_zh: 某地区特有的；地方特有的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Naturally occurring only in a particular geographical area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某种生物在自然状态下仅分布于某个特定地区的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab fin-natura biss f'żona ġeografika partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地方特有的，指生物的自然分布仅限于某个特定地区。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jgħix jew jikber b'mod naturali biss f'reġjun partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An endemic animal or plant occurs naturally only in a particular geographical area.

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi annimal endemiku li jgħix b'mod naturali biss fuq din il-gżira.
formal.en: The study describes an endemic animal that occurs naturally only on this island.
formal.zh: 这项研究描述了一种自然分布仅限于该岛的特有动物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan l-għasfur jissejjaħ endemiku? Mark: Għax jgħix b'mod naturali biss f'dan ir-reġjun.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is this bird called endemic? Mark: Because it occurs naturally only in this region.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么说这种鸟是地方特有的？马克：因为它在自然状态下只分布于这个地区。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 为什么说这种鸟是地方特有的？
messages.en: Why is this bird called endemic?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jgħix b'mod naturali biss f'dan ir-reġjun.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jgħix b'mod naturali biss f'dan ir-reġjun.
messages.zh: 因为它在自然状态下只分布于这个地区。
messages.en: Because it occurs naturally only in this region.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上只有一个地区亮起，里面生活着当地特有的生物；用这个画面记住 endemiku 的分布限制。

gloss_zh: 被强调的；被着重指出的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Given particular importance or made especially noticeable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被赋予特别重要性，或被突出表达以引起注意的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ngħata importanza jew prominenza speċjali biex jiġbed l-attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被特别强调或突出表达的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġie espress jew ippreżentat b'mod li juri l-importanza tiegħu u jiġbed l-attenzjoni lejh.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An emphasised point is presented in a way that draws particular attention to its importance.

formal.mt: Il-punt enfasizzat fir-rapport huwa l-ħtieġa ta' taħriġ regolari għall-ħaddiema.
formal.en: The point emphasised in the report is the need for regular training for employees.
formal.zh: 报告中着重强调的是员工需要定期接受培训。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema punt għandi niftakar? Mark: Il-punt enfasizzat fit-test: aqra l-istruzzjonijiet qabel tibda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which point should I remember? Mark: The point emphasised in the text: read the instructions before you start.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我应该记住哪个要点？马克：文中强调的那个要点：开始前先阅读说明。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 我应该记住哪个要点？
messages.en: Which point should I remember?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-punt enfasizzat fit-test: aqra l-istruzzjonijiet qabel tibda.
messages.mt_standard: Il-punt enfasizzat fit-test: aqra l-istruzzjonijiet qabel tibda.
messages.zh: 文中强调的那个要点：开始前先阅读说明。
messages.en: The point emphasised in the text: read the instructions before you start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师把一个要点画上粗线并重复说明；那个被突出强调的要点就是 punt enfasizzat。

gloss_zh: 神秘难解的；令人捉摸不透的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mysterious and difficult to understand or interpret.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有神秘感，难以理解其含义、意图或原因的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu misterjuż u diffiċli biex tifhem it-tifsira jew l-intenzjoni tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神秘而难以理解的；使人难以判断其真实含义或意图的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jħalli t-tifsira jew l-intenzjoni tiegħu mhux ċara u għalhekk jidher misterjuż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something enigmatic seems mysterious because their meaning or intentions are difficult to understand.

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz jintemm b'messaġġ enigmatiku li jħalli lill-qarrej jistaqsi x'kienet l-intenzjoni tal-protagonist.
formal.en: The novel ends with an enigmatic message that leaves the reader wondering what the protagonist intended.
formal.zh: 小说以一则神秘难解的信息收尾，让读者不禁猜想主人公的意图。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fhimt xi ried jgħid b'dak il-messaġġ? Mark: Le, kien enigmatiku wisq. Se nitolbu jispjega.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you understand what he meant by that message? Mark: No, it was too enigmatic. I'll ask him to explain.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你明白他那条信息是什么意思吗？马克：不明白，太令人费解了。我会请他解释一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fhimt xi ried jgħid b'dak il-messaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Fhimt xi ried jgħid b'dak il-messaġġ?
messages.zh: 你明白他那条信息是什么意思吗？
messages.en: Did you understand what he meant by that message?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kien enigmatiku wisq. Se nitolbu jispjega.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kien enigmatiku wisq. Se nitolbu jispjega.
messages.zh: 不明白，太令人费解了。我会请他解释一下。
messages.en: No, it was too enigmatic. I'll ask him to explain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人留下一张谜一样的纸条，你看得见文字却猜不透意图；用这个场景记住 enigmatiku。

gloss_zh: 编码；将信息转换为特定代码或格式

teaching_sense.en_definition: To convert information into a particular code or format.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照一定规则，将信息转换为某种代码或格式，以便处理、储存或传输。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tbiddel informazzjoni f'kodiċi jew format partikolari biex tkun tista' tiġi pproċessata, maħżuna jew trażmessa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将信息编码，即按一定规则转换为特定的代码或表示格式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tikkonverti informazzjoni skont regoli partikolari f'kodiċi jew f'format ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you encode information, you convert it into a particular code or format for processing, storage, or transmission.

formal.mt: Il-programm enkowdja l-informazzjoni fil-format meħtieġ qabel it-trażmissjoni.
formal.en: The program encoded the information in the required format before transmission.
formal.zh: 该程序在传输前将信息编码为所需的格式。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-programm enkowdja l-fajl? Mark: Iva, bidlu fil-format li għandna bżonn. Issa nistgħu nibagħtuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the program encode the file? Mark: Yes, it converted it into the format we need. We can send it now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：程序对这个文件进行编码了吗？马克：是的，它已经把文件转换成我们需要的格式了。现在可以发送了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 程序对这个文件进行编码了吗？
messages.en: Did the program encode the file?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bidlu fil-format li għandna bżonn. Issa nistgħu nibagħtuh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bidlu fil-format li għandna bżonn. Issa nistgħu nibagħtuh.
messages.zh: 是的，它已经把文件转换成我们需要的格式了。现在可以发送了。
messages.en: Yes, it converted it into the format we need. We can send it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把同一条信息装进规定格式的盒子，方便储存和传送；这个按规则转换表示形式的动作就是编码。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who loves wine and takes an interest in tasting and learning about it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喜爱葡萄酒，并对品尝葡萄酒及了解相关知识感兴趣的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħobb l-inbid u tieħu interess fit-togħma tiegħu u fl-għarfien dwaru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喜爱葡萄酒、对葡萄酒有浓厚兴趣的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tħobb ħafna l-inbid u li tieħu interess fil-varjetajiet u l-kwalitajiet tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An oenophile is someone who loves wine and enjoys exploring its varieties and qualities.

collocations.zh: 热衷于葡萄酒的爱好者
经验丰富的葡萄酒爱好者

formal.mt: Bħala enofilu b'esperjenza, is-sur Borg ġie mistieden jitkellem dwar il-karatteristiċi ta' diversi nbejjed Maltin.
formal.en: As an experienced wine enthusiast, Mr Borg was invited to speak about the characteristics of several Maltese wines.
formal.zh: 博格先生是一位经验丰富的葡萄酒爱好者，受邀介绍几款马耳他葡萄酒的特点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'nixtru lil Pawlu għal għeluq sninu? Mark: Hu enofilu; naħseb li ktieb dwar l-inbid ikun rigal sabiħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What shall we buy Pawlu for his birthday? Mark: He's a wine enthusiast; I think a book about wine would make a lovely gift.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们给保罗买什么生日礼物呢？马克：他是个葡萄酒爱好者，我觉得一本介绍葡萄酒的书会是不错的礼物。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'nixtru lil Pawlu għal għeluq sninu?
messages.mt_standard: X'nixtru lil Pawlu għal għeluq sninu?
messages.zh: 我们给保罗买什么生日礼物呢？
messages.en: What shall we buy Pawlu for his birthday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu enofilu; naħseb li ktieb dwar l-inbid ikun rigal sabiħ.
messages.mt_standard: Hu enofilu; naħseb li ktieb dwar l-inbid ikun rigal sabiħ.
messages.zh: 他是个葡萄酒爱好者，我觉得一本介绍葡萄酒的书会是不错的礼物。
messages.en: He's a wine enthusiast; I think a book about wine would make a lovely gift.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 enofilu 和“认真品酒、乐于聊酒的人”这一画面绑定，记住它表示爱好者，并不自动表示职业品酒师。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something regarded as having a separate existence or identity, including an organisation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被视为具有独立存在或独立身份的事物，也可指机构或组织。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa meqjusa li għandha eżistenza jew identità għaliha, li tista' tkun ukoll organizzazzjoni jew istituzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被视为独立存在、具有自身身份的实体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li titqies bħala ħaġa għaliha, b'eżistenza jew identità distinta minn dik ta' affarijiet oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An entity is something that is considered to have its own separate existence or identity.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有一定组织结构、为特定目的开展活动的机构或组织。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għaqda jew istituzzjoni bi struttura organizzata li taħdem għal skop jew għal għanijiet partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An organisation is a structured group or institution that works towards particular aims.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jittratta kull organizzazzjoni bħala entità separata u jiddeskrivi r-responsabbiltajiet tagħha.
formal.en: The report treats each organisation as a separate entity and describes its responsibilities.
formal.zh: 报告将每个组织视为独立实体，并说明各自的职责。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dawn iż-żewġ uffiċċji jagħmlu parti mill-istess entità? Pawlu: Le, kull wieħed jagħmel parti minn organizzazzjoni differenti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are these two offices part of the same organisation? Pawlu: No, each belongs to a different organisation.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这两个办事处属于同一个机构吗？保罗：不属于，它们各自隶属不同的组织。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn iż-żewġ uffiċċji jagħmlu parti mill-istess entità?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn iż-żewġ uffiċċji jagħmlu parti mill-istess entità?
messages.zh: 这两个办事处属于同一个机构吗？
messages.en: Are these two offices part of the same organisation?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kull wieħed jagħmel parti minn organizzazzjoni differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kull wieħed jagħmel parti minn organizzazzjoni differenti.
messages.zh: 不属于，它们各自隶属不同的组织。
messages.en: No, each belongs to a different organisation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给某个对象单独画一个框：框内有自己的身份，就是 entità；若框里是一家机构，则用“机构、组织”义理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organisation or body responsible for entering into a contract, especially to obtain goods, services, or works.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责订立合同的组织或机构，尤指通过合同取得货物、服务或工程的发包方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Organizzazzjoni jew korp responsabbli li jidħol f'kuntratt, speċjalment biex jikseb oġġetti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责订立合同的实体，尤指在采购中授予合同的机构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Entità li tidħol f'kuntratt u li, fil-kuntest tal-akkwist, tkun responsabbli għall-għoti tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contracting entity is an organisation or body that enters into a contract, especially one awarding a procurement contract.

collocations.en: a decision by the contracting entity

formal.mt: L-entità kontraenti se tevalwa l-offerti skont il-kriterji indikati fid-dokumenti tas-sejħa għall-offerti.
formal.en: The contracting entity will evaluate the bids according to the criteria set out in the tender documents.
formal.zh: 发包机构将按照招标文件中列明的标准评估投标。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Lil min nibagħtu l-mistoqsija dwar il-kuntratt? Lara: Lill-entità kontraenti, permezz tal-indirizz indikat fid-dokumenti.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who should we send the question about the contract to? Lara: To the contracting entity, using the address given in the documents.
colloquial.zh: 马克：关于合同的问题，我们应该发给谁？拉拉：发给订约实体，用文件中列出的地址。

messages.speaker: Mark (供应商职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min nibagħtu l-mistoqsija dwar il-kuntratt?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min nibagħtu l-mistoqsija dwar il-kuntratt?
messages.zh: 关于合同的问题，我们应该发给谁？
messages.en: Who should we send the question about the contract to?

messages.speaker: Lara (供应商同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Lill-entità kontraenti, permezz tal-indirizz indikat fid-dokumenti.
messages.mt_standard: Lill-entità kontraenti, permezz tal-indirizz indikat fid-dokumenti.
messages.zh: 发给订约实体，用文件中列出的地址。
messages.en: To the contracting entity, using the address given in the documents.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“谁负责订立或授予合同”来记 entità kontraenti：脑中放一份合同，再把负责订约的机构圈出来。

gloss_zh: 交易实体；从事买卖业务的主体

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organization or other business unit that carries out buying and selling activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开展商品、服务或其他资产买卖活动的组织或经营单位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Organizzazzjoni jew unità kummerċjali li twettaq attivitajiet ta' xiri u bejgħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开展买卖交易活动的组织或经营单位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Organizzazzjoni jew unità kummerċjali li tidħol fi tranżazzjonijiet ta' xiri u bejgħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A trading entity is an organization or business unit that carries out buying and selling activities.

collocations.en: the activities of a trading entity

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-attivitajiet ta' xiri u bejgħ tal-entità ta' negozjar.
formal.en: The report describes the trading entity's buying and selling activities.
formal.zh: 该报告说明了这一交易实体的买卖业务。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'tagħmel din l-entità ta' negozjar? Pawlu: Tixtri prodotti mingħand il-fornituri u tbigħhom lill-ħwienet.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does this trading entity do? Pawlu: It buys products from suppliers and sells them to shops.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这个交易实体做什么业务？Pawlu：它从供应商那里购入产品，再卖给商店。

messages.speaker: Marija (实习生)
messages.zh: 这个交易实体做什么业务？
messages.en: What does this trading entity do?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tixtri prodotti mingħand il-fornituri u tbigħhom lill-ħwienet.
messages.mt_standard: Tixtri prodotti mingħand il-fornituri u tbigħhom lill-ħwienet.
messages.zh: 它从供应商那里购入产品，再卖给商店。
messages.en: It buys products from suppliers and sells them to shops.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语联想成买卖流程图中央的一个经营单位：左边进货，右边销售，中间就是“交易实体”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organisation or body responsible for procuring goods, services, or works.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责采购货物、服务或工程的组织或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Organizzazzjoni jew korp responsabbli għall-akkwist ta' oġġetti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责组织和开展货物、服务或工程采购的实体或机构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Entità li torganizza u twettaq proċess ta' akkwist biex tikseb l-oġġetti, is-servizzi jew ix-xogħlijiet meħtieġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A procuring entity is an organisation or body responsible for obtaining goods, services, or works through procurement.

formal.mt: L-entità tal-akkwist ħejjiet lista tal-ħtiġijiet tagħha qabel ma ppubblikat is-sejħa għall-offerti.
formal.en: The procuring entity prepared a list of its needs before publishing the call for tenders.
formal.zh: 采购机构在发布招标公告之前，编制了自身的需求清单。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min se jiġbor il-ħtiġijiet tad-dipartimenti kollha? David: L-entità tal-akkwist se tiġborhom qabel ma titlob il-kwotazzjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who will collect the requirements from all the departments? David: The procuring entity will collect them before requesting quotations.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁来汇总所有部门的需求？戴维：采购机构会在询价之前把这些需求汇总起来。

messages.speaker: Nina (部门职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jiġbor il-ħtiġijiet tad-dipartimenti kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jiġbor il-ħtiġijiet tad-dipartimenti kollha?
messages.zh: 谁来汇总所有部门的需求？
messages.en: Who will collect the requirements from all the departments?

messages.speaker: David (采购协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: L-entità tal-akkwist se tiġborhom qabel ma titlob il-kwotazzjonijiet.
messages.mt_standard: L-entità tal-akkwist se tiġborhom qabel ma titlob il-kwotazzjonijiet.
messages.zh: 采购机构会在询价之前把这些需求汇总起来。
messages.en: The procuring entity will collect them before requesting quotations.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 entità tal-akkwist 放进“汇总需求、组织采购”的场景来记，看到这个词组就想到负责采购工作的机构。

gloss_zh: 账目中的记录；账务分录

teaching_sense.en_definition: A record of a financial transaction or amount in a set of accounts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在账目中登记某笔经济交易或某项金额的记录。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reġistrazzjoni ta' tranżazzjoni finanzjarja jew ta' ammont fil-kontijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 账目中登记的一笔交易或金额记录。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reġistrazzjoni fil-kontijiet li turi tranżazzjoni finanzjarja jew ammont partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An entry in the accounts is a record showing a particular financial transaction or amount in those accounts.

collocations.en: to make an entry in the accounts
collocations.zh: 在账目中登记一笔记录

collocations.en: to check an entry in the accounts
collocations.zh: 核查账目中的一笔记录

formal.mt: L-entrata fil-kontijiet turi ħlas ta' mitejn ewro għall-manutenzjoni.
formal.en: The entry in the accounts shows a payment of two hundred euros for maintenance.
formal.zh: 账目中的这笔记录显示，已支付二百欧元维修费。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din l-entrata fil-kontijiet għal xiex hi? Ġorġ: Hi għall-ħlas tat-tiswija tal-bieb.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is this entry in the accounts for? Ġorġ: It is for the payment for repairing the door.
colloquial.zh: Nina：账目中的这笔记录是什么费用？Ġorġ：是修门的费用。

messages.speaker: Nina (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Din l-entrata fil-kontijiet għal xiex hi?
messages.mt_standard: Din l-entrata fil-kontijiet għal xiex hi?
messages.zh: 账目中的这笔记录是什么费用？
messages.en: What is this entry in the accounts for?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (记账员)
messages.zh: 是修门的费用。
messages.en: It is for the payment for repairing the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指指着账目中的某一行，问“这一笔是什么钱”；整个短语就对应账目里可以逐笔核查的记录。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A record of a financial transaction entered in an accounting journal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在会计日记账中记载一笔经济交易的分录。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reġistrazzjoni ta' tranżazzjoni finanzjarja fil-ġurnal tal-kontabilità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 会计日记账中记录某笔经济交易的分录。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reġistrazzjoni fil-ġurnal tal-kontabilità li turi d-dettalji ta' tranżazzjoni finanzjarja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A journal entry is a record in an accounting journal showing the details of a financial transaction.

formal.mt: L-accountant għamel entrata fil-ġurnal biex jirreġistra x-xiri tat-tagħmir.
formal.en: The accountant made a journal entry to record the purchase of equipment.
formal.zh: 会计编制了一笔日记账分录，记录设备购置业务。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għamilt l-entrata fil-ġurnal għax-xiri tal-kompjuter? Mark: Iva, irreġistrajt ix-xiri dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you made the journal entry for the computer purchase? Mark: Yes, I recorded the purchase this morning.
colloquial.zh: Lara：购买电脑的日记账分录做好了吗？Mark：做好了，我今天上午记录了这笔购置业务。

messages.speaker: Lara (会计主管)
messages.zh: 购买电脑的日记账分录做好了吗？
messages.en: Have you made the journal entry for the computer purchase?

messages.speaker: Mark (会计助理)
messages.zh: 做好了，我今天上午记录了这笔购置业务。
messages.en: Yes, I recorded the purchase this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会计翻开按日期记录交易的日记账，在其中写下一笔分录；把整个短语与“日记账里的一笔记录”一起记。

gloss_zh: 热情的；热衷的；充满干劲的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing strong interest, excitement, and eagerness about something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事表现出浓厚兴趣、兴奋和积极参与意愿的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri interess kbir, ħeġġa u xewqa li jieħu sehem f'xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某事充满热情、兴趣和积极意愿的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun mimli ħeġġa u interess għal xi ħaġa u juri xewqa li jinvolvi ruħu fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are enthusiastic about something, you show strong interest in it and are eager to take part.

collocations.zh: 对这个项目充满热情的

formal.mt: L-istudent kien entużjast dwar il-proġett u offra li jgħin fl-organizzazzjoni.
formal.en: The student was enthusiastic about the project and offered to help with the organization.
formal.zh: 这名学生对项目充满热情，并主动提出协助组织工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif qed tħossok dwar il-kors il-ġdid? Luqa: Jien entużjast ħafna! Ma nistax nistenna biex nibda.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do you feel about the new course? Luqa: I am very enthusiastic! I cannot wait to start.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你对新课程感觉怎么样？Luqa：我特别有热情！已经迫不及待想开始了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif qed tħossok dwar il-kors il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Kif qed tħossok dwar il-kors il-ġdid?
messages.zh: 你对新课程感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How do you feel about the new course?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien entużjast ħafna! Ma nistax nistenna biex nibda.
messages.mt_standard: Jien entużjast ħafna! Ma nistax nistenna biex nibda.
messages.zh: 我特别有热情！已经迫不及待想开始了。
messages.en: I am very enthusiastic! I cannot wait to start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词和“眼睛发亮、主动举手、迫不及待参加”的画面绑定，记住它表达对事情充满热情的状态。

gloss_zh: 百科全书的；知识广博的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to an encyclopedia, or showing extensive knowledge of many subjects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与百科全书有关的；也形容涉及许多领域、知识广博而详尽的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' enċiklopedija, jew li juri għarfien wiesa' u dettaljat dwar ħafna suġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 百科全书的；或像百科全书一样涵盖广泛知识、内容详尽的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li huwa marbut ma' enċiklopedija jew li jiġbor jew juri għarfien estensiv u dettaljat f'ħafna oqsma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something encyclopedic relates to an encyclopedia or contains extensive, detailed knowledge of many subjects.

collocations.zh: 百科全书般广博的知识
一部百科全书式的著作

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza l-għarfien enċiklopediku tal-awtur, li jkopri firxa wiesgħa ta' suġġetti.
formal.en: The report highlights the author's encyclopedic knowledge, which covers a wide range of subjects.
formal.zh: 报告强调了作者百科全书般广博的知识，其范围涵盖众多主题。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif jaf tant affarijiet Pawlu? Elena: Għandu għarfien enċiklopediku; jaqra dwar ħafna suġġetti.
colloquial.en: Sara: How does Pawlu know so many things? Elena: He has encyclopedic knowledge; he reads about many subjects.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗怎么知道这么多事情？埃莱娜：他的知识像百科全书一样丰富；他读的书涉及很多主题。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗怎么知道这么多事情？
messages.en: How does Pawlu know so many things?

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu għarfien enċiklopediku; jaqra dwar ħafna suġġetti.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu għarfien enċiklopediku; jaqra dwar ħafna suġġetti.
messages.zh: 他的知识像百科全书一样丰富；他读的书涉及很多主题。
messages.en: He has encyclopedic knowledge; he reads about many subjects.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人脑中装着整套百科全书：用这个画面记住 għarfien enċiklopediku，表示知识广博而详尽。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An outbreak of a disease that affects unusually many people in a particular community or area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某种疾病在特定地区或群体中传播，患病人数明显超过通常水平的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni fejn marda tinfirex f'żona jew f'komunità u tolqot ħafna aktar nies mis-soltu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某一地区或人群中，某种疾病的病例数明显超过通常水平的流行情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Epidemja sseħħ meta l-għadd ta' każijiet ta' marda f'żona jew f'komunità jkun ħafna ogħla minn dak li jkun mistenni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An epidemic occurs when a disease affects substantially more people than expected in a particular community or area.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tixrid tal-epidemja u l-miżuri meħuda biex titrażżan.
formal.en: The report describes the spread of the epidemic and the measures taken to contain it.
formal.zh: 报告描述了疫情的传播情况以及为遏制疫情而采取的措施。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħassru l-laqgħa? Toni: Minħabba l-epidemja; se nagħmluha fuq l-internet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did they cancel the meeting? Toni: Because of the epidemic; we'll hold it online.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：为什么取消了这次会议？托尼：因为疫情；我们会改成线上开会。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 为什么取消了这次会议？
messages.en: Why did they cancel the meeting?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-epidemja; se nagħmluha fuq l-internet.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-epidemja; se nagħmluha fuq l-internet.
messages.zh: 因为疫情；我们会改成线上开会。
messages.en: Because of the epidemic; we'll hold it online.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 epidemja 放进“疫情传播、会议转线上”的情景中记忆；重点记它表示群体中的疾病流行。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Christian celebration of Jesus being revealed to the world, especially through the visit of the Magi; also, a sudden moment of deep understanding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 纪念耶稣向世人显现、尤其是贤士来朝的基督教节日；也可指突然获得深刻理解的顿悟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-festa Nisranija li tfakkar il-manifestazzjoni ta' Ġesù lid-dinja, speċjalment permezz taż-żjara tal-Maġi; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll mument ta' fehim profond li jiġi f'daqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 主显节，即纪念耶稣向世人显现的基督教节日，尤其与贤士来朝有关；引申指突然而深刻的领悟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-Epifanija hija festa Nisranija marbuta mal-manifestazzjoni ta' Ġesù lid-dinja u maż-żjara tal-Maġi; f'użu figurattiv, epifanija hija esperjenza ta' għarfien jew fehim li jasal f'daqqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Epiphany is a Christian festival celebrating the revelation of Jesus to the world, while an epiphany can also be a sudden and profound realization.
