formal.mt: It-test jispjega kif il-festa tal-Epifanija hija marbuta maż-żjara tal-Maġi lil Ġesù.
formal.en: The text explains how the feast of Epiphany is connected with the Magi's visit to Jesus.
formal.zh: 这篇文章解释了主显节与贤士拜访耶稣之间的联系。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta qrajt in-nota, kelli epifanija: fl-aħħar fhimt il-problema. Mark: Mela issa taf kif issolviha?
colloquial.en: Lara: When I read the note, I had an epiphany: I finally understood the problem. Mark: So do you know how to solve it now?
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：读到那张便条时，我突然顿悟了：我终于理解了问题。马克：那你现在知道怎么解决了吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta qrajt in-nota, kelli epifanija: fl-aħħar fhimt il-problema.
messages.mt_standard: Meta qrajt in-nota, kelli epifanija: fl-aħħar fhimt il-problema.
messages.zh: 读到那张便条时，我突然顿悟了：我终于理解了问题。
messages.en: When I read the note, I had an epiphany: I finally understood the problem.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 那你现在知道怎么解决了吗？
messages.en: So do you know how to solve it now?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记 epifanija：节日里贤士来朝，学习时突然想通；分别对应“主显节”和“顿悟”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a long narrative about heroic deeds, or exceptionally grand and impressive in scale.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与叙述英雄事迹的长篇作品有关的；也形容规模宏大、令人震撼的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' rakkont twil ta' għemejjel erojċi, jew li huwa kbir ħafna u jħalli impressjoni qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有史诗性质的，涉及英雄事迹的长篇叙事的；也指规模宏大、气势壮观的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa epika tkun marbuta ma' narrattiva twila dwar eroj u l-għemejjel tagħhom, jew tkun straordinarja fid-daqs, fl-ambizzjoni jew fl-effett tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something epic relates to a long heroic narrative or is exceptionally grand, ambitious, and impressive.

formal.mt: Il-poema għandha ton epiku u tirrakkonta l-vjaġġ twil ta' eroj li jiffaċċja bosta perikli.
formal.en: The poem has an epic tone and recounts the long journey of a hero who faces many dangers.
formal.zh: 这首长诗具有史诗般的基调，讲述了一位英雄历经重重险境的漫长旅程。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif kien il-film tal-bieraħ? Pawlu: Kien epiku! Ix-xeni tal-battalja kienu impressjonanti ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: What was yesterday's film like? Pawlu: It was epic! The battle scenes were very impressive.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：昨天的电影怎么样？保罗：太壮观了！战斗场面特别震撼。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天的电影怎么样？
messages.en: What was yesterday's film like?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien epiku! Ix-xeni tal-battalja kienu impressjonanti ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Kien epiku! Ix-xeni tal-battalja kienu impressjonanti ħafna.
messages.zh: 太壮观了！战斗场面特别震撼。
messages.en: It was epic! The battle scenes were very impressive.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 epiku 想成银幕上的英雄远征：叙事像史诗，场面很宏大；搭配 film epiku 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A neurological condition involving a lasting tendency to have recurrent seizures caused by abnormal electrical activity in the brain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种神经系统疾病，其特征是由于脑内异常电活动而具有反复出现癫痫发作的持续倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni newroloġika li fiha persuna jkollha tendenza dejjiema għal aċċessjonijiet rikorrenti kkawżati minn attività elettrika anormali fil-moħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 癫痫，一种具有持续性反复发作倾向的神经系统疾病，发作与脑内异常电活动有关。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-epilessija hija kundizzjoni tal-moħħ ikkaratterizzata minn tendenza dejjiema għal aċċessjonijiet li jerġgħu jseħħu minħabba attività elettrika anormali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Epilepsy is a neurological condition in which a person has an enduring tendency to experience recurrent seizures arising from abnormal electrical activity in the brain.

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jispjega x'inhi l-epilessija u jiddeskrivi kif tista' taffettwa l-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The leaflet explains what epilepsy is and describes how it can affect everyday life.
formal.zh: 这本宣传册解释了什么是癫痫，并介绍了它可能如何影响日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex se jsir dan it-taħriġ fl-iskola? David: Biex l-għalliema jifhmu aħjar l-epilessija u kif jistgħu jappoġġjaw lill-istudenti.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is this training being held at school? David: So that teachers can understand epilepsy better and learn how they can support students.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：学校为什么要开展这项培训？戴维：为了让老师更好地了解癫痫，以及如何为学生提供支持。

messages.speaker: Nina (家长)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex se jsir dan it-taħriġ fl-iskola?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex se jsir dan it-taħriġ fl-iskola?
messages.zh: 学校为什么要开展这项培训？
messages.en: Why is this training being held at school?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex l-għalliema jifhmu aħjar l-epilessija u kif jistgħu jappoġġjaw lill-istudenti.
messages.mt_standard: Biex l-għalliema jifhmu aħjar l-epilessija u kif jistgħu jappoġġjaw lill-istudenti.
messages.zh: 为了让老师更好地了解癫痫，以及如何为学生提供支持。
messages.en: So that teachers can understand epilepsy better and learn how they can support students.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 epilessija 和“大脑异常电活动、反复发作”联系起来；再用 persuna bl-epilessija 记住“癫痫患者”的表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to epilepsy, or describing a person who has epilepsy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与癫痫有关的，或形容患有癫痫的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-epilessija, jew li jiddeskrivi persuna li għandha l-epilessija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 癫痫的；与癫痫有关的；患有癫痫的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li huwa marbut mal-epilessija, jew li jirreferi għal persuna li għandha din il-kundizzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Epileptic describes something connected with epilepsy or a person who has this condition.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi attakk epilettiku li seħħ waqt il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The report describes an epileptic seizure that occurred during the lesson.
formal.zh: 报告描述了课堂上发生的一次癫痫发作。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Xi jfisser 'epilettiku' f'dan it-test? Pawlu: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-epilessija, bħal fil-frażi 'attakk epilettiku'.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does 'epilettiku' mean in this text? Pawlu: It means connected with epilepsy, as in the phrase 'an epileptic seizure'.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这篇文章里的 epilettiku 是什么意思？保罗：意思是与癫痫有关的，比如 attakk epilettiku，就是癫痫发作。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 epilettiku 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'epilettiku' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-epilessija, bħal fil-frażi 'attakk epilettiku'.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-epilessija, bħal fil-frażi 'attakk epilettiku'.
messages.zh: 意思是与癫痫有关的，比如 attakk epilettiku，就是癫痫发作。
messages.en: It means connected with epilepsy, as in the phrase 'an epileptic seizure'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 epilettiku 和 attakk epilettiku 整组记忆：attakk 指发作，epilettiku 说明与癫痫有关；本词在这里是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A concluding section of a literary work that comments on the story or tells what happens afterwards.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 文学作品结尾的补充部分，用来评论故事或交代故事结束后发生的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taqsima fl-aħħar ta' xogħol letterarju li tikkummenta fuq il-ġrajja jew tirrakkonta x'jiġri wara t-tmiem tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 文学作品的尾声或终章，通常补充说明人物后来的经历，或对故事作结。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Parti li tagħlaq xogħol letterarju u li tista' tagħti tagħrif dwar x'ġara lill-karattri wara l-ġrajja ewlenija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An epilogue is a section at the end of a literary work that comments on the story or describes later events.

formal.mt: Fl-epilogu tar-rumanz, l-awtur jirrakkonta kif inbidlet il-ħajja tal-karattri għaxar snin wara.
formal.en: In the novel's epilogue, the author describes how the characters' lives have changed ten years later.
formal.zh: 在小说的尾声中，作者讲述了十年后人物生活的变化。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qrajt l-epilogu wkoll? Mark: Iva, u fl-aħħar sirt naf x'ġara lil Sara wara li telqet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you read the epilogue too? Mark: Yes, and I finally found out what happened to Sara after she left.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你也读了尾声吗？马克：读了，我终于知道萨拉离开后发生了什么。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你也读了尾声吗？
messages.en: Did you read the epilogue too?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u fl-aħħar sirt naf x'ġara lil Sara wara li telqet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u fl-aħħar sirt naf x'ġara lil Sara wara li telqet.
messages.zh: 读了，我终于知道萨拉离开后发生了什么。
messages.en: Yes, and I finally found out what happened to Sara after she left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小说最后又翻出一页，交代主角十年后的生活：这一段尾声就是 epilogu；可与英语 epilogue 对照记忆。

gloss_zh: 一集；一段情节；一次事件

teaching_sense.en_definition: One part of a television or radio series, or a distinct event within a longer sequence of events.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 电视或广播连续节目的其中一集，也可指较长经历中一段相对独立的事件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti waħda minn sensiela televiżiva jew radjofonika, jew ġrajja distinta li tagħmel parti minn sensiela usa' ta' ġrajjiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 连续节目的某一集；较长故事、经历或事件发展中相对独立的一段。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taqsima ta' sensiela ta' programmi, jew ġrajja partikolari fi storja, f'esperjenza jew f'sensiela ta' avvenimenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An episode is one part of a broadcast series or a distinct event within a longer story or experience.

formal.mt: L-ewwel episodju tas-sensiela jintroduċi l-karattri ewlenin u l-post fejn tiżvolġi l-ġrajja.
formal.en: The first episode of the series introduces the main characters and the setting in which the story unfolds.
formal.zh: 该剧第一集介绍了主要人物以及故事展开的地点。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt l-episodju tal-bieraħ? David: Għadni ma rajtux. Ejja narawh flimkien illejla.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you watch yesterday's episode? David: I haven't watched it yet. Let's watch it together tonight.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你看昨天那一集了吗？戴维：我还没看。今晚一起看吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看昨天那一集了吗？
messages.en: Did you watch yesterday's episode?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma rajtux. Ejja narawh flimkien illejla.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma rajtux. Ejja narawh flimkien illejla.
messages.zh: 我还没看。今晚一起看吧。
messages.en: I haven't watched it yet. Let's watch it together tonight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用追剧场景记 episodju：一部长剧分成一集一集，每一集都是 episodju；把人生看成长故事时，它也可表示其中一段经历。

gloss_zh: 墓志铭；墓碑上的纪念文字

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short text written on a gravestone to remember the person buried there.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刻写在墓碑上、用来纪念死者的简短文字。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kitba qasira fuq lapida ta' qabar li tfakkar il-persuna midfuna hemm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 墓志铭；通常刻在墓碑上、纪念死者的简短文字。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Test qasir, ġeneralment imnaqqax fuq lapida, li jfakkar persuna mejta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An epitaph is a short text on a gravestone that commemorates the person buried there.

formal.mt: L-epitaffju fuq il-lapida jfakkar il-ġenerożità tal-mejjet u l-imħabba tiegħu lejn il-familja.
formal.en: The epitaph on the gravestone commemorates the deceased's generosity and his love for his family.
formal.zh: 墓碑上的墓志铭纪念了死者的慷慨，以及他对家人的爱。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'hemm miktub fuq dik il-lapida? Ġużeppi: Hemm epitaffju qasir li jfakkar kemm kien maħbub in-nannu.
colloquial.en: Anna: What is written on that gravestone? Ġużeppi: There is a short epitaph recalling how much Grandad was loved.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：那块墓碑上写着什么？朱塞佩：是一篇简短的墓志铭，纪念爷爷生前多么受人爱戴。

messages.speaker: Anna (孙女)
messages.zh: 那块墓碑上写着什么？
messages.en: What is written on that gravestone?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm epitaffju qasir li jfakkar kemm kien maħbub in-nannu.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm epitaffju qasir li jfakkar kemm kien maħbub in-nannu.
messages.zh: 是一篇简短的墓志铭，纪念爷爷生前多么受人爱戴。
messages.en: There is a short epitaph recalling how much Grandad was loved.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 epitaffju 放进墓园画面记忆：lapida 是墓碑，碑上纪念逝者的简短文字就是 epitaffju；记住它指文字内容。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period of history distinguished by particular events or characteristics.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以特定事件、发展或共同特征为标志的历史时期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu fl-istorja li jingħaraf minn ġrajjiet, żviluppi jew karatteristiċi partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有特定历史特征或重要发展的时代。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Epoka hija perjodu fl-istorja li għandu karatteristiċi jew żviluppi li jiddistingwuh minn perjodi oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An epoch is a period of history that is distinguished by particular events, developments, or characteristics.

formal.mt: Il-ktieb jiddeskrivi epoka ta' bidliet kbar fil-ħajja tal-belt.
formal.en: The book describes an epoch of major changes in the life of the city.
formal.zh: 这本书描写了城市生活发生重大变化的一个时代。

colloquial.mt: Maja: F'liema epoka tiġri l-istorja ta' dan il-film? Mark: F'epoka meta n-nies kienu jivvjaġġaw biż-żwiemel.
colloquial.en: Maja: In which historical period does this film's story take place? Mark: In a period when people travelled on horseback.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这部电影的故事发生在哪个时代？马克：在一个人们骑马出行的时代。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'liema epoka tiġri l-istorja ta' dan il-film?
messages.mt_standard: F'liema epoka tiġri l-istorja ta' dan il-film?
messages.zh: 这部电影的故事发生在哪个时代？
messages.en: In which historical period does this film's story take place?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'epoka meta n-nies kienu jivvjaġġaw biż-żwiemel.
messages.mt_standard: F'epoka meta n-nies kienu jivvjaġġaw biż-żwiemel.
messages.zh: 在一个人们骑马出行的时代。
messages.en: In a period when people travelled on horseback.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把历史时间轴想成几大段，每一段有鲜明特色的时代就是 epoka；配合 epoka ġdida“新时代”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The public treasury or funds held by the state.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 国家持有并用于公共事务的财政资金，或管理这些资金的国库。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fondi pubbliċi tal-istat, jew it-teżor pubbliku li fih jinżammu dawn il-fondi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 国库，即国家持有的公共财政资金。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-Erarju huwa t-teżor pubbliku tal-istat u l-fondi li jinżammu fih għall-ħtiġijiet pubbliċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The Erarju is the public treasury containing funds held by the state for public purposes.

collocations.en: a payment from the public treasury
collocations.zh: 从国库支付的一笔款项

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif intużaw il-fondi tal-Erarju matul is-sena.
formal.en: The report explains how public treasury funds were used during the year.
formal.zh: 这份报告说明了本年度国库资金的使用情况。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi jfisser l-Erarju f'dan ir-rapport? Lara: Jiġifieri l-fondi pubbliċi tal-istat.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does Erarju mean in this report? Lara: It means the state's public funds.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这份报告里的 Erarju 是什么意思？拉拉：指的是国家的公共财政资金。

messages.speaker: Mark (居民)
messages.zh: 这份报告里的 Erarju 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does Erarju mean in this report?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 指的是国家的公共财政资金。
messages.en: It means the state's public funds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Erarju，就想象一个标着“国家公共资金”的大钱库，再用 il-fondi tal-Erarju“国库资金”巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number four, representing one more than three.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数字四，表示比三多一的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru li jiġi wara tlieta u qabel ħamsa, u li jirrappreżenta kwantità ta' erba' unitajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 四，位于三与五之间的数；也表示四个的数量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Erbgħa huwa n-numru bejn tlieta u ħamsa u jindika kwantità ta' erba' unitajiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Four is the number that comes after three and before five when you count.

formal.mt: Waslu erbgħa mill-mistednin qabel nofsinhar.
formal.en: Four of the guests arrived before noon.
formal.zh: 四位客人在中午之前到达了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm għandna tazzi fuq il-mejda? Mark: Għandna erbgħa, waħda għal kull persuna.
colloquial.en: Maja: How many cups do we have on the table? Mark: We have four, one for each person.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：桌上有几个杯子？马克：有四个，每人一个。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 桌上有几个杯子？
messages.en: How many cups do we have on the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna erbgħa, waħda għal kull persuna.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna erbgħa, waħda għal kull persuna.
messages.zh: 有四个，每人一个。
messages.en: We have four, one for each person.

cognitive_memory_aid: 词条键 erbgha 对应规范拼写 erbgħa；想象桌上四个杯子，边指边说 erbgħa，把字形和数量四连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who lives alone away from society, often for religious reasons.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 远离社会、独自生活的人，常因宗教修行而选择隐居。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħix waħedha u mbiegħda mis-soċjetà, spiss għal raġunijiet reliġjużi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 隐士，指远离人群独居、常以宗教修行为目的的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Eremita huwa bniedem li jagħżel li jgħix waħdu u 'l bogħod minn nies oħra, spiss biex jiddedika ruħu għat-talb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hermit is someone who lives alone away from other people, often in order to practise their religion.

formal.mt: L-eremita kien jgħix f'dar żgħira 'l bogħod mir-raħal u jqatta' ħafna ħin fit-talb.
formal.en: The hermit lived in a small house far from the village and spent much of his time in prayer.
formal.zh: 那位隐士住在远离村庄的一所小屋里，把许多时间用于祈祷。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-karattru fil-ktieb jgħix waħdu fuq il-muntanja? Mark: Hu eremita; għażel li jgħix 'il bogħod min-nies.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does the character in the book live alone on the mountain? Mark: He is a hermit; he chose to live far away from other people.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：书里的那个人物为什么独自住在山上？马克：他是个隐士，选择了远离人群的生活。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-karattru fil-ktieb jgħix waħdu fuq il-muntanja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-karattru fil-ktieb jgħix waħdu fuq il-muntanja?
messages.zh: 书里的那个人物为什么独自住在山上？
messages.en: Why does the character in the book live alone on the mountain?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu eremita; għażel li jgħix 'il bogħod min-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Hu eremita; għażel li jgħix 'il bogħod min-nies.
messages.zh: 他是个隐士，选择了远离人群的生活。
messages.en: He is a hermit; he chose to live far away from other people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象山上一间小屋，里面住着远离人群的隐士；把这个画面配上 eremita，再记 jgħix bħal eremita“像隐士一样生活”。

gloss_zh: 异端的；违背宗教正统教义的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Contrary to the officially accepted teachings of a religion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某一宗教正式认可的教义相违背的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jmur kontra t-tagħlim uffiċjali aċċettat minn reliġjon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 异端的，指信仰、观点或教导违背某一宗教认可的正统教义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Twemmin, ħsieb jew tagħlim ikun eretiku meta jmur kontra d-duttrina uffiċjali ta' reliġjon.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A belief or teaching is heretical if it conflicts with the officially accepted doctrines of a religion.

formal.mt: L-awtur jispjega għaliex l-awtoritajiet reliġjużi qiesu dak it-tagħlim bħala eretiku.
formal.en: The author explains why the religious authorities regarded that teaching as heretical.
formal.zh: 作者解释了宗教当局为何将那种教导视为异端。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser 'tagħlim eretiku'? Pawlu: Ifisser tagħlim li jmur kontra d-duttrina uffiċjali ta' reliġjon.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'heretical teaching' mean? Pawlu: It means teaching that goes against the official doctrine of a religion.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：‘异端教导’是什么意思？保罗：就是违背某一宗教正式教义的教导。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: ‘异端教导’是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'heretical teaching' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser tagħlim li jmur kontra d-duttrina uffiċjali ta' reliġjon.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser tagħlim li jmur kontra d-duttrina uffiċjali ta' reliġjon.
messages.zh: 就是违背某一宗教正式教义的教导。
messages.en: It means teaching that goes against the official doctrine of a religion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 eretiku 放进 twemmin eretiku 一起记：它给“信仰”贴上“违背正统教义”的形容词标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A religious belief or teaching that conflicts with officially accepted doctrine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某一宗教正式认可的教义相冲突的信仰或学说。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ereżija hija twemmin jew tagħlim reliġjuż li jmur kontra d-duttrina uffiċjali aċċettata minn reliġjon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 异端，指被某一宗教认定为违背其正统教义的信仰、观点或学说。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ereżija hija twemmin, opinjoni jew tagħlim li awtorità reliġjuża tqis li jmur kontra d-duttrina uffiċjali tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Heresy is a religious belief or teaching that religious authorities consider contrary to their accepted doctrine.

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-akkuża ta' ereżija u jispjega liema ideat kienu meqjusa kuntrarji għad-duttrina uffiċjali.
formal.en: The study examines the accusation of heresy and explains which ideas were considered contrary to official doctrine.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察了异端指控，并解释了哪些思想被视为违背正式教义。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-ktieb isemmi akkuża ta' ereżija? Mark: Għax xi awtoritajiet reliġjużi qiesu dawk l-ideat kuntrarji għat-tagħlim tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does the book mention an accusation of heresy? Mark: Because some religious authorities considered those ideas contrary to their teachings.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这本书为什么提到异端指控？马克：因为一些宗教当局认为那些思想违背了他们的教义。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-ktieb isemmi akkuża ta' ereżija?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-ktieb isemmi akkuża ta' ereżija?
messages.zh: 这本书为什么提到异端指控？
messages.en: Why does the book mention an accusation of heresy?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax xi awtoritajiet reliġjużi qiesu dawk l-ideat kuntrarji għat-tagħlim tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Għax xi awtoritajiet reliġjużi qiesu dawk l-ideat kuntrarji għat-tagħlim tagħhom.
messages.zh: 因为一些宗教当局认为那些思想违背了他们的教义。
messages.en: Because some religious authorities considered those ideas contrary to their teachings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“异端指控”这个场景记住 ereżija：它指受到争议的信仰或学说，是名词，不是形容人的标签。

gloss_zh: 小姐（按所给词条的 Miss 称谓义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: In this entry, the title Miss, used before the name of a girl or an unmarried woman.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本词条按所给的 Miss 义项理解，指用于女孩或未婚女性姓名前的“小姐”称谓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'din l-entrata, il-kelma tirreferi għat-titlu Ingliż 'Miss', li jintuża qabel isem jew kunjom ta' tifla jew mara mhux miżżewġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小姐，英语中用于女孩或未婚女性姓名前的称谓；此处按所给词条的称谓义解释。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'din l-entrata, it-tifsira mogħtija hija t-titlu Ingliż 'Miss', użat qabel isem jew kunjom ta' tifla jew mara mhux miżżewġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Miss is a title used before the name of a girl or an unmarried woman.

collocations.zh: 本词条中的 erfajt 一词
为 erfajt 提供的释义

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-entrata 'erfajt' tingħata t-tifsira 'Miss', titlu li jintuża qabel isem jew kunjom ta' tifla jew mara mhux miżżewġa.
formal.en: In this exercise, the entry 'erfajt' is given the meaning 'Miss', a title used before the name of a girl or an unmarried woman.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，词条 erfajt 给出的释义是 Miss，即用于女孩或未婚女性姓名前的“小姐”称谓。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser 'erfajt' f'din il-lista? Pawlu: Hawn tingħata bħala 'Miss', it-titlu Ingliż li jiġi qabel isem ta' tifla jew mara mhux miżżewġa.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'erfajt' mean in this list? Pawlu: Here it is given as 'Miss', the English title placed before the name of a girl or an unmarried woman.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这份词表里的 erfajt 是什么意思？保罗：这里给的是 Miss，也就是放在女孩或未婚女性姓名前的英语称谓。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这份词表里的 erfajt 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'erfajt' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tingħata bħala 'Miss', it-titlu Ingliż li jiġi qabel isem ta' tifla jew mara mhux miżżewġa.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tingħata bħala 'Miss', it-titlu Ingliż li jiġi qabel isem ta' tifla jew mara mhux miżżewġa.
messages.zh: 这里给的是 Miss，也就是放在女孩或未婚女性姓名前的英语称谓。
messages.en: Here it is given as 'Miss', the English title placed before the name of a girl or an unmarried woman.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给本词条画一张姓名卡，用“Miss＋姓名”记住所给称谓义；将 erfajt 与这张词条卡关联，不据此推断其他用法。

gloss_zh: 雌雄同体生物；具有雌雄两种生殖器官的个体

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organism that has both male and female reproductive organs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 同时具有雄性和雌性生殖器官的生物个体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ermafrodita huwa organiżmu li għandu kemm organi riproduttivi maskili kif ukoll organi riproduttivi femminili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雌雄同体生物，指同一个体同时具有雄性和雌性生殖器官。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ermafrodita huwa individwu ta' organiżmu li fih jinsabu kemm organi riproduttivi maskili kif ukoll dawk femminili.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hermaphrodite is an organism that possesses both male and female reproductive organs within the same individual.

formal.mt: L-annimal deskritt fir-rapport huwa ermafrodita, għax għandu kemm organi riproduttivi maskili kif ukoll organi riproduttivi femminili.
formal.en: The animal described in the report is a hermaphrodite because it has both male and female reproductive organs.
formal.zh: 报告中描述的动物是雌雄同体生物，因为它同时具有雄性和雌性生殖器官。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser li dan l-annimal huwa ermafrodita? David: Ifisser li l-istess annimal għandu kemm organi riproduttivi maskili kif ukoll femminili.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does it mean that this animal is a hermaphrodite? David: It means that the same animal has both male and female reproductive organs.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：说这只动物是雌雄同体生物，是什么意思？戴维：意思是同一只动物同时具有雄性和雌性生殖器官。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser li dan l-annimal huwa ermafrodita?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser li dan l-annimal huwa ermafrodita?
messages.zh: 说这只动物是雌雄同体生物，是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean that this animal is a hermaphrodite?

messages.speaker: David (生物教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-istess annimal għandu kemm organi riproduttivi maskili kif ukoll femminili.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-istess annimal għandu kemm organi riproduttivi maskili kif ukoll femminili.
messages.zh: 意思是同一只动物同时具有雄性和雌性生殖器官。
messages.en: It means that the same animal has both male and female reproductive organs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个生物轮廓里同时画着雄性和雌性两套生殖器官，用“一体兼有雌雄”记住 ermafrodita。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The English verb form 'erodes' describes something gradually wearing away a material or weakening something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 英语动词形式 erodes，表示逐渐磨损、侵蚀某种物质，或逐渐削弱某种事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forma tal-verb Ingliż 'erodes' tfisser li xi ħaġa gradwalment tiekol materjal jew iddgħajjef xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐侵蚀、磨损，或逐步削弱。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta xi ħaġa tiekol materjal jew iddgħajjef xi ħaġa oħra ftit ftit, bl-Ingliż jista' jintuża l-verb 'erodes'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something erodes a material or a quality, it gradually wears that material away or weakens that quality.

formal.mt: Fil-frażi Ingliża 'water erodes rock', il-verb 'erodes' jindika li l-ilma jiekol il-blat gradwalment.
formal.en: In the English phrase 'water erodes rock', the verb 'erodes' indicates that water gradually wears the rock away.
formal.zh: 在英语短语 water erodes rock 中，动词 erodes 表示水逐渐侵蚀岩石。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'erodes' f'din is-sentenza dwar il-baħar? Toni: Tfisser li l-baħar jiekol il-blat ftit ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'erodes' mean in this sentence about the sea? Toni: It means that the sea wears the rock away little by little.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这句谈到大海的话里，erodes 是什么意思？托尼：意思是大海一点一点地侵蚀岩石。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'erodes' f'din is-sentenza dwar il-baħar?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'erodes' f'din is-sentenza dwar il-baħar?
messages.zh: 这句谈到大海的话里，erodes 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'erodes' mean in this sentence about the sea?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li l-baħar jiekol il-blat ftit ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li l-baħar jiekol il-blat ftit ftit.
messages.zh: 意思是大海一点一点地侵蚀岩石。
messages.en: It means that the sea wears the rock away little by little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 erodes 配上海浪日复一日磨损岩石的画面，再联想到信任也会被一点点削弱；记住核心是逐渐损耗。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mistake in an action, statement, or calculation, or a difference between a measured value and the correct value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行为、表述或计算中的错误，也可指测量值与正确值之间的误差。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żball f'azzjoni, fi stqarrija jew f'kalkolu, jew differenza bejn valur imkejjel u l-valur korrett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 错误或差错；在测量、计算等语境中，也指所得数值与正确值之间的误差。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Errur huwa żball li jsir f'xi xogħol jew kalkolu, jew differenza bejn riżultat miksub u l-valur korrett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An error is something incorrect in what you do, say, or calculate, or a difference between a measured value and the correct value.

formal.mt: L-awtur ikkoreġa errur fil-kalkolu qabel ma ppubblika r-rapport.
formal.en: The author corrected an error in the calculation before publishing the report.
formal.zh: 作者在发表报告之前纠正了一处计算错误。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Naħseb li hemm errur f'dan il-kont. Mark: Għandek raġun, għoddejt l-istess ħaġa darbtejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: I think there is an error in this bill. Mark: You're right; I counted the same item twice.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我觉得这张账单有个错误。马克：你说得对，我把同一项算了两遍。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li hemm errur f'dan il-kont.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li hemm errur f'dan il-kont.
messages.zh: 我觉得这张账单有个错误。
messages.en: I think there is an error in this bill.

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun, għoddejt l-istess ħaġa darbtejn.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun, għoddejt l-istess ħaġa darbtejn.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我把同一项算了两遍。
messages.en: You're right; I counted the same item twice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 errur 和英语 error 对照记形，再想象账单上被圈出的错误数字，联记“错误、差错、误差”。

gloss_zh: 频率偏差；频率的系统性误差

teaching_sense.en_definition: A systematic tendency for an estimate or measurement of frequency to differ from the actual frequency.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对频率的估计或测量持续偏离实际频率的系统性偏差。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tendenza sistematika li stima jew kejl ta' kemm-il darba sseħħ xi ħaġa jkun differenti mill-frekwenza reali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 频率偏差，指对某现象发生频率的估计或测量存在系统性的高估或低估。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Errur sistematiku tal-frekwenza huwa devjazzjoni konsistenti li biha l-frekwenza stmata jew imkejla tkun ogħla jew aktar baxxa mill-frekwenza reali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Frequency bias occurs when estimates or measurements systematically make something appear more or less frequent than it actually is.

formal.mt: Il-paragun bejn l-istimi u l-għadd reali wera errur sistematiku tal-frekwenza: l-avvenimenti kienu qed jiġu stmati bħala aktar frekwenti milli kienu fil-fatt.
formal.en: Comparing the estimates with the actual counts revealed frequency bias: the events were being estimated to occur more frequently than they actually did.
formal.zh: 将估计值与实际计数进行比较后发现了频率偏差：这些事件的发生频率被系统性地高估了。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex l-istimi tagħna dejjem juru li dan jiġri aktar spiss? Pawlu: Jista' jkun hemm errur sistematiku tal-frekwenza; ejja nqabbluhom mal-għadd reali.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do our estimates always suggest this happens more often? Pawlu: There may be frequency bias; let's compare them with the actual counts.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：为什么我们的估计总显示这件事发生得更频繁？保罗：可能存在频率偏差；我们把估计值和实际计数比较一下吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (研究助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-istimi tagħna dejjem juru li dan jiġri aktar spiss?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-istimi tagħna dejjem juru li dan jiġri aktar spiss?
messages.zh: 为什么我们的估计总显示这件事发生得更频繁？
messages.en: Why do our estimates always suggest this happens more often?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (研究同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jista' jkun hemm errur sistematiku tal-frekwenza; ejja nqabbluhom mal-għadd reali.
messages.mt_standard: Jista' jkun hemm errur sistematiku tal-frekwenza; ejja nqabbluhom mal-għadd reali.
messages.zh: 可能存在频率偏差；我们把估计值和实际计数比较一下吧。
messages.en: There may be frequency bias; let's compare them with the actual counts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分块记忆：errur 是误差，sistematiku 是系统性的，tal-frekwenza 表示频率的；想象计数总向同一方向偏离实际值。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A call or instruction expressed by 'ersaq', asking someone to move closer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用 ersaq 表达的招呼或指令，意思是让对方靠近一些。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sejħa jew istruzzjoni bil-kelma 'ersaq' li titlob lil xi ħadd jiġi aktar qrib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: “靠近些；走近一点”这一招呼或指令。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kelma 'ersaq' tintuża bħala sejħa jew istruzzjoni biex il-persuna li qed tkellimha tiġi aktar qrib.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use 'ersaq' when you want the person you are addressing to move closer to you or to something.

formal.mt: Fl-istruzzjonijiet għall-eżerċizzju hemm miktub: 'Ersaq lejn il-mejda u ħares lejn l-istampa.'
formal.en: The exercise instructions read: 'Move closer to the table and look at the picture.'
formal.zh: 练习说明中写道：“走近桌子，观察图片。”

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ersaq ftit eqreb, ħa nurik ir-ritratt. Ben: Hawn tajjeb? Sara: Iva, issa tista' tarah sew.
colloquial.en: Sara: Come a little closer so I can show you the photo. Ben: Is here okay? Sara: Yes, now you can see it clearly.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：靠近一点，我给你看这张照片。本：站这里可以吗？萨拉：可以，现在你能看清了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ersaq ftit eqreb, ħa nurik ir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Ersaq ftit eqreb, ħa nurik ir-ritratt.
messages.zh: 靠近一点，我给你看这张照片。
messages.en: Come a little closer so I can show you the photo.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 站这里可以吗？
messages.en: Is here okay?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 可以，现在你能看清了。
messages.en: Yes, now you can see it clearly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友拿着照片招手说“Ersaq！”你便向前靠近一步；把这句招呼与身体靠近的动作一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or organization that displays objects, products, or works at an exhibition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在展览中展示物品、产品或作品的个人或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li turi oġġetti, prodotti jew xogħlijiet f'esebizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在展览会上展示物品、产品或作品的参展者或参展单位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Eseb itur huwa persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tipparteċipa f'esebizzjoni billi turi oġġetti, prodotti jew xogħlijiet lill-pubbliku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An exhibitor is a person or organization that shows objects, products, or works to visitors at an exhibition.

formal.mt: Kull esebitur għandu jipprepara l-istand tiegħu qabel il-ftuħ tal-esebizzjoni.
formal.en: Each exhibitor must prepare their stand before the exhibition opens.
formal.zh: 每位参展者都必须在展览开幕前布置好自己的展位。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn l-istand? Mark: Hu esebitur. Qed juri l-prodotti tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that man beside the stand? Mark: He is an exhibitor. He is showing his products.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：展位旁边那个男人是谁？马克：他是参展者，正在展示自己的产品。

messages.speaker: Maja (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn l-istand?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn l-istand?
messages.zh: 展位旁边那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that man beside the stand?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu esebitur. Qed juri l-prodotti tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Hu esebitur. Qed juri l-prodotti tiegħu.
messages.zh: 他是参展者，正在展示自己的产品。
messages.en: He is an exhibitor. He is showing his products.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象展位后面介绍产品的人：esebitur 指参展者。把它与表示展览的 esebizzjoni 配对记，分清人物与活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An event or organized display at which objects, products, or works are shown to the public.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有组织地向公众展示物品、产品或作品的活动或陈列。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wirja organizzata li fiha jintwerew oġġetti, prodotti jew xogħlijiet lill-pubbliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向公众展示物品、产品或作品的展览或展览会。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Esebizzjoni hija wirja organizzata fejn il-pubbliku jista' jara oġġetti, prodotti jew xogħlijiet miġbura għall-wiri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An exhibition is an organized event or display where members of the public can see objects, products, or works.

formal.mt: L-esebizzjoni tal-arti se tkun miftuħa għall-pubbliku mit-Tnejn sal-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: The art exhibition will be open to the public from Monday to Friday.
formal.zh: 艺术展览将于周一至周五向公众开放。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid tiġi miegħi għall-esebizzjoni tal-arti għada? Pawlu: Iva! F'liema ħin tiftaħ?
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like to come with me to the art exhibition tomorrow? Pawlu: Yes! What time does it open?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：明天你想和我一起去艺术展览吗？保罗：想！几点开门？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi miegħi għall-esebizzjoni tal-arti għada?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi miegħi għall-esebizzjoni tal-arti għada?
messages.zh: 明天你想和我一起去艺术展览吗？
messages.en: Would you like to come with me to the art exhibition tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 想！几点开门？
messages.en: Yes! What time does it open?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 esebizzjoni 联想成摆满展品的整个展厅，记住它表示展览；展位后面的参展者则用 esebitur。

gloss_zh: 已执行的；已演奏或表演的；已遵照执行的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing an action that has been carried out, a work that has been performed, or an instruction that has been followed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容行动已经实施、作品已经演奏或表演，或者指令已经得到遵照执行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi azzjoni li twettqet, xogħol li ndaqq jew ġie ppreżentat, jew ordni li ġiet segwita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指行动或行为已经实施、执行的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta azzjoni jew att ikun esegwit, dan ikun twettaq fil-prattika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An action described as executed has been carried out in practice.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指作品、曲目或节目已经演奏或表演的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta xogħol jew brano jkun esegwit, dan ikun indaqq, tkanta jew ġie ppreżentat bħala prestazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A work described as performed has been presented through music, singing, acting, or another form of performance.

sense_translations.en_definition: followed (used of orders or directives given)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 指已下达的命令或指示得到遵从并执行的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta ordni jew direttiva tkun esegwita, ikun sar dak li ntalab jew ġie ordnat fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An order described as followed has been obeyed by doing what it required.

collocations.en: a piece performed by the orchestra
collocations.zh: 由管弦乐团演奏的曲目

formal.mt: Il-brano ġie esegwit mill-orkestra waqt il-kunċert ta' filgħaxija.
formal.en: The piece was performed by the orchestra during the evening concert.
formal.zh: 这首曲目在晚间音乐会上由管弦乐团演奏。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għoġbok il-brano li smajna? Ben: Iva, kien esegwit tajjeb ħafna!
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you like the piece we heard? Ben: Yes, it was performed very well!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你喜欢我们刚才听的那首曲子吗？本：喜欢，演奏得非常好！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢我们刚才听的那首曲子吗？
messages.en: Did you like the piece we heard?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 喜欢，演奏得非常好！
messages.en: Yes, it was performed very well!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个完成画面记 esegwit：行动已落实、曲目已演奏、命令已执行。它描述完成后的状态；搭配阴性名词 ordni 时可见 esegwita。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To carry out an action or deed, or to present a work through performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 实施某项行动或行为，或者通过演奏、演唱或表演呈现作品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iwettaq azzjoni jew att, jew jippreżenta xogħol billi jdoqqu, ikantah jew jirreċtah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 执行、实施某项行动或行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tesegwixxi azzjoni jew att ifisser li twettqu fil-prattika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone executes an action or deed, they carry it out in practice.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 演奏、演唱或表演某个作品或节目。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tesegwixxi xogħol ifisser li tippreżentah billi ddoqqu, tkantah jew tirreċtah.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone performs a work, they present it by playing music, singing, acting, or using another performance skill.

collocations.en: he performed a piece of music

formal.mt: Il-pjanista esegwixxa brano mużikali waqt iċ-ċerimonja tal-ftuħ.
formal.en: The pianist performed a piece of music during the opening ceremony.
formal.zh: 钢琴家在开幕仪式上演奏了一首乐曲。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'esegwixxa Mark fil-kunċert? Sam: Esegwixxa brano qasir fuq il-pjanu.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did Mark perform at the concert? Sam: He performed a short piece on the piano.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克在音乐会上演奏了什么？萨姆：他用钢琴演奏了一首短曲。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克在音乐会上演奏了什么？
messages.en: What did Mark perform at the concert?

messages.speaker: Sam (朋友)
messages.zh: 他用钢琴演奏了一首短曲。
messages.en: He performed a short piece on the piano.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 esegwixxa 配两个动作画面：把任务做出来，把乐曲奏出来。例句中的这个形式表示他已经执行或演奏，先看宾语判断具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Only for a particular person, group, purpose, or use, with all others excluded.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示只限于某个人、群体、目的或用途，不包括其他对象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jkun limitat għal persuna, grupp, għan jew użu partikolari, mingħajr ma jinkludi oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仅限于某一对象、范围或用途地；专门地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta xi ħaġa ssir jew tkun disponibbli esklussivament għal xi ħadd jew għal xi għan, tkun limitata għal dak biss.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is intended exclusively for particular people or purposes, it is intended only for them.

collocations.en: to be used exclusively for research

formal.mt: Dan il-fond huwa maħsub esklussivament biex jappoġġja proġetti ta' riċerka.
formal.en: This fund is intended exclusively to support research projects.
formal.zh: 这项基金专门用于支持研究项目。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Nista' nuża din il-kamra? Pawlu: Le, hija riservata esklussivament għall-għalliema.
colloquial.en: Lina: Can I use this room? Pawlu: No, it is reserved exclusively for teachers.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：我可以使用这个房间吗？保罗：不可以，这个房间仅供教师使用。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 我可以使用这个房间吗？
messages.en: Can I use this room?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 不可以，这个房间仅供教师使用。
messages.en: No, it is reserved exclusively for teachers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门上写着“仅供会员”：esklussivament 强调“只给这一类”，其他对象不包括在内。

gloss_zh: 被排除的；不包括在内的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not included in a group, activity, amount, or arrangement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未被纳入某个群体、活动、金额或安排之中的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx inkluż fi grupp, attività, ammont jew arranġament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被排除在外的；未被包含或计入的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew oġġett ikun eskluż meta jitħalla barra minn grupp, attività jew arranġament, jew ma jiġix inkluż f'xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is excluded is left out of a group, activity, or arrangement.

formal.mt: It-trasport huwa eskluż mill-prezz tal-biljett u jrid jitħallas separatament.
formal.en: Transport is excluded from the ticket price and must be paid for separately.
formal.zh: 票价不包含交通费用，交通费用须另行支付。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex qed titlobni nħallas għat-trasport? Sara: Għax it-trasport huwa eskluż mill-prezz.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why are you asking me to pay for transport? Sara: Because transport is excluded from the price.
colloquial.zh: 马克：为什么你还要我支付交通费？萨拉：因为价格里不包括交通费。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 为什么你还要我支付交通费？
messages.en: Why are you asking me to pay for transport?

messages.speaker: Sara (售票员)
messages.zh: 因为价格里不包括交通费。
messages.en: Because transport is excluded from the price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个圈，把某个人或某项费用放在圈外：eskluż 就是“被排除、未包括”的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short trip made for pleasure, learning, or visiting a particular place, often with a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了休闲、学习或参观某个地方而进行的短途旅行，常以团体形式开展。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vjaġġ qasir għal divertiment, tagħlim jew żjara f'post partikolari, spiss ma' grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为游玩、学习或参观而进行的短途出游，常指有组织的游览活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Eskursjoni hija ħarġa jew vjaġġ qasir li jsir biex wieħed jieħu pjaċir, jitgħallem jew iżur post, ħafna drabi bħala parti minn grupp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An excursion is a short journey that people make for pleasure or to visit an interesting place.

formal.mt: L-iskola se torganizza eskursjoni lejn l-Imdina biex l-istudenti jitgħallmu dwar l-istorja tal-belt.
formal.en: The school will organize an excursion to Mdina so that students can learn about the city's history.
formal.zh: 学校将组织一次前往姆迪纳的游览活动，让学生了解这座城市的历史。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tiġi magħna għall-eskursjoni nhar is-Sibt? Toni: Iva! Fejn se mmorru?
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you coming with us on the excursion on Saturday? Toni: Yes! Where are we going?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：星期六你和我们一起去短途游玩吗？托尼：去！我们要去哪里？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 星期六你和我们一起去短途游玩吗？
messages.en: Are you coming with us on the excursion on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 去！我们要去哪里？
messages.en: Yes! Where are we going?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“早上集合、白天游览、当天回家”的画面记 eskursjoni，抓住“短途出游”的核心意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Exceptionally beautiful, delicate, or finely made.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容事物格外优美、细腻或制作精良，令人欣赏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tkun sabiħa ħafna, delikata jew maħduma b'ħila u b'attenzjoni kbira għad-dettall.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 极其精美、细腻或制作精良的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tkun eskwiżita meta tkun ta' sbuħija jew finezza kbira, jew tkun maħduma b'ħila kbira u b'dettalji delikati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is exquisite is exceptionally beautiful, delicate, or made with great skill.

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesponi vażun b'disinn eskwiżit u dettalji delikati.
formal.en: The museum displays a vase with an exquisite design and delicate details.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出了一只设计精美、细节精巧的花瓶。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara dan il-vażun! Kemm hu sabiħ! Luqa: Veru, għandu disinn eskwiżit.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at this vase! It's so beautiful! Luqa: It really is; it has an exquisite design.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看这个花瓶！真漂亮！卢卡：确实，它的设计非常精美。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dan il-vażun! Kemm hu sabiħ!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dan il-vażun! Kemm hu sabiħ!
messages.zh: 看这个花瓶！真漂亮！
messages.en: Look at this vase! It's so beautiful!

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 确实，它的设计非常精美。
messages.en: It really is; it has an exquisite design.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿起花瓶细看，每一处花纹都精巧优美：用这个画面记住 eskwiżit 的“精美细腻”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A planned test carried out to discover something or check an idea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为发现某种情况、检验想法或观察结果而有计划地进行的实验或试验。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prova ppjanata li ssir biex tinkiseb informazzjoni ġdida, tiġi ttestjata idea jew jiġu osservati r-riżultati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为探索现象、检验设想或观察结果而进行的实验或试验。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prova li ssir biex jiġi skopert xi ħaġa, tiġi ttestjata idea jew jiġi osservat x'jiġri taħt ċerti kundizzjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An experiment is a test that you carry out to discover something or find out whether an idea is correct.

formal.mt: L-istudenti għamlu esperiment biex jaraw kif id-dawl jaffettwa t-tkabbir tal-pjanti.
formal.en: The students carried out an experiment to see how light affects plant growth.
formal.zh: 学生们进行了一项实验，观察光照如何影响植物生长。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex poġġejt pjanta ħdejn it-tieqa u oħra fid-dlam? Pawlu: Qed nagħmel esperiment biex nara liema tikber aktar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you put one plant by the window and another in the dark? Pawlu: I'm doing an experiment to see which one grows more.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么把一盆植物放在窗边，另一盆放在暗处？保罗：我在做实验，看看哪盆长得更多。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex poġġejt pjanta ħdejn it-tieqa u oħra fid-dlam?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex poġġejt pjanta ħdejn it-tieqa u oħra fid-dlam?
messages.zh: 你为什么把一盆植物放在窗边，另一盆放在暗处？
messages.en: Why did you put one plant by the window and another in the dark?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel esperiment biex nara liema tikber aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel esperiment biex nara liema tikber aktar.
messages.zh: 我在做实验，看看哪盆长得更多。
messages.en: I'm doing an experiment to see which one grows more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 esperiment 和“两盆植物对照观察”的画面绑定，连同 tagħmel esperiment“一起做实验”这个常用搭配记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person with extensive knowledge or skill in a particular subject or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某个学科、领域或活动中具有丰富知识或熟练技能的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha għarfien wiesa' jew ħila kbira f'suġġett, f'qasam jew f'attività partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某个领域具有专门知识或高超技能的专家、行家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taf ħafna dwar qasam partikolari jew li għandha ħila kbira fih bis-saħħa tat-tagħlim jew tal-esperjenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An expert is someone who has a great deal of knowledge or skill in a particular area.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat talab il-parir ta' espert qabel ħa deċiżjoni dwar is-sistema l-ġdida.
formal.en: The committee sought an expert's advice before making a decision about the new system.
formal.zh: 委员会在就新系统作出决定之前，征求了一位专家的意见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kompjuter tiegħi reġa' waqaf jaħdem. Taf lil xi ħadd li jista' jgħinni? Mark: Iva, ħija huwa espert fil-kompjuters. Nista' nitolbu jagħti ħarsa.
colloquial.en: Maja: My computer has stopped working again. Do you know anyone who can help me? Mark: Yes, my brother is a computer expert. I can ask him to take a look.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我的电脑又不能用了。你认识能帮我的人吗？马克：认识，我哥哥是计算机专家。我可以请他看看。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kompjuter tiegħi reġa' waqaf jaħdem. Taf lil xi ħadd li jista' jgħinni?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kompjuter tiegħi reġa' waqaf jaħdem. Taf lil xi ħadd li jista' jgħinni?
messages.zh: 我的电脑又不能用了。你认识能帮我的人吗？
messages.en: My computer has stopped working again. Do you know anyone who can help me?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħija huwa espert fil-kompjuters. Nista' nitolbu jagħti ħarsa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħija huwa espert fil-kompjuters. Nista' nitolbu jagħti ħarsa.
messages.zh: 认识，我哥哥是计算机专家。我可以请他看看。
messages.en: Yes, my brother is a computer expert. I can ask him to take a look.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 espert 记成遇到难题时请来帮忙的“专家本人”；本条是名词，可用“计算机专家”这个具体人物形象巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making amends for guilt or wrongdoing, especially in a moral or religious context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为自身的罪责或过错作出补偿、求得赎罪的行为，尤用于道德或宗教语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att li bih persuna tipprova tpatti għall-ħtija jew għall-ħażen li tkun għamlet, speċjalment f'kuntest morali jew reliġjuż.

sense_translations.en_definition: expiation; the act of making amends or reparation for guilt or wrongdoing; atonement.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 赎罪；通过补偿或弥补行为，为罪责或所犯的过错作出偿还。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għemil li bih wieħed jipprova jpatti għal ħtija jew għal xi ħażen li jkun wettaq, billi jagħmel tajjeb għall-ħsara jew ifittex il-maħfra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Expiation is the act of doing something to make amends for wrongdoing or to atone for guilt.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru jqis is-servizz tiegħu lill-komunità bħala att ta' espjazzjoni għall-ħażen li għamel.
formal.en: In the novel, the character regards his service to the community as an act of atonement for the wrong he has done.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，人物把自己为社区服务的行为视为对所犯过错的赎罪。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser espjazzjoni f'din is-sentenza? Luqa: Tfisser li wieħed jipprova jpatti għall-ħażen li jkun għamel, bħal meta l-karattru jgħin lil dawk li weġġa'.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does expiation mean in this sentence? Luqa: It means trying to make amends for wrongdoing, as when the character helps the people he has hurt.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这句话里的 espjazzjoni 是什么意思？卢卡：意思是设法为自己做过的坏事作出补偿，比如这个人物去帮助被他伤害过的人。

messages.speaker: Nina (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 espjazzjoni 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does expiation mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Luqa (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li wieħed jipprova jpatti għall-ħażen li jkun għamel, bħal meta l-karattru jgħin lil dawk li weġġa'.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li wieħed jipprova jpatti għall-ħażen li jkun għamel, bħal meta l-karattru jgħin lil dawk li weġġa'.
messages.zh: 意思是设法为自己做过的坏事作出补偿，比如这个人物去帮助被他伤害过的人。
messages.en: It means trying to make amends for wrongdoing, as when the character helps the people he has hurt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 espjazzjoni 放进“犯错后用行动弥补”的故事里记忆；重点联想罪责、补偿与赎罪，适合联系文学或宗教阅读场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To examine a place, subject, or possibility in order to learn more about it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过走访、观察或研究，进一步了解某个地方、主题或可能性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Teżamina post, suġġett jew possibbiltà, jew iżżur post u tistħarrġu, biex issir taf aktar dwaru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 探索或探查某地；深入考察某个主题、想法或可能性，以增进了解。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tistħarreġ post jew teżamina suġġett, idea jew possibbiltà biex tiskopri aktar informazzjoni u tifhimhom aħjar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you explore a place or subject, you investigate it in order to discover more about it.

formal.mt: It-tim esplora diversi possibbiltajiet biex itejjeb it-trasport pubbliku qabel ippreżenta l-proposta finali.
formal.en: The team explored several possibilities for improving public transport before presenting the final proposal.
formal.zh: 团队在提交最终提案之前，探讨了改善公共交通的多种可能性。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'nistgħu nagħmlu waqt li nkun qed naħdem? Toni: Esplora l-belt ma' ħuk, u wara niltaqgħu għall-ikel.
colloquial.en: Sara: What can we do while I'm working? Toni: Explore the city with your brother, and then we'll meet for a meal.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我工作的时候，我们能安排些什么活动？托尼：你和你兄弟去探索这座城市吧，之后我们再碰面吃饭。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'nistgħu nagħmlu waqt li nkun qed naħdem?
messages.mt_standard: X'nistgħu nagħmlu waqt li nkun qed naħdem?
messages.zh: 我工作的时候，我们能安排些什么活动？
messages.en: What can we do while I'm working?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Esplora l-belt ma' ħuk, u wara niltaqgħu għall-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Esplora l-belt ma' ħuk, u wara niltaqgħu għall-ikel.
messages.zh: 你和你兄弟去探索这座城市吧，之后我们再碰面吃饭。
messages.en: Explore the city with your brother, and then we'll meet for a meal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 esplora 和“拿着地图寻找未知街巷”的动作绑定，再把地图换成问题清单，就能联想到探究主题和探索可能性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activities of searching for mineral deposits and assessing their characteristics and potential value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 寻找矿产资源，并评估其特征及潜在价值的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attivitajiet ta' tiftix għal depożiti minerali u ta' valutazzjoni tal-karatteristiċi u l-valur potenzjali tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 矿产勘探与评价，即寻找矿产资源并评估其特征和潜在价值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' tiftix għal depożiti minerali u ta' ġbir u analiżi ta' informazzjoni biex jiġu vvalutati l-karatteristiċi u l-valur potenzjali tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mineral exploration and evaluation involves searching for mineral deposits and assessing their characteristics and potential value.

collocations.mt: proġett ta' esplorazzjoni u evalwazzjoni minerali
collocations.en: a mineral exploration and evaluation project

collocations.mt: spejjeż ta' esplorazzjoni u evalwazzjoni minerali

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta r-riżultati tal-esplorazzjoni u l-evalwazzjoni minerali fiż-żona studjata.
formal.en: The report presents the results of mineral exploration and evaluation in the area studied.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了研究区域内矿产勘探与评价的结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq xiex qed taħdem bħalissa? Pawlu: Fuq proġett ta' esplorazzjoni u evalwazzjoni minerali. Qed infittxu depożiti u nevalwaw l-informazzjoni li niġbru.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you working on at the moment? Pawlu: A mineral exploration and evaluation project. We are looking for deposits and evaluating the information we collect.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你最近在做什么工作？Pawlu：一个矿产勘探与评价项目。我们在寻找矿藏，并评估收集到的信息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你最近在做什么工作？
messages.en: What are you working on at the moment?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (地质工作者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq proġett ta' esplorazzjoni u evalwazzjoni minerali. Qed infittxu depożiti u nevalwaw l-informazzjoni li niġbru.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq proġett ta' esplorazzjoni u evalwazzjoni minerali. Qed infittxu depożiti u nevalwaw l-informazzjoni li niġbru.
messages.zh: 一个矿产勘探与评价项目。我们在寻找矿藏，并评估收集到的信息。
messages.en: A mineral exploration and evaluation project. We are looking for deposits and evaluating the information we collect.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“先找矿，再评估”的画面记忆：esplorazzjoni 对应勘探，evalwazzjoni 对应评价，u 表示“和”，minerali 提醒你整个短语围绕矿产。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exporter who has been officially approved by the relevant authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已获得有关主管机构正式核准的出口商。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Esportatur li jkun ingħata approvazzjoni uffiċjali mill-awtorità rilevanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经核准的出口商，即已获得有关主管机构正式批准的出口经营者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li tesporta merkanzija u li tkun kisbet approvazzjoni uffiċjali mingħand l-awtorità rilevanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An approved exporter is a person or company that exports goods and has received official approval from the relevant authority.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija kisbet l-istatus ta' esportatur approvat wara li l-awtorità rilevanti approvat l-applikazzjoni tagħha.
formal.en: The company obtained approved exporter status after the relevant authority approved its application.
formal.zh: 有关主管机构批准申请后，该公司取得了经核准出口商资格。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-kumpanija tiegħek diġà għandha l-istatus ta' esportatur approvat? Mark: Iva, irċevejna l-approvazzjoni l-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does your company already have approved exporter status? Mark: Yes, we received approval last week.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你们公司已经取得经核准出口商资格了吗？Mark：是的，我们上周收到了批准。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumpanija tiegħek diġà għandha l-istatus ta' esportatur approvat?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumpanija tiegħek diġà għandha l-istatus ta' esportatur approvat?
messages.zh: 你们公司已经取得经核准出口商资格了吗？
messages.en: Does your company already have approved exporter status?

messages.speaker: Mark (出口业务负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irċevejna l-approvazzjoni l-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irċevejna l-approvazzjoni l-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.zh: 是的，我们上周收到了批准。
messages.en: Yes, we received approval last week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出口商拿到一张盖有批准章的文件：esportatur 是出口商，approvat 表示已获批准，合起来强调“取得核准资格”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or company that has recently begun exporting goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 最近开始从事货物出口业务的个人或公司。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li tkun għadha kemm bdiet tesporta merkanzija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 新出口商，即刚开始从事出口业务的个人或企业。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Esportatur li jkun beda l-attività tiegħu ta' esportazzjoni reċentement u li jkun għadu fil-bidu ta' din l-attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A new exporter is a person or company that has only recently started selling and sending goods to other countries.

formal.mt: Dan l-esportatur ġdid qed iħejji l-ewwel kunsinna tiegħu għal klijent barra minn Malta.
formal.en: This new exporter is preparing its first shipment for a customer outside Malta.
formal.zh: 这家新出口商正在为马耳他境外的一位客户准备首批货物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek ħafna esperjenza fl-esportazzjoni? Daniel: Għadni esportatur ġdid. Qed inħejji l-ewwel kunsinna tiegħi din il-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have much experience in exporting? Daniel: I am still a new exporter. I am preparing my first shipment this week.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你有很多出口经验吗？Daniel：我还是个新出口商。这周我正在准备自己的首批货物。

messages.speaker: Lara (商业伙伴)
messages.zh: 你有很多出口经验吗？
messages.en: Do you have much experience in exporting?

messages.speaker: Daniel (新出口商)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni esportatur ġdid. Qed inħejji l-ewwel kunsinna tiegħi din il-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni esportatur ġdid. Qed inħejji l-ewwel kunsinna tiegħi din il-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 我还是个新出口商。这周我正在准备自己的首批货物。
messages.en: I am still a new exporter. I am preparing my first shipment this week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把新出口商想成正在打包第一批海外订单的人：esportatur 指出口商，ġdid 表示“新的”，整个短语突出刚开始出口业务。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The exportation of goods before another related operation takes place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在另一项相关操作进行之前，先将货物出口的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-esportazzjoni ta' merkanzija li ssir qabel operazzjoni oħra relatata magħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 先行出口，即在另一项相关操作之前进行货物出口。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ ta' merkanzija mill-pajjiż permezz tal-esportazzjoni qabel ma titwettaq operazzjoni oħra marbuta magħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Prior exportation occurs when goods are exported before another operation connected with those goods takes place.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika d-data tal-esportazzjoni antiċipata u jiddeskrivi l-operazzjoni relatata li saret wara.
formal.en: The report indicates the date of prior exportation and describes the related operation that took place afterwards.
formal.zh: 报告注明了先行出口日期，并说明了随后进行的相关操作。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhi esportazzjoni antiċipata? Joseph: Tfisser li l-merkanzija tiġi esportata qabel ma ssir operazzjoni oħra relatata magħha.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is prior exportation? Joseph: It means that the goods are exported before another related operation takes place.
colloquial.zh: Nina：什么是先行出口？Joseph：意思是在另一项相关操作进行之前，先把货物出口。

messages.speaker: Nina (实习生)
messages.zh: 什么是先行出口？
messages.en: What is prior exportation?

messages.speaker: Joseph (业务培训员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li l-merkanzija tiġi esportata qabel ma ssir operazzjoni oħra relatata magħha.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li l-merkanzija tiġi esportata qabel ma ssir operazzjoni oħra relatata magħha.
messages.zh: 意思是在另一项相关操作进行之前，先把货物出口。
messages.en: It means that the goods are exported before another related operation takes place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条时间线，先写“出口”，再写“相关操作”：esportazzjoni 表示出口行为，antiċipata 提醒你出口先发生，记住两项操作的先后关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not covered or protected from contact, weather, or other outside influences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有遮盖或保护，直接受到接触、天气或其他外界因素影响的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex mgħotti jew protett u għalhekk jista' jintlaqat mit-temp, mill-mess jew minn influwenzi oħra minn barra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暴露在外、缺乏遮盖或保护的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsab mingħajr għata jew protezzjoni kontra dak li jista' jolqtu minn barra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is exposed, it has no covering or protection against things that may affect or damage it.

formal.mt: Il-kejbil espost għandu jitgħatta qabel ma tintuża l-kamra.
formal.en: The exposed cable must be covered before the room is used.
formal.zh: 使用房间之前，必须将暴露在外的电缆遮盖起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-post hu espost wisq għar-riħ. Mark: Ejja noqogħdu ħdejn il-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Maja: This spot is too exposed to the wind. Mark: Let's sit next to the wall.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个地方太不挡风了。马克：我们坐到墙边去吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-post hu espost wisq għar-riħ.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-post hu espost wisq għar-riħ.
messages.zh: 这个地方太不挡风了。
messages.en: This spot is too exposed to the wind.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们坐到墙边去吧。
messages.en: Let's sit next to the wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 espost 和“无遮无挡”的画面一起记：电缆没有外罩、座位没有挡风处，都可以想到“暴露、缺乏保护”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Covering a wide area or a broad range of subjects, activities, or details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 覆盖地域广，或涉及许多主题、活动及细节的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkopri żona kbira jew firxa wiesgħa ta' suġġetti, attivitajiet jew dettalji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 范围广泛的；覆盖面积大或涉及内容多的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu firxa wiesgħa jew ikopri ħafna spazju, suġġetti jew aspetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is extensive covers a large area or includes a wide range of subjects or details.

formal.mt: L-università ppubblikat studju estensiv dwar l-użu tal-lingwi fl-iskejjel.
formal.en: The university published an extensive study on language use in schools.
formal.zh: 该大学发表了一项关于学校语言使用情况的广泛研究。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandna bżonn rapport daqshekk estensiv? Pawlu: Iva, irid ikopri l-proġett kollu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do we need such an extensive report? Pawlu: Yes, it needs to cover the whole project.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们需要一份涉及范围这么广的报告吗？保罗：需要，它得涵盖整个项目。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 我们需要一份涉及范围这么广的报告吗？
messages.en: Do we need such an extensive report?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 需要，它得涵盖整个项目。
messages.en: Yes, it needs to cover the whole project.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 estensiv 时想象一份摊满桌面的调查报告：它涉及的地区、主题和细节都很多，重点是“覆盖范围广”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An increase in length, area, or duration, or an extra part added to something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长度、面积或持续时间的增加，也指增添的延伸部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żieda fit-tul, fl-erja jew fil-ħin ta' xi ħaġa, jew parti miżjuda magħha biex titkabbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对时间、长度或范围的延长或扩大；也指为扩大原有事物而增加的部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-titwil jew it-tkabbir ta' xi ħaġa fiż-żmien jew fl-ispazju, jew parti ġdida li tiżdied magħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An extension is an increase in the time, length, or size of something, or an additional part joined to it.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat approva estensjoni ta' ġimgħa għall-preżentazzjoni tar-rapport.
formal.en: The committee approved a one-week extension for submitting the report.
formal.zh: 委员会批准将报告提交期限延长一周。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nitlob estensjoni ta' jumejn għax-xogħol? David: Iva, tista' tibagħtu sal-Ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I ask for a two-day extension for the assignment? David: Yes, you can send it by Friday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这份作业可以申请延期两天吗？戴维：可以，你可以在星期五之前发过来。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nitlob estensjoni ta' jumejn għax-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nitlob estensjoni ta' jumejn għax-xogħol?
messages.zh: 这份作业可以申请延期两天吗？
messages.en: Can I ask for a two-day extension for the assignment?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.zh: 可以，你可以在星期五之前发过来。
messages.en: Yes, you can send it by Friday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 estensjoni 想成“在原有末端再加一段”：日历多两天是延期，房屋多一间是扩建，都抓住“增加一段”的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Situated outside something, or coming from outside a particular organization or system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于某物外部，或来自某个组织、系统之外的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab fuq barra ta' xi ħaġa jew li ġej minn barra organizzazzjoni jew sistema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 位于外部的；来自有关组织或系统之外的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-parti ta' barra ta' xi ħaġa jew ma' sors minn barra grupp, organizzazzjoni jew sistema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is external is on the outside of something or comes from outside the organization or system concerned.

formal.mt: Konsulent estern se jevalwa l-proċeduri tal-organizzazzjoni u jippreżenta rapport lill-bord.
formal.en: An external consultant will assess the organization's procedures and present a report to the board.
formal.zh: 一名外部顾问将评估该组织的工作程序，并向董事会提交报告。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-problema ġejja mill-kejbil estern? Rita: Iva, dak li jgħaddi minn barra d-dar.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the problem coming from the external cable? Rita: Yes, the one that runs along the outside of the house.
colloquial.zh: 马克：问题出在外面的那根电缆上吗？丽塔：是的，就是沿着房子外侧走的那根。

messages.speaker: Mark (住户)
messages.zh: 问题出在外面的那根电缆上吗？
messages.en: Is the problem coming from the external cable?

messages.speaker: Rita (维修人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak li jgħaddi minn barra d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak li jgħaddi minn barra d-dar.
messages.zh: 是的，就是沿着房子外侧走的那根。
messages.en: Yes, the one that runs along the outside of the house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 estern 时先画一道边界：墙在建筑外侧、顾问来自组织外部，都用“边界之外”这个画面连接词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arrangement in which outsourced work is passed through a succession of external providers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 承接外包工作的服务商又将工作交给下一家外部服务商，从而形成连续承包链的安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arranġament li fih xogħol mogħti lil fornitur estern jerġa' jingħata lil fornituri oħra, wieħed wara l-ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 链式外包，指外包工作在多家服务商之间逐级转交。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' xogħol lil fornitur estern li jgħaddih lil fornitur ieħor, b'tali mod li tinħoloq katina ta' fornituri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Chain outsourcing occurs when an external provider passes contracted work to further providers in succession.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-esternalizzazzjoni katina u jisħaq li r-responsabbiltajiet ta' kull fornitur għandhom ikunu ċari.
formal.en: The report examines chain outsourcing and stresses that each provider's responsibilities should be clear.
formal.zh: 报告分析了链式外包，并强调应明确每家服务商的责任。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Il-kumpanija li qabbadna għaddiet ix-xogħol lil kumpanija oħra. Pawlu: Mela għandna esternalizzazzjoni katina; ejja niċċaraw min hu responsabbli.
colloquial.en: Marta: The company we hired passed the work to another company. Pawlu: Then we have chain outsourcing; let's clarify who is responsible.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我们聘用的公司把工作交给了另一家公司。保罗：那就是链式外包了；我们来弄清楚由谁负责。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumpanija li qabbadna għaddiet ix-xogħol lil kumpanija oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumpanija li qabbadna għaddiet ix-xogħol lil kumpanija oħra.
messages.zh: 我们聘用的公司把工作交给了另一家公司。
messages.en: The company we hired passed the work to another company.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela għandna esternalizzazzjoni katina; ejja niċċaraw min hu responsabbli.
messages.mt_standard: Mela għandna esternalizzazzjoni katina; ejja niċċaraw min hu responsabbli.
messages.zh: 那就是链式外包了；我们来弄清楚由谁负责。
messages.en: Then we have chain outsourcing; let's clarify who is responsible.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把工作想成接力棒：甲公司交给乙公司，乙公司再交给丙公司；用连续传递的画面记住“链式外包”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to beauty and the appreciation of appearance, or pleasing to look at.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与美及外观欣赏有关的；也可形容外表美观、令人赏心悦目的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sbuħija u mal-apprezzament tad-dehra, jew li hu sabiħ u pjaċevoli għall-għajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 审美的；有关美、外观及其欣赏的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda s-sbuħija, id-dehra u l-mod kif dawn jiġu apprezzati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An aesthetic consideration concerns beauty or the way something looks and is appreciated.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 美观的；外观优美、令人赏心悦目的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu dehra sabiħa u li jagħti gost lil min iħares lejh.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as beautiful has an appearance that gives people pleasure when they look at it.

formal.mt: Il-proġett għandu valur estetiku għoli, għax il-kuluri u l-forom joħolqu dehra armonjuża.
formal.en: The project has high aesthetic value because its colours and shapes create a harmonious appearance.
formal.zh: 这个项目具有很高的审美价值，因为其色彩与造型营造出和谐的外观。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif jidher il-vażun fuq din il-mejda? Mark: Joħloq effett estetiku sabiħ, speċjalment ħdejn dawk il-fjuri.
colloquial.en: Lara: How does the vase look on this table? Mark: It creates a lovely visual effect, especially next to those flowers.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个花瓶放在这张桌子上看起来怎么样？马克：视觉效果很美，尤其是放在那些花旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif jidher il-vażun fuq din il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Kif jidher il-vażun fuq din il-mejda?
messages.zh: 这个花瓶放在这张桌子上看起来怎么样？
messages.en: How does the vase look on this table?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Joħloq effett estetiku sabiħ, speċjalment ħdejn dawk il-fjuri.
messages.mt_standard: Joħloq effett estetiku sabiħ, speċjalment ħdejn dawk il-fjuri.
messages.zh: 视觉效果很美，尤其是放在那些花旁边。
messages.en: It creates a lovely visual effect, especially next to those flowers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看一件作品时分两步记：讨论色彩造型属于“审美的”，觉得外观赏心悦目就是“美观的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing an animal or plant species that no longer has any living members.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某种动物或植物已没有任何存活个体，即已经灭绝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jingħad għal speċi ta' annimali jew pjanti li ma għad baqa' ebda membru ħaj tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已灭绝的；指某一物种已无任何存活个体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma għadx jeżisti bħala speċi ħajja għax mietu l-membri kollha tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An extinct species no longer exists because all of its members have died.

formal.mt: Il-pannell fil-mużew jiddeskrivi għasfur estint u juri kif kien jidher meta kien għadu jgħix.
formal.en: The museum panel describes an extinct bird and shows what it looked like when it was still alive.
formal.zh: 博物馆的展板介绍了一种已灭绝的鸟，并展示了它存活时的样子。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan l-għasfur għadu jeżisti? Toni: Le, huwa estint; ma baqa' ebda wieħed ħaj.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does this bird still exist? Toni: No, it is extinct; there are no living ones left.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这种鸟现在还存在吗？托尼：不存在了，它已经灭绝；一只活着的也没有了。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这种鸟现在还存在吗？
messages.en: Does this bird still exist?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa estint; ma baqa' ebda wieħed ħaj.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa estint; ma baqa' ebda wieħed ħaj.
messages.zh: 不存在了，它已经灭绝；一只活着的也没有了。
messages.en: No, it is extinct; there are no living ones left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象博物馆里只剩模型、自然界已无活体的鸟，用“最后一个也消失了”的画面记住已灭绝。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The event in the evening when the sun disappears below the horizon.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 傍晚太阳落到地平线以下、从视野中消失的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fenomenu ta' filgħaxija meta x-xemx tinżel taħt l-orizzont u ma tibqax tidher.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 日落；傍晚太阳降至地平线以下的现象。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mument ta' filgħaxija meta x-xemx tgħib taħt l-orizzont.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sunset is the event each evening when the sun disappears below the horizon.

formal.mt: L-osservaturi waslu fuq l-għolja qabel l-estinzjoni tax-xemx biex jaraw il-bidliet fil-kuluri tas-sema.
formal.en: The observers arrived on the hill before sunset to watch the changes in the colours of the sky.
formal.zh: 观察者在日落之前到达山丘，观看天空色彩的变化。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Immorru ħdejn il-baħar qabel l-estinzjoni tax-xemx? Luqa: Iva, irrid nara x-xemx tinżel taħt l-orizzont.
colloquial.en: Sara: Shall we go down to the sea before sunset? Luqa: Yes, I want to watch the sun go below the horizon.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们日落前去海边好吗？卢卡：好啊，我想看太阳落到地平线以下。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Immorru ħdejn il-baħar qabel l-estinzjoni tax-xemx?
messages.mt_standard: Immorru ħdejn il-baħar qabel l-estinzjoni tax-xemx?
messages.zh: 我们日落前去海边好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go down to the sea before sunset?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irrid nara x-xemx tinżel taħt l-orizzont.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irrid nara x-xemx tinżel taħt l-orizzont.
messages.zh: 好啊，我想看太阳落到地平线以下。
messages.en: Yes, I want to watch the sun go below the horizon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词条给定的日落义，想象夕阳缓缓沉入海平线；把完整搭配与傍晚画面一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Made longer in duration or greater in extent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在持续时间上被延长的，或在范围上被扩大的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li sar itwal fiż-żmien jew akbar fil-firxa tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 持续时间被延长的；覆盖范围被扩大的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li żdied fit-tul taż-żmien jew fil-firxa meta mqabbel ma' qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is extended lasts longer or covers a greater area than before.

formal.mt: Il-ħin tal-ftuħ tal-librerija ġie estiż biex l-istudenti jkunu jistgħu jistudjaw filgħaxija.
formal.en: The library's opening hours have been extended so that students can study in the evening.
formal.zh: 图书馆延长了开放时间，以便学生能在晚间学习。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ħin tal-ftuħ ġie estiż illum? Pawlu: Iva, il-ħanut se jibqa' miftuħ sad-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have the opening hours been extended today? Pawlu: Yes, the shop will stay open until nine.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天延长营业时间了吗？保罗：是的，商店会一直开到九点。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天延长营业时间了吗？
messages.en: Have the opening hours been extended today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ħanut se jibqa' miftuħ sad-disgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ħanut se jibqa' miftuħ sad-disgħa.
messages.zh: 是的，商店会一直开到九点。
messages.en: Yes, the shop will stay open until nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把日历上的结束日期向后移动，联想 estiż：时间延长了；把地图上的边界向外推，联想范围扩大了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very great in degree or far beyond what is usual or moderate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 程度非常高，或远远超出通常、适中范围的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ta' grad għoli ħafna jew 'il bogħod ħafna minn dak li hu tas-soltu jew moderat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 极端的；在程度、强度或立场上远超通常或适中范围的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jilħaq grad jew intensità għolja ħafna, jew li jkun 'il bogħod minn pożizzjoni moderata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something extreme is very great in degree or goes far beyond what people usually consider moderate.

formal.mt: F'każ ta' temp estrem, l-attivitajiet kollha fil-beraħ jiġu posposti.
formal.en: In the event of extreme weather, all outdoor activities will be postponed.
formal.zh: 如遇极端天气，所有户外活动都将推迟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li għandna nikkanċellaw il-vjaġġ kollu? Toni: Dak ikun pass estrem. Nistgħu nibdlu d-data biss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think we should cancel the whole trip? Toni: That would be an extreme step. We can just change the date.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得我们应该取消整个行程吗？托尼：那样做太极端了。我们只改日期就可以。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li għandna nikkanċellaw il-vjaġġ kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li għandna nikkanċellaw il-vjaġġ kollu?
messages.zh: 你觉得我们应该取消整个行程吗？
messages.en: Do you think we should cancel the whole trip?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ikun pass estrem. Nistgħu nibdlu d-data biss.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ikun pass estrem. Nistgħu nibdlu d-data biss.
messages.zh: 那样做太极端了。我们只改日期就可以。
messages.en: That would be an extreme step. We can just change the date.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象温度计的刻度冲到最顶端，用 estrem 记住“程度走到极端”；再用 każ estrem 巩固“极端情况”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The holding or promotion of political, religious, or other views that are far from moderate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持有或宣扬远离温和立场的政治、宗教或其他观点的思想倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-twemmin fi jew il-promozzjoni ta' fehmiet politiċi, reliġjużi jew oħrajn li huma 'l bogħod ħafna mill-moderazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 极端主义；坚持或鼓吹远离温和立场的政治、宗教等主张的思想倾向。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attitudni jew twemmin li jħaddan jew ixerred fehmiet estremi, speċjalment fil-politika jew fir-reliġjon.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Extremism is the holding or promotion of political, religious, or other views that are far from moderate.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddiskuti r-rwol tal-edukazzjoni fil-prevenzjoni tal-estremiżmu politiku u reliġjuż.
formal.en: The report discusses the role of education in preventing political and religious extremism.
formal.zh: 报告讨论了教育在预防政治和宗教极端主义方面的作用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fuq xiex kienet it-taħdita tal-bieraħ? Mark: Fuq l-estremiżmu u kif nistgħu niddiskutu ideat differenti b'rispett.
colloquial.en: Sara: What was yesterday's talk about? Mark: Extremism and how we can discuss different ideas respectfully.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：昨天的讲座讲了什么？马克：讲的是极端主义，以及我们怎样以尊重的态度讨论不同观点。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 昨天的讲座讲了什么？
messages.en: What was yesterday's talk about?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq l-estremiżmu u kif nistgħu niddiskutu ideat differenti b'rispett.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq l-estremiżmu u kif nistgħu niddiskutu ideat differenti b'rispett.
messages.zh: 讲的是极端主义，以及我们怎样以尊重的态度讨论不同观点。
messages.en: Extremism and how we can discuss different ideas respectfully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 estremiżmu 放进“政治、宗教、思想立场”的词汇框，记成一种极端主义倾向，避免与一次极端天气混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something eternal lasts forever or is understood to have no end.
