teaching_sense.zh_definition: 永远持续、没有终结的，常用于描述时间、生命、安息或感情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa eterna tibqa' għal dejjem u ma jkollhiex tmiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 永恒的；无终止、永远存在或持续的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa eterna ma tispiċċa qatt u tibqa' teżisti jew tkompli għal dejjem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is eternal continues forever and has no end.

formal.mt: Fil-poeżija, il-baħar isir simbolu tal-moviment etern taż-żmien.
formal.en: In the poem, the sea becomes a symbol of the eternal movement of time.
formal.zh: 在这首诗中，大海成为时间永恒流动的象征。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ktibt 'imħabba eterna' fuq il-kartolina? Lara: Għax irrid ngħid li l-imħabba tiegħi tibqa' għal dejjem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you write 'eternal love' on the card? Lara: Because I want to say that my love will last forever.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么在卡片上写“永恒的爱”？拉拉：因为我想表达，我的爱会一直持续下去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在卡片上写“永恒的爱”？
messages.en: Why did you write 'eternal love' on the card?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax irrid ngħid li l-imħabba tiegħi tibqa' għal dejjem.
messages.mt_standard: Għax irrid ngħid li l-imħabba tiegħi tibqa' għal dejjem.
messages.zh: 因为我想表达，我的爱会一直持续下去。
messages.en: Because I want to say that my love will last forever.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 etern 配上一条没有终点的时间线，记住“永恒”；再连读 imħabba eterna“永恒的爱”，同时熟悉词形变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something ethical concerns moral principles or follows accepted standards of right conduct.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与判断行为对错的伦理原则有关的，或符合道德行为准则的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa etika għandha x'taqsam mal-prinċipji dwar it-tajjeb u l-ħażin, jew taqbel ma' dawk il-prinċipji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伦理的；涉及道德原则的，或符合道德准则的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa etika tirrigwarda l-prinċipji morali jew tkun konformi mal-imġiba meqjusa tajba u ġusta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is ethical relates to moral principles or meets standards of right conduct.

formal.mt: Il-kodiċi etiku tal-istituzzjoni jitlob li r-riċerkaturi jipproteġu l-privatezza tal-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The institution's code of ethics requires researchers to protect participants' privacy.
formal.zh: 该机构的伦理守则要求研究人员保护参与者的隐私。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Taħseb li hu etiku li naqsam dan ir-ritratt mingħajr permess? Sara: Le, l-ewwel staqsi lill-persuna li tidher fih.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you think it is ethical to share this photo without permission? Sara: No, first ask the person who appears in it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你觉得未经允许分享这张照片合乎道德吗？萨拉：不，先问问照片里的人。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li hu etiku li naqsam dan ir-ritratt mingħajr permess?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li hu etiku li naqsam dan ir-ritratt mingħajr permess?
messages.zh: 你觉得未经允许分享这张照片合乎道德吗？
messages.en: Do you think it is ethical to share this photo without permission?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, l-ewwel staqsi lill-persuna li tidher fih.
messages.mt_standard: Le, l-ewwel staqsi lill-persuna li tidher fih.
messages.zh: 不，先问问照片里的人。
messages.en: No, first ask the person who appears in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 etiku，就想象分享照片前先征求同意的场景，用“这样做合乎道德吗”帮助记住它；搭配 kodiċi etiku 一起练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Etymology is the study of word origins and development, or an account of a particular word's origin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究词语起源及其形式、意义演变的学问，也可指某个词的来源及演变说明；马耳他语对应词为 etimoloġija。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-etimoloġija hija l-istudju tal-oriġini tal-kliem u tal-iżvilupp tal-forom u t-tifsiriet tiegħu; tista' wkoll tkun spjegazzjoni tal-oriġini ta' kelma partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词源学，即研究词语起源和演变的学问；也指某个词的来源及演变情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-etimoloġija tistudja minn fejn ġej il-kliem u kif jinbidlu l-forom u t-tifsiriet tiegħu matul iż-żmien, jew tispjega l-oriġini ta' kelma waħda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Etymology is the study of how words originated and developed, or an explanation of a particular word's origin.

formal.mt: L-istudju tal-etimoloġija jeħtieġ evidenza dwar l-użu tal-kliem f'perjodi differenti.
formal.en: The study of etymology requires evidence of word use in different periods.
formal.zh: 词源学研究需要有关词语在不同时期使用情况的证据。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser il-kelma Ingliża 'etymology'? Pawlu: Tfisser etimoloġija, jiġifieri l-istudju ta' minn fejn ġej il-kliem u kif żviluppa.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the English word 'etymology' mean? Pawlu: It means etimoloġija, the study of where words come from and how they developed.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：英语单词 etymology 是什么意思？保罗：意思是 etimoloġija，也就是研究词语从哪里来以及如何演变的学问。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 英语单词 etymology 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the English word 'etymology' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser etimoloġija, jiġifieri l-istudju ta' minn fejn ġej il-kliem u kif żviluppa.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser etimoloġija, jiġifieri l-istudju ta' minn fejn ġej il-kliem u kif żviluppa.
messages.zh: 意思是 etimoloġija，也就是研究词语从哪里来以及如何演变的学问。
messages.en: It means etimoloġija, the study of where words come from and how they developed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 etymology 想成给词语画“成长时间线”：查来源、看形式、追踪意义变化；英语词形与马耳他语 etimoloġija 配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The length of time someone or something has existed, or a historical period with particular characteristics.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或事物已经存在的时间，即年龄或年岁；也指具有特定特征的历史时期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żmien li jkun għadda minn twelid ta' persuna jew mill-bidu ta' xi ħaġa; ukoll perjodu storiku b'karatteristiċi partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 年龄；从出生或形成起已经经过的时间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iż-żmien li jkun għadda minn meta twieldet persuna jew minn meta bdiet teżisti xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your age is the length of time you have been alive, usually expressed in years.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 时代；以某些显著特征、发展或事件为标志的历史时期。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Perjodu fl-istorja li jingħaraf minn karatteristiċi, żviluppi jew ġrajjiet partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An era is a period of history recognized for its particular features, developments, or events.

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jiddeskrivi kif l-età industrijali bidlet ix-xogħol u l-ħajja fil-bliet.
formal.en: The chapter describes how the industrial era changed work and life in cities.
formal.zh: 本章描述了工业时代如何改变城市中的工作与生活。

colloquial.mt: Nina: F'liema età bdejt titgħallem il-Malti? Adam: Bdejt fl-età ta' tnax-il sena, meta mort ngħix Malta.
colloquial.en: Nina: At what age did you start learning Maltese? Adam: I started at the age of twelve, when I moved to Malta.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你几岁开始学马耳他语的？亚当：我十二岁开始学，那时我搬到了马耳他。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你几岁开始学马耳他语的？
messages.en: At what age did you start learning Maltese?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Bdejt fl-età ta' tnax-il sena, meta mort ngħix Malta.
messages.mt_standard: Bdejt fl-età ta' tnax-il sena, meta mort ngħix Malta.
messages.zh: 我十二岁开始学，那时我搬到了马耳他。
messages.en: I started at the age of twelve, when I moved to Malta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 età 配两张图：生日蛋糕表示“年龄”，历史时间轴表示“时代”；看到具体岁数想年龄，看到历史特征想时代。

gloss_zh: 福音派的；与福音有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something evangelical relates to evangelical Christianity or to the Christian gospel and its teachings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与基督教福音派有关的，或与基督教福音及其教导有关的；具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa evanġelika għandha x'taqsam mal-Kristjaneżmu evanġeliku jew mal-Evanġelju u t-tagħlim tiegħu, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 福音派的；与强调福音、个人信仰及传福音的基督教福音派传统有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa evanġelika għandha x'taqsam mat-tradizzjoni Nisranija evanġelika, li tenfasizza l-Evanġelju, il-fidi personali u t-tixrid tal-messaġġ Nisrani.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is evangelical relates to Christian traditions emphasizing the gospel, personal faith, and sharing Christian beliefs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与基督教福音及其信息或教导有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa evanġelika tirrigwarda l-Evanġelju, il-messaġġ tiegħu jew it-tagħlim li fih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described this way concerns the Christian gospel or the message and teachings it contains.

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddistingwi bejn l-użu ta' 'evanġeliku' għal tradizzjoni Nisranija u l-użu tiegħu għal dak li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Evanġelju.
formal.en: The article distinguishes between using 'evanġeliku' for a Christian tradition and using it for something related to the gospel.
formal.zh: 文章区分了 evanġeliku 的两种用法：指一种基督教传统，以及指与福音有关的事物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawnhekk, 'messaġġ evanġeliku' jfisser messaġġ ta' knisja evanġelika? Pawlu: F'dan il-kuntest, ifisser il-messaġġ tal-Evanġelju; il-kelma tista' tintuża fiż-żewġ sensi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Here, does 'messaġġ evanġeliku' mean a message from an evangelical church? Pawlu: In this context, it means the gospel message; the word can be used in both senses.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 messaġġ evanġeliku 是指福音派教会发出的信息吗？保罗：在这个语境里，它指福音的信息；这个词有这两种用法。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk, 'messaġġ evanġeliku' jfisser messaġġ ta' knisja evanġelika?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk, 'messaġġ evanġeliku' jfisser messaġġ ta' knisja evanġelika?
messages.zh: 这里的 messaġġ evanġeliku 是指福音派教会发出的信息吗？
messages.en: Here, does 'messaġġ evanġeliku' mean a message from an evangelical church?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan il-kuntest, ifisser il-messaġġ tal-Evanġelju; il-kelma tista' tintuża fiż-żewġ sensi.
messages.mt_standard: F'dan il-kuntest, ifisser il-messaġġ tal-Evanġelju; il-kelma tista' tintuża fiż-żewġ sensi.
messages.zh: 在这个语境里，它指福音的信息；这个词有这两种用法。
messages.en: In this context, it means the gospel message; the word can be used in both senses.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 evanġeliku：教会招牌提示“福音派的”，讲解福音的书页提示“与福音有关的”；读句子时靠语境选择。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To change from a liquid into a gas or vapour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从液体状态变成气体或蒸气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinbidel minn likwidu għal gass jew fwar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蒸发；由液体变成气体或蒸气。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta likwidu jevapora, jinbidel f'gass jew fwar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a liquid evaporates, it changes into a gas or vapour.

formal.mt: Matul l-esperiment, parti mill-ilma evapora u l-livell tiegħu fil-kontenitur naqas.
formal.en: During the experiment, some of the water evaporated and its level in the container fell.
formal.zh: 实验过程中，部分水蒸发了，容器中的水位随之下降。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-platt għadu hawn, imma l-ilma spiċċa? Pawlu: L-ilma evapora għax ħallejna l-platt fix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the dish still here, but the water is gone? Pawlu: The water evaporated because we left the dish in the sun.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么盘子还在，水却没了？保罗：因为我们把盘子放在太阳下，水蒸发了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-platt għadu hawn, imma l-ilma spiċċa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-platt għadu hawn, imma l-ilma spiċċa?
messages.zh: 为什么盘子还在，水却没了？
messages.en: Why is the dish still here, but the water is gone?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ilma evapora għax ħallejna l-platt fix-xemx.
messages.mt_standard: L-ilma evapora għax ħallejna l-platt fix-xemx.
messages.zh: 因为我们把盘子放在太阳下，水蒸发了。
messages.en: The water evaporated because we left the dish in the sun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 evapora 和“太阳下盘中的水渐渐变少”这幅画面一起记：水由液态变成水蒸气，就是蒸发。

gloss_zh: 生命周期事件；人生各阶段的重要事件

teaching_sense.en_definition: Events that mark stages or changes in the course of a life or lifecycle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 标志生命历程或生命周期中不同阶段及其变化的事件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġrajjiet li jimmarkaw stadji jew bidliet matul il-ħajja jew matul ċiklu tal-ħajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生命周期中标志阶段或状态变化的事件；用于人生语境时，可指出生、结婚等事件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġrajjiet li jimmarkaw stadji jew bidliet f'ċiklu tal-ħajja, bħat-twelid jew iż-żwieġ fil-ħajja ta' persuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Lifecycle events are occurrences that mark particular stages or changes in a life or lifecycle.

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza kif eventi taċ-ċiklu tal-ħajja, bħat-twelid ta' wild u ż-żwieġ, jistgħu jbiddlu l-ħtiġijiet tal-familji.
formal.en: The study analyses how lifecycle events, such as the birth of a child and marriage, can change families' needs.
formal.zh: 这项研究分析孩子出生、结婚等生命周期事件如何改变家庭的需求。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'nista' ninkludi fil-proġett dwar il-familja tiegħi? Mark: Tista' tinkludi eventi taċ-ċiklu tal-ħajja, bħat-twelid ta' ħuk u ż-żwieġ tan-nanniet tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Lara: What can I include in the project about my family? Mark: You can include lifecycle events, such as your brother's birth and your grandparents' marriage.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：介绍我家的课题里可以放些什么？马克：可以放一些生命周期事件，比如你弟弟的出生和你祖父母的婚事。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'nista' ninkludi fil-proġett dwar il-familja tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: X'nista' ninkludi fil-proġett dwar il-familja tiegħi?
messages.zh: 介绍我家的课题里可以放些什么？
messages.en: What can I include in the project about my family?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tinkludi eventi taċ-ċiklu tal-ħajja, bħat-twelid ta' ħuk u ż-żwieġ tan-nanniet tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tinkludi eventi taċ-ċiklu tal-ħajja, bħat-twelid ta' ħuk u ż-żwieġ tan-nanniet tiegħek.
messages.zh: 可以放一些生命周期事件，比如你弟弟的出生和你祖父母的婚事。
messages.en: You can include lifecycle events, such as your brother's birth and your grandparents' marriage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条人生时间线，把出生、结婚等事件标在相应位置，再整体记住 eventi taċ-ċiklu tal-ħajja：贯穿生命历程的阶段性事件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: After some time, often following a delay, difficulty, or a series of events.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过一段时间后，通常在等待、困难或一连串事情之后，最终发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wara li jgħaddi xi żmien, spiss wara dewmien, diffikultajiet jew sensiela ta' ġrajjiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最终；终于；表示某事在一段时间或一连串过程之后发生。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fl-aħħar, wara li jkun għadda xi żmien jew wara li jkunu seħħew diversi ġrajjiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happens eventually, it happens after some time, often following delays or difficulties.

collocations.zh: 他最终找到了解决办法

formal.mt: Wara diversi laqgħat, il-kumitat eventwalment approva l-proposta.
formal.en: After several meetings, the committee eventually approved the proposal.
formal.zh: 经过几次会议，委员会最终批准了这项提案。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Sibt iċ-ċwievet? David: Iva, eventwalment sibthom taħt is-sufan.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you find the keys? David: Yes, I eventually found them under the sofa.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：找到钥匙了吗？戴维：找到了，最后在沙发底下找到了。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 找到钥匙了吗？
messages.en: Did you find the keys?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.zh: 找到了，最后在沙发底下找到了。
messages.en: Yes, I eventually found them under the sofa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“找了好久，最后终于找到钥匙”的情景记 eventwalment，重点是经过一段时间后出现的最终结果。

gloss_zh: 明显的；显而易见的；清楚明白的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clear enough to be easily seen, understood, or recognized.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清楚到容易被看出、理解或辨认的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jidher jew jinftiehem b'mod ċar u jkun faċli biex wieħed jagħrfu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 明显的；从观察到的事实或迹象中能够清楚看出的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jidher ċar mill-fatti jew mis-sinjali li wieħed jista' josserva.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is evident, the available facts or signs make it clear to you.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 显而易见的；很容易察觉或理解，几乎不需要解释的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun faċli ħafna biex wieħed jinduna bih jew jifhmu, mingħajr il-ħtieġa ta' ħafna spjegazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is obvious is easy to notice or understand without much explanation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清楚明白的；用于意思、意图等，表示容易看透或理解的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li t-tifsira jew l-intenzjoni tiegħu tkun ċara u faċli biex wieħed jifhimha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a meaning or intention is transparent, it is easy to understand or recognize.

formal.mt: Mir-riżultati ppreżentati fir-rapport, huwa evidenti li l-kwalità tas-servizz tjiebet.
formal.en: From the results presented in the report, it is evident that the quality of the service has improved.
formal.zh: 从报告所列的结果可以明显看出，服务质量有所提高。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Taħseb li dan il-pjanta għandu bżonn l-ilma? Toni: Iva, huwa evidenti: il-ħamrija niexfa u l-weraq qed jidbiel.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you think this plant needs water? Toni: Yes, it is obvious: the soil is dry and the leaves are wilting.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你觉得这株植物需要浇水吗？托尼：是啊，很明显：土已经干了，叶子也在发蔫。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li dan il-pjanta għandu bżonn l-ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li dan il-pjanta għandu bżonn l-ilma?
messages.zh: 你觉得这株植物需要浇水吗？
messages.en: Do you think this plant needs water?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa evidenti: il-ħamrija niexfa u l-weraq qed jidbiel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa evidenti: il-ħamrija niexfa u l-weraq qed jidbiel.
messages.zh: 是啊，很明显：土已经干了，叶子也在发蔫。
messages.en: Yes, it is obvious: the soil is dry and the leaves are wilting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象干土和发蔫的叶子摆在眼前，缺水这件事“一看就明白”。把这种清楚可见、容易理解的感觉与 evidenti 连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Facts, information, or objects that help show whether something is true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 帮助判断某件事是否真实、某种说法是否成立的事实、信息或实物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fatti, informazzjoni jew oġġetti li jgħinu biex jintwera jekk xi ħaġa hijiex vera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够支持、反驳或检验某种说法的证据。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fatti, informazzjoni jew oġġetti li jistgħu jintużaw biex isostnu jew jikkontradixxu xi stqarrija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Evidence consists of facts, information, or objects that help establish whether a claim is true.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta evidenza ċara li l-miżuri l-ġodda naqqsu l-konsum tal-ilma.
formal.en: The report presents clear evidence that the new measures reduced water consumption.
formal.zh: 报告提出了明确的证据，表明新措施减少了用水量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek evidenza li ħallast? Mark: Iva, għandi l-irċevuta fuq il-mowbajl.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have evidence that you paid? Mark: Yes, I have the receipt on my phone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有付款的证据吗？马克：有，我手机里有收据。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有付款的证据吗？
messages.en: Do you have evidence that you paid?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，我手机里有收据。
messages.en: Yes, I have the receipt on my phone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 evidenza 放进“提出说法，再拿出证据”的情景：手机里的收据就是付款的 evidenza。搭配 evidenza ċara 一起记，表示“明确的证据”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep away from someone or something, prevent an unwanted situation, or move out of the way of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 避开某人或某物，防止不希望发生的情况，或移动身体以躲开迎面而来的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżomm ruħu 'l bogħod minn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jagħmel mod li sitwazzjoni mhux mixtieqa ma sseħħx, jew jitwarrab biex ma jintlaqatx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 避免某种情况发生，或有意避开某人、某物或某项活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel mod li xi ħaġa mhux mixtieqa ma tiġrix, jew iżomm ruħu 'l bogħod minn persuna, ħaġa jew attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you avoid something, you take action to prevent it from happening or keep away from it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过迅速移动身体或改变方向，躲开来物、碰撞或攻击。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jitwarrab jew ibiddel id-direzzjoni malajr biex ma jintlaqatx minn xi ħaġa jew minn xi ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you dodge something, you move quickly out of its path so that it does not hit you.

formal.mt: Biex jevita l-iżbalji, l-istudent għandu jaqra l-istruzzjonijiet kollha qabel jibda l-eżami.
formal.en: To avoid mistakes, the student should read all the instructions before starting the examination.
formal.zh: 为避免出错，学生应在开始考试前读完所有说明。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif irnexxielek tevita l-ballun? Pawlu: Rajtu ġej u twarrabt malajr.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did you manage to dodge the ball? Pawlu: I saw it coming and quickly moved aside.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你是怎么躲开那个球的？保罗：我看到球飞过来，就赶紧闪到一边。

messages.speaker: Lara (队友)
messages.zh: 你是怎么躲开那个球的？
messages.en: How did you manage to dodge the ball?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (队友)
messages.zh: 我看到球飞过来，就赶紧闪到一边。
messages.en: I saw it coming and quickly moved aside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个动作记 evita：检查答案来“避免错误”，看到来球就“闪身躲开”。前者对应 avoid，后者对应 dodge；共同画面是让自己避开麻烦或碰撞。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to evolution or to a process of gradual change and development.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与进化有关的，或涉及事物逐渐变化、发展的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-evoluzzjoni jew ma' proċess ta' bidla u żvilupp gradwali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与生物进化或逐渐演变、发展的过程有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-evoluzzjoni tal-ħlejjaq ħajjin jew il-bidla u l-iżvilupp gradwali ta' xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is evolutionary relates to evolution or develops through a process of gradual change.

collocations.zh: 进化性变化；渐进的演变

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-proċess evoluttiv li wassal għad-diversità tal-ispeċijiet f'dan l-ambjent.
formal.en: The study examines the evolutionary process that led to the diversity of species in this environment.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察了形成该环境中物种多样性的进化过程。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-kapitlu jitkellem dwar il-proċess evoluttiv? Samwel: Iva, jispjega kif l-ispeċijiet jinbidlu maż-żmien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this chapter about the evolutionary process? Samwel: Yes, it explains how species change over time.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这一章讲的是进化过程吗？萨姆韦尔：是的，它解释物种如何随时间发生变化。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kapitlu jitkellem dwar il-proċess evoluttiv?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kapitlu jitkellem dwar il-proċess evoluttiv?
messages.zh: 这一章讲的是进化过程吗？
messages.en: Is this chapter about the evolutionary process?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jispjega kif l-ispeċijiet jinbidlu maż-żmien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jispjega kif l-ispeċijiet jinbidlu maż-żmien.
messages.zh: 是的，它解释物种如何随时间发生变化。
messages.en: Yes, it explains how species change over time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象课本上连续几幅展示变化的图，用 proċess evoluttiv 标记整个“进化过程”。再配对记 evoluttiv 与 evoluttiva：proċess evoluttiv、bidla evoluttiva。

gloss_zh: 圣体圣事的；与圣体圣事有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the Eucharist or to its celebration in Christian worship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与基督宗教中的圣体圣事或其礼仪庆典有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Ewkaristija jew maċ-ċelebrazzjoni tagħha fil-qima Nisranija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涉及圣体圣事及其礼仪、敬礼或相关活动的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-Ewkaristija, ir-riti tagħha jew l-attivitajiet marbuta magħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is Eucharistic is connected with the Eucharist or with the worship and ceremonies associated with it.

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-parroċċa jinkludi ċelebrazzjoni ewkaristika l-Ħadd filgħodu.
formal.en: The parish programme includes a Eucharistic celebration on Sunday morning.
formal.zh: 堂区的活动安排包括星期日上午的圣体圣事庆典。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Meta jibda l-kungress ewkaristiku? Ġużeppi: Għada filgħodu; il-programm qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb tal-knisja.
colloquial.en: Marija: When does the Eucharistic congress start? Ġużeppi: Tomorrow morning; the programme is beside the church door.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：圣体大会什么时候开始？约瑟夫：明天上午；活动安排就在教堂门旁边。

messages.speaker: Marija (堂区教友)
messages.zh: 圣体大会什么时候开始？
messages.en: When does the Eucharistic congress start?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (堂区志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada filgħodu; il-programm qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb tal-knisja.
messages.mt_standard: Għada filgħodu; il-programm qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb tal-knisja.
messages.zh: 明天上午；活动安排就在教堂门旁边。
messages.en: Tomorrow morning; the programme is beside the church door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ewkaristiku 联想到教堂活动表上的“圣体”主题：kungress ewkaristiku 是圣体大会，ċelebrazzjoni ewkaristika 是圣体圣事庆典。整组搭配记忆能同时练习形容词配合。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The day that came two days before today.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 今天往前数第二天，即昨天的前一天。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-jum ta' qabel ilbieraħ, jiġifieri jumejn qabel illum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 前天；昨天之前的那一天。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-jum li jiġi qabel ilbieraħ u li jkun jumejn qabel illum.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The day before yesterday is the day that occurred two days before today.

collocations.en: the meeting held the day before yesterday

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa saret ewlmiemes, u l-minuti tagħha ntbagħtu lill-membri lbieraħ.
formal.en: The meeting took place the day before yesterday, and its minutes were sent to the members yesterday.
formal.zh: 会议于前天举行，会议纪要已于昨天发送给各位成员。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta wasal ħuk? | Pawlu: Ewlmiemes. Illum se nieklu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: When did your brother arrive? | Pawlu: The day before yesterday. We're going to eat together today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你哥哥什么时候到的？ | 保罗：前天。今天我们打算一起吃饭。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥什么时候到的？
messages.en: When did your brother arrive?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 前天。今天我们打算一起吃饭。
messages.en: The day before yesterday. We're going to eat together today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历上从今天往回跳两格，把 ewlmiemes 放在“前天”那一格；用“今天、昨天、前天”的顺序帮助定位。

gloss_zh: 使兴奋；刺激；撩拨兴趣或感官

teaching_sense.en_definition: To arouse excitement, stimulate activity, or pleasantly tease someone's curiosity or senses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人兴奋，刺激思想或活动，或以令人愉悦的方式撩拨好奇心或感官。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqanqal eċċitament, tistimula l-ħsieb jew l-attività, jew tqanqal il-kurżità jew is-sensi b'mod pjaċevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人因期待、兴趣或热情而兴奋、激动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tqanqal f'xi ħadd sens qawwi ta' entużjażmu, ħeġġa jew stennija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something excites someone, it makes them feel enthusiastic or eager about what may happen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过刺激促使思想、感官或某种活动变得更加活跃。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħti stimolu li jagħmel il-ħsieb, is-sensi jew xi attività aktar attivi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something stimulates a process or faculty, it encourages it to become more active.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以逗引或暗示的方式撩拨好奇心、感官或欲望，使人产生愉悦的兴奋感。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tqanqal il-kurżità, is-sensi jew ix-xewqa b'mod li jagħti eċċitament pjaċevoli, xi drabi permezz ta' suġġeriment sesswali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something titillates someone, it pleasantly arouses their curiosity or senses, sometimes in a sexual way.

formal.mt: Il-kittieb eċita l-kurżità tal-qarrejja b'dettall misterjuż fl-ewwel paġna.
formal.en: The writer titillated the readers' curiosity with a mysterious detail on the first page.
formal.zh: 作者用第一页上的一个神秘细节撩拨了读者的好奇心。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għoġbok il-bidu tal-ktieb? Mark: Iva, eċita l-kurżità tiegħi mill-ewwel. Sara: Issa trid tkun taf x'ġara wara!
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you like the beginning of the book? Mark: Yes, it aroused my curiosity straight away. Sara: Now you want to know what happened next!
colloquial.zh: Sara：你喜欢这本书的开头吗？Mark：喜欢，它一下子就勾起了我的好奇心。Sara：现在你想知道后来发生了什么吧！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这本书的开头吗？
messages.en: Did you like the beginning of the book?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 喜欢，它一下子就勾起了我的好奇心。
messages.en: Yes, it aroused my curiosity straight away.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa trid tkun taf x'ġara wara!
messages.mt_standard: Issa trid tkun taf x'ġara wara!
messages.zh: 现在你想知道后来发生了什么吧！
messages.en: Now you want to know what happened next!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个义项串成阅读场景：情节使人兴奋，细节激发想象，悬念撩拨好奇；共同记成“引起反应”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who feels strong enthusiasm or eager anticipation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到非常兴奋、激动或热切期待的人，此处按名词化用法理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħoss ħeġġa kbira jew li tkun qed tistenna xi ħaġa b'ħafna entużjażmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 兴奋或激动的人，指因某事而充满热情或期待者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna mimlija entużjażmu jew ħeġġa minħabba xi ħaġa li ġrat jew li qed tistenna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone described as excited feels very enthusiastic about something that is happening or expected.

collocations.en: the most excited person in the group
the most excited person among the participants

formal.mt: L-aktar eċċitat fost il-parteċipanti kien Mark, li kien ilu jistenna din iż-żjara.
formal.en: The most excited person among the participants was Mark, who had been waiting a long time for this visit.
formal.zh: 参与者中最兴奋的是 Mark，他期待这次参观已经很久了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu l-aktar eċċitat għall-vjaġġ? Mark: Jien! Diġà ħejjejt il-bagalja. Maja: Għad fadal ġimgħa!
colloquial.en: Maja: Who's the most excited about the trip? Mark: Me! I've already packed my suitcase. Maja: There's still a week to go!
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁对这次旅行最兴奋？Mark：我！我已经收拾好行李箱了。Maja：还有一周呢！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁对这次旅行最兴奋？
messages.en: Who's the most excited about the trip?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我！我已经收拾好行李箱了。
messages.en: Me! I've already packed my suitcase.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 还有一周呢！
messages.en: There's still a week to go!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象旅行前一周就收好行李的那个人，用“最兴奋的那位”记住这里的名词化用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the greatest degree of sweetness among the things being compared.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在所比较的食物或饮料中甜度最高的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-akbar ħlewwa fost l-ikel jew ix-xorb li jkun qed jitqabbel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最甜的；在比较对象中甜度最高的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ogħla grad ta' ħlewwa fost l-affarijiet li jkunu qed jitqabblu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as sweetest has more sweetness than all the other things being compared.

formal.mt: Wara li daqu t-tliet tipi ta' ħelu, il-parteċipanti għażlu dan bħala l-eħlew fosthom.
formal.en: After tasting the three types of sweets, the participants chose this one as the sweetest among them.
formal.zh: 品尝三种糖果后，参与者选出这一种，认为它是其中最甜的。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema wieħed hu l-eħlew? Pawlu: Dan, imma għalija hu ħelu wisq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which one is the sweetest? Pawlu: This one, but it is too sweet for me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：哪一个最甜？保罗：这个，不过对我来说太甜了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 哪一个最甜？
messages.en: Which one is the sweetest?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan, imma għalija hu ħelu wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Dan, imma għalija hu ħelu wisq.
messages.zh: 这个，不过对我来说太甜了。
messages.en: This one, but it is too sweet for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面前摆着三种糖果，把甜度最高的那一种圈起来，用 eħlew 记住“最甜的”；这是场景记忆法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To honour someone or something highly, or to express strong praise for them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给予某人或某事很高的尊崇，或对其作出热烈的称赞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tagħti ġieħ kbir lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa, jew li tfaħħarhom ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尊崇；将某人或某事物推崇到很高的地位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tgħolli lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa fil-ġieħ u tqishom ta' importanza kbira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you exalt someone or something, you honour them greatly and present them as especially important or worthy.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 称赞；对某人的品质、表现或某事物的价值表示赞许。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tesprimi kliem ta' tifħir jew approvazzjoni dwar il-kwalitajiet, il-ħidma jew il-valur ta' xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you praise someone or something, you express approval of their qualities, achievements, or value.

formal.mt: Fid-diskors tiegħu, il-president eżalta l-kuraġġ tal-voluntiera u faħħar is-servizz tagħhom lill-komunità.
formal.en: In his speech, the president exalted the volunteers' courage and praised their service to the community.
formal.zh: 主席在讲话中赞颂了志愿者的勇气，并表扬了他们为社区提供的服务。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għoġbu l-kunċert lil Mark? | Luqa: Iva, eżalta lill-kantanta u qal li kellha vuċi mill-isbaħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Mark like the concert? | Luqa: Yes, he praised the singer highly and said she had a wonderful voice.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克喜欢那场音乐会吗？ | 卢卡：喜欢，他对那位女歌手大加赞赏，说她的嗓音非常美。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克喜欢那场音乐会吗？
messages.en: Did Mark like the concert?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, eżalta lill-kantanta u qal li kellha vuċi mill-isbaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, eżalta lill-kantanta u qal li kellha vuċi mill-isbaħ.
messages.zh: 喜欢，他对那位女歌手大加赞赏，说她的嗓音非常美。
messages.en: Yes, he praised the singer highly and said she had a wonderful voice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把优秀的人请上高台，再热烈称赞：高台提示“尊崇”，掌声提示“赞扬”，一起记住 eżalta 的两个义项。

gloss_zh: 崇高的；备受尊崇的；高妙的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Held in very high honour, or showing exceptional grandeur, beauty, or nobility.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到极高尊崇的，或在气度、美感、思想等方面显得崇高卓越的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgawdi ġieħ kbir, jew li juri kobor, sbuħija jew nobbiltà straordinarja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地位崇高的；受到高度尊崇的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu pożizzjoni għolja ħafna jew li jingħata ġieħ u rispett kbir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is exalted has a very high position or is regarded with great honour.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 崇高而令人赞叹的；在美感、思想或表达上高妙卓绝的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu sbuħija, kobor jew nobbiltà tant straordinarja li jqajjem ammirazzjoni profonda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something sublime has such exceptional beauty, grandeur, or nobility that it inspires deep admiration.

formal.mt: Il-poeta juża stil eżaltat biex jesprimi l-ammirazzjoni tiegħu għall-kobor tan-natura.
formal.en: The poet uses a sublime style to express his admiration for the grandeur of nature.
formal.zh: 诗人以崇高的文风表达自己对大自然壮美的赞叹。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif sibt il-poeżija? | Adam: Għandha stil eżaltat, imma xi kliem kien diffiċli għalija.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did you think of the poem? | Adam: It has a sublime style, but some words were difficult for me.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你觉得这首诗怎么样？ | 亚当：它的文风很崇高，不过有些词对我来说比较难。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你觉得这首诗怎么样？
messages.en: What did you think of the poem?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandha stil eżaltat, imma xi kliem kien diffiċli għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Għandha stil eżaltat, imma xi kliem kien diffiċli għalija.
messages.zh: 它的文风很崇高，不过有些词对我来说比较难。
messages.en: It has a sublime style, but some words were difficult for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记 eżaltat：受众人敬仰的领袖对应“备受尊崇”，令人赞叹的诗篇对应“崇高高妙”；这是义项联想。

gloss_zh: 已检查的；已审查的；经过仔细审视的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Already inspected, studied, or checked, sometimes with close attention to detail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经接受检查、研究或审查的，也可强调经过细致审视。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie spezzjonat, studjat jew iċċekkjat, kultant b'attenzjoni kbira għad-dettalji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已被检查、查看或研究过的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie osservat, spezzjonat jew studjat sabiex tinkiseb informazzjoni dwaru jew tiġi vverifikata l-kundizzjoni tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that has been examined has been inspected or studied to discover information about it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经过仔细审视或严格审查的，强调对细节的关注。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie mistħarreġ b'attenzjoni kbira u fid-dettall sabiex jiġu identifikati żbalji, problemi jew aspetti importanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that has been scrutinised has been checked very carefully, with close attention to its details.

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt ġie eżaminat fid-dettall qabel ma ġie ffirmat miż-żewġ partijiet.
formal.en: The contract was scrutinised in detail before it was signed by both parties.
formal.zh: 合同在双方签署之前已经过详细审查。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-mekkanik diġà ra l-mutur? | Rita: Iva, il-mutur ġie eżaminat dalgħodu, u kollox jidher sew.
colloquial.en: Mark: Has the mechanic looked at the engine yet? | Rita: Yes, the engine was examined this morning, and everything looks fine.
colloquial.zh: 马克：修理工已经看过发动机了吗？ | 丽塔：看过了，发动机今天上午已经检查过，一切看起来都正常。

messages.speaker: Mark (车主)
messages.zh: 修理工已经看过发动机了吗？
messages.en: Has the mechanic looked at the engine yet?

messages.speaker: Rita (修理店接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-mutur ġie eżaminat dalgħodu, u kollox jidher sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-mutur ġie eżaminat dalgħodu, u kollox jidher sew.
messages.zh: 看过了，发动机今天上午已经检查过，一切看起来都正常。
messages.en: Yes, the engine was examined this morning, and everything looks fine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象文件上盖着“已检查”印章来记 eżaminat；再加一只放大镜，就能联想到“经过仔细审视”的较强含义。

gloss_zh: 筋疲力尽的；耗尽的；售罄的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having no strength, supply, or stock left.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人已精疲力竭，或资源已经耗尽、商品已经售罄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna bla saħħa minħabba l-għeja, riżorsa li ntemmet, jew prodott li m'għadux disponibbli fl-istokk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 筋疲力尽的；因极度疲劳而几乎没有力气的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jkun għajjien ħafna u kważi bla saħħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is exhausted is extremely tired and has very little energy left.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耗尽的；储备或可用数量已经用完的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi riżorsa jew provvista li tkun intużat kollha u ma jkun baqa' xejn minnha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A supply that is depleted has been used up until none remains.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缺货的；现有库存已经售完、暂时无货可供的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi prodott li m'għadux disponibbli għall-bejgħ għax l-istokk tiegħu jkun spiċċa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A product that is out of stock is currently unavailable because the seller has none left.

formal.mt: Wara ġurnata sħiħa ta' xogħol fiżiku, il-ħaddiem kien eżawrit u kellu bżonn jistrieħ.
formal.en: After a full day of physical work, the worker was exhausted and needed to rest.
formal.zh: 经过一整天的体力劳动，这名工人筋疲力尽，需要休息。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għad għandkom dan il-ktieb? Lara: Le, bħalissa huwa eżawrit. Nista' nurik ktieb ieħor.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you still have this book? Lara: No, it is currently out of stock. I can show you another book.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你们还有这本书吗？拉拉：没有，目前已经售罄。我可以给你看看另一本。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 你们还有这本书吗？
messages.en: Do you still have this book?

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, bħalissa huwa eżawrit. Nista' nurik ktieb ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Le, bħalissa huwa eżawrit. Nista' nurik ktieb ieħor.
messages.zh: 没有，目前已经售罄。我可以给你看看另一本。
messages.en: No, it is currently out of stock. I can show you another book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个义项连成一幅图：人的体力见底、资源储备见底、商店库存见底，都可用这个词描述；按主语判断具体含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To use up a supply or leave someone without strength.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 耗尽可用的资源或精力，或使某人疲惫至几乎没有力气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tuża riżorsa kollha kemm hi jew tħalli lil xi ħadd bla saħħa minħabba sforz jew għeja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耗尽资源或精力；使某人筋疲力尽。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tuża provvista jew riżorsa sakemm ma jibqa' xejn minnha, jew iġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jgħejja ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: To exhaust something means to use it up, while to exhaust someone means to make them extremely tired.

formal.mt: Il-proġett eżawrixxa r-riżorsi kollha tat-tim qabel ma tlesta x-xogħol.
formal.en: The project exhausted all the team's resources before the work was completed.
formal.zh: 工作尚未完成，这个项目就耗尽了团队的全部资源。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex sejjer torqod daqshekk kmieni? Pawlu: Ix-xogħol tal-lum eżawrixxa s-saħħa kollha tiegħi. Għandi bżonn nistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you going to bed so early? Pawlu: Today's work exhausted all my strength. I need to rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么这么早就去睡觉？保罗：今天的工作把我的体力都耗尽了。我需要休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么这么早就去睡觉？
messages.en: Why are you going to bed so early?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xogħol tal-lum eżawrixxa s-saħħa kollha tiegħi. Għandi bżonn nistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xogħol tal-lum eżawrixxa s-saħħa kollha tiegħi. Għandi bżonn nistrieħ.
messages.zh: 今天的工作把我的体力都耗尽了。我需要休息。
messages.en: Today's work exhausted all my strength. I need to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“工作耗尽体力，项目耗尽资源”两组宾语记忆：这个动词强调把原有的力量或储备用到见底。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a funeral or rites performed for a deceased person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与葬礼或为逝者举行的丧葬仪式有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' funeral jew mar-riti li jsiru għal persuna mejta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 葬礼的；与为逝者举行的丧葬礼仪有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi riti, ċerimonji jew affarijiet oħra marbuta mal-funeral ta' persuna mejta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as exequial or funerary is connected with a funeral or ceremonies held for a deceased person.

formal.mt: Il-programm jagħti d-dettalji taċ-ċerimonji eżekjali u l-ħin meta jibdew.
formal.en: The programme provides details of the funeral ceremonies and the time they begin.
formal.zh: 这份程序单列出了葬礼仪式的具体安排及开始时间。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fil-programm hemm miktub 'riti eżekjali'. Xi tfisser? David: Tfisser ir-riti tal-funeral.
colloquial.en: Anna: The programme says 'riti eżekjali'. What does that mean? David: It means the funeral rites.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：程序单上写着“riti eżekjali”。这是什么意思？戴维：意思是葬礼的礼仪。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-programm hemm miktub 'riti eżekjali'. Xi tfisser?
messages.mt_standard: Fil-programm hemm miktub 'riti eżekjali'. Xi tfisser?
messages.zh: 程序单上写着“riti eżekjali”。这是什么意思？
messages.en: The programme says 'riti eżekjali'. What does that mean?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 意思是葬礼的礼仪。
messages.en: It means the funeral rites.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词放在葬礼程序单上记忆：看到“礼仪”或“仪式”后接 eżekjali，就联想到为逝者举行的丧葬活动。

gloss_zh: 根本性不履行；根本性履行不足

teaching_sense.en_definition: A serious failure to fulfil an essential obligation under an agreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对协议中核心义务的严重不履行或履行不足。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas serju fit-twettiq ta' obbligu essenzjali taħt ftehim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 根本性不履行：对协议核心义务的严重不履行，包括严重的履行不足。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nuqqas fit-twettiq ta' obbligu taħt ftehim li jkun tant serju li jolqot l-iskop ewlieni tal-ftehim.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fundamental non-performance is a failure to fulfil an obligation that seriously undermines the main purpose of an agreement.

collocations.zh: 一起根本性不履行的情形

collocations.mt: tevalwa jekk hemmx eżekuzzjoni insuffiċjenti fundamentali
collocations.en: to assess whether there is fundamental non-performance
collocations.zh: 评估是否存在根本性不履行

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina jekk in-nuqqas fit-twettiq tal-obbligu ewlieni jikkostitwixxix eżekuzzjoni insuffiċjenti fundamentali.
formal.en: The report examines whether the failure to fulfil the main obligation constitutes fundamental non-performance.
formal.zh: 报告探讨了未履行主要义务是否构成根本性不履行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser 'eżekuzzjoni insuffiċjenti fundamentali' f'dan l-eżempju? Mark: Tfisser nuqqas serju ħafna fit-twettiq ta' obbligu ewlieni tal-ftehim. Sara: Allura qed nitkellmu dwar problema li tolqot l-iskop ewlieni tal-ftehim. Mark: Iva, hekk hu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'fundamental non-performance' mean in this example? Mark: It means a very serious failure to fulfil a main obligation under the agreement. Sara: So we are talking about a problem that affects the agreement's main purpose. Mark: Yes, that is right.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个例子中的“根本性不履行”是什么意思？马克：意思是履行协议主要义务时出现了非常严重的缺失。萨拉：也就是说，我们谈的是影响协议主要目的的问题。马克：对，是这样。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'eżekuzzjoni insuffiċjenti fundamentali' f'dan l-eżempju?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'eżekuzzjoni insuffiċjenti fundamentali' f'dan l-eżempju?
messages.zh: 这个例子中的“根本性不履行”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'fundamental non-performance' mean in this example?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser nuqqas serju ħafna fit-twettiq ta' obbligu ewlieni tal-ftehim.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser nuqqas serju ħafna fit-twettiq ta' obbligu ewlieni tal-ftehim.
messages.zh: 意思是履行协议主要义务时出现了非常严重的缺失。
messages.en: It means a very serious failure to fulfil a main obligation under the agreement.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Allura qed nitkellmu dwar problema li tolqot l-iskop ewlieni tal-ftehim.
messages.mt_standard: Allura qed nitkellmu dwar problema li tolqot l-iskop ewlieni tal-ftehim.
messages.zh: 也就是说，我们谈的是影响协议主要目的的问题。
messages.en: So we are talking about a problem that affects the agreement's main purpose.

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 对，是这样。
messages.en: Yes, that is right.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按三个意义块记忆整条术语：eżekuzzjoni 对应履行，insuffiċjenti 对应不足，fundamentali 对应根本性；合起来指核心义务出现严重履行缺失。

gloss_zh: 对待给付；相互对应的履约给付

teaching_sense.en_definition: The performance that one party provides in return for the other party's performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一方为换取另一方的履约给付而作出的相应给付或履约行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-twettiq ta' obbligu minn parti bi skambju għat-twettiq ta' obbligu mill-parti l-oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对待给付，即一方为交换另一方的给付而承担并履行的相应义务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-twettiq ta' obbligu li parti tagħti bi skambju għall-prestazzjoni tal-parti l-oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A counter-performance is something that one party does or provides in return for what the other party does or provides.

collocations.en: counter-performance in the form of payment
collocations.zh: 以付款形式作出的对待给付

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, il-kunsinna tal-oġġetti hija l-prestazzjoni tal-bejjiegħ, filwaqt li l-ħlas huwa l-eżekuzzjoni korrispettiva tax-xerrej.
formal.en: In this example, delivery of the goods is the seller's performance, while payment is the buyer's counter-performance.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，交付货物是卖方的给付，而付款是买方的对待给付。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser eżekuzzjoni korrispettiva f'dan l-eżempju? Mark: Il-bejjiegħ jagħtik il-mejda, u inti tħallsu. Il-ħlas huwa dak li tagħti bi skambju.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does counter-performance mean in this example? Mark: The seller gives you the table, and you pay him. The payment is what you provide in return.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个例子里的“对待给付”是什么意思？马克：卖方把桌子交给你，你付钱给他。付款就是你作出的相应给付。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser eżekuzzjoni korrispettiva f'dan l-eżempju?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser eżekuzzjoni korrispettiva f'dan l-eżempju?
messages.zh: 这个例子里的“对待给付”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does counter-performance mean in this example?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bejjiegħ jagħtik il-mejda, u inti tħallsu. Il-ħlas huwa dak li tagħti bi skambju.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bejjiegħ jagħtik il-mejda, u inti tħallsu. Il-ħlas huwa dak li tagħti bi skambju.
messages.zh: 卖方把桌子交给你，你付钱给他。付款就是你作出的相应给付。
messages.en: The seller gives you the table, and you pay him. The payment is what you provide in return.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象交易桌两边一边交货、一边付款：用“你给我，我相应给你”的画面记住对待给付。

gloss_zh: 合同的实施；合同义务的履行

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of putting a contract into effect and carrying out the obligations it contains.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将合同约定付诸实施，并完成其中规定的各项义务的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jitwettaq dak li jkun ġie miftiehem f'kuntratt u jiġu sodisfatti l-obbligi tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合同的实施，即将合同中的约定和安排实际落实。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih l-arranġamenti u l-kundizzjonijiet miftiehma f'kuntratt jitqiegħdu fil-prattika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The implementation of a contract is the process of putting its agreed arrangements and terms into practice.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合同的履行，即当事人完成合同规定的义务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-twettiq mill-partijiet tal-obbligi li jkunu daħlu għalihom skont il-kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The performance of a contract involves carrying out the duties that the parties have agreed to undertake.

collocations.en: monitoring the implementation of a contract
a delay in the performance of a contract

formal.mt: Ir-rapport dwar l-eżekuzzjoni ta' kuntratt għandu jiddeskrivi x-xogħol li sar u jindika jekk l-obbligi twettqux fil-ħin.
formal.en: A report on the performance of a contract should describe the work completed and indicate whether the obligations were fulfilled on time.
formal.zh: 合同履行报告应说明已经完成的工作，并指出各项义务是否按时履行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qed tistudja llum? David: L-eżekuzzjoni ta' kuntratt. Qed nitgħallem kif il-partijiet iwettqu dak li jkunu ftiehmu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you studying today? David: The performance of a contract. I'm learning how the parties carry out what they have agreed.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今天在学什么？戴维：合同的履行。我在学合同各方怎样落实已经达成的约定。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天在学什么？
messages.en: What are you studying today?

messages.speaker: David (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: L-eżekuzzjoni ta' kuntratt. Qed nitgħallem kif il-partijiet iwettqu dak li jkunu ftiehmu.
messages.mt_standard: L-eżekuzzjoni ta' kuntratt. Qed nitgħallem kif il-partijiet iwettqu dak li jkunu ftiehmu.
messages.zh: 合同的履行。我在学合同各方怎样落实已经达成的约定。
messages.en: The performance of a contract. I'm learning how the parties carry out what they have agreed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把合同想成一张行动清单：约定开始落实是“实施”，各方完成应做的事是“履行”，两种侧重点一起记。

gloss_zh: 堪称典范的；值得效法的

teaching_sense.en_definition: So good in conduct or quality that it provides an example for others to follow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在行为或品质方面十分出色，足以成为他人学习榜样的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun tajjeb ħafna fl-imġiba jew fil-kwalità u jservi ta' eżempju għal ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 堪称典范的；表现或品质优秀到值得他人效法的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri livell għoli ħafna ta' mġiba jew kwalità u jistħoqqlu li ħaddieħor jieħu eżempju minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone's conduct or work is exemplary, it is so good that other people can learn from it and follow its example.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat faħħar lill-voluntiera għall-imġiba eżemplari tagħhom u għall-għajnuna li taw lill-komunità.
formal.en: The committee praised the volunteers for their exemplary behaviour and the help they gave the community.
formal.zh: 委员会表扬了志愿者们堪称典范的行为，以及他们为社区提供的帮助。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif mar ix-xogħol ta' Nina? Pawlu: Kien eżemplari! Kollox kien ċar, preċiż u lest fil-ħin.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did Nina's work turn out? Pawlu: It was exemplary! Everything was clear, accurate and ready on time.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：妮娜的工作完成得怎么样？保罗：堪称典范！每一项都清楚、准确，而且按时完成。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 妮娜的工作完成得怎么样？
messages.en: How did Nina's work turn out?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien eżemplari! Kollox kien ċar, preċiż u lest fil-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Kien eżemplari! Kollox kien ċar, preċiż u lest fil-ħin.
messages.zh: 堪称典范！每一项都清楚、准确，而且按时完成。
messages.en: It was exemplary! Everything was clear, accurate and ready on time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师把优秀作业举起来请全班学习：不只是“做得好”，还要“值得大家照着学”，就是 eżemplari。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To officially release someone or something from a duty, payment, or requirement that would otherwise apply.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式免除某人或某物原本适用的义务、费用或要求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jeħles uffiċjalment lil persuna jew lil xi ħaġa minn obbligu, ħlas jew rekwiżit li kieku kien japplika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 豁免；使某人或某物不必承担原本适用的义务、缴款或要求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jeħles lil persuna jew lil xi ħaġa minn dmir, ħlas jew kundizzjoni li normalment tkun tapplika għaliha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an authority exempts someone from a requirement, it officially allows that person not to meet a requirement that would normally apply.

collocations.en: exempted the student from the examination
collocations.zh: 免除了该学生参加考试的要求
免除了参与者的缴费义务

formal.mt: Il-kumitat eżenta lill-istudent mill-eżami finali wara li rrikonoxxa kwalifika ekwivalenti.
formal.en: The committee exempted the student from the final examination after recognising an equivalent qualification.
formal.zh: 委员会认可了一项同等资格，因此免除了该学生参加期末考试的要求。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex ma ħallastx għall-kors? Ġanni: L-organizzatur eżenta lill-voluntiera mill-ħlas, u jien wieħed minnhom.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why didn't you pay for the course? Ġanni: The organiser exempted the volunteers from payment, and I'm one of them.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你为什么没有交课程费？詹尼：主办方免除了志愿者的费用，我就是其中一员。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么没有交课程费？
messages.en: Why didn't you pay for the course?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: L-organizzatur eżenta lill-voluntiera mill-ħlas, u jien wieħed minnhom.
messages.mt_standard: L-organizzatur eżenta lill-voluntiera mill-ħlas, u jien wieħed minnhom.
messages.zh: 主办方免除了志愿者的费用，我就是其中一员。
messages.en: The organiser exempted the volunteers from payment, and I'm one of them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象负责人把你的名字从缴费名单中划去：本来需要承担，现在正式免除。连着记“豁免某人某项义务”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exemption that removes the obligation to pay import duties on particular goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 免除对特定进口货物缴纳进口关税义务的安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħelsien mill-obbligu li jitħallsu dazji ta' importazzjoni fuq ċerti oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 免除进口货物所应缴纳的进口关税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Eżenzjoni li teħles lill-importatur mill-obbligu li jħallas id-dazji ta' importazzjoni fuq oġġetti speċifiċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If goods qualify for relief from import duties, the importer does not have to pay those duties on them.

collocations.mt: tapplika għal eżenzjoni mid-dazji ta' importazzjoni
collocations.en: apply for relief from import duties
be granted relief from import duties

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ressqet applikazzjoni għal eżenzjoni mid-dazji ta' importazzjoni fuq it-tagħmir il-ġdid.
formal.en: The company submitted an application for relief from import duties on the new equipment.
formal.zh: 该公司提交了新设备进口关税豁免申请。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Applikajt għal eżenzjoni mid-dazji ta' importazzjoni fuq dan it-tagħmir? Mark: Iva, imma għadni qed nistenna t-tweġiba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you apply for relief from import duties on this equipment? Mark: Yes, but I'm still waiting for a reply.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你申请免缴这批设备的进口关税了吗？Mark：申请了，不过我还在等回复。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Applikajt għal eżenzjoni mid-dazji ta' importazzjoni fuq dan it-tagħmir?
messages.mt_standard: Applikajt għal eżenzjoni mid-dazji ta' importazzjoni fuq dan it-tagħmir?
messages.zh: 你申请免缴这批设备的进口关税了吗？
messages.en: Did you apply for relief from import duties on this equipment?

messages.speaker: Mark (进口业务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għadni qed nistenna t-tweġiba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għadni qed nistenna t-tweġiba.
messages.zh: 申请了，不过我还在等回复。
messages.en: Yes, but I'm still waiting for a reply.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象进口设备旁的一张关税豁免批准书，把整组词记成“进口货物免缴关税”；末尾的 importazzjoni 提醒你限定的是进口环节。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exemption from paying a duty, especially a customs duty on goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 免除缴纳某项税捐的义务，尤指免缴货物关税。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħelsien mill-obbligu li jitħallas dazju, speċjalment dazju doganali fuq oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 免除缴纳某项税捐的义务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħelsien mill-obbligu li jitħallas dazju partikolari li kieku kien ikun dovut.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A duty exemption allows a person or organization to avoid paying a duty that would otherwise be due.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 免除货物所应缴纳的关税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħelsien mill-obbligu li jitħallas id-dazju doganali fuq ċerti oġġetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An exemption from customs duty means that the specified goods are allowed without payment of that customs charge.

collocations.en: a request for a duty exemption

formal.mt: L-ittra tikkonferma li l-eżenzjoni mid-dazju tapplika biss għall-oġġetti elenkati fl-applikazzjoni.
formal.en: The letter confirms that the duty exemption applies only to the goods listed in the application.
formal.zh: 该信函确认，关税豁免仅适用于申请中列明的货物。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Waslet il-konferma tal-eżenzjoni mid-dazju? Pawlu: Iva, iżda tkopri biss l-oġġetti f'din il-lista.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has the confirmation of the duty exemption arrived? Pawlu: Yes, but it only covers the goods on this list.
colloquial.zh: Sara：关税豁免的确认函到了吗？Pawlu：到了，不过只涵盖这份清单上的货物。

messages.speaker: Sara (进口商)
messages.zh: 关税豁免的确认函到了吗？
messages.en: Has the confirmation of the duty exemption arrived?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (业务助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iżda tkopri biss l-oġġetti f'din il-lista.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iżda tkopri biss l-oġġetti f'din il-lista.
messages.zh: 到了，不过只涵盖这份清单上的货物。
messages.en: Yes, but it only covers the goods on this list.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这组词与“税单上盖了豁免章”的画面绑定：一般语境记“免缴税捐”，货物通关语境记“免缴关税”，依上下文选择中文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A structured examination of accounts and financial records to check their accuracy and compliance with applicable requirements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有组织地检查账目和财务记录，以核实其准确性及是否符合适用要求的核查或审计工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċess organizzat ta' eżami tal-kontijiet u tar-rekords finanzjarji biex jiġu vverifikati l-eżattezza tagħhom u l-konformità mar-rekwiżiti applikabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过检查账目和财务记录，核实会计信息并发现差错的会计核查工作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kontroll tal-kontijiet u tar-rekords finanzjarji biex jiġi żgurat li l-informazzjoni tkun korretta u biex jinstabu żbalji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Accounting control involves checking financial records to ensure that transactions are recorded correctly and errors are identified.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对账目及相关财务记录进行系统检查，以评估其准确性和合规性的审计。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Eżami sistematiku tal-kontijiet u tar-rekords finanzjarji biex jiġu evalwati l-eżattezza tagħhom u l-konformità mar-regoli applikabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An audit is a systematic examination of accounts and related records to assess their accuracy and compliance with relevant requirements.

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju tal-awditjar identifika differenzi bejn il-fatturi u l-ammonti rreġistrati fil-kontijiet.
formal.en: The audit identified discrepancies between the invoices and the amounts recorded in the accounts.
formal.zh: 此次审计发现，发票金额与账目中记录的金额存在差异。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Lest l-eżerċizzju tal-awditjar? David: Kważi; għad irridu niċċekkjaw żewġ fatturi.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is the audit finished? David: Almost; we still need to check two invoices.
colloquial.zh: Rita：审计做完了吗？David：快了，我们还得核查两张发票。

messages.speaker: Rita (财务主管)
messages.zh: 审计做完了吗？
messages.en: Is the audit finished?

messages.speaker: David (审计员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi; għad irridu niċċekkjaw żewġ fatturi.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi; għad irridu niċċekkjaw żewġ fatturi.
messages.zh: 快了，我们还得核查两张发票。
messages.en: Almost; we still need to check two invoices.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象审计员把发票、账簿和记录逐项对照，将整组词记作“一次查账工作”；内部核查侧重会计控制，系统检查侧重审计。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Detailed explanation and interpretation of a text, especially a religious text.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对文本进行细致说明和意义阐释，尤指对宗教经文的解释。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spjegazzjoni u interpretazzjoni dettaljata ta' test, speċjalment test reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对文本，尤其是宗教经文，所作的细致解释与阐释。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Analiżi dettaljata ta' test li tispjega t-tifsira tiegħu, speċjalment meta jkun test reliġjuż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Exegesis is the detailed explanation and interpretation of a text, especially a religious one.

formal.mt: Dan l-istudju jippreżenta eżigeżi dettaljata tat-test u jispjega t-tifsira ta' kull silta.
formal.en: This study presents a detailed exegesis of the text and explains the meaning of each passage.
formal.zh: 本研究对该文本作了细致阐释，并说明各段的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se naqraw it-test biss? Pawlu: Le, se nagħmlu wkoll eżigeżi biex nifhmu aħjar it-tifsira tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are we just going to read the text? Pawlu: No, we are also going to do an exegesis to understand its meaning better.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们只是读这篇文本吗？保罗：不是，我们还要作细致阐释，以便更好地理解它的含义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 我们只是读这篇文本吗？
messages.en: Are we just going to read the text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, se nagħmlu wkoll eżigeżi biex nifhmu aħjar it-tifsira tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, se nagħmlu wkoll eżigeżi biex nifhmu aħjar it-tifsira tiegħu.
messages.zh: 不是，我们还要作细致阐释，以便更好地理解它的含义。
messages.en: No, we are also going to do an exegesis to understand its meaning better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师逐句解释经文、在旁边写满注释，把 eżigeżi 记成“细读文本并阐明意义”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To force someone to leave a place or their own country and live elsewhere.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强迫某人离开某地或自己的国家，到别处居住。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitlaq minn post jew minn pajjiżu u jgħix xi mkien ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将某人逐出某地，并禁止其返回。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tkeċċi lil xi ħadd minn post u ma tħallihx jerġa' lura fih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone in authority banishes a person, they order that person to leave a place and stay away.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将某人放逐到国外，使其被迫离开祖国生活。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitlaq minn pajjiżu u jgħix barra minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an authority exiles someone, it forces that person to leave their own country and live elsewhere.

collocations.mt: eżilja lil xi ħadd minn pajjiżu

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-ħakkiem eżilja lill-poeta minħabba l-kritika tiegħu lejn il-gvern.
formal.en: In the novel, the ruler exiled the poet because of his criticism of the government.
formal.zh: 在小说中，统治者因诗人批评政府而将他放逐。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ħakkiem eżilja lill-poeta fl-istorja? Mark: Għax il-poeta kkritika lill-gvern.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the ruler exile the poet in the story? Mark: Because the poet criticized the government.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事里的统治者为什么放逐那位诗人？马克：因为诗人批评了政府。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里的统治者为什么放逐那位诗人？
messages.en: Why did the ruler exile the poet in the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 因为诗人批评了政府。
messages.en: Because the poet criticized the government.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 eżilja 放进“统治者把某人赶出国”的动作画面，记住它是表示放逐行为的动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state or period of living away from one's own country because of forced departure or an inability to return safely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因被迫离开祖国或无法安全返回而居住在国外的状态或时期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda jew il-perjodu ta' min jgħix barra minn pajjiżu għax ikun imġiegħel jitlaq jew ma jkunx jista' jerġa' lura bla periklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被迫离开祖国或无法安全返国而在国外生活的状态，也指这样的生活时期。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qagħda jew iż-żmien li fih persuna tgħix barra minn pajjiżha għax tkun tkeċċiet jew ma tkunx tista' tirritorna bla periklu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Exile is the state or period of living away from your own country because you have been forced to leave or cannot safely return.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist iqatta' għaxar snin fl-eżilju qabel ma jkun jista' jerġa' lura lejn pajjiżu.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist spends ten years in exile before being able to return to his country.
formal.zh: 在小说中，主人公度过了十年的流亡生活，之后才得以返回祖国。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-protagonist mar jgħix barra minn pajjiżu għax ried? Mark: Le, qed jgħix fl-eżilju u ma jistax jerġa' lura.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did the protagonist move abroad because he wanted to? Mark: No, he is living in exile and cannot return.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：主人公是自愿搬到国外生活的吗？马克：不是，他正在流亡，无法回国。

messages.speaker: Sara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-protagonist mar jgħix barra minn pajjiżu għax ried?
messages.mt_standard: Il-protagonist mar jgħix barra minn pajjiżu għax ried?
messages.zh: 主人公是自愿搬到国外生活的吗？
messages.en: Did the protagonist move abroad because he wanted to?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, qed jgħix fl-eżilju u ma jistax jerġa' lura.
messages.mt_standard: Le, qed jgħix fl-eżilju u ma jistax jerġa' lura.
messages.zh: 不是，他正在流亡，无法回国。
messages.en: No, he is living in exile and cannot return.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 eżilja“放逐的动作”和 eżilju“流亡的状态”配对记忆：前者做动作，后者过日子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The final result of an action, event, process, or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个行动、事件、过程或局势最终产生的结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-riżultat finali ta' azzjoni, ġrajja, proċess jew sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行动、事件或过程最终形成的结果或结局。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dak li jirriżulta fl-aħħar minn azzjoni, ġrajja jew proċess.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The outcome of an activity or situation is the final result that it produces.

formal.mt: L-eżitu tan-negozjati kien pożittiv, u ż-żewġ naħat iffirmaw ftehim.
formal.en: The outcome of the negotiations was positive, and both sides signed an agreement.
formal.zh: 谈判取得了积极结果，双方签署了协议。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif marret il-laqgħa? Mark: Kellha eżitu tajjeb; qbilna fuq id-data tal-attività.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did the meeting go? Mark: It had a good outcome; we agreed on the date of the event.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：会议开得怎么样？马克：结果不错，我们就活动日期达成了一致。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 会议开得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the meeting go?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kellha eżitu tajjeb; qbilna fuq id-data tal-attività.
messages.mt_standard: Kellha eżitu tajjeb; qbilna fuq id-data tal-attività.
messages.zh: 结果不错，我们就活动日期达成了一致。
messages.en: It had a good outcome; we agreed on the date of the event.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会议结束后在记录末尾写下“最终结果”，用 eżitu 对应这一栏，再连读 eżitu pożittiv“积极结果”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To expect a particular standard or action, or to insist that something be provided or done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 期望某人达到某种标准或采取某种行动，或坚持要求提供某物、完成某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tistenna livell jew azzjoni partikolari mingħand xi ħadd, jew titlob b'insistenza li tingħata xi ħaġa jew li ssir xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 期望某人履行职责、达到某种标准或采取某种行动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tistenna li xi ħadd jaġixxi b'ċertu mod jew jilħaq livell partikolari fix-xogħol jew fl-imġiba tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you expect a particular standard from someone, you consider that they should meet it in their work or behaviour.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坚决或强烈地要求得到某物，或要求某人完成某事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Titlob xi ħaġa b'insistenza jew tgħid b'mod sod li xi ħaġa għandha ssir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you demand something, you ask for it firmly and insist that it should be provided or done.

collocations.en: expected a high standard of professionalism
collocations.zh: 期望有高度的专业素养
强烈要求给出明确解释

formal.mt: Id-direttur eżiġa spjegazzjoni bil-miktub dwar id-dewmien fil-proġett.
formal.en: The director demanded a written explanation for the delay in the project.
formal.zh: 主管要求就项目延误提交书面解释。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qal il-klijent dwar il-ħlas żejjed? Ben: Eżiġa li nroddulu l-flus lura minnufih.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did the customer say about the extra charge? Ben: He demanded that we refund the money immediately.
colloquial.zh: Lara：顾客对多收的费用怎么说？Ben：他强烈要求我们立即退款。

messages.speaker: Lara (客服同事)
messages.zh: 顾客对多收的费用怎么说？
messages.en: What did the customer say about the extra charge?

messages.speaker: Ben (客服人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Eżiġa li nroddulu l-flus lura minnufih.
messages.mt_standard: Eżiġa li nroddulu l-flus lura minnufih.
messages.zh: 他强烈要求我们立即退款。
messages.en: He demanded that we refund the money immediately.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记住语气：主管心中设定工作标准，对应“期望”；顾客坚持马上退款，对应“强烈要求”。例句中的 eżiġa 表示“他曾期望或要求”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The biblical book that recounts the Israelites' departure from Egypt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 《圣经》中记述以色列人离开埃及的书卷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ktieb tal-Bibbja li jirrakkonta l-ħruġ tal-Iżraelin mill-Eġittu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 《出埃及记》，《圣经》中记述以色列人离开埃及的书卷。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-Eżodu huwa l-ktieb tal-Bibbja li jirrakkonta l-ħruġ tal-Iżraelin mill-Eġittu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Exodus is the book of the Bible that tells the story of the Israelites leaving Egypt.

formal.mt: Għal din il-lezzjoni, l-istudenti għandhom jaqraw l-ewwel kapitlu tal-Eżodu u jiktbu sommarju qasir.
formal.en: For this lesson, students should read the first chapter of Exodus and write a short summary.
formal.zh: 本课要求学生阅读《出埃及记》第一章，并写一篇简短摘要。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema ktieb qed taqra? Mark: Qed naqra l-Eżodu. Lara: Trid taqra kapitlu miegħi?
colloquial.en: Lara: Which book are you reading? Mark: I'm reading Exodus. Lara: Would you like to read a chapter with me?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你在读哪部书？马克：我在读《出埃及记》。拉拉：你想和我一起读一章吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在读哪部书？
messages.en: Which book are you reading?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在读《出埃及记》。
messages.en: I'm reading Exodus.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想和我一起读一章吗？
messages.en: Would you like to read a chapter with me?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Eżodu 与书名《出埃及记》配对记忆，再用“读一章”的场景巩固它作为书卷名称的用法。

gloss_zh: 异国情调的；具有异域特色的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unusual and interesting because it is associated with a distant or unfamiliar place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因与遥远或不熟悉的地方有关而显得新奇、有异域特色的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jidher mhux tas-soltu u interessanti għax ikun marbut ma' post imbiegħed jew mhux familjari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有异国情调的；因来自遥远或不熟悉的地方而显得新奇的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa eżotika tidher mhux tas-soltu u interessanti għax tiġi minn post imbiegħed jew tkun marbuta miegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something exotic seems unusual and interesting because it comes from, or is associated with, a distant or unfamiliar place.

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi deżerta magħmula minn frott eżotiku.
formal.en: The menu includes a dessert made with exotic fruit.
formal.zh: 菜单上有一道用异域水果制作的甜点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-frott jidher eżotiku. Qatt doqtu? Pawlu: Le, imma nixtieq nippruvah. Maja: Ejja nixtru ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: This fruit looks exotic. Have you ever tasted it? Pawlu: No, but I'd like to try it. Maja: Let's buy some.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这水果看起来很有异域特色。你尝过吗？保罗：没有，不过我想尝尝。玛雅：我们买一点吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-frott jidher eżotiku. Qatt doqtu?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-frott jidher eżotiku. Qatt doqtu?
messages.zh: 这水果看起来很有异域特色。你尝过吗？
messages.en: This fruit looks exotic. Have you ever tasted it?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，不过我想尝尝。
messages.en: No, but I'd like to try it.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们买一点吧。
messages.en: Let's buy some.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象第一次在市场见到陌生的异域水果，把 frott eżotiku 整组记成“具有异域特色的水果”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At the same time or in one action, or in a sudden and unexpected manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示多件事同时发生或一次完成，也可表示动作或变化突然发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fl-istess ħin jew b'azzjoni waħda, jew b'mod għal għarrieda u mhux mistenni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 同时；一齐；一次性地，强调多件事在同一时间发生或一并完成。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fl-istess ħin jew b'azzjoni waħda, mingħajr ma l-affarijiet isiru waħda wara l-oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If several things happen f'daqqa, they happen at the same time or are done in a single action.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 突然地；骤然地，指动作或状态没有逐渐过渡便发生变化。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod għal għarrieda, mingħajr bidla gradwali jew twissija minn qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something changes or stops f'daqqa, it does so suddenly, without a gradual transition or prior warning.

collocations.zh: 全部同时；全部一次性地

formal.mt: L-applikant għandu jibgħat id-dokumenti kollha f'daqqa sabiex l-uffiċċju jkun jista' jeżamina l-applikazzjoni sħiħa.
formal.en: The applicant should send all the documents at once so that the office can examine the complete application.
formal.zh: 申请人应一次性提交所有文件，以便办公室审查完整的申请。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Inġib il-kotba wieħed wieħed jew kollha f'daqqa? Mark: Ġibhom kollha f'daqqa jekk mhumiex tqal wisq.
colloquial.en: Nina: Shall I bring the books one at a time or all at once? Mark: Bring them all at once if they aren't too heavy.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这些书是一本一本拿过来，还是一次全拿来？马克：如果不太重，就一次全拿来。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Inġib il-kotba wieħed wieħed jew kollha f'daqqa?
messages.mt_standard: Inġib il-kotba wieħed wieħed jew kollha f'daqqa?
messages.zh: 这些书是一本一本拿过来，还是一次全拿来？
messages.en: Shall I bring the books one at a time or all at once?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġibhom kollha f'daqqa jekk mhumiex tqal wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Ġibhom kollha f'daqqa jekk mhumiex tqal wisq.
messages.zh: 如果不太重，就一次全拿来。
messages.en: Bring them all at once if they aren't too heavy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文“一下子”帮助区分：书一下子全搬来是“一次完成”，车一下子停住是“突然”；结合动作判断 f'daqqa 的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In an instant, or suddenly and without being expected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事在瞬间发生或完成，也可强调事情突然发生、出乎意料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'ħin qasir ħafna, jew b'mod għal għarrieda u mhux mistenni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瞬间；立刻，强调事情几乎不经过时间间隔便发生或完成。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Minnufih jew f'ħin qasir ħafna, mingħajr dewmien li jinħass.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happens f'daqqa waħda in this sense, it happens in an instant, with virtually no delay.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 突然；骤然，强调事情发生得出乎意料或没有预先的征兆。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għal għarrieda, mingħajr ma wieħed ikun qed jistenna dak li jiġri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happens f'daqqa waħda, it happens unexpectedly, often without any warning that it is about to occur.

formal.mt: Meta nfetaħ il-valv, il-pressjoni niżlet f'daqqa waħda u s-sistema waqfet taħdem.
formal.en: When the valve was opened, the pressure dropped suddenly and the system stopped working.
formal.zh: 阀门打开时，压力骤然下降，系统停止了运转。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Smajt dak il-ħoss? Luqa: Iva, beda f'daqqa waħda u ħasadni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you hear that noise? Luqa: Yes, it started suddenly and startled me.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你听到那个声音了吗？卢卡：听到了，它突然响起来，吓了我一跳。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 你听到那个声音了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that noise?

messages.speaker: Luqa (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, beda f'daqqa waħda u ħasadni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, beda f'daqqa waħda u ħasadni.
messages.zh: 听到了，它突然响起来，吓了我一跳。
messages.en: Yes, it started suddenly and startled me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象安静房间里忽然响起一声巨响：时间上只是一瞬，感觉上出乎意料。用这一画面记住 f'daqqa waħda 的“瞬间”和“突然”。

gloss_zh: 在……之中；在……中间；在……进行到一半时

teaching_sense.en_definition: Among surrounding people or things, or at a middle point in a place, period, or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处在周围的人、事物或情境之中，或处在某个空间、时段或活动的中间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fost nies jew affarijiet li jdawru lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew fil-parti tan-nofs ta' post, perjodu jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在……之中；置身于周围的人群、事物或某种情境中，不一定指正中央。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fost nies jew affarijiet li jdawru lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew waqt li jkun hemm ċirkostanzi partikolari madwarhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is amid a crowd or situation, they are surrounded by it or involved in it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在……的中间；在某个地点、时段或活动的中段。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fil-parti ċentrali ta' post, fil-parti tan-nofs ta' perjodu, jew waqt li attività tkun għadha għaddejja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is in the middle of a place, period, or activity, they are at its central point or partway through it.

collocations.en: in the middle of the room
in the middle of the night
in the middle of the meeting

formal.mt: F'nofs il-konfużjoni, l-għalliema ġabret lit-tfal f'nofs il-bitħa u talbithom jibqgħu flimkien.
formal.en: Amid the confusion, the teacher gathered the children in the middle of the courtyard and asked them to stay together.
formal.zh: 混乱之中，老师把孩子们集合到院子中央，并要求他们待在一起。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn int? Ma nistax narak f'nofs din il-folla! Luqa: Qiegħed ħdejn il-mejda li hemm f'nofs il-kamra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you? I can't see you amid this crowd! Luqa: I'm beside the table in the middle of the room.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在哪儿？这么多人，我看不到你！Luqa：我在房间中央那张桌子旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn int? Ma nistax narak f'nofs din il-folla!
messages.mt_standard: Fejn int? Ma nistax narak f'nofs din il-folla!
messages.zh: 你在哪儿？这么多人，我看不到你！
messages.en: Where are you? I can't see you amid this crowd!

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed ħdejn il-mejda li hemm f'nofs il-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed ħdejn il-mejda li hemm f'nofs il-kamra.
messages.zh: 我在房间中央那张桌子旁边。
messages.en: I'm beside the table in the middle of the room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一个被周围事物包围的圆点记f'nofs：在人群中表示“置身其中”，在房间里可指“中央”，用于活动则表示“进行到中途”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Physically fit, strong, or in good health.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体健康、强健或体能状况良好的；此处为阳性单数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu saħħa tajba jew jinsab f'kundizzjoni fiżika tajba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体能良好的；身体强健、能够进行体力活动的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsab f'kundizzjoni fiżika tajba u kapaċi jagħmel attività fiżika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is fit is physically strong and able to exercise without becoming tired too easily.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 健康的；身体状况良好、没有明显病态的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu saħħa tajba u ma jurix sinjali ta' mard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is healthy is well and does not show signs of illness.

formal.mt: Pawlu jagħmel eżerċizzju regolari biex jibqa' f'saħħtu.
formal.en: Pawlu exercises regularly to stay fit and healthy.
formal.zh: Pawlu 经常锻炼，以保持身体健康。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu jidher f'saħħtu ħafna. Mark: Iva, jimxi kuljum u jgħum darbtejn fil-ġimgħa. Lara: Għalhekk jitla' t-taraġ bla ma jgħejja!
colloquial.en: Lara: Pawlu looks very fit. Mark: Yes, he walks every day and swims twice a week. Lara: That's why he climbs the stairs without getting tired!
colloquial.zh: Lara：Pawlu 看起来身体很强健。Mark：是啊，他每天走路，每周游泳两次。Lara：难怪他爬楼梯都不觉得累！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 看起来身体很强健。
messages.en: Pawlu looks very fit.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jimxi kuljum u jgħum darbtejn fil-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jimxi kuljum u jgħum darbtejn fil-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 是啊，他每天走路，每周游泳两次。
messages.en: Yes, he walks every day and swims twice a week.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalhekk jitla' t-taraġ bla ma jgħejja!
messages.mt_standard: Għalhekk jitla' t-taraġ bla ma jgħejja!
messages.zh: 难怪他爬楼梯都不觉得累！
messages.en: That's why he climbs the stairs without getting tired!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 f'saħħtu 和“他爬楼梯不喘气”的画面绑定，同时记住身体健康和体能强健两个相近义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Floating on the surface of water rather than sinking beneath it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于水面上漂浮而没有沉下去的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fuq il-wiċċ tal-ilma, b'mod li persuna jew oġġett jibqa' jżomm fil-wiċċ mingħajr ma jegħreq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 浮在水面上的；处于漂浮而未下沉的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew oġġett ikun f'wiċċ l-ilma meta jkun qiegħed iżomm fuq il-wiċċ tal-ilma u ma jkunx qed jegħreq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is afloat, they are floating on the surface of water without sinking.

collocations.zh: 使小船保持浮在水面上

formal.mt: Matul l-esperiment, il-biċċa tal-injam baqgħet f'wiċċ l-ilma, filwaqt li l-ġebla għerqet.
formal.en: During the experiment, the piece of wood remained afloat, while the stone sank.
formal.zh: 实验过程中，木块一直浮在水面上，而石头沉了下去。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-ballun? Mark: Hemm, għadu f'wiċċ l-ilma ħdejn id-dgħajsa. Maja: Tajjeb, nistgħu nilħquh minn hawn.
