colloquial.en: Maja: Where's the ball? Mark: There, it's still afloat next to the boat. Maja: Good, we can reach it from here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：球在哪里？马克：在那里，还浮在小船旁边的水面上。玛雅：好，我们从这里就够得着。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 球在哪里？
messages.en: Where's the ball?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm, għadu f'wiċċ l-ilma ħdejn id-dgħajsa.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm, għadu f'wiċċ l-ilma ħdejn id-dgħajsa.
messages.zh: 在那里，还浮在小船旁边的水面上。
messages.en: There, it's still afloat next to the boat.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我们从这里就够得着。
messages.en: Good, we can reach it from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语 f'wiċċ l-ilma 配上“球浮在水面上”的画面记忆，再用 jibqa' f'wiċċ l-ilma 练习表达“一直浮着”。

gloss_zh: 完全捏造；彻头彻尾的编造

teaching_sense.en_definition: A story or claim that is entirely invented and has no basis in fact.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 完全编造、没有事实依据的故事或说法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Storja jew stqarrija li tkun ivvintata kollha kemm hi u ma jkollha ebda bażi fil-fatti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 完全捏造，指故事或说法全部出于编造而没有事实依据。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fabrikazzjoni kompluta hija storja jew stqarrija vvintata kollha kemm hi, mingħajr ebda bażi fil-fatti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a story or claim is a complete fabrication, it has been entirely invented and has no basis in fact.

collocations.en: a story that is a complete fabrication
an accusation that is a complete fabrication

formal.mt: Wara li eżamina l-provi, l-investigatur ikkonkluda li l-istorja kienet fabrikazzjoni kompluta.
formal.en: After examining the evidence, the investigator concluded that the story was a complete fabrication.
formal.zh: 调查人员审查证据后，认定这个故事完全是捏造的。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Veru li rbaħt karozza? Daniel: Le, dik l-istorja hija fabrikazzjoni kompluta. Sara: Mela ma nemminhiex.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is it true that you won a car? Daniel: No, that story is a complete fabrication. Sara: Then I won't believe it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你真的赢了一辆车吗？丹尼尔：没有，那个故事完全是捏造的。萨拉：那我就不信了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你真的赢了一辆车吗？
messages.en: Is it true that you won a car?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dik l-istorja hija fabrikazzjoni kompluta.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dik l-istorja hija fabrikazzjoni kompluta.
messages.zh: 没有，那个故事完全是捏造的。
messages.en: No, that story is a complete fabrication.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我就不信了。
messages.en: Then I won't believe it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上“一篇从头到尾都编出来的故事”的画面，记住它强调完全没有事实依据。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To depend on someone or something with confidence that they will provide help or work as expected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 相信某人或某事物能够提供帮助或发挥预期作用，并据此加以依靠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jistrieħ fuq persuna jew ħaġa b'fiduċja li se tagħtih l-għajnuna jew ir-riżultat mistenni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依靠、信赖某人或某事物，相信其能够给予支持或达到预期。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikollu fiduċja f'persuna jew f'ħaġa u jistrieħ fuqha biex jikseb għajnuna jew riżultat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you rely on someone or something, you trust them to help you or to do what you need.

formal.mt: Il-maniġer fada fit-tim tiegħu biex il-proġett jitlesta fil-ħin.
formal.en: The manager relied on his team to complete the project on time.
formal.zh: 经理依靠自己的团队按时完成项目。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif irnexxielek iġġorr dawk il-kaxxi kollha? David: Fdajt f'ħija. Ġie jgħinni wara x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did you manage to carry all those boxes? David: I relied on my brother. He came to help me after work.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那么多箱子，你是怎么搬完的？戴维：我靠了我兄弟帮忙。他下班后来帮我了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irnexxielek iġġorr dawk il-kaxxi kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irnexxielek iġġorr dawk il-kaxxi kollha?
messages.zh: 那么多箱子，你是怎么搬完的？
messages.en: How did you manage to carry all those boxes?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fdajt f'ħija. Ġie jgħinni wara x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Fdajt f'ħija. Ġie jgħinni wara x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 我靠了我兄弟帮忙。他下班后来帮我了。
messages.en: I relied on my brother. He came to help me after work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象搬箱子时信赖朋友来帮忙，把 fada fi 连成“依靠、信赖”；fi 与定冠词结合可见 fil- 或 fl-。

gloss_zh: 围在颈部吸汗的小毛巾

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small towel placed around the neck to absorb sweat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围放在颈部、用于吸收汗水的小毛巾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xugaman żgħir li jitqiegħed madwar l-għonq biex jassorbi l-għaraq.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small towel put around the neck to catch sweath.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为吸收汗水而围在脖子周围的小毛巾。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xugaman żgħir li persuna tqiegħed madwar għonqha biex jiġbor u jassorbi l-għaraq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fadrask is a small towel that you put around your neck to absorb sweat.

collocations.en: a cotton towel for absorbing sweat around the neck
collocations.zh: 围在颈部吸汗的棉质小毛巾

collocations.en: to place a small sweat towel around his neck
collocations.zh: 把吸汗小毛巾围在脖子上

formal.mt: Waqt ix-xogħol fis-sħana, il-ħaddiem qiegħed fadrask madwar għonqu biex jassorbi l-għaraq.
formal.en: While working in the heat, the worker placed a small towel around his neck to absorb sweat.
formal.zh: 在炎热环境中工作时，工人把一条吸汗小毛巾围在脖子上，用来吸收汗水。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex għandek dak ix-xugaman żgħir madwar għonqok? Toni: Dan fadrask. Qed nużah biex jassorbi l-għaraq waqt li naħdem.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why have you got that small towel around your neck? Toni: It's a fadrask. I'm using it to absorb sweat while I work.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么在脖子上围着那条小毛巾？托尼：这是围颈吸汗巾。我工作时用它来吸汗。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandek dak ix-xugaman żgħir madwar għonqok?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandek dak ix-xugaman żgħir madwar għonqok?
messages.zh: 你为什么在脖子上围着那条小毛巾？
messages.en: Why have you got that small towel around your neck?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan fadrask. Qed nużah biex jassorbi l-għaraq waqt li naħdem.
messages.mt_standard: Dan fadrask. Qed nużah biex jassorbi l-għaraq waqt li naħdem.
messages.zh: 这是围颈吸汗巾。我工作时用它来吸汗。
messages.en: It's a fadrask. I'm using it to absorb sweat while I work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fadrask 配成一幅具体画面：劳动时脖子围着小毛巾，汗水被吸走；同时记住位置与用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A musical instrument is an object that a person plays to produce musical sounds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种供人演奏、发出乐音的器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fagott huwa strument mużikali li persuna ddoqq biex tipproduċi ħsejjes mużikali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乐器，即供人演奏并产生乐音的器具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fagott huwa strument li jintuża biex jindaqqu noti u melodiji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A musical instrument is an object that you play in order to produce musical sounds.

collocations.en: a lesson in playing the musical instrument

formal.mt: Waqt il-kunċert tal-iskola, l-istudent daqq il-fagott flimkien mal-bqija tal-grupp.
formal.en: During the school concert, the student played the instrument together with the rest of the group.
formal.zh: 在学校音乐会上，这名学生与小组其他成员一起演奏了这种乐器。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Illum għandek lezzjoni tal-fagott? Mark: Iva, u wara rrid nipprattika d-dar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have a lesson on that instrument today? Mark: Yes, and afterwards I need to practise at home.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你今天有这种乐器的演奏课吗？马克：有，上完课我还要在家练习。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你今天有这种乐器的演奏课吗？
messages.en: Do you have a lesson on that instrument today?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u wara rrid nipprattika d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u wara rrid nipprattika d-dar.
messages.zh: 有，上完课我还要在家练习。
messages.en: Yes, and afterwards I need to practise at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fagott 放进“上音乐课、演奏、回家练习”的连续场景中记忆，并把 idoqq il-fagott 当作完整搭配朗读。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An old male pig is a male pig that has reached an advanced age.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 年纪已经较大的雄性猪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fahal huwa ħanżir maskili li għandu età kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 老公猪，指年老的雄性猪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fahal huwa ħanżir maskili li xjieħ u m'għadux żgħir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An old male pig is a male pig that has lived for many years.

collocations.en: we feed the old male pig
the old male pig on the farm

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem tar-razzett jagħti l-ikel lill-fahal kull filgħodu u jiċċekkja li jkollu ilma nadif.
formal.en: The farm worker feeds the old male pig every morning and checks that it has clean water.
formal.zh: 农场工人每天早晨给那头老公猪喂食，并检查它是否有干净的水喝。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Tajt l-ikel lill-fahal? Ġużeppi: Iva, u mlejtlu l-ilma wkoll.
colloquial.en: Rita: Have you fed the old male pig? Ġużeppi: Yes, and I filled up its water too.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你给那头老公猪喂食了吗？朱塞佩：喂了，也给它添了水。

messages.speaker: Rita (农场工人)
messages.zh: 你给那头老公猪喂食了吗？
messages.en: Have you fed the old male pig?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农场工人)
messages.zh: 喂了，也给它添了水。
messages.en: Yes, and I filled up its water too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 fahal 时同时贴上“猪、雄性、年老”三个标签，想象农场工人给老公猪喂食，避免只记成泛指的猪。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Faience is glazed pottery that is often used to make decorative objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 釉陶，常用于制作具有装饰用途的陶器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fajjenza hija fuħħar miksi bi żmalt, li spiss jintuża biex isiru oġġetti dekorattivi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 釉陶，指表面施有釉层的一类陶器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fajjenza hija tip ta' fuħħar li l-wiċċ tiegħu jkun miksi bi żmalt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Faience is a type of pottery with a glazed surface, often made into decorative objects.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装饰陶器，主要用于陈设、观赏或美化环境的陶制品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fajjenza hija fuħħar magħmul biex iżejjen post, bħal vażuni u platti dekorattivi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ornamental pottery consists of ceramic objects that are made mainly to decorate a place.

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesponi kollezzjoni ta' fajjenza, fosthom vażuni u platti dekorattivi.
formal.en: The museum displays a collection of ornamental pottery, including vases and decorative plates.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出了一批装饰陶器，其中包括花瓶和装饰盘。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-vażun tal-fajjenza jogħġobni ħafna. Toni: Nistgħu npoġġuh fuq l-ixkaffa fis-salott.
colloquial.en: Nina: I really like this faience vase. Toni: We can put it on the shelf in the living room.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我很喜欢这只釉陶花瓶。托尼：我们可以把它放在客厅的架子上。

messages.speaker: Nina (伴侣)
messages.zh: 我很喜欢这只釉陶花瓶。
messages.en: I really like this faience vase.

messages.speaker: Toni (伴侣)
messages.zh: 我们可以把它放在客厅的架子上。
messages.en: We can put it on the shelf in the living room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fajjenza 连到架子上的釉陶花瓶和装饰盘：看表面记“釉陶”，看陈设用途记“装饰陶器”，用同一画面区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 招标或投标文件；标书档案

teaching_sense.en_definition: A collection of documents containing the requirements, information, and forms for a tender procedure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 汇集招标或投标程序所需条件、资料和表格的一套文件或档案。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' dokumenti li jkun fiha l-kundizzjonijiet, l-informazzjoni u l-formoli meħtieġa għal proċedura ta' sejħa għall-offerti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 招标邀请文件汇编，载有邀请供应商投标的条件、要求和有关资料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' dokumenti marbuta ma' stedina biex jitressqu offerti, li tinkludi l-kundizzjonijiet u r-rekwiżiti tal-parteċipazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An invitation to tender dossier contains the documents that explain what suppliers must provide when responding to a tender invitation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 招标或投标程序使用的文件资料总称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-dokumentazzjoni kollha li tintuża fi proċedura ta' sejħa għall-offerti u li tispjega l-kundizzjonijiet u l-informazzjoni meħtieġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tender documentation is the written material used to explain, prepare, or support participation in a tender procedure.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 招标或投标所需的各份文件，如条件说明、规格和表格。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-dokumenti individwali meħtieġa għal sejħa għall-offerti, bħall-kundizzjonijiet, l-ispeċifikazzjonijiet u l-formoli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tender documents are the individual papers or electronic documents that provide the requirements and forms for a tender.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 围绕某项招标或投标整理成套的文件汇编。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġabra organizzata ta' dokumenti li tirrigwarda sejħa għall-offerti partikolari jew offerta mressqa għaliha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tender dossier brings together the documents relating to a particular tender in one organized collection.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 存放某项招标或投标相关资料的纸质或电子档案。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fajl fuq il-karta jew f'format elettroniku li fih jinżammu d-dokumenti relatati ma' sejħa għall-offerti jew ma' offerta partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tender file is a paper or electronic file in which documents concerning a tender are kept together.

formal.mt: Qabel ma tressaq l-offerta, il-kumpanija għandha tivverifika li l-fajl tal-offerta jinkludi l-formoli kollha meħtieġa.
formal.en: Before submitting its bid, the company should check that the tender dossier includes all the required forms.
formal.zh: 公司提交投标书之前，应核查标书文件是否包含所有必需表格。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Il-fajl tal-offerta lest? Pawlu: Kważi; għad irrid inżid il-formola ffirmata.
colloquial.en: Marta: Is the tender file ready? Pawlu: Almost; I still need to add the signed form.
colloquial.zh: Marta：标书文件准备好了吗？Pawlu：差不多了；我还得加上签好字的表格。

messages.speaker: Marta (采购同事)
messages.zh: 标书文件准备好了吗？
messages.en: Is the tender file ready?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (投标负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi; għad irrid inżid il-formola ffirmata.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi; għad irrid inżid il-formola ffirmata.
messages.zh: 差不多了；我还得加上签好字的表格。
messages.en: Almost; I still need to add the signed form.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词配上一个装满招标条件、规格和表格的文件夹画面，记成“一套招投标文件”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A garment worn from the waist down, hanging around the legs without separate sections for each leg.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从腰部向下穿着、围绕双腿垂落而不分裤腿的衣物，通常指半身裙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilbies li jintlibes mill-qadd 'l isfel u jinżel madwar ir-riġlejn mingħajr ma jkollu parti separata għal kull riġel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 裙子，指从腰部向下覆盖身体、没有分开裤腿的衣物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa lbies li tibda mill-qadd u tgħatti parti mir-riġlejn jew ir-riġlejn kollha, mingħajr ma taqsamhom f'żewġ partijiet separati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A skirt is a piece of clothing that hangs from the waist and surrounds the legs without enclosing each leg separately.

formal.mt: Il-mudella fil-katalgu liebsa falda twila bil-piegi u qmis bajda.
formal.en: The model in the catalogue is wearing a long pleated skirt and a white shirt.
formal.zh: 目录中的模特穿着一条长褶裙和一件白衬衫。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif tidher din il-falda mal-qmis tiegħi? Nina: Taqbel ħafna, speċjalment ma' dawk iż-żraben.
colloquial.en: Lara: How does this skirt look with my shirt? Nina: It goes really well, especially with those shoes.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这条裙子配我的衬衫怎么样？Nina：很搭，尤其是再配上那双鞋。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif tidher din il-falda mal-qmis tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Kif tidher din il-falda mal-qmis tiegħi?
messages.zh: 这条裙子配我的衬衫怎么样？
messages.en: How does this skirt look with my shirt?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taqbel ħafna, speċjalment ma' dawk iż-żraben.
messages.mt_standard: Taqbel ħafna, speċjalment ma' dawk iż-żraben.
messages.zh: 很搭，尤其是再配上那双鞋。
messages.en: It goes really well, especially with those shoes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 falda 写在裙子图片的腰部，再向下画出展开的裙摆，记住它指半身裙。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that a person may choose to include or do, without being required to do so.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可以自行选择是否采用、参加或完成的项目或内容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li persuna tista' tagħżel li tinkludi jew tagħmel, iżda li mhijiex meħtieġa tagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可选的项目或内容，是否选择由个人决定，并非强制要求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Element jew attività li wieħed jista' jagħżel jekk jinkludix jew jagħmilx, mingħajr ma jkun obbligat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An optional item is something you can choose to include or complete, but are not required to include or complete.

formal.mt: Fil-formola, it-terminu 'falkulattiv' jindika li l-applikant jista' jagħżel jekk jagħtix l-informazzjoni mitluba.
formal.en: On the form, the term 'optional' indicates that the applicant can choose whether to provide the requested information.
formal.zh: 表格中的“可选”一词表示，申请人可以自行决定是否提供所要求的信息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħdejn in-numru tat-telefon hemm miktub 'falkulattiv'. Irrid nimlieh? Toni: Le, tista' tħallih vojt jekk ma tridx tagħti n-numru.
colloquial.en: Sara: It says 'optional' next to the phone number. Do I have to fill it in? Toni: No, you can leave it blank if you don't want to give your number.
colloquial.zh: Sara：电话号码旁边写着“可选”。我必须填吗？Toni：不用，如果你不想提供号码，可以留空。

messages.speaker: Sara (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn in-numru tat-telefon hemm miktub 'falkulattiv'. Irrid nimlieh?
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn in-numru tat-telefon hemm miktub 'falkulattiv'. Irrid nimlieh?
messages.zh: 电话号码旁边写着“可选”。我必须填吗？
messages.en: It says 'optional' next to the phone number. Do I have to fill it in?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tista' tħallih vojt jekk ma tridx tagħti n-numru.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tista' tħallih vojt jekk ma tridx tagħti n-numru.
messages.zh: 不用，如果你不想提供号码，可以留空。
messages.en: No, you can leave it blank if you don't want to give your number.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象表格上一个可以勾选也可以留空的方框，把 falkulattiv 和“由你选择”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A situation in which a market does not allocate resources efficiently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 市场机制无法有效配置资源，导致社会整体利益受损的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni li fiha s-suq ma jqassamx ir-riżorsi b'mod effiċjenti, u dan jista' jagħmel ħsara lill-ġid tas-soċjetà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 市场失灵；市场自行运作时无法有效配置资源的情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni ekonomika li fiha s-suq waħdu ma jwassalx għal tqassim effiċjenti tar-riżorsi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Market failure occurs when a market operating on its own does not allocate resources efficiently.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika t-tniġġis bħala każ ta' falliment tas-suq, għax il-prezz tal-prodott ma jirriflettix il-ħsara lill-ambjent.
formal.en: The report identifies pollution as a case of market failure because the product's price does not reflect the damage to the environment.
formal.zh: 报告将污染列为市场失灵的案例，因为产品价格没有反映其对环境造成的损害。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed nitkellmu dwar falliment tas-suq? Mark: Għax il-prezz ma jinkludix il-ħsara li t-tniġġis jagħmel lin-nies.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are we talking about market failure? Mark: Because the price does not include the harm that pollution causes people.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么我们在谈市场失灵？马克：因为价格没有计入污染对人们造成的损害。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed nitkellmu dwar falliment tas-suq?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed nitkellmu dwar falliment tas-suq?
messages.zh: 为什么我们在谈市场失灵？
messages.en: Why are we talking about market failure?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-prezz ma jinkludix il-ħsara li t-tniġġis jagħmel lin-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-prezz ma jinkludix il-ħsara li t-tniġġis jagħmel lin-nies.
messages.zh: 因为价格没有计入污染对人们造成的损害。
messages.en: Because the price does not include the harm that pollution causes people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“价格没算进去的污染损害”：市场仍在交易，却没有有效配置资源，这就是市场失灵。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to bankruptcy or to the procedures used to deal with it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与破产状态或处理破产的程序有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-falliment jew mal-proċeduri li jintużaw biex jiġi ttrattat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涉及破产或与破产事务、程序有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-falliment ta' persuna jew ta' kumpanija, jew il-proċeduri marbuta miegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is described as fallimentari concerns bankruptcy or the processes through which bankruptcy is handled.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega l-istadji ewlenin tal-proċedura fallimentari u d-dokumenti relatati magħha.
formal.en: The report explains the main stages of the bankruptcy procedure and the documents associated with it.
formal.zh: 报告说明了破产程序的主要阶段及其相关文件。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Xi jfisser 'fallimentari' f'din l-ittra? David: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-falliment; hawn qed jitkellmu dwar il-proċedura.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does 'fallimentari' mean in this letter? David: It means relating to bankruptcy; here they're talking about the procedure.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这封信里的 fallimentari 是什么意思？David：意思是与破产有关的；这里说的是破产程序。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 这封信里的 fallimentari 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'fallimentari' mean in this letter?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-falliment; hawn qed jitkellmu dwar il-proċedura.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-falliment; hawn qed jitkellmu dwar il-proċedura.
messages.zh: 意思是与破产有关的；这里说的是破产程序。
messages.en: It means relating to bankruptcy; here they're talking about the procedure.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fallimentari 放在“程序”和“法律”前面练习，想象一份破产案卷，记住它表示“与破产有关的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Made to look genuine when it is not, or altered to present false information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物品被制作成以假乱真的样子，或文件、资料被改动以呈现虚假信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa magħmula biex tidher ġenwina meta mhijiex, jew mibdula biex tagħti informazzjoni falza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伪造的；仿冒的；被制作得像真品一样以蒙骗他人的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Magħmul biex jidher bħall-oġġett ġenwin u biex iqarraq b'min jużah jew jixtrih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is counterfeit has been made to resemble a genuine item in order to deceive people.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被篡改的；经过不实改动或编造，使人误信其内容真实的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mibdul jew imfassal b'informazzjoni falza biex jagħti impressjoni li mhijiex vera.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a document or record has been falsified, its information has been dishonestly changed or invented.

formal.mt: L-awditur ikkonkluda li r-rapport kien falsifikat, peress li ċ-ċifri kienu nbidlu biex jaħbu t-telf.
formal.en: The auditor concluded that the report had been falsified because the figures had been changed to conceal the losses.
formal.zh: 审计员认定报告遭到篡改，因为其中的数字被改动以掩盖亏损。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taħseb li dan il-biljett huwa falsifikat? Pawlu: Jista' jkun. Ejja nivverifikaw in-numru tiegħu mal-organizzaturi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you think this ticket is counterfeit? Pawlu: It might be. Let's check its number with the organizers.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你觉得这张票是伪造的吗？保罗：有可能。我们找主办方核对一下票号吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li dan il-biljett huwa falsifikat?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li dan il-biljett huwa falsifikat?
messages.zh: 你觉得这张票是伪造的吗？
messages.en: Do you think this ticket is counterfeit?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jista' jkun. Ejja nivverifikaw in-numru tiegħu mal-organizzaturi.
messages.mt_standard: Jista' jkun. Ejja nivverifikaw in-numru tiegħu mal-organizzaturi.
messages.zh: 有可能。我们找主办方核对一下票号吧。
messages.en: It might be. Let's check its number with the organizers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记忆：假护照对应“伪造的”，改过数字的报告对应“被篡改的”；共同点是让人误信为真。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being widely known, or the opinion people have of someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 广为人知的名气或盛名，也指公众对某人或某事物形成的评价和声誉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li persuna jew xi ħaġa tkun magħrufa minn ħafna nies, jew l-opinjoni li n-nies ikollhom tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盛名；因成就、能力或卓越品质而获得的广泛赞誉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għarfien u apprezzament mifrux li persuna jew xi ħaġa tikseb minħabba kisbiet jew kwalitajiet eċċellenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Renown is the widespread recognition and admiration that someone or something receives for notable achievements or qualities.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 声誉；人们根据某人或某事物的表现形成的总体评价，可好可坏。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-opinjoni ġenerali, tajba jew ħażina, li n-nies ikollhom ta' persuna jew ta' xi ħaġa minħabba l-imġiba jew il-kwalitajiet tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reputation is the general opinion people have of someone or something based on its qualities or past behaviour.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 名气；知名度；被许多人认识或知晓的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' persuna jew ta' xi ħaġa li tkun magħrufa minn għadd kbir ta' nies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fame is the state of being known by a large number of people.

formal.mt: Il-kittieba kisbet fama internazzjonali wara li r-rumanz tagħha ġie tradott f'diversi lingwi.
formal.en: The writer gained international renown after her novel was translated into several languages.
formal.zh: 这位女作家的小说被译成多种语言后，她获得了国际盛名。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan ir-restorant għandu fama tajba? Toni: Iva, in-nies ifaħħru l-ikel u s-servizz tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does this restaurant have a good reputation? Toni: Yes, people praise its food and service.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这家餐厅口碑好吗？托尼：好，大家都称赞它的食物和服务。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这家餐厅口碑好吗？
messages.en: Does this restaurant have a good reputation?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, in-nies ifaħħru l-ikel u s-servizz tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, in-nies ifaħħru l-ikel u s-servizz tiegħu.
messages.zh: 好，大家都称赞它的食物和服务。
messages.en: Yes, people praise its food and service.

cognitive_memory_aid: 围绕“大家知道你，也会评价你”来记：强调被认识是名气，强调公众评价是声誉，强调广受赞誉是盛名。

gloss_zh: 他们的家庭；她们的家人

teaching_sense.en_definition: The family belonging to the people being referred to.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所谈及的那些人的家庭，或与他们有亲属关系的家人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-familja tal-persuni li jkun qed isir riferiment għalihom, jiġifieri l-qraba tagħhom meqjusa flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他们或她们的家庭；所指那些人的家人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-familja tagħhom, jiġifieri l-grupp ta' persuni marbuta magħhom b'relazzjonijiet ta' familja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Their family means the relatives or family group of the people being referred to.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti ġew mistiedna jattendu ċ-ċerimonja ma' familthom.
formal.en: The participants were invited to attend the ceremony with their families.
formal.zh: 参与者受邀与各自的家人一起出席典礼。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Anna u Mark se jiġu waħedhom? Luqa: Le, se jiġu ma' familthom kollha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are Anna and Mark coming on their own? Luqa: No, they are coming with their whole family.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：安娜和马克会自己来吗？卢卡：不会，他们会和全家人一起来。

messages.speaker: Sara (聚会组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Anna u Mark se jiġu waħedhom?
messages.mt_standard: Anna u Mark se jiġu waħedhom?
messages.zh: 安娜和马克会自己来吗？
messages.en: Are Anna and Mark coming on their own?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, se jiġu ma' familthom kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, se jiġu ma' familthom kollha.
messages.zh: 不会，他们会和全家人一起来。
messages.en: No, they are coming with their whole family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词条放进“他们和全家一起来”的画面中记忆：先确定所指的是哪些人，再联想到那些人的家庭或家人。

gloss_zh: 马耳他的；与马耳他人或马耳他语有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Malta, its people, or the Maltese language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与马耳他、马耳他人或马耳他语有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' Malta, man-nies tagħha jew mal-lingwa Maltija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他的；马耳他人的；马耳他语的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirreferi għal Malta, għan-nies tagħha jew għal-lingwa Maltija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described by this adjective is connected with Malta, its people, or their language.

formal.mt: F'din id-deskrizzjoni, il-kelma 'Famuza' tindika li t-tradizzjoni għandha rabta ma' Malta.
formal.en: In this description, the word 'Famuza' indicates that the tradition is connected with Malta.
formal.zh: 在这段描述中，Famuza 一词表示这项传统与马耳他有关。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser 'Famuza' f'din il-frażi? Pawlu: Tfisser li xi ħaġa għandha x'taqsam ma' Malta.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does 'Famuza' mean in this phrase? Pawlu: It means that something is connected with Malta.
colloquial.zh: Lina：这个短语里的 Famuza 是什么意思？Pawlu：意思是某件事物与马耳他有关。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 这个短语里的 Famuza 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'Famuza' mean in this phrase?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li xi ħaġa għandha x'taqsam ma' Malta.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li xi ħaġa għandha x'taqsam ma' Malta.
messages.zh: 意思是某件事物与马耳他有关。
messages.en: It means that something is connected with Malta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Famuza 与“马耳他的”配对记忆，再用“文化、传统、语言”三个语境巩固其关联意义。

gloss_zh: 著名的；作感叹语时表示“太棒了”

teaching_sense.en_definition: Known and recognized by many people; also used as an exclamation expressing strong approval.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为许多人所熟知的；也可独立用作感叹语，表示非常赞赏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magħruf minn ħafna nies; jintuża wkoll bħala esklamazzjoni biex jesprimi approvazzjoni kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 著名的；广为人知的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li hu magħruf minn ħafna nies, pereżempju minħabba x-xogħol jew il-kisbiet tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something famous is known about by a large number of people.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作感叹语使用，表示“太棒了”或“好极了”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta jintuża bħala esklamazzjoni, jesprimi li xi ħaġa hija tajba ħafna jew ta' min ifaħħarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You can use this word as an exclamation to show that you think something is excellent.

formal.mt: Il-kittieb famuż ġie mistieden jitkellem dwar il-kotba tiegħu fil-librerija pubblika.
formal.en: The famous writer was invited to speak about his books at the public library.
formal.zh: 这位著名作家受邀在公共图书馆介绍自己的书。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Irnexxieli nsib żewġ biljetti għall-kunċert! Mark: Famuż! Fl-aħħar nistgħu mmorru flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: I managed to find two tickets for the concert! Mark: Brilliant! We can finally go together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我找到两张音乐会门票了！Mark：太棒了！我们终于可以一起去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我找到两张音乐会门票了！
messages.en: I managed to find two tickets for the concert!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 太棒了！我们终于可以一起去了。
messages.en: Brilliant! We can finally go together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景记忆：名词旁的 famuż 表示“著名的”，听到好消息时单独说 Famuż! 表示“太棒了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tower with a powerful light that helps ships find a harbour and navigate safely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设有强光灯的塔状设施，用来帮助船只辨认港口位置并安全航行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Torri b'dawl qawwi li jgħin lill-vapuri jagħrfu fejn jinsab il-port u jbaħħru b'mod sigur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灯塔；以明亮灯光为船只指示位置和航向的塔状设施。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Torri li għandu dawl qawwi biex juri lill-baħħara fejn jinsabu l-kosta jew id-daħla tal-port.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lighthouse is a tower with a powerful light that helps sailors identify coastal locations and navigate safely.

collocations.en: the light of the harbour lighthouse

formal.mt: Bil-lejl, id-dawl tal-fanal tal-port jgħin lill-baħħara jagħrfu d-daħla tal-port.
formal.en: At night, the light of the harbour lighthouse helps sailors identify the harbour entrance.
formal.zh: 夜间，港口灯塔的灯光帮助船员辨认港口入口。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se niltaqgħu qabel il-mixja? Toni: Ħdejn il-fanal tal-port. Nistenniek hemm fil-ħamsa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where shall we meet before the walk? Toni: Beside the harbour lighthouse. I'll wait for you there at five.
colloquial.zh: Sara：散步前我们在哪里碰面？Toni：在港口灯塔旁边。我五点在那里等你。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 散步前我们在哪里碰面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet before the walk?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-fanal tal-port. Nistenniek hemm fil-ħamsa.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-fanal tal-port. Nistenniek hemm fil-ħamsa.
messages.zh: 在港口灯塔旁边。我五点在那里等你。
messages.en: Beside the harbour lighthouse. I'll wait for you there at five.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语想成“港口边发光的高塔”，再用“看见灯光、找到港口”的连续画面记住港口灯塔。

gloss_zh: 狂热者；偏执者；狂热的；热忱的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose enthusiasm for an activity, belief, or cause is extremely strong and may become unreasonable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某种活动、信念或事业抱有极强热情，甚至可能失去理性的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha entużjażmu qawwi ħafna għal attività, twemmin jew kawża, xi drabi sal-punt li ma taċċettax fehmiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狂热者；对某项活动、观念或事业极度着迷或投入的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun marbuta b'mod estrem ma' attività, idea jew kawża u tagħtiha importanza kbira ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fanatic is someone whose enthusiasm for an activity or belief is extremely strong and sometimes unreasonable.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狂热信奉者；以强烈而不妥协的态度支持某种信仰或事业的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tiddefendi twemmin jew kawża b'ħeġġa kbira u ma tkunx lesta tagħmel kompromessi dwarhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A zealot is someone who supports a belief or cause with intense enthusiasm and little willingness to compromise.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偏执者；固执地抱有偏见，不容忍不同信仰、观点或群体的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li żżomm b'mod riġidu ma' preġudizzji u ma tittollerax nies bi twemmin, fehmiet jew identitajiet differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bigot is someone who holds strong prejudices and refuses to tolerate people with different beliefs or backgrounds.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狂热的；热情或信念强烈到极端程度的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri entużjażmu jew twemmin estrem, xi drabi mingħajr ma jqis ir-raġuni jew fehmiet differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is fanatical has an extreme enthusiasm or commitment that may prevent reasonable judgment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 热忱的；积极而坚定地投入某项事业或目标的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri ħeġġa kbira u impenn qawwi biex jappoġġja kawża jew jilħaq għan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is zealous works with great enthusiasm and commitment to support a cause or achieve an aim.

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tad-dibattitu, l-awtur jiddistingwi bejn sostenitur impenjat u fanatiku li jirrifjuta kull opinjoni differenti.
formal.en: In the analysis of the debate, the author distinguishes between a committed supporter and a fanatic who rejects every differing opinion.
formal.zh: 在对这场辩论的分析中，作者区分了坚定的支持者与拒绝一切不同意见的狂热者。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tgħid li jien fanatiku għax nara kull logħba? Lara: Le, tista' tkun partitarju ħerqan u xorta tirrispetta lil min iżomm ma' tim ieħor.
colloquial.en: Mark: Would you call me a fanatic because I watch every match? Lara: No, you can be an enthusiastic supporter and still respect people who support another team.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我每场比赛都看，你会说我是狂热者吗？Lara：不会，你可以是热情的球迷，同时仍然尊重支持其他球队的人。

messages.speaker: Mark (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħid li jien fanatiku għax nara kull logħba?
messages.mt_standard: Tgħid li jien fanatiku għax nara kull logħba?
messages.zh: 我每场比赛都看，你会说我是狂热者吗？
messages.en: Would you call me a fanatic because I watch every match?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tista' tkun partitarju ħerqan u xorta tirrispetta lil min iżomm ma' tim ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tista' tkun partitarju ħerqan u xorta tirrispetta lil min iżomm ma' tim ieħor.
messages.zh: 不会，你可以是热情的球迷，同时仍然尊重支持其他球队的人。
messages.en: No, you can be an enthusiastic supporter and still respect people who support another team.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按语境记成热情程度的刻度：积极投入可译“热忱”，走向极端可译“狂热”，排斥异见时可指“偏执者”；作名词指人，作形容词描述态度。

gloss_zh: 狂热；盲目而排他的极端热忱

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extreme and uncritical devotion to a belief, cause, or activity, often accompanied by intolerance of other views.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某种信仰、事业或活动抱有极端而缺乏批判思考的热忱，常表现为不能容忍其他观点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rabta estrema u bla kritika ma' twemmin, kawża jew attività, li spiss twassal biex persuna ma tittollerax fehmiet differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某种信念或事业的盲目狂热，常伴有对不同意见的不容忍。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Entużjażmu estrem għal twemmin jew kawża, mingħajr eżami kritiku u spiss b'nuqqas ta' tolleranza lejn min jaħseb mod ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fanaticism is extreme devotion to a belief or cause that often prevents someone from considering other views fairly.

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddiskuti kif il-fanatiżmu jista' jfixkel id-djalogu bejn persuni b'fehmiet differenti.
formal.en: The article discusses how fanaticism can hinder dialogue between people with different views.
formal.zh: 这篇文章讨论了盲目狂热如何妨碍持不同观点的人之间的对话。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tappoġġja tim mingħajr ma tinsulta lil ħadd. Mark: Naqbel. Dak il-fanatiżmu jħassar il-gost tal-logħba.
colloquial.en: Maja: You can support a team without insulting anyone. Mark: I agree. That fanaticism spoils the enjoyment of the game.
colloquial.zh: Maja：支持一支球队也可以不辱骂别人。Mark：我同意。那种盲目狂热会破坏看球的乐趣。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tappoġġja tim mingħajr ma tinsulta lil ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tappoġġja tim mingħajr ma tinsulta lil ħadd.
messages.zh: 支持一支球队也可以不辱骂别人。
messages.en: You can support a team without insulting anyone.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naqbel. Dak il-fanatiżmu jħassar il-gost tal-logħba.
messages.mt_standard: Naqbel. Dak il-fanatiżmu jħassar il-gost tal-logħba.
messages.zh: 我同意。那种盲目狂热会破坏看球的乐趣。
messages.en: I agree. That fanaticism spoils the enjoyment of the game.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人支持自己的观点支持到完全听不进别人说话，把这个场景与 fanatiżmu 联系起来，记住它比普通的热情更极端。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device that moves air to provide cooling, powered by electricity or moved by hand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使空气流动以带来凉意的用具，可以指电动风扇，也可以指用手摇动的扇子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat jew oġġett li jċaqlaq l-arja biex jagħti l-frisk, jew bl-elettriku jew billi jitħarrek bl-id.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由电力驱动、通过转动扇叶使空气流动的风扇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat li jaħdem bl-elettriku u jdawwar il-paletti biex iċaqlaq l-arja u jagħti l-frisk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An electric fan is a powered device with rotating blades that move air to help you feel cooler.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拿在手中来回摇动、用来扇风取凉的扇子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett li żżommu f'idek u ċċaqalqu 'l quddiem u lura biex tagħmel l-arja u tħoss il-frisk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A handheld fan is an object you wave in your hand to move air towards yourself.

formal.mt: Il-kamra għandha fann elettriku, u fuq il-mejda hemm ukoll fann tal-idejn għall-mistednin.
formal.en: The room has an electric fan, and there is also a handheld fan on the table for guests.
formal.zh: 房间里配有电风扇，桌上还放着一把供客人使用的手持扇子。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hawn sħana! Tixgħel il-fann, jekk jogħġbok? Pawlu: Dan ma jaħdimx, imma tista' tuża dan il-fann tal-idejn.
colloquial.en: Sara: It's hot in here! Could you switch on the fan, please? Pawlu: This one doesn't work, but you can use this handheld fan.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这里好热！请打开电风扇好吗？Pawlu：这台坏了，不过你可以用这把手持扇子。

messages.speaker: Sara (客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn sħana! Tixgħel il-fann, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn sħana! Tixgħel il-fann, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 这里好热！请打开电风扇好吗？
messages.en: It's hot in here! Could you switch on the fan, please?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ma jaħdimx, imma tista' tuża dan il-fann tal-idejn.
messages.mt_standard: Dan ma jaħdimx, imma tista' tuża dan il-fann tal-idejn.
messages.zh: 这台坏了，不过你可以用这把手持扇子。
messages.en: This one doesn't work, but you can use this handheld fan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fann 记成带来一阵凉风的物件：插电转动的是电风扇，握在手里摇动的是手持扇子；用这两个画面区分词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extremely good or impressive, or exceptionally great in amount, degree, or effect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容事物极好、令人赞叹，或形容其数量、程度或效果大得惊人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu tajjeb ħafna jew jimpressjona ħafna, jew li hu kbir ħafna fl-ammont, fil-grad jew fl-effett tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 极好的；非常出色、令人赞叹的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li hu tajjeb ħafna u jqajjem ammirazzjoni jew pjaċir kbir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you describe something as fantastic, you mean that it is extremely good and you are very pleased with it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 极大的；在数量、程度或效果上大得惊人的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li hu kbir ħafna fl-ammont, fil-grad jew fl-effett, b'mod li jiġbed l-attenzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is tremendous, its amount, degree, or effect is exceptionally great.

formal.mt: It-tim wettaq ammont fantastiku ta' xogħol fi żmien qasir, u r-riżultat kien fantastiku.
formal.en: The team completed a tremendous amount of work in a short time, and the result was fantastic.
formal.zh: 团队在短时间内完成了极大的工作量，成果也非常出色。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif kien il-kunċert ilbieraħ? David: Kien fantastiku! Ħadt gost ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: How was the concert yesterday? David: It was fantastic! I really enjoyed it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：昨天的音乐会怎么样？David：太棒了！我听得非常开心。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天的音乐会怎么样？
messages.en: How was the concert yesterday?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 太棒了！我听得非常开心。
messages.en: It was fantastic! I really enjoyed it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 fantastiku 配上两个夸张画面：看完电影竖起大拇指表示“极好”，面对堆成山的工作张大嘴表示“数量惊人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fungi that typically have a stalk and a cap, including varieties used as food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常具有菌柄和菌盖的菌类，其中一些种类可用作食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fungi li ġeneralment ikollhom zokk u kappell, u li xi tipi minnhom jintużaw bħala ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蘑菇，通常有菌柄和菌盖的菌类；其中有可食用的种类。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fungi li ġeneralment jikbru b'zokk u kappell; xi tipi jistgħu jittieklu u jintużaw fit-tisjir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mushrooms are fungi that usually have a stalk and a cap, some varieties of which are eaten as food.

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, qatta' l-faqqiegħ frisk u sajru f'taġen bi ftit żejt.
formal.en: For this recipe, slice the fresh mushrooms and cook them in a pan with a little oil.
formal.zh: 制作这道菜时，将新鲜蘑菇切片，再放入平底锅中加少量油烹调。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Trid il-faqqiegħ mal-għaġin? Ben: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Inħobb ħafna l-għaġin bil-faqqiegħ.
colloquial.en: Anna: Would you like mushrooms with the pasta? Ben: Yes, please. I really like pasta with mushrooms.
colloquial.zh: Anna：意面里要加蘑菇吗？Ben：要的，谢谢。我很喜欢蘑菇意面。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 意面里要加蘑菇吗？
messages.en: Would you like mushrooms with the pasta?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Inħobb ħafna l-għaġin bil-faqqiegħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Inħobb ħafna l-għaġin bil-faqqiegħ.
messages.zh: 要的，谢谢。我很喜欢蘑菇意面。
messages.en: Yes, please. I really like pasta with mushrooms.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词条与一篮撑着小伞的蘑菇联系起来，再用“新鲜蘑菇、蘑菇汤、蘑菇意面”三个厨房画面反复回忆例句中的 faqqiegħ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The day on which someone celebrates the anniversary of their birth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人每年纪念自己出生的日子，即生日。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-jum li fih persuna tiċċelebra l-anniversarju tat-twelid tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生日；每年与某人出生日期相同的日子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-jum tas-sena li jaħbat mad-data li fiha twieldet persuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone's birthday is the annual anniversary of the day they were born.

formal.mt: Il-familja organizzat ikla biex tiċċelebra l-faqqisu ta' Marija.
formal.en: The family organized a meal to celebrate Marija's birthday.
formal.zh: 家人安排了一顿聚餐，庆祝玛丽亚的生日。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għada niċċelebraw il-faqqisu ta' Marija. Tiġi? Pawlu: Iva, niġi u nġib rigal.
colloquial.en: Marta: Tomorrow we're celebrating Marija's birthday. Are you coming? Pawlu: Yes, I'll come and bring a present.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：明天我们庆祝玛丽亚的生日。你来吗？保罗：来，我会带一份礼物。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada niċċelebraw il-faqqisu ta' Marija. Tiġi?
messages.mt_standard: Għada niċċelebraw il-faqqisu ta' Marija. Tiġi?
messages.zh: 明天我们庆祝玛丽亚的生日。你来吗？
messages.en: Tomorrow we're celebrating Marija's birthday. Are you coming?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 来，我会带一份礼物。
messages.en: Yes, I'll come and bring a present.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 faqqisu 写在生日蛋糕图旁，再配上礼物和日期，用生日场景一起记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A guinea fowl, a bird with spotted feathers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 珍珠鸡，一种羽毛带有点状斑纹的鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' għasfur b'rix ittikkjat, magħruf bħala farawni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 珍珠鸡；一种羽毛上有细小斑点的鸟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għasfur b'rix imżejjen b'tikek żgħar, li jissejjaħ farawni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A guinea fowl is a bird whose feathers have small spots.

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara fir-razzett, l-istudenti osservaw il-farawni u ddeskrivew it-tikek fuq ir-rix tiegħu.
formal.en: During the farm visit, the students observed the guinea fowl and described the spots on its feathers.
formal.zh: 参观农场时，学生们观察了珍珠鸡，并描述了它羽毛上的斑点。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak l-għasfur bir-rix ittikkjat? Toni: Dak farawni. Ejja narawh mill-qrib.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's that bird with the spotted feathers? Toni: That's a guinea fowl. Let's take a closer look.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那只羽毛有斑点的是什么鸟？托尼：那是珍珠鸡。我们走近看看吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.zh: 那只羽毛有斑点的是什么鸟？
messages.en: What's that bird with the spotted feathers?

messages.speaker: Toni (农场主)
messages.zh: 那是珍珠鸡。我们走近看看吧。
messages.en: That's a guinea fowl. Let's take a closer look.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 farawni 配上一只羽毛布满珍珠般小点的鸡的图像，用斑点特征记住珍珠鸡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particular variety of fig known as farkizzan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为 farkizzan 的无花果品种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Varjetà ta' tin magħrufa bl-isem farkizzan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无花果的一个品种，名称为 farkizzan。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip partikolari ta' tin li jissejjaħ farkizzan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Farkizzan is the name of a particular variety of fig.

formal.mt: It-tikketta fuq il-kaxxa tindika li t-tin huwa tal-varjetà farkizzan.
formal.en: The label on the box indicates that the figs are of the farkizzan variety.
formal.zh: 箱子上的标签注明，这些无花果属于 farkizzan 品种。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandek tin farkizzan illum? Ġużeppi: Iva, kemm trid? Anna: Agħtini nofs kilo, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you have farkizzan figs today? Ġużeppi: Yes, how much would you like? Anna: Half a kilo, please.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：今天有 farkizzan 无花果吗？朱塞佩：有，你要多少？安娜：请给我半公斤。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天有 farkizzan 无花果吗？
messages.en: Do you have farkizzan figs today?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (水果摊主)
messages.zh: 有，你要多少？
messages.en: Yes, how much would you like?

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我半公斤。
messages.en: Half a kilo, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象无花果箱上贴着 farkizzan 品种标签，把它和 tin 一起记成一种无花果的名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to medicines or to their preparation and production.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与药品或药品的配制、生产有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-mediċini jew mal-preparazzjoni u l-produzzjoni tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 药品的；制药的；与药物配制或生产有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Marbut mal-mediċini, b'mod partikolari mal-preparazzjoni jew mal-manifattura tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pharmaceutical means relating to medicines or to the work of preparing and producing them.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proċess ta' produzzjoni ta' prodott farmaċewtiku ġdid.
formal.en: The report describes the production process for a new pharmaceutical product.
formal.zh: 这份报告描述了一种新药品的生产流程。

colloquial.mt: Sara: F'liema settur taħdem issa? Mark: Naħdem fis-settur farmaċewtiku, f'fabbrika tal-mediċini.
colloquial.en: Sara: What sector do you work in now? Mark: I work in the pharmaceutical sector, at a medicine factory.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你现在在哪个行业工作？马克：我在制药行业工作，在一家药厂上班。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你现在在哪个行业工作？
messages.en: What sector do you work in now?

messages.speaker: Mark (药厂职员)
messages.zh: 我在制药行业工作，在一家药厂上班。
messages.en: I work in the pharmaceutical sector, at a medicine factory.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 farmaċewtiku 和英语 pharmaceutical 对照记忆，再用“药品、药厂、制药行业”三个场景巩固含义。

gloss_zh: 皮肤上细而较长的伤口，尤指头部的细长伤口

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thin, somewhat long cut in the skin, especially on the head.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 皮肤上宽度较窄、长度较长的割伤或裂口，通常用于描述头部的这种伤口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qatgħa rqiqa u kemxejn twila fil-ġilda, speċjalment f'dik tar-ras.

sense_translations.en_definition: a thin and longish cut in the skin (usually used in relation to the head)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 皮肤上细而较长的伤口，通常指头部皮肤上的这种伤口。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qatgħa dejqa u kemxejn twila fil-ġilda; il-kelma tintuża l-aktar għal qatgħa bħal din fir-ras.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A farrett is a narrow, rather long cut in the skin, usually described in connection with someone's head.

collocations.en: a thin, elongated cut on his head
collocations.zh: 他头上的一道细长伤口

collocations.en: a narrow, elongated cut in the skin
collocations.zh: 皮肤上的一道细长伤口

formal.mt: Wara li ħabat rasu mat-tarf tal-ixkaffa, it-tifel kellu farrett fil-ġilda tar-ras.
formal.en: After hitting his head against the edge of the shelf, the boy had a thin, elongated cut on his scalp.
formal.zh: 男孩的头撞到架子边缘后，头皮上出现了一道细长的伤口。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġaralek f'rasek? Mark: Ħbatt mal-ixkaffa u għandi farrett żgħir.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to your head? Mark: I hit the shelf and have a small, thin cut.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的头怎么了？马克：我撞到了架子，留下了一道小小的细长伤口。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的头怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to your head?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħbatt mal-ixkaffa u għandi farrett żgħir.
messages.mt_standard: Ħbatt mal-ixkaffa u għandi farrett żgħir.
messages.zh: 我撞到了架子，留下了一道小小的细长伤口。
messages.en: I hit the shelf and have a small, thin cut.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 farrett 配上一幅头皮上细长伤口的简图，记住“细、较长、常在头部”三个特征。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to describe someone whose movements or handling of objects are awkward and poorly controlled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于形容动作不灵巧、做事手脚笨拙，容易碰到或弄掉东西的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal min jagħmel movimenti goffi jew ma jimmaniġġjax l-affarijiet b'ħila, u għalhekk faċilment jolqot jew iwaqqa' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动作笨拙、不够灵巧的，尤其指拿放物品或移动时控制不好动作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jiċċaqlaq jew juża jdejh b'mod goff u li jista' jolqot jew iwaqqa' l-affarijiet bla ma jrid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is farrfash, they move or handle things awkwardly and may accidentally knock things over or drop them.

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-karattru, Pawlu jidher farrfash għax iwaqqa' l-kotba kull darba li jipprova jġorrhom flimkien.
formal.en: In the character description, Pawlu appears clumsy because he drops the books whenever he tries to carry them all together.
formal.zh: 在人物描写中，保罗显得笨手笨脚，因为每次想把书一起搬走时，他都会把书弄掉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Erġajt waqqajt il-kuċċarina? Mark: Iva, illum jien farrfash! Agħtini oħra, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you drop the spoon again? Mark: Yes, I'm clumsy today! Give me another one, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你又把勺子弄掉了？马克：是啊，我今天笨手笨脚的！请再给我一把。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你又把勺子弄掉了？
messages.en: Did you drop the spoon again?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum jien farrfash! Agħtini oħra, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum jien farrfash! Agħtini oħra, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 是啊，我今天笨手笨脚的！请再给我一把。
messages.en: Yes, I'm clumsy today! Give me another one, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿起勺子却又碰掉书本的笨拙动作，把 farrfash 和“笨手笨脚”的画面一起记。

gloss_zh: 闹剧；滑稽剧；荒唐可笑的局面

teaching_sense.en_definition: A comedy based on exaggerated, ridiculous situations, or a real situation that seems similarly absurd.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以夸张动作、误会和荒唐情节制造笑料的戏剧，也可指现实中荒唐可笑、像闹剧一样的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kummiedja mibnija fuq sitwazzjonijiet esaġerati, nuqqas ta' ftehim u ġrajjiet redikoli; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll sitwazzjoni reali li tidher assurda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以夸张而荒诞的情节逗笑观众的滑稽剧；也指荒唐可笑、缺乏严肃性的事情或局面。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xogħol teatrali komiku li juża esaġerazzjoni u sitwazzjonijiet redikoli biex idaħħak, jew ġrajja fil-ħajja reali li tidher daqstant assurda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A farsa is a comedy involving exaggerated and ridiculous situations, or an event that seems absurd when it should be serious.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija teatrali ppreżentat farsa dwar żewġ familji li jħawdu l-bagalji tagħhom waqt vaganza.
formal.en: The theatre company presented a farce about two families who mix up their suitcases while on holiday.
formal.zh: 剧团上演了一出滑稽剧，讲述两个家庭在度假时弄混行李箱的故事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif marret il-laqgħa? Mark: Inbidlet f'farsa! Ħadd ma kien jaf fuq xiex kellna nivvutaw.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the meeting go? Mark: It turned into a farce! Nobody knew what we were supposed to vote on.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：会议开得怎么样？马克：变成一场闹剧了！谁都不知道我们究竟要对什么进行表决。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 会议开得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the meeting go?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Inbidlet f'farsa! Ħadd ma kien jaf fuq xiex kellna nivvutaw.
messages.mt_standard: Inbidlet f'farsa! Ħadd ma kien jaf fuq xiex kellna nivvutaw.
messages.zh: 变成一场闹剧了！谁都不知道我们究竟要对什么进行表决。
messages.en: It turned into a farce! Nobody knew what we were supposed to vote on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 farsa 连到“舞台人物误会连连”的画面，再联想到现实中乱成一团的会议，两种语境都可记成“闹剧”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An irritated or troubled feeling caused by something bothersome, or the disturbance that causes that feeling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因受到打扰、遇到麻烦或事情不顺而产生的烦躁、恼烦，也可指造成这种感受的烦扰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' dwejjaq jew irritazzjoni minħabba xi ħaġa li tfixkel jew tħabbat lil dak li jkun, jew l-inkonvenjent li joħloq dan is-sens.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因噪声、打扰或其他令人不快的事情而产生的烦躁；也可指这种令人厌烦的干扰。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Irritazzjoni jew dwejjaq li wieħed iħoss meta xi ħaġa tfixklu jew iddejqu, jew il-ħaġa li tkun qed tikkawża dan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fastidju is the irritation you feel when something bothers you, or the disturbance that produces that feeling.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因麻烦、受阻或事情不如意而产生的恼烦、苦恼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dwejjaq u taħbit li wieħed iħoss minħabba diffikultà, ostaklu jew sitwazzjoni li ma tkunx sejra kif jixtieq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fastidju can describe the troubled irritation you feel when difficulties or setbacks prevent things from going as you wish.

collocations.en: to cause annoyance or bother someone

formal.mt: Il-ħsejjes ripetuti taw fastidju lill-qarrejja, u d-dewmien fis-soluzzjoni tal-problema żied id-dwejjaq tagħhom.
formal.en: The repeated noises caused annoyance to the readers, and the delay in resolving the problem increased their frustration.
formal.zh: 反复出现的噪声使读者感到烦扰，而问题迟迟未获解决，又加重了他们的恼烦。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed nagħtik fastidju bil-mużika? Mark: Ftit, iva. Tista' tbaxxiha sakemm nispiċċa naqra?
colloquial.en: Maja: Am I bothering you with the music? Mark: A little, yes. Could you turn it down until I finish reading?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我的音乐打扰到你了吗？马克：是有一点。能先调低音量，等我读完吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 我的音乐打扰到你了吗？
messages.en: Am I bothering you with the music?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit, iva. Tista' tbaxxiha sakemm nispiċċa naqra?
messages.mt_standard: Ftit, iva. Tista' tbaxxiha sakemm nispiċċa naqra?
messages.zh: 是有一点。能先调低音量，等我读完吗？
messages.en: A little, yes. Could you turn it down until I finish reading?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象读书时音乐反复打断思路：外来的“烦扰”和心里的“恼烦”都用 fastidju 联系记忆，再整句记住 tagħti fastidju。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something fatal causes a person's death.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容会导致人死亡的事故、伤害或其他情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi inċident, korriment jew ċirkostanza oħra li twassal għall-mewt ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 致命的；造成死亡的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tikkawża l-mewt ta' persuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An accident or injury that is fatal causes someone to die.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi inċident fatali li seħħ fit-triq prinċipali.
formal.en: The report describes a fatal accident that occurred on the main road.
formal.zh: 报告描述了发生在主干道上的一起致命事故。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jiġifieri 'inċident fatali'? Pawlu: Jiġifieri inċident li fih miet xi ħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'a fatal accident' mean? Pawlu: It means an accident in which someone died.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：‘致命事故’是什么意思？保罗：就是有人死亡的事故。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: ‘致命事故’是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'a fatal accident' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri inċident li fih miet xi ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri inċident li fih miet xi ħadd.
messages.zh: 就是有人死亡的事故。
messages.en: It means an accident in which someone died.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fatali 和英语 fatal 对照记忆，再用“事故导致死亡”的画面记住其程度：不是普通受伤，而是致命。

gloss_zh: 名词；所给释义仅为标记“{2}”，具体词义未提供

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning cannot be established from the supplied marker '{2}'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本材料将 fatatina 标为名词，但释义栏仅有“{2}”，因此无法据此确定它指什么。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'dan il-materjal, 'fatatina' hija mniżżla bħala nom, iżda l-marka '{2}' ma tagħtix tagħrif biżżejjed biex tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义仅为“{2}”；该标记未说明这个名词的具体含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa mogħtija fiha biss il-marka '{2}', li ma tispjegax it-tifsira ta' dan in-nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied marker does not establish what this noun means.

collocations.zh: “fatatina”的词义（用于询问或核对释义）

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'fatatina' hija mniżżla bħala nom, iżda l-glossa '{2}' ma tippermettix li tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira tagħha.

formal.zh: “fatatina”被列为名词，但释义“{2}”不足以确定它的含义。

gloss_zh: 弊端、错事、复杂情况、坏习惯（所给词性为形容词，英文释义以名词短语列出）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adjective associated in the supplied gloss with disadvantages, wrong things, complications, and bad habits; its precise descriptive use is not specified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本材料将 Fatizzi 标为形容词，释义涉及弊端、错事、复杂情况和坏习惯，但没有说明它在句中具体如何修饰事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'dan il-materjal, 'Fatizzi' huwa mniżżel bħala aġġettiv marbut ma' żvantaġġi, affarijiet ħżiena, kumplikazzjonijiet u drawwiet ħżiena, iżda l-użu preċiż tiegħu biex jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa mhuwiex spjegat.

sense_translations.en_definition: Cons, wrong things, complications, bad habits
sense_translations.zh_definition: 释义列出弊端、不妥之事、复杂情况或麻烦，以及坏习惯；本条仍按所给信息保留形容词词性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa ssemmi żvantaġġi, affarijiet ħżiena, kumplikazzjonijiet u drawwiet ħżiena; il-kelma tibqa' mniżżla bħala aġġettiv skont it-tagħrif mogħti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss associates this adjective with disadvantages, wrong things, complications, and bad habits, without specifying its grammatical use.

collocations.zh: 形容词“Fatizzi”（用于讨论所给词性）

formal.mt: Il-glossa ta' 'Fatizzi' ssemmi żvantaġġi, affarijiet ħżiena, kumplikazzjonijiet u drawwiet ħżiena, filwaqt li l-kelma hija mniżżla bħala aġġettiv.
formal.en: The gloss for 'Fatizzi' mentions disadvantages, wrong things, complications, and bad habits, while the word is listed as an adjective.
formal.zh: “Fatizzi”的释义提到弊端、错事、复杂情况和坏习惯，而该词被列为形容词。

colloquial.mt: Nina: 'Fatizzi' hawn imniżżel bħala aġġettiv? Toni: Iva, imma l-glossa tagħti lista ta' affarijiet ħżiena u ma turix kif nużawh f'sentenza.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is 'Fatizzi' listed here as an adjective? Toni: Yes, but the gloss gives a list of negative things and does not show how to use it in a sentence.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这里把‘Fatizzi’列为形容词吗？托尼：是的，但释义只是列举了负面的事物，没有展示怎样把它用在句子里。
