teaching_sense.en_definition: A fact is something that is true or has actually happened.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事实，指真实存在或确实发生的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fatt huwa xi ħaġa li hija vera jew li tassew ġrat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 事实；真实存在或已经确实发生的事情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa vera jew xi ħaġa li seħħet tassew.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fact is something that is true or has really happened.

formal.mt: Il-fatt li l-laqgħa bdiet fid-disgħa huwa kkonfermat fil-minuti.
formal.en: The fact that the meeting began at nine is confirmed in the minutes.
formal.zh: 会议记录证实了会议在九点开始这一事实。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-ħanut fetaħ fit-tmienja? Luqa: Iva, dak hu fatt. Kont hemm meta fetaħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did the shop open at eight? Luqa: Yes, that is a fact. I was there when it opened.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：商店是八点开门的吗？卢卡：是的，这是事实。开门时我就在场。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 商店是八点开门的吗？
messages.en: Did the shop open at eight?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak hu fatt. Kont hemm meta fetaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak hu fatt. Kont hemm meta fetaħ.
messages.zh: 是的，这是事实。开门时我就在场。
messages.en: Yes, that is a fact. I was there when it opened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fatt 与英语 fact 并排做词卡，用“有记录、确实发生”记住事实；再整体记住 il-fatt li，后面接具体事实内容。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The extent to which a plan or project can be carried out successfully with the resources available.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 计划或项目在现有资源和条件下能够成功实施的程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-grad sa fejn pjan jew proġett jista' jitwettaq b'suċċess bir-riżorsi u fil-kundizzjonijiet disponibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 计划、方案或项目在实际条件下得以实施的可能性和可行程度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-possibbiltà li pjan, proposta jew proġett jitwettaq fil-prattika, meta jitqiesu r-riżorsi, l-ispejjeż u l-kundizzjonijiet meħtieġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The feasibility of a plan is the extent to which it can realistically be carried out.

formal.mt: Qabel ma japprova l-proġett, il-kumitat se jeżamina l-istudju ta' fattibilità.
formal.en: Before approving the project, the committee will examine the feasibility study.
formal.zh: 委员会将在批准项目之前审查可行性研究。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taħseb li nistgħu niftħu ħanut żgħir? Mark: Forsi, imma l-ewwel irridu naraw il-fattibilità tal-pjan.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you think we could open a small shop? Mark: Maybe, but first we need to assess the feasibility of the plan.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你觉得我们能开一家小店吗？Mark：也许可以，但我们得先看看这个计划的可行性。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li nistgħu niftħu ħanut żgħir?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li nistgħu niftħu ħanut żgħir?
messages.zh: 你觉得我们能开一家小店吗？
messages.en: Do you think we could open a small shop?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi, imma l-ewwel irridu naraw il-fattibilità tal-pjan.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi, imma l-ewwel irridu naraw il-fattibilità tal-pjan.
messages.zh: 也许可以，但我们得先看看这个计划的可行性。
messages.en: Maybe, but first we need to assess the feasibility of the plan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把计划放进时间、资金、人手三道检查关；问“实际做得成吗”，就联想到 fattibilità“可行性”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woman employed to clean a home and carry out other household tasks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受雇打扫住宅并料理其他家务的女性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara impjegata biex tnaddaf dar u tagħmel xogħol ieħor tad-dar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受雇从事住宅清洁、整理及其他家务劳动的女性；女佣。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mara li titħallas biex tagħmel it-tindif, l-imbarazzar u xogħol ieħor fid-dar ta' min iħaddimha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A maid is a woman employed to clean and perform other domestic tasks in someone's home.

formal.mt: Il-familja qabbdet fattiga biex tnaddaf id-dar darbtejn fil-ġimgħa.
formal.en: The family hired a maid to clean the house twice a week.
formal.zh: 这家人雇用了一名家务女工，每周打扫房屋两次。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Meta tiġi l-fattiga? Rita: Tiġi għada filgħodu biex tnaddaf il-kċina u l-kamra tal-banju.
colloquial.en: Anna: When is the maid coming? Rita: She is coming tomorrow morning to clean the kitchen and the bathroom.
colloquial.zh: Anna：家务女工什么时候来？Rita：她明天上午来打扫厨房和浴室。

messages.speaker: Anna (住户)
messages.zh: 家务女工什么时候来？
messages.en: When is the maid coming?

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tiġi għada filgħodu biex tnaddaf il-kċina u l-kamra tal-banju.
messages.mt_standard: Tiġi għada filgħodu biex tnaddaf il-kċina u l-kamra tal-banju.
messages.zh: 她明天上午来打扫厨房和浴室。
messages.en: She is coming tomorrow morning to clean the kitchen and the bathroom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位受雇上门打扫厨房、整理房间的女性，把这个家务工作场景与 fattiga 联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A document listing goods or services supplied and the amount that the customer must pay.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 列明已提供的商品或服务及客户应付金额的单据。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument li jelenka l-oġġetti jew is-servizzi pprovduti u l-ammont li l-klijent għandu jħallas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卖方向客户出具的付款单据，列明所提供的商品或服务以及应付金额；发票或账单。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument li l-bejjiegħ joħroġ lill-klijent u li juri l-oġġetti jew is-servizzi pprovduti, il-prezzijiet tagħhom u s-somma dovuta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An invoice is a document that a seller sends to a customer showing what has been supplied and how much is owed.

formal.mt: Il-klijent għandu jħallas il-fattura fi żmien tletin jum mid-data tal-ħruġ tagħha.
formal.en: The customer must pay the invoice within thirty days of its issue date.
formal.zh: 客户须在发票开具之日起三十天内付款。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tista' tibgħatli l-fattura bl-email? Lara: Iva, nibgħathielek illum waranofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can you send me the invoice by email? Lara: Yes, I will send it to you this afternoon.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你能把发票通过电子邮件发给我吗？Lara：可以，我今天下午发给你。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 你能把发票通过电子邮件发给我吗？
messages.en: Can you send me the invoice by email?

messages.speaker: Lara (商家职员)
messages.zh: 可以，我今天下午发给你。
messages.en: Yes, I will send it to you this afternoon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见列有商品、价格和应付总额的单据，就联想到 fattura；它告诉你该付多少，不一定表示已经付款。

gloss_zh: 保理；应收账款转让融资

teaching_sense.en_definition: A financial arrangement in which a business sells its outstanding customer debts to a finance company to obtain money sooner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 企业将尚未收回的客户应收账款出售给金融公司，以提前取得资金的融资安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arranġament finanzjarju li bih negozju jbigħ lil kumpanija finanzjarja l-ammonti li għadhom dovuti mill-klijenti tiegħu sabiex jirċievi l-flus qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 企业将客户尚未支付的应收账款出售给保理机构，以提前获得资金，并由该机构收取有关款项的金融业务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Servizz finanzjarju li fih negozju jbigħ l-ammonti dovuti mill-klijenti tiegħu lil kumpanija finanzjarja, li tagħtih il-flus qabel il-ħlas tal-klijenti u mbagħad tiġbor il-krediti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Factoring is an arrangement in which a business sells its unpaid customer debts to a finance company in order to receive money sooner.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija daħlet fi ftehim ta' fatturament biex tikseb fondi qabel ma l-klijenti jħallsu l-fatturi tagħhom.
formal.en: The company entered into a factoring agreement to obtain funds before its customers paid their invoices.
formal.zh: 该公司签订了保理协议，以便在客户支付发票款项之前获得资金。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-klijenti se jħallsuna x-xahar id-dieħel, imma għandna bżonn il-flus issa. Paul: Nistgħu nistaqsu dwar servizz ta' fatturament biex nirċievu parti mill-flus qabel.
colloquial.en: Sara: Our customers will pay us next month, but we need the money now. Paul: We can ask about a factoring service so that we receive part of the money sooner.
colloquial.zh: Sara：客户下个月才会付款，但我们现在就需要资金。Paul：我们可以咨询保理服务，好提前收到部分款项。

messages.speaker: Sara (企业负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-klijenti se jħallsuna x-xahar id-dieħel, imma għandna bżonn il-flus issa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-klijenti se jħallsuna x-xahar id-dieħel, imma għandna bżonn il-flus issa.
messages.zh: 客户下个月才会付款，但我们现在就需要资金。
messages.en: Our customers will pay us next month, but we need the money now.

messages.speaker: Paul (财务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nistaqsu dwar servizz ta' fatturament biex nirċievu parti mill-flus qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nistaqsu dwar servizz ta' fatturament biex nirċievu parti mill-flus qabel.
messages.zh: 我们可以咨询保理服务，好提前收到部分款项。
messages.en: We can ask about a factoring service so that we receive part of the money sooner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“客户欠款尚未到账，转让账款提前拿钱”的场景记 fatturament；这是帮助理解保理的情景联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Liked or preferred more than others of the same kind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在同类的人或事物中最受某人喜爱或最合某人心意的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew ħaġa favorita hija dik li xi ħadd iħobb jew jippreferi aktar minn oħrajn tal-istess tip.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最喜欢的；在同类对象中最偏爱的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta persuna jew ħaġa tkun favorita, xi ħadd jippreferiha aktar minn persuni jew affarijiet oħra tal-istess tip.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your favourite person or thing is the one you like most among others of the same kind.

formal.mt: Kull student għandu jagħżel il-ktieb favorit tiegħu u jispjega għaliex jogħġbu.
formal.en: Each student should choose their favourite book and explain why they like it.
formal.zh: 每位学生都应选择自己最喜欢的书，并解释喜欢它的原因。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema hu l-kulur favorit tiegħek? Toni: Il-blu. U tiegħek?
colloquial.en: Maja: What is your favourite colour? Toni: Blue. And yours?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你最喜欢什么颜色？托尼：蓝色。你呢？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你最喜欢什么颜色？
messages.en: What is your favourite colour?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 蓝色。你呢？
messages.en: Blue. And yours?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 favorit 放进“我的最爱”小卡片：书、颜色、食物中排第一的那个，就用它来描述。

gloss_zh: 偏袒；徇私；不公平的优待

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unfair treatment that gives preferred people advantages over others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因为个人偏爱或私人关系而给予某些人优待，使其他人受到不公平对待的做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-favoritiżmu huwa trattament inġust li jagħti vantaġġi lil ċerti persuni minħabba preferenza personali jew rabtiet magħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出于个人偏爱而偏袒某些人、给予他们不公平优待的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-favoritiżmu jseħħ meta xi ħadd jittratta ċerti persuni aħjar minn oħrajn minħabba preferenza personali aktar milli skont kriterji ġusti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Favouritism is the unfair practice of giving particular people better treatment because you personally prefer them.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat għandu juża kriterji ċari biex jevita l-favoritiżmu fl-għażla tal-kandidati.
formal.en: The committee should use clear criteria to avoid favouritism when selecting candidates.
formal.zh: 委员会应采用明确的标准，以避免在遴选候选人时徇私偏袒。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex dejjem jagħti l-aħjar xogħol lill-istess persuna? Mark: Jekk jagħżilha għax hi ħabiba tiegħu, dak hu favoritiżmu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does he always give the best work to the same person? Mark: If he chooses her because she is his friend, that is favouritism.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他为什么总把最好的工作交给同一个人？马克：如果他选她是因为她是他的朋友，那就是徇私偏袒。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dejjem jagħti l-aħjar xogħol lill-istess persuna?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dejjem jagħti l-aħjar xogħol lill-istess persuna?
messages.zh: 他为什么总把最好的工作交给同一个人？
messages.en: Why does he always give the best work to the same person?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk jagħżilha għax hi ħabiba tiegħu, dak hu favoritiżmu.
messages.mt_standard: Jekk jagħżilha għax hi ħabiba tiegħu, dak hu favoritiżmu.
messages.zh: 如果他选她是因为她是他的朋友，那就是徇私偏袒。
messages.en: If he chooses her because she is his friend, that is favouritism.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象评选时有人把机会全给熟人：把这种“偏爱变成不公平优待”的场景与 favoritiżmu 绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of help or kindness, or support for someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为别人提供的帮助或好意；也可表示对某人或某事的支持。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Favur huwa att ta' għajnuna jew tjubija lejn xi ħadd; jista' wkoll ifisser appoġġ għal persuna, proposta jew idea.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给予他人的帮助、好意或恩惠；也指对某人或某事的支持、赞同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Favur jista' jkun xi ħaġa li tagħmel biex tgħin lil xi ħadd, jew appoġġ li tagħti lil persuna jew lil xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A favour is something helpful you do for someone, and favour can also mean support for a person or proposal.

collocations.en: to vote in favour of the proposal

formal.mt: Il-membri tal-kumitat ivvutaw favur il-proposta biex jitjiebu s-servizzi tal-librerija.
formal.en: The committee members voted in favour of the proposal to improve library services.
formal.zh: 委员会成员投票支持改善图书馆服务的提案。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' tagħmilli favur u żżommli l-bieb? Pawlu: Iva, żgur. Għaddi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you do me a favour and hold the door for me? Pawlu: Yes, of course. Go ahead.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：能帮我个忙，替我扶住门吗？保罗：当然可以。你先过。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tagħmilli favur u żżommli l-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tagħmilli favur u żżommli l-bieb?
messages.zh: 能帮我个忙，替我扶住门吗？
messages.en: Can you do me a favour and hold the door for me?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 当然可以。你先过。
messages.en: Yes, of course. Go ahead.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个动作记 favur：伸手帮忙是“帮个忙”，举手赞成是“支持”；分别配合固定表达练习。

gloss_zh: 动物群；某地区或环境中的动物总称

teaching_sense.en_definition: The animals living in a particular region or environment, considered as a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生活在某个地区或某种环境中的动物的总称，强调其整体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fawna hija l-ġabra tal-annimali li jgħixu f'reġjun jew f'ambjent partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动物群，指某一地区或特定环境中所有动物的总体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fawna tinkludi l-annimali kollha li jgħixu f'żona jew f'ambjent partikolari, meqjusa flimkien bħala grupp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The fauna of a particular place consists of all the animals that live there, considered together.

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi l-fawna tal-gżira u l-ambjenti fejn jgħixu dawn l-annimali.
formal.en: The study describes the island's fauna and the environments in which these animals live.
formal.zh: 该研究描述了岛上的动物群及这些动物生活的环境。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser il-kelma fawna fuq dan it-tabellun? David: Tfisser l-annimali kollha li jgħixu hawn, bħall-għasafar u l-insetti.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does the word fauna mean on this information board? David: It means all the animals that live here, such as birds and insects.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这块说明牌上的 fawna 是什么意思？戴维：指生活在这里的所有动物，比如鸟类和昆虫。

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma fawna fuq dan it-tabellun?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma fawna fuq dan it-tabellun?
messages.zh: 这块说明牌上的 fawna 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word fauna mean on this information board?

messages.speaker: David (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser l-annimali kollha li jgħixu hawn, bħall-għasafar u l-insetti.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser l-annimali kollha li jgħixu hawn, bħall-għasafar u l-insetti.
messages.zh: 指生活在这里的所有动物，比如鸟类和昆虫。
messages.en: It means all the animals that live here, such as birds and insects.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中给一座岛画边框，把框内的鸟、昆虫和其他动物一起圈住；这一整套动物就是 fawna。

gloss_zh: 蒸汽；短时蒸制；一阵潮热

teaching_sense.en_definition: Steam, a brief steaming process in cooking, or a sudden feeling of heat in the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指蒸汽、烹饪时短时间用蒸汽加热的过程，或身体突然出现的一阵热感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fwar, tisjir bil-fwar għal żmien qasir, jew sensazzjoni ta' sħana li tiġi għal għarrieda fil-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 热水或受热食物等产生的蒸汽。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fwar li joħroġ minn ilma jaħraq jew minn ikel waqt it-tisjir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Steam is the hot vapour that rises from heated water or food.

sense_translations.en_definition: in cooking, the process of steaming for a short time
sense_translations.zh_definition: 烹饪中短时间用蒸汽加热食物的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih l-ikel jissajjar bil-fwar għal żmien qasir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In cooking, this is the process of heating food with steam for a short time.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体突然出现的一阵潮热或发热感。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni qasira ta' sħana li tinħass għal għarrieda fil-ġisem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hot flush is a sudden, brief feeling of intense warmth in the body.

formal.mt: Agħti fawra lill-ħaxix għal ftit minuti, imbagħad servih minnufih.
formal.en: Steam the vegetables for a few minutes, then serve them immediately.
formal.zh: 把蔬菜蒸几分钟，然后立即上桌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Attenta meta tiftaħ l-għatu; hemm ħafna fawra. Rita: Sewwa, niftaħ bil-mod u nżomm wiċċi 'l bogħod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Be careful when you lift the lid; there's a lot of steam. Rita: Okay, I'll open it slowly and keep my face away.
colloquial.zh: Maja：揭开锅盖时小心，蒸汽很多。Rita：好，我会慢慢打开，把脸离远一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Attenta meta tiftaħ l-għatu; hemm ħafna fawra.
messages.mt_standard: Attenta meta tiftaħ l-għatu; hemm ħafna fawra.
messages.zh: 揭开锅盖时小心，蒸汽很多。
messages.en: Be careful when you lift the lid; there's a lot of steam.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, niftaħ bil-mod u nżomm wiċċi 'l bogħod.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, niftaħ bil-mod u nżomm wiċċi 'l bogħod.
messages.zh: 好，我会慢慢打开，把脸离远一点。
messages.en: Okay, I'll open it slowly and keep my face away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个热的画面串记：锅口冒蒸汽、蔬菜稍蒸一下、身体突然一阵潮热；再靠上下文区分词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: So full that the contents flow over the edge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容容器等装得过满，以致内容物越过边缘溢出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun tant mimli li dak li jkun fih joħroġ minn fuq ix-xifer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装得过满而向外溢出的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun mimli żżejjed, b'dak li jkun fih ħiereġ minn fuq ix-xifer.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is overflowing is so full that its contents spill over the edge.

formal.mt: Il-barmil kien fawwari, u l-ilma beda jinxtered mal-art.
formal.en: The bucket was overflowing, and the water began to spread across the floor.
formal.zh: 水桶满得溢了出来，水开始流到地板上。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Agħlaq il-vit! Il-barmil fawwari. Lara: Qed nagħlqu, u se nixxotta l-ilma mill-art.
colloquial.en: Mark: Turn off the tap! The bucket is overflowing. Lara: I'm turning it off, and I'll mop up the water on the floor.
colloquial.zh: Mark：关掉水龙头！水桶都溢出来了。Lara：我正在关，接着会把地上的水拖干。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 关掉水龙头！水桶都溢出来了。
messages.en: Turn off the tap! The bucket is overflowing.

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħlqu, u se nixxotta l-ilma mill-art.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħlqu, u se nixxotta l-ilma mill-art.
messages.zh: 我正在关，接着会把地上的水拖干。
messages.en: I'm turning it off, and I'll mop up the water on the floor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象水已经越过桶沿：这个形容词强调满到溢出。搭配记忆 barmil fawwari，也留意阴性搭配 tazza fawwara。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The different stages through which a process, activity, or development passes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个过程、活动或发展所经历的不同阶段；该词为复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istadji differenti li minnhom jgħaddi proċess, xogħol jew żvilupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阶段，指一个过程或发展中具有特定特点的一段时期；fazijiet 表示多个阶段。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stadju partikolari fi proċess jew fi żvilupp; il-kelma fazijiet tirreferi għal aktar minn stadju wieħed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A phase is a particular stage in a process or development, and fazijiet refers to several such stages.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-fazijiet tal-proġett u jagħti d-dati għal kull stadju.
formal.en: The report describes the phases of the project and gives the dates for each stage.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了项目的各个阶段，并列出了每个阶段的日期。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif se nqassmu x-xogħol? Pawlu: Nagħmluh fi tliet fazijiet: l-ewwel nippjanaw, imbagħad nibdew, u fl-aħħar niċċekkjaw kollox.
colloquial.en: Marija: How shall we divide up the work? Pawlu: We'll do it in three phases: first we plan, then we start, and finally we check everything.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我们怎么划分工作？保罗：分三个阶段做：先规划，然后动手，最后检查所有内容。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 我们怎么划分工作？
messages.en: How shall we divide up the work?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħmluh fi tliet fazijiet: l-ewwel nippjanaw, imbagħad nibdew, u fl-aħħar niċċekkjaw kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħmluh fi tliet fazijiet: l-ewwel nippjanaw, imbagħad nibdew, u fl-aħħar niċċekkjaw kollox.
messages.zh: 分三个阶段做：先规划，然后动手，最后检查所有内容。
messages.en: We'll do it in three phases: first we plan, then we start, and finally we check everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一项任务画成三个连续方框，每框代表一个阶段；看到 fazijiet，就想起整排方框，提醒自己这是复数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Routine practical tasks that need to be done, especially around the home.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 需要日常处理的事务，尤其指打扫、洗衣等家务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħlijiet ta' kuljum li jridu jsiru, speċjalment fid-dar, bħat-tindif u l-ħasil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 日常杂务，尤指打扫、洗衣等需要经常完成的家务劳动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-faċendi huma xogħlijiet ta' rutina li jridu jsiru regolarment, speċjalment biex tinżamm id-dar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Chores are routine tasks that you need to do regularly, especially to keep your home clean and organized.

collocations.en: we share the chores between us

formal.mt: Il-membri tal-familja għandhom jaqsmu l-faċendi tad-dar b'mod ġust.
formal.en: Family members should share household chores fairly.
formal.zh: 家庭成员应当公平分担家务。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Tista' tgħinni bil-faċendi llum? Nina: Iva. Naħsel il-platti jien? Omm: Iva, u jien niknes il-kċina.
colloquial.en: Mum: Can you help me with the chores today? Nina: Yes. Shall I wash the dishes? Mum: Yes, and I'll sweep the kitchen.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：你今天能帮我做家务吗？妮娜：可以。我来洗碗好吗？妈妈：好，我来扫厨房。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 你今天能帮我做家务吗？
messages.en: Can you help me with the chores today?

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 可以。我来洗碗好吗？
messages.en: Yes. Shall I wash the dishes?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 好，我来扫厨房。
messages.en: Yes, and I'll sweep the kitchen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把洗碗、扫地、洗衣画成一张家务清单，在清单上写 faċendi，帮助记住它表示一组日常杂务。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Buildings, equipment, or services provided for a particular activity or purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为开展某种活动或满足某种用途而提供的建筑、设备或配套服务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini, tagħmir jew servizzi pprovduti biex jintużaw għal attività jew għan partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供特定活动使用的设施、设备或配套服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-bini, it-tagħmir u s-servizzi li jkunu disponibbli għal attività jew għal użu partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Facilities are buildings, equipment, or services that people can use for a particular purpose.

formal.mt: Iċ-ċentru l-ġdid joffri faċilitajiet sportivi għall-istudenti u għar-residenti.
formal.en: The new centre offers sports facilities for students and residents.
formal.zh: 新中心为学生和居民提供体育设施。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'faċilitajiet hemm f'din il-lukanda? Lara: Hemm pixxina, ġinnasju u kamra tal-logħob.
colloquial.en: Maja: What facilities does this hotel have? Lara: There is a pool, a gym, and a games room.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这家酒店有哪些设施？Lara：有游泳池、健身房和游戏室。

messages.speaker: Maja (旅客)
messages.zh: 这家酒店有哪些设施？
messages.en: What facilities does this hotel have?

messages.speaker: Lara (酒店接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm pixxina, ġinnasju u kamra tal-logħob.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm pixxina, ġinnasju u kamra tal-logħob.
messages.zh: 有游泳池、健身房和游戏室。
messages.en: There is a pool, a gym, and a games room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把酒店里的泳池、健身房和游戏室放进同一幅图，整套配套设施就是 faċilitajiet；这里记的是多项设施。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place or installation used to store goods or materials for a limited period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于在有限时间内存放货物或物料的场所或设施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post jew faċilità fejn jinżammu oġġetti jew materjali għal żmien limitat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供货物或物料暂时存放、而非长期保管的储存设施。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Faċilità maħsuba biex oġġetti jew materjali jinżammu fiha għal perjodu limitat qabel ma jittieħdu xi mkien ieħor jew jintużaw.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A temporary storage facility is a place where goods or materials are kept for a limited time.

collocations.en: goods in a temporary storage facility
collocations.zh: 临时储存设施内的货物

collocations.mt: it-trasferiment lejn faċilità ta' ħażna temporanja
collocations.en: transfer to a temporary storage facility
collocations.zh: 向临时储存设施的转运

formal.mt: Il-kaxxi se jinżammu f'faċilità ta' ħażna temporanja sakemm jitlesta x-xogħol fil-maħżen ewlieni.
formal.en: The boxes will be kept in a temporary storage facility until work on the main warehouse is completed.
formal.zh: 这些箱子将存放在临时储存设施内，直至主仓库的工程完工。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn se npoġġu dawn il-kaxxi għalissa? Mark: F'faċilità ta' ħażna temporanja; inġibuhom lura l-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where will we put these boxes for now? Mark: In a temporary storage facility; we will bring them back next week.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这些箱子暂时放在哪里？Mark：放在临时储存设施里；我们下周再把它们运回来。

messages.speaker: Nina (仓库管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se npoġġu dawn il-kaxxi għalissa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se npoġġu dawn il-kaxxi għalissa?
messages.zh: 这些箱子暂时放在哪里？
messages.en: Where will we put these boxes for now?

messages.speaker: Mark (物流协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: F'faċilità ta' ħażna temporanja; inġibuhom lura l-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
messages.mt_standard: F'faċilità ta' ħażna temporanja; inġibuhom lura l-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
messages.zh: 放在临时储存设施里；我们下周再把它们运回来。
messages.en: In a temporary storage facility; we will bring them back next week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象箱子贴着“下周取回”的标签进入仓库：ħażna 提醒你“储存”，temporanja 提醒你“临时”，合起来记整个设施名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A building or specially equipped place where goods or materials are kept until they are needed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于存放货物或材料，直至需要取用的建筑物或专门场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini jew post mgħammar apposta fejn jinżammu oġġetti jew materjali sakemm ikun hemm bżonnhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供货物、物品或材料储存使用的设施或场所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Faċilità fejn jinżammu merkanzija, oġġetti jew materjali biex jintużaw jew jitqassmu aktar tard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A storage facility is a building or designated place where goods or materials are kept until they are needed.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija fetħet faċilità ta' ħżin ġdida biex iżżomm il-merkanzija qabel id-distribuzzjoni.
formal.en: The company opened a new storage facility to keep goods before distribution.
formal.zh: 公司启用了一座新的仓储设施，用于在配送前存放货物。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn se nżommu dawn il-kaxxi? Pawlu: Hemm faċilità ta' ħżin fil-qrib. Nistgħu nħalluhom hemm.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where are we going to keep these boxes? Pawlu: There's a storage facility nearby. We can leave them there.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这些箱子我们要放在哪里？保罗：附近有一处仓储设施。我们可以把它们存放在那里。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 这些箱子我们要放在哪里？
messages.en: Where are we going to keep these boxes?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm faċilità ta' ħżin fil-qrib. Nistgħu nħalluhom hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm faċilità ta' ħżin fil-qrib. Nistgħu nħalluhom hemm.
messages.zh: 附近有一处仓储设施。我们可以把它们存放在那里。
messages.en: There's a storage facility nearby. We can leave them there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词与“箱子入库”的画面绑定：faċilità 是设施，ta' ħżin 说明用途是储存。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A facility in an electricity system where electrical energy is consumed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 电力系统中消耗电能的设施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Faċilità f'sistema tal-elettriku fejn tiġi kkunsmata l-enerġija elettrika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电力系统中作为电能使用端的用电设施。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Faċilità li tuża l-enerġija elettrika u tirrappreżenta domanda għall-elettriku fis-sistema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A demand facility is a facility that consumes electrical energy within an electricity system.

collocations.en: the electricity consumption of the demand facility
the connection of the demand facility to the network
collocations.zh: 用电设施与电网的连接

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta d-dejta dwar il-konsum tal-elettriku tal-faċilità tad-domanda matul ix-xahar ta' Ġunju.
formal.en: The report presents data on the electricity consumption of the demand facility during June.
formal.zh: 报告列出了该用电设施在六月的耗电量数据。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi tfisser faċilità tad-domanda f'dan ir-rapport? Rita: Hawnhekk tfisser faċilità li tuża l-elettriku, bħal fabbrika.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does demand facility mean in this report? Rita: Here it means a facility that uses electricity, such as a factory.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这份报告里的“用电设施”是什么意思？Rita：这里指使用电力的设施，比如工厂。

messages.speaker: Mark (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser faċilità tad-domanda f'dan ir-rapport?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser faċilità tad-domanda f'dan ir-rapport?
messages.zh: 这份报告里的“用电设施”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does demand facility mean in this report?

messages.speaker: Rita (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk tfisser faċilità li tuża l-elettriku, bħal fabbrika.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk tfisser faċilità li tuża l-elettriku, bħal fabbrika.
messages.zh: 这里指使用电力的设施，比如工厂。
messages.en: Here it means a facility that uses electricity, such as a factory.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电流进入工厂带动机器：工厂这一端提出用电需求，把整个短语与“用电设施”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A demand facility that is relevant to the matter being considered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与当前讨论、分析或处理事项有关的用电设施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Faċilità li tikkonsma l-enerġija elettrika u li għandha x'taqsam mal-kwistjoni li tkun qed tiġi kkunsidrata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与所讨论事项有关的用电设施；具体所指由上下文确定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Faċilità tad-domanda li tkun marbuta mas-suġġett, mal-analiżi jew mal-każ li jkun qed jiġi diskuss.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A relevant demand facility is an electricity-consuming facility that has a bearing on the matter under consideration.

collocations.en: the data for the relevant demand facility
the operator of the relevant demand facility
collocations.zh: 相关用电设施的运营方

formal.mt: Għal din l-analiżi, intużat biss id-dejta dwar il-konsum tal-faċilità tad-domanda rilevanti.
formal.en: For this analysis, only consumption data for the relevant demand facility was used.
formal.zh: 本次分析仅使用了相关用电设施的耗电量数据。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema dejta għandna nibagħtu? Pawlu: Id-dejta tal-faċilità tad-domanda rilevanti, jiġifieri tal-fabbrika msemmija fir-rapport.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which data should we send? Pawlu: The data for the relevant demand facility, meaning the factory mentioned in the report.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们应该发送哪些数据？Pawlu：相关用电设施的数据，也就是报告中提到的那家工厂的数据。

messages.speaker: Lara (项目助理)
messages.zh: 我们应该发送哪些数据？
messages.en: Which data should we send?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-dejta tal-faċilità tad-domanda rilevanti, jiġifieri tal-fabbrika msemmija fir-rapport.
messages.mt_standard: Id-dejta tal-faċilità tad-domanda rilevanti, jiġifieri tal-fabbrika msemmija fir-rapport.
messages.zh: 相关用电设施的数据，也就是报告中提到的那家工厂的数据。
messages.en: The data for the relevant demand facility, meaning the factory mentioned in the report.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记住“用电设施”，再想象报告用荧光笔圈出其中一家：rilevanti 帮你锁定与当前事项相关的那一家。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A site or installation with equipment that produces electrical power.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 配备发电设备、用于生产电能的场所或设施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post jew installazzjoni b'tagħmir li jipproduċi l-elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于生产电能的设施，包括发电所需的设备及其所在场所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Faċilità li fiha jintuża tagħmir biex tiġi prodotta l-enerġija elettrika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A power generating facility is a site equipped to produce electricity for use in homes, businesses, or other places.

collocations.en: the construction of a power generating facility
the operation of a power generating facility

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-miżuri ta' sigurtà meħtieġa għat-tħaddim tal-faċilità tal-ġenerazzjoni tal-enerġija.
formal.en: The report describes the safety measures required for operating the power generating facility.
formal.zh: 报告说明了运行该发电设施所需的安全措施。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak il-bini kbir għal xiex jintuża? Mark: Huwa parti minn faċilità tal-ġenerazzjoni tal-enerġija. Hemm jipproduċu l-elettriku.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that large building used for? Mark: It's part of a power generating facility. They produce electricity there.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那栋大楼是做什么用的？马克：它是一处发电设施的一部分。那里生产电力。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-bini kbir għal xiex jintuża?
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-bini kbir għal xiex jintuża?
messages.zh: 那栋大楼是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is that large building used for?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa parti minn faċilità tal-ġenerazzjoni tal-enerġija. Hemm jipproduċu l-elettriku.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa parti minn faċilità tal-ġenerazzjoni tal-enerġija. Hemm jipproduċu l-elettriku.
messages.zh: 它是一处发电设施的一部分。那里生产电力。
messages.en: It's part of a power generating facility. They produce electricity there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“设施—产生—能源”三个意义块记住长词组，再把整体对应到“发电设施”的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pheasant is a bird with a long tail, whose male often has colourful feathers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 雉是一种尾巴较长的鸟，雄鸟通常具有鲜艳的羽毛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Faġan huwa għasfur b'denb twil, li r-raġel tiegħu spiss ikollu rix ikkulurit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雉，俗称野鸡，是一种长尾鸟类，雄鸟的羽毛通常较为鲜艳。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Faġan huwa għasfur b'denb twil, u r-raġel tiegħu ġeneralment ikollu rix ikkulurit.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pheasant is a long-tailed bird whose male often has brightly coloured feathers.

collocations.en: a pheasant with a long tail

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher faġan b'denb twil u rix ikkulurit fit-tarf tal-għalqa.
formal.en: The photograph shows a pheasant with a long tail and colourful feathers at the edge of the field.
formal.zh: 照片中，一只长着长尾巴、羽毛鲜艳的雉出现在田边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak l-għasfur ħdejn is-siġra! X'inhu? Pawlu: Dak faġan. Ħares lejn id-denb twil tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that bird beside the tree! What is it? Pawlu: That's a pheasant. Look at its long tail.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看树旁边那只鸟！那是什么鸟？保罗：那是雉。看看它的长尾巴。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak l-għasfur ħdejn is-siġra! X'inhu?
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak l-għasfur ħdejn is-siġra! X'inhu?
messages.zh: 看树旁边那只鸟！那是什么鸟？
messages.en: Look at that bird beside the tree! What is it?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak faġan. Ħares lejn id-denb twil tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak faġan. Ħares lejn id-denb twil tiegħu.
messages.zh: 那是雉。看看它的长尾巴。
messages.en: That's a pheasant. Look at its long tail.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 faġan 和“长尾巴、彩羽毛、田边的雉”这幅画面一起记，再用 ir-rix tal-faġan 练习表达“雉的羽毛”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The stage before bids are submitted, when information is reviewed and preparations are made.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提交投标文件之前，用于了解要求、澄清信息和进行准备的阶段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istadju qabel ma jitressqu l-offerti, li fih jiġu eżaminati r-rekwiżiti, jintalbu kjarifiki u jsiru t-tħejjijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投标前的准备环节，即正式提交投标文件之前的阶段。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-parti tal-proċess li sseħħ qabel ma jitressqu l-offerti u li tkun tinkludi t-tħejjija għall-parteċipazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pre-bidding is the part of a bidding process when participants prepare before submitting their bids.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投标前阶段，指提交投标文件之前进行资料审阅、问题澄清和准备工作的时期。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-perjodu qabel it-tressiq tal-offerti, meta l-parteċipanti jeżaminaw id-dokumenti, jiċċaraw il-mistoqsijiet u jħejju l-offerti tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The pre-bidding phase is the period before bids are submitted, during which participants review requirements and prepare.

collocations.en: a meeting in the pre-bidding phase

formal.mt: Matul il-fażi ta' qabel l-offerti, il-kumpaniji jistgħu jitolbu kjarifiki dwar ir-rekwiżiti tal-proġett.
formal.en: During the pre-bidding phase, companies may request clarification of the project requirements.
formal.zh: 在投标前阶段，各公司可以就项目要求请求澄清。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għadna fil-fażi ta' qabel l-offerti? Pawlu: Iva, għadna qed niċċaraw ir-rekwiżiti qabel nibagħtu l-offerta tagħna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are we still in the pre-bidding phase? Pawlu: Yes, we're still clarifying the requirements before sending our bid.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们还在投标前阶段吗？Pawlu：是的，我们还在澄清要求，之后才提交投标文件。

messages.speaker: Sara (项目协调员)
messages.zh: 我们还在投标前阶段吗？
messages.en: Are we still in the pre-bidding phase?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (投标负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadna qed niċċaraw ir-rekwiżiti qabel nibagħtu l-offerta tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadna qed niċċaraw ir-rekwiżiti qabel nibagħtu l-offerta tagħna.
messages.zh: 是的，我们还在澄清要求，之后才提交投标文件。
messages.en: Yes, we're still clarifying the requirements before sending our bid.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按短语分块记：fażi 是阶段，qabel 表示之前，l-offerti 指投标文件；连成提交投标文件之前的阶段。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not genuine, or made to appear real in order to deceive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 并非真实或正品的，或为了欺骗而伪装成真实事物的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex ġenwin jew li jkun sar biex jidher veru u jqarraq bin-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 假的、伪造的或冒充真实事物的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex veru jew ġenwin, jew li jippretendi li huwa xi ħaġa li fil-fatt mhuwiex.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is fake or bogus is not genuine, although it may be presented as real.

collocations.zh: 虚假个人资料；冒牌账号

formal.mt: Wara l-verifika, l-uffiċjal ikkonferma li d-dokument kien fażull.
formal.en: After checking it, the official confirmed that the document was fake.
formal.zh: 核验后，工作人员确认该文件是伪造的。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-profil fażull; qed juża r-ritratt tiegħi. Karl: Irrapportah lill-pjattaforma u avża lil sħabek.
colloquial.en: Nina: This profile is fake; it's using my photo. Karl: Report it to the platform and let your friends know.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个账号是冒牌的，正在用我的照片。Karl：向平台举报，再告诉你的朋友们。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-profil fażull; qed juża r-ritratt tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-profil fażull; qed juża r-ritratt tiegħi.
messages.zh: 这个账号是冒牌的，正在用我的照片。
messages.en: This profile is fake; it's using my photo.

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrapportah lill-pjattaforma u avża lil sħabek.
messages.mt_standard: Irrapportah lill-pjattaforma u avża lil sħabek.
messages.zh: 向平台举报，再告诉你的朋友们。
messages.en: Report it to the platform and let your friends know.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一份看似正式却被盖上假字的文件，搭配 dokument fażull 记忆；核心是外表像真的，实际并不真实。

gloss_zh: 废墟；遗迹；残余物；剩余物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Parts left after something has been destroyed, used, or otherwise ceased to be complete.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物遭到破坏、被使用或不再完整之后留下的部分，可指建筑遗迹，也可指其他残余物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-partijiet li jibqgħu wara li xi ħaġa tkun inqerdet, intużat jew ma tkunx għadha sħiħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑物遭到毁坏或年久失修后留下的废墟、残迹或遗址。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-partijiet li għadhom jeżistu minn bini li nqered jew ġġarraf.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The ruins of a building are the parts that remain after it has been destroyed or has fallen into decay.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某物被使用、损坏、消耗或毁坏后留下的部分；残余物或遗留物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dak li jibqa' minn xi ħaġa wara li tkun intużat, ġarrbet ħsara, ġiet ikkunsmata jew inqerdet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The remains of something are the parts left after the rest has been used, damaged, consumed, or destroyed.

collocations.en: the ruins of an ancient temple

formal.mt: L-arkeologi studjaw il-fdalijiet tat-tempju biex jifhmu kif kien mibni.
formal.en: The archaeologists studied the ruins of the temple to understand how it had been built.
formal.zh: 考古学家研究了神庙的遗迹，以了解它当初是如何建造的。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'nagħmel bil-fdalijiet tal-ikel? David: Poġġihom f'kontenitur fil-friġġ; nistgħu nikluhom għada.
colloquial.en: Lara: What should I do with the leftover food? David: Put it in a container in the fridge; we can eat it tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：剩下的食物怎么处理？戴维：装进容器放到冰箱里，我们明天可以吃。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 剩下的食物怎么处理？
messages.en: What should I do with the leftover food?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġihom f'kontenitur fil-friġġ; nistgħu nikluhom għada.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġihom f'kontenitur fil-friġġ; nistgħu nikluhom għada.
messages.zh: 装进容器放到冰箱里，我们明天可以吃。
messages.en: Put it in a container in the fridge; we can eat it tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“留下的部分”串联两幅画面：倒塌建筑留下遗迹，一顿饭后留下剩菜；fdalijiet 的具体译法由语境决定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Opinions and comments about someone's work or performance that help them understand what went well and what could improve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针对某人的工作、表现或成果提出的意见和评价，帮助其了解优点与需要改进之处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Opinjonijiet u kummenti dwar ix-xogħol jew il-prestazzjoni ta' xi ħadd li jgħinuh jifhem x'mar tajjeb u x'jista' jtejjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某项工作、表现或成果给出的意见与评论。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fehmiet u l-kummenti li jingħataw dwar xogħol, prestazzjoni jew riżultat biex jgħinu fl-evalwazzjoni u fit-titjib.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Feedback consists of opinions and comments that help someone evaluate and improve their work or performance.

collocations.en: to ask for feedback on your work
collocations.zh: 请求对自己的工作提出反馈

formal.mt: Wara l-preżentazzjoni, l-għalliema tat feedback kostruttiv lill-istudenti dwar il-kontenut u l-organizzazzjoni tax-xogħol tagħhom.
formal.en: After the presentation, the teacher gave the students constructive feedback on the content and organisation of their work.
formal.zh: 展示结束后，老师就学生作品的内容和组织方式给出了建设性的反馈。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tagħtini ftit feedback dwar il-preżentazzjoni tiegħi? Mark: Iva, kienet ċara, imma tista' tqassar l-introduzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you give me some feedback on my presentation? Mark: Yes, it was clear, but you could shorten the introduction.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你能对我的展示提点意见吗？Mark：可以，讲得很清楚，不过开头可以缩短一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tagħtini ftit feedback dwar il-preżentazzjoni tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tagħtini ftit feedback dwar il-preżentazzjoni tiegħi?
messages.zh: 你能对我的展示提点意见吗？
messages.en: Can you give me some feedback on my presentation?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kienet ċara, imma tista' tqassar l-introduzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kienet ċara, imma tista' tqassar l-introduzzjoni.
messages.zh: 可以，讲得很清楚，不过开头可以缩短一点。
messages.en: Yes, it was clear, but you could shorten the introduction.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把展示后收到的两栏便签想成 feedback：一栏写优点，一栏写改进意见，帮助记住它是“反馈”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To understand someone's words, intentions, or a situation incorrectly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 错误地理解某人的话语、意图或某种情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Interpreta kliem, intenzjonijiet jew sitwazzjoni b'mod li ma jaqbilx mat-tifsira jew mal-fatti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 误解某人的话语或意图，或对情况产生错误理解。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħa tifsira ħażina ta' dak li ntqal jew ta' dak li ġara, u għalhekk ma fehemx il-messaġġ jew is-sitwazzjoni kif suppost.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone misunderstands something, they interpret its meaning or the situation incorrectly.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipant fehem ħażin l-istruzzjonijiet u bagħat id-dokument fl-indirizz elettroniku żbaljat.
formal.en: The participant misunderstood the instructions and sent the document to the wrong email address.
formal.zh: 参与者误解了操作说明，把文件发送到了错误的电子邮箱地址。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu ġie fid-disgħa? Mark: Fehem ħażin il-messaġġ; il-laqgħa tibda fl-għaxra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu arrive at nine? Mark: He misunderstood the message; the meeting starts at ten.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 怎么九点就来了？Mark：他理解错了消息，会议十点才开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: Pawlu 怎么九点就来了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu arrive at nine?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fehem ħażin il-messaġġ; il-laqgħa tibda fl-għaxra.
messages.mt_standard: Fehem ħażin il-messaġġ; il-laqgħa tibda fl-għaxra.
messages.zh: 他理解错了消息，会议十点才开始。
messages.en: He misunderstood the message; the meeting starts at ten.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把十点的通知看成九点：fehem ħażin 对应“理解错了”。整组连记，重点记住理解出现偏差。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A first-person expression saying that the speaker sprained their foot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 第一人称表达，表示说话者扭伤了自己的脚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni fl-ewwel persuna li biha l-kelliem jgħid li weġġa' siequ minħabba tidwira qawwija jew moviment ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我因扭转或动作不当而扭伤了脚。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kelliem jgħid li weġġa' siequ meta din iddawret jew tgħawġet b'mod ħażin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you say you sprained your foot, you mean you injured it by twisting it awkwardly.

collocations.mt: fekkikt saqajja waqt li kont niġri
collocations.en: I sprained my foot while running
I sprained my foot on the stairs

formal.mt: Nixtieq ninfurmak li lbieraħ fekkikt saqajja waqt li kont niġri u għalhekk mhux se nipparteċipa fl-attività sportiva ta' għada.
formal.en: I would like to inform you that I sprained my foot while running yesterday and will therefore not participate in tomorrow's sporting activity.
formal.zh: 特此告知，我昨天跑步时扭伤了脚，因此将不参加明天的体育活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed izzappap? Mark: Fekkikt saqajja fuq it-taraġ dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you limping? Mark: I sprained my foot on the stairs this morning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么一瘸一拐的？Mark：我今天早上在楼梯上扭伤了脚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么一瘸一拐的？
messages.en: Why are you limping?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今天早上在楼梯上扭伤了脚。
messages.en: I sprained my foot on the stairs this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己下楼踩歪后说“我扭伤了脚”，把 fekkikt saqajja 当作完整的第一人称经历句来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To think carefully and deeply about an experience, decision, or idea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对经历、决定或想法进行认真而深入的思考。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaseb fil-fond dwar esperjenza, deċiżjoni jew idea u qies id-dettalji tagħha bir-reqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仔细思考或反思某件事，以加深理解。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qies xi ħaġa bir-reqqa u ħaseb dwar it-tifsira tagħha jew dwar dak li seta' jitgħallem minnha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone reflects on something, they think carefully about it to understand it more deeply.

collocations.zh: 仔细思量了自己的决定

formal.mt: Qabel ma kiteb ir-rapport finali, l-istudent fela' l-esperjenza tiegħu u identifika dak li kien tgħallem minnha.
formal.en: Before writing the final report, the student reflected on his experience and identified what he had learned from it.
formal.zh: 撰写最终报告之前，这名学生反思了自己的经历，并明确了从中学到的东西。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark biddel fehmtu? Pawlu: Fela' d-deċiżjoni tiegħu u induna li kellu bżonn aktar ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark change his mind? Pawlu: He reflected on his decision and realised that he needed more time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 为什么改主意了？Pawlu：他仔细想了想自己的决定，意识到自己需要更多时间。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么改主意了？
messages.en: Why did Mark change his mind?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fela' d-deċiżjoni tiegħu u induna li kellu bżonn aktar ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Fela' d-deċiżjoni tiegħu u induna li kellu bżonn aktar ħin.
messages.zh: 他仔细想了想自己的决定，意识到自己需要更多时间。
messages.en: He reflected on his decision and realised that he needed more time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“停下来，把经历或决定仔细想一遍”的画面记 fela'；本条的 reflect 表示深思或反思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of deep happiness and contentment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 深切快乐、内心满足的幸福状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' ferħ kbir u kuntentizza profonda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 至福；极其快乐而满足的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat ta' ferħ qawwi u sodisfazzjon profond li fih persuna tħossha kuntenta ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Bliss is a feeling of complete happiness and deep contentment.

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tagħha, l-awtriċi ddeskriviet il-feliċità li ħasset meta reġgħet ingħaqdet mal-familja tagħha.
formal.en: In her letter, the writer described the bliss she felt when she was reunited with her family.
formal.zh: 作者在信中描述了与家人重聚时感受到的深切幸福。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ħassejtek meta rajt lil oħtok wara tant żmien? Lara: Ħassejt feliċità kbira. Ma ridtx nitlaq minn ħdejha!
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you feel when you saw your sister after so long? Lara: I felt such happiness. I didn't want to leave her side!
colloquial.zh: Maja：隔了这么久再见到姐姐，你是什么感觉？Lara：我觉得幸福极了，真不想离开她身边！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħassejtek meta rajt lil oħtok wara tant żmien?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħassejtek meta rajt lil oħtok wara tant żmien?
messages.zh: 隔了这么久再见到姐姐，你是什么感觉？
messages.en: How did you feel when you saw your sister after so long?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt feliċità kbira. Ma ridtx nitlaq minn ħdejha!
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt feliċità kbira. Ma ridtx nitlaq minn ħdejha!
messages.zh: 我觉得幸福极了，真不想离开她身边！
messages.en: I felt such happiness. I didn't want to leave her side!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 feliċità 配上久别重逢时拥抱的画面，记成内心充满幸福与满足；反复说 feliċità kbira，联结“极大的幸福”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small growth or mark on the skin, referring to a wart or a mole according to context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 皮肤上的小赘生物或小斑记，依上下文可指疣或痣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkabbir żgħir jew marka fuq il-ġilda; skont il-kuntest, tista' tkun ħotba b'wiċċ aħrax jew marka ġeneralment skura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疣；皮肤上由病毒引起的小赘生物，表面常较粗糙。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tkabbir żgħir fuq il-ġilda, spiss b'wiċċ aħrax, ikkawżat minn virus.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A wart is a small growth on the skin, often with a rough surface, caused by a virus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 痣；皮肤上通常颜色较深的小斑点或小隆起。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Marka żgħira fuq il-ġilda, ġeneralment skura, li tista' tkun ċatta jew kemxejn imqabbża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mole is a small, usually dark mark on the skin that may be flat or slightly raised.

collocations.en: a wart with a rough surface
a dark mole on the cheek

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni, l-għalliema spjegat li l-kelma felula tista' tirreferi għal tkabbir żgħir b'wiċċ aħrax jew għal marka skura fuq il-ġilda, skont il-kuntest.
formal.en: During the lesson, the teacher explained that felula can refer to a small rough growth or a dark mark on the skin, depending on the context.
formal.zh: 课堂上，老师解释说，felula 依上下文可以指皮肤上表面粗糙的小赘生物，也可以指深色的痣。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif se nagħraf lil kuġintek? Lara: Għandha xagħar qasir u felula żgħira skura fuq ħaddejha. Mark: Tajjeb, issa naf lil min infittex.
colloquial.en: Mark: How will I recognize your cousin? Lara: She has short hair and a small dark mole on her cheek. Mark: Great, now I know who to look for.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我怎么认出你表姐？Lara：她留着短发，脸颊上有一颗小小的深色痣。Mark：好，现在我知道该找谁了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我怎么认出你表姐？
messages.en: How will I recognize your cousin?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandha xagħar qasir u felula żgħira skura fuq ħaddejha.
messages.mt_standard: Għandha xagħar qasir u felula żgħira skura fuq ħaddejha.
messages.zh: 她留着短发，脸颊上有一颗小小的深色痣。
messages.en: She has short hair and a small dark mole on her cheek.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, issa naf lil min infittex.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, issa naf lil min infittex.
messages.zh: 好，现在我知道该找谁了。
messages.en: Great, now I know who to look for.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 felula 画两张学习卡：手指上的粗糙小凸起对应“疣”，脸颊上的深色小点对应“痣”；依上下文选择词义，勿把两者当作同一种皮肤表现。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plant with divided leaves that reproduces by spores rather than seeds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种通常具有分裂叶片、通过孢子而非种子繁殖的植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta li ġeneralment għandha weraq maqsum f'ħafna partijiet u tirriproduċi permezz ta' spori minflok żrieragħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蕨；一种不产生花和种子、通过孢子繁殖的植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta mingħajr fjuri jew żrieragħ, li għandha weraq spiss maqsum f'partijiet iżgħar u tirriproduċi permezz ta' spori.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fern is a plant with leafy fronds that produces spores instead of flowers and seeds.

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-weraq tal-felċi u tgħallmu li din il-pjanta tirriproduċi permezz ta' spori.
formal.en: The students examined the fern's leaves and learned that this plant reproduces by spores.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了蕨叶，并了解到这种植物通过孢子繁殖。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Lara: Din felċi. Ara kemm hu sabiħ il-weraq tagħha!
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this plant called? Lara: It's a fern. Look how beautiful its leaves are!
colloquial.zh: Maja：这种植物叫什么？Lara：这是蕨类植物。你看它的叶子多漂亮！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这种植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant called?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din felċi. Ara kemm hu sabiħ il-weraq tagħha!
messages.mt_standard: Din felċi. Ara kemm hu sabiħ il-weraq tagħha!
messages.zh: 这是蕨类植物。你看它的叶子多漂亮！
messages.en: It's a fern. Look how beautiful its leaves are!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 felċi 与一盆展开羽状绿叶的蕨联系起来，再用 weraq tal-felċi（蕨叶）巩固记忆；这是图像联想，不是词源分析。

gloss_zh: 杀害女性；因女性身份而实施的杀害

teaching_sense.en_definition: The murder of a woman because she is a woman.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因受害者的女性身份而对其实施的谋杀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qtil intenzjonat ta' mara minħabba li hija mara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杀害女性，尤指因受害者是女性而实施的谋杀。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qtil intenzjonat ta' mara minħabba li hija mara, marbut ma' vjolenza jew mibegħda kontra n-nisa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Femicide is the murder of a woman because she is a woman.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对一名女性的谋杀；此释义本身未限定谋杀动机。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qtil intenzjonat ta' mara, mingħajr ma din id-definizzjoni tispeċifika l-motiv tal-qtil.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This sense refers to the deliberate murder of a woman without specifying the killer's motive.

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddiskuti l-prevenzjoni tal-femiċidju u jenfasizza l-importanza li jittieħdu bis-serjetà t-theddid u l-vjolenza kontra n-nisa.
formal.en: The article discusses the prevention of femicide and emphasizes the importance of taking threats and violence against women seriously.
formal.zh: 文章讨论了如何预防杀害女性的行为，并强调必须认真对待针对女性的威胁和暴力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser femiċidju f'dan l-artiklu? Lara: Hawnhekk ifisser il-qtil ta' mara minħabba li hija mara. Maja: Issa nifhem għaliex l-artiklu jitkellem dwar il-vjolenza kontra n-nisa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does femiċidju mean in this article? Lara: Here it means the murder of a woman because she is a woman. Maja: Now I understand why the article talks about violence against women.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这篇文章里的 femiċidju 是什么意思？Lara：这里指因受害者是女性而实施的谋杀。Maja：现在我明白文章为什么会讨论针对女性的暴力了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 femiċidju 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does femiċidju mean in this article?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk ifisser il-qtil ta' mara minħabba li hija mara.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk ifisser il-qtil ta' mara minħabba li hija mara.
messages.zh: 这里指因受害者是女性而实施的谋杀。
messages.en: Here it means the murder of a woman because she is a woman.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa nifhem għaliex l-artiklu jitkellem dwar il-vjolenza kontra n-nisa.
messages.mt_standard: Issa nifhem għaliex l-artiklu jitkellem dwar il-vjolenza kontra n-nisa.
messages.zh: 现在我明白文章为什么会讨论针对女性的暴力了。
messages.en: Now I understand why the article talks about violence against women.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆 femiċidju 时并列两张概念卡：“女性遭谋杀”与“因女性身份遭谋杀”；阅读时留意上下文是否明确性别动机，保持两个释义的范围区别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small rodent with a rounded body, often kept as a pet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种身体圆实的小型啮齿动物，常被作为宠物饲养，称为豚鼠或天竺鼠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Gerriem żgħir b'ġisem mimli li spiss jinżamm bħala annimal domestiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 豚鼠，又称天竺鼠，一种常作为宠物饲养的小型啮齿动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Gerriem żgħir b'ġisem mimli u saqajn qosra li ħafna nies iżommu bħala annimal domestiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A guinea pig is a small rodent with a rounded body that people often keep as a pet.

collocations.en: to look after a guinea pig

formal.mt: Il-fenek tal-Indi għandu bżonn ilma nadif u post xieraq fejn jgħix.
formal.en: A guinea pig needs clean water and a suitable place to live.
formal.zh: 豚鼠需要干净的水和适宜的生活环境。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tara l-fenek tal-Indi tiegħi? Leo: Iva! X'jismu? Maja: Jismu Bubu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to see my guinea pig? Leo: Yes! What's his name? Maja: His name is Bubu.
colloquial.zh: Maja：想看看我的豚鼠吗？Leo：想！它叫什么名字？Maja：它叫 Bubu。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 想看看我的豚鼠吗？
messages.en: Do you want to see my guinea pig?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.zh: 想！它叫什么名字？
messages.en: Yes! What's his name?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 它叫 Bubu。
messages.en: His name is Bubu.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fenek tal-Indi 整组配上一张豚鼠图片记忆；看到完整词组就想到圆滚滚的宠物豚鼠，避免只凭其中一个词猜动物。

gloss_zh: 腓尼基人；与腓尼基文明有关者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person belonging to Phoenician civilisation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于腓尼基文明的人，即腓尼基人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tappartjeni għaċ-ċiviltà Feniċja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腓尼基人，即属于腓尼基文明的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tappartjeni għall-poplu u ċ-ċiviltà tal-Feniċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A Phoenician is a person who belongs to the people of Phoenician civilisation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与腓尼基文明有关的人或事物，侧重其与该文明的关联。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew ħaġa li għandha rabta maċ-ċiviltà Feniċja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This sense identifies someone or something connected with Phoenician civilisation.

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi l-ħajja ta' Feniċu u r-rabta tiegħu maċ-ċiviltà Feniċja.
formal.en: The text describes the life of a Phoenician and his connection with Phoenician civilisation.
formal.zh: 这篇文章描述了一位腓尼基人的生活，以及他与腓尼基文明的联系。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser Feniċu f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Persuna li tappartjeni għaċ-ċiviltà Feniċja. Sara: Mela hawn qed nitkellmu dwar persuna.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does Feniċu mean in this sentence? Mark: A person belonging to Phoenician civilisation. Sara: So we're talking about a person here.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个句子里的 Feniċu 是什么意思？Mark：属于腓尼基文明的人。Sara：所以这里说的是一个人。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个句子里的 Feniċu 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does Feniċu mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 属于腓尼基文明的人。
messages.en: A person belonging to Phoenician civilisation.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela hawn qed nitkellmu dwar persuna.
messages.mt_standard: Mela hawn qed nitkellmu dwar persuna.
messages.zh: 所以这里说的是一个人。
messages.en: So we're talking about a person here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Feniċu 与英文 Phoenician、中文“腓尼基人”做成三语卡片；先记人物义，再用“与腓尼基文明有关”提示关联义，并根据上下文区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rabbit meat prepared or intended for eating.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供食用或烹调的兔肉，也可指作为菜肴的兔子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Laħam tal-fenek maħsub biex jittiekel, jew platt magħmul minn dan il-laħam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 兔肉，指供食用的兔子或以兔肉制成的食物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Laħam tal-fenek li jintuża bħala ikel, kemm qabel jissajjar kif ukoll bħala parti minn platt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Rabbit, in this sense, is the meat of the animal when it is used as food.

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta tispjega kif jitħejja stuffat tal-fennek bil-ħaxix.
formal.en: The recipe explains how to prepare rabbit stew with vegetables.
formal.zh: 这份食谱说明如何制作蔬菜炖兔肉。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'se nieklu llejla? Rita: Se nsajjar il-fennek. Mark: Se tagħmlu stuffat? Rita: Iva, bil-ħaxix.
colloquial.en: Mark: What are we having tonight? Rita: I'm going to cook rabbit. Mark: Are you going to make it into a stew? Rita: Yes, with vegetables.
colloquial.zh: Mark：今晚吃什么？Rita：我打算做兔肉。Mark：要炖着吃吗？Rita：对，和蔬菜一起炖。

messages.speaker: Mark (丈夫)
messages.zh: 今晚吃什么？
messages.en: What are we having tonight?

messages.speaker: Rita (妻子)
messages.zh: 我打算做兔肉。
messages.en: I'm going to cook rabbit.

messages.speaker: Mark (丈夫)
messages.zh: 要炖着吃吗？
messages.en: Are you going to make it into a stew?

messages.speaker: Rita (妻子)
messages.zh: 对，和蔬菜一起炖。
messages.en: Yes, with vegetables.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 fennek 配上炖兔肉的餐盘图，把本条固定记成食物义；用“菜单上点兔肉”的场景帮助回忆，并留意本词条的双写 n。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An event, fact, or process that can be observed or studied.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可以观察、研究或寻求解释的事件、事实或过程，即现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġrajja, fatt jew proċess li jista' jiġi osservat, studjat jew spjegat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 现象，指能够被观察或研究的事件、事实或过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġrajja, fatt jew proċess li nistgħu nosservaw u nistudjaw biex nifhmu kif jew għaliex iseħħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A phenomenon is an event, fact, or process that can be observed and studied.

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza dan il-fenomenu soċjali u jipprova jispjega għaliex iseħħ.
formal.en: The study analyses this social phenomenon and attempts to explain why it occurs.
formal.zh: 这项研究分析了这一社会现象，并试图解释其发生的原因。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex tidher qawsalla wara x-xita? Nina: Hija fenomenu naturali marbut mad-dawl u l-qtar tal-ilma. Lara: Mela nistgħu nispjegaw kif tifforma?
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does a rainbow appear after rain? Nina: It's a natural phenomenon connected with light and water droplets. Lara: So we can explain how it forms?
colloquial.zh: Lara：为什么雨后会出现彩虹？Nina：这是一种与光和水滴有关的自然现象。Lara：所以我们能解释它是怎么形成的？

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 为什么雨后会出现彩虹？
messages.en: Why does a rainbow appear after rain?

messages.speaker: Nina (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija fenomenu naturali marbut mad-dawl u l-qtar tal-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Hija fenomenu naturali marbut mad-dawl u l-qtar tal-ilma.
messages.zh: 这是一种与光和水滴有关的自然现象。
messages.en: It's a natural phenomenon connected with light and water droplets.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 所以我们能解释它是怎么形成的？
messages.en: So we can explain how it forms?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fenomenu 放进“观察现象、解释现象”的学习链：先想象看到彩虹，再说 fenomenu naturali，让词形与可观察的现象直接关联。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express pleasure at another person's achievement or good fortune.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某人的成就或喜事而向其表达祝贺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jesprimi l-ferħ tiegħu lil xi ħadd minħabba suċċess jew aħbar tajba li tkun tikkonċernah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因他人的成功、成就或喜事而向其道贺。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jgħid kliem ta' awgurju lil xi ħadd biex juri li huwa ferħan bis-suċċess jew bil-ġid li jkun ġralu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you congratulate someone, you express your pleasure at their success or good fortune.

collocations.en: congratulated the team on the victory

formal.mt: Wara t-tħabbir tar-riżultati, id-direttur feraħ lil kull student li għadda mill-eżami.
formal.en: After the results were announced, the director congratulated every student who passed the examination.
formal.zh: 成绩公布后，主任向每位通过考试的学生表示祝贺。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark feraħ lil Sara? Lara: Iva, feraħlha għax sabet xogħol ġdid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark congratulate Sara? Lara: Yes, he congratulated her because she found a new job.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克向萨拉道贺了吗？拉拉：道贺了，因为她找到了新工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克向萨拉道贺了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark congratulate Sara?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, feraħlha għax sabet xogħol ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, feraħlha għax sabet xogħol ġdid.
messages.zh: 道贺了，因为她找到了新工作。
messages.en: Yes, he congratulated her because she found a new job.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语放进“向某人道贺”的场景记忆：先说 feraħ，再用 lil 引出接受祝贺的人。

gloss_zh: Ferhan（动词义未明确）；快乐（名词标注，具体所指未明确）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry labelled as a verb, with the gloss 'Ferhan', whose specific action meaning is not established.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 标注为动词、释义写作“Ferhan”的词条；该释义未明确表示哪一种动作，学习时应暂时保留原形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma mmarkata bħala verb bil-glossa 'Ferhan', iżda mingħajr tifsira ċara ta' xi azzjoni; għalhekk għandha tinżamm fil-forma mogħtija sakemm it-tifsira tiġi ċċarata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 释义为“Ferhan”的动词义项；具体动作含义未明确，不能据此确定中文动词译法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan is-sens huwa mmarkat bħala verb u għandu l-glossa 'Ferhan', iżda din ma tispeċifikax azzjoni li tista' tingħata definizzjoni preċiża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This verb entry carries the gloss 'Ferhan', which does not establish a specific action meaning.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 标注为名词、释义为“Happy”的义项，提示快乐之意，但未明确其具体名词所指。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan is-sens huwa mmarkat bħala nom u għandu l-glossa Ingliża 'Happy', li tindika l-ferħ iżda ma tiċċarax x'inhu eżattament imsemmi min-nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This noun entry is associated with happiness, although its precise noun referent remains unspecified.

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, l-istudent għandu jżomm il-forma 'Ferhan' u jindika li t-tifsira verbali tagħha għadha mhix ċara.
formal.en: In the exercise, the student should retain the form 'Ferhan' and indicate that its verbal meaning is still unclear.
formal.zh: 在练习中，学生应保留“Ferhan”这一形式，并注明其动词含义尚不明确。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nittraduċi 'Ferhan' hawn? Mark: It-tifsira mhix ċara; żomm il-kelma kif inhi għalissa.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I translate 'Ferhan' here? Mark: The meaning is unclear; keep the word as it is for now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的“Ferhan”怎么翻译？马克：意思还不明确，先保留原词。

messages.en: How do I translate 'Ferhan' here?
