messages.mt_spoken: It-tifsira mhix ċara; żomm il-kelma kif inhi għalissa.
messages.mt_standard: It-tifsira mhix ċara; żomm il-kelma kif inhi għalissa.
messages.zh: 意思还不明确，先保留原词。
messages.en: The meaning is unclear; keep the word as it is for now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 Ferhan 做两张分开的词性卡：动词卡注明义未明，名词卡注明 Happy；不要自行改拼写或合并词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A penis that is small in size.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指体积或尺寸较小的阴茎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pene li huwa żgħir fid-daqs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小阴茎；尺寸较小的男性生殖器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-organu ġenitali maskili meta jkun żgħir fid-daqs.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ferillu is a penis described as being small in size.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju tal-vokabularju, 'ferillu' jfisser pene żgħir.
formal.en: In this vocabulary exercise, 'ferillu' means a small penis.
formal.zh: 在这道词汇练习中，“ferillu”指小阴茎。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'ferillu'? Mark: Tfisser pene żgħir.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ferillu' mean? Mark: It means a small penis.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“ferillu”是什么意思？马克：意思是小阴茎。

messages.speaker: Maja (成年学习者)
messages.zh: “ferillu”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ferillu' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (语言教师)
messages.zh: 意思是小阴茎。
messages.en: It means a small penis.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“身体部位＋尺寸小”两格记忆卡记住 ferillu：身体部位是阴茎，尺寸特征是小；不据拼写推断词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of unrest in which people are unsettled or dissatisfied.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们情绪不安或不满而形成的动荡、骚动状态；此义项的词性未明确。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' taqlib jew nuqqas ta' kwiet fost in-nies, li jistgħu jkunu mħassba jew mhux sodisfatti; il-kategorija grammatikali mhix speċifikata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动荡或骚动；群体因不满、不安而处于不平静的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qagħda fejn ma jkunx hemm kwiet fost in-nies minħabba tħassib, skuntentizza jew tensjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When there is ferment, people are unsettled or dissatisfied, creating a state of unrest.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi perjodu ta' ferment soċjali, b'laqgħat pubbliċi u protesti frekwenti.
formal.en: The report describes a period of social unrest, with frequent public meetings and protests.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一段社会动荡时期，其间公众集会和抗议频繁发生。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex in-nies qed jipprotestaw? Mark: Hemm ferment fil-belt għax ħafna nies mhumiex kuntenti bid-deċiżjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are people protesting? Mark: There is unrest in the city because many people are unhappy with the decision.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：人们为什么在抗议？马克：城里出现了骚动，因为许多人对这项决定不满。

messages.speaker: Maja (居民)
messages.zh: 人们为什么在抗议？
messages.en: Why are people protesting?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ferment fil-belt għax ħafna nies mhumiex kuntenti bid-deċiżjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ferment fil-belt għax ħafna nies mhumiex kuntenti bid-deċiżjoni.
messages.zh: 城里出现了骚动，因为许多人对这项决定不满。
messages.en: There is unrest in the city because many people are unhappy with the decision.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ferment 和“人群不安、社会不平静”的画面绑定，看到 ferment soċjali 就联想“社会动荡”；词性标记 x 暂保留。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very aggressive or violent, especially in a way that causes fear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人或动物具有强烈攻击性，表现得凶猛、暴烈或令人害怕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri aggressività jew vjolenza qawwija u jqanqal il-biża'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凶猛的；表现出强烈攻击性、使人害怕的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jġib ruħu b'aggressività qawwija u jista' jbeżża' lil min jersaq lejh.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An animal or person that is fierce behaves aggressively and can make others feel afraid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凶残的；极其凶猛且具有强烈暴力倾向的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri vjolenza jew ħruxija kbira ħafna, speċjalment waqt attakk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An animal or person that is ferocious shows extreme aggression or violence, especially when attacking.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi attakk feroċi minn kelb li ħarab minn ġnien privat.
formal.en: The report describes a ferocious attack by a dog that escaped from a private garden.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一只从私人花园逃出的狗发动的凶猛攻击。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak il-kelb jidher feroċi. Mark: Iva, ejja nibqgħu 'l bogħod minnu.
colloquial.en: Maja: That dog looks fierce. Mark: Yes, let's keep our distance from it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那只狗看起来很凶。马克：是啊，我们离它远一点吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那只狗看起来很凶。
messages.en: That dog looks fierce.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我们离它远一点吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's keep our distance from it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 feroċi 和“龇牙扑来的凶猛动物”这一画面联系起来，再用 kelb feroċi 反复练习；这是情境记忆法，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 皮肤上的深抓痕；深划伤

teaching_sense.en_definition: A deep scratch in the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 皮肤被抓挠或刮划后留下的较深伤痕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grif fond fil-ġilda li jitħalla minn dwiefer jew minn xi ħaġa li tobrox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 皮肤上的深抓痕或深划伤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Grif li jidħol fil-fond fil-ġilda u jħalli marka jew ferita.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ferret is a deep scratch that breaks or damages the skin.

collocations.en: a deep scratch on the arm

formal.mt: Fir-rapport ġie nnutat ferret fond fuq id-driegħ tax-xellug.
formal.en: A deep scratch on the left arm was noted in the report.
formal.zh: 报告记录了左臂上的一道深抓痕。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif ġibt dak il-ferret fuq id-driegħ? Pawlu: Il-qattus baraxni meta ppruvajt inġorru.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did you get that deep scratch on your arm? Pawlu: The cat scratched me when I tried to pick it up.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你手臂上那道深抓痕是怎么弄的？保罗：我想抱起那只猫时，被它抓了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ġibt dak il-ferret fuq id-driegħ?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ġibt dak il-ferret fuq id-driegħ?
messages.zh: 你手臂上那道深抓痕是怎么弄的？
messages.en: How did you get that deep scratch on your arm?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想抱起那只猫时，被它抓了。
messages.en: The cat scratched me when I tried to pick it up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ferret 记成“皮肤上留下的一道深抓痕”，配合 ferret fuq id-driegħ 想象手臂上的伤痕，牢牢记住这里的名词义。

gloss_zh: 肥沃的；有生育或繁殖能力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to support abundant plant growth or capable of producing offspring.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容土地肥沃、适宜植物生长，或形容人及其他生物具有生育或繁殖能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jagħti ħajja ġdida permezz tar-riproduzzjoni, jew, meta jingħad dwar ħamrija, li jgħin lill-pjanti jikbru tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肥沃、能使植物茂盛生长的；具有生育或繁殖能力的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila li jirriproduċi, jew li fih il-pjanti jistgħu jikbru tajjeb u jagħtu ħsad abbundanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Land that is fertile supports healthy plant growth, while a fertile organism is capable of reproduction.

formal.mt: Il-ħamrija fertili ta' din iż-żona tippermetti lill-bdiewa jkabbru diversi tipi ta' ħaxix.
formal.en: The fertile soil in this area allows farmers to grow several kinds of vegetables.
formal.zh: 这一地区肥沃的土壤使农民能够种植多种蔬菜。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex it-tadam tiegħek jikber daqshekk tajjeb? Ġużeppi: Hawnhekk il-ħamrija fertili, u nsaqqih regolarment.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do your tomatoes grow so well? Ġużeppi: The soil here is fertile, and I water them regularly.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你的番茄为什么长得这么好？朱塞佩：这里的土壤肥沃，而且我定期浇水。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex it-tadam tiegħek jikber daqshekk tajjeb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex it-tadam tiegħek jikber daqshekk tajjeb?
messages.zh: 你的番茄为什么长得这么好？
messages.en: Why do your tomatoes grow so well?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk il-ħamrija fertili, u nsaqqih regolarment.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk il-ħamrija fertili, u nsaqqih regolarment.
messages.zh: 这里的土壤肥沃，而且我定期浇水。
messages.en: The soil here is fertile, and I water them regularly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fertili 联想到“能够孕育生长”：土地能长出丰盛作物，生物能繁育后代；用 ħamrija fertili 作为最先掌握的搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who has been wounded or injured.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体受到伤害的人；本词条按名词学习，表示伤者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġarrbet ferita jew ħsara f'ġisimha, pereżempju f'inċident jew waqt attakk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伤者；身体受了伤的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun ġarrbet ferita jew korriment f'ġisimha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ferut is a person who has suffered a wound or physical injury.

formal.mt: Il-ferut ittieħed l-isptar b'ambulanza wara li ngħata l-ewwel għajnuna fuq il-post.
formal.en: The injured person was taken to hospital by ambulance after receiving first aid at the scene.
formal.zh: 伤者在现场接受急救后，由救护车送往医院。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu l-ferut? David: Qiegħed mal-paramediċi ħdejn l-ambulanza.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is the injured person? David: He is with the paramedics beside the ambulance.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：伤者在哪里？戴维：他在救护车旁边，急救人员正陪着他。

messages.speaker: Sara (现场志愿者)
messages.zh: 伤者在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the injured person?

messages.speaker: David (现场志愿者)
messages.zh: 他在救护车旁边，急救人员正陪着他。
messages.en: He is with the paramedics beside the ambulance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“救护车接走一名伤者”的画面记 ferut；看到 il-ferut 就想到“那名伤者”，帮助牢牢记住本词条表示人的名词用法。

gloss_zh: 圣诞佳节；圣诞节庆时光

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Christmas celebration and the festive time associated with it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 庆祝圣诞节的佳节及其相关的节庆时光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċ-ċelebrazzjoni tal-Milied u ż-żmien ta' ferħ u laqgħat marbut magħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣诞佳节，指圣诞节及其周边的节庆时光。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iż-żmien tal-Milied, meta n-nies jiċċelebraw u jiltaqgħu mal-familja u mal-ħbieb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Yuletide is the festive period around Christmas, when people celebrate and spend time together.

collocations.en: the preparations for the Christmas celebration

formal.mt: Il-komunità qed tħejji programm ta' attivitajiet għall-festa tal-Milied.
formal.en: The community is preparing a programme of activities for the Christmas festive period.
formal.zh: 社区正在为圣诞佳节筹备一系列活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se tiċċelebraw il-festa tal-Milied din is-sena? Luqa: Għand in-nanna, mal-familja kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you celebrating Christmas this year? Luqa: At Grandma's, with the whole family.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你们今年在哪里过圣诞节？Luqa：在奶奶家，和全家人一起过。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se tiċċelebraw il-festa tal-Milied din is-sena?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se tiċċelebraw il-festa tal-Milied din is-sena?
messages.zh: 你们今年在哪里过圣诞节？
messages.en: Where are you celebrating Christmas this year?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 在奶奶家，和全家人一起过。
messages.en: At Grandma's, with the whole family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个短语和圣诞灯饰、全家团聚的画面一起记，整组理解为“圣诞佳节”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A social gathering where people enjoy themselves, often with food, drink, or music.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们相聚娱乐的社交活动，通常有食物、饮料或音乐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Laqgħa soċjali fejn in-nies jieħdu gost flimkien, spiss bl-ikel, bix-xorb jew bil-mużika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为庆祝或娱乐而举行的聚会或派对。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Laqgħa ta' nies organizzata biex jiċċelebraw xi okkażjoni jew biex jieħdu gost flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A party is a social occasion where people gather to celebrate or enjoy themselves.

formal.mt: L-iskola organizzat festin għall-istudenti biex tiċċelebra t-tmiem tas-sena skolastika.
formal.en: The school organised a party for the students to celebrate the end of the school year.
formal.zh: 学校为学生举办了一场聚会，庆祝学年结束。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se tiġi għall-festin tiegħi nhar is-Sibt? Mark: Iva! X'ħin jibda?
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you coming to my party on Saturday? Mark: Yes! What time does it start?
colloquial.zh: Sara：星期六你来参加我的派对吗？Mark：来！几点开始？

messages.speaker: Sara (聚会主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tiġi għall-festin tiegħi nhar is-Sibt?
messages.mt_standard: Se tiġi għall-festin tiegħi nhar is-Sibt?
messages.zh: 星期六你来参加我的派对吗？
messages.en: Are you coming to my party on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 来！几点开始？
messages.en: Yes! What time does it start?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友围着生日蛋糕聊天，把 festin 和“生日派对”这个具体场景绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organised event or series of events celebrating music, art, culture, or another shared interest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围绕音乐、艺术、文化或其他共同主题举办的节庆活动或系列活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attività organizzata jew sensiela ta' attivitajiet li jiċċelebraw il-mużika, l-arti, il-kultura jew suġġett ieħor ta' interess komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 围绕特定文化、艺术或其他主题举办的节庆活动，常包含多场表演或活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Avveniment jew sensiela ta' avvenimenti organizzati madwar tema partikolari, bħall-mużika, iċ-ċinema jew l-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A festival is an organised occasion featuring activities or performances devoted to a particular theme.

formal.mt: Il-festival tal-films se jinkludi wirjiet u diskussjonijiet ma' diretturi mistiedna.
formal.en: The film festival will include screenings and discussions with guest directors.
formal.zh: 电影节将安排影片放映以及与受邀导演的讨论活动。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Trid tiġi miegħi għall-festival tal-mużika? Pawlu: Iva, imma l-ewwel irrid nara l-programm.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you want to come to the music festival with me? Pawlu: Yes, but I want to look at the programme first.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你想和我一起去音乐节吗？Pawlu：想，不过我想先看看节目单。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想和我一起去音乐节吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come to the music festival with me?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-ewwel irrid nara l-programm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-ewwel irrid nara l-programm.
messages.zh: 想，不过我想先看看节目单。
messages.en: Yes, but I want to look at the programme first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“音乐节有节目单和多场演出”的画面记 festival，再搭配 tal-mużika 一起练习。

gloss_zh: 他忽然想到；他一时起意

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to say that he suddenly had the idea or inclination to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示他忽然产生了做某事的念头，或一时兴起想做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tgħid li ġietu f'moħħu idea jew ħass ix-xewqa li jagħmel xi ħaġa dak il-ħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他产生了某个念头，尤其指忽然想到或一时兴起要做某事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġietu l-idea jew ix-xewqa li jagħmel xi ħaġa, spiss bla ma jkun ippjanaha minn qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If he suddenly had the idea to do something, he thought of doing it, often without planning it beforehand.

collocations.en: he suddenly had the idea to travel abroad
he suddenly felt like changing the plan
collocations.zh: 他一时兴起想改变计划

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara fil-mużew, fettillu jikteb artiklu dwar il-wirja.
formal.en: During his visit to the museum, he suddenly had the idea to write an article about the exhibition.
formal.zh: 参观博物馆时，他忽然想到要写一篇关于该展览的文章。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex mar il-baħar Luqa dalgħodu? Sara: Fettillu jmur jgħum qabel ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Luqa go to the seaside this morning? Sara: He suddenly felt like going for a swim before work.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Luqa 今天早上为什么去海边了？Sara：他一时兴起，想在上班前去游个泳。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Luqa 今天早上为什么去海边了？
messages.en: Why did Luqa go to the seaside this morning?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他一时兴起，想在上班前去游个泳。
messages.en: He suddenly felt like going for a swim before work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象他头顶突然亮起一盏灯，把 fettillu 记成“他忽然起意”，再接具体想做的事情。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To write your name on a document to show agreement, approval, or authorship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在文件上签下自己的姓名，以表示同意、批准或确认身份。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikteb ismek fuq dokument biex turi li taqbel miegħu, tapprovah jew tikkonferma min int.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在文件等上面签名或签署，以表示同意、批准或确认。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tikteb ismek fuq dokument jew karta biex turi l-qbil tiegħek jew tikkonferma xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you sign a document, you write your name on it to show your agreement or confirmation.

formal.mt: Luca ffirma l-kuntratt wara li qara l-kundizzjonijiet kollha.
formal.en: Luca signed the contract after reading all the conditions.
formal.zh: 卢卡阅读了所有条款后签署了合同。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Diġà ffirmajt il-formola? Luca: Iva, ffirmajtha dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Have you signed the form yet? Luca: Yes, I signed it this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你已经在表格上签名了吗？卢卡：是的，我今天早上签了。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 你已经在表格上签名了吗？
messages.en: Have you signed the form yet?

messages.speaker: Luca (同事)
messages.zh: 是的，我今天早上签了。
messages.en: Yes, I signed it this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己拿笔在合同末尾签下姓名，把 ffirma 和“签名这个动作”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a person's signature written on it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经有人在上面签名或签署的，通常用来描述文件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-firma ta' xi ħadd fuqu, bħal dokument jew kuntratt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已签名的；已有签署人签字的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li fuqu xi ħadd diġà kiteb il-firma tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A signed document has someone's signature on it.

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt huwa ffirmat miż-żewġ partijiet u jinsab fl-arkivju.
formal.en: The contract is signed by both parties and is held in the archive.
formal.zh: 合同已由双方签署，并存放在档案中。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-kuntratt huwa ffirmat? Mark: Iva, qiegħed hawn fil-fajl.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is the contract signed? Mark: Yes, it's here in the file.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：合同签好了吗？马克：签好了，就在这里的文件夹里。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 合同签好了吗？
messages.en: Is the contract signed?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 签好了，就在这里的文件夹里。
messages.en: Yes, it's here in the file.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象文件上的签名已经写好：ffirmat 描述“已签署”的状态，可与 ffirma 的签名动作对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring parts or people together into a whole, or to establish a group or organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使不同部分或人员组成一个整体，或组建团体、成立组织。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaqqad partijiet jew persuni biex jagħmlu ħaġa waħda, jew twaqqaf grupp jew organizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使形成；使若干部分或人员组成一个整体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħaqqad elementi jew persuni b'mod li jagħmlu ħaġa waħda jew jieħdu għamla partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you form something, you bring its parts together into a particular shape or whole.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 组建或成立团体、委员会等组织。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Twaqqaf grupp, kumitat jew organizzazzjoni biex jibda jaħdem għal skop partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you set up a group or organization, you establish it so that it can begin its work.

formal.mt: Il-kunsill fforma kumitat ġdid biex jeżamina l-proposti tar-residenti.
formal.en: The council set up a new committee to examine the residents' proposals.
formal.zh: 议会成立了一个新委员会，以审议居民的提议。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif se npoġġu s-siġġijiet? Luca: Nistgħu niffurmaw ċirku biex kulħadd jara lil xulxin.

gloss_zh: 未经许可进入他人的 Facebook 账号

teaching_sense.en_definition: To access another person's Facebook account without that person's permission.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未经账号持有人许可，进入其 Facebook 账号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tidħol fil-kont ta' Facebook ta' persuna oħra mingħajr il-permess tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: to frape (i.e. to access someone's Facebook account without their permission)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 未经他人许可进入其 Facebook 账号。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taċċessa l-kont ta' Facebook ta' xi ħadd ieħor mingħajr ma jkollok il-permess tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone frapes another person, they access that person's Facebook account without permission.

collocations.mt: jiffrejpja l-kont ta' Facebook ta' xi ħadd
collocations.en: to access someone's Facebook account without permission
collocations.zh: 未经许可进入某人的 Facebook 账号

collocations.en: to access a friend's Facebook account without permission
collocations.zh: 未经许可进入朋友的 Facebook 账号

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tagħha, Rita spjegat li xi ħadd kien daħal fil-kont tagħha ta' Facebook mingħajr permess u kien iffrejpja l-kont.
formal.en: In her report, Rita explained that someone had entered her Facebook account without permission and had fraped the account.
formal.zh: 丽塔在报告中说明，有人未经许可进入了她的 Facebook 账号，即擅自访问了该账号。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Xi ħadd ffrejpja l-kont tiegħi ta' Facebook! Sam: Dan mhux aċċettabbli. Ħadd m'għandu jidħol fil-kont tiegħek mingħajr il-permess tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Rita: Someone accessed my Facebook account without permission! Sam: That's unacceptable. Nobody should enter your account without your permission.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：有人未经许可进入了我的 Facebook 账号！萨姆：这不能接受。任何人都不该未经你的许可进入你的账号。

messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd ffrejpja l-kont tiegħi ta' Facebook!

gloss_zh: 使他窒息；使他透不过气

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stifle someone by making it difficult for them to breathe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人呼吸困难、透不过气，或使其窒息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel lil xi ħadd ma jkunx jista' jieħu n-nifs sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人透不过气；使人窒息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għamel lil persuna ssibha diffiċli biex tieħu n-nifs, pereżempju minħabba d-duħħan jew nuqqas ta' arja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something stifles someone, it makes breathing difficult or prevents them from breathing freely.

collocations.en: The heat made him feel unable to breathe.
collocations.zh: 炎热使他感到喘不过气。

formal.mt: Id-duħħan fil-kamra fgah, u għalhekk ħareġ malajr biex jieħu n-nifs.
formal.en: The smoke in the room stifled him, so he quickly went outside to breathe.
formal.zh: 房间里的烟使他透不过气，因此他赶紧出去呼吸。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex ħareġ Pawlu? Sara: Id-duħħan fgah. Issa qiegħed barra u qed jieħu n-nifs aħjar.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did Pawlu go outside? Sara: The smoke stifled him. He's outside now and breathing more easily.
colloquial.zh: Mark：Pawlu为什么出去了？Sara：烟呛得他透不过气。他现在在外面，呼吸顺畅些了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu为什么出去了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu go outside?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)

messages.mt_standard: Id-duħħan fgah. Issa qiegħed barra u qed jieħu n-nifs aħjar.
messages.zh: 烟呛得他透不过气。他现在在外面，呼吸顺畅些了。
messages.en: The smoke stifled him. He's outside now and breathing more easily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fgah 和“烟呛得他透不过气”的画面一起记，整句练习 Id-duħħan fgah.，将动作与受影响的人联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to indicate a location, an enclosed space, or a period within which something happens.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于指出所在地点、内部空间，或事情发生所处的时间范围。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prepożizzjoni li tindika post, il-ġewwa ta' xi ħaġa, jew medda ta' żmien li fiha sseħħ xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某个地点，表示人或活动所在的位置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika l-post fejn tinsab persuna jew ħaġa, jew fejn issir attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use fi to indicate the place where someone is or where an activity happens.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某个空间、区域或容器里面。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li persuna jew ħaġa tinsab ġewwa spazju, żona jew kontenitur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use fi when someone or something is inside a space, area, or container.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某个界限或规定的时间范围之内。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li xi ħaġa tinsab jew isseħħ fil-limiti ta' spazju jew ta' medda ta' żmien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use fi to show that something stays within a boundary or happens within a specified period.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti se jaħdmu fi grupp żgħir u jlestu r-rapport fi żmien ġimgħa.
formal.en: The participants will work in a small group and complete the report within a week.
formal.zh: 参与者将以小组形式工作，并在一周之内完成报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu? Lara: Fi ġnien ħdejn id-dar tiegħi. Maja: Tajjeb, nasal fi żmien għaxar minuti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet? Lara: In a garden near my house. Maja: All right, I'll be there within ten minutes.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们在哪里见面？Lara：在我家附近的一个花园里。Maja：好，我十分钟内到。

messages.en: Where shall we meet?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)

messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, nasal fi żmien għaxar minuti.
messages.zh: 好，我十分钟内到。
messages.en: All right, I'll be there within ten minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fi 想成把事物放进一个框：地点框表示“在”，空间框表示“在里面”，时间框表示“在期限之内”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thin threadlike strand of material, or plant material in food that the body does not fully digest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 构成某种材料的细丝状物质；也指食物中人体不能完全消化的植物性纤维成分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħajta rqiqa li tifforma parti minn materjal; fl-ikel, materjal tal-pjanti li l-ġisem ma jiddiġerixxix għalkollox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纤维，指材料中的细丝状成分；用于食物时指膳食纤维。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Element irqiq bħal ħajta li minnu jkun magħmul materjal, jew parti mill-ikel li ġej mill-pjanti u li l-ġisem ma jiddiġerixxix għalkollox.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fibre is a thin strand forming part of a material, or plant material in food that your body does not fully digest.

formal.mt: Il-ħobż ismar, il-fażola u l-ħaxix huma sorsi ta' fibra fl-ikel.
formal.en: Brown bread, beans, and vegetables are sources of dietary fibre.
formal.zh: 全麦面包、豆类和蔬菜都是膳食纤维的来源。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-ħobż fih ħafna fibra? Anna: Iva, hekk tgħid it-tikketta. Mark: Mela nieħu wieħed.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does this bread contain a lot of fibre? Anna: Yes, that's what the label says. Mark: Then I'll take one.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这种面包的膳食纤维含量高吗？Anna：是的，标签上是这样写的。Mark：那我买一个。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The degree of confidence consumers have in the economy and their own financial situation, influencing their willingness to spend.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 消费者对经济状况及自身财务状况抱有信心的程度，这种信心会影响其消费意愿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-grad ta' fiduċja li għandhom il-konsumaturi fl-ekonomija u fil-qagħda finanzjarja tagħhom, li jinfluwenza kemm ikunu lesti jonfqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消费者信心，指消费者对经济和个人财务状况及其前景的信任或乐观程度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-livell ta' fiduċja tal-konsumaturi dwar il-qagħda preżenti u futura tal-ekonomija u tal-finanzi personali tagħhom, li jista' jaffettwa d-deċiżjonijiet tax-xiri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Consumer confidence is the degree to which people feel positive about the economy and their finances, which can influence their spending decisions.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, żieda fil-fiduċja tal-konsumaturi hija interpretata bħala sinjal li n-nies iħossuhom aktar lesti jonfqu.
formal.en: In the report, an increase in consumer confidence is interpreted as a sign that people feel more willing to spend.
formal.zh: 报告将消费者信心上升解读为人们消费意愿增强的迹象。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser fiduċja tal-konsumaturi? Daniel: Kemm in-nies iħossuhom fiduċjużi dwar l-ekonomija u l-flus tagħhom. Maja: Jiġifieri tista' taffettwa kemm jixtru? Daniel: Iva, tista'.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does consumer confidence mean? Daniel: How confident people feel about the economy and their own money. Maja: So it can affect how much they buy? Daniel: Yes, it can.
colloquial.zh: Maja：消费者信心是什么意思？Daniel：就是人们对经济和自己财务状况有多大信心。Maja：也就是说，它可能影响人们买多少东西？Daniel：对，可能会。

messages.zh: 消费者信心是什么意思？
messages.en: What does consumer confidence mean?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同学)

messages.mt_standard: Kemm in-nies iħossuhom fiduċjużi dwar l-ekonomija u l-flus tagħhom.
messages.zh: 就是人们对经济和自己财务状况有多大信心。
messages.en: How confident people feel about the economy and their own money.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)

messages.en: Yes, it can.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fiduċja tal-konsumaturi 整体联想成消费者心里的“信心温度计”：对经济和钱包越有信心，消费意愿就可能越强。

gloss_zh: 筋疲力尽的；极度虚弱的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Exhausted or very weak, with little strength or energy remaining.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容精力耗尽或身体十分虚弱，几乎没有力气的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jkun għajjien ħafna jew dgħajjef ħafna, bi ftit li xejn saħħa jew enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 筋疲力尽，或身体极度虚弱、缺乏力气。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi stat ta' għeja kbira jew dgħufija qawwija, meta persuna ma tantx ikollha saħħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is fieni is extremely tired or weak and has very little strength left.

collocations.en: I feel exhausted or very weak
collocations.zh: 我感到筋疲力尽或十分虚弱

formal.mt: Wara ġurnata twila ta' xogħol, il-ħaddiem ħassu fieni u kellu bżonn jistrieħ.
formal.en: After a long day of work, the worker felt exhausted and needed to rest.
formal.zh: 工作了漫长的一天后，这名工人感到筋疲力尽，需要休息。

colloquial.en: Mark: I feel exhausted today. Luqa: Would you like to sit down and rest a little? Mark: Yes, I need a break.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我今天感到筋疲力尽。卢卡：你要坐下来休息一会儿吗？马克：要，我需要歇一歇。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata mmarkata bħala nom u marbuta ma' vojt jew ma' rifluss tal-baħar; il-kuntest irid jiċċara liema interpretazzjoni hija maħsuba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 空的、空无，或退潮；原释义未进一步区分，词性标为名词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa tindika vojt jew rifluss tal-baħar, mingħajr aktar distinzjoni bejn dawn l-interpretazzjonijiet, u l-entrata hija mmarkata bħala nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This noun entry is associated with emptiness or an ebb, and its intended meaning requires a supporting context.

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tal-entrata 'fieraħ', l-istudent għandu jikkunsidra l-glossa 'empty or ebb' u juża l-kuntest biex jagħżel l-interpretazzjoni xierqa.
formal.en: When analysing the entry 'fieraħ', the student should consider the gloss 'empty or ebb' and use the context to choose the appropriate interpretation.
formal.zh: 分析 fieraħ 这一词条时，学生应考虑“empty or ebb”这项释义，并根据语境选择适当的解释。

colloquial.mt: Luqa: Għal 'fieraħ', għandi nagħżel is-sens ta' vojt jew ta' rifluss? Sara: Aqra s-sentenza kollha; il-kuntest għandu jgħinek tagħżel. Luqa: Se naqra wkoll is-sentenza ta' qabel.
colloquial.en: Luqa: For 'fieraħ', should I choose the meaning of emptiness or ebb? Sara: Read the whole sentence; the context should help you choose. Luqa: I'll also read the previous sentence.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：fieraħ 应该取“空无”还是“退潮”的意思？萨拉：把整句话读完，语境应该能帮助你选择。卢卡：我也会读一下前一句。

messages.speaker: Luqa (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal 'fieraħ', għandi nagħżel is-sens ta' vojt jew ta' rifluss?
messages.mt_standard: Għal 'fieraħ', għandi nagħżel is-sens ta' vojt jew ta' rifluss?
messages.zh: fieraħ 应该取“空无”还是“退潮”的意思？
messages.en: For 'fieraħ', should I choose the meaning of emptiness or ebb?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Aqra s-sentenza kollha; il-kuntest għandu jgħinek tagħżel.
messages.mt_standard: Aqra s-sentenza kollha; il-kuntest għandu jgħinek tagħżel.
messages.zh: 把整句话读完，语境应该能帮助你选择。
messages.en: Read the whole sentence; the context should help you choose.

messages.speaker: Luqa (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Se naqra wkoll is-sentenza ta' qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Se naqra wkoll is-sentenza ta' qabel.
messages.zh: 我也会读一下前一句。
messages.en: I'll also read the previous sentence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 fieraħ 画两格提示图：一格表示空无，一格表示退潮；用语境选择，并注意末尾是 ħ。

gloss_zh: 爱调情、喜欢吸引爱慕目光的女子

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woman who flirts to attract romantic attention, often without serious intentions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喜欢通过调情吸引他人爱慕、往往并无认真交往意图的女子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara li tħobb tiġbed l-interess romantiku ta' ħaddieħor bil-kliem u bl-imġiba tagħha, spiss mingħajr intenzjoni ta' relazzjoni serja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱调情、喜欢吸引他人爱慕而未必有认真交往意图的女子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mara li tipprova tiġbed l-attenzjoni u l-interess romantiku ta' ħaddieħor, spiss mingħajr ma tkun trid relazzjoni serja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A coquette is a woman who flirts to attract romantic interest, often without intending to form a serious relationship.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-fiergħa tiġbed l-interess ta' diversi rġiel, iżda ma turix intenzjoni li tibda relazzjoni serja.
formal.en: In the story, the coquette attracts the interest of several men but shows no intention of beginning a serious relationship.
formal.zh: 故事中，这名爱调情的女子吸引了几位男子的爱慕，却没有表现出开始认真交往的意图。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif tiddeskrivi lill-karattru prinċipali? Lara: Hija fiergħa; tħobb tiġbed l-interess ta' kulħadd, imma ma tridx relazzjoni serja.
colloquial.en: Maja: How would you describe the main character? Lara: She's a coquette; she likes attracting everyone's romantic interest, but she doesn't want a serious relationship.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你会怎样描述主角？拉拉：她是个爱调情的女子，喜欢让大家对她产生爱慕，却不想认真交往。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 你会怎样描述主角？
messages.en: How would you describe the main character?

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija fiergħa; tħobb tiġbed l-interess ta' kulħadd, imma ma tridx relazzjoni serja.
messages.mt_standard: Hija fiergħa; tħobb tiġbed l-interess ta' kulħadd, imma ma tridx relazzjoni serja.
messages.zh: 她是个爱调情的女子，喜欢让大家对她产生爱慕，却不想认真交往。
messages.en: She's a coquette; she likes attracting everyone's romantic interest, but she doesn't want a serious relationship.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用故事人物来记：她不断吸引爱慕目光，却未必愿意认真交往；把这个人物画面与 fiergħa 联系起来。

gloss_zh: 马耳他复活节杏仁夹心造型甜饼

teaching_sense.en_definition: A traditional Easter sweet made of sweet pastry with an almond filling and usually shaped like an object or animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 复活节期间制作的传统烘焙甜饼，以甜酥皮包裹杏仁馅，通常做成物品或动物等造型。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħelwa tradizzjonali li tinħema fi żmien l-Għid, magħmula minn għaġina ħelwa b'mili tal-lewż u ġeneralment mogħtija għamla ta' oġġett jew annimal.

sense_translations.en_definition: Traditional baked sweet made at Easter time, consisting of sweet pastry with an almond filling, typically formed in the shape of an object or creature.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 复活节期间制作的传统烘焙甜点，由甜酥皮和杏仁馅组成，通常做成某种物品或动物等造型。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħelwa tradizzjonali tal-Għid magħmula minn għaġina ħelwa b'mili tal-lewż, li tinħema u s-soltu jkollha l-għamla ta' oġġett jew ta' xi ħlejqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A figolla is a traditional Easter pastry with an almond filling, usually made in the shape of an object or creature.

collocations.zh: 兔子造型的杏仁夹心甜饼

collocations.en: a figolla with an almond filling
collocations.zh: 包有杏仁馅的复活节甜饼

formal.mt: Għall-Għid, il-familja ħejjiet figolla f'għamla ta' fenek, magħmula minn għaġina ħelwa b'mili tal-lewż.
formal.en: For Easter, the family prepared a rabbit-shaped figolla made of sweet pastry with an almond filling.
formal.zh: 为了庆祝复活节，这家人制作了一块兔子造型的甜饼，以甜酥皮包裹杏仁馅。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din il-figolla għandha l-lewż ġewwa? Rita: Iva, għandha mili tal-lewż. Trid biċċa?
colloquial.en: Mark: Does this figolla have almonds inside? Rita: Yes, it has an almond filling. Would you like a piece?
colloquial.zh: 马克：这块复活节甜饼里面有杏仁吗？丽塔：有，里面是杏仁馅。你要来一块吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这块复活节甜饼里面有杏仁吗？
messages.en: Does this figolla have almonds inside?

messages.speaker: Rita (糕点店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandha mili tal-lewż. Trid biċċa?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandha mili tal-lewż. Trid biċċa?
messages.zh: 有，里面是杏仁馅。你要来一块吗？
messages.en: Yes, it has an almond filling. Would you like a piece?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 figolla 记成复活节餐桌上的造型甜饼：外层甜酥皮，里面杏仁馅，外形可以是一只小兔子。

gloss_zh: 裁缝用时装杂志；装饰小雕像；裁衣人台

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fashion magazine used by seamstresses, a small ornamental figure, or a dressmaker's dummy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指供裁缝参考款式的时装杂志、用于装饰的小雕像，或供裁制服装使用的人台；具体含义由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tista' tfisser rivista tal-moda li l-ħajjata jużaw għall-mudelli, statwetta dekorattiva, jew mudell tal-ġisem li jintuża waqt il-ħjata tal-ħwejjeġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: fashion magazine used by seamstresses for designs
sense_translations.zh_definition: 供裁缝参考服装设计和款式的时装杂志。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rivista tal-moda bi stampi u disinji ta' ħwejjeġ li l-ħajjata jużaw biex jagħżlu jew ifasslu mudelli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A figorin is a fashion magazine that seamstresses consult for clothing designs and ideas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作为装饰品摆放的小雕像或小塑像。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Statwetta żgħira li tirrappreżenta persuna, annimal jew figura oħra u tintuża bħala tiżjin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A figorin is a small ornamental figure displayed as a decorative object.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 裁缝制作、调整或试配服装时使用的人体模型，即裁衣人台。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mudell tal-ġisem tal-bniedem li fuqu l-ħajjata jqiegħdu u jaġġustaw il-ħwejjeġ waqt li jkunu qed jaħdmuhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A figorin is a body-shaped dummy used by a seamstress to fit and adjust clothing.

collocations.en: look for a design in a fashion magazine
collocations.zh: 在时装杂志中寻找服装款式

collocations.en: adjust a dress on a dressmaker's dummy

formal.mt: Il-ħajjata għażlet mudell minn figorin tal-moda u mbagħad aġġustat il-libsa fuq figorin tal-ħjata.
formal.en: The seamstress selected a design from a fashion magazine and then adjusted the dress on a dressmaker's dummy.
formal.zh: 女裁缝从时装杂志中选定一个款式，然后在裁衣人台上调整连衣裙。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn ġibt dak il-figorin fuq l-ixkaffa? Lara: Xtrajtu lbieraħ. Huwa tal-porċellana, allura oqgħod attenta meta terfgħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you get that figurine on the shelf? Lara: I bought it yesterday. It's made of porcelain, so be careful when you pick it up.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：架子上那个小雕像是从哪里买来的？拉拉：我昨天买的。它是瓷做的，拿起来时小心一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġibt dak il-figorin fuq l-ixkaffa?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġibt dak il-figorin fuq l-ixkaffa?
messages.zh: 架子上那个小雕像是从哪里买来的？
messages.en: Where did you get that figurine on the shelf?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xtrajtu lbieraħ. Huwa tal-porċellana, allura oqgħod attenta meta terfgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Xtrajtu lbieraħ. Huwa tal-porċellana, allura oqgħod attenta meta terfgħu.
messages.zh: 我昨天买的。它是瓷做的，拿起来时小心一点。
messages.en: I bought it yesterday. It's made of porcelain, so be careful when you pick it up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象裁缝工作室里的三个画面：桌上翻时装杂志，架上摆小雕像，旁边用人台试衣。用场景区分 figorin 的三个义项，不把它们混成同一种物品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Using words in a non-literal, figurative sense, or representing recognizable physical figures in art.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于语言时指采用比喻而非字面意义的；用于艺术时指表现可辨识实体形象、具有具象特征的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juża kliem b'tifsira mhux letterali, bħal fil-metafori, jew li jirrappreżenta figuri fiżiċi li jistgħu jingħarfu f'xogħol artistiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 比喻性的；词语所表达的意义超出或不同于其字面意义的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jesprimi tifsira differenti minn dik letterali tal-kliem, pereżempju permezz ta' metafora jew xebh.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Language is figurative when its words express a meaning beyond their literal sense, often through metaphor or comparison.

sense_translations.en_definition: involving the representation of physical figures
sense_translations.zh_definition: 涉及表现实体形象的；在艺术中描绘可辨识人物、动物或其他实体的，具象的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi r-rappreżentazzjoni artistika ta' figuri fiżiċi li jistgħu jingħarfu, bħal nies jew annimali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Art is figurative when it represents recognizable physical figures, such as people or animals.

formal.mt: Il-pittur juża stil figurattiv biex jirrappreżenta nies u annimali f'xeni tal-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The painter uses a figurative style to represent people and animals in scenes of everyday life.
formal.zh: 这位画家采用具象风格，在日常生活场景中描绘人物和动物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta tgħid li għandek muntanja xogħol, tassew qed titkellem fuq muntanja? Mark: Le, qed nuża l-kelma f'sens figurattiv: għandi ħafna xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: When you say you have a mountain of work, are you really talking about a mountain? Mark: No, I'm using the word in a figurative sense: I have a lot of work.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你说工作堆成山，真的是在说一座山吗？马克：不是，我用的是比喻义，意思是我的工作很多。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid li għandek muntanja xogħol, tassew qed titkellem fuq muntanja?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid li għandek muntanja xogħol, tassew qed titkellem fuq muntanja?
messages.zh: 你说工作堆成山，真的是在说一座山吗？
messages.en: When you say you have a mountain of work, are you really talking about a mountain?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, qed nuża l-kelma f'sens figurattiv: għandi ħafna xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Le, qed nuża l-kelma f'sens figurattiv: għandi ħafna xogħol.
messages.zh: 不是，我用的是比喻义，意思是我的工作很多。
messages.en: No, I'm using the word in a figurative sense: I have a lot of work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 figurattiv 配两张学习卡：语言卡写“工作堆成山”，提醒自己是比喻义；绘画卡画可辨识的人物和动物，提醒自己是具象表现。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inside him, referring to a person's interior or inner feelings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示在某个男性的身体内部或内心之中，可用于描述他内在的感受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tindika li xi ħaġa tinsab ġewwa persuna maskili, fil-ġisem tagħha jew fil-ħsibijiet u s-sentimenti tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在他身体内部或内心之中。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser ġewwa persuna maskili, kemm fis-sens fiżiku kif ukoll b'rabta mal-ħsibijiet jew is-sentimenti tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is inside him is within his body or forms part of his private thoughts and feelings.

collocations.en: keep everything bottled up inside him
collocations.zh: 把所有心事都憋在心里

formal.mt: Għalkemm baqa' sieket waqt il-laqgħa, Pawlu ħass rabja kbira fih.
formal.en: Although he remained silent during the meeting, Pawlu felt great anger inside him.
formal.zh: 虽然保罗在会议期间一直保持沉默，但他内心感到十分愤怒。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ma jitkellimx dwar dak li qed idejqu? Rita: Iżomm kollox fih. Se nipprova nitkellem miegħu bil-kwiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why doesn't Mark talk about what's bothering him? Rita: He keeps everything bottled up inside. I'll try talking to him quietly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么不说说有什么事让他烦心？丽塔：他把所有心事都憋在心里。我会试着找他平静地聊聊。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ma jitkellimx dwar dak li qed idejqu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ma jitkellimx dwar dak li qed idejqu?
messages.zh: 马克为什么不说说有什么事让他烦心？
messages.en: Why doesn't Mark talk about what's bothering him?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iżomm kollox fih. Se nipprova nitkellem miegħu bil-kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iżomm kollox fih. Se nipprova nitkellem miegħu bil-kwiet.
messages.zh: 他把所有心事都憋在心里。我会试着找他平静地聊聊。
messages.en: He keeps everything bottled up inside. I'll try talking to him quietly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fih 放进“他把心事藏在内心”的画面里，整句记忆 iżomm kollox fih，抓住“在他里面”的空间感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Has or contains something within it, used with a feminine singular referent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某个阴性单数所指对象内部有、含有或装有某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tindika li ħaġa msemmija b'kelma femminili fis-singular għandha xi ħaġa ġewwa jew bħala parti mill-kontenut tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有，含有或装有，表示某个阴性单数对象具有某种内部内容。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li ħaġa femminili fis-singular għandha xi ħaġa ġewwa fiha jew inkluża fil-kontenut tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a container, text, or other feminine singular referent has something in it, that thing is included within its contents.

collocations.en: has a lot of information in it

formal.mt: Il-kaxxa fiha għaxar kotba u lista tal-kontenut.
formal.en: The box contains ten books and a list of its contents.
formal.zh: 箱子里装有十本书和一份物品清单。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'fiha din il-borża? Lara: Fiha l-ħobż u ftit frott għall-ikla.
colloquial.en: Mark: What's in this bag? Lara: It has the bread and some fruit for the meal.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个袋子里有什么？拉拉：里面有这顿饭要吃的面包和一些水果。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 这个袋子里有什么？
messages.en: What's in this bag?

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fiha l-ħobż u ftit frott għall-ikla.
messages.mt_standard: Fiha l-ħobż u ftit frott għall-ikla.
messages.zh: 里面有这顿饭要吃的面包和一些水果。
messages.en: It has the bread and some fruit for the meal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开一个袋子清点物品，用 il-borża fiha… 接上里面的东西，把 fiha 与“其中装有”连在一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Outside in the open air, rather than inside a building or enclosed space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在建筑物或封闭空间以外的露天环境中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Barra, f'post miftuħ għall-arja, mhux ġewwa bini jew spazju magħluq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在露天环境中；在户外开放的地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'post barra u miftuħ għall-arja, minflok ġewwa bini jew f'post magħluq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an activity takes place fil-beraħ, it happens outside in the open air.

collocations.en: to eat in the open air

formal.mt: Il-kunċert se jsir fil-beraħ fil-ġnien pubbliku, jekk it-temp jippermetti.
formal.en: The concert will take place in the open air in the public garden, weather permitting.
formal.zh: 天气允许的话，音乐会将在公共花园露天举行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nieklu ġewwa jew fil-beraħ? Mark: Fil-beraħ, għax illum hemm arja friska.
colloquial.en: Sara: Shall we eat indoors or outside? Mark: Outside, because there's a cool breeze today.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们在室内吃，还是在露天吃？马克：在露天吃吧，今天有凉风。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在室内吃，还是在露天吃？
messages.en: Shall we eat indoors or outside?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-beraħ, għax illum hemm arja friska.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-beraħ, għax illum hemm arja friska.
messages.zh: 在露天吃吧，今天有凉风。
messages.en: Outside, because there's a cool breeze today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fil-beraħ 整体联想成露天餐桌：抬头见天空，身边有空气流动，就是在户外。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At the planned or agreed time, without being late.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在计划或约定的时间，没有迟到或延误。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fil-waqt ippjanat jew miftiehem, mingħajr dewmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 准时地；在预定或约定的时间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fil-waqt li jkun ġie stabbilit jew miftiehem, bla ma wieħed jasal jew jagħmel xi ħaġa tard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone arrives or something happens on time, they arrive or it happens at the time that was planned.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom jaslu fil-ħin sabiex il-laqgħa tkun tista' tibda fit-tmienja.
formal.en: Participants should arrive on time so that the meeting can begin at eight.
formal.zh: 与会者应准时到达，以便会议能在八点开始。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Se tasal fil-ħin għaċ-ċinema? David: Iva, diġà qiegħed fit-triq. Marija: Sewwa, nistenniek ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Marija: Will you get to the cinema on time? David: Yes, I'm already on my way. Marija: Good, I'll wait for you by the entrance.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你能准时到电影院吗？David：能，我已经在路上了。Marija：好，我在门口等你。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你能准时到电影院吗？
messages.en: Will you get to the cinema on time?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 能，我已经在路上了。
messages.en: Yes, I'm already on my way.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我在门口等你。
messages.en: Good, I'll wait for you by the entrance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象约好八点见面，钟表刚到八点你就出现；把这个“准时到达”的画面和 jasal fil-ħin 一起记。

gloss_zh: 慈善的；以帮助他人为目的的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Intended to improve other people's lives through charitable support or assistance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以改善他人生活为目的，通过捐助、援助等方式开展慈善活动的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-għan li jgħin lin-nies u jtejjeb ħajjithom permezz ta' donazzjonijiet jew għajnuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 慈善的，旨在通过捐助或其他援助增进他人福祉的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Marbut ma' ħidma li tfittex il-ġid ta' ħaddieħor billi tipprovdi flus, riżorsi jew forom oħra ta' għajnuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A philanthropical activity or purpose involves helping other people, especially by providing money or practical support to improve their lives.

formal.mt: Il-proġett filantropiku jipprovdi kotba u materjal edukattiv lil tfal minn familji bi dħul baxx.
formal.en: The philanthropic project provides books and educational materials to children from low-income families.
formal.zh: 该慈善项目向低收入家庭的儿童提供书籍和学习材料。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tiġbru dawn il-kotba? David: Għal proġett filantropiku. Se nagħtuhom lil tfal li għandhom bżonnhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you collecting these books? David: For a philanthropic project. We're going to give them to children who need them.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你们为什么在收集这些书？戴维：为了一个慈善项目。我们会把书送给有需要的孩子。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们为什么在收集这些书？
messages.en: Why are you collecting these books?

messages.speaker: David (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal proġett filantropiku. Se nagħtuhom lil tfal li għandhom bżonnhom.
messages.mt_standard: Għal proġett filantropiku. Se nagħtuhom lil tfal li għandhom bżonnhom.
messages.zh: 为了一个慈善项目。我们会把书送给有需要的孩子。
messages.en: For a philanthropic project. We're going to give them to children who need them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“募集书籍送给有需要的孩子”作记忆画面，反复搭配 proġett filantropiku，把这个形容词与慈善援助联系起来。

gloss_zh: 爱乐的；与爱乐乐团或音乐团体有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a musical society or ensemble devoted to performing and promoting music.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与以演奏、推广音乐为宗旨的爱乐团体或乐团有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' għaqda jew grupp mużikali li jdoqq u jxerred l-apprezzament tal-mużika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱乐的，指与演奏、推广音乐的团体或乐团有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Marbut ma' soċjetà jew grupp ta' mużiċisti li għandu l-għan li jinterpreta l-mużika u jħeġġeġ l-apprezzament tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A philharmonic society or ensemble is an organization of musicians and supporters concerned with performing music and encouraging its appreciation.

formal.mt: Il-każin filarmoniku ħabbar programm ta' kunċerti biex iħeġġeġ l-apprezzament tal-mużika fil-komunità.
formal.en: The philharmonic club announced a programme of concerts to encourage appreciation of music in the community.
formal.zh: 该爱乐会公布了一系列音乐会安排，以促进社区居民对音乐的欣赏。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn se niltaqgħu għall-kunċert? Toni: Quddiem il-każin filarmoniku, fis-sebgħa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where shall we meet for the concert? Toni: Outside the philharmonic club, at seven.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：去听音乐会，我们在哪里碰面？托尼：七点在爱乐会会所门前见。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 去听音乐会，我们在哪里碰面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet for the concert?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 七点在爱乐会会所门前见。
messages.en: Outside the philharmonic club, at seven.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 filarmoniku 与音乐会、乐团排练的画面绑定；成组记忆 każin filarmoniku 和 orkestra filarmonika，同时留意搭配中的词尾变化。

gloss_zh: 一皮砌石；高度为一块石头的一层石列

teaching_sense.en_definition: A horizontal row of building stones forming a single layer one stone high.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 砌筑时横向排列的一层石块，其高度相当于一块石头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ringiela orizzontali ta' ġebel tal-bini li tifforma saff wieħed għoli daqs ġebla waħda.

sense_translations.en_definition: a line of build stone, one stone high
sense_translations.zh_definition: 由建筑石块横向砌成、高度为一块石头的一皮石层。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Saff wieħed ta' ġebel tal-bini mqiegħed f'ringiela orizzontali, għoli daqs ġebla waħda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A filat is a horizontal row of building stones that forms a layer one stone high.

collocations.en: to add another course of stone

formal.mt: Il-bennej żied filat wieħed ta' ġebel biex jgħolli l-ħajt.
formal.en: The builder added one course of stone to raise the wall.
formal.zh: 建筑工人加砌了一皮石头，以增加墙的高度。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Kemm se tgħolli l-ħajt? Pawlu: Se nżid filat wieħed biss, għoli daqs ġebla.
colloquial.en: Lina: How much higher will you make the wall? Pawlu: I'll add just one course, the height of one stone.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你要把墙加高多少？保罗：只加砌一皮，就是一块石头的高度。

messages.speaker: Lina (屋主)
messages.zh: 你要把墙加高多少？
messages.en: How much higher will you make the wall?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (建筑工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nżid filat wieħed biss, għoli daqs ġebla.
messages.mt_standard: Se nżid filat wieħed biss, għoli daqs ġebla.
messages.zh: 只加砌一皮，就是一块石头的高度。
messages.en: I'll add just one course, the height of one stone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象砌墙时横铺一排石块：一个 filat 就是一皮，关键是一块石头高。

gloss_zh: 经匣；内装经文、供犹太教祈祷时佩戴的小匣子

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small boxes containing passages of scripture, worn on the arm and head during Jewish prayer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 内装经文的小匣子，在犹太教祈祷时佩戴于手臂和头部；本词为复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kaxxi żgħar li fihom siltiet mill-Iskrittura u li jintlibsu fuq id-driegħ u fuq ir-ras waqt it-talb Lhudi.

sense_translations.en_definition: Ara Bibbja Mattew Kap 23 vers 5 Grazzi
sense_translations.zh_definition: 经匣：内装经文、在犹太教祈祷时佩戴于手臂和头部的小匣子，词形为复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kaxxi żgħar li jkun fihom siltiet mill-Iskrittura, li jintlibsu fuq id-driegħ u fuq ir-ras waqt it-talb Lhudi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Phylacteries are small boxes containing scriptural passages that are worn on the arm and head during Jewish prayer.

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi l-filatteri bħala kaxxi żgħar li fihom siltiet mill-Iskrittura u li jintlibsu waqt it-talb Lhudi.
formal.en: The text describes phylacteries as small boxes containing passages of scripture that are worn during Jewish prayer.
formal.zh: 文章将经匣描述为内装经文、在犹太教祈祷时佩戴的小匣子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser il-kliem 'jilbes il-filatteri'? David: Ifisser li jilbes dawk il-kaxxi żgħar li fihom siltiet mill-Iskrittura.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the phrase 'wear phylacteries' mean? David: It means wearing those small boxes that contain passages of scripture.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“佩戴经匣”这个说法是什么意思？戴维：就是佩戴那些装着经文的小匣子。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: “佩戴经匣”这个说法是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the phrase 'wear phylacteries' mean?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li jilbes dawk il-kaxxi żgħar li fihom siltiet mill-Iskrittura.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li jilbes dawk il-kaxxi żgħar li fihom siltiet mill-Iskrittura.
messages.zh: 就是佩戴那些装着经文的小匣子。
messages.en: It means wearing those small boxes that contain passages of scripture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用画面记忆 filatteri：小匣子里装经文，祈祷时佩戴；同时记住这里是复数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Thin, flexible metal wire used for fastening or making things, including wire wound into a coil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于绑扎或制作物件的细长、可弯曲金属丝，也可指盘绕成圈的柔性金属线。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wajer irqiq u flessibbli tal-metall li jintuża biex jintrabtu jew isiru affarijiet, u li jista' jkun imdawwar f'kolja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 金属丝；细长且可弯曲的金属线材。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Wajer tal-metall irqiq u flessibbli li jista' jintuża biex jintrabtu affarijiet jew biex isiru oġġetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Wire is a thin, flexible length of metal that you can bend or use to fasten things together.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 柔性金属线圈；由可弯曲金属线盘绕而成的线圈。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kolja magħmula minn wajer tal-metall flessibbli mdawwar f'sensiela ta' dawriet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A flexible metal coil consists of bendable metal wire wound into a series of turns.

formal.mt: Għall-mudell, ħu biċċa fildiferru u dawwarha ma' lapes biex tifforma kolja flessibbli.
formal.en: For the model, take a piece of wire and wind it around a pencil to form a flexible coil.
formal.zh: 制作模型时，取一段金属丝，将它绕在铅笔上，做成柔性的线圈。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandek biċċa fildiferru għall-mudell? Ġorġ: Iva, ħu minn din il-kolja; tista' tgħawġu faċilment.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you have a piece of wire for the model? Ġorġ: Yes, take some from this coil; you can bend it easily.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你有一段做模型用的金属丝吗？乔治：有，从这卷取一点吧，很容易弯。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 你有一段做模型用的金属丝吗？
messages.en: Do you have a piece of wire for the model?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu minn din il-kolja; tista' tgħawġu faċilment.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu minn din il-kolja; tista' tgħawġu faċilment.
messages.zh: 有，从这卷取一点吧，很容易弯。
messages.en: Yes, take some from this coil; you can bend it easily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手工画面记住 fildiferru：拉开是一段金属丝，盘绕起来成为可弯曲的金属线圈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of fish or meat with the bones removed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从鱼或肉上切下、已经去除骨头的一块肉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ħut jew laħam li minnha jkun tneħħa l-għadam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 去除骨头后切下的鱼肉片或肉块。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa ħut jew laħam imħejjija billi jitneħħa minnha l-għadam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fillet is a piece of fish or meat from which the bones have been removed.

formal.mt: Poġġi l-filett tal-ħut f'dixx u żid ftit żejt u meraq tal-lumi.
formal.en: Place the fish fillet in a dish and add a little oil and lemon juice.
formal.zh: 将去骨鱼片放入盘中，加入少许油和柠檬汁。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'se nieklu llejla? Pawlu: Nista' nsajjar filett tal-ħut bil-lumi. Lara: Tajjeb, jien nipprepara l-insalata.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are we having tonight? Pawlu: I can cook a fish fillet with lemon. Lara: Great, I'll prepare the salad.
colloquial.zh: Lara：今晚我们吃什么？Pawlu：我可以做柠檬鱼片。Lara：好，我来准备沙拉。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 今晚我们吃什么？
messages.en: What are we having tonight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 我可以做柠檬鱼片。
messages.en: I can cook a fish fillet with lemon.

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 好，我来准备沙拉。
messages.en: Great, I'll prepare the salad.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 filett 和盘中已经剔除鱼骨的一片鱼肉一起记，再用 filett tal-ħut 巩固“去骨鱼片”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A boy or girl in relation to their godfather or godmother.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 相对于其教父或教母而言的男孩或女孩，即教子或教女。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tifel jew tifla fir-relazzjoni tiegħu jew tagħha mal-parrinu jew mal-parrina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 教子或教女，即由某人担任教父或教母的孩子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tifel jew tifla li persuna tkun aċċettat li tkun il-parrinu jew il-parrina tiegħu jew tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone's godson or goddaughter is a child for whom that person has become a godparent.

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tagħha, il-parrina awgurat lill-filjozz tagħha suċċess fl-istudji tiegħu.
formal.en: In her letter, the godmother wished her godson success in his studies.
formal.zh: 教母在信中祝愿她的教子学业顺利。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għal min hu dan il-ktieb? Ġorġ: Għall-filjozz tiegħi. Għada jagħlaq tmien snin. Rita: Kemm hu sabiħ! Żgur se jieħu gost bih.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who is this book for? Ġorġ: My godson. He turns eight tomorrow. Rita: How lovely! I'm sure he'll enjoy it.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这本书是送给谁的？Ġorġ：送给我的教子。他明天就八岁了。Rita：真好！他一定会喜欢的。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书是送给谁的？
messages.en: Who is this book for?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (教父)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-filjozz tiegħi. Għada jagħlaq tmien snin.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-filjozz tiegħi. Għada jagħlaq tmien snin.
messages.zh: 送给我的教子。他明天就八岁了。
messages.en: My godson. He turns eight tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu sabiħ! Żgur se jieħu gost bih.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu sabiħ! Żgur se jieħu gost bih.
messages.zh: 真好！他一定会喜欢的。
messages.en: How lovely! I'm sure he'll enjoy it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“教父为教子挑生日礼物”的场景记住 filjozz；学习时把它放进教父母与孩子的关系中理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Material used to fill an empty space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于填满空隙或空处的材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal li jintuża biex jimla vojt jew spazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 填充物；用来填补空隙的材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjal imqiegħed fi spazju vojt sabiex jimlieh.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fill is material that is put into an empty space in order to occupy it.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema żiedu filliera ta' ramel biex jimlew il-vojt taħt iċ-ċangaturi.
formal.en: The workers added sand fill to fill the gap beneath the paving slabs.
formal.zh: 工人添加了砂填料，以填满铺路板下方的空隙。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għad hemm vojt taħt din iċ-ċangatura. Mark: Għandna bżonn ftit filliera oħra. Nina: Tajjeb, inġib aktar ramel.
colloquial.en: Nina: There's still a gap under this paving slab. Mark: We need a little more fill. Nina: All right, I'll bring more sand.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这块铺路板下面还有空隙。Mark：我们还需要一点填料。Nina：好，我再拿些砂来。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad hemm vojt taħt din iċ-ċangatura.
messages.mt_standard: Għad hemm vojt taħt din iċ-ċangatura.
messages.zh: 这块铺路板下面还有空隙。
messages.en: There's still a gap under this paving slab.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 我们还需要一点填料。
messages.en: We need a little more fill.

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 好，我再拿些砂来。
messages.en: All right, I'll bring more sand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词包的 fill 义，把 filliera 与“用砂填满板下空隙”的画面关联，记住填料是放入空处的材料。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Material placed in a damaged tooth to fill a cavity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 牙医用来填补牙齿龋洞或缺损的材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal li d-dentist iqiegħed f'ħofra f'sinna biex jimlieha u jsewwiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于填补牙齿龋洞或缺损的补牙材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Filling huwa materjal li jitqiegħed f'ħofra f'sinna biex jagħlaqha u jsewwi s-sinna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A filling is material that a dentist puts into a cavity to repair a tooth.

collocations.en: a filling that has fallen out

formal.mt: Id-dentist eżamina s-sinna u poġġa filling ġdid biex jimla l-ħofra.
formal.en: The dentist examined the tooth and placed a new filling to fill the cavity.
formal.zh: 牙医检查了这颗牙，并放入新的补牙材料来填补龋洞。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Waqagħli l-filling waqt li kont qed niekol. Pawlu: Ċempel lid-dentist biex jagħtik appuntament.
colloquial.en: Lara: My filling fell out while I was eating. Pawlu: Call the dentist to make an appointment.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我吃东西的时候，补牙填充物掉了。Pawlu：打电话给牙医约个时间吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Waqagħli l-filling waqt li kont qed niekol.
messages.mt_standard: Waqagħli l-filling waqt li kont qed niekol.
messages.zh: 我吃东西的时候，补牙填充物掉了。
messages.en: My filling fell out while I was eating.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 打电话给牙医约个时间吧。
messages.en: Call the dentist to make an appointment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 filling 和牙齿上的小洞联系起来：牙医把洞填好，留下的补牙填充物就是 filling。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strip of material used to record photographs or moving images, or a movie.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于记录照片或活动影像的胶片，也指供观看的电影作品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strixxa ta' materjal li tintuża biex tirrekordja ritratti jew stampi li jiċċaqilqu, jew xogħol ċinematografiku li n-nies jaraw.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于记录照片或活动影像的感光胶片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Film huwa strixxa ta' materjal sensittiv għad-dawl li tintuża f'kamera biex tirrekordja ritratti jew stampi li jiċċaqilqu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Film is a strip of light-sensitive material used in a camera to record photographs or moving images.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由连续活动影像构成、供人观看的电影作品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Film huwa xogħol ċinematografiku magħmul minn sensiela ta' stampi li jiċċaqilqu, li jirrakkonta storja jew jippreżenta suġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A movie is a work of moving images that tells a story or presents a subject for viewers.

formal.mt: Il-mużew juri kif il-film kien jintuża fil-kameras biex jiġu rrekordjati ritratti.
formal.en: The museum shows how film was used in cameras to record photographs.
formal.zh: 博物馆展示了过去如何在相机中使用胶片来记录照片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tara film illejla? Mark: Iva, ejja nagħżlu kummiedja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to watch a movie tonight? Mark: Yes, let's choose a comedy.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今晚想看部电影吗？Mark：想，我们选部喜剧吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今晚想看部电影吗？
messages.en: Do you want to watch a movie tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，我们选部喜剧吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's choose a comedy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 film：相机里的一卷胶片，以及影院里的一部电影；结合句子判断具体含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A recorded sequence of moving images, especially one showing an event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 录制下来的活动影像片段，尤其指记录某个事件的录像。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reġistrazzjoni ta' stampi li jiċċaqilqu, speċjalment waħda li turi avveniment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由录制的活动影像构成的影片或视频片段。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Filmat huwa reġistrazzjoni ta' stampi li jiċċaqilqu li tista' tintwera fuq skrin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A film in this sense is a recorded sequence of moving images that can be shown on a screen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拍摄并记录某个事件或活动的录像。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Filmat huwa reġistrazzjoni ta' avveniment li turi dak li ġara waqt dak l-avveniment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A filmed event is a recording that shows what happened during a particular occasion or incident.

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa ntwera filmat tal-avveniment biex il-parteċipanti setgħu jaraw x'ġara.
formal.en: A recording of the event was shown during the meeting so that participants could see what happened.
formal.zh: 会议期间播放了该事件的录像，让与会者能够了解当时发生的情况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajt il-filmat tat-tieġ? Toni: Iva, rajtu lbieraħ. Il-parti taż-żfin kienet sabiħa ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you seen the wedding video? Toni: Yes, I watched it yesterday. The dancing part was lovely.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你看婚礼录像了吗？Toni：看了，我昨天看的。跳舞那一段特别美。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看婚礼录像了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the wedding video?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, rajtu lbieraħ. Il-parti taż-żfin kienet sabiħa ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, rajtu lbieraħ. Il-parti taż-żfin kienet sabiħa ħafna.
messages.zh: 看了，我昨天看的。跳舞那一段特别美。
messages.en: Yes, I watched it yesterday. The dancing part was lovely.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 filmat 配上一段婚礼录像来记：打开视频，重看当天发生的事情，这段影像就是 filmat。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who studies or develops ideas about knowledge, existence, values, and reasoning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究知识、存在、价值和推理等根本问题，或提出相关思想的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tistudja jew tiżviluppa ideat dwar il-għarfien, l-eżistenza, il-valuri u r-raġunament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 系统思考或研究知识、存在、价值等根本问题的哲学家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Filosofu huwa persuna li tistudja l-filosofija jew tiżviluppa ideat dwar mistoqsijiet fundamentali, bħal x'nistgħu nkunu nafu u kif għandna ngħixu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A philosopher is someone who studies fundamental questions about reality, knowledge, values, and how people should live.

formal.mt: Fl-esej tagħha, l-istudenta spjegat kif il-filosofu jiddistingwi bejn l-għarfien u l-opinjoni.
formal.en: In her essay, the student explained how the philosopher distinguishes between knowledge and opinion.
formal.zh: 这名学生在论文中解释了这位哲学家如何区分知识与意见。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hu l-awtur ta' dan il-ktieb? David: Huwa filosofu li jikteb dwar kif għandna ngħixu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is the author of this book? David: He is a philosopher who writes about how we should live.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这本书的作者是谁？David：他是一位哲学家，写的是我们应该如何生活。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu l-awtur ta' dan il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu l-awtur ta' dan il-ktieb?
messages.zh: 这本书的作者是谁？
messages.en: Who is the author of this book?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa filosofu li jikteb dwar kif għandna ngħixu.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa filosofu li jikteb dwar kif għandna ngħixu.
messages.zh: 他是一位哲学家，写的是我们应该如何生活。
messages.en: He is a philosopher who writes about how we should live.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位不断追问“什么是知识、怎样生活才好”的思想者，把这个人物形象与 filosofu 联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of passing a liquid or gas through a filter to remove unwanted particles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使液体或气体通过过滤器，以去除其中不需要的颗粒的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih likwidu jew gass jgħaddi minn filtru biex jitneħħew minnu frak jew sustanzi mhux mixtieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用过滤器去除液体或气体中不需要的物质的操作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tgħaddi likwidu jew gass minn filtru biex tneħħi minnu materjal mhux mixtieq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Filtering is the action of using a filter to remove unwanted material from a liquid or gas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使液体或气体通过能截留颗粒的材料，从而分离出这些颗粒的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess ta' separazzjoni li fih likwidu jew gass jgħaddi minn materjal li jħallih jgħaddi iżda jżomm lura ċerti partiċelli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Filtration is a process in which a liquid or gas passes through material that traps certain particles.

formal.mt: Wara l-filtrazzjoni, l-ilma kellu inqas partiċelli sospiżi.
formal.en: After filtration, the water contained fewer suspended particles.
formal.zh: 过滤之后，水中的悬浮颗粒减少了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tgħaddi l-ilma minn dan il-filtru? Toni: Qed nagħmel filtrazzjoni biex inneħħi l-frak li hemm fih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you passing the water through this filter? Toni: I'm filtering it to remove the particles in it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把水倒进这个过滤器里过滤？托尼：我在做过滤，把里面的颗粒去掉。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tgħaddi l-ilma minn dan il-filtru?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tgħaddi l-ilma minn dan il-filtru?
messages.zh: 你为什么把水倒进这个过滤器里过滤？
messages.en: Why are you passing the water through this filter?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel filtrazzjoni biex inneħħi l-frak li hemm fih.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel filtrazzjoni biex inneħħi l-frak li hemm fih.
messages.zh: 我在做过滤，把里面的颗粒去掉。
messages.en: I'm filtering it to remove the particles in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把滤水过程想成一段小电影：水流通过、颗粒留下。filtrazzjoni 记整段“过滤过程”，并用 sistema ta' filtrazzjoni“过滤系统”巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device or material that removes unwanted particles from a liquid or gas passing through it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让液体或气体通过，同时截留其中不需要的颗粒的装置或材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat jew materjal li jżomm lura frak jew partiċelli mhux mixtieqa meta likwidu jew gass jgħaddi minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于截留杂质的过滤装置或过滤材料，如过滤器、滤芯或滤网。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat jew materjal li minnu jgħaddi likwidu jew gass u li jżomm lura ċerti impuritajiet jew partiċelli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A filter is a device or material that allows a liquid or gas through while retaining unwanted particles.

formal.mt: Il-filtru tal-arja għandu jinbidel skont l-istruzzjonijiet tal-manifattur.
formal.en: The air filter should be replaced according to the manufacturer's instructions.
formal.zh: 应按照制造商的说明更换空气过滤器。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-filtru tal-ilma ilu ma jinbidel? Mark: Iva, se nixtri wieħed ġdid illum.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has it been a long time since this water filter was replaced? Mark: Yes, I'll buy a new one today.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个滤水器的滤芯是不是很久没换了？马克：是的，我今天会买一个新的。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-filtru tal-ilma ilu ma jinbidel?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-filtru tal-ilma ilu ma jinbidel?
messages.zh: 这个滤水器的滤芯是不是很久没换了？
messages.en: Has it been a long time since this water filter was replaced?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nixtri wieħed ġdid illum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nixtri wieħed ġdid illum.
messages.zh: 是的，我今天会买一个新的。
messages.en: Yes, I'll buy a new one today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手里拿着一个能更换的滤芯：filtru 指这件过滤工具。再配对记忆：filtru 是“器具”，filtrazzjoni 是“过滤过程”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used in the expression 'filwaqt li' to indicate that two situations occur at the same time or to contrast them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于表达 filwaqt li，表示两个情况同时发生，或引出两个情况之间的对比。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża fl-espressjoni 'filwaqt li' biex juri li żewġ sitwazzjonijiet iseħħu fl-istess ħin jew biex jesprimi kuntrast bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在 filwaqt li 中表示“当……时、在……的同时”，也可表示对比意义的“而、然而”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fl-espressjoni 'filwaqt li', jindika li xi ħaġa sseħħ fl-istess ħin bħal oħra, jew jintroduċi sitwazzjoni li tikkuntrasta ma' oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use 'filwaqt li' when two things happen at the same time or when you contrast two situations.

formal.mt: Xi studenti jippreferu jaħdmu waħedhom, filwaqt li oħrajn jitgħallmu aħjar fi grupp.
formal.en: Some students prefer to work alone, while others learn better in a group.
formal.zh: 有些学生喜欢独立学习，而另一些学生在小组中学得更好。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Jien naqra r-riċetta filwaqt li inti tħallat. Toni: Sewwa, għidli x'għandi nżid issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'll read the recipe while you mix. Toni: All right, tell me what I should add now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你来搅拌，我同时念食谱。托尼：好，告诉我现在该加什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien naqra r-riċetta filwaqt li inti tħallat.
messages.mt_standard: Jien naqra r-riċetta filwaqt li inti tħallat.
messages.zh: 你来搅拌，我同时念食谱。
messages.en: I'll read the recipe while you mix.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，告诉我现在该加什么。
messages.en: All right, tell me what I should add now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 filwaqt li 整块记成两条并排的轨道：两件事一起发生时译“同时”，两种情况相比较时译“而”。先判断句意，再选择中文表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Delicate in texture, subtle in effect or distinction, or made with careful attention to small details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容质地细腻、效果或差别微妙，或制作时注重细节、做工精细。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa delikata fin-nisġa, effett jew differenza li ma tidhirx mal-ewwel, jew xogħol magħmul b'attenzjoni kbira għad-dettall.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 质地细腻、轻柔或纤细的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu nisġa ħafifa u delikata jew dehra rqiqa u eleganti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is delicate has a light, fine texture or a slender and graceful appearance.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 细微而不易立即察觉或辨别的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li huwa żgħir jew mhux ovvju u jeħtieġ attenzjoni biex wieħed jinduna bih jew jifhmu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A subtle difference or effect is not immediately obvious and requires careful attention to notice.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 制作精细、细节处理讲究且质量好的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li huwa magħmul b'sengħa, bi preċiżjoni u b'attenzjoni għad-dettalji żgħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fine work is made with skill and careful attention to even the smallest details.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega d-differenza fina bejn iż-żewġ kunċetti permezz ta' eżempji ċari.
formal.en: The report explains the subtle difference between the two concepts through clear examples.
formal.zh: 报告通过清晰的例子解释了这两个概念之间的细微差别。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħoss dan id-drapp; kemm hu fin! Nina: Veru, huwa artab ħafna. Nagħżlu dan għall-libsa?
colloquial.en: Lara: Feel this fabric; it's so delicate! Nina: It really is very soft. Shall we choose this one for the dress?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：摸摸这块布，多细腻啊！妮娜：确实，很柔软。我们选它来做裙子好吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħoss dan id-drapp; kemm hu fin!
messages.mt_standard: Ħoss dan id-drapp; kemm hu fin!
messages.zh: 摸摸这块布，多细腻啊！
messages.en: Feel this fabric; it's so delicate!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, huwa artab ħafna. Nagħżlu dan għall-libsa?
messages.mt_standard: Veru, huwa artab ħafna. Nagħżlu dan għall-libsa?
messages.zh: 确实，很柔软。我们选它来做裙子好吗？
messages.en: It really is very soft. Shall we choose this one for the dress?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文“细”串联三个场景：手摸布料是“细腻”，比较意思是“细微”，观察做工是“精细”。搭配记 drapp fin、differenza fina、xogħol fin。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming last in a sequence or representing the completed decision or result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于一个过程或次序的最后阶段的，或表示决定、结果已经确定的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġi fl-aħħar ta' sensiela jew proċess, jew li jirrappreżenta deċiżjoni jew riżultat li jkun ġie stabbilit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最后的；最终确定的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun l-aħħar wieħed f'sensiela jew li juri l-għażla jew ir-riżultat li jkun ġie deċiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is final comes last in a process or represents a decision that has been settled.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat se jħabbar id-deċiżjoni finali wara li jeżamina r-rapport.
formal.en: The committee will announce the final decision after examining the report.
formal.zh: 委员会将在审阅报告后公布最终决定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din hi l-verżjoni finali tal-istedina? Mark: Iva, tista' tibgħatha lill-ħbieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this the final version of the invitation? Mark: Yes, you can send it to our friends.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是邀请函的最终版本吗？马克：是的，你可以发给朋友们了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是邀请函的最终版本吗？
messages.en: Is this the final version of the invitation?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，你可以发给朋友们了。
messages.en: Yes, you can send it to our friends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 finali 放在流程终点来记：草稿反复修改，最后得到 verżjoni finali，也就是最终版本。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An asset such as money, a share, or a bond that has financial value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有金融价值的资产，例如现金、股票或债券；对应的马耳他语表达为 assi finanzjarju。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Assi bħal flus, sehem jew bond li għandu valur finanzjarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 金融资产，例如现金、股票或债券。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Assi li għandu valur finanzjarju, bħal flus, sehem f'kumpanija jew bond.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A financial asset is something such as money, a share, or a bond that has financial value.

collocations.en: the value of a financial asset
the purchase of a financial asset
the sale of a financial asset

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika l-valur ta' kull assi finanzjarju li għandha l-kumpanija.
formal.en: The report indicates the value of each financial asset held by the company.
formal.zh: 报告列明了公司持有的每项金融资产的价值。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu assi finanzjarju? Mark: Sehem f'kumpanija huwa eżempju ta' assi finanzjarju.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is a financial asset? Mark: A share in a company is an example of a financial asset.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：什么是金融资产？马克：公司的股票就是金融资产的一个例子。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是金融资产？
messages.en: What is a financial asset?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Sehem f'kumpanija huwa eżempju ta' assi finanzjarju.
messages.mt_standard: Sehem f'kumpanija huwa eżempju ta' assi finanzjarju.
messages.zh: 公司的股票就是金融资产的一个例子。
messages.en: A share in a company is an example of a financial asset.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用双语配对记忆：financial asset 对应 assi finanzjarju；脑中放一张股票卡片，再联想到中文“金融资产”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A window in a roof that allows daylight to enter a building from above.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设置在屋顶上、让日光从上方进入室内的窗户。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tieqa fis-saqaf li tħalli d-dawl tax-xemx jidħol fil-bini minn fuq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天窗，即安装在屋顶上以引入自然光的窗户。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tieqa magħmula fis-saqaf ta' bini biex id-dawl naturali jkun jista' jidħol minn fuq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A skylight is a window in a roof that lets natural light enter a room from above.

formal.mt: Il-pjan jinkludi finestrun fis-saqaf biex jidħol aktar dawl naturali fil-kamra.
formal.en: The plan includes a skylight in the roof to bring more natural light into the room.
formal.zh: 该方案包括在屋顶安装一扇天窗，以便让更多自然光进入房间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn ġej dan id-dawl kollu? Mark: Mill-finestrun. Ħares 'il fuq!
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is all this light coming from? Mark: From the skylight. Look up!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这么多光是从哪里照进来的？马克：从天窗照进来的。抬头看！

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġej dan id-dawl kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġej dan id-dawl kollu?
messages.zh: 这么多光是从哪里照进来的？
messages.en: Where is all this light coming from?

messages.speaker: Mark (房主)
messages.zh: 从天窗照进来的。抬头看！
messages.en: From the skylight. Look up!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 finestrun 时配上“抬头找光”的画面：阳光穿过屋顶的窗户落在地板上，这扇窗就是天窗。

gloss_zh: 微妙之处；细腻；巧妙娴熟的手法

teaching_sense.en_definition: A delicate quality or distinction, or skill in handling something with care and precision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不易直接察觉的细腻特点或微妙差别，也指处理事情时表现出的精巧、娴熟和分寸感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kwalità delikata jew differenza sottili, jew ħila li biha wieħed jittratta xi ħaġa b'attenzjoni, preċiżjoni u tattika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 细腻、微妙的特点，或需要仔细体会才能察觉的差别。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kwalità jew differenza delikata li ma tkunx tidher mill-ewwel u li teħtieġ attenzjoni biex tinftiehem jew tiġi apprezzata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Subtlety is a delicate quality or distinction that requires careful attention to notice or understand.
