sense_translations.zh_definition: 处理事情时表现出的精巧娴熟，尤其指兼具技巧与分寸的做法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħila li biha wieħed iwettaq xogħol jew jittratta sitwazzjoni b'mod delikat, preċiż u għaqli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Finesse is the skill you show when you handle a task or situation with delicacy and precision.

collocations.en: to handle a situation with finesse
collocations.zh: 巧妙而有分寸地处理局面

collocations.en: to perform a piece of music with finesse
collocations.zh: 以细腻娴熟的技巧演奏乐曲

formal.mt: L-analiżi turi l-finezza tal-espressjoni tal-awtur u l-ħila tiegħu li jittratta suġġett delikat b'finezza.
formal.en: The analysis shows the subtlety of the author's expression and his ability to handle a sensitive subject with finesse.
formal.zh: 这篇分析展示了作者表达的细腻之处，以及他巧妙而有分寸地处理敏感题材的能力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif se tgħidlu li ma taqbilx miegħu? Mark: Se nitkellem miegħu b'finezza u nispjegalu għaliex.
colloquial.en: Maja: How will you tell him that you disagree with him? Mark: I'll speak to him tactfully and explain why.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要怎么告诉他，你不同意他的看法？马克：我会有分寸地跟他说，并解释原因。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se tgħidlu li ma taqbilx miegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se tgħidlu li ma taqbilx miegħu?
messages.zh: 你要怎么告诉他，你不同意他的看法？
messages.en: How will you tell him that you disagree with him?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nitkellem miegħu b'finezza u nispjegalu għaliex.
messages.mt_standard: Se nitkellem miegħu b'finezza u nispjegalu għaliex.
messages.zh: 我会有分寸地跟他说，并解释原因。
messages.en: I'll speak to him tactfully and explain why.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“细”串起 finezza 的两个义项：读作品时体会细微之处，处理难题时讲究细腻手法；前者重感知，后者重技巧。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The fingers of the hands, expressed in Maltese as swaba' tal-idejn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 手上的指头；马耳他语可用 swaba' tal-idejn 表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-swaba' tal-idejn huma l-partijiet li bihom naqbdu l-oġġetti, immissuhom u nagħmlu movimenti żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手指，即手上用于抓握、触摸等动作的部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-swaba' huma l-partijiet tal-id li nużaw biex naqbdu, inżommu u mmissu l-oġġetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your fingers are the parts of your hands that you use to hold and touch things.

formal.mt: Qabel tibda l-eżerċizzju, iftaħ idejk u ċaqlaq is-swaba' bil-mod.
formal.en: Before starting the exercise, open your hands and move your fingers slowly.
formal.zh: 开始练习前，张开双手，缓慢活动手指。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tħokk idejk? • Pawlu: Is-swaba' tiegħi kesħin ħafna. • Maja: Ilbes l-ingwanti tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you rubbing your hands? • Pawlu: My fingers are very cold. • Maja: Put on my gloves.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么在搓手？ • 保罗：我的手指很冷。 • 玛雅：戴上我的手套吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在搓手？
messages.en: Why are you rubbing your hands?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的手指很冷。
messages.en: My fingers are very cold.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 戴上我的手套吧。
messages.en: Put on my gloves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 伸出双手并活动手指，同时读 swaba' tal-idejn，把整个短语与眼前的手指动作联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that is finished is complete; something that is finite has a limit in size, number, or extent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可表示已经完成、达到最终状态的；也可表示在大小、数量或范围上有限的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Finit jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tlestiet, jew xi ħaġa li għandha limitu fid-daqs, fl-għadd jew fil-firxa tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已完成的；已经完成制作或处理、达到最终状态的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa finita hija xi ħaġa li tlestiet u waslet għall-istat finali tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is finished has been completed and has reached its final state.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有限的；在数量、大小或范围上存在界限的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa finita għandha limitu fl-għadd, fid-daqs jew fil-firxa tagħha u mhijiex bla tarf.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is finite has a limit to its size, number, or extent.

formal.mt: Dan is-sett fih numru finit ta' elementi, u għalhekk nistgħu ngħodduhom kollha.
formal.en: This set contains a finite number of elements, so we can count them all.
formal.zh: 这个集合包含有限数量的元素，因此我们可以逐一数出全部元素。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dan il-mudell għadu qed jinħadem? • Toni: Le, dan huwa l-prodott finit. • Marta: Mela nista' nieħu ritratt tiegħu?
colloquial.en: Marta: Is this model still being worked on? • Toni: No, this is the finished product. • Marta: Then can I take a photo of it?
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这个模型还在制作中吗？ • 托尼：没有，这就是成品了。 • 玛尔塔：那我可以给它拍张照吗？

messages.speaker: Marta (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个模型还在制作中吗？
messages.en: Is this model still being worked on?

messages.speaker: Toni (工匠)
messages.zh: 没有，这就是成品了。
messages.en: No, this is the finished product.

messages.speaker: Marta (顾客)
messages.zh: 那我可以给它拍张照吗？
messages.en: Then can I take a photo of it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 finit 画两张学习图：一张成品打勾，记“完成的”；一张圈住若干圆点，记“有限的”，用搭配区分两义。

gloss_zh: 关于海关事务；就海关事项而言

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used to specify that a statement concerns customs matters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于限定讨论范围的表达，表示所说内容涉及海关事务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex tindika li dak li jingħad jirreferi għal kwistjonijiet relatati mad-dwana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关于海关事务；用于说明某项陈述、安排或行动所涉及的范围是海关事项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din l-espressjoni tfisser li dikjarazzjoni, arranġament jew azzjoni tirrigwarda kwistjonijiet relatati mad-dwana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something applies in respect of customs matters, it concerns issues relating to customs.

collocations.en: cooperation in respect of customs matters
information in respect of customs matters

formal.mt: Dan id-dokument jiddeskrivi l-kooperazzjoni bejn iż-żewġ uffiċċji fir-rigward ta' materji doganali.
formal.en: This document describes cooperation between the two offices in respect of customs matters.
formal.zh: 本文件说明两个办事机构在海关事务方面的合作。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'tgħid l-ittra fir-rigward ta' materji doganali? Rita: Tgħid li għandna nikkuntattjaw lid-dwana qabel nibagħtu l-pakkett.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does the letter say in respect of customs matters? Rita: It says we should contact customs before sending the parcel.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这封信关于海关事项说了些什么？丽塔：信上说，我们应该在寄包裹之前联系海关。

messages.speaker: Mark (寄件人)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tgħid l-ittra fir-rigward ta' materji doganali?
messages.mt_standard: X'tgħid l-ittra fir-rigward ta' materji doganali?
messages.zh: 这封信关于海关事项说了些什么？
messages.en: What does the letter say in respect of customs matters?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħid li għandna nikkuntattjaw lid-dwana qabel nibagħtu l-pakkett.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħid li għandna nikkuntattjaw lid-dwana qabel nibagħtu l-pakkett.
messages.zh: 信上说，我们应该在寄包裹之前联系海关。
messages.en: It says we should contact customs before sending the parcel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意义分块记忆：fir-rigward ta' 对应“关于”，materji doganali 对应“海关事务”；想象文件中标出海关事项的一栏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A separation in which people or things become apart, including the parting of people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或事物彼此分开；也指人与人之间的离别。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Firda hija l-fatt jew il-proċess li persuni jew affarijiet jinfirdu minn xulxin, inkluż meta n-nies ikollhom jitilqu minn ħdejn xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分离；原本相聚、相连或在一起的人或事物彼此分开，也可指离别。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Firda sseħħ meta persuni jew affarijiet li kienu flimkien jinfirdu jew jibqgħu 'l bogħod minn xulxin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A separation is a situation or event in which people or things become apart from one another.

formal.mt: Wara firda twila, il-membri tal-familja reġgħu ltaqgħu u qattgħu ġurnata flimkien.
formal.en: After a long separation, the family members met again and spent a day together.
formal.zh: 经过长时间的分离，家人再次相聚，一起度过了一天。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se nħoss in-nuqqas tiegħek meta titlaq. • Marija: Jien ukoll, imma l-firda mhux se tkun twila. • Sara: Inċemplulek kull ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: I'll miss you when you leave. • Marija: I'll miss you too, but the separation won't be long. • Sara: We'll call you every week.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你走后，我会想你的。 • 玛丽亚：我也会想你，不过我们不会分开很久。 • 萨拉：我们每周都会给你打电话。

messages.speaker: Sara (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nħoss in-nuqqas tiegħek meta titlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Se nħoss in-nuqqas tiegħek meta titlaq.
messages.zh: 你走后，我会想你的。
messages.en: I'll miss you when you leave.

messages.speaker: Marija (妹妹)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien ukoll, imma l-firda mhux se tkun twila.
messages.mt_standard: Jien ukoll, imma l-firda mhux se tkun twila.
messages.zh: 我也会想你，不过我们不会分开很久。
messages.en: I'll miss you too, but the separation won't be long.

messages.speaker: Sara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 我们每周都会给你打电话。
messages.en: We'll call you every week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两位亲人在车站挥手离别，把中间拉开的距离标成 firda，再用 firda twila 记住“长时间的分离”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Firenze is the name of the city called Florence in English.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 城市专名，指英语称为 Florence 的佛罗伦萨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Firenze huwa l-isem tal-belt magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala Florence.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 佛罗伦萨，城市专名，对应英语名称 Florence。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Firenze huwa isem proprju li jirreferi għall-belt li bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ Florence.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Firenze is the city name that corresponds to Florence in English.

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-vjaġġ jinkludi żjara f'Firenze u ħin liberu biex il-parteċipanti jesploraw il-belt.
formal.en: The travel programme includes a visit to Florence and free time for participants to explore the city.
formal.zh: 行程安排包括游览佛罗伦萨，以及供参与者自由探索这座城市的时间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn sejjer fi tmiem il-ġimgħa? • Mark: Se mmur Firenze ma' oħti. • Lara: Kemm se ddumu hemm?
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are you going this weekend? • Mark: I'm going to Florence with my sister. • Lara: How long will you stay there?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你周末要去哪里？ • 马克：我要和姐姐去佛罗伦萨。 • 拉拉：你们要在那里待多久？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你周末要去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going this weekend?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要和姐姐去佛罗伦萨。
messages.en: I'm going to Florence with my sister.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们要在那里待多久？
messages.en: How long will you stay there?

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三语地名卡，把 Firenze、Florence、佛罗伦萨并排写在一起，再用 f'Firenze 练习表达“在佛罗伦萨”。

gloss_zh: 马耳他传统低矮短身帆桨渔船

teaching_sense.en_definition: A traditional Maltese fishing boat with a short, low hull, propelled by a sail or oars.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他传统渔船的一种，船身短而低矮，使用帆或船桨行进。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dgħajsa tradizzjonali Maltija tas-sajd, qasira u baxxa, li timxi bil-qlugħ jew bl-imqadef.

sense_translations.en_definition: Traditional Maltese short, low, fishing boat with sail or ors.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种马耳他传统渔船，船身短而低矮，以帆或船桨推进。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-firilla hija dgħajsa tradizzjonali Maltija tas-sajd, b'buq qasir u baxx, li timxi bil-qlugħ jew bl-imqadef.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A firilla is a traditional Maltese fishing boat with a short, low hull that can be propelled by a sail or oars.

collocations.zh: 装有帆的传统短身渔船
这种传统短身渔船的船体

formal.mt: Il-mudell juri firilla, dgħajsa tradizzjonali Maltija tas-sajd b'buq qasir u baxx.
formal.en: The model depicts a firilla, a traditional Maltese fishing boat with a short, low hull.
formal.zh: 这个模型展示的是一种名为 firilla 的马耳他传统渔船，其船身短而低矮。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tip ta' dgħajsa hi dik? Pawlu: Dik firilla, dgħajsa tradizzjonali tas-sajd li timxi bil-qlugħ jew bl-imqadef.
colloquial.en: Maja: What kind of boat is that? Pawlu: That's a firilla, a traditional fishing boat propelled by a sail or oars.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那是什么船？保罗：那是 firilla，一种靠帆或船桨行进的传统渔船。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 那是什么船？
messages.en: What kind of boat is that?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik firilla, dgħajsa tradizzjonali tas-sajd li timxi bil-qlugħ jew bl-imqadef.
messages.mt_standard: Dik firilla, dgħajsa tradizzjonali tas-sajd li timxi bil-qlugħ jew bl-imqadef.
messages.zh: 那是 firilla，一种靠帆或船桨行进的传统渔船。
messages.en: That's a firilla, a traditional fishing boat propelled by a sail or oars.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 firilla 配上一幅短船身、低船舷的小渔船图，再画上帆和船桨，用画面记住这种马耳他传统渔船。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person's name written in their own hand to identify them or confirm a document.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本人亲笔写下的姓名，用于表明身份或确认文件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem li persuna tikteb b'idha stess biex turi l-identità tagħha jew tikkonferma dokument.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 本人亲笔书写的姓名，通常用于确认身份、同意内容或使文件得到签署。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-firma hija l-isem li persuna tikteb b'idha stess fuq dokument biex turi min hi jew li taqbel mal-kontenut tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your signature is your name written in your own hand, usually to identify yourself or show agreement with a document.

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, ikteb ismek u poġġi l-firma tiegħek fl-aħħar tal-formola.
formal.en: Please write your name and put your signature at the end of the form.
formal.zh: 请填写姓名，并在表格末尾签名。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn trid il-firma tiegħi? Rita: Hawn taħt, ħdejn id-data.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where do you need my signature? Rita: Down here, next to the date.
colloquial.zh: 马克：需要我在哪里签名？丽塔：在这下面，日期旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 需要我在哪里签名？
messages.en: Where do you need my signature?

messages.speaker: Rita (工作人员)
messages.zh: 在这下面，日期旁边。
messages.en: Down here, next to the date.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 firma 就想象表格底部的一条签名横线，线上写着你自己的姓名；把它记成纸上的签名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or party that signs a document, especially an agreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在文件上签名的人或签署方，尤其指协议的签署者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew parti li tiffirma dokument, speċjalment ftehim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 文件或协议的签署人；参与签署的个人或一方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Firmatarju huwa persuna jew parti li tkun iffirmat dokument jew ftehim.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A signatory to a document or agreement is a person or party that has signed it.

formal.mt: Kull firmatarju tal-ftehim għandu jirċievi kopja tad-dokument iffirmat.
formal.en: Each signatory to the agreement should receive a copy of the signed document.
formal.zh: 协议的每位签署人都应收到一份已签署文件的副本。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu l-firmatarju l-ieħor tal-ftehim? David: Jien. Niffirma wara li naqrah.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is the other signatory to the agreement? David: I am. I'll sign after I read it.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这份协议的另一位签署人是谁？戴维：是我。我看完就签。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 这份协议的另一位签署人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the other signatory to the agreement?

messages.speaker: David (签约人)
messages.zh: 是我。我看完就签。
messages.en: I am. I'll sign after I read it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张签约现场图记忆：纸上的签名是 firma，拿笔签署的人是 firmatarju；把注意力放在人物身上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sliding bar used to fasten a door or window.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过滑动销杆来扣住门或窗的插销。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Virga li tiżżerżaq biex iżżomm bieb jew tieqa magħluqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于扣紧门或窗的插销。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa li tiżżerżaq f'ħoloq jew f'toqba biex iżżomm bieb jew tieqa magħluqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bolt is a sliding bar that you move into position to keep a door or window closed.

collocations.en: fasten the door with the bolt

formal.mt: Qabel jitlaq, il-persunal għandu jagħlaq il-bieb ta' wara bil-firroll.
formal.en: Before leaving, staff must fasten the back door with the bolt.
formal.zh: 工作人员离开前须用插销扣好后门。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għalaqt il-bieb bil-firroll? Pawlu: Iva, imma l-firroll tat-tieqa għadu miftuħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you bolt the door? Pawlu: Yes, but the window bolt is still open.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你把门插销插好了吗？保罗：插好了，不过窗户的插销还开着。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你把门插销插好了吗？
messages.en: Did you bolt the door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-firroll tat-tieqa għadu miftuħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-firroll tat-tieqa għadu miftuħ.
messages.zh: 插好了，不过窗户的插销还开着。
messages.en: Yes, but the window bolt is still open.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 firroll 和关门后横推插销的动作一起记：看到门窗，就想起滑动销杆扣紧。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The range of frequencies within which frequency recovery can take place under specified conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在规定条件下能够进行频率恢复的频率范围。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-medda ta' frekwenzi li fiha jista' jsir l-irkupru tal-frekwenza taħt kundizzjonijiet speċifikati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在给定条件下可以实现频率恢复的频率范围。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-medda ta' frekwenzi li fiha jista' jseħħ il-proċess tal-irkupru tal-frekwenza skont il-kundizzjonijiet mogħtija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The frequency recovery range specifies the frequencies over which frequency recovery can occur under stated conditions.

collocations.en: the limits of the frequency recovery range

formal.mt: Ir-rapport għandu jindika l-firxa tal-irkupru tal-frekwenza u l-kundizzjonijiet li taħthom ġiet iddeterminata.
formal.en: The report must state the frequency recovery range and the conditions under which it was determined.
formal.zh: 报告须列明频率恢复范围及确定该范围时的条件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn insib il-firxa tal-irkupru tal-frekwenza? Mark: Fit-tabella ta' hawn taħt; hemm iż-żewġ limiti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where can I find the frequency recovery range? Mark: In the table below; both limits are there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：在哪里能找到频率恢复范围？马克：在下面的表格里，两个界限都列出来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 在哪里能找到频率恢复范围？
messages.en: Where can I find the frequency recovery range?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fit-tabella ta' hawn taħt; hemm iż-żewġ limiti.
messages.mt_standard: Fit-tabella ta' hawn taħt; hemm iż-żewġ limiti.
messages.zh: 在下面的表格里，两个界限都列出来了。
messages.en: In the table below; both limits are there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按词组分块记：firxa 是范围，irkupru 对应恢复，frekwenza 对应频率；想象图上标出恢复范围的两端。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The range of frequencies within which frequency restoration can take place under specified conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在规定条件下能够进行频率复原的频率范围。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-medda ta' frekwenzi li fiha jista' jsir ir-restawr tal-frekwenza taħt kundizzjonijiet speċifikati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在给定条件下可以实现频率复原的频率范围。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-medda ta' frekwenzi li fiha jista' jseħħ il-proċess tar-restawr tal-frekwenza skont il-kundizzjonijiet mogħtija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The frequency restoration range specifies the frequencies over which frequency restoration can occur under stated conditions.

collocations.en: the limits of the frequency restoration range

collocations.zh: 明确规定频率复原范围

formal.mt: L-ispeċifikazzjoni teknika għandha tiddefinixxi l-firxa tar-restawr tal-frekwenza u tagħti l-unitajiet tal-kejl.
formal.en: The technical specification must define the frequency restoration range and give the measurement units.
formal.zh: 技术规范须界定频率复原范围，并注明计量单位。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din hija l-firxa tar-restawr tal-frekwenza? Pawlu: Iva, ikteb il-limitu t'isfel u l-limitu ta' fuq ukoll.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this the frequency restoration range? Pawlu: Yes, write down the lower limit and the upper limit too.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这就是频率复原范围吗？保罗：对，把下限和上限也记下来。

messages.speaker: Sara (实习生)
messages.zh: 这就是频率复原范围吗？
messages.en: Is this the frequency restoration range?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ikteb il-limitu t'isfel u l-limitu ta' fuq ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ikteb il-limitu t'isfel u l-limitu ta' fuq ukoll.
messages.zh: 对，把下限和上限也记下来。
messages.en: Yes, write down the lower limit and the upper limit too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 restawr 与英文 restoration 配对记，再用 firxa 提醒自己这是范围；这种联想用于记词，不表示词源结论。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The difference between two market prices, such as a buying price and a selling price.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 市场中两个价格之间的差额，例如买入报价与卖出报价之差。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-differenza bejn żewġ prezzijiet fis-suq, bħall-prezz tax-xiri u l-prezz tal-bejgħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 市场价格之间的差额，可指买方报价与卖方报价之间的价差。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-differenza bejn żewġ prezzijiet fis-suq, pereżempju bejn il-prezz offrut mix-xerrej u l-prezz mitlub mill-bejjiegħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A market spread is the difference between two market prices, for example the prices quoted by buyers and sellers.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, il-prezz offrut mix-xerrej huwa €10 u dak mitlub mill-bejjiegħ huwa €12; għalhekk, il-firxa tas-suq hija €2.
formal.en: In this example, the buyer offers €10 and the seller asks €12; the market spread is therefore €2.
formal.zh: 在此例中，买方报价为10欧元，卖方要价为12欧元，因此市场价差为2欧元。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm hi l-firxa tas-suq jekk ix-xerrej joffri għaxra u l-bejjiegħ jitlob tnax? Sara: Żewġ ewro, għax tnaqqas għaxra minn tnax.
colloquial.en: Mark: What is the market spread if the buyer offers ten and the seller asks twelve? Sara: Two euros, because you subtract ten from twelve.
colloquial.zh: 马克：如果买方出十欧元，卖方要十二欧元，市场价差是多少？萨拉：两欧元，因为十二减十等于二。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hi l-firxa tas-suq jekk ix-xerrej joffri għaxra u l-bejjiegħ jitlob tnax?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hi l-firxa tas-suq jekk ix-xerrej joffri għaxra u l-bejjiegħ jitlob tnax?
messages.zh: 如果买方出十欧元，卖方要十二欧元，市场价差是多少？
messages.en: What is the market spread if the buyer offers ten and the seller asks twelve?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Żewġ ewro, għax tnaqqas għaxra minn tnax.
messages.mt_standard: Żewġ ewro, għax tnaqqas għaxra minn tnax.
messages.zh: 两欧元，因为十二减十等于二。
messages.en: Two euros, because you subtract ten from twelve.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象市场上买卖双方各举一个报价牌，两块牌子之间的数字差就是这里的 firxa tas-suq。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to public finances, especially government revenue, taxation, and spending.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与公共财政有关的，尤其涉及政府收入、税收和支出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-aġġettiv fiskali jiddeskrivi dak li għandu x'jaqsam mal-finanzi pubbliċi, speċjalment mad-dħul, it-taxxi u l-infiq tal-gvern.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 财政的，涉及政府税收、收入或公共支出的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa fiskali għandha x'taqsam mal-mod kif il-gvern jiġbor id-dħul u juża l-flus pubbliċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fiscal matters concern government finances, particularly taxation, revenue, and public spending.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif il-politika fiskali tista' tinfluwenza d-dħul u l-infiq tal-gvern.
formal.en: The report explains how fiscal policy can influence government revenue and spending.
formal.zh: 报告解释了财政政策如何影响政府收入和支出。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'inhi politika fiskali? Pawlu: Hija l-politika tal-gvern dwar it-taxxi u l-infiq pubbliku.
colloquial.en: Marija: What is fiscal policy? Pawlu: It is the government's policy on taxes and public spending.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：什么是财政政策？保罗：就是政府有关税收和公共支出的政策。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是财政政策？
messages.en: What is fiscal policy?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija l-politika tal-gvern dwar it-taxxi u l-infiq pubbliku.
messages.mt_standard: Hija l-politika tal-gvern dwar it-taxxi u l-infiq pubbliku.
messages.zh: 就是政府有关税收和公共支出的政策。
messages.en: It is the government's policy on taxes and public spending.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fiskali 放在政府收税与公共支出的账本旁记忆，看到 politika fiskali 就联想到财政政策。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A metal nail driven into a material to fasten things together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 敲入木材等材料中、用来固定或连接物件的金属钉子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fiskla hija musmar tal-metall li jiddaħħal f'materjal bħall-injam biex iwaħħal l-affarijiet flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于固定或连接物件的金属钉子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fiskla hija musmar b'tarf ippuntat li jintuża biex iwaħħal biċċiet ta' materjal flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fiskla is a metal nail used to fasten materials together.

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa waħħal iż-żewġ biċċiet tal-injam b'fiskla.
formal.en: The carpenter fastened the two pieces of wood together with a nail.
formal.zh: 木匠用一枚钉子把两块木材固定在一起。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Agħtini fiskla, jekk jogħġbok. Toni: Hawn waħda; trid il-martell ukoll?
colloquial.en: Lara: Pass me a nail, please. Toni: Here is one; do you want the hammer too?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：请递给我一枚钉子。托尼：给你；也要锤子吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 请递给我一枚钉子。
messages.en: Pass me a nail, please.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 给你；也要锤子吗？
messages.en: Here is one; do you want the hammer too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fiskla 与锤子敲钉子的画面一起记，再用“钉进去、拔出来”两个动作巩固词义。

gloss_zh: 宠儿；受宠爱的人或动物

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or animal treated with particular affection and special attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到格外疼爱和特别照顾的人或动物，即宠儿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fissud huwa persuna jew annimal li jingħata ħafna mħabba u attenzjoni speċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 格外受到某人或某个群体宠爱的人或动物；宠儿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fissud huwa persuna jew annimal li xi ħadd iħobb ħafna u jittratta bi ħlewwa u b'attenzjoni speċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone's pet is a person or animal they treat with particular affection and attention.

formal.mt: Il-qattus sar il-fissud tal-familja, u kull membru jieħu ħsiebu b'ħafna mħabba.
formal.en: The cat has become the family's darling, and every member cares for it with great affection.
formal.zh: 这只猫成了全家人的宠儿，每位家庭成员都十分疼爱地照顾它。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-kelb huwa l-fissud tad-dar! David: Veru, kulħadd irid joqgħod ħdejh u jilgħab miegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: This dog is the darling of the household! David: True, everyone wants to sit beside him and play with him.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这只狗可是家里的宠儿！戴维：确实，大家都想坐在它旁边，陪它玩。

messages.speaker: Nina (姐姐)
messages.zh: 这只狗可是家里的宠儿！
messages.en: This dog is the darling of the household!

messages.speaker: David (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, kulħadd irid joqgħod ħdejh u jilgħab miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, kulħadd irid joqgħod ħdejh u jilgħab miegħu.
messages.zh: 确实，大家都想坐在它旁边，陪它玩。
messages.en: True, everyone wants to sit beside him and play with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象全家围着一个宝贝疼爱的场景，把 fissud 记成“大家特别宠爱的那一个”。

gloss_zh: 挑剔的；纠缠不休的；冗烦的；令人厌烦的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Difficult to satisfy because of strong preferences about small details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对细节要求很多、很难满足的；挑剔的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna fitta tagħżel ħafna u tkun diffiċli biex tikkuntenta, anki dwar dettalji żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过分在意细节、难以满足的；挑剔的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna fitta tkun diffiċli biex tikkuntenta għax tagħżel ħafna u tagħti wisq importanza lil dettalji żgħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is finicky is difficult to please because they care excessively about small details.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为达到自己的目的而不断催逼或纠缠他人的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna fitta tibqa' tinsisti biex tikseb dak li trid, anki meta l-oħrajn ma jkunux iridu jew ikunu diġà rrifjutaw.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is pushy keeps pressing other people to do what they want.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因冗长、重复或繁琐而使人感到枯燥厌倦的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xogħol jew proċess fitt idejjaq għax ikun twil, ripetittiv jew mimli dettalji li jeħtieġu ħafna paċenzja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is tedious makes you bored because it is lengthy, repetitive, or full of dull details.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 让人心烦、厌倦或失去耐心的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa jew xi ħadd fitt idejjaq u jġiegħlek titlef il-paċenzja, speċjalment meta l-istess imġiba jew sitwazzjoni tibqa' tirrepeti ruħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something or someone that is tiresome annoys you and makes you lose patience.

formal.mt: Il-kontroll ta' kull dokument kien xogħol fitt, għax kien jeħtieġ li l-istess dettalji jiġu vverifikati ħafna drabi.
formal.en: Checking every document was tedious work because the same details had to be verified many times.
formal.zh: 逐份检查文件是一项繁琐枯燥的工作，因为相同的细节需要反复核实。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dak il-bejjiegħ kien fitt ħafna. Mark: Iva, baqa' jinsisti anki wara li għedtlu le.
colloquial.en: Sara: That salesperson was very pushy. Mark: Yes, he kept insisting even after I told him no.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那个推销员真是纠缠不休。马克：是啊，我拒绝后他还一直坚持推销。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 那个推销员真是纠缠不休。
messages.en: That salesperson was very pushy.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, baqa' jinsisti anki wara li għedtlu le.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, baqa' jinsisti anki wara li għedtlu le.
messages.zh: 是啊，我拒绝后他还一直坚持推销。
messages.en: Yes, he kept insisting even after I told him no.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四幅画面区分 fitt：吃饭挑细节、推销一直缠、工作反复做、噪声惹人烦；分别记住四个义项。

gloss_zh: 起诉；通过法律途径控告

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring a legal action against a person or organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向法院对某人或某个机构提起诉讼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tressaq kawża quddiem il-qorti kontra persuna jew organizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向法院起诉某人或某个机构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiftaħ kawża fil-qorti kontra persuna jew organizzazzjoni biex titlob rimedju legali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you sue someone, you bring a legal action against them in a court.

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, il-klijent spjega li kien se jfittex lill-kumpanija bil-liġi minħabba l-ħsara fil-proprjetà tiegħu.
formal.en: In his letter, the client explained that he was going to sue the company over the damage to his property.
formal.zh: 客户在信中说明，他将就自己的财产损失起诉该公司。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Se tfittex lill-kumpanija bil-liġi? Pawlu: Iva, għax għamlet ħsara fid-dar tiegħi u ma tridx tħallas għat-tiswijiet.
colloquial.en: Marija: Are you going to sue the company? Pawlu: Yes, because it damaged my house and refuses to pay for the repairs.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你打算起诉那家公司吗？保罗：是的，因为他们弄坏了我的房子，却不肯支付维修费用。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算起诉那家公司吗？
messages.en: Are you going to sue the company?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (房主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax għamlet ħsara fid-dar tiegħi u ma tridx tħallas għat-tiswijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax għamlet ħsara fid-dar tiegħi u ma tridx tħallas għat-tiswijiet.
messages.zh: 是的，因为他们弄坏了我的房子，却不肯支付维修费用。
messages.en: Yes, because it damaged my house and refuses to pay for the repairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和“递交诉状”的画面一起记：遇到财产纠纷，决定通过法院起诉，就用 fittex bil-liġi。

gloss_zh: 找词游戏；字母方格寻词题

teaching_sense.en_definition: A puzzle in which you find words hidden in a grid of letters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在字母方格中寻找隐藏单词的文字游戏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Logħba li fiha ssib kliem moħbi fi grilja ta' ittri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 找词游戏，要求从排列成方格的字母中找出隐藏的单词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taħbil il-moħħ li fih tfittex u timmarka kliem moħbi fost l-ittri ta' grilja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A wordsearch is a puzzle in which you look for hidden words within a grid of letters.

collocations.zh: 以动物为主题的找词游戏

formal.mt: L-għalliema qassmet fittiexa dwar l-annimali biex l-istudenti jirrevedu l-kliem li kienu tgħallmu.
formal.en: The teacher handed out a wordsearch about animals so that the students could review the words they had learned.
formal.zh: 老师发了一份以动物为主题的找词题，让学生复习学过的词汇。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Sibt il-kelma 'qattus' f'din il-fittiexa? Ben: Iva, qiegħda fit-tieni ringiela. Immarkaha bil-lapes.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you found the word 'cat' in this wordsearch? Ben: Yes, it's in the second row. Mark it with a pencil.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你在这道找词题里找到“猫”这个词了吗？本：找到了，在第二行。用铅笔标出来吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你在这道找词题里找到“猫”这个词了吗？
messages.en: Have you found the word 'cat' in this wordsearch?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħda fit-tieni ringiela. Immarkaha bil-lapes.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħda fit-tieni ringiela. Immarkaha bil-lapes.
messages.zh: 找到了，在第二行。用铅笔标出来吧。
messages.en: Yes, it's in the second row. Mark it with a pencil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张密密麻麻的字母方格，用铅笔把藏着的单词逐个圈出；把这个“方格里找词”的画面与 fittiexa 配对记忆。

gloss_zh: 游戏用仿制硬币；处境的谷底；belladonna 牌戏中的一种牌；骰子不计分的一面

teaching_sense.en_definition: An imitation coin used when playing games.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 玩游戏时使用的仿制硬币。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Munita finta li tintuża fil-logħob.

sense_translations.en_definition: an imitation coin used in games
sense_translations.zh_definition: 游戏中使用的仿制硬币。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett magħmul bħal munita li jintuża fil-logħob minflok flus veri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fixxa is an imitation coin that players use while playing games.

sense_translations.en_definition: rock bottom (when used as a description of a situation)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于描述处境时，指最糟糕的状态或最低谷。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-agħar stat li tkun waslet fih sitwazzjoni, meta tintuża biex tiddeskrivi dik is-sitwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a situation is described as rock bottom, it has reached its worst or lowest state.

sense_translations.en_definition: a card in the game of belladonna
sense_translations.zh_definition: belladonna 牌戏中的一种牌。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Karta fil-logħba tal-belladonna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In the game of belladonna, a fixxa is a particular card used in play.

sense_translations.en_definition: a side of a die that gains the player no points
sense_translations.zh_definition: 骰子上不能让玩家获得分数的一面。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Wiċċ ta' dada li ma jagħti ebda punt lill-plejer.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fixxa is a face of a die that gives the player no points.

collocations.zh: belladonna 牌戏中的 fixxa 牌

formal.mt: F'din il-logħba, jekk id-dada turi l-fixxa, il-plejer ma jikseb ebda punt.
formal.en: In this game, if the die shows the face called the fixxa, the player receives no points.
formal.zh: 在这项游戏中，如果骰子掷出称为 fixxa 的那一面，玩家便不得分。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din munita vera? Mark: Le, din fixxa li nużaw fil-logħob. Il-flus veri qegħdin fil-kartiera.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this a real coin? Mark: No, it's an imitation coin we use for games. The real money is in the wallet.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这是真硬币吗？马克：不是，这是我们玩游戏用的仿制硬币。真钱在钱包里。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是真硬币吗？
messages.en: Is this a real coin?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, din fixxa li nużaw fil-logħob. Il-flus veri qegħdin fil-kartiera.
messages.mt_standard: Le, din fixxa li nużaw fil-logħob. Il-flus veri qegħdin fil-kartiera.
messages.zh: 不是，这是我们玩游戏用的仿制硬币。真钱在钱包里。
messages.en: No, it's an imitation coin we use for games. The real money is in the wallet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 fixxa 做四格记忆卡：仿制硬币、处境谷底、belladonna 的牌、骰子零分面。按上下文选格，不把四个义项混成一个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who holds an authorized position in a government or organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在政府或其他机构中担任正式职务、执行公务或管理职责的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha kariga uffiċjali fi gvern jew f'organizzazzjoni u twettaq dmirijiet marbuta ma' dik il-kariga.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在政府、公共机构或组织中担任正式职务的人员；官员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna b'kariga rikonoxxuta fi ħdan gvern, istituzzjoni jew organizzazzjoni, li taġixxi skont ir-responsabbiltajiet tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An official is a person who holds a position of responsibility in a government or organization.

formal.mt: Il-fizzjal eżamina d-dokumenti qabel ma approva t-talba.
formal.en: The official examined the documents before approving the application.
formal.zh: 这名公务人员在批准申请之前审查了文件。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Ma' min għandi nitkellem dwar it-talba tiegħi? Rita: Kellem lill-fizzjal ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who should I speak to about my application? Rita: Speak to the official by the window.
colloquial.zh: 马克：关于我的申请，我应该找谁谈？丽塔：找窗边那位公务人员谈。

messages.speaker: Mark (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' min għandi nitkellem dwar it-talba tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Ma' min għandi nitkellem dwar it-talba tiegħi?
messages.zh: 关于我的申请，我应该找谁谈？
messages.en: Who should I speak to about my application?

messages.speaker: Rita (接待员)
messages.zh: 找窗边那位公务人员谈。
messages.en: Speak to the official by the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象办事窗口里审核申请、核对文件的人，把 fizzjal 记成“担任正式职务的人”；本条是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The science that studies matter, energy, motion, and their interactions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究物质、能量、运动及其相互作用的科学。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xjenza li tistudja l-materja, l-enerġija, il-moviment u l-interazzjonijiet bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 物理学，研究物质、能量、运动及其相互作用的科学学科。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qasam tax-xjenza li jistudja l-materja u l-enerġija, kif ukoll il-moviment u l-forzi li jaġixxu fuq l-oġġetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Physics is the branch of science concerned with matter, energy, motion, and the forces that affect them.

formal.mt: Matul il-lezzjoni tal-fiżika, l-istudenti kejlu l-veloċità ta' karrettun u qabblu r-riżultati tagħhom.
formal.en: During the physics lesson, the students measured the speed of a small cart and compared their results.
formal.zh: 在物理课上，学生们测量了一辆小车的速度，并比较了各自的结果。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandna l-fiżika llum? Luqa: Iva, wara l-matematika. Ġib il-pitazz, għax se nagħmlu esperiment.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do we have physics today? Luqa: Yes, after maths. Bring your notebook, because we're going to do an experiment.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们今天有物理课吗？卢卡：有，在数学课之后。带上笔记本，因为我们要做实验。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 我们今天有物理课吗？
messages.en: Do we have physics today?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, wara l-matematika. Ġib il-pitazz, għax se nagħmlu esperiment.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, wara l-matematika. Ġib il-pitazz, għax se nagħmlu esperiment.
messages.zh: 有，在数学课之后。带上笔记本，因为我们要做实验。
messages.en: Yes, after maths. Bring your notebook, because we're going to do an experiment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fiżika 和 physics 并排写在“物理学”旁，再画一辆正在测速度的小车，用词形联想和实验场景一起记住这个学科名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the body, material things, or physical processes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与身体、实际存在的物质或物理过程有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ġisem, ma' affarijiet materjali jew ma' proċessi fin-natura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体方面的；涉及物质、物体或物理过程的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-ġisem, il-materja jew il-proċessi li jseħħu fid-dinja materjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is physical concerns the body, material objects, or processes in the material world.

formal.mt: Ix-xogħol jinvolvi sforz fiżiku, speċjalment meta l-ħaddiema jġorru kaxxi tqal.
formal.en: The work involves physical exertion, especially when workers carry heavy boxes.
formal.zh: 这项工作需要付出体力，尤其是在工人搬运重箱子时。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex int daqshekk għajjien? Mark: Għamilt ħafna eżerċizzju fiżiku dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you so tired? Mark: I did a lot of physical exercise this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么这么累？马克：我今天早上做了很多体育锻炼。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么这么累？
messages.en: Why are you so tired?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今天早上做了很多体育锻炼。
messages.en: I did a lot of physical exercise this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fiżiku 和举重、跑步、身体接触的画面连起来，先记“身体的”，再扩展到物质和物理过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A portable source of light with a flame burning at one end.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一端燃烧、可以手持或携带的照明工具；火把或火炬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jinġarr u li jkollu fjamma taqbad f'tarf wieħed biex jagħti d-dawl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过一端燃烧的火焰提供照明的手持工具；火把、火炬。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda tad-dawl li tista' tinġarr, magħmula b'tarf li jinħaraq u jipproduċi fjamma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A torch is a portable light that produces a flame from burning material at one end.

formal.mt: Matul il-purċissjoni, kull parteċipant ġarr fjakkla mixgħula.
formal.en: During the procession, each participant carried a lit torch.
formal.zh: 游行期间，每位参与者都举着一支点燃的火把。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek fjakkla għall-purċissjoni? Pawlu: Iva, imma għadni ma xgħelthiex.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have a torch for the procession? Pawlu: Yes, but I haven't lit it yet.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你有参加游行用的火把吗？保罗：有，不过我还没点燃。

messages.speaker: Lara (游行参与者)
messages.zh: 你有参加游行用的火把吗？
messages.en: Do you have a torch for the procession?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (游行参与者)
messages.zh: 有，不过我还没点燃。
messages.en: Yes, but I haven't lit it yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 fjakkla 时想象夜间游行中手举火把、火焰照亮前路的画面，把“火焰”和“可携带”一起记。

gloss_zh: 火烈鸟的；与火烈鸟有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to or depicting a flamingo, a long-legged bird often having pink feathers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与火烈鸟有关的，或描绘火烈鸟的；火烈鸟是一种腿长、羽毛常呈粉红色的鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' għasfur b'saqajn twal, għonq twil u rix li spiss ikun roża, jew li juri lil dan l-għasfur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 火烈鸟的；与这种长腿、长颈且羽毛常呈粉红色的鸟有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirreferi għal għasfur b'saqajn twal u għonq twil, li spiss ikollu rix roża, jew għal xi ħaġa marbuta miegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as flamingo relates to or depicts the long-legged bird that often has pink feathers.

formal.mt: Id-disinn fjammingu fuq il-qoxra juri għasfur roża b'għonq twil.
formal.en: The flamingo design on the cover depicts a pink bird with a long neck.
formal.zh: 封面上的火烈鸟图案描绘了一只长颈的粉红色鸟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema disinn trid għall-kartolina? Lara: Irrid id-disinn fjammingu, bl-għasfur roża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which design do you want for the postcard? Lara: I want the flamingo design, with the pink bird.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：明信片你想用哪种图案？拉拉：我要火烈鸟图案，就是有那只粉红色鸟的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 明信片你想用哪种图案？
messages.en: Which design do you want for the postcard?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要火烈鸟图案，就是有那只粉红色鸟的。
messages.en: I want the flamingo design, with the pink bird.

cognitive_memory_aid: 本条按形容词记：看见 fjammingu，就联想粉红羽毛、长腿和长颈，再把这些特征连到火烈鸟图案。

gloss_zh: 词义未提供；原释义是翻译提示

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose lexical meaning is not specified in the supplied entry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给条目标为名词，但只提供了翻译提示，因此无法据此确定具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma mniżżla bħala nom li t-tifsira tagħha mhijiex speċifikata fl-entrata mogħtija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: “译成英语。”这是翻译指令，并非该名词的词义定义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-test mogħti huwa struzzjoni biex issir traduzzjoni bl-Ingliż, iżda ma jagħtix it-tifsira tan-nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied text requests an English translation but does not explain what this noun means.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'fjokk' hija mniżżla bħala nom, iżda l-entrata mogħtija ma tinkludix definizzjoni lessikali.
formal.en: The word 'fjokk' is listed as a noun, but the supplied entry does not include a lexical definition.
formal.zh: “fjokk”被列为名词，但所给条目没有提供词义定义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An electrical safety device that melts and breaks a circuit when too much current flows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 电流过大时通过内部元件熔断来切断电路的保护装置，即保险丝或熔断器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat ta' protezzjoni elettrika b'element li jdub u jaqta' ċ-ċirkwit meta jgħaddi kurrent żejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 保险丝；熔断器，指电流过大时熔断并切断电路的电气保护装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat ta' sigurtà f'ċirkwit elettriku li fih element idub meta l-kurrent ikun qawwi wisq, u b'hekk jaqta' ċ-ċirkwit.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fuse is a safety device that breaks an electrical circuit when excessive current causes its internal element to melt.

formal.mt: It-tekniku biddel il-fjus maħruq qabel ma reġa' qabbad l-apparat.
formal.en: The technician replaced the blown fuse before reconnecting the appliance.
formal.zh: 技术员更换了烧断的保险丝，然后才重新接通电器。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Inqata' d-dawl. Taħseb li nħaraq il-fjus? Mark: Jista' jkun. Ħalli nsejjaħ elettriċista.
colloquial.en: Maja: The power has gone out. Do you think the fuse has blown? Mark: Maybe. Let me call an electrician.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：停电了。你觉得是保险丝烧断了吗？马克：有可能。我来叫个电工。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Inqata' d-dawl. Taħseb li nħaraq il-fjus?
messages.mt_standard: Inqata' d-dawl. Taħseb li nħaraq il-fjus?
messages.zh: 停电了。你觉得是保险丝烧断了吗？
messages.en: The power has gone out. Do you think the fuse has blown?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 有可能。我来叫个电工。
messages.en: Maybe. Let me call an electrician.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电流过大时保险丝先熔断的画面，把 fjus 和“切断电路、保护电器”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In the air, above the ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示处于空中或地面上方的位置，常用于描述飞行或悬空的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li xi ħaġa tinsab fl-arja, 'il fuq mill-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在上空；在空中，指某物处于离开地面的高处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li xi ħaġa tinsab fl-arja f'pożizzjoni ogħla mill-art.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is up in this sense, it is in the air above the ground.

collocations.en: to remain up in the air

formal.mt: L-ajruplan baqa' fl-ajru għal sagħtejn qabel ma niżel fl-ajruport.
formal.en: The aircraft remained up in the air for two hours before landing at the airport.
formal.zh: 飞机在空中飞行了两个小时，然后降落在机场。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-astun? Mark: Għadu fl-ajru. Ħares 'il fuq!
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the kite? Mark: It's still up in the air. Look up!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：风筝在哪儿？马克：它还在空中。往上看！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 风筝在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is the kite?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 它还在空中。往上看！
messages.en: It's still up in the air. Look up!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fl-ajru 整体配上风筝停在空中的画面，记成“在空中”的位置表达，再用飞机例句巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Flannel is a soft fabric, or cloth made from this fabric.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 法兰绒，一种柔软的织物；也指用这种织物制成的布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Drapp artab, jew biċċa drapp magħmula minn dan il-materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法兰绒，一种柔软的织物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' drapp artab li jista' jintuża biex isiru ħwejjeġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Flannel is a soft fabric that can be used for making clothes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法兰绒布，即一块或一幅法兰绒织物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp magħmula mill-materjal magħruf bħala flanella.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A flannel cloth is a piece of cloth made from flannel fabric.

formal.mt: Għal dan il-proġett tal-ħjata, l-istudenti għandhom iġibu biċċa flanella u jispjegaw għaliex għażlu dan id-drapp.
formal.en: For this sewing project, students should bring a piece of flannel and explain why they chose this fabric.
formal.zh: 在这个缝纫项目中，学生应带来一块法兰绒布，并说明选择这种织物的原因。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn xiex hi magħmula din il-qmis? Rita: Mill-flanella. Missha, kemm hi ratba!
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this shirt made of? Rita: Flannel. Feel how soft it is!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这件衬衫是什么料子的？丽塔：法兰绒的。摸摸看，多柔软！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn xiex hi magħmula din il-qmis?
messages.mt_standard: Minn xiex hi magħmula din il-qmis?
messages.zh: 这件衬衫是什么料子的？
messages.en: What is this shirt made of?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 法兰绒的。摸摸看，多柔软！
messages.en: Flannel. Feel how soft it is!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 flanella 和柔软衬衫的触感一起记：既可说法兰绒这种面料，也可说一块法兰绒布。

gloss_zh: 田垄；与犁沟相对的隆起土带

teaching_sense.en_definition: In agriculture, a flann is a raised strip of soil, as opposed to a furrow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 农业用语，指与凹下的犁沟相对的隆起土带，即田垄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strixxa ta' ħamrija għolja fl-għalqa, għall-kuntrarju tar-radda li tkun ħofra tawwalija fil-ħamrija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 田垄，农业中与犁沟相对的隆起土带。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Parti twila u għolja tal-ħamrija f'għalqa, għall-kuntrarju ta' radda li tkun aktar baxxa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In agriculture, a flann is a raised strip of soil that contrasts with the hollow of a furrow.

formal.mt: Fid-disinn tal-għalqa, il-flann jidher bħala strixxa għolja ta' ħamrija, filwaqt li r-radda tidher bħala ħofra twila.
formal.en: In the drawing of the field, the ridge appears as a raised strip of soil, while the furrow appears as a long hollow.
formal.zh: 在这幅农田示意图中，田垄画成隆起的土带，犁沟则画成长条形的凹沟。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-flann hu l-parti għolja jew il-ħofra? Pawlu: Il-parti għolja. Il-ħofra twila hi r-radda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the ridge the raised part or the hollow? Pawlu: The raised part. The long hollow is the furrow.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：田垄是高起来的部分，还是凹沟？保罗：高起来的部分。长长的凹沟是犁沟。

messages.speaker: Lara (农学学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-flann hu l-parti għolja jew il-ħofra?
messages.mt_standard: Il-flann hu l-parti għolja jew il-ħofra?
messages.zh: 田垄是高起来的部分，还是凹沟？
messages.en: Is the ridge the raised part or the hollow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-parti għolja. Il-ħofra twila hi r-radda.
messages.mt_standard: Il-parti għolja. Il-ħofra twila hi r-radda.
messages.zh: 高起来的部分。长长的凹沟是犁沟。
messages.en: The raised part. The long hollow is the furrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条起伏的田地横截线，把 flann 标在凸起处，把犁沟标在凹下处，用高低对照记住田垄。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flute is a wind instrument played by blowing across an opening and using finger holes or keys to change the notes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长笛，一种通过向吹口吹气发声，并用指孔或按键改变音高的管乐器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument mużikali tan-nifs li jindaqq billi jonfoħ il-mużiċist minn fuq fetħa u jibdel in-noti permezz ta' toqob jew ċwievet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长笛，一种吹奏时通过指孔或按键改变音高的管乐器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strument mużikali tan-nifs li jipproduċi ħoss meta wieħed jonfoħ minn fuq il-fetħa tiegħu u jibdel in-noti bit-toqob jew biċ-ċwievet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A flute is a wind instrument that you play by blowing across an opening and changing notes with finger holes or keys.

formal.mt: Waqt il-kunċert tal-iskola, l-istudenta daqqet il-flawt filwaqt li l-għalliem akkumpanjaha fuq il-pjanu.
formal.en: During the school concert, the student played the flute while the teacher accompanied her on the piano.
formal.zh: 在学校音乐会上，这名学生吹奏长笛，老师则用钢琴为她伴奏。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'se ddoqq fil-kunċert? Nina: Se ndoqq il-flawt. Trid tisma' l-biċċa li qed nitgħallem?
colloquial.en: Mark: What are you going to play at the concert? Nina: I'm going to play the flute. Would you like to hear the piece I'm learning?
colloquial.zh: 马克：音乐会上你要演奏什么乐器？妮娜：我要吹长笛。想听听我正在学的曲子吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 音乐会上你要演奏什么乐器？
messages.en: What are you going to play at the concert?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Se ndoqq il-flawt. Trid tisma' l-biċċa li qed nitgħallem?
messages.mt_standard: Se ndoqq il-flawt. Trid tisma' l-biċċa li qed nitgħallem?
messages.zh: 我要吹长笛。想听听我正在学的曲子吗？
messages.en: I'm going to play the flute. Would you like to hear the piece I'm learning?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 flawt 与英文 flute 并排做词卡，再配一幅吹长笛的图，用拼写近似和演奏动作帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A source of severe suffering, a whip used for striking, or a disastrous event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指造成严重痛苦的祸害、用于抽打的鞭子，或带来重大损失的灾难；具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tista' tfisser ħaġa li ġġib tbatija kbira, għodda biex wieħed isawwat, jew ġrajja li tikkawża ħsara kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 祸害；造成严重痛苦或广泛损害的人、事物或现象。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna, ħaġa jew fenomenu li jġib tbatija kbira jew jagħmel ħsara serja lil ħafna nies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A scourge is something or someone that causes great suffering or widespread harm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鞭子；用柔韧长条抽打人或动物的器具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda magħmula minn ċinga jew minn strixxi flessibbli, spiss imwaħħla ma' manku, li tintuża biex issawwat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A whip is an implement with a flexible length used for striking a person or an animal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灾难；造成严重损失、破坏或痛苦的不幸事件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġrajja ħażina ħafna li tikkawża telf serju, qerda jew tbatija kbira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A calamity is a disastrous event that causes serious damage, loss, or suffering.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi n-nixfa bħala flaġell għall-biedja, minħabba l-ħsara kbira li għamlet lill-uċuħ tar-raba'.
formal.en: The report describes the drought as a scourge of agriculture because of the severe damage it caused to crops.
formal.zh: 报告将干旱称为农业的一大祸害，因为它给农作物造成了严重损害。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan in-nemus huwa flaġell! Ma nistax norqod. Mark: Agħlaq it-tieqa u ixgħel il-fann.
colloquial.en: Maja: These mosquitoes are a real scourge! I can't sleep. Mark: Close the window and turn on the fan.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些蚊子真是祸害！我都睡不着了。马克：关上窗户，把风扇打开吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan in-nemus huwa flaġell! Ma nistax norqod.
messages.mt_standard: Dan in-nemus huwa flaġell! Ma nistax norqod.
messages.zh: 这些蚊子真是祸害！我都睡不着了。
messages.en: These mosquitoes are a real scourge! I can't sleep.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 关上窗户，把风扇打开吧。
messages.en: Close the window and turn on the fan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅画面分别记忆：造成痛苦的祸害、手里的鞭子、破坏严重的灾难；这是词义联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 马耳他传统芦苇管笛，外形近似小直笛

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flejguta is a traditional Maltese flute made from a reed pipe and shaped similarly to a penny whistle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种由芦苇管制成的马耳他传统笛子，外形类似 penny whistle 小直笛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Flawt tradizzjonali Malti magħmul minn qasba, b'forma li tixbah lil dik ta' penny whistle.

sense_translations.en_definition: A traditional Maltese flute consisting of a reed pipe, similar in shape to a penny whistle
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他传统笛子，由一根芦苇管构成，形状类似 penny whistle 小直笛。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strument mużikali tradizzjonali Malti tat-tip tal-flawt, magħmul minn qasba u simili fil-forma għal penny whistle.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A flejguta is a traditional Maltese flute consisting of a reed pipe whose shape resembles that of a penny whistle.

collocations.zh: 吹奏马耳他传统芦苇管笛

collocations.en: a flejguta made from a reed pipe
collocations.zh: 一支由芦苇管制成的马耳他传统笛子

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni dwar l-istrumenti tradizzjonali Maltin, l-għalliema ppreżentat flejguta u spjegat li hi magħmula minn qasba u li l-forma tagħha tixbah lil dik ta' penny whistle.
formal.en: In the lesson on traditional Maltese instruments, the teacher presented a flejguta and explained that it is made from a reed pipe and resembles a penny whistle in shape.
formal.zh: 在介绍马耳他传统乐器的课堂上，老师展示了一支 flejguta，并解释说它由芦苇管制成，外形类似 penny whistle 小直笛。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dan l-istrument? Toni: Din flejguta, flawt tradizzjonali Malti magħmul minn qasba. Sara: Tista' ddoqqha biex nisma' l-ħoss tagħha?
colloquial.en: Sara: What is this instrument? Toni: This is a flejguta, a traditional Maltese flute made from a reed pipe. Sara: Can you play it so I can hear what it sounds like?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这是什么乐器？托尼：这是 flejguta，一种用芦苇管制成的马耳他传统笛子。萨拉：你能吹一下，让我听听它的声音吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是什么乐器？
messages.en: What is this instrument?

messages.speaker: Toni (乐手)
messages.mt_spoken: Din flejguta, flawt tradizzjonali Malti magħmul minn qasba.
messages.mt_standard: Din flejguta, flawt tradizzjonali Malti magħmul minn qasba.
messages.zh: 这是 flejguta，一种用芦苇管制成的马耳他传统笛子。
messages.en: This is a flejguta, a traditional Maltese flute made from a reed pipe.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' ddoqqha biex nisma' l-ħoss tagħha?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' ddoqqha biex nisma' l-ħoss tagħha?
messages.zh: 你能吹一下，让我听听它的声音吗？
messages.en: Can you play it so I can hear what it sounds like?

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 flejguta 画一支细长的芦苇管笛，旁边写上马耳他传统乐器，用材料、外形和地域三个线索记忆。

gloss_zh: 含义未明（所给材料未提供释义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning is not established by the supplied material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料将此词标为名词，但未提供可确定其含义的释义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li l-materjal mogħti ma jipprovdix tifsira ċara tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含义未确定；原释义仅为问号。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan in-nom mhijiex stabbilita, għax il-materjal mogħti juri biss marka ta' mistoqsija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied material identifies this as a noun but does not establish its meaning.

formal.mt: Il-materjal mogħti jikklassifika 'fleri' bħala nom, iżda ma jagħtix tifsira li tista' tintuża fit-tagħlim.
formal.en: The supplied material classifies 'fleri' as a noun but gives no meaning that can be used for teaching.
formal.zh: 所给材料将“fleri”归为名词，但没有提供可用于教学的词义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'fleri'? Mark: Hawn hemm biss marka ta' mistoqsija; ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti mit-tifsira.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'fleri' mean? Mark: There is only a question mark here; we cannot be certain of its meaning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：fleri是什么意思？Mark：这里只有一个问号，我们无法确定它的含义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: fleri是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'fleri' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn hemm biss marka ta' mistoqsija; ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti mit-tifsira.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn hemm biss marka ta' mistoqsija; ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti mit-tifsira.
messages.zh: 这里只有一个问号，我们无法确定它的含义。
messages.en: There is only a question mark here; we cannot be certain of its meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把fleri与问号卡片一起记：目前只记词形和名词标签，词义留空，不凭拼写猜测。

gloss_zh: 柔韧的；灵活的，可调整的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to bend or move easily, or to adapt to different needs and circumstances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够轻松弯曲或活动的；也指能够根据不同需要和情况作出调整的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jitgħawweġ jew jiċċaqlaq faċilment, jew jinbidel skont il-ħtiġijiet u ċ-ċirkostanzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 柔软而有韧性的；身体或材料容易弯曲、活动自如的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jitgħawweġ jew jiċċaqlaq faċilment u bla ebusija, bħal ġisem jew materjal artab.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is supple bends or moves easily without being stiff.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可弯曲的；也指安排、方法等灵活而可按需要调整的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jista' jitgħawweġ mingħajr ma jinkiser, jew jiġi adattat għal ħtiġijiet u sitwazzjonijiet differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is flexible can bend or be adjusted to suit different needs.

formal.mt: Il-kors joffri ħinijiet flessibbli sabiex l-istudenti jkunu jistgħu jattendu l-lezzjonijiet wara x-xogħol.
formal.en: The course offers flexible hours so that students can attend lessons after work.
formal.zh: 该课程提供弹性上课时间，让学生能够在下班后参加课程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nistgħu niltaqgħu fis-sitta minflok fil-ħamsa? Mark: Iva, il-ħin tiegħi llum huwa flessibbli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can we meet at six instead of five? Mark: Yes, my schedule is flexible today.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们能改成六点见面，不在五点见吗？Mark：可以，我今天的时间安排很灵活。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们能改成六点见面，不在五点见吗？
messages.en: Can we meet at six instead of five?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ħin tiegħi llum huwa flessibbli.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ħin tiegħi llum huwa flessibbli.
messages.zh: 可以，我今天的时间安排很灵活。
messages.en: Yes, my schedule is flexible today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记flessibbli：身体能弯是“柔韧”，日程能改是“灵活”；共同点都是能够调整。

gloss_zh: 腰脊肉；去骨肉块或鱼片

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cut of meat from the loin, or a boneless piece of meat or fish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 取自动物腰背部的肉；也指去除骨头的肉块或鱼片。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa laħam mill-parti tad-dahar qrib il-qadd ta' annimal, jew biċċa laħam jew ħut mingħajr għadam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腰脊肉，指取自动物背部靠近腰部区域的肉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Laħam meħud mill-parti tad-dahar qrib il-qadd ta' annimal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The loin is a cut of meat taken from an animal's back near the waist.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 去骨肉块；去除鱼骨后切取的鱼肉片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa laħam jew ħut li minnha jkun tneħħa l-għadam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fillet is a piece of meat or fish from which the bones have been removed.

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, poġġi l-flett tal-ħut f'dixx u żid ftit żejt taż-żebbuġa qabel it-tisjir.
formal.en: For this recipe, place the fish fillet in a dish and add a little olive oil before cooking.
formal.zh: 制作这道菜时，先把去骨鱼片放入烤盘，再在烹调前加入少许橄榄油。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se nsajru llejla? Mark: Flett tal-ħut bil-patata. Maja: Tajjeb, jien inqaxxar il-patata.
colloquial.en: Maja: What shall we cook tonight? Mark: Fish fillet with potatoes. Maja: Good, I will peel the potatoes.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今晚我们做什么吃？Mark：鱼片配土豆。Maja：好，我来削土豆皮。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 今晚我们做什么吃？
messages.en: What shall we cook tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 鱼片配土豆。
messages.en: Fish fillet with potatoes.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 好，我来削土豆皮。
messages.en: Good, I will peel the potatoes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给flett画两张食材卡：一张标出动物腰背部，一张画去骨鱼片，分别对应loin和fillet。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tender, boneless cut of beef from the loin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 取自牛腰部的嫩而无骨的肉，即牛里脊肉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa laħam taċ-ċanga tenera u mingħajr għadam, meħuda mill-parti tad-dahar qrib il-qadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牛里脊肉，取自牛腰部、肉质细嫩的无骨肉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa laħam tenera taċ-ċanga mill-parti tad-dahar qrib il-qadd, li tiġi ppreparata mingħajr għadam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Beef fillet is a tender, boneless cut of meat taken from the loin of a cow.

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi flett taċ-ċanga mixwi, servut ma' ħaxix tal-istaġun u zalza tal-bżar.
formal.en: The menu includes grilled beef fillet served with seasonal vegetables and pepper sauce.
formal.zh: 菜单上有烤牛里脊肉，配时令蔬菜和胡椒酱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandkom flett taċ-ċanga llum? Mark: Iva. Kemm tixtieq? Maja: Żewġ biċċiet, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have beef fillet today? Mark: Yes. How much would you like? Maja: Two pieces, please.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你们今天有牛里脊肉吗？Mark：有。您想要多少？Maja：请给我两块。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 你们今天有牛里脊肉吗？
messages.en: Do you have beef fillet today?

messages.speaker: Mark (肉店店员)
messages.zh: 有。您想要多少？
messages.en: Yes. How much would you like?

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我两块。
messages.en: Two pieces, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把flett taċ-ċanga作为肉店点单整句块记忆：看到牛里脊图片就念全词组，再配上“两块”的购买场景。

gloss_zh: 弗勒德利斯（马耳他地名）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fleur de Lys is a town in Malta situated near Birkirkara.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 弗勒德利斯是马耳他的一个城镇，位于比尔基卡拉附近。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fleur de Lys hija belt f'Malta li tinsab qrib Birkirkara.

sense_translations.en_definition: Town in Malta situated close to Birkirkara
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他的一个城镇，位于比尔基卡拉附近。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fleur de Lys hija belt f'Malta li tinsab qrib Birkirkara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fleur de Lys is the name of a Maltese town located near Birkirkara.

formal.mt: L-avviż jgħid li l-laqgħa se ssir fi Fleur de Lys.
formal.en: The notice states that the meeting will take place in Fleur de Lys.
formal.zh: 通知说明，会议将在弗勒德利斯举行。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn toqgħod? Pawlu: Noqgħod fi Fleur de Lys, qrib Birkirkara.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where do you live? Pawlu: I live in Fleur de Lys, near Birkirkara.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你住在哪里？保罗：我住在弗勒德利斯，在比尔基卡拉附近。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你住在哪里？
messages.en: Where do you live?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Noqgħod fi Fleur de Lys, qrib Birkirkara.
messages.mt_standard: Noqgħod fi Fleur de Lys, qrib Birkirkara.
messages.zh: 我住在弗勒德利斯，在比尔基卡拉附近。
messages.en: I live in Fleur de Lys, near Birkirkara.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Fleur de Lys 当作地图上的完整地名记忆，再配上“比尔基卡拉附近”这个位置提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A narrow passage of sea between areas of land, connecting larger areas of water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于陆地之间、连接较大水域的狭窄海上通道，即海峡或水道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fliegu huwa passaġġ dejjaq tal-baħar bejn żewġ meded ta' art li jgħaqqad żewġ żoni akbar tal-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水道；海峡，指陆地之间连接较大水域的狭窄海上通道。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fliegu huwa passaġġ dejjaq tal-baħar bejn meded ta' art, li minnu l-ilma jgħaddi bejn żewġ żoni tal-baħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A channel or strait is a narrow stretch of sea between areas of land that connects larger bodies of water.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海峡，指两侧有陆地、连接两片海域的狭窄水域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fliegu huwa parti dejqa tal-baħar li tifred żewġ meded ta' art u tgħaqqad żewġ żoni tal-baħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A strait is a narrow sea passage separating areas of land and joining two larger areas of sea.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi fliegu dejjaq li jgħaqqad żewġ żoni tal-baħar.
formal.en: The report describes a narrow strait connecting two areas of sea.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一条连接两片海域的狭窄海峡。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ara kemm hu dejjaq dan il-fliegu! Mark: Iva, tista' tara l-art fuq iż-żewġ naħat.
colloquial.en: Sara: Look how narrow this strait is! Mark: Yes, you can see land on both sides.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你看，这条海峡多窄啊！马克：是啊，两边的陆地都看得见。

messages.speaker: Sara (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hu dejjaq dan il-fliegu!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hu dejjaq dan il-fliegu!
messages.zh: 你看，这条海峡多窄啊！
messages.en: Look how narrow this strait is!

messages.speaker: Mark (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tista' tara l-art fuq iż-żewġ naħat.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tista' tara l-art fuq iż-żewġ naħat.
messages.zh: 是啊，两边的陆地都看得见。
messages.en: Yes, you can see land on both sides.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 fliegu 时画两块陆地，中间留一条连接两片海域的窄水道，用画面记住“海峡”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cold or a condition in which the nose runs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指感冒，或鼻腔不断流出鼻涕的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-flissjoni hija riħ jew stat li fih l-imnieħer iqattar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感冒；流鼻涕的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-flissjoni hija riħ jew kundizzjoni li fiha joħroġ likwidu mill-imnieħer.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you have flissjoni, you have a cold or a runny nose.

collocations.en: I have a cold or a runny nose
a bad cold or a very runny nose

formal.mt: L-istudent kiteb lill-għalliem biex jgħidlu li għandu flissjoni u se jibqa' d-dar.
formal.en: The student wrote to the teacher to say that he had a cold and would stay at home.
formal.zh: 学生写信告诉老师，自己感冒了，将留在家中。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandek maktur? Għandi flissjoni. Lara: Iva, hawn wieħed nadif.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you have a handkerchief? I've got a runny nose. Lara: Yes, here's a clean one.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你有手帕吗？我在流鼻涕。劳拉：有，这里有一条干净的。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有手帕吗？我在流鼻涕。
messages.en: Do you have a handkerchief? I've got a runny nose.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，这里有一条干净的。
messages.en: Yes, here's a clean one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 flissjoni 与“拿手帕擦鼻子”的情景一起记，再练一句 Għandi flissjoni，连接感冒和流鼻涕的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bottle used for holding or carrying water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来盛水或随身携带水的瓶子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Flixkun ta' l-ilma huwa reċipjent li jintuża biex iżomm l-ilma jew biex wieħed iġorr l-ilma miegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水瓶，用来盛放或携带水的瓶子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Flixkun ta' l-ilma huwa flixkun li fih jinżamm jew jinġarr l-ilma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A water bottle is a container that you use to hold or carry water.

collocations.en: carry a water bottle with me

formal.mt: Kull parteċipant għandu jġib flixkun tal-ilma għall-mixja.
formal.en: Each participant should bring a water bottle for the walk.
formal.zh: 每位参加者都应为此次步行活动带上一个水瓶。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Fejn hu l-flixkun tal-ilma tiegħi? Anna: Fil-borża tiegħek, ħdejn il-ktieb.
colloquial.en: Ben: Where's my water bottle? Anna: In your bag, next to the book.
colloquial.zh: 本：我的水瓶在哪里？安娜：在你的包里，书的旁边。

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 我的水瓶在哪里？
messages.en: Where's my water bottle?

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 在你的包里，书的旁边。
messages.en: In your bag, next to the book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与“出门前装满水瓶，再放进包里”的动作连起来记，并用例句中的 tal-ilma 形式反复练习。

gloss_zh: 替换“iħajru”的另一个词（元语言说明）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A metalinguistic request for another word to use in place of 'iħajru', without specifying the replacement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 要求另找一个词来替换“iħajru”的元语言说明；所给释义没有提供具体替换词，也没有确立独立的名词词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Talba għal kelma oħra li tista' tintuża minflok 'iħajru', mingħajr ma tingħata l-kelma li għandha tissostitwiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 另一个用来替换“iħajru”的词；这是替换用词的说明，未指明具体同义词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma oħra li tintuża minflok 'iħajru'; din l-ispjegazzjoni titlob sostituzzjoni iżda ma tagħtix il-kelma alternattiva.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This entry requests an alternative word to replace 'iħajru', but does not identify a particular replacement.

collocations.en: to look for a word to replace 'iħajru'

formal.mt: In-nota 'kelma oħra flok iħajru' titlob sostituzzjoni ta' kelma, iżda ma tispeċifikax liema kelma għandha tintuża.
formal.en: The note 'another word in place of iħajru' requests a word replacement, but does not specify which word should be used.
formal.zh: “另找一个词替换 iħajru”这条注释要求更换用词，但没有说明应使用哪个词。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tfisser in-nota 'kelma oħra flok iħajru'? Pawlu: Qed titlob kelma oħra minflok 'iħajru', imma ma tgħidx liema.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the note 'another word in place of iħajru' mean? Pawlu: It asks for another word to replace 'iħajru', but does not say which one.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：注释“另找一个词替换 iħajru”是什么意思？保罗：它要求用另一个词替换“iħajru”，但没说具体用哪个。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 注释“另找一个词替换 iħajru”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the note 'another word in place of iħajru' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed titlob kelma oħra minflok 'iħajru', imma ma tgħidx liema.
messages.mt_standard: Qed titlob kelma oħra minflok 'iħajru', imma ma tgħidx liema.
messages.zh: 它要求用另一个词替换“iħajru”，但没说具体用哪个。
messages.en: It asks for another word to replace 'iħajru', but does not say which one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它想成老师写在页边的“这里换个词”：这是换词提示，不能据此背成一个有确定所指的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small float attached to a fishing line.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 装在钓线上、能够浮在水面的小浮漂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett żgħir imwaħħal ma' xlief tas-sajd li jibqa' f'wiċċ l-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供钓线使用的小浮漂。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira li titwaħħal ma' xlief tas-sajd u żżomm f'wiċċ l-ilma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A flontin is a small floating object that you attach to a fishing line.

collocations.en: to attach a small float to the fishing line

formal.mt: Qabel tibda tistad, waħħal il-flontin max-xlief u ċċekkja li jibqa' f'wiċċ l-ilma.
formal.en: Before you start fishing, attach the small float to the line and check that it stays on the surface.
formal.zh: 开始钓鱼前，把小浮漂装到钓线上，并检查它能否保持浮在水面。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu l-flontin? Mark: Fil-kaxxa ż-żgħira. Waħħlu max-xlief qabel tibda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the small float? Mark: In the little box. Attach it to the line before you start.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：小浮漂在哪儿？马克：在小盒子里。开始前把它装到钓线上。

messages.speaker: Lara (钓友)
messages.zh: 小浮漂在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is the small float?

messages.speaker: Mark (钓友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kaxxa ż-żgħira. Waħħlu max-xlief qabel tibda.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kaxxa ż-żgħira. Waħħlu max-xlief qabel tibda.
messages.zh: 在小盒子里。开始前把它装到钓线上。
messages.en: In the little box. Attach it to the line before you start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 flontin 和“钓线上浮着的小点”一起记：脑中画出一根钓线连着水面小浮漂的图。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who sells flowers and prepares flower arrangements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以售卖鲜花、制作花束或花卉装饰为业的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tbigħ il-fjuri u tipprepara bukketti jew arranġamenti tal-fjuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 售卖鲜花并制作花束或花卉装饰的人；花商或花艺师。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tbigħ il-fjuri u tħejji bukketti u arranġamenti tal-fjuri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A florist is someone whose job is to sell flowers and arrange them for customers.

collocations.en: to order a bouquet from the florist

collocations.zh: 从事花卉销售或花艺工作

formal.mt: Għall-avveniment, il-florist se jħejji bukketti u arranġamenti tal-fjuri għas-sala.
formal.en: For the event, the florist will prepare bouquets and flower arrangements for the hall.
formal.zh: 花艺师将为此次活动准备花束及会场花卉装饰。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Minn fejn nista' nixtri bukkett għal ommi? David: Mur għand il-florist ħdejn il-pjazza; hemm tista' tagħżel il-fjuri.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where can I buy a bouquet for my mother? David: Go to the florist near the square; you can choose the flowers there.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我可以去哪儿给妈妈买一束花？戴维：去广场旁的花商那里吧，你可以在那里挑花。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn nista' nixtri bukkett għal ommi?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn nista' nixtri bukkett għal ommi?
messages.zh: 我可以去哪儿给妈妈买一束花？
messages.en: Where can I buy a bouquet for my mother?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mur għand il-florist ħdejn il-pjazza; hemm tista' tagħżel il-fjuri.
messages.mt_standard: Mur għand il-florist ħdejn il-pjazza; hemm tista' tagħżel il-fjuri.
messages.zh: 去广场旁的花商那里吧，你可以在那里挑花。
messages.en: Go to the florist near the square; you can choose the flowers there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 florist 配上“接过订单、扎好花束的人”这幅画面；马耳他语和英语这里拼写相同，可成对记忆。

gloss_zh: 船队；舰队；统一管理的车队或机队

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of ships, vehicles, or aircraft operated or managed together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由同一组织运营、管理或共同执行任务的一组船舶、车辆或飞机。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' vapuri, vetturi jew ajruplani li jitħaddmu jew jitmexxew flimkien minn organizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 统一组织或管理的船队、舰队、车队或机队。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għadd ta' vapuri, vetturi jew ajruplani li jappartjenu lil organizzazzjoni waħda jew jintużaw flimkien għal għan komuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fleet is a group of ships, vehicles, or aircraft that an organization operates together.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija se żżid tliet vapuri ġodda mal-flotta tagħha biex ittejjeb is-servizz bejn il-portijiet.
formal.en: The company will add three new ships to its fleet to improve service between the ports.
formal.zh: 公司将为其船队增添三艘新船，以改善各港口之间的运输服务。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dawn id-dgħajjes kollha tal-istess kumpanija? Toni: Iva, flimkien jagħmlu l-flotta tagħha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do all these boats belong to the same company? Toni: Yes, together they make up its fleet.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些船都属于同一家公司吗？托尼：对，它们合起来就是这家公司的船队。

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.zh: 这些船都属于同一家公司吗？
messages.en: Do all these boats belong to the same company?

messages.speaker: Toni (导游)
messages.zh: 对，它们合起来就是这家公司的船队。
messages.en: Yes, together they make up its fleet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 flotta 时想象码头上挂着同一公司标志的一整排船，抓住“统一管理的一队”这个核心，再联想到车队和机队。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money coming into a business, organization, or account during a particular period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某一时期内流入企业、机构或账户的现金。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-flus li jidħlu f'negozju, f'organizzazzjoni jew f'kont matul perjodu partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 现金流入；某段时间内实际收到的现金款项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-moviment ta' flus li jidħlu f'negozju jew f'kont, pereżempju minn ħlasijiet tal-klijenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cash in-flow is money that a business or account receives during a particular period.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri li l-fluss ta' flus dieħel mill-bejgħ żdied matul l-aħħar tliet xhur.
formal.en: The report shows that cash inflow from sales increased over the last three months.
formal.zh: 报告显示，过去三个月销售带来的现金流入有所增加。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex qed niċċekkjaw il-kont kuljum? Pawlu: Biex naraw il-fluss ta' flus dieħel u nkunu nafu kemm għandna biex inħallsu l-kontijiet.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are we checking the account every day? Pawlu: To track the cash inflow and know how much we have to pay the bills.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我们为什么每天都查账户？Pawlu：为了看看现金流入情况，知道我们有多少钱可以支付账单。

messages.speaker: Marija (店主)
messages.zh: 我们为什么每天都查账户？
messages.en: Why are we checking the account every day?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (会计)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex naraw il-fluss ta' flus dieħel u nkunu nafu kemm għandna biex inħallsu l-kontijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Biex naraw il-fluss ta' flus dieħel u nkunu nafu kemm għandna biex inħallsu l-kontijiet.
messages.zh: 为了看看现金流入情况，知道我们有多少钱可以支付账单。
messages.en: To track the cash inflow and know how much we have to pay the bills.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把账户想成一个水池：dieħel提示“正在进入”，钱流进池子就是现金流入；与ħiereġ“正在流出”成对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money leaving a business, organization, or account during a particular period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某一时期内从企业、机构或账户流出的现金。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-flus li joħorġu minn negozju, minn organizzazzjoni jew minn kont matul perjodu partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 现金流出；某段时间内实际支付出去的现金款项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-moviment ta' flus li joħorġu minn negozju jew minn kont, pereżempju għall-ħlas tal-kera, tal-pagi jew tal-fornituri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cash out-flow is money that leaves a business or account when payments are made.

collocations.mt: fluss ta' flus ħiereġ għall-ħlas tal-pagi
collocations.zh: 支付工资产生的现金流出

collocations.mt: fluss ta' flus ħiereġ kull xahar

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija qed tissorvelja l-fluss ta' flus ħiereġ biex tiżgura li jkollha biżżejjed flus għall-ħlasijiet tax-xahar id-dieħel.
formal.en: The company is monitoring cash outflow to ensure that it has enough money for next month's payments.
formal.zh: 公司正在监测现金流出，以确保有足够资金支付下个月的款项。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex fadal daqshekk ftit flus fil-kont? David: Il-fluss ta' flus ħiereġ kien għoli din il-ġimgħa; ħallasna l-kera u l-fornituri.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is there so little money left in the account? David: Cash outflow was high this week; we paid the rent and the suppliers.
colloquial.zh: Lara：账户里怎么只剩这么点钱？David：这周现金流出较多；我们付了租金和供应商的款项。

messages.speaker: Lara (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex fadal daqshekk ftit flus fil-kont?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex fadal daqshekk ftit flus fil-kont?
messages.zh: 账户里怎么只剩这么点钱？
messages.en: Why is there so little money left in the account?

messages.speaker: David (合伙人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-fluss ta' flus ħiereġ kien għoli din il-ġimgħa; ħallasna l-kera u l-fornituri.
messages.mt_standard: Il-fluss ta' flus ħiereġ kien għoli din il-ġimgħa; ħallasna l-kera u l-fornituri.
messages.zh: 这周现金流出较多；我们付了租金和供应商的款项。
messages.en: Cash outflow was high this week; we paid the rent and the suppliers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象账户水池向外排水：ħiereġ提示“正在出去”，付租金、发工资时钱向外流，就是现金流出。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A change or series of changes in prices as they rise and fall over time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 价格随时间上涨和下跌的变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidla jew sensiela ta' bidliet fil-prezzijiet hekk kif dawn jogħlew u jinżlu maż-żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 价格波动；商品或服务的价格在一段时间内出现的升降变化。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-bidla fil-prezzijiet ta' oġġetti jew servizzi meta dawn jogħlew jew jinżlu matul perjodu ta' żmien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Price fluctuation occurs when the prices of goods or services rise and fall over time.

formal.mt: Il-fluttwazzjoni tal-prezzijiet tal-materja prima tagħmilha diffiċli għall-kumpanija li tippjana l-ispejjeż tagħha.
formal.en: Fluctuation in raw material prices makes it difficult for the company to plan its costs.
formal.zh: 原材料价格的波动使公司难以规划成本。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-ġimgħa li għaddiet it-tadam kien irħas. Għaliex għola? Mark: Hemm fluttwazzjoni tal-prezzijiet; kultant jogħlew u kultant jinżlu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Tomatoes were cheaper last week. Why has the price gone up? Mark: There is price fluctuation; sometimes prices go up and sometimes they go down.
colloquial.zh: Nina：上周番茄还便宜些，怎么涨价了？Mark：价格会波动，有时上涨，有时下跌。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
