messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġimgħa li għaddiet it-tadam kien irħas. Għaliex għola?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġimgħa li għaddiet it-tadam kien irħas. Għaliex għola?
messages.zh: 上周番茄还便宜些，怎么涨价了？
messages.en: Tomatoes were cheaper last week. Why has the price gone up?

messages.speaker: Mark (摊主)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm fluttwazzjoni tal-prezzijiet; kultant jogħlew u kultant jinżlu.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm fluttwazzjoni tal-prezzijiet; kultant jogħlew u kultant jinżlu.
messages.zh: 价格会波动，有时上涨，有时下跌。
messages.en: There is price fluctuation; sometimes prices go up and sometimes they go down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一条价格曲线，上下起伏对应fluttwazzjoni，tal-prezzijiet限定为价格；整组记作“价格波动”。

gloss_zh: 锡纸；食品包装用金属箔

teaching_sense.en_definition: Thin metal foil used to wrap or cover food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来包裹或覆盖食物的薄金属箔，日常常称为锡纸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Folja rqiqa ħafna tal-metall li tintuża biex jitgeżwer jew jitgħatta l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于包裹、覆盖食物的薄金属箔；锡纸。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjal magħmul minn metall irqiq ħafna, f'folji li jintużaw biex jitgeżwer jew jitgħatta l-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tinfoil is a very thin sheet of metal that you use to wrap food or cover a cooking dish.

formal.mt: Wara li l-ikel jiksaħ, għatti t-trej bil-fojl u poġġih fil-friġġ.
formal.en: After the food cools, cover the tray with foil and put it in the refrigerator.
formal.zh: 食物冷却后，用锡纸盖住托盘，再放入冰箱。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu l-fojl? Irrid ngeżwer dan il-ħobż. Pawlu: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-forn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where's the foil? I want to wrap this bread. Pawlu: In the drawer next to the oven.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：锡纸在哪儿？我想把这个面包包起来。保罗：在烤箱旁边的抽屉里。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-fojl? Irrid ngeżwer dan il-ħobż.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-fojl? Irrid ngeżwer dan il-ħobż.
messages.zh: 锡纸在哪儿？我想把这个面包包起来。
messages.en: Where's the foil? I want to wrap this bread.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 在烤箱旁边的抽屉里。
messages.en: In the drawer next to the oven.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fojl 和厨房里亮闪闪的锡纸卷联系起来，连着记 romblu fojl，再想象用它包面包的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mammal that swims in the sea and also rests on land or ice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种在海中游泳、也会上岸或到冰面上休息的哺乳动物；海豹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal mammiferu li jgħix u jgħum fil-baħar u jitla' fuq l-art jew fuq is-silġ biex jistrieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海豹，一种适应水中生活、也会到陆地或冰面上休息的哺乳动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mammiferu tal-baħar b'ġisem addattat għall-għawm, li joħroġ mill-ilma biex jistrieħ fuq l-art jew fuq is-silġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A seal is a mammal that swims in the sea and comes onto land or ice to rest.

collocations.en: a seal swimming in the sea
collocations.zh: 一只在海里游泳的海豹

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt tidher foka tistrieħ fuq is-silġ ħdejn il-baħar.
formal.en: The photograph shows a seal resting on the ice beside the sea.
formal.zh: 照片中，一只海豹正在海边的冰面上休息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dik il-foka! Għadha kemm ħarġet mill-ilma. Mark: Rajtha! Issa qed tistrieħ fuq il-blat.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that seal! It has just come out of the water. Mark: I saw it! Now it's resting on the rocks.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看那只海豹！它刚从水里出来。马克：我看到了！它现在正趴在岩石上休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dik il-foka! Għadha kemm ħarġet mill-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Ara dik il-foka! Għadha kemm ħarġet mill-ilma.
messages.zh: 看那只海豹！它刚从水里出来。
messages.en: Look at that seal! It has just come out of the water.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtha! Issa qed tistrieħ fuq il-blat.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtha! Issa qed tistrieħ fuq il-blat.
messages.zh: 我看到了！它现在正趴在岩石上休息。
messages.en: I saw it! Now it's resting on the rocks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 foka 时，想象一只海豹先在海里游泳，再爬上冰面休息；把动物形象和词形一起记住。

gloss_zh: 民俗的；与民俗活动有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to traditional popular customs, stories, music, or activities that present them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与民间传统、故事、音乐、习俗或展示这些传统的活动有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-folklor, bħad-drawwiet, l-istejjer u l-mużika tradizzjonali, jew ma' attivitajiet li jippreżentaw dawn it-tradizzjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 民俗的；与民间流传的习俗、故事和传统有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-folklor ta' komunità, inklużi d-drawwiet, l-istejjer u t-tradizzjonijiet tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something folkloric is connected with the traditional customs, stories, or beliefs of a community.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与展示、传承或庆祝民俗传统的活动有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' attivitajiet li jippreżentaw, jgħaddu lil oħrajn jew jiċċelebraw il-folklor u t-tradizzjonijiet popolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An event or programme described this way involves activities that present or celebrate traditional customs and culture.

formal.mt: Il-mużew se jorganizza avveniment folkloristiku li jinkludi mużika u żfin tradizzjonali.
formal.en: The museum will organise a folk event featuring traditional music and dance.
formal.zh: 博物馆将举办一场民俗活动，内容包括传统音乐和舞蹈。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tiġi miegħi għall-ispettaklu folkloristiku llejla? Toni: Iva! Inħobb nara ż-żfin tradizzjonali.
colloquial.en: Sara: Will you come with me to the folk performance tonight? Toni: Yes! I love watching traditional dancing.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今晚你跟我一起去看民俗表演吗？托尼：去！我喜欢看传统舞蹈。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 今晚你跟我一起去看民俗表演吗？
messages.en: Will you come with me to the folk performance tonight?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 去！我喜欢看传统舞蹈。
messages.en: Yes! I love watching traditional dancing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 folkloristiku 配上一幅民俗节画面：传统服装、音乐和舞蹈；既记民俗属性，也记相关活动。

gloss_zh: 浓密的；茂密的（如头发、皮毛）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having many hairs growing close together, so that the hair or fur looks dense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容头发、皮毛等数量多、排列紧密，显得浓密的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħafna xagħar jew pil jikber qrib xulxin u għalhekk jidher dens.

sense_translations.en_definition: thick (e.g. used of hair or fur)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 浓密的，尤指头发或皮毛数量多、长得密。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun magħmul minn ħafna xagħar jew pil qrib xulxin, b'mod li jifforma kisja densa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Hair or fur that is thick has many hairs growing close together and therefore looks dense.

formal.mt: Il-qattus fir-ritratt għandu pil folt li jkopri ġismu kollu.
formal.en: The cat in the photograph has thick fur covering its entire body.
formal.zh: 照片中的猫全身覆盖着浓密的皮毛。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm għandek xagħar folt! Tieħu ħafna ħin biex tnixxfu? Lara: Iva, speċjalment meta nħallih jinxef waħdu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Your hair is so thick! Does it take you a long time to dry it? Lara: Yes, especially when I let it dry naturally.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你的头发真浓密！吹干要花很久吗？拉拉：是啊，尤其是让它自然晾干的时候。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm għandek xagħar folt! Tieħu ħafna ħin biex tnixxfu?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm għandek xagħar folt! Tieħu ħafna ħin biex tnixxfu?
messages.zh: 你的头发真浓密！吹干要花很久吗？
messages.en: Your hair is so thick! Does it take you a long time to dry it?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment meta nħallih jinxef waħdu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment meta nħallih jinxef waħdu.
messages.zh: 是啊，尤其是让它自然晾干的时候。
messages.en: Yes, especially when I let it dry naturally.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 folt 时想象密密的一头头发：重点是长得多、长得密，连着 xagħar folt 和 pil folt 一起记。

gloss_zh: 巴赫里亚附近的一处海滩

teaching_sense.en_definition: A beach near Baħrija.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指巴赫里亚附近的一处海滩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xatt qrib Baħrija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 巴赫里亚附近的一处海滩。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xatt li jinsab qrib Baħrija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This name refers to a beach situated near Baħrija.

formal.mt: Il-grupp ippjana żjara fix-xatt ta' fomiriħ, qrib Baħrija.
formal.en: The group planned a visit to the beach at fomiriħ, near Baħrija.
formal.zh: 小组计划前往巴赫里亚附近的 fomiriħ 海滩参观。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid immorru sa fomiriħ għada? Mark: Iva, nixtieq nagħmel mixja ħdejn il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you want to go to fomiriħ tomorrow? Mark: Yes, I'd like to take a walk by the sea.
colloquial.zh: Lara：明天想去 fomiriħ 吗？Mark：好啊，我想在海边散散步。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 明天想去 fomiriħ 吗？
messages.en: Do you want to go to fomiriħ tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq nagħmel mixja ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq nagħmel mixja ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.zh: 好啊，我想在海边散散步。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to take a walk by the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fomiriħ 与“巴赫里亚附近的海滩”配成一张记忆卡，再用“去海滩散步”的画面帮助记忆。

gloss_zh: Fomm ir-Riħ 湾，马耳他西侧的一处小海湾

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a small bay on the western side of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他西侧一处小海湾的专有名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' bajja żgħira fin-naħa tal-punent ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: A small bay on the western side of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 位于马耳他西侧的一处小海湾，名称为 Fomm ir-Riħ。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bajja żgħira li tinsab fin-naħa tal-punent ta' Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fomm ir-Riħ is the name of a small bay on Malta's western side.

formal.mt: Fomm ir-Riħ hija bajja żgħira fin-naħa tal-punent ta' Malta.
formal.en: Fomm ir-Riħ is a small bay on the western side of Malta.
formal.zh: Fomm ir-Riħ 是位于马耳他西侧的一处小海湾。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn tinsab Fomm ir-Riħ? Pawlu: Fin-naħa tal-punent ta' Malta. Trid nurik fuq il-mappa?
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is Fomm ir-Riħ? Pawlu: On the western side of Malta. Would you like me to show you on the map?
colloquial.zh: Nina：Fomm ir-Riħ 在哪里？Pawlu：在马耳他西侧。要我在地图上指给你看吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.zh: Fomm ir-Riħ 在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Fomm ir-Riħ?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fin-naħa tal-punent ta' Malta. Trid nurik fuq il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Fin-naħa tal-punent ta' Malta. Trid nurik fuq il-mappa?
messages.zh: 在马耳他西侧。要我在地图上指给你看吗？
messages.en: On the western side of Malta. Would you like me to show you on the map?

cognitive_memory_aid: 在想象中的马耳他地图西侧画一个小海湾，标上 Fomm ir-Riħ，把完整地名和地理位置一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pool of money contributed by several people or groups and used for shared purposes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由多个人或团体共同出资、用于共同目的的一笔资金。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Somma ta' flus li diversi persuni jew gruppi jiġbru flimkien biex jużawha għal skopijiet komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由多方共同筹集并用于共同目的的资金。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Flus miġbura minn diversi persuni jew gruppi u miżmuma flimkien biex jitħallsu spejjeż jew jintlaħqu għanijiet komuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A common fund is money that several people or groups contribute and use for purposes they share.

formal.mt: Il-membri tal-għaqda ħolqu fond komuni biex iħallsu l-ispejjeż tal-attivitajiet.
formal.en: The association's members created a common fund to pay for the activities.
formal.zh: 协会成员设立了一笔共同资金，用于支付活动费用。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Nagħmlu fond komuni għall-ikel tal-vjaġġ? Pawlu: Iva, kull wieħed minna jista' jagħti għaxar ewro.
colloquial.en: Marija: Shall we set up a common fund for food on the trip? Pawlu: Yes, each of us can put in ten euros.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我们凑一笔共同资金，支付旅行中的伙食费，好吗？保罗：好，我们每人可以出十欧元。

messages.speaker: Marija (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 我们凑一笔共同资金，支付旅行中的伙食费，好吗？
messages.en: Shall we set up a common fund for food on the trip?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kull wieħed minna jista' jagħti għaxar ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kull wieħed minna jista' jagħti għaxar ewro.
messages.zh: 好，我们每人可以出十欧元。
messages.en: Yes, each of us can put in ten euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大家把钱放进同一个公用钱盒：fond komuni 就是共同出资、共同使用的资金。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money set aside to cover unexpected expenses or needs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 预先留出、用于应对意外支出或突发需要的一笔资金。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Somma ta' flus imwarrba minn qabel biex tkopri spejjeż jew ħtiġijiet mhux mistennija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为支付意外费用或应对突发情况而设立的应急基金。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fond maħluq biex ikun hemm flus disponibbli meta jinqalgħu spejjeż jew sitwazzjonijiet mhux mistennija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contingency fund is money set aside to pay for unexpected costs or deal with unforeseen situations.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在预算或现有资金中预留、用于应付意外需要的应急储备金。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Riżerva ta' flus miżmuma fil-baġit jew mill-fondi disponibbli biex tintuża jekk jinqalgħu ħtiġijiet mhux mistennija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contingency reserve is an amount of money kept available in case unexpected needs arise.

collocations.mt: iwarrab flus għal fond ta' kontinġenza
collocations.en: set aside money for a contingency fund

formal.mt: Il-baġit tal-proġett jinkludi fond ta' kontinġenza biex ikopri spejjeż mhux mistennija.
formal.en: The project budget includes a contingency fund to cover unexpected expenses.
formal.zh: 项目预算包含一笔应急基金，用于支付意外费用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed inwarrbu ftit flus kull xahar? Mark: Biex ikollna fond ta' kontinġenza jekk tinqala' xi spiża mhux mistennija.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are we putting a little money aside every month? Mark: So we have a contingency fund if an unexpected expense comes up.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们为什么每个月都要存下一点钱？马克：这样万一出现意外开销，我们就有应急储备金了。

messages.speaker: Sara (家庭成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed inwarrbu ftit flus kull xahar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed inwarrbu ftit flus kull xahar?
messages.zh: 我们为什么每个月都要存下一点钱？
messages.en: Why are we putting a little money aside every month?

messages.speaker: Mark (家庭成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ikollna fond ta' kontinġenza jekk tinqala' xi spiża mhux mistennija.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ikollna fond ta' kontinġenza jekk tinqala' xi spiża mhux mistennija.
messages.zh: 这样万一出现意外开销，我们就有应急储备金了。
messages.en: So we have a contingency fund if an unexpected expense comes up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词联想成标着“以防万一”的备用钱袋：平时预留，遇到意外费用时才动用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The small particles of ground coffee left after coffee has been brewed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 咖啡冲煮后留下的咖啡粉颗粒或沉渣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-partiċelli tal-kafè mitħun li jibqgħu wara li jkun tħejja l-kafè.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咖啡冲煮后残留的咖啡粉渣。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fdal tal-kafè mitħun li jibqa' fil-filtru jew fil-qiegħ tar-reċipjent wara li jitħejja l-kafè.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Coffee grounds are the small particles of ground coffee that remain after the drink has been made.

formal.mt: Wara li tħejji l-kafè, neħħi l-fond tal-kafè mill-filtru u naddaf it-tagħmir.
formal.en: After making the coffee, remove the coffee grounds from the filter and clean the equipment.
formal.zh: 冲煮咖啡后，请清除滤器中的咖啡渣，并清洁设备。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għad hemm il-fond tal-kafè fil-filtru? Ġanni: Iva, se nneħħih issa u naħsel il-filtru.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are the coffee grounds still in the filter? Ġanni: Yes, I'll remove them now and wash the filter.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：咖啡渣还在滤器里吗？詹尼：是的，我现在就把它清掉，再洗一下滤器。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 咖啡渣还在滤器里吗？
messages.en: Are the coffee grounds still in the filter?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nneħħih issa u naħsel il-filtru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nneħħih issa u naħsel il-filtru.
messages.zh: 是的，我现在就把它清掉，再洗一下滤器。
messages.en: Yes, I'll remove them now and wash the filter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住冲完咖啡后滤器里湿湿的褐色残渣，把这个画面与整组 fond tal-kafè 绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Established or set up, especially as an institution, club, or organisation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容机构、俱乐部或组织已经被创立、成立或设立。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġie mwaqqaf jew stabbilit, speċjalment bħala istitut, klabb jew organizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 创立的；成立的，指机构或组织已经开始存在。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġie mwaqqaf u beda jeżisti bħala istituzzjoni jew organizzazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An institution described as founded has been brought into existence by its founders.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设立的；建立的，指机构或组织已经被组建起来。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġie stabbilit u organizzat bħala entità, bħal klabb jew ċentru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An organisation described as set up has been established for a particular purpose.

formal.mt: Il-klabb, fondat minn grupp ta' studenti, jorganizza attivitajiet kulturali.
formal.en: The club, founded by a group of students, organises cultural activities.
formal.zh: 这个由一群学生创立的俱乐部组织文化活动。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-klabb ilu jeżisti? Mark: Le, għadu ġdid. Kien fondat is-sena l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has this club been around for a long time? Mark: No, it's still new. It was founded last year.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个俱乐部成立很久了吗？Mark：没有，还很新，是去年成立的。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个俱乐部成立很久了吗？
messages.en: Has this club been around for a long time?

messages.speaker: Mark (俱乐部成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għadu ġdid. Kien fondat is-sena l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għadu ġdid. Kien fondat is-sena l-oħra.
messages.zh: 没有，还很新，是去年成立的。
messages.en: No, it's still new. It was founded last year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象俱乐部门口挂着“去年成立”的牌子，用 klabb fondat 把“俱乐部”和“已创立的”连成一个记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organisation established as a foundation to carry out or support particular activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以基金会形式设立、开展或支持特定活动的组织。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Organizzazzjoni mwaqqfa bħala fondazzjoni biex twettaq jew tappoġġa attivitajiet għal għanijiet partikolari.

sense_translations.en_definition: foundation (an organisation created as a foundation)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 基金会，即以基金会形式设立的组织。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Organizzazzjoni li tkun ġiet stabbilita bħala fondazzjoni għal għanijiet partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A foundation is an organisation established in that form to pursue particular aims.

formal.mt: Il-fondazzjoni tipprovdi appoġġ finanzjarju għal proġetti edukattivi fil-komunità.
formal.en: The foundation provides financial support for educational projects in the community.
formal.zh: 该基金会为社区内的教育项目提供资金支持。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min qed jgħin biex jitħallas il-kors? Lara: Fondazzjoni edukattiva. Qed tkopri nofs l-ispiża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is helping to pay for the course? Lara: An educational foundation. It's covering half the cost.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁在帮忙支付课程费用？Lara：一家教育基金会，承担了一半的费用。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Min qed jgħin biex jitħallas il-kors?
messages.mt_standard: Min qed jgħin biex jitħallas il-kors?
messages.zh: 谁在帮忙支付课程费用？
messages.en: Who is helping to pay for the course?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fondazzjoni edukattiva. Qed tkopri nofs l-ispiża.
messages.mt_standard: Fondazzjoni edukattiva. Qed tkopri nofs l-ispiża.
messages.zh: 一家教育基金会，承担了一半的费用。
messages.en: An educational foundation. It's covering half the cost.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张写着 fondazzjoni 的基金会资助通知，再配上“教育项目获得支持”的场景，记住这里指一种组织。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to speech sounds or to the representation of pronunciation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与言语声音有关的，或用于记录、表示发音的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ħsejjes tad-diskors jew mar-rappreżentazzjoni tal-pronunzja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与言语声音及其发音有关的；用符号表示实际发音的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-ħsejjes tad-diskors u kif jiġu ppronunzjati, jew li juża simboli biex jirrappreżenta dawn il-ħsejjes.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is phonetic relates to speech sounds or represents the way words are pronounced.

formal.mt: Id-dizzjunarju juża alfabet fonetiku biex juri l-pronunzja tal-kliem.
formal.en: The dictionary uses a phonetic alphabet to show how words are pronounced.
formal.zh: 这本词典使用音标字母表来标示单词的发音。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif nippronunzja din il-kelma? Pawlu: Ħares lejn it-traskrizzjoni fonetika ħdejha; turik il-ħsejjes tal-kelma.
colloquial.en: Rita: How do I pronounce this word? Pawlu: Look at the phonetic transcription beside it; it shows you the sounds of the word.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这个词怎么读？保罗：看它旁边的音标转写；那里标出了这个词的语音。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.zh: 这个词怎么读？
messages.en: How do I pronounce this word?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares lejn it-traskrizzjoni fonetika ħdejha; turik il-ħsejjes tal-kelma.
messages.mt_standard: Ħares lejn it-traskrizzjoni fonetika ħdejha; turik il-ħsejjes tal-kelma.
messages.zh: 看它旁边的音标转写；那里标出了这个词的语音。
messages.en: Look at the phonetic transcription beside it; it shows you the sounds of the word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fonetiku 与“听声音、看音标”一起记：alfabet fonetiku 是音标字母表；搭配阴性名词时，可见 traskrizzjoni fonetika。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to scientific examination of evidence for criminal investigations or legal proceedings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与为刑事调查或司法程序而对证据进行科学检验有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-eżami xjentifiku tal-provi għal investigazzjonijiet kriminali jew proċeduri fil-qorti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涉及运用科学方法检验、分析证据，以协助刑事调查或司法程序的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi l-użu ta' metodi xjentifiċi biex jiġu eżaminati u analizzati provi għal investigazzjoni kriminali jew għal proċeduri fil-qorti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Forensic work uses scientific methods to examine evidence for criminal investigations or legal proceedings.

formal.mt: L-espert forensiku ppreżenta rapport dwar l-analiżi tal-provi lill-qorti.
formal.en: The forensic expert presented a report on the analysis of the evidence to the court.
formal.zh: 法证专家向法庭提交了一份关于证据分析的报告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jagħmel espert forensiku? Mark: Jeżamina l-provi b'metodi xjentifiċi biex jgħin fl-investigazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does a forensic expert do? Mark: They examine evidence using scientific methods to help with the investigation.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：法证专家做什么工作？马克：用科学方法检验证据，协助调查。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 法证专家做什么工作？
messages.en: What does a forensic expert do?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jeżamina l-provi b'metodi xjentifiċi biex jgħin fl-investigazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Jeżamina l-provi b'metodi xjentifiċi biex jgħin fl-investigazzjoni.
messages.zh: 用科学方法检验证据，协助调查。
messages.en: They examine evidence using scientific methods to help with the investigation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 forensiku，就联想“科学检验证据”的场景；搭配 espert 记专家，搭配 analiżi 时观察 forensika 的形式。

gloss_zh: 福费廷（无追索权出口应收款融资）；丧失或放弃权利

teaching_sense.en_definition: Export financing in which a financial institution buys receivables without recourse to the exporter if the buyer fails to pay.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 金融机构买入出口应收款，并在买方不付款时不向出口商追索的融资方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma ta' finanzjament tal-esportazzjoni li fiha istituzzjoni finanzjarja tixtri krediti mingħajr dritt ta' rikors kontra l-esportatur jekk ix-xerrej ma jħallasx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 福费廷：金融机构以无追索权方式买入出口应收款，为出口商提供融资。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arranġament ta' finanzjament li fih istituzzjoni finanzjarja tixtri l-krediti ta' esportatur mingħajr ma tkun tista' titlob il-ħlas lura mingħandu jekk ix-xerrej ma jħallasx.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Forfaiting is an arrangement in which a financial institution buys export receivables without recourse to the exporter if the buyer fails to pay.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因违反规则、未履行条件等而丧失某物或某项权利，或主动放弃某项权利的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jitlef xi ħaġa jew dritt minħabba ksur ta' regola jew nuqqas li jwettaq kundizzjoni, jew li jirrinunzja għal dritt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Forfeiting is the act of losing something because a rule or condition has been broken, or of giving up a right.

formal.mt: Il-ftehim ta' forfaiting jistipula li l-bank jixtri l-krediti tal-esportatur mingħajr dritt ta' rikors kontrih jekk ix-xerrej ma jħallasx.
formal.en: The forfaiting agreement specifies that the bank buys the exporter's receivables without recourse to the exporter if the buyer fails to pay.
formal.zh: 福费廷协议规定，银行买入出口商的应收款，并在买方不付款时不向出口商追索。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Xi jfisser forfaiting f'dan il-kuntratt? David: Ifisser li l-bank jixtri l-krediti tagħna, u jekk ix-xerrej ma jħallasx, ma jistax jitlob il-ħlas lura mingħandna.
colloquial.en: Rita: What does forfaiting mean in this contract? David: It means the bank buys our receivables, and if the buyer fails to pay, it cannot demand repayment from us.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这份合同里的 forfaiting 是什么意思？戴维：意思是银行买下我们的应收款；如果买方不付款，银行不能要求我们偿还。

messages.speaker: Rita (出口公司职员)
messages.zh: 这份合同里的 forfaiting 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does forfaiting mean in this contract?

messages.speaker: David (财务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-bank jixtri l-krediti tagħna, u jekk ix-xerrej ma jħallasx, ma jistax jitlob il-ħlas lura mingħandna.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-bank jixtri l-krediti tagħna, u jekk ix-xerrej ma jħallasx, ma jistax jitlob il-ħlas lura mingħandna.
messages.zh: 意思是银行买下我们的应收款；如果买方不付款，银行不能要求我们偿还。
messages.en: It means the bank buys our receivables, and if the buyer fails to pay, it cannot demand repayment from us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 forfaiting 做两张情境卡：银行买入出口应收款时记“福费廷”，规则导致失去资格或权益时记“丧失、放弃”，用上下文区分义项。

gloss_zh: 理所当然；想当然地认定

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used with tieħu to describe assuming that something is certain or will remain available without questioning it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于 tieħu 等表达中，表示未经质疑便认定某事必然如此，或把某人的帮助等视为理所当然。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża ma' tieħu biex tesprimi li tqis xi ħaġa bħala ċerta jew dejjem disponibbli, mingħajr ma tiddubitaha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被当作确定无疑的事；被视为理所当然。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li titqies bħala ċerta mingħajr ma tiġi mistoqsija jew ivverifikata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you take something for granted, you assume that it is true or will remain available without questioning that assumption.

collocations.zh: 想当然地认为一定会成功

formal.mt: Ma għandniex nieħdu l-għajnuna tal-voluntiera forgranted; għandna nirrikonoxxu l-ħin u l-isforz tagħhom.
formal.en: We should not take the volunteers' help for granted; we should acknowledge their time and effort.
formal.zh: 我们不应把志愿者的帮助视为理所当然，而应认可他们付出的时间和努力。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Pawlu dejjem jgħinni meta jkolli bżonn. Rita: Tajjeb, imma tiħux l-għajnuna tiegħu forgranted. Għidlu grazzi.
colloquial.en: Marija: Paul always helps me when I need it. Rita: That's good, but don't take his help for granted. Thank him.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我需要帮助时，保罗总会帮我。Rita：这很好，但别把他的帮助当作理所当然。记得谢谢他。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu dejjem jgħinni meta jkolli bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu dejjem jgħinni meta jkolli bżonn.
messages.zh: 我需要帮助时，保罗总会帮我。
messages.en: Paul always helps me when I need it.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, imma tiħux l-għajnuna tiegħu forgranted. Għidlu grazzi.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, imma tiħux l-għajnuna tiegħu forgranted. Għidlu grazzi.
messages.zh: 这很好，但别把他的帮助当作理所当然。记得谢谢他。
messages.en: That's good, but don't take his help for granted. Thank him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tieħu…forgranted 整块记成“把……当作理所当然”，用“别人帮助我，我仍要道谢”的情景巩固记忆。

gloss_zh: 正式的；合乎正式礼仪或规范的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Following the conventions, procedures, or style appropriate to an official or serious occasion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 符合官方、庄重场合所要求的礼仪、程序或表达风格的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jsegwi r-regoli, il-proċeduri jew l-istil xieraq għal okkażjoni uffiċjali jew serja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正式的，指言语、服装、活动或程序符合庄重场合的规范。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun adattat għal sitwazzjoni uffiċjali jew serja u josserva l-konvenzjonijiet mistennija fl-imġiba, fl-ilbies jew fil-komunikazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is formal follows the accepted conventions of an official or serious situation.

formal.mt: Il-kandidati huma mitluba jużaw lingwaġġ formali fl-ittra ta' applikazzjoni.
formal.en: Candidates are asked to use formal language in their application letter.
formal.zh: 申请人须在申请信中使用正式语言。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi nilbes ġakketta għal-laqgħa? Mark: Iva, hija laqgħa formali mal-klijenti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Should I wear a jacket to the meeting? Mark: Yes, it's a formal meeting with the clients.
colloquial.zh: Lara：开会要穿西装外套吗？Mark：要，这是一次与客户举行的正式会议。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 开会要穿西装外套吗？
messages.en: Should I wear a jacket to the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 要，这是一次与客户举行的正式会议。
messages.en: Yes, it's a formal meeting with the clients.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 formali 就联想“穿正装、写正式信、参加正式会议”，把这个形容词与庄重场合一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official procedure required by customs when goods or luggage cross a border.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 货物或行李跨越国境时，按海关要求办理的申报、文件提交等正式手续。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura uffiċjali mitluba mid-dwana meta merkanzija jew bagalji jaqsmu fruntiera, bħall-preżentazzjoni ta' dikjarazzjoni jew dokumenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 货物或行李进出国境时需要办理的海关手续。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċeduri uffiċjali li jridu jitwettqu mad-dwana għad-dħul jew għall-ħruġ ta' merkanzija jew bagalji minn pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Customs formalities are the official procedures you must complete with customs when bringing goods into or taking them out of a country.

collocations.zh: 办理海关手续所需的文件

formal.mt: L-importatur għandu jippreżenta d-dokumenti meħtieġa biex il-formalitajiet doganali jitlestew qabel il-kunsinna.
formal.en: The importer must submit the required documents so that customs formalities can be completed before delivery.
formal.zh: 进口商须提交所需文件，以便在交货前办妥海关手续。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nista' niġbor il-pakkett illum? Joseph: Għad irridu nlestu l-formalitajiet doganali. Inċempillek meta jkun lest.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can I collect the parcel today? Joseph: We still need to complete the customs formalities. I'll call you when it's ready.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我今天可以取包裹吗？Joseph：我们还得办完海关手续。可以领取时，我会打电话给你。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 我今天可以取包裹吗？
messages.en: Can I collect the parcel today?

messages.speaker: Joseph (货运公司职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad irridu nlestu l-formalitajiet doganali. Inċempillek meta jkun lest.
messages.mt_standard: Għad irridu nlestu l-formalitajiet doganali. Inċempillek meta jkun lest.
messages.zh: 我们还得办完海关手续。可以领取时，我会打电话给你。
messages.en: We still need to complete the customs formalities. I'll call you when it's ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 formalità doganali 放进“包裹到达海关，提交文件后领取”的画面中；单项手续与复数 formalitajiet doganali 配对记忆。

gloss_zh: 离境手续；离开时须办的手续

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official procedural step required before leaving a country or another controlled place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 离开某个国家或受管理的场所之前，必须完成的一项正式手续。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pass jew proċedura uffiċjali li trid titwettaq qabel ma persuna titlaq minn pajjiż jew minn post fejn il-ħruġ ikun ikkontrollat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 离境或离开受管理场所时需要办理的一项正式手续。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura amministrattiva meħtieġa biex persuna tkun tista' titlaq minn pajjiż jew minn post b'kontroll tal-ħruġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An exit formality is an official step that a person must complete before being allowed to leave a country or controlled place.

collocations.zh: 一项必须办理的离境手续

formal.mt: Skont l-istruzzjonijiet tal-vjaġġ, il-passiġġier għandu jlesti kull formalità tal-ħruġ meħtieġa qabel ma jitla' abbord.
formal.en: According to the travel instructions, the passenger must complete every required exit formality before boarding.
formal.zh: 根据出行须知，旅客必须在登机前办妥各项必要的离境手续。

colloquial.mt: David: Issa nistgħu mmorru lejn il-bieb tal-imbark? Sara: Għad fadal formalità tal-ħruġ waħda. Wara nistgħu mmorru.
colloquial.en: David: Can we go to the boarding gate now? Sara: There's still one exit formality left. We can go after that.
colloquial.zh: David：我们现在可以去登机口了吗？Sara：还有一项离境手续没办。办完就可以去了。

messages.speaker: David (同行旅客)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa nistgħu mmorru lejn il-bieb tal-imbark?
messages.mt_standard: Issa nistgħu mmorru lejn il-bieb tal-imbark?
messages.zh: 我们现在可以去登机口了吗？
messages.en: Can we go to the boarding gate now?

messages.speaker: Sara (同行旅客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad fadal formalità tal-ħruġ waħda. Wara nistgħu mmorru.
messages.mt_standard: Għad fadal formalità tal-ħruġ waħda. Wara nistgħu mmorru.
messages.zh: 还有一项离境手续没办。办完就可以去了。
messages.en: There's still one exit formality left. We can go after that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 formalità tal-ħruġ 记成“离开之前还要办的一道手续”，联想办完最后一项离境手续再走向登机口。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The arrangement or presentation of information in a document or other medium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 文件或其他载体中信息的编排和呈现形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mod kif l-informazzjoni tkun organizzata u ppreżentata f'dokument jew f'mezz ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 信息、文件或内容所采用的格式和编排形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-forma li tintuża biex jiġi organizzat u ppreżentat il-kontenut ta' dokument jew ta' materjal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The format of a document is the way its information is arranged and presented.

formal.mt: Ir-rapporti kollha għandhom isegwu l-istess format biex ikun aktar faċli li jitqabblu.
formal.en: All reports should follow the same format so that they are easier to compare.
formal.zh: 所有报告都应采用相同格式，以便比较。

colloquial.mt: Maja: F'liema format trid ir-rapport? Mark: Uża l-istess format bħal dak tal-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: What format do you want the report in? Mark: Use the same format as last week's report.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你希望报告用什么格式？Mark：用上周报告的格式就行。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你希望报告用什么格式？
messages.en: What format do you want the report in?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża l-istess format bħal dak tal-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.mt_standard: Uża l-istess format bħal dak tal-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.zh: 用上周报告的格式就行。
messages.en: Use the same format as last week's report.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 format 和英语同形词一起记：想象同一份报告换了标题位置和段落排列，内容相同，格式改变。

gloss_zh: 程式；公式；固定表达形式

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fixed form used to express a rule, calculation, or procedure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来表达规则、计算关系或操作程序的固定形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma stabbilita li tintuża biex tesprimi regola, kalkolu jew proċedura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表达规则、计算关系或程序所用的固定形式或程式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Forma fissa ta' espressjoni li biha tiġi ppreżentata regola, relazzjoni ta' kalkolu jew proċedura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A formula is a set form in which a rule, calculation, or procedure is expressed.

formal.mt: Il-formula miktuba fid-dokument turi kif jiġi kkalkulat il-prezz finali.
formal.en: The formula written in the document shows how the final price is calculated.
formal.zh: 文件中写明的公式展示了最终价格的计算方法。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema formula nuża biex insib il-prezz finali? Pawlu: Uża dik fin-noti; l-ewwel żid l-ispejjeż kollha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which formula should I use to find the final price? Pawlu: Use the one in the notes; first add up all the costs.
colloquial.zh: Sara：计算最终价格该用哪个公式？Pawlu：用笔记里的那个；先把所有费用加起来。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema formula nuża biex insib il-prezz finali?
messages.mt_standard: Liema formula nuża biex insib il-prezz finali?
messages.zh: 计算最终价格该用哪个公式？
messages.en: Which formula should I use to find the final price?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża dik fin-noti; l-ewwel żid l-ispejjeż kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Uża dik fin-noti; l-ewwel żid l-ispejjeż kollha.
messages.zh: 用笔记里的那个；先把所有费用加起来。
messages.en: Use the one in the notes; first add up all the costs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 formula 想成一张可以反复套用的规则卡：计算或表达有固定形式，就联想到程式或公式。

gloss_zh: 已拟定的；已明确表述的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Developed or expressed in a definite and organized form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经形成明确、有条理的形式，或已用明确语言表述出来的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie mfassal jew espress f'forma definita u organizzata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经过构思而拟定，或已经用明确形式表达出来的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie żviluppat permezz tal-ħsieb jew imqiegħed fi kliem li jesprimi l-kontenut b'mod definit.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is formulated has been developed or expressed in a definite, organized form.

formal.mt: L-għan tal-proġett huwa formulat b'mod ċar fid-dokument sabiex kull membru tat-tim jifhem x'għandu jsir.
formal.en: The project's objective is clearly formulated in the document so that every team member understands what needs to be done.
formal.zh: 项目目标已在文件中明确表述，以便每位团队成员了解需要完成的工作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taħseb li dan il-pjan huwa formulat tajjeb? David: Iva, iżda rridu niċċaraw min se jagħmel kull xogħol.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you think this plan is well formulated? David: Yes, but we need to clarify who will do each task.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你觉得这个计划拟定得好吗？David：是的，不过我们还得明确每项工作由谁负责。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li dan il-pjan huwa formulat tajjeb?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li dan il-pjan huwa formulat tajjeb?
messages.zh: 你觉得这个计划拟定得好吗？
messages.en: Do you think this plan is well formulated?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iżda rridu niċċaraw min se jagħmel kull xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iżda rridu niċċaraw min se jagħmel kull xogħol.
messages.zh: 是的，不过我们还得明确每项工作由谁负责。
messages.en: Yes, but we need to clarify who will do each task.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把脑中零散的计划整理成清楚的文字，再盖上“已拟定”印章；用这个画面记住 formulat 描述的状态。

gloss_zh: 可持续采购；可持续来源获取

teaching_sense.en_definition: Obtaining goods or materials from sources chosen with regard to long-term environmental and social effects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在选择商品或材料来源时，考虑长期环境及社会影响的采购方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kisba ta' prodotti jew materjali minn sorsi magħżula b'kunsiderazzjoni għall-effetti ambjentali u soċjali fit-tul.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在获取商品或原材料时，兼顾来源的长期环境和社会影响的可持续采购做法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prattika ta' xiri u kisba ta' prodotti jew materjali li tqis l-impatt tas-sorsi tagħhom fuq l-ambjent u fuq in-nies fit-tul.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sustainable sourcing is the practice of obtaining goods or materials while considering the long-term environmental and social effects of their sources.

formal.mt: Il-politika ta' forniment sostenibbli titlob li l-kumpanija tqis l-impatt ambjentali u l-kundizzjonijiet tax-xogħol meta tagħżel il-fornituri.
formal.en: The sustainable sourcing policy requires the company to consider environmental impact and working conditions when choosing suppliers.
formal.zh: 这项可持续采购政策要求公司在选择供应商时考虑环境影响和劳动条件。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed nistaqsu minn fejn ġej dan id-drapp? Mark: Għax irridu forniment sostenibbli; irridu nkunu nafu kif isir u f'liema kundizzjonijiet jaħdmu n-nies.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are we asking where this fabric comes from? Mark: Because we want sustainable sourcing; we want to know how it is made and what conditions people work in.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们为什么要问这种布料来自哪里？Mark：因为我们希望做到可持续采购；我们想了解它如何生产，以及工人的劳动条件。

messages.speaker: Nina (采购助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed nistaqsu minn fejn ġej dan id-drapp?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed nistaqsu minn fejn ġej dan id-drapp?
messages.zh: 我们为什么要问这种布料来自哪里？
messages.en: Why are we asking where this fabric comes from?

messages.speaker: Mark (采购经理)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax irridu forniment sostenibbli; irridu nkunu nafu kif isir u f'liema kundizzjonijiet jaħdmu n-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Għax irridu forniment sostenibbli; irridu nkunu nafu kif isir u f'liema kundizzjonijiet jaħdmu n-nies.
messages.zh: 因为我们希望做到可持续采购；我们想了解它如何生产，以及工人的劳动条件。
messages.en: Because we want sustainable sourcing; we want to know how it is made and what conditions people work in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词配上一张采购单来记：挑选来源时，同时看环境、劳动条件和长期影响，就联想到可持续采购。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or organization that provides a service to maintain or restore balance in a system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提供服务以维持或恢复某个系统平衡的个人或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tipprovdi servizz biex jinżamm jew jerġa' jinkiseb bilanċ f'sistema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为维持或恢复系统平衡而提供相关服务的个人或机构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni responsabbli biex tipprovdi servizz li jżomm jew jerġa' jġib bilanċ f'sistema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A balancing service provider is a person or organization that supplies services needed to maintain or restore balance within a system.

collocations.mt: kuntratt ma' fornitur tas-servizz ta' bbilanċjar
collocations.en: a contract with a balancing service provider
collocations.zh: 与平衡服务提供者签订的合同

collocations.mt: l-għażla ta' fornitur tas-servizz ta' bbilanċjar
collocations.en: the selection of a balancing service provider
collocations.zh: 平衡服务提供者的选择

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt jispeċifika r-responsabbiltajiet tal-fornitur tas-servizz ta' bbilanċjar.
formal.en: The contract specifies the responsibilities of the balancing service provider.
formal.zh: 合同明确规定了平衡服务提供者的职责。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għażiltu fornitur tas-servizz ta' bbilanċjar? Pawlu: Għadna le; qed inqabblu żewġ offerti.
colloquial.en: Marta: Have you chosen a balancing service provider? Pawlu: Not yet; we are comparing two offers.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你们选好平衡服务提供者了吗？保罗：还没有，我们正在比较两份报价。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 你们选好平衡服务提供者了吗？
messages.en: Have you chosen a balancing service provider?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (采购负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna le; qed inqabblu żewġ offerti.
messages.mt_standard: Għadna le; qed inqabblu żewġ offerti.
messages.zh: 还没有，我们正在比较两份报价。
messages.en: Not yet; we are comparing two offers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整串词按意思分成“提供者—服务—平衡”三块，想象采购人员选择维持系统平衡的服务商；这是理解短语的记忆法，不是词源分析。

gloss_zh: 防御工事；设防、加固防御

teaching_sense.en_definition: Defensive structures protecting a place, or the act of strengthening a place against attack.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 保护某地的防御工事，也指为抵御攻击而进行设防或加固防御的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strutturi difensivi li jipproteġu post, jew l-att li post jissaħħaħ biex ikun jista' jirreżisti attakk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为保护某地、抵御攻击而修建的城墙、堡垒等防御工事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħitan, swar u strutturi difensivi oħra mibnija biex jipproteġu post minn attakk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fortifications are walls and other defensive structures built to protect a place against attack.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过修建或加强防御设施，使某地更能抵御攻击的行为或过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li post jissaħħaħ kontra attakk billi jinbnew jew jissaħħu strutturi difensivi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The act of fortifying involves strengthening a place so that it can resist an attack more effectively.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-fortifikazzjoni tal-belt u jidentifika l-fdalijiet tal-istrutturi difensivi tagħha.
formal.en: The report describes the fortification of the city and identifies the remains of its defensive structures.
formal.zh: 报告描述了城市的设防过程，并指出了其防御设施的遗迹。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dik il-ħajt kienet parti mill-fortifikazzjoni? Toni: Iva, kienet tgħin biex tipproteġi l-belt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Was that wall part of the fortifications? Toni: Yes, it helped protect the city.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那道墙以前是防御工事的一部分吗？托尼：是的，它有助于保护这座城市。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.zh: 那道墙以前是防御工事的一部分吗？
messages.en: Was that wall part of the fortifications?

messages.speaker: Toni (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kienet tgħin biex tipproteġi l-belt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kienet tgħin biex tipproteġi l-belt.
messages.zh: 是的，它有助于保护这座城市。
messages.en: Yes, it helped protect the city.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张图分成左右两格：左格正在修城墙，记“设防行为”；右格城墙已经建成，记“防御工事”。同一个词可指过程或设施。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strongly defended building or place built to resist attack.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为抵御攻击而建造、具有坚固防御设施的建筑或地点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini jew post b'difiżi b'saħħithom, mibni biex jirreżisti attakk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有坚固防御设施、用于抵御攻击的要塞或堡垒。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bini jew post imsaħħaħ b'ħitan u difiżi oħra biex jipproteġi lil min ikun fih minn attakk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fortress is a strongly defended building or place designed to protect its occupants against attack.

formal.mt: Il-pjan tar-restawr jinkludi t-tiswija tal-ħitan tal-fortizza u l-konservazzjoni tad-daħla prinċipali.
formal.en: The restoration plan includes repairing the fortress walls and conserving the main entrance.
formal.zh: 修复计划包括修缮要塞城墙和保护主要入口。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Immorru naraw il-fortizza llum? Mark: Iva, irrid nara l-ħitan tagħha mill-qrib.
colloquial.en: Nina: Shall we go and see the fortress today? Mark: Yes, I want to see its walls up close.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们今天去看看那座要塞好吗？马克：好，我想近距离看看它的城墙。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们今天去看看那座要塞好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go and see the fortress today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irrid nara l-ħitan tagħha mill-qrib.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irrid nara l-ħitan tagħha mill-qrib.
messages.zh: 好，我想近距离看看它的城墙。
messages.en: Yes, I want to see its walls up close.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fortizza 配上一幅厚墙、窄门、有人守卫的建筑图，整座建筑就是“要塞”；再用“要塞的城墙”和“要塞的入口”两个短语巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of the video game Fortnite.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 电子游戏《堡垒之夜》的名称，英文名称为 Fortnite。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-logħba elettronika magħrufa bħala Fortnite.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 《堡垒之夜》，电子游戏 Fortnite 的名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem li jirreferi għal-logħba elettronika Fortnite.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fortnite is the name of a video game that people refer to when discussing or playing that game.

formal.mt: Fil-kwestjonarju, il-parteċipanti ġew mistoqsija kemm iqattgħu ħin jilagħbu Fortnite kull ġimgħa.
formal.en: In the questionnaire, participants were asked how much time they spend playing Fortnite each week.
formal.zh: 问卷询问了参与者每周花多少时间玩《堡垒之夜》。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid tilgħab Fortnite miegħi llejla? Ben: Iva, nista' nilgħab wara l-ikel.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you want to play Fortnite with me tonight? Ben: Yes, I can play after dinner.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今晚想和我一起玩《堡垒之夜》吗？本：想，我晚饭后可以玩。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今晚想和我一起玩《堡垒之夜》吗？
messages.en: Do you want to play Fortnite with me tonight?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，我晚饭后可以玩。
messages.en: Yes, I can play after dinner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Fortnite 当作游戏封面上的完整名称记忆，再把 nilgħab Fortnite 与“我玩《堡垒之夜》”配对；词条键虽为小写，例句中的游戏名使用大写首字母。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Luck or the influence of chance on what happens to someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 运气，或偶然因素对个人遭遇与事情结果的影响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xorti jew l-influwenza ta' ġrajjiet mhux ippjanati fuq dak li jiġri lil persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 命运；际遇，指个人生活中受到偶然因素影响的境遇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ġrajjiet tajbin jew ħżiena li jsawru l-ħajja ta' persuna u li ma jkunux kollha taħt il-kontroll tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone's fortune is the course their life takes through events partly beyond their control.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 运气，指并非完全由努力或计划决定的有利或不利结果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ix-xorti tajba jew ħażina li taffettwa r-riżultat ta' xi ħaġa mingħajr ma tiddependi għalkollox fuq l-isforz jew l-ippjanar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Luck is the way chance brings someone favorable or unfavorable results.

formal.mt: Mhux kollox jiddependi mill-fortuna; it-tħejjija hija importanti wkoll.
formal.en: Not everything depends on luck; preparation is important too.
formal.zh: 并非一切都取决于运气；准备也很重要。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sibt biljett fl-aħħar minuta? Mark: Kelli fortuna tajba! Xi ħadd ħassar il-prenotazzjoni tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you find a ticket at the last minute? Mark: I had good luck! Someone cancelled their booking.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么在最后一刻买到票的？马克：我运气好！有人取消了预订。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么在最后一刻买到票的？
messages.en: How did you find a ticket at the last minute?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli fortuna tajba! Xi ħadd ħassar il-prenotazzjoni tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli fortuna tajba! Xi ħadd ħassar il-prenotazzjoni tiegħu.
messages.zh: 我运气好！有人取消了预订。
messages.en: I had good luck! Someone cancelled their booking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把fortuna放进临时买到最后一张票的画面：准备之外还有运气；搭配tajba记好运，搭配ħażina记坏运气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to say that something happened in a way that was lucky or favorable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于说明某件事情幸运地发生，或事情结果令人庆幸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tindika li xi ħaġa ġrat b'xorti tajba jew b'riżultat favorevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 幸好；幸运的是，用于表达对有利情况或结果的庆幸。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'xorti tajba; tintuża biex il-kelliem jesprimi li ċirkostanza jew riżultat huwa favorevoli u ta' serħan il-moħħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You say fortunately when you are pleased that something happened in a favorable way.

formal.mt: Fortunatament, il-maltemp ma kkawża ebda ħsara lill-bini tal-iskola.
formal.en: Fortunately, the storm caused no damage to the school building.
formal.zh: 幸好，暴风雨没有对校舍造成任何损坏。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tlift ix-xarabank? Pawlu: Le, fortunatament waslet tard u lħaqtha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you miss the bus? Pawlu: No, fortunately it arrived late and I caught it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你错过公交车了吗？保罗：没有，幸好车晚到了，我赶上了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你错过公交车了吗？
messages.en: Did you miss the bus?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, fortunatament waslet tard u lħaqtha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, fortunatament waslet tard u lħaqtha.
messages.zh: 没有，幸好车晚到了，我赶上了。
messages.en: No, fortunately it arrived late and I caught it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象赶到车站时公交车也迟到了，松口气说fortunatament：幸好！把它当作引出幸运结果的整句提示词来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A meeting or platform where people exchange ideas and discuss a subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人们就某个主题交流意见、展开讨论的会议或平台。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Laqgħa jew pjattaforma fejn in-nies jiskambjaw ideat u jiddiskutu suġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 论坛，指供人们公开交换意见和讨论问题的会议、场合或网络平台。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Laqgħa, spazju jew pjattaforma fuq l-internet fejn il-parteċipanti jistgħu jesprimu l-opinjonijiet tagħhom u jiddiskutu kwistjonijiet ma' oħrajn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A forum is a meeting or platform where people can exchange opinions and discuss particular issues.

collocations.en: to take part in a forum

formal.mt: L-università organizzat forum pubbliku biex ir-residenti jkunu jistgħu jiddiskutu t-trasport fil-belt.
formal.en: The university organized a public forum so that residents could discuss transport in the city.
formal.zh: 大学组织了一场公共论坛，让居民能够讨论市内交通问题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn nista' nistaqsi dwar dan il-kors? David: Hemm forum għall-istudenti. Tista' tikteb il-mistoqsija tiegħek hemm.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where can I ask about this course? David: There is a forum for students. You can post your question there.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我可以在哪里询问这门课程的事情？戴维：有一个学生论坛。你可以在那里发问题。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' nistaqsi dwar dan il-kors?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' nistaqsi dwar dan il-kors?
messages.zh: 我可以在哪里询问这门课程的事情？
messages.en: Where can I ask about this course?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm forum għall-istudenti. Tista' tikteb il-mistoqsija tiegħek hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm forum għall-istudenti. Tista' tikteb il-mistoqsija tiegħek hemm.
messages.zh: 有一个学生论坛。你可以在那里发问题。
messages.en: There is a forum for students. You can post your question there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把forum想成大家围坐讨论的一张桌子：线下可以是论坛会议，搬到网上就是发帖交流的讨论平台。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Strength or power used to move something, produce an effect, or influence a situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于移动物体、产生作用或影响局势的力量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qawwa li biha persuna jew ħaġa tista' tmexxi xi ħaġa, tipproduċi effett jew tinfluwenza sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 力量；力气，指进行身体活动或承受负荷的能力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kapaċità fiżika li persuna jew ħaġa għandha biex tagħmel sforz, iġġorr piż jew tiflaħ għal tagħbija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Strength is the physical ability to exert effort, carry weight, or withstand a load.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 力；强力，指对人或物施加的推动、拉动或强制作用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Azzjoni fiżika li timbotta jew tiġbed persuna jew oġġett, jew li tintuża biex xi ħadd jagħmel xi ħaġa kontra r-rieda tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Force is physical action used to push or pull something or make someone act against their wishes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 力量；影响力，指造成结果或影响他人、事件和局势的能力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kapaċità ta' persuna, grupp jew ħaġa li tipproduċi effett jew tinfluwenza nies, ġrajjiet jew sitwazzjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Power is the ability of a person or thing to produce effects or influence what happens.

formal.mt: Matul l-esperiment, l-istudenti kejlu l-forza meħtieġa biex imexxu l-kaxxa fuq l-art.
formal.en: During the experiment, the students measured the force needed to move the box across the floor.
formal.zh: 实验中，学生测量了使箱子在地面上移动所需的力。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan l-għatu ma jridx jinfetaħ! Mark: Tużax wisq forza. Għaddihli u nipprova niftaħu jien.
colloquial.en: Nina: This lid just won't open! Mark: Don't use too much force. Pass it to me and I'll try to open it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个盖子就是打不开！马克：别用太大的力。递给我，我来试着打开。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个盖子就是打不开！
messages.en: This lid just won't open!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tużax wisq forza. Għaddihli u nipprova niftaħu jien.
messages.mt_standard: Tużax wisq forza. Għaddihli u nipprova niftaħu jien.
messages.zh: 别用太大的力。递给我，我来试着打开。
messages.en: Don't use too much force. Pass it to me and I'll try to open it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面记forza：搬箱子的力气、推门时施加的力、一个有力论证的影响力；共同核心是能够产生作用的力量。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A medical instrument with two opposing parts used to grasp or hold something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有两个相对夹持部分、用于夹取或固定物体的医疗器械。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument mediku b'żewġ partijiet li jingħalqu kontra xulxin biex jaqbdu jew iżommu xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于夹取或固定组织、敷料等物体的医用钳状或镊状器械。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strument mediku b'żewġ partijiet li jintużaw biex jaqbdu jew iżommu tessut, garża jew oġġetti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Forceps are medical instruments used to grasp or hold tissue, dressings, or other objects.

formal.mt: Qabel l-intervent, it-tim ivverifika li l-forċipi kienu sterili.
formal.en: Before the procedure, the team checked that the forceps were sterile.
formal.zh: 操作开始前，团队确认了医用钳处于无菌状态。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn huma l-forċipi sterili? Pawlu: Qegħdin fuq it-trej, fil-pakkett magħluq.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where are the sterile forceps? Pawlu: They are on the tray, in the sealed packet.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：无菌医用钳在哪里？保罗：在托盘上，装在密封包装里。

messages.speaker: Marija (护士)
messages.zh: 无菌医用钳在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the sterile forceps?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (护士同事)
messages.zh: 在托盘上，装在密封包装里。
messages.en: They are on the tray, in the sealed packet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 forċipi 和托盘上成对夹合的医用钳联系起来，再用 forċipi sterili 记住“无菌医用钳”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A furnace for heating metal before shaping it, or a workshop where this work is done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在金属锻打成形前将其加热的炉子，或进行这类工作的作坊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forn li fih jissaħħan il-metall qabel jingħata forma, jew ħanut tax-xogħol fejn isir dan ix-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供金属加热后锻打成形的锻炉，或设有这种设备的铁匠作坊。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Forn li jintuża biex jissaħħan il-metall qabel jinħadem bid-daqqiet, jew post tax-xogħol mgħammar għal dan l-għan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A forge is a furnace used to heat metal before shaping it, or a workshop where such metalworking takes place.

formal.mt: Fil-forġa, il-ħaddied saħħan il-biċċa ħadid qabel ma taha forma bil-martell.
formal.en: At the forge, the blacksmith heated the piece of iron before shaping it with a hammer.
formal.zh: 在锻造作坊里，铁匠先将铁块加热，再用锤子将其锻打成形。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn isaħħan il-ħadid il-ħaddied? Ġużeppi: Fil-forġa. Imbagħad jagħtih forma bil-martell.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where does the blacksmith heat the iron? Ġużeppi: In the forge. Then he shapes it with a hammer.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：铁匠在哪里加热铁？朱塞佩：在锻炉里。然后他用锤子把铁锻打成形。

messages.speaker: Anna (参观者)
messages.zh: 铁匠在哪里加热铁？
messages.en: Where does the blacksmith heat the iron?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (导览员)
messages.zh: 在锻炉里。然后他用锤子把铁锻打成形。
messages.en: In the forge. Then he shapes it with a hammer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 forġa 想成铁匠作坊里发红的锻炉：先加热，再锤打；这幅画面同时帮助记住“锻炉”和“锻造作坊”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A foss is a long, narrow excavation in the ground, used for drainage, protection, or other purposes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在地面挖出的狭长沟槽，可用于排水、防护等用途。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Foss huwa kanal twil u dejjaq imħaffer fl-art, li jista' jintuża biex jgħaddi l-ilma jew għal skopijiet ta' protezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沟；沟渠，尤指用于排水或设在道路、田地边缘的狭长沟槽。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Foss huwa kanal twil u dejjaq fl-art, spiss maġenb triq jew għalqa, li minnu jista' jgħaddi l-ilma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ditch is a long, narrow channel in the ground, often made to carry water away from a road or field.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 壕沟；深沟，指为防护、施工等目的挖出的狭长沟槽。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Foss huwa ħofra twila u dejqa mħaffra fl-art għal skop partikolari, bħal protezzjoni jew tqegħid ta' pajpijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A trench is a long, narrow excavation made for purposes such as protection or laying pipes.

collocations.en: to dig a ditch or trench

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema ħaffru foss maġenb it-triq biex l-ilma tax-xita jkun jista' jgħaddi mingħajr ma jgħarraq l-għelieqi.
formal.en: The workers dug a ditch beside the road so that rainwater could flow away without flooding the fields.
formal.zh: 工人在路边挖了一条沟，让雨水能够流走，避免淹没田地。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Oqgħod attent, hemm foss quddiemek! Mark: Rajtu. Se ngħaddi mill-pont iż-żgħir.
colloquial.en: Maja: Be careful, there's a ditch in front of you! Mark: I've seen it. I'll cross using the little bridge.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：小心，你前面有条沟！马克：我看见了。我从那座小桥过去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 小心，你前面有条沟！
messages.en: Be careful, there's a ditch in front of you!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看见了。我从那座小桥过去。
messages.en: I've seen it. I'll cross using the little bridge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 foss 配上地面一条狭长沟的画面：排水时是沟渠，防护或施工时可指壕沟。用“挖沟 iħaffer foss”整组记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fossa is a pit used to collect sewage, or a ditch dug in the ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于收集污水的坑，也可指地面挖出的沟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fossa hija ħofra li tintuża biex tinġabar fiha d-drenaġġ, jew kanal imħaffer fl-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 污水坑；粪污池，指用于收集生活污水或粪污的地下坑池。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fossa hija ħofra jew ġiebja taħt l-art li fiha jinġabru l-ilma maħmuġ u l-iskart mit-tojlits.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cesspit is an underground pit or tank in which sewage and household wastewater are collected.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沟；沟渠，指地面上的狭长沟槽，常用于引水或排水。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fossa hija kanal twil u dejjaq fl-art li jista' jintuża biex jgħaddi jew jinġabar l-ilma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ditch is a long, narrow channel dug in the ground, often to collect or carry water.

formal.mt: Il-fossa tad-drenaġġ għandha titbattal regolarment sabiex ma tfurx u ma tikkontaminax l-art ta' madwarha.
formal.en: The cesspit should be emptied regularly so that it does not overflow and contaminate the surrounding ground.
formal.zh: 污水坑应定期清空，以免溢出并污染周围的土地。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ġej it-trakk illum? Pawlu: Biex ibattal il-fossa. Kważi mtliet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the truck coming today? Pawlu: To empty the cesspit. It's almost full.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天为什么有卡车来？保罗：来清空污水坑。它快满了。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.zh: 今天为什么有卡车来？
messages.en: Why is the truck coming today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 来清空污水坑。它快满了。
messages.en: To empty the cesspit. It's almost full.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 fossa 配两幅场景图：住宅旁需要清空的污水坑，以及道路旁的沟。看到 tad-drenaġġ 时结合污水处理语境判断词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fossil fuels are fuels such as coal, oil, and natural gas that formed from ancient organic material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由古代生物的有机物质经过漫长过程形成的燃料，如煤、石油和天然气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fjuwils fossili huma fjuwils bħall-faħam, iż-żejt u l-gass naturali, li ffurmaw minn materjal organiku antik fuq perjodu twil ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 化石燃料，如煤、石油和天然气，由古代有机物质经过漫长过程形成。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fjuwils fossili huma sorsi ta' enerġija bħall-faħam, iż-żejt u l-gass naturali, li ffurmaw minn materjal organiku antik u jintużaw bħala karburant.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fossil fuels are substances such as coal, oil, and natural gas that formed from ancient organic material and are burned to provide energy.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jipproponi miżuri biex jitnaqqas l-użu tal-fjuwils fossili fil-produzzjoni tal-elettriku.
formal.en: The report proposes measures to reduce the use of fossil fuels in electricity generation.
formal.zh: 该报告提出了减少发电过程中化石燃料使用量的措施。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-faħam u l-gass naturali huma fjuwils fossili? David: Iva, u ż-żejt ukoll. Nużawhom biex niksbu l-enerġija.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are coal and natural gas fossil fuels? David: Yes, and oil is too. We use them to obtain energy.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：煤和天然气是化石燃料吗？戴维：是的，石油也是。我们用它们获取能源。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-faħam u l-gass naturali huma fjuwils fossili?
messages.mt_standard: Il-faħam u l-gass naturali huma fjuwils fossili?
messages.zh: 煤和天然气是化石燃料吗？
messages.en: Are coal and natural gas fossil fuels?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u ż-żejt ukoll. Nużawhom biex niksbu l-enerġija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ż-żejt ukoll. Nużawhom biex niksbu l-enerġija.
messages.zh: 是的，石油也是。我们用它们获取能源。
messages.en: Yes, and oil is too. We use them to obtain energy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“煤、石油、天然气”画在同一张能源卡上，统一标注 fossil fuels；再配读马耳他语 fjuwils fossili，记住整个短语表示化石燃料。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fossili are preserved remains or traces of organisms that lived in the distant past.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 远古生物遗留下来并被保存的遗体、遗物或活动痕迹；此处为复数名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fossili huma fdalijiet jew traċċi ppreservati ta' ħlejjaq li għexu fi żminijiet imbiegħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 化石，指远古生物被保存下来的遗体、遗物或活动痕迹；此处表示复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fossili huma fdalijiet jew traċċi ta' pjanti u annimali tal-imgħoddi li baqgħu ppreservati, ħafna drabi fil-blat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fossils are the preserved remains or traces of ancient organisms, often found in rock.

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesponi ġabra ta' fossili li tgħin lill-viżitaturi jifhmu aħjar il-ħajja tal-imgħoddi.
formal.en: The museum displays a collection of fossils that helps visitors better understand life in the distant past.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出了一批化石，帮助参观者更好地了解远古生命。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dawn il-marki fil-blat huma fossili? Toni: Iva, huma fossili ta' qxur. Ħares lejn il-forma tagħhom!
colloquial.en: Sara: Are these marks in the rock fossils? Toni: Yes, they're shell fossils. Look at their shape!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：岩石上的这些印痕是化石吗？托尼：是的，是贝壳化石。看看它们的形状！

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.zh: 岩石上的这些印痕是化石吗？
messages.en: Are these marks in the rock fossils?

messages.speaker: Toni (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huma fossili ta' qxur. Ħares lejn il-forma tagħhom!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huma fossili ta' qxur. Ħares lejn il-forma tagħhom!
messages.zh: 是的，是贝壳化石。看看它们的形状！
messages.en: Yes, they're shell fossils. Look at their shape!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象博物馆里摆着多块带贝壳印痕的石头，一起标作 fossili。用“这些是化石 Dawn huma fossili”记住本词条的名词复数用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A paper copy of a document or image made using a photocopier.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用复印机复制文件或图像而得到的纸质副本。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kopja fuq il-karta ta' dokument jew stampa, magħmula b'magna tal-fotokopji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 复印件；用复印机制作的文件或图像的纸质副本。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fotokopja hija kopja ta' dokument jew stampa magħmula fuq il-karta permezz ta' magna tal-fotokopji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A photocopy is a paper reproduction of a document or image made using a photocopier.

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, ehmeż fotokopja tal-passaport mal-formola tal-applikazzjoni.
formal.en: Please attach a photocopy of your passport to the application form.
formal.zh: 请将护照复印件附在申请表上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek fotokopja ta' din il-paġna? Mark: Iva, għamilt tnejn. Ħu waħda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have a photocopy of this page? Mark: Yes, I made two. Take one.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你有这一页的复印件吗？马克：有，我复印了两份。拿一份吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你有这一页的复印件吗？
messages.en: Do you have a photocopy of this page?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 有，我复印了两份。拿一份吧。
messages.en: Yes, I made two. Take one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和复印机吐出的一张副本联系起来：原件留在手中，fotokopja 是复制出来的那一份。

gloss_zh: 去你妈的；操你（粗俗辱骂）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very offensive expression used to insult someone directly in anger or contempt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 愤怒或轻蔑时直接辱骂对方的极粗俗表达，相当于“去你妈的”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni vulgari ħafna li tintuża biex tinsulta direttament lil xi ħadd meta tkun irrabjat jew tħoss disprezz lejh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 去你妈的；操你。直接针对对方的强烈粗俗辱骂。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din hija espressjoni oxxena u offensiva ħafna li persuna tgħid lil oħra biex turi rabja jew disprezz lejha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: People use this very offensive expression to insult someone directly and express strong anger or contempt.

collocations.mt: jgħid 'foxx kemm għandek' lil xi ħadd

formal.mt: L-espressjoni 'foxx kemm għandek' hija insult vulgari ħafna u mhijiex xierqa f'ittra formali.
formal.en: The expression 'fuck you' is a very vulgar insult and is inappropriate in a formal letter.
formal.zh: “去你妈的”是极粗俗的辱骂，不适合用于正式信函。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qalli 'foxx kemm għandek' u telaq. Lara: Dak insult ikrah ħafna. X'ġara bejnietkom?
colloquial.en: Mark: He said 'fuck you' to me and left. Lara: That's a really nasty insult. What happened between you two?
colloquial.zh: 马克：他对我骂了句“去你妈的”就走了。拉拉：这话骂得很难听。你们俩发生什么事了？

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他对我骂了句“去你妈的”就走了。
messages.en: He said 'fuck you' to me and left.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak insult ikrah ħafna. X'ġara bejnietkom?
messages.mt_standard: Dak insult ikrah ħafna. X'ġara bejnietkom?
messages.zh: 这话骂得很难听。你们俩发生什么事了？
messages.en: That's a really nasty insult. What happened between you two?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句话作为强烈辱骂来识别，联想争吵中对方愤怒离开的场景；不要按单词逐个直译，也不要当作朋友间的普通招呼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having or giving off a pleasant smell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有或散发令人愉悦的香气的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu jew joħroġ riħa pjaċevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 芳香的；有香味的；散发宜人气味的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa fragranti jkollha riħa pjaċevoli li tista' tinxtamm minn min ikun qrib tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is fragrant has a pleasant smell that you can notice around it.

formal.mt: Il-ġnien fih varjetà ta' fjuri fragranti li jagħmlu l-mixja aktar pjaċevoli.
formal.en: The garden contains a variety of fragrant flowers that make the walk more pleasant.
formal.zh: 花园里种有多种芳香的花卉，让散步更加惬意。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm huma fragranti dawn il-fjuri! Mark: Iva, poġġihom fuq il-mejda ħdejk.
colloquial.en: Lara: These flowers are so fragrant! Mark: Yes, put them on the table next to you.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些花真香啊！马克：是啊，把它们放在你旁边的桌子上吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些花真香啊！
messages.en: These flowers are so fragrant!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，把它们放在你旁边的桌子上吧。
messages.en: Yes, put them on the table next to you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 fragranti 就想象凑近花束闻到香气；可借英语 fragrant 的相似拼写记忆，重点记住它描述的是宜人的气味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person's way of thinking or mental attitude at a particular time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人在某一时刻看待事物、思考问题时的心理状态或态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mod kif persuna taħseb jew tħares lejn l-affarijiet f'ħin partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个人的思考方式或看待事物的心态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mod kif persuna taħseb dwar sitwazzjoni u l-attitudni mentali li jkollha lejha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your frame of mind is the mental attitude that influences how you think about and respond to a situation.

collocations.mt: fil-frame of mind it-tajjeb biex tistudja
collocations.en: in the right frame of mind to study
collocations.zh: 处于适合学习的心理状态

formal.mt: Qabel tibda l-eżami, ipprova tidħol f'frame of mind kalm u pożittiv.
formal.en: Before starting the examination, try to get into a calm and positive frame of mind.
formal.zh: 开始考试前，试着让自己进入平静、积极的心理状态。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek trid tistudja llejla? Pawlu: Iva, imma bħalissa m'iniex fil-frame of mind it-tajjeb. L-ewwel se nistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you still want to study tonight? Pawlu: Yes, but I'm not in the right frame of mind at the moment. I'll rest a little first.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今晚还想学习吗？保罗：想，不过我现在的状态不适合学习。我先休息一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今晚还想学习吗？
messages.en: Do you still want to study tonight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma bħalissa m'iniex fil-frame of mind it-tajjeb. L-ewwel se nistrieħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma bħalissa m'iniex fil-frame of mind it-tajjeb. L-ewwel se nistrieħ ftit.
messages.zh: 想，不过我现在的状态不适合学习。我先休息一会儿。
messages.en: Yes, but I'm not in the right frame of mind at the moment. I'll rest a little first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个短语想成当下的“心理频道”：频道平静，思考就容易有条理；记住它常指某一时刻的心态。

gloss_zh: 市场碎片化；市场分散化

teaching_sense.en_definition: The division of a market into many smaller groups or competing parts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 市场分散为许多较小的消费群体或竞争部分的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qsim ta' suq f'ħafna gruppi żgħar ta' konsumaturi jew f'partijiet separati li jikkompetu bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 市场分裂、分散为多个较小部分的现象或过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih is-swieq jinqasmu f'partijiet iżgħar, b'gruppi differenti ta' konsumaturi jew b'ħafna kompetituri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fragmentation of markets occurs when markets become divided into smaller parts with different customers or competing suppliers.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 市场碎片化，即一个市场由许多较小群体或分散的竞争部分构成的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni fejn suq ikun magħmul minn ħafna gruppi żgħar ta' konsumaturi jew minn partijiet separati li jikkompetu bejniethom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Market fragmentation is a situation in which a market consists of many smaller customer groups or competing parts.

collocations.zh: 市场碎片化程度的加剧

formal.mt: Ir-rapport janalizza kif il-frammentazzjoni tas-suq toħloq il-ħtieġa għal kampanji ta' reklamar differenti għal gruppi differenti ta' konsumaturi.
formal.en: The report analyses how market fragmentation creates a need for different advertising campaigns for different consumer groups.
formal.zh: 报告分析了市场碎片化如何使企业需要针对不同消费群体开展不同的广告活动。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed nagħmlu tant reklami differenti? Mark: Minħabba l-frammentazzjoni tas-suq. Kull grupp ta' klijenti jfittex xi ħaġa differenti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are we making so many different advertisements? Mark: Because of market fragmentation. Each group of customers is looking for something different.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们为什么要制作这么多种不同的广告？马克：因为市场碎片化。每一类顾客想要的东西都不一样。

messages.speaker: Sara (营销助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed nagħmlu tant reklami differenti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed nagħmlu tant reklami differenti?
messages.zh: 我们为什么要制作这么多种不同的广告？
messages.en: Why are we making so many different advertisements?

messages.speaker: Mark (营销经理)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-frammentazzjoni tas-suq. Kull grupp ta' klijenti jfittex xi ħaġa differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-frammentazzjoni tas-suq. Kull grupp ta' klijenti jfittex xi ħaġa differenti.
messages.zh: 因为市场碎片化。每一类顾客想要的东西都不一样。
messages.en: Because of market fragmentation. Each group of customers is looking for something different.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一整块市场拼图分成许多小块，每块对应不同顾客或竞争部分；用这幅画面记住“市场碎片化”。

gloss_zh: 特许经营授权方；特许人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or company that grants another business the right to operate using its brand and business system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 授权其他经营者使用其品牌和经营体系开展业务的个人或公司。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li tagħti lil negozju ieħor id-dritt li jopera bl-isem kummerċjali u bis-sistema tan-negozju tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 特许经营中的授权方，即允许其他经营者按约定使用其品牌和经营体系的一方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-persuna jew il-kumpanija li tawtorizza lil operaturi oħra jużaw l-isem kummerċjali u s-sistema tan-negozju tagħha skont ftehim.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A franchisor is a person or company that allows another business to use its brand and operating system under an agreement.

collocations.zh: 与特许经营授权方签订的协议
特许经营授权方提供的培训

formal.mt: Skont il-ftehim, il-franchisor jipprovdi taħriġ lill-operatur il-ġdid qabel ma jinfetaħ il-ħanut.
formal.en: Under the agreement, the franchisor provides training to the new operator before the shop opens.
formal.zh: 根据协议，特许经营授权方在商店开业前向新经营者提供培训。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nbiddel il-logo tal-ħanut? David: L-ewwel kellem lill-franchisor. Il-ftehim jgħid li għandna nużaw il-logo approvat.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I change the shop's logo? David: Speak to the franchisor first. The agreement says we must use the approved logo.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我可以更改商店的标志吗？戴维：先和特许经营授权方谈谈。协议规定我们必须使用获批的标志。

messages.speaker: Lara (加盟店经营者)
messages.zh: 我可以更改商店的标志吗？
messages.en: Can I change the shop's logo?

messages.speaker: David (业务顾问)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel kellem lill-franchisor. Il-ftehim jgħid li għandna nużaw il-logo approvat.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel kellem lill-franchisor. Il-ftehim jgħid li għandna nużaw il-logo approvat.
messages.zh: 先和特许经营授权方谈谈。协议规定我们必须使用获批的标志。
messages.en: Speak to the franchisor first. The agreement says we must use the approved logo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“谁把品牌交给别人经营”来记：交出使用授权的一方就是 franchisor，把人物角色与授权动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The proper name of a city, rendered in Chinese as 法兰克福.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 城市专名，中文译作“法兰克福”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem proprju ta' belt, li jintuża biex jidentifika post speċifiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法兰克福，城市名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Frankfurt huwa isem proprju ta' belt, u jintuża meta wieħed isemmiha bħala post jew destinazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Frankfurt is a city name used when referring to that place or identifying it as a destination.

collocations.zh: 在法兰克福举行的会议

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti se jattendu laqgħa fi Frankfurt nhar it-Tlieta.
formal.en: The participants will attend a meeting in Frankfurt on Tuesday.
formal.zh: 与会者将于星期二在法兰克福参加会议。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn sejjer għada? Adam: Sejjer Frankfurt għal laqgħa. Nina: Il-vjaġġ it-tajjeb!
colloquial.en: Nina: Where are you going tomorrow? Adam: I'm going to Frankfurt for a meeting. Nina: Have a good trip!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你明天去哪儿？亚当：我要去法兰克福开会。妮娜：一路顺风！

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 你明天去哪儿？
messages.en: Where are you going tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Adam (出差同事)
messages.zh: 我要去法兰克福开会。
messages.en: I'm going to Frankfurt for a meeting.

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 一路顺风！
messages.en: Have a good trip!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象机票目的地一栏写着 Frankfurt，旁边标注“法兰克福”；把城市名称和首字母大写一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: During the time between one event and another, or while something else is happening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示在两件事之间的一段时间内，或在另一件事情进行的同时。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Matul iż-żmien bejn ġrajja u oħra, jew waqt li tkun qed tiġri xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在等待另一件事情发生的这段时间里；与此同时。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Matul iż-żmien li jgħaddi sakemm isseħħ xi ħaġa oħra, jew waqt li tkun għaddejja attività oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happens in the meantime, it happens while you are waiting for another event or while another activity continues.

collocations.en: in the meantime, prepare the food

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se tibda fid-disgħa; frattant, il-parteċipanti jistgħu jaqraw ir-rapport.
formal.en: The meeting will begin at nine; in the meantime, participants can read the report.
formal.zh: 会议将于九点开始；在此期间，与会者可以阅读报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-karozza tal-linja tasal għaxar minuti oħra. Mark: Frattant, nistgħu nieħdu kafè.
colloquial.en: Maja: The bus arrives in ten minutes. Mark: In the meantime, we can have a coffee.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：公交车还有十分钟到。马克：这段时间我们可以喝杯咖啡。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-karozza tal-linja tasal għaxar minuti oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Il-karozza tal-linja tasal għaxar minuti oħra.
messages.zh: 公交车还有十分钟到。
messages.en: The bus arrives in ten minutes.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这段时间我们可以喝杯咖啡。
messages.en: In the meantime, we can have a coffee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 frattant 放进等车画面：车还没到，这段时间先喝咖啡，记住“在此期间”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of disorder or noisy disturbance, or an excessive display of concern about something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指混乱不安的局面、吵闹骚动，或对某事表现出的过度紧张和大惊小怪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni ta' taħwid jew storbju, jew reazzjoni esaġerata ta' tħassib dwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 混乱不安；难以维持秩序或平静的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat ta' taħwid u nuqqas ta' ordni jew kalma, li fih ikun diffiċli li l-affarijiet jimxu sew.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a situation is in turmoil, it is confused and unsettled, making normal activity difficult.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喧嚣；许多人同时吵嚷或激动反应形成的骚动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għagħa kbira li tinħoloq meta ħafna nies jgħajtu jew jirreaġixxu b'mod qawwi fl-istess ħin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An uproar is a noisy disturbance caused by many people shouting or reacting strongly together.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某事过分操心、大惊小怪或小题大做的反应。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reazzjoni ta' tħassib jew aġitazzjoni akbar milli teħtieġ is-sitwazzjoni, speċjalment dwar xi ħaġa żgħira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone makes a fuss, they show more concern or excitement than the situation seems to require.

formal.mt: Wara t-tħabbira qamet frattarija fis-sala, u l-president talab lill-parteċipanti biex jikkalmaw.
formal.en: After the announcement, an uproar broke out in the hall, and the chair asked the participants to calm down.
formal.zh: 公告发布后，大厅里一片喧闹，会议主席请与会者冷静下来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tagħmel din il-frattarija kollha? Mark: Ma nistax insib iċ-ċwievet, u diġà wasalna tard.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you making all this fuss? Mark: I can't find the keys, and we're already late.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么这么大惊小怪？马克：我找不到钥匙，而且我们已经迟到了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tagħmel din il-frattarija kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tagħmel din il-frattarija kollha?
messages.zh: 你为什么这么大惊小怪？
messages.en: Why are you making all this fuss?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nistax insib iċ-ċwievet, u diġà wasalna tard.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nistax insib iċ-ċwievet, u diġà wasalna tard.
messages.zh: 我找不到钥匙，而且我们已经迟到了。
