messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-idea hi li żbilanċi opposti jikkumpensaw għal xulxin u naraw x'jibqa'.
messages.zh: 可以，意思是让方向相反的失衡量相互抵消，再看剩下多少。
messages.en: Yes, the idea is that opposing imbalances offset one another and we see what remains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长词组分成“功能—流程—净额抵消—失衡量”四块，想象正负失衡先相抵，再读出剩余量；这是理解和记忆的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used of food cooked by the heat of steam.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容食物利用蒸汽的热量烹熟，或说明采用蒸制的烹调方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża għal ikel imsajjar bis-sħana tal-fwar jew biex tindika dan il-mod ta' tisjir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指食物用蒸汽烹熟的，即蒸制的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta jingħad li ikel huwa msajjar fuq il-fwar, dan ifisser li jissajjar bis-sħana tal-fwar mingħajr ma jkun mgħaddas fl-ilma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Food described as steamed is cooked by the heat of steam rather than by being immersed in boiling water.

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, sajjar il-ħaxix fuq il-fwar sakemm jirtab, imbagħad żid ftit żejt taż-żebbuġa.
formal.en: For this recipe, steam the vegetables until tender, then add a little olive oil.
formal.zh: 制作这道菜时，将蔬菜蒸至软嫩，再加入少许橄榄油。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif se ssajjar il-ħut illum? Toni: Fuq il-fwar, u nservih ma' ftit ħaxix.
colloquial.en: Sara: How are you going to cook the fish today? Toni: I'll steam it and serve it with some vegetables.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今天打算怎么做鱼？托尼：蒸着吃，再配一点蔬菜。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天打算怎么做鱼？
messages.en: How are you going to cook the fish today?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-fwar, u nservih ma' ftit ħaxix.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-fwar, u nservih ma' ftit ħaxix.
messages.zh: 蒸着吃，再配一点蔬菜。
messages.en: I'll steam it and serve it with some vegetables.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鱼放在蒸架上，下面的蒸汽向上升；看到 fuq il-fwar 就联想到“靠蒸汽蒸熟”，并搭配鱼和蔬菜反复练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression describing someone who is energetic, cheerful, and lively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人精神充沛、活泼有生气，也可形容年长者精神矍铄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li għandu ħafna enerġija u jkun ferrieħi u mimli ħajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精神矍铄的；行动轻快而富有活力的，尤其可用于年长者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li tkun attiva u mimlija enerġija, anki meta tkun anzjana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is sprightly moves and behaves energetically, especially when they are older.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 活泼开朗的；言谈举止充满生气的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna ferrieħa u mimlija ħajja li turi ħafna enerġija fil-kliem u fl-imġiba tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is vivacious shows an engaging liveliness in the way they speak and behave.

formal.mt: Minkejja l-età tiegħu, in-nannu għadu fuq ruħu u jieħu sehem fl-attivitajiet tal-komunità.
formal.en: Despite his age, the grandfather is still sprightly and takes part in community activities.
formal.zh: 尽管年事已高，这位祖父仍然精神矍铄，并积极参加社区活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu n-nannu tiegħek? Mark: Għadu fuq ruħu! Ilbieraħ żifen magħna fil-festa.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is your grandfather? Mark: Still sprightly! Yesterday he danced with us at the celebration.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你祖父近来怎么样？马克：依然精神矍铄！昨天庆祝活动上，他还和我们一起跳舞呢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你祖父近来怎么样？
messages.en: How is your grandfather?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu fuq ruħu! Ilbieraħ żifen magħna fil-festa.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu fuq ruħu! Ilbieraħ żifen magħna fil-festa.
messages.zh: 依然精神矍铄！昨天庆祝活动上，他还和我们一起跳舞呢。
messages.en: Still sprightly! Yesterday he danced with us at the celebration.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和“爷爷仍能轻快跳舞”的画面绑定，记住它形容精神充沛、活泼有生气，不要逐词硬译。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression describing someone who is lively and full of energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人活泼、有精神，表现出充沛的活力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jkun attiv, ferrieħi u mimli enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 活泼的；精力充沛、表现得很有生气的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li turi ħafna enerġija u tkun attiva u mimlija ħajja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is lively shows plenty of energy and takes an active interest in what is happening.

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa tal-klabb, Pawlu kien fuq tiegħu u ħeġġeġ lill-membri l-oħra biex jieħdu sehem fid-diskussjoni.
formal.en: During the club meeting, Pawlu was lively and encouraged the other members to take part in the discussion.
formal.zh: 在俱乐部会议期间，保罗表现得很有活力，并鼓励其他成员参与讨论。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu jidher fuq tiegħu llum! Maja: Iva, ilu jkanta u jiċċajta minn filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Pawlu looks lively today! Maja: Yes, he has been singing and joking since this morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗今天看起来真有精神！玛雅：是啊，他从早上开始就一直唱歌、开玩笑。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗今天看起来真有精神！
messages.en: Pawlu looks lively today!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ilu jkanta u jiċċajta minn filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ilu jkanta u jiċċajta minn filgħodu.
messages.zh: 是啊，他从早上开始就一直唱歌、开玩笑。
messages.en: Yes, he has been singing and joking since this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象保罗一早就唱歌说笑，用整句“Pawlu jidher fuq tiegħu”记住“看起来很有精神”，将短语作为整体学习。

gloss_zh: 发夹；固定头发用的发针

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small pin used to hold hair in position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 插在头发中、用来固定发束或发型的小发针。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Labra żgħira li tiddaħħal fix-xagħar biex iżżommu f'postu jew iżżomm forma partikolari tax-xagħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发针；插入头发中以固定发束或发型的小夹针。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett żgħir f'għamla ta' labra li jintuża biex iżomm ix-xagħar f'postu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hairpin is a small pin that you put into your hair to hold it in place.

collocations.en: to hold the hair in place with a hairpin

formal.mt: Qabel il-wirja, iż-żeffiena waħħlet furfiċetta f'xagħarha biex iżżommu f'postu waqt iż-żfin.
formal.en: Before the performance, the dancer put a hairpin in her hair to keep it in place while dancing.
formal.zh: 演出前，女舞者在头发中插了一枚发针，以便在跳舞时固定头发。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek furfiċetta żejda? Xagħri qed jaqa' fuq wiċċi. Sara: Iva, ħu din. Għandha żżommu f'postu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a spare hairpin? My hair keeps falling over my face. Sara: Yes, take this one. It should hold it in place.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有多余的发针吗？我的头发老是垂到脸上。萨拉：有，拿这枚吧。应该能把头发固定住。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek furfiċetta żejda? Xagħri qed jaqa' fuq wiċċi.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek furfiċetta żejda? Xagħri qed jaqa' fuq wiċċi.
messages.zh: 你有多余的发针吗？我的头发老是垂到脸上。
messages.en: Do you have a spare hairpin? My hair keeps falling over my face.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu din. Għandha żżommu f'postu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu din. Għandha żżommu f'postu.
messages.zh: 有，拿这枚吧。应该能把头发固定住。
messages.en: Yes, take this one. It should hold it in place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时想象一枚小发针把额前碎发固定住，边做插发针的动作边读“furfiċetta”，把声音与用途连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extreme anger, or an uncontrolled outburst of anger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 极其强烈的愤怒，也指因愤怒或不满而突然大发脾气的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rabja qawwija ħafna, jew tifqigħa ta' rabja li fiha persuna titlef il-kontroll tal-imġiba tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暴怒；极其强烈的愤怒情绪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat ta' rabja kbira ħafna li persuna tħoss minħabba xi ħaġa li tkun ġrat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fury is a feeling of extremely strong anger about something that has happened.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一阵大发脾气，常表现为哭闹、喊叫等失控行为，尤指儿童的发作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tifqigħa ta' rabja, speċjalment minn tifel jew tifla, li tista' tinkludi biki jew għajjat meta ma jiksbux dak li jridu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tantrum is an uncontrolled outburst of anger, often involving crying or shouting when someone cannot have what they want.

formal.mt: Meta sar jaf bil-ħsara, ir-raġel tkellem b'furja kbira, iżda wara ftit ikkalma u sema' l-ispjegazzjoni.
formal.en: When he learned about the damage, the man spoke with great fury, but soon calmed down and listened to the explanation.
formal.zh: 得知损坏情况后，那名男子满怀怒火地说话，但不久便冷静下来，听取了解释。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Luca għamel furja? Mark: Għax ried jibqa' jilgħab, imma kien sar il-ħin biex nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Luca have a tantrum? Mark: Because he wanted to keep playing, but it was time for us to leave.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：卢卡为什么大发脾气？马克：因为他想继续玩，可我们已经该走了。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.zh: 卢卡为什么大发脾气？
messages.en: Why did Luca have a tantrum?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ried jibqa' jilgħab, imma kien sar il-ħin biex nitilqu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ried jibqa' jilgħab, imma kien sar il-ħin biex nitilqu.
messages.zh: 因为他想继续玩，可我们已经该走了。
messages.en: Because he wanted to keep playing, but it was time for us to leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记两个义项：心中怒火对应“暴怒”，孩子因不能继续玩而哭闹对应“一阵大发脾气”；两者都用 furja。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a person who comes from Floriana.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某人来自弗洛里亚纳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Furjana, meta tiddeskrivi persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自弗洛里亚纳的；用于说明某人的地域出身。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li ġejja mill-Furjana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is furjaniż comes from Floriana.

collocations.zh: 一位来自弗洛里亚纳的男子
一位来自弗洛里亚纳纳的作家

formal.mt: Il-kittieb furjaniż ippreżenta l-ktieb tiegħu waqt attività fil-librerija.
formal.en: The writer from Floriana presented his book at an event in the library.
formal.zh: 这位来自弗洛里亚纳的作家在图书馆的一场活动中介绍了自己的书。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn hu Pawlu? Mark: Hu furjaniż, mill-Furjana.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Pawlu from? Mark: He's from Floriana.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu是哪里人？Mark：他是弗洛里亚纳人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu是哪里人？
messages.en: Where is Pawlu from?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他是弗洛里亚纳人。
messages.en: He's from Floriana.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象人物名片上写着“来自弗洛里亚纳”，用 furjaniż 给这位男子标注出身地；把词义与人物和地图位置一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool with a sharp cutting edge used to cut or shape hard material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有锋利刃口、用于凿削或修整坚硬材料的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'xifer jaqta' li tintuża biex tqatta' jew tagħti forma lil materjal iebes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凿子；用刃口凿削木材、石材等材料的工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda b'xifer jaqta' li tintuża biex tnaqqax jew tneħħi biċċiet minn materjal bħall-injam jew il-ġebel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A chisel is a tool with a sharp edge that you use to cut or shape wood, stone, or other hard materials.

formal.mt: L-artiġjan uża furmatur biex inaqqax disinn sempliċi fl-injam.
formal.en: The craftsperson used a chisel to carve a simple design into the wood.
formal.zh: 工匠用凿子在木头上雕刻了一个简单的图案。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn qiegħed il-furmatur? Anna: Fuq il-bank, ħdejn il-martell.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is the chisel? Anna: On the workbench, next to the hammer.
colloquial.zh: Mark：凿子在哪里？Anna：在工作台上，锤子旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (木工)
messages.zh: 凿子在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the chisel?

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 在工作台上，锤子旁边。
messages.en: On the workbench, next to the hammer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 furmatur 放进木工工作台的画面：一把凿子紧挨着锤子，刃口正在凿出花纹，用工具和动作一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 作牛饲料用的大麦，通常未成熟便收割

teaching_sense.en_definition: Barley grown or gathered as cattle feed, usually harvested before it becomes ripe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作牛饲料的大麦，通常在成熟之前收割。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xgħir li jintuża bħala għalf għall-baqar u li ġeneralment jinħasad qabel ma jimmatura.

sense_translations.en_definition: Barley used as cattle fodder, usually harvested before it is ripe
sense_translations.zh_definition: 供牛食用的大麦饲料，通常是尚未成熟便收割的大麦。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xgħir maħsud biex jintuża bħala għalf għall-baqar, ġeneralment qabel ma jkun misjur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Furrajna is barley used to feed cattle, and it is usually harvested before it is ripe.

collocations.en: to harvest barley for cattle fodder
collocations.zh: 收割作牛饲料用的大麦

formal.mt: Il-bidwi ħasad il-furrajna qabel ma mmaturat, biex jużaha bħala għalf għall-baqar.
formal.en: The farmer harvested the barley before it ripened, to use it as cattle fodder.
formal.zh: 农民在大麦成熟之前将其收割，用作牛饲料。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed taħsad dan ix-xgħir issa? Pawlu: Din furrajna għall-baqar; naħsadha qabel ma timmatura.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you harvesting this barley now? Pawlu: It's barley fodder for the cattle; I harvest it before it ripens.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么现在就收割这些大麦？Pawlu：这是给牛吃的大麦饲料，我在它成熟之前收割。

messages.speaker: Sara (农场访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed taħsad dan ix-xgħir issa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed taħsad dan ix-xgħir issa?
messages.zh: 你为什么现在就收割这些大麦？
messages.en: Why are you harvesting this barley now?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Din furrajna għall-baqar; naħsadha qabel ma timmatura.
messages.mt_standard: Din furrajna għall-baqar; naħsadha qabel ma timmatura.
messages.zh: 这是给牛吃的大麦饲料，我在它成熟之前收割。
messages.en: It's barley fodder for the cattle; I harvest it before it ripens.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“大麦还没熟，先收来喂牛”的田间画面；furrajna 要同时联想到大麦、牛饲料和通常提前收割这三个要点。

gloss_zh: 管理期货；由专业管理人管理的期货投资

teaching_sense.en_definition: Futures investments managed on an investor's behalf by a professional manager.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由专业管理人代表投资者管理的期货投资。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Investimenti f'kuntratti tal-futuri li jitmexxew minn maniġer professjonali f'isem investitur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由专业管理人代投资者管理的期货投资。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Investiment f'kuntratt tal-futuri li jitmexxa minn maniġer professjonali f'isem investitur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A managed future is a futures investment that a professional manager manages on behalf of an investor.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-istrateġija ta' futuri mmaniġġjati u r-rwol tal-maniġer fl-għażla tal-kuntratti.
formal.en: The report describes the managed futures strategy and the manager's role in selecting contracts.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了管理期货策略，以及管理人在选择合约方面的职责。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfissru futuri mmaniġġjati? David: Huma investimenti f'kuntratti tal-futuri li maniġer professjonali jmexxi f'isem l-investitur.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does managed futures mean? David: They are investments in futures contracts that a professional manager manages on the investor's behalf.
colloquial.zh: Maja：管理期货是什么意思？David：就是由专业管理人代表投资者管理的期货合约投资。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 管理期货是什么意思？
messages.en: What does managed futures mean?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huma investimenti f'kuntratti tal-futuri li maniġer professjonali jmexxi f'isem l-investitur.
messages.mt_standard: Huma investimenti f'kuntratti tal-futuri li maniġer professjonali jmexxi f'isem l-investitur.
messages.zh: 就是由专业管理人代表投资者管理的期货合约投资。
messages.en: They are investments in futures contracts that a professional manager manages on the investor's behalf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 futuri mmaniġġjati 想成一叠交给专业管理人打理的期货合约；记忆重点是“期货投资有人代为管理”。

gloss_zh: 未来风格的；富有未来感的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a style or appearance that suggests an imagined future, especially through unusual design or advanced technology.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指风格或外观让人联想到想象中的未来，尤其体现新颖设计或先进科技的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu stil jew dehra li tfakkar f'futur immaġinat, speċjalment permezz ta' disinn mhux tas-soltu jew teknoloġija avvanzata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有未来感的；在设计、外观或风格上让人联想到未来世界的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li hija futuristika għandha dehra jew disinn li jġiegħlek taħseb kif jista' jkun il-futur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is futuristic has a design or appearance that makes you think of an imagined future.

formal.mt: Il-mużew il-ġdid għandu disinn futuristiku, b'linji sempliċi u twieqi kbar.
formal.en: The new museum has a futuristic design, with simple lines and large windows.
formal.zh: 新博物馆采用具有未来感的设计，线条简洁，窗户宽大。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt il-bini l-ġdid ħdejn l-istazzjon? Mark: Iva, għandu stil futuristiku. Qisu ħareġ minn film!
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you seen the new building next to the station? Mark: Yes, it has a futuristic style. It looks like something out of a film!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你见过车站旁边的新建筑吗？马克：见过，很有未来感，简直像电影里的建筑！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你见过车站旁边的新建筑吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the new building next to the station?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandu stil futuristiku. Qisu ħareġ minn film!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandu stil futuristiku. Qisu ħareġ minn film!
messages.zh: 见过，很有未来感，简直像电影里的建筑！
messages.en: Yes, it has a futuristic style. It looks like something out of a film!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 futuristiku 和科幻电影里的建筑画面配对记忆：看到未来感设计，就想起 disinn futuristiku。

gloss_zh: 操；靠（表达愤怒、惊讶或懊恼的粗俗用语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vulgar expression used to convey strong anger, surprise, or frustration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于表达强烈愤怒、惊讶或懊恼的粗俗说法，语气近似汉语的“操”或“靠”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni vulgari li tintuża biex tesprimi rabja kbira, sorpriża jew frustrazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 操；靠。用于发泄愤怒、惊讶或懊恼，属于粗俗表达。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma vulgari li persuna tuża meta tkun irrabjata, sorpriża jew frustrata ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: People use this vulgar expression when they feel very angry, surprised, or frustrated.

formal.mt: F'dan id-djalogu, il-kelma 'Fux' turi l-frustrazzjoni tal-karattru u għandha ton vulgari.
formal.en: In this dialogue, the word 'Fux' expresses the character's frustration and has a vulgar tone.
formal.zh: 在这段对话中，“Fux”表达了人物的懊恼，带有粗俗语气。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fux, insejt iċ-ċwievet id-dar! Maja: Tinkwetax, nistgħu mmorru lura niġbruhom.
colloquial.en: Mark: Fuck, I left the keys at home! Maja: Don't worry, we can go back and get them.
colloquial.zh: 马克：靠，我把钥匙落在家里了！玛雅：别担心，我们可以回去拿。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 靠，我把钥匙落在家里了！
messages.en: Fuck, I left the keys at home!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 别担心，我们可以回去拿。
messages.en: Don't worry, we can go back and get them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“忘带钥匙时脱口而出的粗话”记住 Fux，同时把粗俗语气一起记牢，避免在正式交谈中随意使用。

gloss_zh: 形容词，具体词义未提供

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adjective whose meaning is not specified in the supplied entry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给词条标为形容词，但没有提供可确定的具体含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aġġettiv li t-tifsira tiegħu mhix speċifikata fl-entrata mogħtija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义不明；问号表示所给资料未提供具体释义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan l-aġġettiv mhix magħrufa mill-informazzjoni mogħtija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry identifies this word as an adjective but does not establish its meaning.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'fuċillati' hija mmarkata bħala aġġettiv, iżda l-entrata ma tagħtix it-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The word 'fuċillati' is marked as an adjective, but the entry does not give its meaning.
formal.zh: “fuċillati”被标为形容词，但该词条没有给出它的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'fuċillati'? Mark: Hawn hemm biss sinjal ta' mistoqsija. It-tifsira mhix mogħtija.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'fuċillati' mean? Mark: There is only a question mark here. The meaning is not given.
colloquial.zh: Maja：‘fuċillati’是什么意思？Mark：这里只有一个问号，没有给出词义。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: ‘fuċillati’是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'fuċillati' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn hemm biss sinjal ta' mistoqsija. It-tifsira mhix mogħtija.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn hemm biss sinjal ta' mistoqsija. It-tifsira mhix mogħtija.
messages.zh: 这里只有一个问号，没有给出词义。
messages.en: There is only a question mark here. The meaning is not given.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fuċillati 放在带问号的形容词卡片上：先记词形与词性，具体意义留待可靠语境确认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or result of joining separate things into a single whole, including the joining of atomic nuclei in physics.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 原本分开的事物结合成为一个整体的过程或结果；在物理学中也指原子核结合的聚变。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew ir-riżultat ta' meta affarijiet separati jingħaqdu f'ħaġa waħda; fil-fiżika tinkludi l-għaqda ta' nuklei atomiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 融合或合并，即不同事物结合成为一个整体；在核物理语境中指聚变。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fużjoni sseħħ meta żewġ affarijiet jew aktar jingħaqdu biex jiffurmaw ħaġa waħda, bħal stili differenti jew nuklei atomiċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fusion is the process in which separate things join together to form a single whole.

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-kunċert jippreżenta fużjoni ta' mużika tradizzjonali Maltija u jazz.
formal.en: The concert programme presents a fusion of traditional Maltese music and jazz.
formal.zh: 这场音乐会的节目呈现了马耳他传统音乐与爵士乐的融合。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tip ta' mużika jdoqq dan il-grupp? Mark: Idoqq fużjoni ta' jazz u rock. Trid tisma' kanzunetta?
colloquial.en: Maja: What kind of music does this band play? Mark: They play a fusion of jazz and rock. Would you like to hear a song?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个乐队演奏什么类型的音乐？马克：爵士与摇滚的融合音乐。你想听一首吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tip ta' mużika jdoqq dan il-grupp?
messages.mt_standard: X'tip ta' mużika jdoqq dan il-grupp?
messages.zh: 这个乐队演奏什么类型的音乐？
messages.en: What kind of music does this band play?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Idoqq fużjoni ta' jazz u rock. Trid tisma' kanzunetta?
messages.mt_standard: Idoqq fużjoni ta' jazz u rock. Trid tisma' kanzunetta?
messages.zh: 爵士与摇滚的融合音乐。你想听一首吗？
messages.en: They play a fusion of jazz and rock. Would you like to hear a song?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两条不同颜色的线汇成一条线，用这个画面记住 fużjoni 的“融合”；遇到 nukleari 时对应“核聚变”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Axles are rods or shafts that support wheels and allow them to rotate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支撑车轮并使车轮能够转动的轴；此词为复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vireg jew xaftijiet li jżommu r-roti ta' vettura jew magna u jippermettulhom iduru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 车轴；支撑车轮或其他转动部件的轮轴，复数形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Vireg jew xaftijiet li fuqhom ikunu mwaħħlin ir-roti ta' vettura jew magna u li jippermettu lir-roti jduru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The axles of a vehicle are the rods or shafts that support its wheels and allow them to turn.

formal.mt: Qabel ma tintuża l-vettura, għandhom jiġu ċċekkjati l-fwies u r-roti tagħha.
formal.en: Before the vehicle is used, its axles and wheels must be checked.
formal.zh: 车辆使用前，必须检查其车轴和车轮。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Iċċekkjajt ir-roti. X'għandi niċċekkja aktar? Rita: Iċċekkja l-fwies ukoll, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: I've checked the wheels. What else should I check? Rita: Check the axles too, please.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我检查过车轮了。还应该检查什么？丽塔：也请检查一下车轴。

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)
messages.zh: 我检查过车轮了。还应该检查什么？
messages.en: I've checked the wheels. What else should I check?

messages.speaker: Rita (修车师傅)
messages.zh: 也请检查一下车轴。
messages.en: Check the axles too, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象汽车底部连接并支撑车轮的几根轴，把 fwies 和“多根车轴”的画面一起记住，注意它表示复数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flat object with a raised edge used to carry or serve food, drinks, or other small items.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来端送食物、饮料或其他小物品的平底器具，边缘通常略微凸起。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett ċatt, normalment b'xifer madwaru, li jintuża biex jinġarru jew jiġu servuti ikel, xorb jew oġġetti żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于端送或盛放杯碟、食物等物品的托盘。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett ċatt b'xifer li fuqu jitqiegħdu tazzi, platti, ikel jew affarijiet oħra biex jinġarru flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tray is a flat object on which you carry or serve several items together.

collocations.en: a tray with cups on it

formal.mt: Il-wejter poġġa t-tazzi fuq il-gabarrè u ġarrhom lejn il-mejda.
formal.en: The waiter placed the cups on the tray and carried them to the table.
formal.zh: 服务员把杯子放在托盘上，端到了桌边。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' tagħtini l-gabarrè? Ben: Iva, ħa. Poġġi t-tazzi fuqu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you pass me the tray? Ben: Yes, here you are. Put the cups on it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：能把托盘递给我吗？Ben：可以，给你。把杯子放上去吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 能把托盘递给我吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me the tray?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 可以，给你。把杯子放上去吧。
messages.en: Yes, here you are. Put the cups on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象服务员把几个杯子集中放在一个平盘上端来，用“托住杯子一起走”的画面记住 gabarrè。

gloss_zh: 街头摊位；外卖售卖亭；简陋小屋

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small stall or kiosk used for selling goods or takeaway food, or a small, simply built hut.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 售卖商品或外带食品的小摊位、小亭，也可指结构简单的小屋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post żgħir minn fejn jinbiegħu prodotti jew ikel biex jittieħed, jew għarix żgħir mibni b'mod sempliċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 街头商贩用于摆卖商品的小摊位或摊亭。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post żgħir fit-triq jew ħdejha minn fejn bejjiegħ ibigħ il-prodotti tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A street vendor's stall is a small place where someone displays and sells goods in the street.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 售卖供顾客带走食用的食品或饮料的小亭。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kjosk żgħir minn fejn jinbiegħ ikel jew xorb biex il-klijent jieħdu miegħu u jikkunsmah xi mkien ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A takeaway kiosk is a small outlet where you buy food or drinks to consume elsewhere.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结构简单、通常较为简陋的小屋或棚屋。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bini żgħir u sempliċi li jintuża bħala kenn jew biex jinżammu xi affarijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hut is a small, simply built structure used for shelter or storage.

formal.mt: Il-gabbana ħdejn il-bajja tbigħ ikel u xorb biex il-klijenti jieħduhom magħhom.
formal.en: The kiosk beside the beach sells food and drinks for customers to take away.
formal.zh: 海滩旁的小亭售卖供顾客外带的食品和饮料。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nieħdu xi ħaġa mill-gabbana? Mark: Iva, jien nieħu sandwich u ilma.
colloquial.en: Nina: Shall we get something from the kiosk? Mark: Yes, I'll have a sandwich and some water.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们去小亭买点东西吧？Mark：好，我要一个三明治和一些水。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们去小亭买点东西吧？
messages.en: Shall we get something from the kiosk?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien nieħu sandwich u ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien nieħu sandwich u ilma.
messages.zh: 好，我要一个三明治和一些水。
messages.en: Yes, I'll have a sandwich and some water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅小建筑画面串联记忆：街边卖水果的摊亭、卖外带食品的小亭、供人遮蔽的简陋小屋；结合场景选义。

gloss_zh: 可能指农民、农夫（词义待确认）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Possibly a farmer: a person who cultivates land or raises animals for agricultural production.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可能指从事土地耕作或牲畜饲养等农业生产的人；此处词义尚不确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Possibbilment persuna li taħdem ir-raba' jew trabbi l-annimali għall-produzzjoni agrikola; din it-tifsira mhijiex ċerta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可能指农民或农夫，即从事耕种或饲养牲畜的人；这一释义带有疑问。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jista' jfisser bidwi, jiġifieri persuna li tikkultiva l-art jew trabbi l-annimali, iżda t-tifsira tibqa' mhux ċerta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A gabillot may be someone who farms land or raises livestock, although this meaning is uncertain.

collocations.en: a farmer in the field, using the tentative meaning
collocations.zh: 田里的农夫（按暂定词义理解）

collocations.en: a farmer working the land, using the tentative meaning
collocations.zh: 农夫耕作土地（按暂定词义理解）

formal.mt: Jekk 'gabillot' hawn ifisser bidwi, is-sentenza 'Il-gabillot jaħdem fl-għalqa' tiddeskrivi persuna li tagħmel xogħol agrikolu.
formal.en: If 'gabillot' means farmer here, the sentence 'The gabillot works in the field' describes someone doing agricultural work.
formal.zh: 如果此处 gabillot 的意思是“农夫”，那么“这位 gabillot 在田里劳动”描述的就是一个从事农业劳动的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser 'gabillot' hawn? Pawlu: Forsi bidwi, imma m'iniex ċert. Irridu niċċekkjaw it-tifsira.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'gabillot' mean here? Pawlu: Perhaps a farmer, but I'm not sure. We need to check the meaning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的 gabillot 是什么意思？Pawlu：可能是农夫，但我不确定。我们需要核实词义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 gabillot 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'gabillot' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi bidwi, imma m'iniex ċert. Irridu niċċekkjaw it-tifsira.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi bidwi, imma m'iniex ċert. Irridu niċċekkjaw it-tifsira.
messages.zh: 可能是农夫，但我不确定。我们需要核实词义。
messages.en: Perhaps a farmer, but I'm not sure. We need to check the meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 暂把 gabillot 放在“田间劳动者”的画面旁，并画一个问号：先记“可能是农夫”，同时保留词义待确认的标记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A separate enclosed section within a larger space or vehicle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 较大空间或交通工具内部隔出的独立小空间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti magħluqa u separata minn partijiet oħra fi spazju akbar jew f'vettura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 较大空间内分隔出来的隔间或舱间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Spazju magħluq li jkun separat mill-bqija ta' post jew vettura permezz ta' ħitan jew diviżorji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A compartment is a separate section within a larger space, often enclosed by walls or partitions.

formal.mt: Il-passiġġieri għandhom iżommu l-bagalji tagħhom ġewwa l-gabina matul il-vjaġġ.
formal.en: Passengers should keep their luggage inside the compartment during the journey.
formal.zh: 旅途中，乘客应将行李放在包厢内。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Din il-gabina vojta? Pawlu: Iva, nistgħu noqogħdu hawn.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is this compartment empty? Pawlu: Yes, we can sit here.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这个包厢没人吗？保罗：是的，我们可以坐这里。

messages.speaker: Marija (乘客)
messages.zh: 这个包厢没人吗？
messages.en: Is this compartment empty?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我们可以坐这里。
messages.en: Yes, we can sit here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象火车内部用隔板分出小包厢，把 gabina 和“隔出来的一间”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small enclosed storage space used for keeping clothes or other household items.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于存放衣物或其他家居物品的小型封闭储物空间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spazju żgħir magħluq fejn jinżammu ħwejjeġ jew oġġetti oħra tad-dar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于收放衣物或日常用品的壁橱或储物小间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Spazju żgħir magħluq, ħafna drabi mibni fil-ħajt u b'bieb, li jintuża biex jinżammu ħwejjeġ jew affarijiet oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A closet is a small enclosed space where clothes or other household belongings are stored.

formal.mt: Il-kutri żejda għandhom jinżammu fil-gabinett ħdejn il-kamra tas-sodda.
formal.en: The spare blankets should be kept in the closet beside the bedroom.
formal.zh: 备用毯子应存放在卧室旁的储物小间里。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-kutri? Mark: Fil-gabinett, fuq l-ixkaffa ta' fuq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where should I put these blankets? Mark: In the closet, on the top shelf.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些毯子放哪里？马克：放在壁橱里最上层的搁板上。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 这些毯子放哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put these blankets?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 放在壁橱里最上层的搁板上。
messages.en: In the closet, on the top shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时想象打开壁橱门，把毯子整齐放上搁板，用这个收纳动作联结 gabinett。

gloss_zh: 翻筋斗；滑稽的嬉闹举动

teaching_sense.en_definition: A movement in which someone turns their whole body over, or a playful, silly action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体整个翻转的筋斗动作，也可指嬉闹中做出的滑稽举动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawra sħiħa tal-ġisem bir-ras 'l isfel u s-saqajn fl-arja, jew azzjoni buffa magħmula waqt il-logħob jew iċ-ċajt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 头部向下、双脚翻过身体，使全身向前或向后翻转一周的筋斗动作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Moviment li fih persuna ddawwar ġisimha dawra sħiħa 'l quddiem jew lura, bis-saqajn jgħaddu minn fuq ir-ras.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A somersault is a movement in which you turn your whole body over forwards or backwards.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出于玩闹或逗乐而做出的滑稽、淘气举动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Azzjoni buffa jew imqarba li xi ħadd jagħmel biex jilgħab, jiċċajta jew idaħħaq lil ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A caper is a playful or silly action that someone performs for amusement.

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni tal-ġinnastika, l-għalliema wriet lill-istudenti kif jagħmlu gabirjola 'l quddiem fuq it-tapit.
formal.en: During the gymnastics lesson, the teacher showed the students how to do a forward somersault on the mat.
formal.zh: 体操课上，老师向学生示范了如何在垫子上做前滚翻。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt il-gabirjola li għamel Leo biex idaħħaq lit-tfal? Sara: Iva, poġġa l-kappell fuq saqajh u beda jiżfen!
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you see the caper Leo pulled to make the children laugh? Sara: Yes, he put his hat on his foot and started dancing!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你看到利奥为了逗孩子们笑做的滑稽举动了吗？萨拉：看到了，他把帽子套在脚上，还跳起舞来了！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt il-gabirjola li għamel Leo biex idaħħaq lit-tfal?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt il-gabirjola li għamel Leo biex idaħħaq lit-tfal?
messages.zh: 你看到利奥为了逗孩子们笑做的滑稽举动了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the caper Leo pulled to make the children laugh?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, poġġa l-kappell fuq saqajh u beda jiżfen!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, poġġa l-kappell fuq saqajh u beda jiżfen!
messages.zh: 看到了，他把帽子套在脚上，还跳起舞来了！
messages.en: Yes, he put his hat on his foot and started dancing!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 gabirjola：体操垫上翻筋斗，朋友面前做滑稽动作；分别对应身体翻转与嬉闹举动。

gloss_zh: 极小的房间或住所；简陋棚屋

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very small room or dwelling, or a roughly built hut.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面积非常小的房间或住所，也可指搭建简陋的棚屋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra jew dar żgħira ħafna, jew għarix mibni b'mod sempliċi u fqir.

sense_translations.en_definition: a very small room or dwelling
sense_translations.zh_definition: 空间极其狭小的房间或住所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kamra jew post fejn wieħed jgħix li jkun żgħir ħafna u jkollu ftit spazju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A very small room or dwelling offers little space for living, moving around, or keeping belongings.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用简单材料粗略搭建的简陋棚屋。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għarix sempliċi u fqir, mibni b'materjali rħas jew użati u mingħajr ħafna kumditajiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A shanty is a roughly built hut made from simple materials and offering few comforts.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi familja li kienet tgħix f'gabuba magħmula minn twavel u folji tal-metall.
formal.en: The report describes a family that was living in a shanty made from planks and sheets of metal.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一个住在木板和金属板搭成的简陋棚屋里的家庭。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif inhi l-kamra li krejt? Toni: Gabuba! Hemm biss sodda u siġġu, u bilkemm nista' ndur.
colloquial.en: Rita: What's the room you rented like? Toni: It's tiny! There's only a bed and a chair, and I can barely turn around.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你租的房间怎么样？托尼：小得可怜！里面只有一张床和一把椅子，我几乎连转身都困难。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你租的房间怎么样？
messages.en: What's the room you rented like?

messages.speaker: Toni (租客)
messages.mt_spoken: Gabuba! Hemm biss sodda u siġġu, u bilkemm nista' ndur.
messages.mt_standard: Gabuba! Hemm biss sodda u siġġu, u bilkemm nista' ndur.
messages.zh: 小得可怜！里面只有一张床和一把椅子，我几乎连转身都困难。
messages.en: It's tiny! There's only a bed and a chair, and I can barely turn around.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一间放下床就难以转身的小屋，再想象木板搭成的简陋棚屋，用这两个场景记住 gabuba 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Local suppliers who provide equipment and other necessary supplies for ships.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在当地为船舶供应设备及其他必需用品的商家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fornituri tal-post li jbigħu tagħmir u provvisti oħra meħtieġa għall-bastimenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 本地供应船舶设备及船上必需用品的商家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-gadraj huma fornituri lokali li jipprovdu tagħmir u provvisti oħra għall-bastimenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Local ship chandlers are businesses that supply ships with equipment and other necessary goods.

collocations.zh: 向本地船舶用品供应商采购
来自本地船舶用品供应商的物资

formal.mt: Qabel it-tluq, il-kaptan xtara l-ħbula u l-provvisti meħtieġa mingħand il-gadraj.
formal.en: Before departure, the captain bought the ropes and necessary supplies from local ship chandlers.
formal.zh: 启航前，船长向本地船舶用品供应商购买了绳索和所需物资。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Minn fejn se nixtru l-ħbula għad-dgħajsa? Rita: Mingħand il-gadraj ħdejn il-port. Mark: Tajjeb, immorru llum.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where are we going to buy ropes for the boat? Rita: From the local ship chandlers near the harbour. Mark: Good, let's go today.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我们去哪里买船用绳索？Rita：去港口附近的本地船舶用品供应商那里。Mark：好，我们今天就去。

messages.speaker: Mark (船主)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn se nixtru l-ħbula għad-dgħajsa?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn se nixtru l-ħbula għad-dgħajsa?
messages.zh: 我们去哪里买船用绳索？
messages.en: Where are we going to buy ropes for the boat?

messages.speaker: Rita (船员)
messages.zh: 去港口附近的本地船舶用品供应商那里。
messages.en: From the local ship chandlers near the harbour.

messages.speaker: Mark (船主)
messages.zh: 好，我们今天就去。
messages.en: Good, let's go today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gadraj 放进港口采购画面：船长上岸买绳索和物资，柜台后就是本地船舶用品供应商。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lacking knowledge or understanding of a subject or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某个主题或情况缺少知识、认识或理解的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jkollux biżżejjed għarfien jew fehim dwar suġġett jew sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无知的；对相关事情缺乏知识或理解的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun nieqes mill-għarfien jew mill-fehim meħtieġ dwar xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is ignorant lacks knowledge or understanding of a particular subject or situation.

formal.mt: Kumment Gahan dwar suġġett kumpless jista' juri nuqqas ta' għarfien u jfixkel diskussjoni serja.
formal.en: An ignorant comment about a complex subject can reveal a lack of knowledge and disrupt a serious discussion.
formal.zh: 针对复杂主题发表无知的评论，可能暴露知识不足，并干扰严肃讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak kien kumment Gahan; lanqas qrajt ir-rapport. Mark: Għandek raġun. Se naqrah qabel nerġa' nitkellem.
colloquial.en: Maja: That was an ignorant comment; you haven't even read the report. Mark: You're right. I'll read it before I speak again.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那句评论太无知了；你连报告都没读。Mark：你说得对。我会先读完再发言。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak kien kumment Gahan; lanqas qrajt ir-rapport.
messages.mt_standard: Dak kien kumment Gahan; lanqas qrajt ir-rapport.
messages.zh: 那句评论太无知了；你连报告都没读。
messages.en: That was an ignorant comment; you haven't even read the report.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun. Se naqrah qabel nerġa' nitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun. Se naqrah qabel nerġa' nitkellem.
messages.zh: 你说得对。我会先读完再发言。
messages.en: You're right. I'll read it before I speak again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 Gahan 修饰评论或态度：想象一个人没读材料就发言，用“缺乏了解、显得无知”帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shellfish with a rough shell in two parts, some kinds of which are eaten as seafood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种有两片粗糙贝壳的贝类，其中一些种类可作为海鲜食用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal tal-baħar b'qoxra ħarxa magħmula minn żewġ partijiet, li xi tipi tiegħu jittieklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牡蛎，俗称蚝；具有两片粗糙贝壳的海生贝类。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-gajdra hija annimal tal-baħar li jgħix ġewwa qoxra ħarxa ta' żewġ partijiet u li jista' jittiekel bħala frott tal-baħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An oyster is a shellfish with a rough shell in two parts that is often eaten as seafood.

formal.mt: L-istudent osserva l-qoxra tal-gajdra u ddeskriva l-wiċċ ħarxa tagħha fir-rapport.
formal.en: The student examined the oyster's shell and described its rough surface in the report.
formal.zh: 学生观察了牡蛎的贝壳，并在报告中描述了它粗糙的表面。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid idduq gajdra? Paul: Iva, imma ma nafx kif niftaħha. Lara: Nitolbu lill-wejter jiftaħha għalina.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like to try an oyster? Paul: Yes, but I don't know how to open it. Lara: Let's ask the waiter to open it for us.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你想尝一只牡蛎吗？Paul：想，不过我不知道怎么打开。Lara：我们请服务员帮忙打开吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想尝一只牡蛎吗？
messages.en: Would you like to try an oyster?

messages.speaker: Paul (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ma nafx kif niftaħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ma nafx kif niftaħha.
messages.zh: 想，不过我不知道怎么打开。
messages.en: Yes, but I don't know how to open it.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们请服务员帮忙打开吧。
messages.en: Let's ask the waiter to open it for us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 gajdra 就想象海鲜盘里一只壳面粗糙的牡蛎，再搭配“打开牡蛎”的动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who betrays a country, group, or someone who trusts them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 背叛国家、所属群体或信任自己的人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tittradixxi lil pajjiżha, lill-grupp tagħha jew lil xi ħadd li jafdaha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 叛徒；背叛自己原应效忠的国家、群体或信任自己的人的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Gakbin huwa persuna li tikser il-lealtà tagħha billi tittradixxi lil pajjiżha, lill-grupp tagħha jew lil min jafdaha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A traitor is someone who betrays their country, their group, or people who have placed trust in them.

collocations.en: a traitor who revealed the secret

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, Gakbin fil-grupp jagħti informazzjoni sigrieta lill-għadu u jitlef il-fiduċja ta' sħabu.
formal.en: In the novel, a traitor within the group gives secret information to the enemy and loses the trust of his companions.
formal.zh: 在小说中，群体内部的一名叛徒向敌人提供秘密情报，失去了同伴的信任。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex sejjaħtlu Gakbin? Sam: Għax ta s-sigriet tagħna lill-avversarji. Nina: Issa nifhem għaliex ma tafdahx.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you call him a traitor? Sam: Because he gave our secret to our opponents. Nina: Now I understand why you don't trust him.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么叫他叛徒？Sam：因为他把我们的秘密告诉了对手。Nina：现在我明白你为什么不信任他了。

messages.speaker: Nina (队友)
messages.zh: 你为什么叫他叛徒？
messages.en: Why did you call him a traitor?

messages.speaker: Sam (队友)
messages.zh: 因为他把我们的秘密告诉了对手。
messages.en: Because he gave our secret to our opponents.

messages.speaker: Nina (队友)
messages.zh: 现在我明白你为什么不信任他了。
messages.en: Now I understand why you don't trust him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Gakbin 记成故事中的背叛者：原本受到同伴信任，却把秘密交给对手，因此被称为叛徒。

gloss_zh: 名词 galdarun（所给材料未说明具体词义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose specific meaning is not established by the supplied gloss.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 材料将 galdarun 标为名词，但释义仍为该词本身，因此无法据此确定它指什么。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira speċifika tiegħu mhijiex spjegata fil-materjal mogħti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: galdarun；原释义未提供可确定的中文词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma kklassifikata bħala nom, iżda mingħajr tifsira speċifika spjegata fil-materjal mogħti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry identifies galdarun as a noun but does not explain what it denotes.

formal.mt: Il-materjal jagħti galdarun bħala nom, iżda ma jispjegax it-tifsira tiegħu.
formal.en: The material lists galdarun as a noun but does not explain its meaning.
formal.zh: 材料将 galdarun 列为名词，但未解释它的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser galdarun? Mark: Ma nafx; hawnhekk hemm biss il-kelma, mingħajr spjegazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does galdarun mean? Mark: I don't know; here there is only the word, without an explanation.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：galdarun 是什么意思？马克：我不知道；这里只有这个词，没有解释。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: galdarun 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does galdarun mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx; hawnhekk hemm biss il-kelma, mingħajr spjegazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx; hawnhekk hemm biss il-kelma, mingħajr spjegazzjoni.
messages.zh: 我不知道；这里只有这个词，没有解释。
messages.en: I don't know; here there is only the word, without an explanation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 galdarun 放入“词义待核实”的名词卡片，用“这个词”和“这个词的含义”练习，不凭词形猜中文义。

gloss_zh: 伽利利的；伽利略的（须由语境确定）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Galilee or to Galileo, with the intended reference determined by context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示与伽利利地区或伽利略有关；材料中的 Galilean 未进一步区分这两种所指，理解时须结合语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Galilija jew ma' Galileo, skont il-kuntest li fih tintuża l-kelma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伽利利的，或与伽利略有关的；具体所指取决于上下文。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Aġġettiv li jindika rabta mal-Galilija jew ma' Galileo, bit-tifsira preċiża tiddependi mill-kuntest.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as Galilean is connected with Galilee or Galileo, as determined by the surrounding context.

collocations.zh: 与伽利利或伽利略有关的语境

formal.mt: Meta jintuża l-aġġettiv galilejan, il-kuntest għandu jagħmilha ċara jekk ir-referenza hijiex għall-Galilija jew għal Galileo.
formal.en: When the adjective galilejan is used, the context should make clear whether the reference is to Galilee or Galileo.
formal.zh: 使用形容词 galilejan 时，上下文应明确它指的是伽利利还是伽利略。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawnhekk galilejan jirreferi għal Galileo? Mark: Ejja naqraw is-sentenza kollha biex naraw.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does galilejan refer to Galileo here? Mark: Let's read the whole sentence to find out.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 galilejan 指伽利略吗？马克：我们把整句话读完，看看具体指什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 galilejan 指伽利略吗？
messages.en: Does galilejan refer to Galileo here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naqraw is-sentenza kollha biex naraw.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naqraw is-sentenza kollha biex naraw.
messages.zh: 我们把整句话读完，看看具体指什么。
messages.en: Let's read the whole sentence to find out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 galilejan 与英文 Galilean 配对记忆，再给卡片画上“地点”和“人物”两个提示框，提醒自己靠上下文确定所指；这只是学习提示，不是词源分析。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Welsh language, used by people in Wales and by Welsh speakers elsewhere.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 威尔士语，即威尔士及其他地方的威尔士语使用者所使用的语言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-lingwa ta' Wales, mitkellma wkoll minn nies li jgħixu f'postijiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 威尔士语；此处按名词理解，指语言。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-lingwa użata f'Wales u minn kelliema tagħha f'pajjiżi oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Welsh is the language spoken in Wales and by Welsh-speaking communities in other places.

formal.mt: Dan il-kors jgħin lill-istudenti jitgħallmu l-Galliż u jipprattikaw konverżazzjonijiet sempliċi.
formal.en: This course helps students learn Welsh and practise simple conversations.
formal.zh: 本课程帮助学生学习威尔士语，并练习简单对话。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed titgħallem il-Galliż? Mark: Iva, imma għadni naf biss ftit kliem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you learning Welsh? Mark: Yes, but I still only know a few words.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在学威尔士语吗？马克：是的，不过我目前还只会几个词。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在学威尔士语吗？
messages.en: Are you learning Welsh?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għadni naf biss ftit kliem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għadni naf biss ftit kliem.
messages.zh: 是的，不过我目前还只会几个词。
messages.en: Yes, but I still only know a few words.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 galliż 放进“语言名称”抽认卡，正面写“学威尔士语”，背面写 titgħallem il-Galliż，用完整搭配记住它的名词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large sailing ship with several masts, used in the past for trade or warfare.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 过去用于贸易或作战的一种大型多桅帆船。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vapur kbir tal-qlugħ b'diversi arbli, li fl-imgħoddi kien jintuża għall-kummerċ jew għall-gwerra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大型多桅帆船；过去用于贸易或作战的帆船类型。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' vapur kbir tal-qlugħ b'diversi arbli, użat fl-imgħoddi biex iġorr merkanzija jew jieħu sehem fil-gwerra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A galleon is a large sailing ship with several masts that was formerly used for trading or fighting.

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesponi mudell ta' galljun biex juri l-arbli u l-qlugħ ta' dan it-tip ta' vapur.
formal.en: The museum displays a model of a galleon to show the masts and sails of this type of ship.
formal.zh: 博物馆陈列了一艘大型多桅帆船模型，用来展示这种船的桅杆和船帆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak il-vapur fil-vetrina? Mark: Huwa mudell ta' galljun. Ara kemm għandu qlugħ!
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that ship in the display case? Mark: It's a model of a galleon. Look how many sails it has!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：展柜里的那艘船是什么？马克：那是一艘大型多桅帆船的模型。看，它有那么多船帆！

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 展柜里的那艘船是什么？
messages.en: What is that ship in the display case?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa mudell ta' galljun. Ara kemm għandu qlugħ!
messages.mt_standard: Huwa mudell ta' galljun. Ara kemm għandu qlugħ!
messages.zh: 那是一艘大型多桅帆船的模型。看，它有那么多船帆！
messages.en: It's a model of a galleon. Look how many sails it has!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 galljun 和英文 galleon 并排写，旁边画一艘有多根桅杆的大帆船，再读 mudell ta' galljun，把词形、图像和搭配一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A gallon is a unit used to measure liquid volume.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 加仑是计量液体体积的容量单位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Gallun huwa unità ta' kejl għall-volum tal-likwidi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加仑，用于计量液体体积的容量单位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Gallun huwa unità li tintuża biex jitkejjel il-volum ta' likwidu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A gallon is a unit of volume used for measuring liquids.

formal.mt: Il-kontenitur għandu kapaċità ta' gallun u jintuża għall-ħażna tal-ilma.
formal.en: The container has a capacity of one gallon and is used for storing water.
formal.zh: 这个容器的容量为一加仑，用于储水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm ilma għandna bżonn għall-vjaġġ? Mark: Ħu gallun ilma; hekk ikollna biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much water do we need for the trip? Mark: Take a gallon of water; that way we will have enough.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这次出行我们需要多少水？马克：带一加仑水吧，这样就够了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这次出行我们需要多少水？
messages.en: How much water do we need for the trip?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu gallun ilma; hekk ikollna biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu gallun ilma; hekk ikollna biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 带一加仑水吧，这样就够了。
messages.en: Take a gallon of water; that way we will have enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gallun 与英语 gallon 对照记忆，再想象标着“一加仑”的水桶；连读 gallun ilma，记住数量单位可以直接接液体名称。

gloss_zh: 斑鸠；另有鸟类所指不明确的存疑释义

teaching_sense.en_definition: A turtle dove is a small bird belonging to the pigeon family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 斑鸠是鸠鸽科的一种小型鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Gamiema hija għasfur żgħir tal-familja tal-ħamiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种鸟，可能指猛禽或鸽类，但该释义本身存疑，无法确定具体所指。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan is-sens jirreferi għal għasfur, iżda mhuwiex ċar jekk huwiex għasfur tal-priża jew ħamiema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This sense refers to a bird, but leaves its identification as a bird of prey or a dove uncertain.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 斑鸠，鸠鸽科的一种鸟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Gamiema hija tip ta' għasfur żgħir li jagħmel parti mill-familja tal-ħamiem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A turtle dove is a small bird that belongs to the pigeon family.

collocations.en: a turtle dove on a branch
the call of the turtle dove

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar, l-istudenti raw gamiema fuq fergħa u semgħu l-leħen tagħha.
formal.en: During the birdwatching activity, the students saw a turtle dove on a branch and heard its call.
formal.zh: 在观鸟活动中，学生们看见一只斑鸠停在树枝上，并听见了它的叫声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dik il-gamiema fuq il-fergħa! Mark: Rajtha! Ejja noqogħdu kwieti biex ma nbeżżgħuhiex.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that turtle dove on the branch! Mark: I see it! Let's keep quiet so we don't frighten it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看树枝上的那只斑鸠！马克：看见了！我们安静一点，别吓着它。

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟同伴)
messages.zh: 看树枝上的那只斑鸠！
messages.en: Look at that turtle dove on the branch!

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtha! Ejja noqogħdu kwieti biex ma nbeżżgħuhiex.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtha! Ejja noqogħdu kwieti biex ma nbeżżgħuhiex.
messages.zh: 看见了！我们安静一点，别吓着它。
messages.en: I see it! Let's keep quiet so we don't frighten it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象树枝上停着一只斑鸠，把画面与 gamiema 配对记忆。学习时先掌握明确的“斑鸠”义，另一个存疑释义不要当成确定的“猛禽”义背诵。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Camomile is a plant whose flowers are used to make a herbal drink.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 洋甘菊是一种植物，其花朵可用于冲泡草本饮品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-gamumilla hija pjanta li l-fjuri tagħha jintużaw biex issir xarba sħuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洋甘菊，一种花朵可用于冲泡草本饮品的植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-gamumilla hija pjanta bi fjuri li jistgħu jitnixxfu u jintużaw biex issir xarba sħuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Camomile is a plant whose flowers can be dried and used to make a herbal drink.

formal.mt: Biex tipprepara t-te tal-gamumilla, poġġi l-fjuri mnixxfa f'tazza u żid l-ilma sħun.
formal.en: To prepare camomile tea, place the dried flowers in a cup and add hot water.
formal.zh: 冲泡洋甘菊茶时，将干花放入杯中，再加入热水。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid kikkra te tal-gamumilla? Pawlu: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma mingħajr zokkor.
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like a cup of camomile tea? Pawlu: Yes, please, but without sugar.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：要喝一杯洋甘菊茶吗？保罗：好的，谢谢，不过不要加糖。

messages.speaker: Sara (主人)
messages.zh: 要喝一杯洋甘菊茶吗？
messages.en: Would you like a cup of camomile tea?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma mingħajr zokkor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma mingħajr zokkor.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢，不过不要加糖。
messages.en: Yes, please, but without sugar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gamumilla 写在洋甘菊茶杯的想象标签上，再连读 te tal-gamumilla；用“花朵泡进茶杯”的画面同时记住植物名称与常用搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A candlestick is an object that holds a candle upright.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 烛台是用来支撑蜡烛、使其直立的器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Gandlier huwa oġġett li fih titqiegħed xemgħa biex tibqa' wieqfa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烛台，用于固定和支撑蜡烛的器具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Gandlier huwa oġġett magħmul biex iżomm xemgħa wieqfa u f'postha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A candlestick is a holder in which you place a candle to keep it upright.

formal.mt: Fuq il-mejda tqiegħed gandlier tal-fidda b'xemgħa bajda fih.
formal.en: A silver candlestick holding a white candle was placed on the table.
formal.zh: 桌上摆放着一个银烛台，里面插着一支白色蜡烛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn inpoġġi din ix-xemgħa? Mark: Poġġiha fil-gandlier li hemm fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where should I put this candle? Mark: Put it in the candlestick on the table.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这支蜡烛放在哪里？马克：放进桌上的烛台里吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 这支蜡烛放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this candle?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġiha fil-gandlier li hemm fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġiha fil-gandlier li hemm fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 放进桌上的烛台里吧。
messages.en: Put it in the candlestick on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把 xemgħa（蜡烛）插进 gandlier（烛台），连读 xemgħa fil-gandlier；用“蜡烛进入底座”的动作区分蜡烛和烛台。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A holder that supports a candle and keeps it upright.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来支撑蜡烛、使其保持直立的器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jżomm xemgħa wieqfa meta titqiegħed fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烛台；用于固定和支撑蜡烛的器具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett li fih titqiegħed xemgħa biex tibqa' wieqfa u f'postha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A candlestick is an object in which you place a candle to hold it upright.

formal.mt: Il-gandlir tal-fidda tqiegħed f'nofs il-mejda b'xemgħa bajda fih.
formal.en: The silver candlestick was placed in the centre of the table with a white candle in it.
formal.zh: 银烛台放在桌子中央，里面插着一支白色蜡烛。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn hu l-gandlir? Pawlu: Fuq l-ixkaffa, ħdejn ix-xemgħat. Marija: Tajjeb, se npoġġih fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where is the candlestick? Pawlu: On the shelf, next to the candles. Marija: Good, I'll put it on the table.
colloquial.zh: Marija：烛台在哪里？Pawlu：在架子上，蜡烛旁边。Marija：好，我把它放到桌子上。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 烛台在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the candlestick?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 在架子上，蜡烛旁边。
messages.en: On the shelf, next to the candles.

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 好，我把它放到桌子上。
messages.en: Good, I'll put it on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gandlir 和 xemgħa（蜡烛）配对记：蜡烛插进烛台，画面中的底座就是 gandlir。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A marine shellfish known as a venus cockle, with a shell consisting of two parts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为 venus cockle 的海生双壳贝类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal tal-baħar b'qoxra magħmula minn żewġ partijiet, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala venus cockle.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 帘蛤类海贝；英语称为 venus cockle 的海生双壳贝类。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' annimal tal-baħar li jgħix f'qoxra magħmula minn żewġ partijiet u li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ venus cockle.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A venus cockle is a marine shellfish whose body is enclosed within a shell made of two parts.

collocations.en: the shell of the venus cockle

formal.mt: Fl-istudju, ir-riċerkatriċi ddeskriviet il-qoxra tal-gandoffla u rreġistrat id-daqs tagħha.
formal.en: In the study, the researcher described the venus cockle's shell and recorded its size.
formal.zh: 在这项研究中，研究员描述了这种帘蛤类海贝的贝壳，并记录了其大小。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi din fil-ktieb? Nina: Din gandoffla. Lara: Mela għandha qoxra magħmula minn żewġ partijiet?
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this in the book? Nina: It's a venus cockle. Lara: So its shell is made of two parts?
colloquial.zh: Lara：书里的这个是什么？Nina：这是一种帘蛤类海贝。Lara：所以它的贝壳由两部分组成？

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 书里的这个是什么？
messages.en: What is this in the book?

messages.speaker: Nina (教师)
messages.zh: 这是一种帘蛤类海贝。
messages.en: It's a venus cockle.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela għandha qoxra magħmula minn żewġ partijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Mela għandha qoxra magħmula minn żewġ partijiet?
messages.zh: 所以它的贝壳由两部分组成？
messages.en: So its shell is made of two parts?

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 gandoffla 画一张双壳海贝卡片，并写上 venus cockle；把词形、贝壳图和本条词义一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cockle, a small shellfish with a shell made of two parts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟蛤，一种具有两片贝壳的小型贝类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal żgħir tal-baħar li jgħix f'qoxra magħmula minn żewġ partijiet u li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ cockle.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸟蛤；一种生活在海中的小型双壳贝类。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' annimal żgħir tal-baħar b'qoxra magħmula minn żewġ partijiet, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala cockle.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cockle is a small marine shellfish that has a shell consisting of two parts.

formal.mt: L-istudent osserva gandofflu żgħir u pinġa l-qoxra tiegħu fid-dettall.
formal.en: The student observed a small cockle and drew its shell in detail.
formal.zh: 学生观察了一只小鸟蛤，并详细画出了它的贝壳。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan gandofflu? Sara: Iva, ara l-qoxra tiegħu. Mark: Se npinġih fin-notebook tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this a cockle? Sara: Yes, look at its shell. Mark: I'll draw it in my notebook.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这是一只鸟蛤吗？Sara：是的，看看它的贝壳。Mark：我要把它画在笔记本上。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 这是一只鸟蛤吗？
messages.en: Is this a cockle?

messages.speaker: Sara (教师)
messages.zh: 是的，看看它的贝壳。
messages.en: Yes, look at its shell.

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 我要把它画在笔记本上。
messages.en: I'll draw it in my notebook.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 dan gandofflu（这是一只鸟蛤）指图朗读；与相似词形对照时，特别看清本词结尾的字母 u。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A long, narrow channel or excavation in the ground, such as a ditch or trench.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地面上狭长的沟或挖出的沟槽，可指沟渠，也可指施工等用途的壕沟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kanal jew ħofra twila u dejqa fl-art, li tista' tintuża biex jgħaddi l-ilma jew biex jitqiegħdu pajpijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沟；沟渠，常用于排水或引水的狭长地沟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kanal twil u dejjaq fl-art, spiss maġenb triq jew għalqa, li minnu jista' jgħaddi l-ilma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ditch is a long, narrow channel in the ground, often used to carry water away.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 壕沟；沟槽，为铺设管道等用途而挖出的狭长地沟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħofra twila u dejqa mħaffra fl-art għal skop partikolari, bħal biex jitqiegħdu pajpijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A trench is a long, narrow excavation made in the ground for a purpose such as laying pipes.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema ħaffru gandott biex iqiegħdu pajp ġdid tal-ilma taħt l-art.
formal.en: The workers dug a trench to lay a new water pipe underground.
formal.zh: 工人们挖了一条沟槽，以便在地下铺设一根新水管。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex hemm daqshekk ilma fit-triq? Toni: Il-gandott imblukkat bil-weraq. Anna: Mela rridu nneħħu l-weraq biex l-ilma jkun jista' jgħaddi.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is there so much water on the road? Toni: The ditch is blocked with leaves. Anna: Then we need to remove the leaves so the water can flow through.
colloquial.zh: Anna：路上怎么有这么多水？Toni：排水沟被树叶堵住了。Anna：那我们得把树叶清掉，让水能够流过去。

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.zh: 路上怎么有这么多水？
messages.en: Why is there so much water on the road?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.zh: 排水沟被树叶堵住了。
messages.en: The ditch is blocked with leaves.

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela rridu nneħħu l-weraq biex l-ilma jkun jista' jgħaddi.
messages.mt_standard: Mela rridu nneħħu l-weraq biex l-ilma jkun jista' jgħaddi.
messages.zh: 那我们得把树叶清掉，让水能够流过去。
messages.en: Then we need to remove the leaves so the water can flow through.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gandott 想成地上的一条长沟：路边排水时对应 ditch，挖开铺管时对应 trench，用用途区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 金属线工艺；另有一个未明确的义项

teaching_sense.en_definition: Work made using metal thread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用金属线制作的工艺或工艺作品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol magħmul bl-użu ta' fil tal-metall.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我不知道；此处表示该义项尚未明确。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kliem 'Ma nafx' jindika li t-tifsira ta' dan is-sens mhijiex magħrufa jew speċifikata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This selector records uncertainty rather than an identified meaning of the word.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以金属线制作的工艺或工艺作品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ganutell huwa xogħol li jsir bl-użu ta' fil tal-metall.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ganutell is work that is made using metal thread.

collocations.en: a piece of metal thread work

formal.mt: Il-wirja tinkludi biċċa ganutell magħmula b'fil tal-metall irqiq.
formal.en: The exhibition includes a piece of metal thread work made with fine metal thread.
formal.zh: 展览中有一件用细金属线制作的工艺作品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dan ix-xogħol? Rita: Dan ganutell, xogħol magħmul b'fil tal-metall. Maja: Nista' nħares lejh mill-qrib? Rita: Iva, ara kemm hu rqiq il-fil.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this work? Rita: This is ganutell, work made with metal thread. Maja: Can I look at it closely? Rita: Yes, look how fine the thread is.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是什么工艺？丽塔：这是 ganutell，用金属线制作的工艺。玛雅：我可以凑近看看吗？丽塔：可以，你看这线多细。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 这是什么工艺？
messages.en: What is this work?

messages.speaker: Rita (展览讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ganutell, xogħol magħmul b'fil tal-metall.
messages.mt_standard: Dan ganutell, xogħol magħmul b'fil tal-metall.
messages.zh: 这是 ganutell，用金属线制作的工艺。
messages.en: This is ganutell, work made with metal thread.

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 我可以凑近看看吗？
messages.en: Can I look at it closely?

messages.speaker: Rita (展览讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara kemm hu rqiq il-fil.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara kemm hu rqiq il-fil.
messages.zh: 可以，你看这线多细。
messages.en: Yes, look how fine the thread is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ganutell 和一件细金属线作品配图记忆；另将 Ma nafx 标为义项未明，勿当作这个词的确定词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A set of steps used to move between different levels of a building.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人上下建筑物不同楼层或高度的一组阶梯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-garador huwa sett ta' tarġiet li jintużaw biex wieħed jitla' jew jinżel bejn livelli differenti ta' bini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 连接建筑物不同楼层或高度、供人上下的楼梯。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sett ta' tarġiet f'bini li jippermetti lin-nies jitilgħu jew jinżlu minn livell għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A garador is a set of steps connecting different levels of a building.

formal.mt: Il-garador li jagħti għall-ewwel sular għandu jinżamm ħieles minn kull oġġett.
formal.en: The staircase leading to the first floor must be kept clear of all objects.
formal.zh: 通往楼上一层的楼梯必须保持畅通，不得堆放任何物品。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hu l-garador? Lara: Ħdejn il-bieb, fuq ix-xellug. Mark: Hu dejjaq? Għandi bagalja kbira. Lara: Iva, ejja ngħinek ittellagħha.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is the staircase? Lara: Beside the door, on the left. Mark: Is it narrow? I have a large suitcase. Lara: Yes, let me help you carry it up.
colloquial.zh: 马克：楼梯在哪里？拉拉：在门旁边，左手边。马克：楼梯窄吗？我有一个大行李箱。拉拉：窄，我来帮你把箱子搬上去。

messages.speaker: Mark (住客)
messages.zh: 楼梯在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the staircase?

messages.speaker: Lara (房东)
messages.zh: 在门旁边，左手边。
messages.en: Beside the door, on the left.

messages.speaker: Mark (住客)
messages.zh: 楼梯窄吗？我有一个大行李箱。
messages.en: Is it narrow? I have a large suitcase.

messages.speaker: Lara (房东)
messages.zh: 窄，我来帮你把箱子搬上去。
messages.en: Yes, let me help you carry it up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象提着行李沿 garador 一级一级上楼，把整个词与楼梯画面一起记，不作词根拆解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Promised or assured, so that someone undertakes that it will be provided or will happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经得到承诺或保证，表示有人承诺会提供某物或确保某事发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li dwaru tkun ingħatat wegħda jew assigurazzjoni li se jingħata, ikun disponibbli jew iseħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已获承诺或保证的；有人担保会提供或实现的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tkun garantita meta jkun hemm wegħda jew assigurazzjoni li se tingħata jew isseħħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is guaranteed, someone has promised that it will be provided or will happen.

formal.mt: Wara li jirċievi l-konferma bil-miktub, il-parteċipant ikollu post garantit fil-kors.
formal.en: After receiving written confirmation, the participant will have a guaranteed place on the course.
formal.zh: 收到书面确认后，参加者便有了该课程的保证名额。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-post tiegħi fil-kors hu garantit? Pawlu: Iva, irċevejt il-konferma, hux? Nina: Iva, waslitli dalgħodu. Pawlu: Mela għandek post garantit.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is my place on the course guaranteed? Pawlu: Yes, you received the confirmation, didn't you? Nina: Yes, it arrived this morning. Pawlu: Then you have a guaranteed place.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我在课程里的名额有保证了吗？保罗：有了，你收到确认了，对吧？妮娜：收到了，今天早上收到的。保罗：那你的名额就有保证了。

messages.speaker: Nina (学员)
messages.zh: 我在课程里的名额有保证了吗？
messages.en: Is my place on the course guaranteed?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (课程管理员)
messages.zh: 有了，你收到确认了，对吧？
messages.en: Yes, you received the confirmation, didn't you?

messages.speaker: Nina (学员)
messages.zh: 收到了，今天早上收到的。
messages.en: Yes, it arrived this morning.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (课程管理员)
messages.zh: 那你的名额就有保证了。
messages.en: Then you have a guaranteed place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 post garantit 想成一张写着名额已确认的通知，用收到确认后的安心感记住有保证的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A personal guarantee that depends on another obligation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依附于另一项义务的个人担保。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Garanzija personali li tiddependi fuq obbligu ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从属性个人担保，即依附于另一项义务的个人担保。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Forma ta' garanzija personali li tkun marbuta ma' obbligu ieħor u tiddependi fuqu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dependent personal security is a personal guarantee that depends on another obligation.

collocations.en: a dependent personal guarantee is given
the conditions of the dependent personal guarantee
collocations.zh: 从属性个人担保的条件

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jiddeskrivi l-garanzija personali dipendenti u jidentifika l-obbligu li tiddependi fuqu.
formal.en: The agreement describes the dependent personal guarantee and identifies the obligation on which it depends.
formal.zh: 协议说明了该从属性个人担保，并明确指出其所依附的义务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'garanzija personali dipendenti'? Mark: Hija garanzija personali li tiddependi fuq obbligu ieħor. Maja: Allura rrid nifhem ma' liema obbligu hi marbuta. Mark: Iva, dik ir-rabta hi importanti biex tifhem il-frażi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'dependent personal guarantee' mean? Mark: It is a personal guarantee that depends on another obligation. Maja: So I need to understand which obligation it is linked to. Mark: Yes, that connection is important for understanding the phrase.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：从属性个人担保是什么意思？马克：就是依附于另一项义务的个人担保。玛雅：所以我要弄清楚它与哪项义务相联系。马克：对，理解这个短语时，这种联系很重要。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 从属性个人担保是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'dependent personal guarantee' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija garanzija personali li tiddependi fuq obbligu ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Hija garanzija personali li tiddependi fuq obbligu ieħor.
messages.zh: 就是依附于另一项义务的个人担保。
messages.en: It is a personal guarantee that depends on another obligation.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Allura rrid nifhem ma' liema obbligu hi marbuta.
messages.mt_standard: Allura rrid nifhem ma' liema obbligu hi marbuta.
messages.zh: 所以我要弄清楚它与哪项义务相联系。
messages.en: So I need to understand which obligation it is linked to.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dik ir-rabta hi importanti biex tifhem il-frażi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dik ir-rabta hi importanti biex tifhem il-frażi.
messages.zh: 对，理解这个短语时，这种联系很重要。
messages.en: Yes, that connection is important for understanding the phrase.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按短语分块记：garanzija 是担保，personali 表示个人的，dipendenti 表示依附的；画一根线把个人担保连到另一项义务。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A guarantee provided to secure the fulfilment of obligations under a contract.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为确保合同义务得到履行而提供的担保。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Garanzija mogħtija biex tiżgura li jitwettqu l-obbligi ta' kuntratt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为保障承包方或合同另一方履行约定义务而提供的履约担保。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Garanzija li tingħata biex tiżgura li kuntrattur jew parti oħra twettaq l-obbligi tagħha skont il-kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A performance bond is a guarantee provided to protect against a party's failure to fulfil its contractual obligations.

collocations.en: the value of the performance bond

formal.mt: Skont il-kuntratt, il-kuntrattur għandu jippreżenta garanzija ta' eżekuzzjoni qabel ma jibda x-xogħol.
formal.en: Under the contract, the contractor must submit a performance bond before starting the work.
formal.zh: 根据合同，承包商须在开工前提交履约保函。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għad fadal xi dokument qabel nibdew ix-xogħol? Pawlu: Iva, irridu nippreżentaw il-garanzija ta' eżekuzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is there still a document we need before starting the work? Pawlu: Yes, we need to submit the performance bond.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：开工前还缺什么文件吗？保罗：是的，我们还要提交履约保函。

messages.speaker: Marija (项目经理)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad fadal xi dokument qabel nibdew ix-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Għad fadal xi dokument qabel nibdew ix-xogħol?
messages.zh: 开工前还缺什么文件吗？
messages.en: Is there still a document we need before starting the work?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (合同专员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irridu nippreżentaw il-garanzija ta' eżekuzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irridu nippreżentaw il-garanzija ta' eżekuzzjoni.
messages.zh: 是的，我们还要提交履约保函。
messages.en: Yes, we need to submit the performance bond.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个短语放在“合同已签，准备履行”的画面中记忆：开工前递交的担保对应“履约担保”。

gloss_zh: 投标担保；投标保证金或保函

teaching_sense.en_definition: A guarantee or financial security submitted with a tender to secure the bidder's commitments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 投标时提交的担保，用于保障投标人履行与投标有关的承诺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Garanzija jew somma ta' flus ippreżentata ma' offerta biex tiżgura li l-offerent iwettaq l-impenji marbuta magħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在投标语境中，为保障投标人履行相关承诺而提供的担保或保证金。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Garanzija jew somma ta' flus li tingħata fil-kuntest ta' offerta biex tiżgura li l-offerent iżomm l-impenji tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In a tendering context, security is money or a guarantee provided to ensure that a bidder honours its commitments.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为保障投标人履行投标承诺而出具的投标担保。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Garanzija mogħtija b'rabta ma' offerta biex tiżgura li l-offerent iwettaq l-impenji li jkun ħa meta ssottometta l-offerta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tender guarantee is a guarantee submitted in connection with a bid to secure the bidder's tender commitments.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 随投标提供、用于保障投标承诺得到履行的保证金或其他担保。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Somma ta' flus jew garanzija oħra pprovduta ma' offerta biex tiżgura t-twettiq tal-impenji tal-offerent.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tender security is money or another form of guarantee supplied with a bid to support the bidder's commitments.

collocations.en: the validity period of the tender guarantee

formal.mt: Id-dokumenti tas-sejħa għall-offerti jindikaw l-ammont u l-perjodu ta' validità tal-garanzija tal-offerta meħtieġa.
formal.en: The tender documents specify the amount and validity period of the required tender guarantee.
formal.zh: 招标文件载明了所需投标担保的金额和有效期。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-offerta lesta biex nibagħtuha? Mark: Kważi. Għad irridu nehmżu l-garanzija tal-offerta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the bid ready to send? Mark: Almost. We still need to attach the tender guarantee.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：投标文件可以发出去了吗？马克：差不多了，还要附上投标担保。

messages.speaker: Lara (投标负责人)
messages.zh: 投标文件可以发出去了吗？
messages.en: Is the bid ready to send?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi. Għad irridu nehmżu l-garanzija tal-offerta.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi. Għad irridu nehmżu l-garanzija tal-offerta.
messages.zh: 差不多了，还要附上投标担保。
messages.en: Almost. We still need to attach the tender guarantee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象投标文件袋里夹着一份担保：它跟随“投标”一起提交，因此整个短语记作“投标担保”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large pot used by witches, especially in a story.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 女巫使用的大锅，适合在故事语境中理解和学习。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Borma kbira li tintuża mis-sħaħar, speċjalment f'rakkont.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 女巫使用的大锅。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Borma kbira li s-sħaħar jużaw biex iħejju jew iħalltu dak li jpoġġu fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A gardarun is a large pot used by witches, such as the one described in a story.

collocations.en: stir the mixture in the witch's large pot
collocations.zh: 搅拌女巫大锅里的混合物

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, is-saħħara poġġiet il-gardarun ħdejn in-nar u bdiet tħawwad it-taħlita.
formal.en: In the story, the witch placed the large pot beside the fire and began stirring the mixture.
formal.zh: 故事中，女巫把大锅放在火旁，开始搅拌里面的混合物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed tpinġi ħdejn is-saħħara? Ben: Gardarun! Se npinġi kuċċarina kbira fih ukoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you drawing beside the witch? Ben: A big witch's pot! I'll draw a large spoon in it too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在女巫旁边画什么？本：女巫的大锅！我还要在里面画一把大勺子。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你在女巫旁边画什么？
messages.en: What are you drawing beside the witch?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Gardarun! Se npinġi kuċċarina kbira fih ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Gardarun! Se npinġi kuċċarina kbira fih ukoll.
messages.zh: 女巫的大锅！我还要在里面画一把大勺子。
messages.en: A big witch's pot! I'll draw a large spoon in it too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一位女巫搅拌大锅，把 gardarun 写在锅身上；每次看图就说“女巫用的大锅”，建立词与画面的联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A goldfinch belonging to the bird species Carduelis carduelis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 红额金翅雀，即学名为 Carduelis carduelis 的鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Carduelis carduelis, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala goldfinch.

sense_translations.en_definition: goldfinch (bird of the species Carduelis carduelis)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 红额金翅雀，指鸟类物种 Carduelis carduelis 的个体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għasfur li jappartjeni għall-ispeċi Carduelis carduelis u li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ goldfinch.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A gardell is a goldfinch, a bird belonging to the species scientifically named Carduelis carduelis.

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar, l-istudenti raw gardell fuq fergħa u kitbu l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu, Carduelis carduelis.
formal.en: During the birdwatching activity, the students saw a goldfinch on a branch and wrote down its scientific name, Carduelis carduelis.
formal.zh: 观鸟活动中，学生们看见树枝上有一只红额金翅雀，并记下了它的学名 Carduelis carduelis。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa! X'inhu? Toni: Dak gardell. Ejja narawh minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at that bird on the branch! What is it? Toni: That's a goldfinch. Let's watch it from here.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看树枝上的那只鸟！那是什么鸟？托尼：那是红额金翅雀。我们就在这里看它吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa! X'inhu?
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa! X'inhu?
messages.zh: 看树枝上的那只鸟！那是什么鸟？
messages.en: Look at that bird on the branch! What is it?

messages.speaker: Toni (观鸟伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak gardell. Ejja narawh minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Dak gardell. Ejja narawh minn hawn.
messages.zh: 那是红额金翅雀。我们就在这里看它吧。
messages.en: That's a goldfinch. Let's watch it from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张鸟类词卡，正面写 gardell，背面写“红额金翅雀、goldfinch”；结合树枝上的鸟这一场景反复回忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A goldfinch is a small bird with a red face and yellow markings on its wings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 金翅雀是一种体型较小、脸部有红色、翅膀上有黄色斑纹的鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur żgħir b'wiċċ aħmar u marki sofor fuq il-ġwienaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 金翅雀，一种脸部有红色、翅膀上有黄色斑纹的小鸟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-gardill huwa għasfur żgħir li jingħaraf mill-wiċċ aħmar u mill-marki sofor fuq il-ġwienaħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A goldfinch is a small bird that you can recognize by its red face and yellow wing markings.

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, l-istudenti raw gardill fuq fergħa u nnutaw il-marki sofor fuq il-ġwienaħ tiegħu.
formal.en: During their observation in the garden, the students saw a goldfinch on a branch and noted the yellow markings on its wings.
formal.zh: 在花园进行观察时，学生们看见树枝上有一只金翅雀，并留意到它翅膀上的黄色斑纹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa! X'inhu? Luqa: Dak gardill. Ara l-isfar fuq il-ġwienaħ tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that bird on the branch! What is it? Luqa: That's a goldfinch. Look at the yellow on its wings.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看树枝上那只鸟！是什么鸟？卢卡：那是金翅雀。看看它翅膀上的黄色。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa! X'inhu?
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa! X'inhu?
messages.zh: 看树枝上那只鸟！是什么鸟？
messages.en: Look at that bird on the branch! What is it?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak gardill. Ara l-isfar fuq il-ġwienaħ tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak gardill. Ara l-isfar fuq il-ġwienaħ tiegħu.
messages.zh: 那是金翅雀。看看它翅膀上的黄色。
messages.en: That's a goldfinch. Look at the yellow on its wings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gardill 与“红脸、黄翅的小鸟”画面绑定，再用“树枝上的金翅雀”短语反复记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To gargle means to move liquid around at the back of your mouth and throat by breathing out through it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将液体含在口腔后部和咽喉处，通过呼气使其翻动，进行漱喉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żamm likwidu fin-naħa ta' wara tal-ħalq u fil-gerżuma u ċaqalqu billi ħareġ l-arja minn ġo fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 漱喉：将水等液体含在口腔后部和咽喉处，呼气使液体翻动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta persuna tagħmel din l-azzjoni, iżżomm likwidu fin-naħa ta' wara tal-ħalq u fil-gerżuma u ċċaqalqu billi toħroġ l-arja minn ġo fih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you gargle, you hold liquid at the back of your mouth and throat and breathe out through it to make it move.

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-azzjoni, l-istudent kiteb: 'Mark gargarizza bl-ilma għal ftit sekondi u mbagħad beżqu fis-sink.'
formal.en: In his description of the action, the student wrote: 'Mark gargled with water for a few seconds and then spat it into the sink.'
formal.zh: 在描述这个动作时，学生写道：“马克用水漱喉几秒钟，然后把水吐进洗手池。”

colloquial.mt: Luqa: X'għamel Mark b'dak l-ilma? Sara: Gargarizza bih u mbagħad beżqu fis-sink.
