colloquial.en: Luqa: What did Mark do with that water? Sara: He gargled with it and then spat it into the sink.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：马克拿那些水做什么了？萨拉：他用来漱喉，然后吐进洗手池了。

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.zh: 马克拿那些水做什么了？
messages.en: What did Mark do with that water?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Gargarizza bih u mbagħad beżqu fis-sink.
messages.mt_standard: Gargarizza bih u mbagħad beżqu fis-sink.
messages.zh: 他用来漱喉，然后吐进洗手池了。
messages.en: He gargled with it and then spat it into the sink.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gargarizza 的重复音节联想成漱喉时的“咕噜咕噜”声；这只是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 螺旋楼梯井；容纳螺旋楼梯的空间

teaching_sense.en_definition: A spiral stairwell is a space in a building containing stairs that wind around a central point.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建筑内供楼梯围绕中心盘旋而上的楼梯井或楼梯空间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spazju f'bini li fih taraġ idur madwar punt ċentrali waqt li jitla' minn sular għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 螺旋楼梯井，即建筑中容纳围绕中心盘旋而上的楼梯的空间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-gargor huwa spazju f'bini li fih taraġ jitla' f'forma ta' spirali madwar punt ċentrali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A spiral stairwell is the space in a building where a staircase winds upwards around a central point.

collocations.en: the stairs in the spiral stairwell

formal.mt: Il-pjanta tal-bini turi gargor ħdejn id-daħla, bit-taraġ idur madwar punt ċentrali sa fuq il-bejt.
formal.en: The building plan shows a spiral stairwell beside the entrance, with the stairs winding around a central point up to the roof.
formal.zh: 建筑平面图显示，入口旁设有一个螺旋楼梯井，楼梯绕着中心盘旋而上，直达屋顶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn nitla' fuq il-bejt? Pawlu: Hemm gargor ħdejn il-bieb. Itla' minn hemm, imma oqgħod attenta għax it-taraġ dejjaq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which way do I go up to the roof? Pawlu: There's a spiral stairwell beside the door. Go up that way, but be careful because the stairs are narrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：从哪里上屋顶？保罗：门旁边有个螺旋楼梯井。从那里上去，不过楼梯很窄，要小心。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 从哪里上屋顶？
messages.en: Which way do I go up to the roof?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm gargor ħdejn il-bieb. Itla' minn hemm, imma oqgħod attenta għax it-taraġ dejjaq.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm gargor ħdejn il-bieb. Itla' minn hemm, imma oqgħod attenta għax it-taraġ dejjaq.
messages.zh: 门旁边有个螺旋楼梯井。从那里上去，不过楼梯很窄，要小心。
messages.en: There's a spiral stairwell beside the door. Go up that way, but be careful because the stairs are narrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 gargor 时想象从楼梯井底向上看，台阶绕着中心一圈圈升高；把词与整个螺旋楼梯空间相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a goat that has short ears.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容山羊耳朵较短的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi mogħża li għandha widnejn qosra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 短耳的，用于形容耳朵较短的山羊。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tiddeskrivi mogħża li għandha widnejn qosra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A goat described as garruwa has short ears.

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt tidher mogħża garruwa, li tingħaraf mill-widnejn qosra tagħha.
formal.en: The photograph shows a short-eared goat, which can be identified by its short ears.
formal.zh: 照片中是一只短耳山羊，可以通过它的短耳朵辨认出来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema mogħża qed tgħid? Pawlu: Dik il-mogħża l-garruwa ħdejn il-bieb. Maja: Issa rajtha! Għandha widnejn qosra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which goat do you mean? Pawlu: That short-eared goat by the door. Maja: I see it now! It has short ears.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你说的是哪只山羊？Pawlu：门旁边那只短耳山羊。Maja：我现在看到了！它的耳朵很短。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 你说的是哪只山羊？
messages.en: Which goat do you mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场主)
messages.zh: 门旁边那只短耳山羊。
messages.en: That short-eared goat by the door.

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 我现在看到了！它的耳朵很短。
messages.en: I see it now! It has short ears.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 garruwa 和 mogħża 一起记：想象两只山羊并排站，给耳朵较短的那只贴上这个形容词标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The vocal cords are two bands of tissue in the larynx that vibrate to produce the voice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 声带是喉内的两条组织带，通过振动产生声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żewġ strixxi ta' tessut fil-larinġi li jivvibraw biex jipproduċu l-vuċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 声带，位于喉内、振动时产生声音的两条组织带。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-garġi huma żewġ strixxi ta' tessut fil-larinġi li jipproduċu l-vuċi meta jivvibraw.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your vocal cords are the two bands of tissue in your larynx that vibrate when you produce voiced sounds.

collocations.en: the vibration of the vocal cords

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-lezzjoni, l-istudenta spjegat li l-garġi jivvibraw waqt il-produzzjoni tal-ħsejjes bil-vuċi.
formal.en: In her lesson report, the student explained that the vocal cords vibrate during the production of voiced sounds.
formal.zh: 在课堂报告中，这名学生解释说，声带在发出浊音时会振动。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Meta ngħid 'aaa', inħoss vibrazzjoni f'għonqi. Għaliex? Nina: Għax il-garġi tiegħek ikunu qed jivvibraw.
colloquial.en: Sara: When I say 'aaa', I feel a vibration in my neck. Why? Nina: Because your vocal cords are vibrating.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我发“啊”的时候，感觉脖子里面在振动。为什么？妮娜：因为你的声带正在振动。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta ngħid 'aaa', inħoss vibrazzjoni f'għonqi. Għaliex?
messages.mt_standard: Meta ngħid 'aaa', inħoss vibrazzjoni f'għonqi. Għaliex?
messages.zh: 我发“啊”的时候，感觉脖子里面在振动。为什么？
messages.en: When I say 'aaa', I feel a vibration in my neck. Why?

messages.speaker: Nina (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-garġi tiegħek ikunu qed jivvibraw.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-garġi tiegħek ikunu qed jivvibraw.
messages.zh: 因为你的声带正在振动。
messages.en: Because your vocal cords are vibrating.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 garġi 时轻声发“啊”，把喉内振动的感觉与“声带”联系起来，形成声音记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Gauze, or a dressing used to cover a wound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 纱布，也指用于覆盖伤口的敷料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Drapp irqiq b'nisġa miftuħa, jew faxxa li tintuża biex tgħatti ferita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纱布，一种织纹疏松、带有细小网孔的薄布。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Drapp irqiq b'nisġa miftuħa li għandu toqob żgħar bejn il-ħjut.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Gauze is a thin fabric with an open weave.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伤口敷料，用于覆盖伤口的材料或敷片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa materjal li titqiegħed fuq ferita biex tgħattiha u tipproteġiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A wound dressing is material placed over a wound to cover and protect it.

formal.mt: L-infermiera għattiet il-ferita b'garża sterili u kitbet fir-rapport li l-garża kienet nadifa.
formal.en: The nurse covered the wound with sterile gauze and recorded in the report that the dressing was clean.
formal.zh: 护士用无菌纱布覆盖伤口，并在报告中记录敷料是干净的。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek garża sterili? Rita: Iva, hemm pakkett fil-kaxxa tal-ewwel għajnuna. Mark: Tajjeb, sibtu. Grazzi!
colloquial.en: Mark: Have you got any sterile gauze? Rita: Yes, there is a packet in the first-aid box. Mark: Great, I found it. Thanks!
colloquial.zh: Mark：你有无菌纱布吗？Rita：有，急救箱里有一包。Mark：好，找到了。谢谢！

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 你有无菌纱布吗？
messages.en: Have you got any sterile gauze?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm pakkett fil-kaxxa tal-ewwel għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm pakkett fil-kaxxa tal-ewwel għajnuna.
messages.zh: 有，急救箱里有一包。
messages.en: Yes, there is a packet in the first-aid box.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 好，找到了。谢谢！
messages.en: Great, I found it. Thanks!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用同一幅画记住两个义项：包装里的网眼薄布是纱布，覆盖伤口时则是敷料；两种语境都能遇到 garża。

gloss_zh: 盆栽支架；花盆架（通常由锻铁或石砌构件制成）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stand that supports a potted plant, usually made of wrought iron or stonework.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于承托盆栽的架子或台座，通常由锻铁或石砌构件制成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Appoġġ li fuqu titqiegħed pjanta f'qasrija, ġeneralment magħmul minn ħadid maħdum jew xogħol tal-ġebel.

sense_translations.en_definition: a stand for a potted plant, usually made of wrought iron or stonework
sense_translations.zh_definition: 承托盆栽的支架或台座，通常由锻铁或石砌构件制成。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Appoġġ għal pjanta f'qasrija, li normalment ikun magħmul minn ħadid maħdum jew xogħol tal-ġebel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A gastra is a stand used to support a potted plant, usually made of wrought iron or stonework.

collocations.en: a plant pot on a stand

formal.mt: Fil-bitħa tqiegħdet gastra tal-ħadid maħdum biex iġġorr qasrija kbira bil-fjuri.
formal.en: A wrought-iron plant stand was placed in the courtyard to support a large pot of flowers.
formal.zh: 庭院中放置了一个锻铁盆栽架，用来承托一大盆花。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn inpoġġi din il-qasrija? Toni: Fuq il-gastra ħdejn it-tieqa. Lara: Sewwa, hemm tidher sabiħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where shall I put this plant pot? Toni: On the plant stand by the window. Lara: All right, it looks lovely there.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这盆植物放在哪里？Toni：放在窗边的盆栽架上。Lara：好，放在那里很好看。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 这盆植物放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I put this plant pot?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 放在窗边的盆栽架上。
messages.en: On the plant stand by the window.

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 好，放在那里很好看。
messages.en: All right, it looks lovely there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象花盆站在一个锻铁小台上：qasrija 是上面的花盆，gastra 是下面承托它的架子，按上下位置区分记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mumps, an infectious illness that can cause swelling of the salivary glands near the ears.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 流行性腮腺炎，一种可引起耳旁唾液腺肿胀的传染病。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marda li tittieħed u li tista' tikkawża nefħa fil-glandoli tal-bżieq ħdejn il-widnejn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流行性腮腺炎，一种可导致耳旁唾液腺肿胀的传染病。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Marda infettiva li tista' tikkawża nefħa fil-glandoli li jipproduċu l-bżieq ħdejn il-widnejn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mumps is an infectious illness that can cause swelling of the salivary glands near the ears.

collocations.zh: 他患上了流行性腮腺炎

formal.mt: Ir-rapport semma każ ta' gattone u ddeskriva s-sintomi li kellu l-pazjent.
formal.en: The report mentioned a case of mumps and described the patient's symptoms.
formal.zh: 报告提到一例流行性腮腺炎，并描述了患者的症状。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Ben ma ġiex illum? Marija: Ommu qaltli li għandu l-gattone. Sara: Miskin! Nittama li jfiq malajr.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why didn't Ben come today? Marija: His mother told me he has mumps. Sara: Poor thing! I hope he gets well soon.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Ben 今天为什么没来？Marija：他妈妈告诉我，他得了流行性腮腺炎。Sara：真可怜！希望他早日康复。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: Ben 今天为什么没来？
messages.en: Why didn't Ben come today?

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 他妈妈告诉我，他得了流行性腮腺炎。
messages.en: His mother told me he has mumps.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 真可怜！希望他早日康复。
messages.en: Poor thing! I hope he gets well soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gattone、mumps、流行性腮腺炎写在同一张词卡上，配一幅耳旁肿胀的示意图，再用 għandu l-gattone 练习表达患病。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wood obtained from an acacia tree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 金合欢树的木材。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Injam li jinkiseb mis-siġra tal-akaċja.

sense_translations.en_definition: Acacia wood. See Il-Bibja, Ghaqda Biblika Maltija Ezodu 38.1
sense_translations.zh_definition: 金合欢木，即金合欢树的木材；所给释义另参引马耳他语《圣经》《出埃及记》38:1。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-gażżi huwa l-injam tas-siġra tal-akaċja; id-definizzjoni mogħtija tirreferi wkoll għal Eżodu 38:1 fil-Bibbja bil-Malti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Gażżi is the wood of an acacia tree, with the supplied entry also referring readers to Exodus 38:1 in the Maltese Bible.

formal.mt: Il-mejda deskritta fir-rapport hija magħmula mill-gażżi, jiġifieri mill-injam tal-akaċja.
formal.en: The table described in the report is made from gażżi, meaning acacia wood.
formal.zh: 报告中描述的桌子由金合欢木制成，马耳他语称这种木材为 gażżi。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-biċċa injam x'inhi? Mark: Hija gażżi, injam tal-akaċja. Maja: Mela nista' nsejħilha biċċa gażżi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What kind of wood is this piece? Mark: It is gażżi, acacia wood. Maja: So I can call it a piece of gażżi.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这块是什么木头？Mark：是 gażżi，也就是金合欢木。Maja：那么我可以把它叫作“一块金合欢木”。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这块是什么木头？
messages.en: What kind of wood is this piece?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 是 gażżi，也就是金合欢木。
messages.en: It is gażżi, acacia wood.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 那么我可以把它叫作“一块金合欢木”。
messages.en: So I can call it a piece of gażżi.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gażżi 写在金合欢木样品的标签上，配合“一块木材”的画面记忆，注意这里指木材。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place that is small in size.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面积或空间较小的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post li huwa żgħir fid-daqs jew fl-ispazju li joffri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个空间或面积较小的地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Gebuba hija post żgħir li ma joffrix ħafna spazju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A gebuba is a small place with relatively little space available.

formal.mt: L-attività saret f'gebuba, u għalhekk in-numru ta' parteċipanti kien limitat.
formal.en: The activity took place in a small place, so the number of participants was limited.
formal.zh: 活动在一个小地方举行，因此参加人数受到限制。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn se niltaqgħu? Din gebuba! Mark: Iva, imma llum se nkunu tlieta biss. Maja: Mela għandna biżżejjed spazju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are we meeting here? This is a small place! Mark: Yes, but there will only be three of us today. Maja: Then we have enough space.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们在这里碰面吗？这地方真小！Mark：是啊，不过今天只有我们三个人。Maja：那空间就够了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在这里碰面吗？这地方真小！
messages.en: Are we meeting here? This is a small place!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma llum se nkunu tlieta biss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma llum se nkunu tlieta biss.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过今天只有我们三个人。
messages.en: Yes, but there will only be three of us today.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那空间就够了。
messages.en: Then we have enough space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象三个人挤进一个小地方，在门口贴上 gebuba；用“小空间”的画面记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning is not established in the supplied material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料中标为名词、但尚无明确释义的词条。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma mniżżla bħala nom li t-tifsira tagħha mhijiex stabbilita fil-materjal mogħti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所给释义仅为“Idk”，未明确说明该名词的词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-materjal mogħti jniżżel biss 'Idk' bħala definizzjoni u ma jagħtix tifsira ċara għal dan in-nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied material lists this noun without providing an identifiable meaning.

formal.mt: Fil-materjal mogħti, il-kelma 'geduda' hija mniżżla bħala nom, iżda d-definizzjoni 'Idk' ma tiċċarax it-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: In the supplied material, 'geduda' is listed as a noun, but the definition 'Idk' does not clarify its meaning.
formal.zh: 所给材料把 geduda 列为名词，但其释义“Idk”并未明确说明词义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'geduda'? Mark: Hawn hemm biss 'Idk'; it-tifsira mhijiex ċara. Maja: Mela se nħalliha mmarkata bħala kelma b'tifsira mhux magħrufa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'geduda' mean? Mark: It only says 'Idk' here; the meaning is unclear. Maja: Then I will leave it marked as a word with an unknown meaning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：geduda 是什么意思？Mark：这里仅写了“Idk”，词义不明确。Maja：那我先把它标记为词义未知的词。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: geduda 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'geduda' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn hemm biss 'Idk'; it-tifsira mhijiex ċara.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn hemm biss 'Idk'; it-tifsira mhijiex ċara.
messages.zh: 这里仅写了“Idk”，词义不明确。
messages.en: It only says 'Idk' here; the meaning is unclear.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela se nħalliha mmarkata bħala kelma b'tifsira mhux magħrufa.
messages.mt_standard: Mela se nħalliha mmarkata bħala kelma b'tifsira mhux magħrufa.
messages.zh: 那我先把它标记为词义未知的词。
messages.en: Then I will leave it marked as a word with an unknown meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 geduda 配一张问号卡，暂记拼写和名词标签；不要把材料中的 Idk 当作已确认的词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person affectionately called darling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对喜爱之人的亲昵称呼，相当于“亲爱的”或“宝贝”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna għażiża li wieħed isejħilha b'dan l-isem biex jesprimi mħabba jew affezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亲爱的；宝贝，用作对所爱之人的爱称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Gedudu huwa isem ta' mħabba għal persuna għażiża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You call someone your gedudu when you want to express love or affection for that person.

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tagħha, l-omm kitbet lil binha: 'Int il-gedudu tiegħi, u nħobbok ħafna.'
formal.en: In her letter, the mother wrote to her son: 'You are my darling, and I love you very much.'
formal.zh: 母亲在信中写给儿子：“你是我的宝贝，我非常爱你。”

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ejja hawn, gedudu tiegħi. Kif kienet l-iskola? Ben: Kienet sabiħa, mamà! Anna: Għidli x'għamilt illum.
colloquial.en: Anna: Come here, my darling. How was school? Ben: It was lovely, Mum! Anna: Tell me what you did today.
colloquial.zh: Anna：过来，我的宝贝。今天在学校怎么样？Ben：很开心，妈妈！Anna：跟我说说你今天做了什么。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja hawn, gedudu tiegħi. Kif kienet l-iskola?
messages.mt_standard: Ejja hawn, gedudu tiegħi. Kif kienet l-iskola?
messages.zh: 过来，我的宝贝。今天在学校怎么样？
messages.en: Come here, my darling. How was school?

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 很开心，妈妈！
messages.en: It was lovely, Mum!

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 跟我说说你今天做了什么。
messages.en: Tell me what you did today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象母亲张开双臂说 gedudu tiegħi，把整句和“我的宝贝”一起记住；注意词尾是 u。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A buffalo, a large, strong animal of the cattle family with horns.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 水牛，一种体形大、身体强壮且长有角的牛科动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal kbir u b'saħħtu tal-familja tal-baqar, li għandu l-qrun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水牛，一种大型、有角的牛科动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal tal-familja tal-baqar li għandu ġisem kbir u b'saħħtu u qrun fuq rasu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A buffalo is a large animal of the cattle family with a strong body and horns.

formal.mt: Fl-istampa tal-ktieb jidher gelmus kbir, u l-istudenti huma mitluba jidentifikaw il-qrun tiegħu.
formal.en: The picture in the book shows a large buffalo, and the students are asked to identify its horns.
formal.zh: 书中的图片展示了一头大水牛，学生需要指出它的角。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak l-annimal fl-istampa? David: Dak gelmus. Ħares lejn il-qrun tiegħu. Lara: Issa narahom!
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that animal in the picture? David: That's a buffalo. Look at its horns. Lara: I can see them now!
colloquial.zh: Lara：图片里的那是什么动物？David：那是水牛。看看它的角。Lara：我现在看到了！

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 图片里的那是什么动物？
messages.en: What is that animal in the picture?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak gelmus. Ħares lejn il-qrun tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak gelmus. Ħares lejn il-qrun tiegħu.
messages.zh: 那是水牛。看看它的角。
messages.en: That's a buffalo. Look at its horns.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 我现在看到了！
messages.en: I can see them now!

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一头身体壮硕、头上长角的水牛，并给图片贴上 gelmus 标签，用动物形象帮助记词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A decorative piece of jewellery fastened to clothing with a pin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胸针，用别针固定在衣服上、起装饰作用的首饰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ġojjellerija li titwaħħal mal-ħwejjeġ b'labra biex iżżejjinhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胸针，一种用别针扣在衣服上的装饰性首饰。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ornament li jintlibes imwaħħal mal-ħwejjeġ permezz ta' labra, normalment fuq is-sider jew fuq il-lapel ta' ġakketta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A brooch is a piece of jewellery that you pin to your clothes as a decoration.

formal.mt: Għall-wirja, il-mużew għażel gemewwa tad-deheb bħala eżempju ta' ġojjellerija li tintlibes fuq il-ħwejjeġ.
formal.en: For the exhibition, the museum selected a gold brooch as an example of jewellery worn on clothing.
formal.zh: 博物馆为展览挑选了一枚金胸针，作为佩戴在衣服上的首饰实例。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'nista' nżid ma' din il-ġakketta? Sara: Ipprova din il-gemewwa. Tmur tajjeb magħha. Nina: Iva, se nilbisha!
colloquial.en: Nina: What can I add to this jacket? Sara: Try this brooch. It goes well with it. Nina: Yes, I'll wear it!
colloquial.zh: Nina：这件夹克可以配点什么？Sara：试试这枚胸针。它和夹克很搭。Nina：好，我就戴它！

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 这件夹克可以配点什么？
messages.en: What can I add to this jacket?

messages.speaker: Sara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipprova din il-gemewwa. Tmur tajjeb magħha.
messages.mt_standard: Ipprova din il-gemewwa. Tmur tajjeb magħha.
messages.zh: 试试这枚胸针。它和夹克很搭。
messages.en: Try this brooch. It goes well with it.

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 好，我就戴它！
messages.en: Yes, I'll wear it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一枚漂亮胸针别在夹克胸前，再读 gemewwa；用“别在衣服上的首饰”这个动作记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Heaven, understood in religious belief as a place of happiness and peace with God after death.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天堂或天国，在宗教信仰中指人死后与上帝同在、享有幸福与安宁的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-post ta' hena u paċi ma' Alla fejn, skont it-twemmin reliġjuż, imorru t-tajbin wara l-mewt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天堂；宗教信仰中人死后可享有幸福、安宁并与上帝同在的所在。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-post li, fit-twemmin reliġjuż, huwa marbut mal-preżenza ta' Alla u mal-hena ta' dawk li jkunu miegħu wara l-mewt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In religious belief, heaven is the place where people live in happiness and peace with God after death.

formal.mt: Fit-test reliġjuż, il-genna hija deskritta bħala post ta' paċi u hena fil-preżenza ta' Alla.
formal.en: In the religious text, heaven is described as a place of peace and happiness in the presence of God.
formal.zh: 在这篇宗教文本中，天堂被描述为一个与上帝同在、充满安宁与幸福的地方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser genna f'din l-istorja? Pawlu: Hawn tfisser il-post fejn, skont it-twemmin reliġjuż, it-tajbin ikunu ma' Alla wara l-mewt. Maja: Mela l-kelma hawn għandha sens reliġjuż.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does genna mean in this story? Pawlu: Here it means the place where, according to religious belief, good people are with God after death. Maja: So the word has a religious meaning here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个故事里的 genna 是什么意思？Pawlu：这里指宗教信仰中善良的人死后与上帝同在的地方。Maja：所以这个词在这里是宗教意义上的天堂。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的 genna 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does genna mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser il-post fejn, skont it-twemmin reliġjuż, it-tajbin ikunu ma' Alla wara l-mewt.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser il-post fejn, skont it-twemmin reliġjuż, it-tajbin ikunu ma' Alla wara l-mewt.
messages.zh: 这里指宗教信仰中善良的人死后与上帝同在的地方。
messages.en: Here it means the place where, according to religious belief, good people are with God after death.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela l-kelma hawn għandha sens reliġjuż.
messages.mt_standard: Mela l-kelma hawn għandha sens reliġjuż.
messages.zh: 所以这个词在这里是宗教意义上的天堂。
messages.en: So the word has a religious meaning here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 genna 与宗教故事中安宁幸福的天堂画面联系起来，记住这里说的是信仰中的天国。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun label glossed as 'geometry trash', with no precise referent established.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 释义为“geometry trash”的名词性标签；具体指什么尚不明确。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikketta nominali bit-tifsira 'geometry trash', li ma tindikax b'mod ċar għal xiex tirreferi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: “几何垃圾”；这一释义的具体所指不明确。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tfisser 'geometry trash', iżda li r-referent preċiż tagħha mhuwiex ċar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This expression carries the gloss 'geometry trash', although its precise referent remains unclear.

formal.mt: It-terminu 'geometry dash' jeħtieġ aktar kuntest biex it-tifsira tiegħu tkun ċara.
formal.en: The term 'geometry dash' requires more context for its meaning to be clear.
formal.zh: “geometry dash”这一术语需要更多上下文才能明确其含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'geometry dash' hawn? Pawlu: Mhux ċar; ejja naqraw is-sentenza kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'geometry dash' mean here? Pawlu: It isn't clear; let's read the whole sentence.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的“geometry dash”是什么意思？保罗：还不清楚；我们把整句话读完吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这里的“geometry dash”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'geometry dash' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux ċar; ejja naqraw is-sentenza kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux ċar; ejja naqraw is-sentenza kollha.
messages.zh: 还不清楚；我们把整句话读完吧。
messages.en: It isn't clear; let's read the whole sentence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词暂放进“含义待确认”的词卡盒，连同给定释义一起记，遇到完整语境再确定所指。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A part or setting in a mechanism that transmits motion, or a vehicle's lever for selecting gears.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 传动机构中用于传递运动的齿轮或挡位，也可指车辆上选择挡位的换挡杆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti jew pożizzjoni f'mekkaniżmu li jittrasmetti l-moviment, jew il-lieva f'vettura li biha jintgħażel il-ger mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 齿轮；传动装置中用于改变速度或传动力的挡位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rota bis-snien li tittrasmetti l-moviment lil parti oħra, jew pożizzjoni fit-trasmissjoni li tiddetermina r-relazzjoni bejn il-veloċità u l-forza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A gear is a toothed part that transmits motion, or a transmission setting that changes speed and driving force.

sense_translations.en_definition: gear lever (of a car or other vehicle)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 汽车或其他车辆上用于选择挡位的换挡杆。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Lieva f'karozza jew f'vettura oħra li s-sewwieq iċaqlaq biex jagħżel jew ibiddel il-ger.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The gear is the lever a driver moves to select a different transmission setting in a vehicle.

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni, l-għalliem spjega kif il-moviment tal-lieva jbiddel il-ger magħżul.
formal.en: During the lesson, the instructor explained how moving the lever changes the selected gear.
formal.zh: 课堂上，教练讲解了移动换挡杆如何改变所选挡位。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta tgħid 'ger', qed tirreferi għal-lieva? Pawlu: Iva, hawn qed nitkellem fuq il-lieva, mhux fuq il-ger magħżul.
colloquial.en: Maja: When you say 'ger', do you mean the lever? Pawlu: Yes, here I'm talking about the lever, not the selected gear.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你说“ger”时，指的是换挡杆吗？保罗：对，这里我说的是换挡杆，不是所选挡位。

messages.speaker: Maja (驾驶学员)
messages.zh: 你说“ger”时，指的是换挡杆吗？
messages.en: When you say 'ger', do you mean the lever?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (驾驶教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn qed nitkellem fuq il-lieva, mhux fuq il-ger magħżul.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn qed nitkellem fuq il-lieva, mhux fuq il-ger magħżul.
messages.zh: 对，这里我说的是换挡杆，不是所选挡位。
messages.en: Yes, here I'm talking about the lever, not the selected gear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手握换挡杆、眼看挡位：同一个 ger 可以指挡位，也可以指手里那根杆；再用齿轮图补记机械义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small, compact piece of material, usually rounded in shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由某种材料形成的小而紧实的颗粒，通常呈圆形或丸状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira u kompatta ta' xi materjal, li ġeneralment ikollha forma tonda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 丸状或近圆形的小颗粒。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa ċkejkna u kompatta ta' materjal, ġeneralment tonda jew magħmula f'forma ta' boċċa żgħira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pellet is a small, compact piece of material that usually has a rounded shape.

formal.mt: Għall-eżerċizzju, kull student għandu jagħmel gerbub tat-tafal u jpoġġih fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: For the exercise, each student should make a clay pellet and place it on the table.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，每位学生都应做一粒黏土丸，并把它放在桌上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed tagħmel bit-tafal? Mark: Qed nagħmel gerbub żgħir. Trid tipprova?
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you making with the clay? Mark: I'm making a small pellet. Want to try?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你在用黏土做什么？马克：我在做一粒小丸。你想试试吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在用黏土做什么？
messages.en: What are you making with the clay?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel gerbub żgħir. Trid tipprova?
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel gerbub żgħir. Trid tipprova?
messages.zh: 我在做一粒小丸。你想试试吗？
messages.en: I'm making a small pellet. Want to try?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用指尖把一小块黏土搓成丸，再指着它说 gerbub，用“小、紧实、近圆”三个特征记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An informal name used for a person instead of, or alongside, their usual name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在人通常使用的姓名之外，为其另取并在交往中使用的非正式称呼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem mhux uffiċjali li jingħata lil persuna u jintuża minflok isimha tas-soltu jew flimkien miegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绰号，外号；替代或伴随本人通常姓名使用的非正式称呼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem informali li bih tissejjaħ persuna minflok isimha proprju jew flimkien ma' dak l-isem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A nickname is an informal name people use for someone instead of, or in addition to, their usual name.

formal.mt: Fl-intervista, il-parteċipant spjega kif il-gerixa tiegħu bdiet tintuża fost il-ħbieb.
formal.en: In the interview, the participant explained how his nickname came to be used among his friends.
formal.zh: 在访谈中，参与者解释了朋友们是如何开始使用他的绰号的。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex kulħadd isejjaħlu 'il-Kaptan'? Pawlu: Dik il-gerixa tiegħu; ismu Mark.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does everyone call him 'the Captain'? Pawlu: That's his nickname; his name is Mark.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么大家都叫他“船长”？保罗：那是他的绰号；他的名字叫马克。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 为什么大家都叫他“船长”？
messages.en: Why does everyone call him 'the Captain'?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是他的绰号；他的名字叫马克。
messages.en: That's his nickname; his name is Mark.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一个人佩戴两张名牌：一张写正式姓名，一张写朋友叫的外号；把第二张名牌与 gerixa 连起来记。

gloss_zh: 儿童或运动员用的护腿、袜带；马腿皮护套

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small leg covering or garter worn by children or sportspeople, or a leather covering for a horse's leg.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 儿童或运动员穿戴的小型护腿或袜带，也指套在马腿上的皮制护套。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għata żgħira għar-riġel jew faxxa li żżomm il-kalzetti f'posthom, għat-tfal jew għall-isportivi; ukoll għata tal-ġilda għal riġel ta' żiemel.

sense_translations.en_definition: 1. Small children's or sportsmen's legging, garters. 2. Leather covering for horse's leg.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 1. 儿童或运动员使用的小型护腿、袜带。2. 马腿上的皮制护套。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għata żgħira li tintlibes fuq ir-riġel minn tfal jew sportivi, jew faxxa li żżomm il-kalzetti f'posthom; tista' wkoll tkun għata tal-ġilda li titqiegħed fuq riġel ta' żiemel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A getta is a small leg covering or garter for a child or sportsperson, or a leather covering placed around a horse's leg.

collocations.zh: 儿童用的小护腿或袜带

collocations.en: a leather leg covering for a horse

formal.mt: Qabel it-taħriġ, il-ħaddiem tal-istalla eżamina l-getta tal-ġilda biex jiżgura li kienet f'qagħda tajba.
formal.en: Before training, the stable worker examined the leather leg covering to ensure that it was in good condition.
formal.zh: 训练前，马厩工作人员检查了皮制护腿套，确保其状况良好。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-getta għal min hi? Toni: Għaż-żiemel; inpoġġuha fuq siequ qabel it-taħriġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is this leg covering for? Toni: For the horse; we put it on its leg before training.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个护腿套是给谁用的？托尼：给马用的；我们在训练前把它套在马腿上。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 这个护腿套是给谁用的？
messages.en: Who is this leg covering for?

messages.speaker: Toni (马厩工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaż-żiemel; inpoġġuha fuq siequ qabel it-taħriġ.
messages.mt_standard: Għaż-żiemel; inpoġġuha fuq siequ qabel it-taħriġ.
messages.zh: 给马用的；我们在训练前把它套在马腿上。
messages.en: For the horse; we put it on its leg before training.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 getta 放进“腿部穿戴”画面：儿童或运动员的小护腿、袜带，以及马腿上的皮护套；结合使用者记住具体意思。

gloss_zh: 说话混乱的；表达不清的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Confused or unclear in the way a person speaks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人说话时思路或表达混乱，使听者不容易理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitkellem b'mod imħawwad u ma jesprimix il-ħsieb tiegħu b'mod ċar.

sense_translations.en_definition: confused in the way he speaks
sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话方式混乱、不能清楚表达意思的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jitħawwad meta jitkellem u li kliemu jkun diffiċli biex jinftiehem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is confused in the way they speak expresses their thoughts so unclearly that other people may struggle to understand them.

formal.mt: Waqt il-preżentazzjoni, il-kelliem kien geġwieġi fid-diskors tiegħu, u għalhekk l-udjenza talbitu jispjega l-punt ewlieni mill-ġdid.
formal.en: During the presentation, the speaker was confused in his speech, so the audience asked him to explain the main point again.
formal.zh: 演讲时，发言人表达混乱，因此听众请他重新解释主要观点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fhimt x'ried jgħid Pawlu? Mark: Mhux sew. Kien geġwieġi fid-diskors tiegħu. Maja: Ejja nitolbuh jispjega bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you understand what Pawlu meant? Mark: Not really. He was confused in the way he spoke. Maja: Let's ask him to explain slowly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听懂保罗想说什么了吗？Mark：没太懂。他说得有些混乱。Maja：我们请他慢慢解释吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听懂保罗想说什么了吗？
messages.en: Did you understand what Pawlu meant?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux sew. Kien geġwieġi fid-diskors tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux sew. Kien geġwieġi fid-diskors tiegħu.
messages.zh: 没太懂。他说得有些混乱。
messages.en: Not really. He was confused in the way he spoke.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们请他慢慢解释吧。
messages.en: Let's ask him to explain slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“说了半天，听者仍理不清头绪”的画面联系起来，重点记住它形容的是说话表达混乱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or practice of gathering separate items into bundles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把分散的物品归拢成束或捆包的行为，也指采用这种方式整理物品的做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-prattika li jinġabru oġġetti separati u jintrabtu jew jitqiegħdu flimkien f'qatet jew pakketti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把多个分散物品归拢并捆扎成束或包的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li jinġabru diversi oġġetti separati u jintrabtu jew jitqiegħdu flimkien f'qatet jew pakketti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Bundling is the act of gathering separate items together into bundles.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以捆束或打包方式整理、处理物品的惯常做法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-prattika li wieħed jiġbor u jorbot oġġetti flimkien f'qatet jew pakketti bħala mod regolari ta' kif jorganizzahom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bundling practice is a regular way of organizing items by putting them together into bundles.

formal.mt: Il-proċedura tinkludi ggruppar ta' karti f'qatet żgħar biex ikun aktar faċli li jinġarru.
formal.en: The procedure includes bundling papers into small bundles to make them easier to carry.
formal.zh: 该流程包括将纸张捆成小束，以便搬运。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed tagħmel b'dawk il-karti kollha? Mark: Qed nagħmel ggruppar f'qatet żgħar, biex inġorruhom aktar faċli.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you doing with all those papers? Mark: I'm bundling them into small bundles so we can carry them more easily.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你在拿那些纸做什么？马克：我在把它们捆成小束，这样我们搬起来更方便。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你在拿那些纸做什么？
messages.en: What are you doing with all those papers?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel ggruppar f'qatet żgħar, biex inġorruhom aktar faċli.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel ggruppar f'qatet żgħar, biex inġorruhom aktar faċli.
messages.zh: 我在把它们捆成小束，这样我们搬起来更方便。
messages.en: I'm bundling them into small bundles so we can carry them more easily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“散物变成一捆”的动作画面：一次捆束是行为，长期这样整理则是做法，两个义项都围绕成束打包。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To obtain something beneficial, such as money, experience, or trust.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 获得金钱、经验、信任等对自己有益或有价值的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kiseb xi ħaġa ta' ġid jew ta' valur, bħal flus, esperjenza jew fiduċja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 获得、赢得或赚得有益或有价值的东西。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kiseb jew qala' xi ħaġa li tkun ta' ġid jew ta' valur għalih, bħal flus, esperjenza jew fiduċja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you gain something, you obtain something useful or valuable through your actions or circumstances.

formal.mt: Matul il-proġett, Andrea ggwadanja esperjenza siewja fil-ġestjoni ta' tim.
formal.en: During the project, Andrea gained valuable experience in managing a team.
formal.zh: 在项目期间，安德烈亚获得了宝贵的团队管理经验。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Luca ggwadanja xi flus mix-xogħol tas-sajf? Toni: Iva, biżżejjed biex jixtri rota.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Luca earn any money from his summer job? Toni: Yes, enough to buy a bicycle.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：卢卡做暑期工作赚到钱了吗？托尼：赚到了，够买一辆自行车。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Luca ggwadanja xi flus mix-xogħol tas-sajf?
messages.mt_standard: Luca ggwadanja xi flus mix-xogħol tas-sajf?
messages.zh: 卢卡做暑期工作赚到钱了吗？
messages.en: Did Luca earn any money from his summer job?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 赚到了，够买一辆自行车。
messages.en: Yes, enough to buy a bicycle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ggwadanja 想成收获袋：袋里可以装钱、经验和信任；搭配金钱译“赚得”，搭配经验或信任译“获得、赢得”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lead someone along a route or guide them through an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带领某人沿路线前进，或引导某人完成一项活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mexxa lil xi ħadd tul triq jew urieh kif jimxi minn pass għal ieħor f'attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某人指引方向并带领其前进，或引导其进行活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mexxa lil persuna jew grupp billi wriehom it-triq jew id-direzzjoni, jew għenhom jgħaddu mill-passi ta' attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you lead someone, you show them the way or guide them through what they need to do.

collocations.en: guided the students step by step

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara, Andrea ggwida lill-viżitaturi minn sala għal oħra u spjega l-esebiti.
formal.en: During the visit, Andrea led the visitors from one room to another and explained the exhibits.
formal.zh: 参观期间，安德烈亚带领参观者逐一走过各个展厅，并讲解了展品。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif sibtu t-triq sal-bajja? Mark: Luca ggwida lilna lkoll; jaf it-triq sew.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did you find the way to the beach? Mark: Luca led us all; he knows the way well.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你们是怎么找到去海滩的路的？马克：卢卡带着我们大家走的；他很熟悉那条路。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们是怎么找到去海滩的路的？
messages.en: How did you find the way to the beach?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Luca ggwida lilna lkoll; jaf it-triq sew.
messages.mt_standard: Luca ggwida lilna lkoll; jaf it-triq sew.
messages.zh: 卢卡带着我们大家走的；他很熟悉那条路。
messages.en: Luca led us all; he knows the way well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ggwida 与“向导带队”画面绑定：既能带人沿路前进，也能像老师一样一步一步引导完成活动。

gloss_zh: 动词；所给释义为“no idea”，无法据此确定词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb whose meaning is not established by the supplied gloss 'no idea'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 标注为动词，但所给“no idea”不足以确定其实际意义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Verb li t-tifsira tiegħu mhijiex ċara mill-glossa mogħtija 'no idea'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所给文字意为“不知道”，但未能说明这个动词的词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa mogħtija tesprimi nuqqas ta' għarfien, iżda ma tagħtix tifsira ċara ta' dan il-verb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss does not establish what this verb means.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'ghagen' hija mniżżla bħala verb, iżda l-glossa 'no idea' mhijiex biżżejjed biex tispjega t-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The word 'ghagen' is listed as a verb, but the gloss 'no idea' is insufficient to explain its meaning.
formal.zh: “ghagen”被列为动词，但“no idea”这一释义不足以说明其含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser il-verb 'ghagen'? Mark: Hawn miktub biss 'no idea', allura ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti mit-tifsira.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the verb 'ghagen' mean? Mark: It only says 'no idea' here, so we cannot be sure of the meaning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：动词“ghagen”是什么意思？马克：这里只有“no idea”，所以我们还不能确定它的含义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 动词“ghagen”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the verb 'ghagen' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub biss 'no idea', allura ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti mit-tifsira.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub biss 'no idea', allura ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti mit-tifsira.
messages.zh: 这里只有“no idea”，所以我们还不能确定它的含义。
messages.en: It only says 'no idea' here, so we cannot be sure of the meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把此条做成“动词、词义待核”的学习卡；不要把 no idea 直接背成该动词的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organ in the face that allows a person or animal to see.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或动物用来观看事物、感知光线的视觉器官。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Organu fil-wiċċ li bih persuna jew annimal jista' jara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 眼睛；人或动物的视觉器官。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Organu tal-vista li jinsab fil-wiċċ u li bih naraw l-affarijiet ta' madwarna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your eye is the organ that enables you to see.

formal.mt: Fl-istampa, it-tifel għandu l-għajn il-leminija magħluqa u l-għajn ix-xellugija miftuħa.
formal.en: In the picture, the boy has his right eye closed and his left eye open.
formal.zh: 图片中，男孩闭着右眼，睁着左眼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tagħlaq għajn waħda? Mark: Iva, ħares! Għalaqt l-għajn il-leminija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you close one eye? Mark: Yes, look! I closed my right eye.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能闭上一只眼睛吗？马克：能，看！我闭上了右眼。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你能闭上一只眼睛吗？
messages.en: Can you close one eye?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 能，看！我闭上了右眼。
messages.en: Yes, look! I closed my right eye.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用动作记忆：指着一只眼睛说 għajn，再闭上一只眼睛，把词形与视觉器官联系起来。

gloss_zh: 天空阴云密布的；多云的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a sky that is covered with clouds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容天空被云层覆盖、呈现阴天或多云状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi sema mgħotti bis-sħab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容天空阴云密布或被云层遮盖的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jintuża biex jiddeskrivi sema mimli sħab jew mgħotti bis-sħab.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An overcast sky is covered with clouds.

formal.mt: Dalgħodu s-sema kien għajbur, u s-sħab għatta x-xemx għal diversi sigħat.
formal.en: This morning the sky was overcast, and clouds covered the sun for several hours.
formal.zh: 今天早晨天空阴云密布，云层遮住太阳达数小时。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif jidher is-sema llum? Mark: Jidher għajbur; ix-xemx hi wara s-sħab.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the sky look like today? Mark: It looks overcast; the sun is behind the clouds.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天天空看起来怎么样？马克：阴云密布，太阳躲在云层后面。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天天空看起来怎么样？
messages.en: What does the sky look like today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jidher għajbur; ix-xemx hi wara s-sħab.
messages.mt_standard: Jidher għajbur; ix-xemx hi wara s-sħab.
messages.zh: 阴云密布，太阳躲在云层后面。
messages.en: It looks overcast; the sun is behind the clouds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象天空盖着一层厚云，把 għajbur 与“云遮天空”的画面绑定；这个画面本身不表示正在下雨。

gloss_zh: 形容词；所给释义仅为“Ghajjurr”，词义未明。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adjective whose meaning is not explained by the supplied gloss 'Ghajjurr'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 标注为形容词，但所给“Ghajjurr”没有提供可以确定的语义解释。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aġġettiv li t-tifsira tiegħu mhijiex spjegata mill-glossa mogħtija 'Ghajjurr'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义为“Ghajjurr”，未提供可确定的中文词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa 'Ghajjurr' ma tipprovdix spjegazzjoni ċara tat-tifsira ta' dan l-aġġettiv.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss does not explain what this adjective means.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'ghajjur' hija mniżżla bħala aġġettiv, iżda l-glossa 'Ghajjurr' ma tispjegax it-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The word 'ghajjur' is listed as an adjective, but the gloss 'Ghajjurr' does not explain its meaning.
formal.zh: “ghajjur”被列为形容词，但“Ghajjurr”这一释义没有说明其含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser l-aġġettiv 'ghajjur'? Mark: Hawn hemm biss 'Ghajjurr'; minn hekk ma nistax ngħidlek it-tifsira.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the adjective 'ghajjur' mean? Mark: There is only 'Ghajjurr' here; I cannot tell you its meaning from that.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：形容词“ghajjur”是什么意思？马克：这里只有“Ghajjurr”；我无法据此告诉你它的含义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 形容词“ghajjur”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the adjective 'ghajjur' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn hemm biss 'Ghajjurr'; minn hekk ma nistax ngħidlek it-tifsira.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn hemm biss 'Ghajjurr'; minn hekk ma nistax ngħidlek it-tifsira.
messages.zh: 这里只有“Ghajjurr”；我无法据此告诉你它的含义。
messages.en: There is only 'Ghajjurr' here; I cannot tell you its meaning from that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把此条标为“形容词、释义待核”；相近拼写不能代替词义说明，先记词性，再补可靠含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plum is a fruit with smooth skin, juicy flesh, and a hard stone in the centre.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 李子，一种果皮光滑、果肉多汁、中央有硬核的水果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frott b'qoxra lixxa, laħam imlaħħam u mmerraq, u għadma iebsa fin-nofs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 李子，一种中央有硬核的多汁水果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Frott b'qoxra lixxa u laħam immerraq li għandu għadma iebsa fin-nofs.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A plum is a juicy fruit with smooth skin and a hard stone inside.

formal.mt: Għall-preparazzjoni tal-ġamm, agħżlu għajnbaqar misjur u aħsluh sew qabel l-użu.
formal.en: To prepare the jam, select ripe plums and wash them thoroughly before use.
formal.zh: 制作果酱时，请挑选成熟的李子，并在使用前充分洗净。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid ftit għajnbaqar? Pawlu: Iva, grazzi. Misjur? Lara: Iva, ħelu ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like some plums? Pawlu: Yes, thanks. Are they ripe? Lara: Yes, they are very sweet.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你想吃点李子吗？保罗：想，谢谢。熟了吗？拉拉：熟了，很甜。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想吃点李子吗？
messages.en: Would you like some plums?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，谢谢。熟了吗？
messages.en: Yes, thanks. Are they ripe?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 熟了，很甜。
messages.en: Yes, they are very sweet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għajnbaqar 和一篮熟李子的画面配对，再连记 ġamm tal-għajnbaqar「李子果酱」，用水果与成品两个场景巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Trouble or worry that makes someone feel uneasy or concerned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人感到不安、忧虑的烦恼或麻烦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inkwiet jew taħbit li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu mħasseb jew mhux fil-kwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烦恼；忧虑；令人不安的麻烦。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat ta' tħassib jew sitwazzjoni ta' taħbit li tfixkel il-kwiet ta' persuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Trouble is a difficult or worrying situation that disturbs someone's peace of mind.

formal.mt: Komunikazzjoni ċara bejn il-parteċipanti tista' tevita għakkux bla bżonn waqt it-tħejjijiet.
formal.en: Clear communication between participants can prevent unnecessary trouble during the preparations.
formal.zh: 参与者之间清楚的沟通可以避免筹备过程中出现不必要的麻烦。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Din il-bidla ġabet magħha ħafna għakkux. Toni: X'ġara? Marta: Issa rridu nerġgħu norganizzaw kollox.
colloquial.en: Marta: This change has caused a lot of trouble. Toni: What happened? Marta: Now we have to organise everything again.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这次变动带来了好多麻烦。托尼：怎么了？玛尔塔：现在我们得把一切重新安排。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-bidla ġabet magħha ħafna għakkux.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-bidla ġabet magħha ħafna għakkux.
messages.zh: 这次变动带来了好多麻烦。
messages.en: This change has caused a lot of trouble.

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 怎么了？
messages.en: What happened?

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 现在我们得把一切重新安排。
messages.en: Now we have to organise everything again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għakkux 放进「计划临时变动，事情全要重排」的场景，联想到烦恼和麻烦；再用 bla bżonn「不必要的」帮助记住常见搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to introduce a result or conclusion that follows from what has just been stated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因此；所以，用于引出由前述事实或理由得出的结果或结论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża biex tintroduċi riżultat jew konklużjoni li toħroġ minn dak li jkun intqal qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因此；所以，表示后面的结果或结论由前面的情况推得。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintuża biex turi li dak li jiġi wara huwa riżultat jew konklużjoni ta' dak li jkun intqal qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use therefore to introduce a result or conclusion that follows from an earlier statement.

formal.mt: In-numru ta' applikazzjonijiet żdied; għaldaqstant huwa meħtieġ li jiġi estiż il-ħin tas-servizz.
formal.en: The number of applications has increased; therefore, service hours need to be extended.
formal.zh: 申请数量有所增加，因此有必要延长服务时间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-ħanut jagħlaq fil-ħamsa. Mark: Għaldaqstant irridu nitilqu issa. Sara: Tajjeb, nieħu ċ-ċwievet u niġi.
colloquial.en: Sara: The shop closes at five. Mark: Therefore, we need to leave now. Sara: All right, I'll get the keys and come.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：商店五点关门。马克：所以我们现在就得走。萨拉：好，我拿上钥匙就来。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 商店五点关门。
messages.en: The shop closes at five.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 所以我们现在就得走。
messages.en: Therefore, we need to leave now.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我拿上钥匙就来。
messages.en: All right, I'll get the keys and come.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸上画「事实 → 结论」，把 għaldaqstant 写在箭头上，记成连接前因与后果的「因此」，再用「快关门了，因此现在走」练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To defeat an opponent in a game, competition, or contest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在比赛、竞赛或较量中击败对手，取得胜利。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tirbaħ kontra avversarju f'logħba, kompetizzjoni jew taqtigħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 击败；战胜，在比赛或较量中胜过对手。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tikseb rebħa kontra persuna jew tim ieħor f'logħba jew kompetizzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you beat an opponent, you defeat them in a game, competition, or contest.

formal.mt: Fit-tieni partita tat-turnew, it-tim tal-iskola għaleb lit-tim l-ieħor bi tliet gowls għal wieħed.
formal.en: In the second match of the tournament, the school team beat the other team by three goals to one.
formal.zh: 在锦标赛的第二场比赛中，校队以三比一战胜了另一支队伍。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min rebaħ il-logħba lbieraħ? Luqa: It-tim tagħna għaleb lit-tim l-ieħor. Nina: Kemm spiċċat? Luqa: Tnejn b'xejn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who won the match yesterday? Luqa: Our team beat the other team. Nina: What was the score? Luqa: Two-nil.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：昨天的比赛谁赢了？卢卡：我们队战胜了另一支队伍。妮娜：比分是多少？卢卡：二比零。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天的比赛谁赢了？
messages.en: Who won the match yesterday?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们队战胜了另一支队伍。
messages.en: Our team beat the other team.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 比分是多少？
messages.en: What was the score?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 二比零。
messages.en: Two-nil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għaleb 和赛后比分牌连在一起：我们队二比零赢了，就是「战胜对手」。将动作、对手和获胜结果一起记忆，巩固这里的 beat 义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to introduce a result or conclusion that follows from something already stated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于引出由前述情况产生的结果或得出的结论，表示“因此、所以”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża biex tintroduċi riżultat jew konklużjoni li toħroġ minn dak li jkun intqal qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因此；所以，表示后面的结果或结论由前面的情况引出。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għalhekk tintuża biex turi li dak li jingħad wara huwa riżultat jew konklużjoni ta' dak li ntqal qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use therefore to introduce a result or conclusion that follows from something you have already mentioned.

formal.mt: It-triq prinċipali se tkun magħluqa għat-tiswijiet; għalhekk, is-sewwieqa għandhom jużaw rotta oħra.
formal.en: The main road will be closed for repairs; therefore, drivers should use another route.
formal.zh: 主路将因维修而封闭；因此，驾驶员应改走其他路线。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tagħmel ħafna xita. Mark: Iva, għalhekk se nibqa' d-dar illum.
colloquial.en: Maja: It's raining heavily. Mark: Yes, so I'm staying home today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：雨下得很大。马克：是啊，所以我今天要待在家里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 雨下得很大。
messages.en: It's raining heavily.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għalhekk se nibqa' d-dar illum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għalhekk se nibqa' d-dar illum.
messages.zh: 是啊，所以我今天要待在家里。
messages.en: Yes, so I'm staying home today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għalhekk 放在“下大雨→留在家”这类因果箭头上：前面交代原因，后面接“因此”的结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to ask about the reason for something or to introduce an indirect question about a reason.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于询问某事的原因，或引出关于原因的间接疑问，表示“为什么”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża biex tistaqsi dwar ir-raġuni għal xi ħaġa jew biex tintroduċi mistoqsija indiretta dwar ir-raġuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为什么；为何，用于询问原因，也可用于间接疑问。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għaliex tintuża meta wieħed jistaqsi x'inhi r-raġuni għal xi ħaġa, kemm f'mistoqsija diretta kif ukoll f'mistoqsija indiretta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use why when you ask about the reason for something or refer to a question about its reason.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega għaliex il-laqgħa ġiet posposta għall-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
formal.en: The report explains why the meeting was postponed until next week.
formal.zh: 报告解释了会议为何被推迟到下周。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex wasalt tard? Pawlu: Għax tlift il-karozza tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you arrive late? Pawlu: Because I missed the bus.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么迟到了？保罗：因为我没赶上公交车。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么迟到了？
messages.en: Why did you arrive late?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 因为我没赶上公交车。
messages.en: Because I missed the bus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għaliex 记成追问原因的问号：看到“迟到”就问“为什么”；对比 għalhekk，它追问原因，后者引出结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose job is to help students learn a subject or develop a skill.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以教授知识或技能、帮助学生学习为职业的人，指教师或老师。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tgħallem suġġett jew ħila u tgħin lill-istudenti jitgħallmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 教师；老师，指以教授知识或技能为职业的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għalliem huwa persuna li tgħallem lill-istudenti u tgħinhom jifhmu suġġett jew jitgħallmu ħila.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A teacher is someone whose job is to help students understand a subject or learn a skill.

formal.mt: L-għalliem tal-matematika jispjega kull pass u jagħti lill-istudenti ħin biex jistaqsu.
formal.en: The mathematics teacher explains each step and gives the students time to ask questions.
formal.zh: 数学老师讲解每个步骤，并给学生留出提问的时间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu l-għalliem il-ġdid? Ben: Is-Sur Borg. Jgħallem il-Malti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is the new teacher? Ben: Mr Borg. He teaches Maltese.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：新老师是谁？本：博格先生。他教马耳他语。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 新老师是谁？
messages.en: Who is the new teacher?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 博格先生。他教马耳他语。
messages.en: Mr Borg. He teaches Maltese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用课堂画面记 għalliem：想象老师站在黑板前讲题，再把“数学老师”和“马耳他语老师”两个搭配一起朗读。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area of land used for growing crops or keeping farm animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于种植农作物或饲养牲畜的一块土地，指田地或农田。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa art li tintuża biex jitkabbru l-uċuħ tar-raba' jew biex jinżammu annimali tar-razzett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 田地；农田，指用于农业种植或饲养牲畜的一块土地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għalqa hija biċċa art fejn jitkabbru l-uċuħ tar-raba' jew fejn jinżammu annimali tar-razzett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A field is an area of land used for growing crops or keeping farm animals.

formal.mt: Il-bidwi jkabbar il-patata f'għalqa qrib ir-raħal u jsaqqiha regolarment.
formal.en: The farmer grows potatoes in a field near the village and waters it regularly.
formal.zh: 农民在村庄附近的一块田里种植马铃薯，并定期给田地浇水。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hu n-nannu? Toni: Qiegħed fl-għalqa, jiġbor il-patata.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is Grandpa? Toni: He's in the field, harvesting potatoes.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：爷爷在哪里？托尼：他在田里收马铃薯。

messages.speaker: Nina (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Grandpa?

messages.speaker: Toni (孙子)
messages.zh: 他在田里收马铃薯。
messages.en: He's in the field, harvesting potatoes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għalqa 配上一幅马铃薯田的画：有人种植、浇水、收获；用这些具体农活帮助记住“田地”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Movable objects such as tables, chairs, and beds used to equip a home or another space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于布置住宅或其他空间的桌子、椅子、床等可移动物品的统称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġetti bħal imwejjed, siġġijiet u sodod li jintużaw biex jarmaw dar jew spazju ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 家具，指桌、椅、床等用于布置生活或工作空间的物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-oġġetti li bihom tiġi mgħammra kamra jew dar, bħal imwejjed, siġġijiet, sodod u armarji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Furniture consists of objects such as tables, chairs, and beds that you use in a home or another space.

formal.mt: L-għamara l-ġdida tal-librerija tinkludi imwejjed għall-qari u siġġijiet komdi.
formal.en: The library's new furniture includes reading tables and comfortable chairs.
formal.zh: 图书馆的新家具包括阅览桌和舒适的椅子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għażilt l-għamara għall-kamra l-ġdida? Mark: Iva, għażilt mejda u żewġ siġġijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you chosen the furniture for the new room? Mark: Yes, I chose a table and two chairs.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你选好新房间的家具了吗？马克：选好了，我选了一张桌子和两把椅子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你选好新房间的家具了吗？
messages.en: Have you chosen the furniture for the new room?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għażilt mejda u żewġ siġġijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għażilt mejda u żewġ siġġijiet.
messages.zh: 选好了，我选了一张桌子和两把椅子。
messages.en: Yes, I chose a table and two chairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għamara 与一间摆好桌椅和床的房间画面绑定，整组记成“家具”，再用“新家具”和“木制家具”巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A word whose intended meaning has not been specified in this entry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本词条尚未明确具体含义的词，暂不指定其中文对应义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li t-tifsira maħsuba tagħha għadha mhix speċifikata f'din l-entrata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义未明确，暂无法确定对应的中文释义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' din il-kelma għadha mhix ċara f'din l-entrata u trid tiġi ċċarata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The intended meaning of this word remains unspecified and requires clarification before it can be taught.

formal.mt: It-tifsira tal-kelma 'Ghamla' trid tiġi ċċarata qabel ma titħejja lezzjoni dwarha.
formal.en: The meaning of the word 'Ghamla' needs to be clarified before a lesson about it is prepared.
formal.zh: 在编写有关“Ghamla”的课程之前，需要先明确这个词的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'Ghamla' hawn? Mark: Għadni ma nafx; irridu niċċaraw it-tifsira tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'Ghamla' mean here? Mark: I don't know yet; we need to clarify its meaning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“Ghamla”这个词在这里是什么意思？马克：我还不知道；我们需要弄清楚它的含义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: “Ghamla”这个词在这里是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'Ghamla' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma nafx; irridu niċċaraw it-tifsira tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma nafx; irridu niċċaraw it-tifsira tagħha.
messages.zh: 我还不知道；我们需要弄清楚它的含义。
messages.en: I don't know yet; we need to clarify its meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先给 Ghamla 配一张带问号的词卡，记住“词义待明确”；这里的例句只练习询问词义，避免把未知释义记成词本身的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deep sadness felt after a serious loss or a distressing event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因重大失去或令人痛苦的事件而产生的深切悲伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Niket profond li persuna tħoss wara telf kbir jew ġrajja ta' wġigħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悲痛，尤指遭遇重大失去或不幸后强烈而深切的哀伤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sentiment qawwi ta' niket u wġigħ emozzjonali minħabba telf jew ġrajja ta' swied il-qalb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Grief is a feeling of deep sadness that you experience after a serious loss or a distressing event.

formal.mt: Il-familja esprimiet l-għamm tagħha għall-mewt ta' qarib għażiż.
formal.en: The family expressed its grief over the death of a dear relative.
formal.zh: 这家人表达了对一位挚爱亲属去世的悲痛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif qed iħossu Pawlu wara t-telf ta' ħuh? Mark: Għadu mimli għamm; illum se mmur noqgħod ftit miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is Pawlu feeling after losing his brother? Mark: He is still filled with grief; I'll go and spend some time with him today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗失去兄弟之后，心情怎么样？马克：他仍然满怀悲痛；我今天会去陪他一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif qed iħossu Pawlu wara t-telf ta' ħuh?
messages.mt_standard: Kif qed iħossu Pawlu wara t-telf ta' ħuh?
messages.zh: 保罗失去兄弟之后，心情怎么样？
messages.en: How is Pawlu feeling after losing his brother?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu mimli għamm; illum se mmur noqgħod ftit miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu mimli għamm; illum se mmur noqgħod ftit miegħu.
messages.zh: 他仍然满怀悲痛；我今天会去陪他一会儿。
messages.en: He is still filled with grief; I'll go and spend some time with him today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għamm 放进“满怀悲痛”的场景来记：朋友失去亲人，你安静陪伴；再连读 mimli għamm，建立情境联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used when saying that the person being addressed has or possesses something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向一个人表示“你有某物”的表达，也可在问句中询问对方是否有某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex tgħid li l-persuna li qed tkellem għandha xi ħaġa, jew biex tistaqsi jekk għandhiex.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你有，表示所说话的对象拥有某物或具备某种条件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni indirizzata lil persuna waħda biex tindika li għandha xi ħaġa jew biex tistaqsi jekk għandhiex.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression when telling someone that they have something or asking whether they have it.

formal.mt: Jekk għandek bżonn aktar informazzjoni dwar il-kors, ikkuntattja lill-uffiċċju.
formal.en: If you need more information about the course, contact the office.
formal.zh: 如果你需要更多有关课程的信息，请联系办公室。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek pinna żejda? Mark: Iva, għandi waħda fil-basket. Ħudha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a spare pen? Mark: Yes, I have one in my bag. Take it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有多余的笔吗？马克：有，我包里有一支。拿去用吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你有多余的笔吗？
messages.en: Do you have a spare pen?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 有，我包里有一支。拿去用吧。
messages.en: Yes, I have one in my bag. Take it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象向同学借笔时问 Għandek pinna?，把 għandek 整体记成“你有”；另把 għandek bżonn 整组记成“你需要”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to say that I possess something or have something available.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示说话者本人拥有某物，或手头有某物可供使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex ngħid li xi ħaġa hija tiegħi jew li qiegħda għad-dispożizzjoni tiegħi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我有；表示我拥有某物或有某物可用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li biha l-kelliem jgħid li għandu xi ħaġa tiegħu jew xi ħaġa għad-dispożizzjoni tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to say that you possess something or have it available.

formal.mt: Għandi kopja tad-dokument u nista' nibgħatha llum.
formal.en: I have a copy of the document and can send it today.
formal.zh: 我有该文件的副本，今天可以发送。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek pinna? Mark: Iva, għandi pinna żejda. Tista' tużaha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a pen? Mark: Yes, I have a spare pen. You can use it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有笔吗？马克：有，我有一支备用笔。你可以用。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你有笔吗？
messages.en: Do you have a pen?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi pinna żejda. Tista' tużaha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi pinna żejda. Tista' tużaha.
messages.zh: 有，我有一支备用笔。你可以用。
messages.en: Yes, I have a spare pen. You can use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għandi 和“我有”一起记：想象自己举起一本书，说 Għandi ktieb，把说话者本人和拥有关系连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to say that he, or a grammatically masculine subject, possesses something or has it available.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“他”或语法上为阳性的主语拥有某物，或有某物可供使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex turi li raġel, tifel jew suġġett grammatikalment maskili għandu xi ħaġa tiegħu jew għad-dispożizzjoni tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他有；表示某位男性拥有某物或有某物可用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li turi li raġel jew tifel għandu xi ħaġa tiegħu jew xi ħaġa għad-dispożizzjoni tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to say that a male person possesses something or has it available.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有；拥有；此形式用于第三人称单数阳性主语。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika pussess jew disponibbiltà ta' xi ħaġa, b'suġġett fit-tielet persuna singular maskil.
sense_translations.en_explanation: To have something means to possess it or have access to it for use.

formal.mt: L-istudent għandu kopja tal-iskeda u jaf meta jibda l-eżami.
formal.en: The student has a copy of the timetable and knows when the examination begins.
formal.zh: 这名学生有一份时间表，知道考试何时开始。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min għandu ċ-ċavetta? Pawlu: Mark għandu ċ-ċavetta. Qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who has the key? Pawlu: Mark has the key. He is by the door.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁有钥匙？保罗：马克有钥匙。他就在门边。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 谁有钥匙？
messages.en: Who has the key?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark għandu ċ-ċavetta. Qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Mark għandu ċ-ċavetta. Qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 马克有钥匙。他就在门边。
messages.en: Mark has the key. He is by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用人物对照记忆：指着自己说 għandi，指着马克说 għandu；把“我有”和“他有”配成一组练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the lowest quality or being the most unpleasant among the things being compared.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在所比较的事物中质量最差、情况最坏或最令人不快的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-inqas kwalità jew li hu l-aktar ħażin jew spjaċevoli fost l-affarijiet li qed jitqabblu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最坏的；最差的；在比较范围内程度最不好的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li hu l-aktar ħażin jew li għandu l-inqas kwalità fost dawk kollha li qed jitqabblu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is the worst has the lowest quality or is the most unpleasant within a particular group.

formal.mt: Dan huwa l-agħar riżultat fost it-tliet provi, għalhekk il-metodu jeħtieġ reviżjoni.
formal.en: This is the worst result of the three trials, so the method needs revision.
formal.zh: 这是三次试验中最差的结果，因此需要修订该方法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien il-vjaġġ? Mark: Kien l-agħar vjaġġ ta' ħajti. Ix-xarabank waqfet tliet darbiet!
colloquial.en: Maja: How was the journey? Mark: It was the worst journey of my life. The bus stopped three times!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：旅途怎么样？马克：那是我这辈子最糟糕的一次旅程。公交车中途停了三次！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 旅途怎么样？
messages.en: How was the journey?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien l-agħar vjaġġ ta' ħajti. Ix-xarabank waqfet tliet darbiet!
messages.mt_standard: Kien l-agħar vjaġġ ta' ħajti. Ix-xarabank waqfet tliet darbiet!
messages.zh: 那是我这辈子最糟糕的一次旅程。公交车中途停了三次！
messages.en: It was the worst journey of my life. The bus stopped three times!

cognitive_memory_aid: 表达本条的“最差”义时，把例句里的 l-agħar 整体记住：想象三份成绩单中最低的一份，说 l-agħar riżultat。

gloss_zh: 意识到；认识的形成（按所给名词标签理解）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of becoming aware of something that was previously unnoticed or not understood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对先前未注意到或未理解的事物开始有所认识的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih persuna ssir konxja ta' xi ħaġa li qabel ma kinitx innutat jew fehmet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始意识到某事；按所给名词词性理解为这种认识的形成过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fatt li persuna tibda tinnota jew tifhem xi ħaġa li qabel ma kinitx konxja tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Becoming aware involves beginning to notice or understand something that you did not previously recognize.

formal.mt: L-għarfien tal-problema huwa l-ewwel pass biex tinstab soluzzjoni.
formal.en: Awareness of the problem is the first step towards finding a solution.
formal.zh: 认识到问题是找到解决办法的第一步。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-laqgħa għenitek tifhem il-problema? Pawlu: Iva, issa għandi għarfien aħjar tagħha u naf għaliex irridu naġixxu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did the meeting help you understand the problem? Pawlu: Yes, I now have a better understanding of it and know why we need to act.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这次会议帮助你理解问题了吗？保罗：是的，我现在对它有了更好的认识，也知道我们为什么需要采取行动。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 这次会议帮助你理解问题了吗？
messages.en: Did the meeting help you understand the problem?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa għandi għarfien aħjar tagħha u naf għaliex irridu naġixxu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa għandi għarfien aħjar tagħha u naf għaliex irridu naġixxu.
messages.zh: 是的，我现在对它有了更好的认识，也知道我们为什么需要采取行动。
messages.en: Yes, I now have a better understanding of it and know why we need to act.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按给定名词标签，把本条概念记成“从没注意到，到心里明白”。搭配和例句用名词 għarfien 表达“认识”，不要把它与词头当作同一拼写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To touch someone lightly in a way that causes a tickling feeling and may make them laugh.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 轻轻触碰某人的身体，使其产生痒感，常使对方发笑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tmiss lil xi ħadd ħafif b'mod li jħoss it-tingiż u jista' jibda jidħaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挠某人的痒处，使其觉得痒或发笑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tmiss ħafif il-ġisem ta' persuna biex tħossha titniegħex jew tibda tidħaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you tickle someone, you touch their body lightly in a way that can make them laugh.

formal.mt: Waqt il-logħob, it-tifel għargħax lil ħuh u t-tnejn bdew jidħqu.
formal.en: While they were playing, the boy tickled his brother, and both began to laugh.
formal.zh: 玩耍时，男孩挠了他兄弟的痒痒，两人都笑了起来。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min għargħax lil Pawlu? Luqa: Jien! Ara kemm qed jidħaq.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who tickled Pawlu? Luqa: I did! Look how much he's laughing.
colloquial.zh: Marija：谁挠了Pawlu的痒痒？Luqa：是我！看他笑得多开心。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 谁挠了Pawlu的痒痒？
messages.en: Who tickled Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Luqa (儿子)
messages.zh: 是我！看他笑得多开心。
messages.en: I did! Look how much he's laughing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“手指轻碰、身体发痒、忍不住笑”的连续画面一起记忆；用兄弟间挠痒痒的场景帮助回想词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To press something firmly, especially to force liquid out of it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用力挤压某物，尤其指通过挤压使其中的液体流出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħfas xi ħaġa bis-saħħa, speċjalment biex toħroġ il-likwidu minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挤压某物；通过施压榨出或挤出其中的液体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħfas oġġett bejn idejk jew b'għodda, ħafna drabi biex toħroġ il-likwidu li jkun fih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you squeeze something, you press it firmly, often to force liquid out of it.

formal.mt: Il-kok għasar il-lumi u żied il-meraq maz-zalza.
formal.en: The cook squeezed the lemon and added the juice to the sauce.
formal.zh: 厨师榨了柠檬，并把柠檬汁加入酱汁中。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min għasar il-lumi? Mark: Jien. Trid ftit meraq fl-ilma tiegħek?
colloquial.en: Anna: Who squeezed the lemon? Mark: I did. Would you like some juice in your water?
colloquial.zh: Anna：谁榨了柠檬？Mark：我榨的。你的水里要加一点柠檬汁吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁榨了柠檬？
messages.en: Who squeezed the lemon?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Trid ftit meraq fl-ilma tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Trid ftit meraq fl-ilma tiegħek?
messages.zh: 我榨的。你的水里要加一点柠檬汁吗？
messages.en: I did. Would you like some juice in your water?

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“一只手挤柠檬，汁水流进杯子”的画面，再换成挤海绵：两种动作都有用力挤压这一共同点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An animal with feathers, wings, and a beak, belonging to a group whose members usually fly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有羽毛、翅膀和喙的动物，所属类群中的大多数成员能够飞行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal bir-rix, bil-ġwienaħ u bil-munqar, minn grupp ta' annimali li ħafna minnhom jistgħu jtiru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸟；具有羽毛、翅膀和喙的动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal li għandu r-rix, żewġ ġwienaħ u munqar, u li ġeneralment jista' jtir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bird is an animal with feathers, wings, and a beak, and most birds can fly.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸟；鸟类动物，通常能够飞行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal bir-rix u bil-munqar li għandu żewġ ġwienaħ u ġeneralment jużahom biex itir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bird is a feathered animal that has wings and a beak and usually moves through the air by flying.

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, l-istudenti raw għasfur żgħir fuq fergħa.
formal.en: During their observation in the garden, the students saw a small bird on a branch.
formal.zh: 在花园进行观察时，学生们看到树枝上有一只小鸟。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa! Ben: Rajtu! Kemm hu żgħir.
colloquial.en: Sara: Look at that bird on the branch! Ben: I see it! It's so small.
colloquial.zh: Sara：看树枝上的那只鸟！Ben：看到了！它真小。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看树枝上的那只鸟！
messages.en: Look at that bird on the branch!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了！它真小。
messages.en: I see it! It's so small.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把għasfur写在一张画有羽毛、翅膀和鸟喙的小鸟卡片上；看到词就回想“树枝上站着一只鸟”的完整画面。

gloss_zh: 词包标注为动词，具体词义未提供

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb listed as 'ghawwi', for which the supplied packet does not specify a meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给词包中列作动词的词形“ghawwi”；词包未提供可确定其具体含义的释义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Verb mogħti bħala 'ghawwi', li t-tifsira tiegħu mhix speċifikata fil-pakkett ipprovdut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原始释义仅重复词形“ghawwi”，未说明该动词的具体含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-definizzjoni mogħtija tirrepeti biss il-forma 'ghawwi' u ma tispjegax it-tifsira ta' dan il-verb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The packet identifies 'ghawwi' as a verb but does not provide enough information to establish its meaning.

formal.mt: Il-pakkett jelenka 'ghawwi' bħala verb, iżda ma jagħtix definizzjoni li tispjega t-tifsira tiegħu.
formal.en: The packet lists 'ghawwi' as a verb but does not give a definition explaining its meaning.
formal.zh: 词包将“ghawwi”列为动词，但没有提供解释其含义的定义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'ghawwi' hawn? Pawlu: Il-pakkett jgħid biss li hu verb. Ma jispjegax it-tifsira tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ghawwi' mean here? Pawlu: The packet only says it's a verb. It doesn't explain its meaning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的“ghawwi”是什么意思？Pawlu：词包只说它是动词，没有解释它的含义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的“ghawwi”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ghawwi' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-pakkett jgħid biss li hu verb. Ma jispjegax it-tifsira tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-pakkett jgħid biss li hu verb. Ma jispjegax it-tifsira tiegħu.
messages.zh: 词包只说它是动词，没有解释它的含义。
messages.en: The packet only says it's a verb. It doesn't explain its meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ghawwi暂记在“动词，词义待补”的卡片上，先认清拼写；不要借相似词形猜义，待获得明确释义后再建立动作联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: She selected one person, thing, or option from several possibilities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 她从若干人、事物或选项中作出了选择，表示已经发生的选择行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Hija ddeċidiet li tieħu persuna, ħaġa jew għażla minn fost diversi possibbiltajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 选择了；此处的马耳他语形式 għażlet 表示“她选择了”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Hija ddeċidiet li tieħu jew tippreferi ħaġa jew persuna minn fost oħrajn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If she chose something, she selected it from the possibilities available to her.

formal.mt: Il-koordinatriċi għażlet tliet proposti għall-fażi li jmiss tal-proġett.
formal.en: The coordinator chose three proposals for the next phase of the project.
formal.zh: 协调员为项目的下一阶段选出了三份提案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema ktieb għażlet Sara? Mark: Għażlet dak dwar il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which book did Sara choose? Mark: She chose the one about the sea.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：萨拉选了哪本书？马克：她选了那本关于大海的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 萨拉选了哪本书？
messages.en: Which book did Sara choose?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 她选了那本关于大海的。
messages.en: She chose the one about the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象萨拉从一排书中抽出一本，把 għażlet 与“她已经选好了”的画面一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is unwilling to work or make an effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不愿工作或付出努力的人；这里按名词义学习“懒人”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ma tkunx trid taħdem jew tagħmel sforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 懒人；指不愿劳动或不愿费力的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bniedem li jevita x-xogħol jew l-isforz u jippreferi jibqa' ma jagħmel xejn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lazy person avoids work or effort even when there is something that needs doing.

collocations.en: a lazy person who does not want to work
the lazy character in the story

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, l-għażżien iħalli x-xogħol kollu f'idejn ħaddieħor u ma jgħin lil ħadd.
formal.en: In the story, the lazy character leaves all the work to others and helps nobody.
formal.zh: 故事里的懒人把所有工作都留给别人，谁也不帮。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu l-għażżien f'din l-istorja? Pawlu: Dak li jorqod waqt li l-oħrajn jaħdmu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is the lazy character in this story? Paul: The one who sleeps while the others work.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个故事里谁是那个懒人？保罗：就是别人在工作时却睡觉的那个人。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这个故事里谁是那个懒人？
messages.en: Who is the lazy character in this story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak li jorqod waqt li l-oħrajn jaħdmu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak li jorqod waqt li l-oħrajn jaħdmu.
messages.zh: 就是别人在工作时却睡觉的那个人。
messages.en: The one who sleeps while the others work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għażżien 记成故事里“大家干活，他却睡觉”的那个人，抓住名词“懒人”的人物画面。

gloss_zh: 他说（所给义项；资料标注为名词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The supplied meaning is 'he said', an expression attributing words to a male speaker; the packet labels the entry as a noun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给含义为“他说”，用于把话语归属于一名男性说话人；保留资料中的名词标签，但该标签与英语释义的语法形式不一致。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tifsira mogħtija hija 'hu qal', espressjoni li tattribwixxi kliem lil kelliem maskili; il-pakkett jimmarka l-entrata bħala nom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他说；表示某名男性说过随后引述或转述的话。资料将此义项标注为名词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-espressjoni 'hu qal' tindika li kelliem maskili qal il-kliem li jkun qed jiġi kkwotat jew irrappurtat; l-entrata hija mmarkata bħala nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use 'he said' when reporting words spoken by a male person.

collocations.zh: 他说……（所给含义的表达搭配）
正如他所说（所给含义的表达搭配）

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-laqgħa hemm miktub: 'Hu qal li d-diskussjoni kellha tkompli l-għada.'
formal.en: The meeting report states: 'He said that the discussion should continue the following day.'
formal.zh: 会议报告写道：“他说，讨论应于次日继续。”

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'qal Mark dwar il-laqgħa? Toni: Hu qal li se jasal fit-tlieta.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did Mark say about the meeting? Tony: He said he would arrive at three.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克关于会议说了什么？托尼：他说他会三点到。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 马克关于会议说了什么？
messages.en: What did Mark say about the meeting?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu qal li se jasal fit-tlieta.
messages.mt_standard: Hu qal li se jasal fit-tlieta.
messages.zh: 他说他会三点到。
messages.en: He said he would arrive at three.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“马克说了什么？——他说三点到”的转述场景记住所给含义；例句展示 hu qal，不据此把 ghefiered 当作已核实的规范形式。

gloss_zh: 有智慧的；明智的（所给义项；资料标注为动词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The supplied meaning 'wise' concerns having or showing good judgment; the packet labels the entry as a verb.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给含义指具有智慧或表现出良好判断力；保留资料中的动词标签，但英语释义 Wise 表达的是形容词意义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tifsira mogħtija tirreferi għal min għandu għaqal jew juri ġudizzju tajjeb; il-pakkett jimmarka l-entrata bħala verb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有智慧的；明智的；能够凭借理解和判断作出妥善选择的。资料将此义项标注为动词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li għandha għaqal u ġudizzju tajjeb, jew deċiżjoni li turi dawn il-kwalitajiet; l-entrata hija mmarkata bħala verb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is wise uses understanding and good judgment to make sensible decisions.

collocations.zh: 明智的建议（所给含义的表达搭配）
明智的决定（所给含义的表达搭配）

formal.mt: Id-deċiżjoni li jiġu eżaminati l-fatti kollha qabel il-vot kienet għaqlija.
formal.en: The decision to examine all the facts before the vote was wise.
formal.zh: 在投票前审查所有事实，这一决定是明智的。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se naħseb ftit qabel inwieġeb. Ben: Dik deċiżjoni għaqlija; ħu l-ħin tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Sara: I'll think for a while before I answer. Ben: That's a wise decision; take your time.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我先想一想再回答。本：这个决定很明智，慢慢想。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我先想一想再回答。
