messages.en: I'll think for a while before I answer.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik deċiżjoni għaqlija; ħu l-ħin tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Dik deċiżjoni għaqlija; ħu l-ħin tiegħek.
messages.zh: 这个决定很明智，慢慢想。
messages.en: That's a wise decision; take your time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“先想清楚，再作决定”的画面记住 Wise 的明智含义；例句展示这一含义，不从 gheref 的给定标签推造动词变位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression inviting someone to come and live in a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 邀请某人来到某个地方居住的表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tistieden lil xi ħadd jiġi jgħix f'post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 来居住；邀请对方来到某处生活。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni ta' stedina biex persuna tiġi tgħix f'post.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to invite someone to come and make their home in a place.

collocations.en: an invitation using the phrase 'ghij joquot'
collocations.zh: 使用“ghij joquot”发出的居住邀请

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-frażi 'ghij joquot' tesprimi stedina biex persuna tiġi tgħix f'post.
formal.en: In this exercise, the phrase 'ghij joquot' expresses an invitation for someone to come and live in a place.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，“ghij joquot”表达邀请某人来到某处居住的意思。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'ghij joquot' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Toni: Tfisser stedina biex xi ħadd jiġi jgħix f'post. Maja: Allura nimmaġina ħabib jistidinni ngħix ħdejh.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ghij joquot' mean in this exercise? Toni: It means an invitation for someone to come and live in a place. Maja: Then I'll picture a friend inviting me to live near him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这道练习里的“ghij joquot”是什么意思？托尼：它表达邀请某人来到某处居住的意思。玛雅：那我就想象一位朋友邀请我搬到他附近住。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这道练习里的“ghij joquot”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ghij joquot' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser stedina biex xi ħadd jiġi jgħix f'post.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser stedina biex xi ħadd jiġi jgħix f'post.
messages.zh: 它表达邀请某人来到某处居住的意思。
messages.en: It means an invitation for someone to come and live in a place.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Allura nimmaġina ħabib jistidinni ngħix ħdejh.
messages.mt_standard: Allura nimmaġina ħabib jistidinni ngħix ħdejh.
messages.zh: 那我就想象一位朋友邀请我搬到他附近住。
messages.en: Then I'll picture a friend inviting me to live near him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“ghij joquot”与朋友递来家门钥匙的画面配对，记住邀请中的“来这里生活”，同时保留“来”和“居住”两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A liking for someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某事物的喜欢之情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sentiment li jkollha persuna meta xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa jogħġbuha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喜欢；对某人或某事物抱有好感。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sentiment ta' pjaċir jew ġibda lejn persuna jew ħaġa li togħġob lil xi ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A liking is a feeling that you enjoy someone or something and find them pleasing.

collocations.en: 'Ghogob' as a word expressing a preference

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-kelma 'Ghogob' tirrappreżenta sentiment ta' pjaċir lejn persuna jew ħaġa.
formal.en: In this exercise, the word 'Ghogob' represents a feeling of liking toward a person or thing.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，“Ghogob”表示对某人或某事物的喜欢之情。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Kif nista' niftakar it-tifsira ta' 'Ghogob'? Mark: Aħseb f'xi ħaġa li togħġbok, bħal kanzunetta. Lina: Mela norbotha mal-kanzunetta favorita tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Lina: How can I remember the meaning of 'Ghogob'? Mark: Think of something you like, such as a song. Lina: Then I'll connect it with my favourite song.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：我怎么记住“Ghogob”的意思？马克：想一件你喜欢的东西，比如一首歌。莉娜：那我就把它和我最喜欢的歌联系起来。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 我怎么记住“Ghogob”的意思？
messages.en: How can I remember the meaning of 'Ghogob'?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħseb f'xi ħaġa li togħġbok, bħal kanzunetta.
messages.mt_standard: Aħseb f'xi ħaġa li togħġbok, bħal kanzunetta.
messages.zh: 想一件你喜欢的东西，比如一首歌。
messages.en: Think of something you like, such as a song.

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 那我就把它和我最喜欢的歌联系起来。
messages.en: Then I'll connect it with my favourite song.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在“Ghogob”旁边画一颗心，再写上自己喜欢的一首歌；用具体喜好帮助记住“喜欢”，不要额外添加人物或时间信息。

gloss_zh: 她喜欢了它；她觉得它不错

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression indicating that a female person liked something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示她对某个事物感到喜欢的表达，所述感受发生在过去。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li persuna femminili sabet xi ħaġa li għoġbitha fil-passat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 她喜欢了它；她当时觉得那个事物令人满意。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li turi li mara jew tifla ħadet pjaċir b'xi ħaġa jew sabitha togħġobha fil-passat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to say that a female person found something pleasing at a past time.

collocations.mt: 'Ghogoba' bħala tweġiba dwar dak li għoġobha
collocations.en: 'Ghogoba' as an answer about what she liked
collocations.zh: 作为说明她喜欢某物之回答的“Ghogoba”

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'Ghogoba' tindika li persuna femminili sabet xi ħaġa li għoġbitha; it-tifsira tirreferi għall-passat.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'Ghogoba' indicates that a female person liked something; the meaning refers to the past.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，“Ghogoba”表示她喜欢某个事物；这一含义指向过去。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'għandi niftakar dwar 'Ghogoba'? Pawlu: Ftakar li t-tifsira hi li hi għoġbitha xi ħaġa fil-passat. Sara: Se nimmaġina lil oħti wara film li għoġobha.
colloquial.en: Sara: What should I remember about 'Ghogoba'? Pawlu: Remember that it means she liked something in the past. Sara: I'll picture my sister after a film she liked.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：关于“Ghogoba”，我该记住什么？保罗：记住它表示她过去喜欢某个事物。萨拉：我会想象姐姐看完一部她喜欢的电影后的样子。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 关于“Ghogoba”，我该记住什么？
messages.en: What should I remember about 'Ghogoba'?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftakar li t-tifsira hi li hi għoġbitha xi ħaġa fil-passat.
messages.mt_standard: Ftakar li t-tifsira hi li hi għoġbitha xi ħaġa fil-passat.
messages.zh: 记住它表示她过去喜欢某个事物。
messages.en: Remember that it means she liked something in the past.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nimmaġina lil oħti wara film li għoġobha.
messages.mt_standard: Se nimmaġina lil oħti wara film li għoġobha.
messages.zh: 我会想象姐姐看完一部她喜欢的电影后的样子。
messages.en: I'll picture my sister after a film she liked.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给“Ghogoba”配上“她昨天看完电影后微笑”的画面，同时记住“她、喜欢、那个事物、过去”四项信息；这是情境联想，不是词形拆解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lift something, with the action performed by a male subject in the past.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示他在过去把某物举起或抬起。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Verb li jindika li persuna maskili refgħet xi ħaġa fil-passat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他举起了；他把某物抬了起来。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Azzjoni fil-passat li fiha persuna maskili refgħet xi ħaġa għal pożizzjoni ogħla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If he lifted something, he moved it upwards from the position where it had been.

collocations.en: 'ghola' in the sense of 'he lifted something'

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-verb 'ghola' jirrappreżenta l-azzjoni ta' persuna maskili li refgħet xi ħaġa fil-passat.
formal.en: In this exercise, the verb 'ghola' represents the past action of a male person lifting something.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，动词“ghola”表示一名男性过去举起某物的动作。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Liema stampa ngħaqqad ma' 'ghola'? Adam: Dik fejn ir-raġel refa' l-kaxxa. Nina: Tajjeb, hekk niftakar li hu għamel l-azzjoni fil-passat.
colloquial.en: Nina: Which picture should I match with 'ghola'? Adam: The one where the man lifted the box. Nina: Good, that helps me remember that he performed the action in the past.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我该把“ghola”和哪张图配对？亚当：男人举起箱子的那张。妮娜：好，这样我就能记住，是他在过去做了这个动作。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 我该把“ghola”和哪张图配对？
messages.en: Which picture should I match with 'ghola'?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.zh: 男人举起箱子的那张。
messages.en: The one where the man lifted the box.

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, hekk niftakar li hu għamel l-azzjoni fil-passat.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, hekk niftakar li hu għamel l-azzjoni fil-passat.
messages.zh: 好，这样我就能记住，是他在过去做了这个动作。
messages.en: Good, that helps me remember that he performed the action in the past.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在“ghola”旁画一名男性把箱子向上举起，再添上“昨天”的日历标记，把“他、举起、过去”连成一个完整画面来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small house or cottage used as a dwelling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人居住的小房屋或小住宅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dar żgħira li tintuża bħala abitazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供人居住的小屋或小住宅。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dar ta' daqs żgħir fejn jistgħu jgħixu n-nies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ghorfa is a small house that people can live in.

formal.mt: Il-familja kriet ghorfa fil-kampanja għal ġimgħa.
formal.en: The family rented a cottage in the countryside for a week.
formal.zh: 这家人在乡间租了一间小屋，住了一个星期。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se noqogħdu fi tmiem il-ġimgħa? Mark: Nistgħu nikru ghorfa ħdejn il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are we staying this weekend? Mark: We can rent a cottage near the sea.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们这个周末住哪里？马克：我们可以在海边租一间小屋。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se noqogħdu fi tmiem il-ġimgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se noqogħdu fi tmiem il-ġimgħa?
messages.zh: 我们这个周末住哪里？
messages.en: Where are we staying this weekend?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们可以在海边租一间小屋。
messages.en: We can rent a cottage near the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ghorfa 配上一幅小屋图：小屋顶、小窗户、一家人，用具体画面记住“小住宅”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short greeting used when acknowledging or meeting someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 见到别人或向别人示意时使用的简短招呼语，相当于“嗨”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tislima qasira li tintuża meta tiltaqa' ma' xi ħadd jew turih li ndunajt bih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 简短的招呼语，意思是“嗨”或“你好”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tislima qasira li biha ssellem lil persuna oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this entry, ghosts denotes a brief greeting used to acknowledge another person.

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, 'ghosts' hija tislima qasira li tintuża biex issellem lil xi ħadd.
formal.en: In this list, 'ghosts' is a brief greeting used to say hi to someone.
formal.zh: 在这份词表中，“ghosts”是向别人说“嗨”的简短招呼语。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'ghosts' f'din il-lista? Mark: Tfisser 'hi'; hija tislima qasira.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ghosts' mean in this list? Mark: It means 'hi'; it is a short greeting.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份词表里的“ghosts”是什么意思？马克：意思是“嗨”，是一句简短的招呼语。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这份词表里的“ghosts”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ghosts' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 意思是“嗨”，是一句简短的招呼语。
messages.en: It means 'hi'; it is a short greeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词条把 ghosts 写在挥手打招呼的图片旁，配上“嗨”，用见面场景记忆这个义项。

gloss_zh: 混蛋；王八蛋（粗俗骂人语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vulgar and offensive term used to insult a person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来辱骂某人的粗俗称呼，相当于“混蛋”或“王八蛋”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma vulgari u offensiva li tintuża biex tinsulenta persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗俗而冒犯的骂人称呼，类似“混蛋”或“王八蛋”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem offensiv u vulgari li bih persuna tinsulenta lil persuna oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person called ghoxx is being addressed with a vulgar and offensive insult.

formal.mt: L-użu ta' 'ghoxx' bħala insult mhuwiex xieraq f'ittra formali.
formal.en: Using 'ghoxx' as an insult is inappropriate in a formal letter.
formal.zh: 在正式信件中使用“ghoxx”来骂人是不恰当的。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex sejjaħli 'ghoxx'? Mark: Kien qed jinsulentak. Hija kelma vulgari ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he call me a fucker? Mark: He was insulting you. It is a very vulgar word.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他为什么骂我是混蛋？马克：他是在侮辱你。这是个很粗俗的词。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么骂我是混蛋？
messages.en: Why did he call me a fucker?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien qed jinsulentak. Hija kelma vulgari ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Kien qed jinsulentak. Hija kelma vulgari ħafna.
messages.zh: 他是在侮辱你。这是个很粗俗的词。
messages.en: He was insulting you. It is a very vulgar word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ghoxx 配上争吵气泡和“粗俗骂人语”标签，把它与辱骂某人的场景一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The hard material from trees that is used for making things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自树木的坚硬材料，可用于制作家具、箱子等物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-materjal iebes tas-siġar li jintuża biex isiru għamara u oġġetti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 树木的木质材料，尤其指用于制作物品的木材或木料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjal iebes li jinkiseb mis-siġar u li jista' jintuża għall-bini jew biex isiru diversi oġġetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ghuda is the hard material obtained from trees and used to make objects.

formal.mt: L-artiġjan uża ghuda biex jagħmel kaxxa żgħira.
formal.en: The craftsperson used wood to make a small box.
formal.zh: 工匠用木料制作了一个小盒子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek biċċa ghuda? Mark: Iva, tista' tuża din biex tagħmel xkaffa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a piece of wood? Mark: Yes, you can use this one to make a shelf.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有一块木料吗？马克：有，你可以用这一块做个搁板。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有一块木料吗？
messages.en: Do you have a piece of wood?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tista' tuża din biex tagħmel xkaffa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tista' tuża din biex tagħmel xkaffa.
messages.zh: 有，你可以用这一块做个搁板。
messages.en: Yes, you can use this one to make a shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ghuda 写在木板图片旁，想象木匠把木料做成盒子，用材料变成物品的画面记住“木材”。

gloss_zh: 马泰奥（Matteo，按所给义项指称的人名）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A personal name used here to refer to Matteo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 专有名词，在本词条所给义项中指名叫 Matteo 的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem proprju li f'din it-tifsira jirreferi għal persuna jisimha Matteo.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Matteo（马泰奥），本义项所指的人名。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem ta' persuna li f'dan il-każ hija identifikata bħala Matteo.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this entry, the name refers to a person identified as Matteo.

formal.mt: Gianluca se jippreżenta r-rapport waqt il-laqgħa ta' għada.
formal.en: Matteo will present the report during tomorrow's meeting.
formal.zh: 马泰奥将在明天的会议上介绍报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu Gianluca? Lara: Qiegħed fil-kċina jagħmel il-kafè.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Matteo? Lara: He's in the kitchen making coffee.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马泰奥在哪里？拉拉：他在厨房煮咖啡。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马泰奥在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Matteo?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他在厨房煮咖啡。
messages.en: He's in the kitchen making coffee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把本条当作人物名牌来记：本条所给指称是 Matteo，再用“他说什么、他在哪里”两类句子练习人名的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb form meaning that I brought a previously mentioned thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“我把它带来了”的动词形式，用于说明自己已经带来前文提到的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma tal-verb li tfisser li jien ġibt xi ħaġa li diġà ssemmiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我把它带来了；指说话者已经带来所谈论的东西。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li jien ġibt il-ħaġa li qed nitkellmu dwarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this form to say that you brought the thing being discussed.

formal.mt: Il-borża bid-dokumenti ġibtha fl-uffiċċju dalgħodu.
formal.en: I brought the bag containing the documents to the office this morning.
formal.zh: 我今天早上把装着文件的袋子带到了办公室。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ġibt il-borża? Mark: Iva, ġibtha miegħi. Qiegħda ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you bring the bag? Mark: Yes, I brought it with me. It's by the door.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你把袋子带来了吗？马克：带来了，我随身带来了。就在门旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你把袋子带来了吗？
messages.en: Did you bring the bag?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġibtha miegħi. Qiegħda ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġibtha miegħi. Qiegħda ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 带来了，我随身带来了。就在门旁边。
messages.en: Yes, I brought it with me. It's by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友问你袋子带来没有，你举起袋子回答 ġibtha：把“我、已经带来、它”连成一个完整画面来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A marmoset, which is a small monkey.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 狨猴，即一种体形较小的猴子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' xadina żgħira magħrufa bħala marmoset.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狨猴，一种小型猴子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal li huwa tip ta' xadina żgħira msejħa marmoset.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A marmoset is a small monkey that you may see described in books about animals.

formal.mt: Il-ktieb jinkludi stampa ta' gidmejmun u jispjega li huwa tip ta' xadina żgħira.
formal.en: The book includes a picture of a marmoset and explains that it is a type of small monkey.
formal.zh: 这本书收录了一张狨猴的图片，并解释它是一种小型猴子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dan l-annimal fl-istampa? Pawlu: Dak gidmejmun, tip ta' xadina żgħira.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's this animal in the picture? Pawlu: That's a marmoset, a type of small monkey.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：图片里的这是什么动物？保罗：那是狨猴，一种小型猴子。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 图片里的这是什么动物？
messages.en: What's this animal in the picture?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak gidmejmun, tip ta' xadina żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Dak gidmejmun, tip ta' xadina żgħira.
messages.zh: 那是狨猴，一种小型猴子。
messages.en: That's a marmoset, a type of small monkey.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张小猴图片词卡，正面写 gidmejmun，背面写“狨猴，小型猴子”，用动物形象帮助记住具体所指。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period of two weeks, equal to fourteen days.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两周的时间，即十四天。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu ta' żewġ ġimgħat, jiġifieri erbatax-il jum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 两周，即连续十四天的一段时间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tul ta' żmien magħmul minn żewġ ġimgħat, jew erbatax-il jum.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Two weeks is a period lasting fourteen days.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport għandu jitlesta fi żmien ġimagħtejn mid-data tal-laqgħa.
formal.en: The report must be completed within two weeks of the meeting date.
formal.zh: 报告必须在会议日期起的两周内完成。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm se ddum fuq btala? Mark: Se ndum ġimagħtejn. Nerġa' lura nhar it-Tnejn ta' ġimagħtejn oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: How long will you be on holiday? Mark: I'll be away for two weeks. I'll return two weeks from Monday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你要度假多久？马克：我要去两周。我会在两周后的星期一回来。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要度假多久？
messages.en: How long will you be on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se ndum ġimagħtejn. Nerġa' lura nhar it-Tnejn ta' ġimagħtejn oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Se ndum ġimagħtejn. Nerġa' lura nhar it-Tnejn ta' ġimagħtejn oħra.
messages.zh: 我要去两周。我会在两周后的星期一回来。
messages.en: I'll be away for two weeks. I'll return two weeks from Monday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历上圈出连续两排星期，把十四天整体标成 ġimagħtejn，再搭配“两周前”和“两周内”反复练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A doctor who specialises in women's reproductive health.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 专门诊治女性生殖系统相关健康问题的医生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tabib li jispeċjalizza fis-saħħa tas-sistema riproduttiva tal-mara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 妇科医生；专门诊治女性生殖系统相关疾病的医生。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ginekoloġista huwa tabib li jispeċjalizza fil-kura tas-sistema riproduttiva tal-mara u fid-dijanjożi u t-trattament tal-mard tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A gynaecologist is a doctor who specialises in the health and treatment of the female reproductive system.

formal.mt: Il-pazjenta għamlet appuntament mal-ginekoloġista għal eżami ta' rutina.
formal.en: The patient made an appointment with the gynaecologist for a routine examination.
formal.zh: 这位女患者预约了妇科医生，准备接受常规检查。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandi appuntament mal-ginekoloġista għada. Maja: Tridni niġi miegħek? Sara: Iva, grazzi. Niltaqgħu quddiem il-klinika.
colloquial.en: Sara: I have an appointment with the gynaecologist tomorrow. Maja: Would you like me to come with you? Sara: Yes, thank you. Let's meet outside the clinic.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我明天预约了妇科医生。Maja：你想让我陪你去吗？Sara：好呀，谢谢。我们在诊所门口见。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我明天预约了妇科医生。
messages.en: I have an appointment with the gynaecologist tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想让我陪你去吗？
messages.en: Would you like me to come with you?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 好呀，谢谢。我们在诊所门口见。
messages.en: Yes, thank you. Let's meet outside the clinic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ginekoloġista 放进“预约妇科医生”的就医场景，连同 appuntament mal-ginekoloġista 一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shallow mark or cut on skin or another surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 皮肤或其他物体表面被抓、刮或划后留下的浅痕或浅伤口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marka jew qatgħa ħafifa fuq il-ġilda jew fuq wiċċ ta' oġġett, magħmula minn xi ħaġa li togħrok jew taqta'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抓挠或刮划造成的浅表伤痕或划痕。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Girfa hija marka jew ferita ħafifa li titħalla fuq il-ġilda jew fuq wiċċ ieħor meta xi ħaġa taqta' jew togħrok miegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A scratch is a shallow mark or cut made when something sharp or rough moves across a surface.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni tal-vettura, instabet girfa fuq il-bieba tax-xellug.
formal.en: During the vehicle inspection, a scratch was found on the left-hand door.
formal.zh: 检查车辆时，发现左侧车门上有一道划痕。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara f'idek? Mark: Il-qattus ħallieli girfa żgħira waqt li konna qed nilagħbu. Maja: Issa nista' naraha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to your hand? Mark: The cat left a small scratch on it while we were playing. Maja: I can see it now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的手怎么了？Mark：我和猫玩的时候，它在我手上留下了一道小抓痕。Maja：现在我看到了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的手怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to your hand?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qattus ħallieli girfa żgħira waqt li konna qed nilagħbu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-qattus ħallieli girfa żgħira waqt li konna qed nilagħbu.
messages.zh: 我和猫玩的时候，它在我手上留下了一道小抓痕。
messages.en: The cat left a small scratch on it while we were playing.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 现在我看到了。
messages.en: I can see it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 girfa 时，想象手背或车门上的一道细细划痕；它表示留下的痕迹，可配合 fuq“在……上”练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A circular arrangement of flowers or leaves used for decoration or remembrance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用花朵或枝叶编成的环形饰物，用于装饰或纪念。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiżjin f'għamla ta' ċirku magħmul minn fjuri jew weraq, li jintuża għal dekorazzjoni jew tifkira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由花朵或枝叶组成的环形花饰；可用于装饰或纪念的花环。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Girlanda hija ċirku ta' fjuri jew weraq irranġati flimkien biex iżejnu post jew biex ifakkru lil xi ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A wreath is an arrangement of flowers or leaves in a circle, used as a decoration or a sign of remembrance.

collocations.en: to hang a wreath on the door

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja ta' tifkira, tqiegħdet girlanda tal-fjuri quddiem il-monument.
formal.en: During the remembrance ceremony, a wreath of flowers was placed in front of the monument.
formal.zh: 纪念仪式上，人们在纪念碑前献放了一个鲜花花环。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se ndendlu l-girlanda? Nina: Mal-bieb ta' barra, ħalli jaraha kulħadd. Lara: Sewwa, inġibha issa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where shall we hang the wreath? Nina: On the front door, so everyone can see it. Lara: All right, I'll bring it now.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们把花环挂在哪里？Nina：挂在大门上吧，这样大家都能看到。Lara：好，我现在把它拿来。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 我们把花环挂在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we hang the wreath?

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mal-bieb ta' barra, ħalli jaraha kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Mal-bieb ta' barra, ħalli jaraha kulħadd.
messages.zh: 挂在大门上吧，这样大家都能看到。
messages.en: On the front door, so everyone can see it.

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 好，我现在把它拿来。
messages.en: All right, I'll bring it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 girlanda 想成门上圆圆的花环，用“鲜花围成一圈”的画面记住本义，再联想装饰和纪念两种场景。

gloss_zh: 田间石砌小屋；避身石棚

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small hut built from rubble stone, usually found in fields and used as a shelter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用碎石或毛石砌成的小屋，通常位于田间，供人遮蔽避身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għarix żgħir mibni minn ġebel tas-sejjieħ, li tipikament jinsab fl-għelieqi u jintuża bħala kenn.

sense_translations.en_definition: small hut built out of rubble, typically found fields and used as a shelter
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通常建在田间、以碎石或毛石砌成并用作遮蔽处的小屋。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Girna hija għarix żgħir magħmul minn ġebel tas-sejjieħ, li normalment jinsab f'għalqa u jipprovdi kenn lil min ikun hemm.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A girna is a small hut built from rubble stone, typically standing in a field and providing shelter.

collocations.en: a stone shelter in a field
collocations.zh: 田间的一座石砌避身小屋

collocations.en: to take shelter in a stone hut
collocations.zh: 在石砌小屋里躲避风雨

formal.mt: Fir-rapport ġiet deskritta girna mibnija minn ġebel tas-sejjieħ f'għalqa, li kienet tintuża bħala kenn mix-xita.
formal.en: The report described a small rubble-stone hut in a field that was used as a shelter from the rain.
formal.zh: 报告描述了田间一座用毛石砌成的小屋，供人避雨使用。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qed tibda x-xita. Fejn nistgħu nieħdu kenn? Pawlu: Hemm girna fit-tarf tal-għalqa. Nistgħu nistennew fiha. Mark: Tajjeb, ejja mmorru hemm.
colloquial.en: Mark: It's starting to rain. Where can we take shelter? Pawlu: There's a small stone hut at the edge of the field. We can wait inside it. Mark: All right, let's go there.
colloquial.zh: Mark：开始下雨了。我们能去哪里避雨？Pawlu：田边有一座石砌小屋，我们可以进去等一等。Mark：好，我们去那里吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tibda x-xita. Fejn nistgħu nieħdu kenn?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tibda x-xita. Fejn nistgħu nieħdu kenn?
messages.zh: 开始下雨了。我们能去哪里避雨？
messages.en: It's starting to rain. Where can we take shelter?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm girna fit-tarf tal-għalqa. Nistgħu nistennew fiha.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm girna fit-tarf tal-għalqa. Nistgħu nistennew fiha.
messages.zh: 田边有一座石砌小屋，我们可以进去等一等。
messages.en: There's a small stone hut at the edge of the field. We can wait inside it.

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 好，我们去那里吧。
messages.en: All right, let's go there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 girna 时，把“田地、毛石小屋、进去避雨”连成一幅画；同时记住 tieħu kenn f'girna，表示在石屋里避身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A natural spring that periodically sends hot water and steam into the air.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 周期性地向空中喷出热水和蒸汽的天然泉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajn naturali li minn żmien għal żmien titfa' ilma sħun u fwar fl-arja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 间歇泉，即周期性喷出热水和蒸汽的天然泉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għajn naturali li minn żmien għal żmien titfa' ilma sħun u fwar fl-arja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A geyser is a natural spring that sends hot water and steam into the air at intervals.

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi osservaw il-giżer minn distanza sigura waqt li kien jitfa' ilma sħun u fwar fl-arja.
formal.en: The visitors observed the geyser from a safe distance as it sent hot water and steam into the air.
formal.zh: 间歇泉向空中喷出热水和蒸汽时，游客们在安全距离外观看。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kemm qed joħroġ fwar minn dak il-giżer! Mark: Iva! Ejja nibqgħu hawn u narawh mill-bogħod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how much steam is coming out of that geyser! Mark: Yes! Let's stay here and watch it from a distance.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看，那个间歇泉冒出了好多蒸汽！Mark：是啊！我们就待在这里，远远地看吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm qed joħroġ fwar minn dak il-giżer!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm qed joħroġ fwar minn dak il-giżer!
messages.zh: 看，那个间歇泉冒出了好多蒸汽！
messages.en: Look how much steam is coming out of that geyser!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Ejja nibqgħu hawn u narawh mill-bogħod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Ejja nibqgħu hawn u narawh mill-bogħod.
messages.zh: 是啊！我们就待在这里，远远地看吧。
messages.en: Yes! Let's stay here and watch it from a distance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 giżer 和“热水喷起、蒸汽升空、过一阵再喷”的画面绑定，记住它指间歇泉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organ or group of cells in the body that produces and releases particular substances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体内产生并释放特定物质的器官或细胞群。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Organu jew grupp ta' ċelloli fil-ġisem li jipproduċi u joħroġ sustanzi partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腺，身体内负责产生并分泌特定物质的器官或细胞群。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Organu jew grupp ta' ċelloli fil-ġisem li jipproduċi u joħroġ sustanzi partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A gland is an organ or group of cells that produces and releases substances used by the body.

formal.mt: L-istudenti tgħallmu li glandola tal-bżieq tipproduċi bżieq li jgħin fid-diġestjoni.
formal.en: The students learned that a salivary gland produces saliva that helps with digestion.
formal.zh: 学生们了解到，唾液腺产生的唾液有助于消化。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi glandola? Pawlu: Hija parti mill-ġisem li tipproduċi u toħroġ sustanzi, bħall-bżieq.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is a gland? Pawlu: It's a part of the body that produces and releases substances, such as saliva.
colloquial.zh: Lara：腺是什么？Pawlu：就是身体里产生并释放某些物质的部分，比如分泌唾液的腺。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 腺是什么？
messages.en: What is a gland?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija parti mill-ġisem li tipproduċi u toħroġ sustanzi, bħall-bżieq.
messages.mt_standard: Hija parti mill-ġisem li tipproduċi u toħroġ sustanzi, bħall-bżieq.
messages.zh: 就是身体里产生并释放某些物质的部分，比如分泌唾液的腺。
messages.en: It's a part of the body that produces and releases substances, such as saliva.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 glandola 想成身体里的“小分泌工厂”：生产并释放物质，再用 glandola tal-bżieq 联想唾液腺。

gloss_zh: 甘油；丙三醇；食品添加剂编号 E 422 所指的物质

teaching_sense.en_definition: Glycerol, a thick, colourless liquid also identified by the food additive code E 422.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 甘油，又称丙三醇，是一种无色黏稠液体，其食品添加剂编号为 E 422。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza likwida bla kulur u viskuża, magħrufa wkoll bħala gliċerina, li għandha l-kodiċi E 422 meta tintuża bħala addittiv tal-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 食品添加剂编号 E 422 所指的甘油。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sustanza magħrufa bħala gliċerol, identifikata bil-kodiċi E 422 meta tintuża bħala addittiv tal-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: E 422 is the food additive code used to identify glycerol on ingredient lists.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 甘油，即丙三醇，一种无色黏稠的液体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sustanza likwida bla kulur u viskuża, magħrufa wkoll bħala gliċerina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Glycerol is a thick, colourless liquid that is also known as glycerine.

collocations.zh: 作为食品添加剂的甘油

formal.mt: Fil-lista tal-ingredjenti, il-gliċerol huwa identifikat bil-kodiċi E 422.
formal.en: In the ingredient list, glycerol is identified by the code E 422.
formal.zh: 在配料表中，甘油以编号 E 422 标示。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dan l-E 422 fuq it-tikketta? David: Huwa l-kodiċi tal-gliċerol, magħruf ukoll bħala gliċerina.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's this E 422 on the label? David: It's the code for glycerol, also known as glycerine.
colloquial.zh: Sara：标签上这个 E 422 是什么？David：这是甘油的编号，甘油也叫丙三醇。

messages.speaker: Sara (购物者)
messages.zh: 标签上这个 E 422 是什么？
messages.en: What's this E 422 on the label?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa l-kodiċi tal-gliċerol, magħruf ukoll bħala gliċerina.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa l-kodiċi tal-gliċerol, magħruf ukoll bħala gliċerina.
messages.zh: 这是甘油的编号，甘油也叫丙三醇。
messages.en: It's the code for glycerol, also known as glycerine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gliċerol、glycerol、甘油和 E 422 写在同一张记忆卡上，用一滴无色黏稠液体的画面串起这些名称与编号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to or affecting the whole world.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涉及整个世界或对全世界产生影响的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mad-dinja kollha jew li jaffettwa lid-dinja kollha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 全球的，涉及整个世界或影响全世界的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mad-dinja kollha jew li jaffettwa lid-dinja kollha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is global relates to or affects the whole world.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif problema globali tista' taffettwa l-ħajja ta' kuljum f'pajjiżi differenti.
formal.en: The report explains how a global problem can affect everyday life in different countries.
formal.zh: 这份报告解释了全球性问题如何影响不同国家的日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din il-problema teżisti f'pajjiżna biss? Adam: Le, hija problema globali. Teżisti f'ħafna pajjiżi madwar id-dinja.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does this problem exist only in our country? Adam: No, it's a global problem. It exists in many countries around the world.
colloquial.zh: Nina：只有我们国家存在这个问题吗？Adam：不是，这是个全球性问题。世界上许多国家都有。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 只有我们国家存在这个问题吗？
messages.en: Does this problem exist only in our country?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hija problema globali. Teżisti f'ħafna pajjiżi madwar id-dinja.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hija problema globali. Teżisti f'ħafna pajjiżi madwar id-dinja.
messages.zh: 不是，这是个全球性问题。世界上许多国家都有。
messages.en: No, it's a global problem. It exists in many countries around the world.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 globali 就想象一个完整地球，把视野从一个国家扩展到全世界；搭配 problema globali 记住“全球性问题”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A solid object with a round shape whose surface is equally distant from its centre.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 球体，指表面各点到中心距离相等的立体形状，也可指具有这种形状的物体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma solida u tonda li kull punt fuq il-wiċċ tagħha jkun fl-istess distanza miċ-ċentru, jew oġġett b'din il-forma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 球体；表面各点到中心距离相等的立体形状。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Forma ġeometrika solida li kull punt fuq il-wiċċ tagħha jkun fl-istess distanza miċ-ċentru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sphere is a round solid shape whose surface is equally distant from its centre.

collocations.en: in the shape of a sphere

formal.mt: L-istudenti kejlu d-dijametru ta' globu tal-ħġieġ waqt il-lezzjoni tal-ġeometrija.
formal.en: The students measured the diameter of a glass sphere during the geometry lesson.
formal.zh: 学生们在几何课上测量了一个玻璃球体的直径。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'forma għandu dan l-oġġett? Mark: Għandu forma ta' globu; huwa tond minn kull naħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What shape is this object? Mark: It has the shape of a sphere; it is round on every side.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个物体是什么形状的？Mark：它呈球形，各个方向看都是圆的。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这个物体是什么形状的？
messages.en: What shape is this object?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu forma ta' globu; huwa tond minn kull naħa.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu forma ta' globu; huwa tond minn kull naħa.
messages.zh: 它呈球形，各个方向看都是圆的。
messages.en: It has the shape of a sphere; it is round on every side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 globu 与一个透明玻璃球的画面绑定：先想象完整球体，再用 globu tal-ħġieġ 练习说出“玻璃球体”。

gloss_zh: 词义未明：所给名词义项仅标为“13”

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry classified as a noun whose supplied sense label, '13', does not establish a lexical meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 资料将 God Prayer 列为名词，但仅提供“13”这一义项标记，无法据此确定其词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata mogħtija bħala nom, iżda t-tikketta tas-sens tagħha hija biss '13' u ma tipprovdix biżżejjed tagħrif biex jiġi stabbilit it-tifsir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原始义项仅为“13”；资料没有说明该标记所代表的名词含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sens huwa mmarkat biss bin-numru 13, mingħajr spjegazzjoni li turi x'ifisser dan in-nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This noun sense is labelled '13', but the supplied information does not explain its meaning.

collocations.zh: “God Prayer”这一词条（讨论词条的表达）
“God Prayer”的含义（讨论词义的表达）

formal.mt: L-entrata 'God Prayer' hija kklassifikata bħala nom, iżda t-tikketta '13' ma tippermettix li jiġi stabbilit it-tifsir tagħha.
formal.en: The entry 'God Prayer' is classified as a noun, but the label '13' does not allow its meaning to be established.
formal.zh: “God Prayer”词条被归为名词，但“13”这一标记不足以确定其含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser l-entrata 'God Prayer'? Mark: Hawn hemm biss in-numru 13; minn dan ma nistgħux inkunu nafu t-tifsir tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the entry 'God Prayer' mean? Mark: There is only the number 13 here; we cannot determine its meaning from that.
colloquial.zh: Maja：“God Prayer”这个词条是什么意思？Mark：这里只有数字13；我们无法据此确定它的含义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: “God Prayer”这个词条是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the entry 'God Prayer' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn hemm biss in-numru 13; minn dan ma nistgħux inkunu nafu t-tifsir tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn hemm biss in-numru 13; minn dan ma nistgħux inkunu nafu t-tifsir tagħha.
messages.zh: 这里只有数字13；我们无法据此确定它的含义。
messages.en: There is only the number 13 here; we cannot determine its meaning from that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词条暂记为“词义待核实”：数字13只是当前资料给出的标记，不据词面猜测含义；例句仅练习如何讨论未知词条。

gloss_zh: 笨拙的；生硬唐突的；粗糙的；粗陋的；笨重的；粗俗的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lacking ease, smoothness, refinement, or delicacy in movement, manner, construction, or texture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容动作不灵巧、举止或语气生硬粗鲁，也可形容物体粗糙、制作粗陋或体积笨重；具体含义由所修饰的对象决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jonqos mill-ħeffa, mill-ħila, mill-irfinar jew mill-ħlewwa, u jista' jiddeskrivi moviment, imġiba, leħen, wiċċ ta' oġġett jew oġġett tqil u diffiċli biex jitmexxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 笨拙、不自然的；动作或举止缺少流畅与自如。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jurix ħeffa jew naturalezza fil-moviment jew fl-imġiba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something awkward lacks ease or natural smoothness in movement or behaviour.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 唐突生硬的；说话或待人简短直接，显得不够礼貌。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jitkellem jew iġib ruħu b'mod qasir u dirett, mingħajr il-kortesija mistennija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A brusque person speaks or behaves abruptly in a way that can seem impolite.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手脚不灵巧的；动作协调性差，容易碰倒或掉落东西。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jkollux koordinazzjoni tajba fil-movimenti u faċilment iwaqqa' l-affarijiet jew jaħbat magħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A clumsy person moves without good coordination and may easily drop or knock things over.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 质地粗糙的；表面不细腻或材料颗粒、纤维较粗。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkollu wiċċ jew nisġa mhux fina, b'partijiet jew ħjut li jinħassu ħorox.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A coarse material has a rough texture rather than a fine or smooth one.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗陋的；制作或处理简单粗糙，缺乏精细加工。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun magħmul jew maħdum b'mod sempliċi u mhux irfinat, mingħajr attenzjoni biżżejjed għad-dettall.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something crude is made or developed roughly and lacks careful finishing or refinement.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 笨重难搬动的；由于体积、重量或形状而不便拿取、移动或使用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun diffiċli biex jinġarr, jitmexxa jew jintuża minħabba l-qies, il-piż jew il-forma tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cumbersome object is difficult to carry or handle because of its size, weight, or shape.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗俗冒犯的；言语或行为粗鄙，令人反感。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun vulgari jew offensiv tant li jqajjem stmerrija jew skumdità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Gross language or behaviour is offensively vulgar and likely to cause disgust or strong disapproval.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嗓音粗哑生硬的；说话声音低沉粗重，听起来不够温和。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkollu leħen baxx u aħrax jew mod ta' diskors li ma jinstemax ġentili.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A gruff voice sounds low and rough, often giving an impression of unfriendliness.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表面粗糙不平的；外形粗犷、缺少平滑轮廓的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkollu wiċċ aħrax u irregolari jew għamla li mhix lixxa u fina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rugged surface or appearance is rough and uneven rather than smooth or finely shaped.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 举止粗野、缺乏教养的；不符合通常的礼貌或社交规范。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri nuqqas ta' manjieri tajbin u jġib ruħu b'mod mhux edukat f'sitwazzjonijiet soċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An uncouth person behaves rudely and shows little understanding of polite social manners.

formal.mt: Minħabba li l-armarju huwa goff u diffiċli biex jitmexxa, se jkun hemm bżonn żewġ persuni biex iġorruh.
formal.en: Because the cupboard is cumbersome and difficult to move, two people will be needed to carry it.
formal.zh: 由于柜子笨重、难以移动，需要两个人来搬运。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-armarju goff wisq biex inġorru waħdi. Mark: Stenna ftit, ngħinek jien; flimkien inkunu nistgħu nmexxuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: This cupboard is too cumbersome for me to carry alone. Mark: Wait a moment, I'll help you; together we can move it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个柜子太笨重了，我一个人搬不了。Mark：等一下，我来帮你；我们一起就能搬动它。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-armarju goff wisq biex inġorru waħdi.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-armarju goff wisq biex inġorru waħdi.
messages.zh: 这个柜子太笨重了，我一个人搬不了。
messages.en: This cupboard is too cumbersome for me to carry alone.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna ftit, ngħinek jien; flimkien inkunu nistgħu nmexxuh.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna ftit, ngħinek jien; flimkien inkunu nistgħu nmexxuh.
messages.zh: 等一下，我来帮你；我们一起就能搬动它。
messages.en: Wait a moment, I'll help you; together we can move it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“缺少细致顺畅感”串联 goff：动作不顺是笨拙，布料不细是粗糙，柜子难搬是笨重，待人不柔和是生硬粗鲁；遇到具体搭配再选中文义。

gloss_zh: 护目镜；游泳镜；潜水面镜

teaching_sense.en_definition: Eyewear that covers and protects the eyes, including equipment worn to see underwater.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 覆盖眼部以提供保护的眼镜，也可指游泳时使用的泳镜或帮助在水下观察的潜水面镜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmir li jintlibes fuq l-għajnejn biex jipproteġihom, jew li jintuża waqt l-għawm biex wieħed ikun jista' jara taħt l-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 护目镜；贴合眼周、用于保护双眼的眼镜，也包括游泳镜。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nuċċali li joqgħod qrib l-għajnejn u jgħattihom biex jipproteġihom waqt attività bħall-għawm jew xogħol partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Goggles are close-fitting glasses worn to protect your eyes during activities such as swimming or practical work.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 潜水面镜；游泳或水下活动时佩戴、用于在水下看清物体的面镜。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Maskra li tintlibes fuq il-parti tal-wiċċ ta' madwar l-għajnejn waqt l-għawm biex wieħed ikun jista' jara taħt l-ilma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An underwater swimming mask fits over the eye area and allows you to see beneath the water.

formal.mt: Qabel ma jidħlu fil-pixxina, l-istudenti għandhom jilbsu l-gogils tal-għawm u jiżguraw li joqogħdu sew fuq wiċċhom.
formal.en: Before entering the pool, students should put on their swimming goggles and ensure that they fit properly on their faces.
formal.zh: 进入泳池前，学生应戴好泳镜，并确保泳镜贴合面部。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn huma l-gogils tiegħi? Irrid nara taħt l-ilma. Mark: Qegħdin fil-borża ħdejn ix-xugaman; ilbishom qabel tidħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are my goggles? I want to see underwater. Mark: They're in the bag beside the towel; put them on before you get in.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我的泳镜在哪里？我想看看水下。Mark：在包里，毛巾旁边；下水前先戴好。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn huma l-gogils tiegħi? Irrid nara taħt l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn huma l-gogils tiegħi? Irrid nara taħt l-ilma.
messages.zh: 我的泳镜在哪里？我想看看水下。
messages.en: Where are my goggles? I want to see underwater.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qegħdin fil-borża ħdejn ix-xugaman; ilbishom qabel tidħol.
messages.mt_standard: Qegħdin fil-borża ħdejn ix-xugaman; ilbishom qabel tidħol.
messages.zh: 在包里，毛巾旁边；下水前先戴好。
messages.en: They're in the bag beside the towel; put them on before you get in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gogils 和“戴好眼部装备再下水”的动作一起记：看到 tal-għawm 就想到泳镜；只出现 gogils 时，再根据场景判断是护目镜还是潜水面镜。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sport in which players use clubs to hit a small ball into holes on a course.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用球杆击打小球，使其进入球场上各个球洞的体育运动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sport li fih il-plejers jużaw bsaten apposta biex jolqtu ballun żgħir u jdaħħluh fit-toqob ta' korsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 高尔夫球运动，用球杆将小球击入球洞的运动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Logħba sportiva li fiha l-plejers jolqtu ballun żgħir bi bsaten apposta u jippruvaw idaħħluh fit-toqob bl-inqas daqqiet possibbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Golf is a sport in which players try to hit a small ball into a series of holes using as few strokes as possible.

formal.mt: Il-klabb joffri lezzjonijiet tal-golf għal dawk li għadhom jibdew.
formal.en: The club offers golf lessons for beginners.
formal.zh: 该俱乐部为初学者提供高尔夫球课程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi tilgħab il-golf nhar is-Sibt? Mark: Iva, imma qatt ma lgħabt qabel. Maja: Tinkwetax, nibdew b'lezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like to come and play golf on Saturday? Mark: Yes, but I've never played before. Maja: Don't worry, we'll start with a lesson.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：星期六你想一起来打高尔夫球吗？马克：想，但我以前从没打过。玛雅：别担心，我们先上一节课。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi tilgħab il-golf nhar is-Sibt?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi tilgħab il-golf nhar is-Sibt?
messages.zh: 星期六你想一起来打高尔夫球吗？
messages.en: Would you like to come and play golf on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma qatt ma lgħabt qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma qatt ma lgħabt qabel.
messages.zh: 想，但我以前从没打过。
messages.en: Yes, but I've never played before.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 别担心，我们先上一节课。
messages.en: Don't worry, we'll start with a lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 golf 和球杆、小白球、球洞连成一幅画，再整组记住 tilgħab il-golf，表示打高尔夫球。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool used to make holes in materials such as wood or metal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来在木材、金属等材料上钻孔的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex tagħmel toqob f'materjali bħall-injam jew il-metall.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钻孔工具，通过钻头旋转在材料上打孔。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda b'parti li ddur u taqta' fil-materjal biex tagħmel toqba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A drill is a tool that makes holes in a material by turning a cutting bit.

collocations.en: make a hole with a drill

formal.mt: Uża l-golja biex tagħmel it-toqob fl-injam qabel ma ddaħħal il-viti.
formal.en: Use the drill to make the holes in the wood before inserting the screws.
formal.zh: 拧入螺丝前，先用钻在木材上钻孔。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hi l-golja? Għandi bżonn nagħmel toqba fl-injam. Pawlu: Fil-kaxxa tal-għodda. Trid ngħinek? Lara: Iva, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where's the drill? I need to make a hole in the wood. Pawlu: In the toolbox. Would you like some help? Lara: Yes, please.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：钻放在哪儿？我需要在木材上钻个孔。保罗：在工具箱里。要我帮忙吗？拉拉：好，麻烦你了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-golja? Għandi bżonn nagħmel toqba fl-injam.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-golja? Għandi bżonn nagħmel toqba fl-injam.
messages.zh: 钻放在哪儿？我需要在木材上钻个孔。
messages.en: Where's the drill? I need to make a hole in the wood.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 在工具箱里。要我帮忙吗？
messages.en: In the toolbox. Would you like some help?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 好，麻烦你了。
messages.en: Yes, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从工具箱里拿出 golja，在木板上钻出一个孔；把工具、动作和 toqba（孔）一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large ape with a powerful body and dark hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种体形高大、身体强壮、长有深色毛发的类人猿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal kbir tal-grupp tax-xadini l-kbar, b'ġisem b'saħħtu u xagħar skur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大猩猩，一种没有尾巴、体格强壮的大型类人猿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal kbir mingħajr denb, li jagħmel parti mill-grupp tax-xadini l-kbar u għandu ġisem b'saħħtu u xagħar skur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A gorilla is a large, powerful ape with dark hair and no tail.

formal.mt: Ir-ritratt juri gorilla fil-foresta waqt li tiekol il-weraq.
formal.en: The photograph shows a gorilla in the forest eating leaves.
formal.zh: 照片展示了一只正在森林中吃树叶的大猩猩。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara dik il-gorilla fir-ritratt! Samwel: Qed tiekol il-weraq? Nina: Iva, u hemm oħra warajha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at that gorilla in the photo! Samwel: Is it eating leaves? Nina: Yes, and there's another one behind it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看照片里的那只大猩猩！萨姆韦尔：它在吃树叶吗？妮娜：是啊，它后面还有一只。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 看照片里的那只大猩猩！
messages.en: Look at that gorilla in the photo!

messages.speaker: Samwel (同学)
messages.zh: 它在吃树叶吗？
messages.en: Is it eating leaves?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 是啊，它后面还有一只。
messages.en: Yes, and there's another one behind it.

cognitive_memory_aid: gorilla 与英语同形，可以对照记忆；脑中配上一只体格强壮、没有尾巴的大猩猩形象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of pleasure, enjoyment, or satisfaction that something gives you.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由某件事带来的喜悦、乐趣、愉悦或满足感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' ferħ, pjaċir jew sodisfazzjon li tħoss meta xi ħaġa togħġbok jew tagħtik dak li tixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喜悦；某件令人高兴的事情引起的强烈快乐。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ferħ kbir li tħoss meta jiġri xi ħaġa sabiħa jew meta xi ħaġa togħġbok ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Delight is a strong feeling of happiness caused by something especially pleasing.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乐趣；参与活动或经历某件事时感受到的快乐。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjaċir li tħoss waqt li tagħmel attività jew tgħaddi minn esperjenza li togħġbok.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Enjoyment is the pleasure you feel while taking part in an activity or having an experience.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 愉悦；由令人喜欢或舒适的事物带来的愉快感受。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni pjaċevoli li tagħtik xi ħaġa li togħġbok jew li ġġiegħlek tħossok tajjeb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pleasure is a pleasant feeling that comes from something you like or find agreeable.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 满足；愿望得到实现、目标达成或结果符合期待时的愉快感。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sens ta' sodisfazzjon li tħoss meta xewqa titwettaq, tilħaq għan jew tikseb riżultat li jogħġbok.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Satisfaction is the pleased feeling you have when a wish is fulfilled or a result meets your expectations.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti qalu li ħadu gost bil-workshop u li kienu sodisfatti bir-riżultati tax-xogħol tagħhom.
formal.en: The participants said that they enjoyed the workshop and were satisfied with the results of their work.
formal.zh: 参与者表示，他们很享受这次工作坊，也对自己的作品成果感到满意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħadt gost ilbieraħ? Mark: Ħafna! Nieħu gost insajjar mal-ħbieb. Maja: Mela nerġgħu niltaqgħu l-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you have a good time yesterday? Mark: Very much! I enjoy cooking with friends. Maja: Then let's meet again next week.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你昨天玩得开心吗？马克：特别开心！我很喜欢和朋友们一起做饭。玛雅：那我们下星期再聚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你昨天玩得开心吗？
messages.en: Did you have a good time yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 特别开心！我很喜欢和朋友们一起做饭。
messages.en: Very much! I enjoy cooking with friends.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们下星期再聚。
messages.en: Then let's meet again next week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gost 放进朋友聚会的开心场景：nieħu gost 表示享受其中，ħadt gost 表示玩得开心，għall-gost 表示为了好玩。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing something that has the characteristics of the Gothic style, especially in architecture or art.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有哥特式风格特征的，尤用于描述建筑或艺术。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-karatteristiċi tal-istil Gotiku, speċjalment fl-arkitettura jew fl-arti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哥特式的；具有哥特式建筑或艺术风格特征的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri l-karatteristiċi tal-istil Gotiku fl-arkitettura jew fl-arti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is Gothic has the characteristics of the Gothic style of architecture or art.

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi dan il-bini bħala eżempju tal-istil gotiku.
formal.en: The catalogue describes this building as an example of the Gothic style.
formal.zh: 目录将这座建筑描述为哥特式风格的一个实例。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-bini huwa gotiku? Mark: Iva, fil-gwida hemm miktub li huwa mibni fl-istil gotiku.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this building Gothic? Mark: Yes, the guide says it is built in the Gothic style.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这座建筑是哥特式的吗？Mark：是的，指南上写着它是按哥特式风格建造的。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 这座建筑是哥特式的吗？
messages.en: Is this building Gothic?

messages.speaker: Mark (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fil-gwida hemm miktub li huwa mibni fl-istil gotiku.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fil-gwida hemm miktub li huwa mibni fl-istil gotiku.
messages.zh: 是的，指南上写着它是按哥特式风格建造的。
messages.en: Yes, the guide says it is built in the Gothic style.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gotiku 放进 stil gotiku（哥特式风格）一起记，想象自己在建筑导览中辨认风格；它回答的是“什么风格的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A disease that can cause attacks of pain and swelling in the joints.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 痛风，一种可引起关节疼痛和肿胀发作的疾病。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marda li tista' tikkawża attakki ta' wġigħ u nefħa fil-ġogi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 痛风；一种可导致关节疼痛、肿胀发作的疾病。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Marda li tikkawża attakki ta' wġigħ u nefħa f'ġog wieħed jew aktar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Gout is a disease that causes attacks of pain and swelling in one or more joints.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport mediku hemm miktub li l-pazjent ibati mill-gotta.
formal.en: The medical report states that the patient suffers from gout.
formal.zh: 医疗报告记载，该患者患有痛风。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qallek it-tabib? Mark: Qalli li għandi l-gotta u spjegali x'inhi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the doctor tell you? Mark: He told me I have gout and explained what it is.
colloquial.zh: Maja：医生跟你说了什么？Mark：他说我患有痛风，还向我解释了这是什么病。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 医生跟你说了什么？
messages.en: What did the doctor tell you?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qalli li għandi l-gotta u spjegali x'inhi.
messages.mt_standard: Qalli li għandi l-gotta u spjegali x'inhi.
messages.zh: 他说我患有痛风，还向我解释了这是什么病。
messages.en: He told me I have gout and explained what it is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用就诊对话记住 gotta：医生说 għandi l-gotta，就是“我患有痛风”；再搭配 attakk tal-gotta 记住“痛风发作”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A point scored in football when the ball legally enters the opposing team's goal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 足球比赛中，球按规则进入对方球门所取得的一次进球得分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Punt li tim jikseb fil-futbol meta l-ballun jidħol fix-xibka tat-tim avversarju skont ir-regoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 足球比赛中的进球；将球按规则踢入对方球门而取得的得分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Punt fil-logħba tal-futbol li jingħata meta l-ballun jidħol fix-xibka tal-avversarji skont ir-regoli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In football, a goal is a point scored when the ball legally enters the opposing team's goal.

formal.mt: Il-plejer skorja l-gowl tar-rebħa fl-aħħar minuta tal-partita.
formal.en: The player scored the winning goal in the final minute of the match.
formal.zh: 这名球员在比赛最后一分钟攻入了制胜一球。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt il-gowl? Mark: Iva! Kien gowl sabiħ ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see the goal? Mark: Yes! It was a really beautiful goal.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看到那个进球了吗？Mark：看到了！那一球进得真漂亮。

messages.speaker: Maja (球迷)
messages.zh: 你看到那个进球了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the goal?

messages.speaker: Mark (球迷)
messages.zh: 看到了！那一球进得真漂亮。
messages.en: Yes! It was a really beautiful goal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gowl 配上足球入网、观众欢呼的画面，再整块记住 jiskorja gowl（攻入一球），将词义牢牢连到比赛得分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A player whose role is to defend the goal and prevent the opposing team from scoring.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责把守球门、阻止对方进球的球员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Plejer li xogħlu hu li jiddefendi l-lasta u jwaqqaf lit-tim avversarju milli jiskorja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 守门员；负责防守球门并阻止对方得分的球员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-plejer li jiddefendi l-lasta tat-tim tiegħu biex il-ballun ma jidħolx fix-xibka.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A goalkeeper is a player whose job is to defend the goal and stop the opposing team from scoring.

formal.mt: Il-gowlkiper tat-tim waqqaf il-ballun qabel ma daħal fix-xibka.
formal.en: The team's goalkeeper stopped the ball before it entered the net.
formal.zh: 球队的守门员在球入网前将它挡住了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jkun il-gowlkiper illum? Mark: Jien. Ġibt l-ingwanti tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is going to be the goalkeeper today? Mark: I am. I brought my gloves.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今天谁来当守门员？Mark：我来。我带了手套。

messages.speaker: Maja (队友)
messages.zh: 今天谁来当守门员？
messages.en: Who is going to be the goalkeeper today?

messages.speaker: Mark (队友)
messages.zh: 我来。我带了手套。
messages.en: I am. I brought my gloves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 gowlkiper 和戴着手套守住球门的球员画面绑定；用“谁当守门员？”这句问答练习，记住它指的是球员角色。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arrangement of intersecting lines that divides a surface into regular spaces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由相互交叉的线条组成、把平面分成规则小格的结构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struttura ta' linji li jaqsmu lil xulxin u jaqsmu wiċċ fi spazji regolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由交叉线条构成的网格，可用于排列内容或标示位置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sett ta' linji li jaqsmu lil xulxin u jiffurmaw spazji regolari biex jiġu rranġati elementi jew indikati postijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A grid is a set of crossing lines that helps you arrange things or identify positions.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由相互交叉的线条划分而成的规则格子结构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Disinn ta' linji li jaqsmu lil xulxin u jiffurmaw għadd ta' spazji regolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A grid divides a surface into regular spaces formed by intersecting lines.

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jużaw il-gradilja fuq il-mappa biex jindikaw il-post ta' kull bini.
formal.en: Students should use the grid on the map to indicate the location of each building.
formal.zh: 学生应使用地图上的网格标示每栋建筑的位置。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif inqassam il-paġna f'kwadri ndaqs? Pawlu: Pinġi gradilja bil-lapes u bir-riga.
colloquial.en: Marija: How do I divide the page into equal squares? Pawlu: Draw a grid with a pencil and a ruler.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：怎样把这一页分成大小相同的方格？保罗：用铅笔和直尺画一个网格。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 怎样把这一页分成大小相同的方格？
messages.en: How do I divide the page into equal squares?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 用铅笔和直尺画一个网格。
messages.en: Draw a grid with a pencil and a ruler.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gradilja 写在方格纸中央，想象横线和竖线交叉成网；每读一次，就用手指描出一个小方格。

gloss_zh: 大学毕业生；大学学位获得者（复数）

teaching_sense.en_definition: People who have completed university studies and obtained a degree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 完成大学学业并获得学位的人；此词为复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuni li temmew l-istudji universitarji tagħhom u kisbu grad akkademiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 完成大学学业并取得学位的人，指多名大学毕业生。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuni li kisbu grad akkademiku wara li temmew kors ta' studju fl-università.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Graduates are people who have successfully completed university studies and received an academic degree.

collocations.zh: 应届毕业生；新近毕业的大学生

formal.mt: Il-programm joffri taħriġ lill-gradwati ġodda biex jgħinhom jidħlu fid-dinja tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The programme offers training to new graduates to help them enter the world of work.
formal.zh: 该项目为新近毕业的大学生提供培训，帮助他们进入职场。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min jista' japplika għal dan ix-xogħol? Mark: Ir-riklam jgħid li qed ifittxu gradwati ġodda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who can apply for this job? Mark: The advert says they are looking for new graduates.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁可以申请这份工作？马克：招聘广告说他们在招应届大学毕业生。

messages.speaker: Sara (求职者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jista' japplika għal dan ix-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Min jista' japplika għal dan ix-xogħol?
messages.zh: 谁可以申请这份工作？
messages.en: Who can apply for this job?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-riklam jgħid li qed ifittxu gradwati ġodda.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-riklam jgħid li qed ifittxu gradwati ġodda.
messages.zh: 招聘广告说他们在招应届大学毕业生。
messages.en: The advert says they are looking for new graduates.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gradwati 配上一群领取大学学位证书的学生：记住画面中是多人，从而同时记住“大学毕业生”和复数用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to pictures, visual designs, or the presentation of information through images.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与图形、视觉设计或利用图像呈现信息有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' stampi, disinji viżivi jew il-preżentazzjoni ta' informazzjoni permezz ta' xbihat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 图形的；与视觉设计或图像表达有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-użu ta' stampi u disinji biex jiġu espressi ideat jew ippreżentata informazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is graphic uses or relates to pictures and visual design to communicate information.

formal.mt: Id-disinn grafiku tal-fuljett jgħin lill-qarrej jifhem l-informazzjoni ewlenija malajr.
formal.en: The leaflet's graphic design helps the reader understand the main information quickly.
formal.zh: 宣传册的平面设计有助于读者迅速理解主要信息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-poster jidher vojt. David: Nistgħu nżidu element grafiku ħdejn it-titlu.
colloquial.en: Lara: This poster looks empty. David: We could add a graphic element next to the title.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这张海报看起来有点空。戴维：我们可以在标题旁边加一个图形元素。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这张海报看起来有点空。
messages.en: This poster looks empty.

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nżidu element grafiku ħdejn it-titlu.
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nżidu element grafiku ħdejn it-titlu.
messages.zh: 我们可以在标题旁边加一个图形元素。
messages.en: We could add a graphic element next to the title.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用整组短语 disinn grafiku 联想“平面设计”，再用 element grafiku 联想“图形元素”，记住 grafiku 在这里负责描述名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A metric unit of mass equal to one thousandth of a kilogram.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公制质量单位，一克等于一千克的千分之一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità metrika tal-massa li hija ugwali għal parti waħda minn elf ta' kilogramma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 克，公制质量单位，符号为 g，等于一千克的千分之一。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Unità tal-massa bis-simbolu g, li minnha elf jagħmlu kilogramma waħda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A gram is a metric unit used to measure mass, equal to one thousandth of a kilogram.

formal.mt: Għal dan l-esperiment, iżen gramma waħda ta' melħ u żidha mal-ilma.
formal.en: For this experiment, weigh out one gram of salt and add it to the water.
formal.zh: 进行这项实验时，称取一克盐并将其加入水中。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kemm melħ irrid inżid? Luqa: Gramma waħda biss; uża l-miżien.
colloquial.en: Anna: How much salt should I add? Luqa: Just one gram; use the scales.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我要加多少盐？卢卡：只加一克，用秤称一下。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要加多少盐？
messages.en: How much salt should I add?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 只加一克，用秤称一下。
messages.en: Just one gram; use the scales.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gramma 和电子秤上的“1 g”一起记，再默念 gramma waħda“一克”，用称盐的动作巩固这个质量单位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The rules governing how words change form and combine into sentences in a language; also, a book describing those rules.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种语言中词形变化及词语组成句子的规则；也指讲解这些规则的语法书。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-regoli ta' lingwa dwar kif jinbidlu l-forom tal-kliem u kif il-kliem jingħaqad f'sentenzi; ukoll, ktieb li jispjega dawn ir-regoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某种语言的语法，即词形变化和词语组合成句的规则。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sistema ta' regoli ta' lingwa li tirregola l-forom tal-kliem u l-mod kif dawn jingħaqdu f'sentenzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The grammar of a language is the system of rules that determines how words change form and combine to make sentences.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 语法书，系统介绍或讲解某种语言语法规则的书。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ktieb li jiġbor u jispjega r-regoli grammatikali ta' lingwa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A grammar is a book that describes and explains the grammatical rules of a particular language.

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi l-istudju tal-grammatika Maltija. L-istudenti għandhom ukoll jaqraw il-kapitlu dwar il-verbi fil-grammatika magħżula għall-kors.
formal.en: The course includes the study of Maltese grammar. Students should also read the chapter on verbs in the grammar book selected for the course.
formal.zh: 本课程包括马耳他语语法的学习。学生还应阅读本课程所选语法书中关于动词的章节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma fhimtx din ir-regola tal-grammatika. Mark: Ejja naraw l-eżempji f'din il-grammatika. Maja: Iva, forsi jgħinuni nifhem aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: I didn't understand this grammar rule. Mark: Let's look at the examples in this grammar book. Maja: Yes, perhaps they'll help me understand better.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我没理解这条语法规则。Mark：我们看看这本语法书里的例句吧。Maja：好，也许它们能帮我理解得更清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 我没理解这条语法规则。
messages.en: I didn't understand this grammar rule.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 我们看看这本语法书里的例句吧。
messages.en: Let's look at the examples in this grammar book.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 好，也许它们能帮我理解得更清楚。
messages.en: Yes, perhaps they'll help me understand better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 grammatika 与两个画面一起记：脑中的语言规则是“语法”，桌上讲解这些规则的书是“语法书”；结合上下文判断具体含义。

gloss_zh: 语法的；符合语法规则的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to grammar, or formed according to the grammatical rules of a language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与语法有关的；也可指符合某种语言语法规则的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-grammatika, jew li huwa magħmul skont ir-regoli tal-grammatika ta' lingwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 语法方面的；符合语法规则的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-grammatika jew li jsegwi r-regoli grammatikali ta' lingwa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something grammatical relates to grammar or follows the accepted grammatical rules of a language.

collocations.zh: 一个符合语法规则的句子

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tat-test, l-istudent għandu jidentifika kull żball grammatikali u jispjega r-regola li tapplika.
formal.en: In analysing the text, the student should identify each grammatical error and explain the applicable rule.
formal.zh: 分析课文时，学生应指出每个语法错误，并说明适用的规则。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm żball grammatikali f'din is-sentenza? Pawlu: Iva, il-verb għandu jkun fil-plural. Sara: Sewwa, issa nikkoreġih.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there a grammatical error in this sentence? Pawlu: Yes, the verb should be plural. Sara: All right, I'll correct it now.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个句子有语法错误吗？Pawlu：有，动词应该用复数形式。Sara：好，我现在就改。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个句子有语法错误吗？
messages.en: Is there a grammatical error in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 有，动词应该用复数形式。
messages.en: Yes, the verb should be plural.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 好，我现在就改。
messages.en: All right, I'll correct it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 grammatika“语法”和 grammatikali“语法的”成对记忆，再背 żball grammatikali“语法错误”；这里形容词放在名词后面。

gloss_zh: 绳钉；用于固定绳子的钉子

teaching_sense.en_definition: A nail used for securing a cord.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于固定绳子的钉子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Musmar li jintuża biex iżomm korda f'postha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绳钉，即用于固定绳子的钉子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Musmar li jservi biex titwaħħal korda u tinżamm f'postha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cord nail is a nail used to hold a cord in position.

collocations.en: to fix a cord nail in place

formal.mt: Biex il-korda tibqa' f'postha, waħħal grampun u ċċekkja li l-korda tkun miżmuma sew.
formal.en: To keep the cord in position, fix a cord nail in place and check that the cord is securely held.
formal.zh: 为使绳子保持在原位，请固定一枚绳钉，并检查绳子是否固定牢靠。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek grampun żgħir għal din il-korda? Rita: Iva, hawn wieħed fil-kaxxa. Mark: Grazzi, issa nista' nwaħħal il-korda.
colloquial.en: Mark: Have you got a small cord nail for this cord? Rita: Yes, there's one here in the box. Mark: Thanks, now I can secure the cord.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你有用来固定这根绳子的小绳钉吗？Rita：有，盒子里这里有一枚。Mark：谢谢，现在我可以把绳子固定好了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek grampun żgħir għal din il-korda?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek grampun żgħir għal din il-korda?
messages.zh: 你有用来固定这根绳子的小绳钉吗？
messages.en: Have you got a small cord nail for this cord?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，盒子里这里有一枚。
messages.en: Yes, there's one here in the box.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 谢谢，现在我可以把绳子固定好了。
messages.en: Thanks, now I can secure the cord.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“绳子需要钉子固定”的操作画面记 grampun，并连读 grampun、korda 两个词，把“绳钉”和“绳子”一起记住。

gloss_zh: 格拉尼塔冰沙；带有冰晶口感的调味碎冰甜品

teaching_sense.en_definition: A frozen sweet made from flavoured liquid with a granular, icy texture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将调味液体冷冻制成、具有颗粒状冰晶口感的冰沙甜品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Deżerta ffriżata magħmula minn likwidu bit-togħma, b'konsistenza ta' kristalli żgħar tas-silġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 格拉尼塔冰沙，一种由调味液体冷冻制成、呈细小冰晶状的甜品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Deżerta magħmula billi jiġi ffriżat likwidu bit-togħma sabiex jifforma kristalli żgħar tas-silġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Granita is a frozen dessert made from flavoured liquid and served with a granular texture of small ice crystals.

formal.mt: Il-menu tas-sajf jinkludi granita tal-lumi, servuta f'tazza bħala deżerta friska.
formal.en: The summer menu includes lemon granita, served in a glass as a refreshing dessert.
formal.zh: 夏季菜单包括柠檬格拉尼塔冰沙，装在杯中，作为清凉甜品供应。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nixtieq granita tal-lumi, jekk jogħġbok. Toni: Trid tazza żgħira jew kbira? Lara: Żgħira, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Lara: I'd like a lemon granita, please. Toni: Would you like a small glass or a large one? Lara: A small one, thanks.
colloquial.zh: Lara：请给我一杯柠檬格拉尼塔冰沙。Toni：你要小杯还是大杯？Lara：小杯，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我一杯柠檬格拉尼塔冰沙。
messages.en: I'd like a lemon granita, please.

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.zh: 你要小杯还是大杯？
messages.en: Would you like a small glass or a large one?

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 小杯，谢谢。
messages.en: A small one, thanks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 granita 想成杯中闪亮的细小冰晶，再用 granita tal-lumi“柠檬冰沙”练习点单，让口感画面和常用短语一起帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling or expressing thanks for help, kindness, or something beneficial.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因得到帮助、善意或好处而心怀感激或表达谢意的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss jew juri ħajr għall-għajnuna, għall-qalb tajba jew għal xi ħaġa ta' ġid li jkun irċieva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因得到帮助或遇到有利情况而心怀谢意的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jħoss ħajr għal għajnuna li jkun irċieva jew għal xi ħaġa tajba li tkun ġrat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are thankful, you feel pleased and appreciative because someone has helped you or something good has happened.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感念他人的帮助、善意或付出并心存感激的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jagħraf u japprezza l-għajnuna jew il-qalb tajba ta' ħaddieħor u jħoss ħajr għalihom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are grateful, you appreciate another person's kindness or assistance and feel a wish to thank them.

formal.mt: Jiena grat lejn il-kollegi tiegħi għall-appoġġ li tawni matul dan il-proġett.
formal.en: I am grateful to my colleagues for the support they gave me throughout this project.
formal.zh: 我感激同事们在整个项目期间给予我的支持。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Grazzi talli għentni nġorr il-kaxxi. Jien grat ħafna. Pawlu: Ta' xejn! Kien pjaċir tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Mark: Thanks for helping me carry the boxes. I'm very grateful. Pawlu: You're welcome! It was my pleasure.
colloquial.zh: Mark：谢谢你帮我搬箱子，我很感激。Pawlu：不客气！很乐意帮忙。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi talli għentni nġorr il-kaxxi. Jien grat ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi talli għentni nġorr il-kaxxi. Jien grat ħafna.
messages.zh: 谢谢你帮我搬箱子，我很感激。
messages.en: Thanks for helping me carry the boxes. I'm very grateful.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 不客气！很乐意帮忙。
messages.en: You're welcome! It was my pleasure.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 grat 放进“别人帮我搬箱子，我心怀感激”的画面中；连着记 grat għall-għajnuna，表示“感激帮助”。

gloss_zh: 负有重担者；受债务或义务拖累者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person burdened by debts, obligations, or other responsibilities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 承担债务、义务或其他责任而受到拖累的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġorr il-piż ta' djun, obbligi jew responsabbiltajiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被债务、义务或其他负担拖累的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun mgħobbija bi djun, obbligi jew piżijiet oħra li jnaqqsulha l-ħila li taġixxi liberament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An encumbered person carries debts, obligations, or other burdens that limit their freedom to act.

collocations.en: the person weighed down by obligations
collocations.zh: 被各种义务压得喘不过气的人

formal.mt: Il-gravat bid-dejn talab aktar żmien biex iħallas l-ammont dovut.
formal.en: The person burdened with debt requested more time to pay the amount owed.
formal.zh: 背负债务的人请求延长偿还欠款的期限。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Jien il-gravat bid-dejn f'din il-familja; għad għandi ħafna x'inħallas. Lara: Nifhem. Ejja naraw kif nistgħu nqassmu l-ispejjeż.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm the one burdened with debt in this family; I still have a lot to pay. Lara: I understand. Let's see how we can share the expenses.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这个家里背着债务的是我，我还有很多钱要还。Lara：我明白。我们看看能怎么分担开支。

messages.speaker: Mark (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien il-gravat bid-dejn f'din il-familja; għad għandi ħafna x'inħallas.
messages.mt_standard: Jien il-gravat bid-dejn f'din il-familja; għad għandi ħafna x'inħallas.
messages.zh: 这个家里背着债务的是我，我还有很多钱要还。
messages.en: I'm the one burdened with debt in this family; I still have a lot to pay.

messages.speaker: Lara (妻子)
messages.mt_spoken: Nifhem. Ejja naraw kif nistgħu nqassmu l-ispejjeż.
messages.mt_standard: Nifhem. Ejja naraw kif nistgħu nqassmu l-ispejjeż.
messages.zh: 我明白。我们看看能怎么分担开支。
messages.en: I understand. Let's see how we can share the expenses.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gravat 想成背着一大袋账单的人；本条按名词记“负担在身者”，用 il-gravat bid-dejn 联想“背债的人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Serious or severe enough to cause substantial concern or harmful consequences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 程度严重、足以引起重大担忧或造成不良后果的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun serju jew ta' severità kbira biżżejjed biex iqajjem tħassib kbir jew iwassal għal konsegwenzi ħżiena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 问题、错误或情况等严重到需要认真关注和处理的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun importanti u serju biżżejjed biex jeħtieġ attenzjoni u ma jistax jitqies bħala ħaġa żgħira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A serious problem or mistake is important enough to require careful attention because it may have harmful consequences.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 情况极为严重、令人深切担忧，可能带来重大危险的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ta' severità kbira ħafna u jqajjem tħassib qawwi minħabba l-periklu jew il-konsegwenzi possibbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A grave situation is extremely serious and gives strong cause for concern about danger or damaging consequences.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport identifika żball gravi fil-kalkoli li seta' jbiddel ir-riżultat finali.
formal.en: The report identified a serious mistake in the calculations that could have changed the final result.
formal.zh: 报告指出，计算中存在一个可能改变最终结果的严重错误。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għamilt żball fil-formola. Taħseb li hu gravi? Lara: Jekk l-ammont hu ħażin, jista' jkun gravi. Ejja niċċekkjawh.
colloquial.en: Maja: I made a mistake on the form. Do you think it's serious? Lara: If the amount is wrong, it could be serious. Let's check it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我把表格填错了。你觉得严重吗？Lara：如果金额错了，可能会很严重。我们检查一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamilt żball fil-formola. Taħseb li hu gravi?
messages.mt_standard: Għamilt żball fil-formola. Taħseb li hu gravi?
messages.zh: 我把表格填错了。你觉得严重吗？
messages.en: I made a mistake on the form. Do you think it's serious?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk l-ammont hu ħażin, jista' jkun gravi. Ejja niċċekkjawh.
messages.mt_standard: Jekk l-ammont hu ħażin, jista' jkun gravi. Ejja niċċekkjawh.
messages.zh: 如果金额错了，可能会很严重。我们检查一下。
messages.en: If the amount is wrong, it could be serious. Let's check it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gravi 和红色警示标记一起记：看到 żball gravi 就想到“严重错误”，看到 kundizzjoni gravi 就想到“危重状况”。

gloss_zh: 游乐场；活动场地；足球场

teaching_sense.en_definition: An outdoor area used for play or sport, including a playground or a football pitch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供游戏或体育活动使用的户外场地，可指游乐场或足球场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fil-beraħ fejn isir il-logħob jew l-isport, bħal post fejn jilagħbu t-tfal jew fejn jintlagħab il-futbol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供儿童玩耍和活动的户外场地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post fil-beraħ maħsub biex it-tfal ikunu jistgħu jilagħbu u jagħmlu attivitajiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A playground is an outdoor area where children can play and take part in recreational activities.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供足球比赛或训练使用的场地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Medda art imħejjija u mmarkata biex fuqha jsiru logħbiet jew taħriġ tal-futbol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A football pitch is a marked area of ground where football matches or training sessions take place.

formal.mt: Il-grawnd tal-futbol se jingħalaq għal ġimgħa sabiex isiru xogħlijiet ta' manutenzjoni.
formal.en: The football pitch will be closed for a week so that maintenance work can be carried out.
formal.zh: 足球场将关闭一周，以进行维护工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn huma t-tfal? Pawlu: Qegħdin jilagħbu fil-grawnd tal-iskola. Maja: Tajjeb, immur niġborhom minn hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are the children? Pawlu: They're playing in the school playground. Maja: Good, I'll go and pick them up there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：孩子们在哪里？Pawlu：他们在学校操场玩。Maja：好，我去那里接他们。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子们在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the children?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 他们在学校操场玩。
messages.en: They're playing in the school playground.

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: 好，我去那里接他们。
messages.en: Good, I'll go and pick them up there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 grawnd 想成一块户外活动场地：孩子在学校的 grawnd 玩，球员在 grawnd tal-futbol 踢球，用场景区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 有魅力的；和蔼可亲的；可爱的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pleasant or appealing in appearance, manner, or character.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容外表吸引人、举止亲切或性情讨人喜欢的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġbed l-attenzjoni jew jogħġob minħabba d-dehra, l-imġiba jew il-karattru tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 外表悦目、有吸引力的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu dehra sabiħa li tiġbed l-attenzjoni u togħġob lil min jarah.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is grazzjuż has an appearance that people find appealing.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 待人友善、和蔼可亲的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jġib ruħu b'mod ħelu u ta' ħbiberija ma' ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is grazzjuż is friendly and pleasant when dealing with others.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可爱、讨人喜欢而令人感到愉快的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li hu ħelu ħafna u jqanqal sens ta' għożża jew pjaċir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something described as grazzjuż gives you a strong feeling of pleasure or affection.

formal.mt: Il-gwida kien raġel grazzjuż li laqa' lill-viżitaturi bi tbissima u wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet tagħhom bil-paċenzja.
formal.en: The guide was an amiable man who welcomed the visitors with a smile and answered their questions patiently.
formal.zh: 导游是一位和蔼可亲的男士，他微笑着迎接访客，耐心回答他们的问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm hu grazzjuż it-tifel tiegħek! Lara: Grazzi! Dejjem jitbissem meta jiltaqa' man-nies.
colloquial.en: Maja: Your little boy is so lovely! Lara: Thank you! He always smiles when he meets people.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你家男孩真可爱！劳拉：谢谢！他见到人总是笑眯眯的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你家男孩真可爱！
messages.en: Your little boy is so lovely!

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi! Dejjem jitbissem meta jiltaqa' man-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi! Dejjem jitbissem meta jiltaqa' man-nies.
messages.zh: 谢谢！他见到人总是笑眯眯的。
messages.en: Thank you! He always smiles when he meets people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个笑容亲切、模样可爱的男孩：外表吸引人、待人和善、令人喜爱，三个角度一起记住 grazzjuż。

gloss_zh: 格里高利的；格里高利历的；格里高利圣咏的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the Gregorian calendar or Gregorian chant.
