colloquial.zh: Sara：这笔钱可以买我们随意选择的供应商的设备吗？David：不行，这是捆绑援助；我们必须向协议列明的供应商购买。

messages.speaker: Sara (项目协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: B'dawn il-flus nistgħu nixtru t-tagħmir minn fejn irridu?
messages.mt_standard: B'dawn il-flus nistgħu nixtru t-tagħmir minn fejn irridu?
messages.zh: 这笔钱可以买我们随意选择的供应商的设备吗？
messages.en: Can we use this money to buy the equipment from wherever we want?

messages.speaker: David (项目财务人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, din hija għajnuna marbuta; irridu nixtruh mingħand il-fornituri msemmija fil-ftehim.
messages.mt_standard: Le, din hija għajnuna marbuta; irridu nixtruh mingħand il-fornituri msemmija fil-ftehim.
messages.zh: 不行，这是捆绑援助；我们必须向协议列明的供应商购买。
messages.en: No, this is tied aid; we have to buy it from the suppliers named in the agreement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象援助款旁边系着一张指定供应商清单：拿到钱，也带着采购限制。用这个画面记住 għajnuna marbuta 的“捆绑援助”含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fellow person, such as a relative, neighbour, or companion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指与自己有亲缘、邻里或伙伴关系的人，也可泛指应当关爱的他人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna oħra, bħal qarib, ġar jew sieħeb, li magħha għandek rabta jew li għandek tittratta b'rispett u mħabba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亲属、邻人或伙伴；在关爱、互助等语境中也可指身边的他人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tista' tkun qarib, ġar jew sieħeb; il-kelma tintuża wkoll għal persuna oħra li għandha tingħata rispett, għajnuna jew imħabba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your neighbour or fellow person is someone such as a relative, a person living nearby, or a companion whom you know or help.

formal.mt: Ir-rispett lejn għajrek jidher fil-mod kif tisma' lil ħaddieħor u toffri l-għajnuna meta jkun hemm bżonn.
formal.en: Respect for your fellow person is shown in the way you listen to others and offer help when it is needed.
formal.zh: 对他人的尊重，体现在你如何倾听别人，以及如何在有需要时提供帮助。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-ġar tagħna għandu ħafna basktijiet x'iġorr. Toni: Ejja ngħinuh. Dejjem tajjeb li tgħin lil għajrek.
colloquial.en: Marija: Our neighbour has lots of bags to carry. Toni: Let's help him. It's always good to help your neighbour.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我们的邻居有好多袋东西要搬。Toni：我们去帮帮他吧。帮助邻人总是件好事。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġar tagħna għandu ħafna basktijiet x'iġorr.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġar tagħna għandu ħafna basktijiet x'iġorr.
messages.zh: 我们的邻居有好多袋东西要搬。
messages.en: Our neighbour has lots of bags to carry.

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja ngħinuh. Dejjem tajjeb li tgħin lil għajrek.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja ngħinuh. Dejjem tajjeb li tgħin lil għajrek.
messages.zh: 我们去帮帮他吧。帮助邻人总是件好事。
messages.en: Let's help him. It's always good to help your neighbour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għajrek 放进 Għin lil għajrek“帮助邻人”一起记，想象自己替身边的人搬东西；用关爱与互助的场景串起亲友、邻人和伙伴这些含义。

gloss_zh: 极其年老（通常与 xiħ 连用）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used with xiħ to emphasize that someone is extremely old.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常与 xiħ 连用的表达，用来强调某人年纪极大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li normalment tintuża mal-aġġettiv xiħ biex tenfasizza li persuna għandha età kbira ħafna.

sense_translations.en_definition: expression indicating extreme old age (usually used with the adjective 'xiħ')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示年纪极大的表达，通常与形容词 xiħ 连用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża l-aktar mal-kelma xiħ biex turi li xi ħadd għandu età kbira ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use għakka with xiħ to emphasize that someone is extremely old.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel kien xiħ għakka, iżda kien għadu jiftakar sew it-tfulija tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the man was extremely old, but he still remembered his childhood clearly.
formal.zh: 故事中的男人已十分年迈，但仍清楚地记得自己的童年。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm għandu żmien ir-raġel f'dan ir-rakkont? Pawlu: Ma jgħidux, imma jiddeskrivuh bħala xiħ għakka.
colloquial.en: Maja: How old is the man in this story? Pawlu: They don't say, but they describe him as extremely old.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个故事里的男人多大年纪？Pawlu：故事没说，不过把他形容为年纪极大。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm għandu żmien ir-raġel f'dan ir-rakkont?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm għandu żmien ir-raġel f'dan ir-rakkont?
messages.zh: 这个故事里的男人多大年纪？
messages.en: How old is the man in this story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma jgħidux, imma jiddeskrivuh bħala xiħ għakka.
messages.mt_standard: Ma jgħidux, imma jiddeskrivuh bħala xiħ għakka.
messages.zh: 故事没说，不过把他形容为年纪极大。
messages.en: They don't say, but they describe him as extremely old.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xiħ għakka 整组记成“年纪极大”，想象故事里一位白发苍苍的老人；此处 għakka 加强年老的程度。

gloss_zh: 永远；永久地；持续不断地

teaching_sense.en_definition: For all future time, or continuously without an end.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某种状态永久延续，或某种情况持续不断、没有终点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfisser għal kull żmien li ġej, jew b'mod kontinwu mingħajr tmiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 永远；永久地，表示延续到未来而没有终点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser għal kull żmien li ġej, mingħajr ma jkun hemm tmiem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something lasts għal dejjem, it continues for all future time.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 持续不断地；始终如此，强调某种状态没有止息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li xi ħaġa tibqa' għaddejja jew teżisti kontinwament, mingħajr waqfien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a condition exists għal dejjem, it persists continuously without coming to an end.

formal.mt: L-għan tal-proġett huwa li dawn ir-reġistrazzjonijiet jinżammu għal dejjem bħala parti mill-wirt kulturali.
formal.en: The project's aim is to preserve these recordings forever as part of the cultural heritage.
formal.zh: 该项目旨在将这些录音作为文化遗产的一部分永久保存。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se żżomm dan ir-ritratt? Mark: Iva, għal dejjem. Ifakkarni fl-ewwel vjaġġ tagħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to keep this photo? Mark: Yes, forever. It reminds me of our first trip.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你会留着这张照片吗？马克：会，永远留着。它让我想起我们第一次旅行。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你会留着这张照片吗？
messages.en: Are you going to keep this photo?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għal dejjem. Ifakkarni fl-ewwel vjaġġ tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għal dejjem. Ifakkarni fl-ewwel vjaġġ tagħna.
messages.zh: 会，永远留着。它让我想起我们第一次旅行。
messages.en: Yes, forever. It reminds me of our first trip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把珍贵照片放进永久保存的相册，给相册贴上 għal dejjem，记住整个短语表示“永远”。

gloss_zh: 出于经济原因；由于经济方面的考虑

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression explaining that a decision or action is motivated by costs, money, or economic circumstances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于说明某项决定或行动是出于成本、资金或经济状况方面的考虑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li deċiżjoni jew azzjoni tkun ittieħdet minħabba l-ispejjeż, il-flus jew il-qagħda ekonomika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出于经济原因，尤其指受到成本、资金或经济状况的影响。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din l-espressjoni tfisser li xi ħaġa ssir minħabba konsiderazzjonijiet marbuta mal-flus, mal-ispejjeż jew mal-ekonomija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is done for economic reasons, financial costs or economic circumstances explain why it is done.

collocations.zh: 出于经济原因削减开支

collocations.en: postpone a project for economic reasons
collocations.zh: 出于经济原因推迟项目

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ddeċidiet li tipposponi l-ftuħ tal-fergħa l-ġdida għal raġunijiet ekonomiċi.
formal.en: The company decided to postpone the opening of its new branch for economic reasons.
formal.zh: 公司出于经济原因，决定推迟新分店的开业。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għażiltu lukanda oħra? Mark: Għal raġunijiet ekonomiċi. Dik li għażilna tiswa inqas.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you choose a different hotel? Mark: For economic reasons. The one we chose costs less.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们为什么换了一家酒店？马克：出于经济原因。我们选的这家比较便宜。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们为什么换了一家酒店？
messages.en: Why did you choose a different hotel?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal raġunijiet ekonomiċi. Dik li għażilna tiswa inqas.
messages.mt_standard: Għal raġunijiet ekonomiċi. Dik li għażilna tiswa inqas.
messages.zh: 出于经济原因。我们选的这家比较便宜。
messages.en: For economic reasons. The one we chose costs less.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和“预算有限，所以调整计划”的情景一起记：回答为什么换酒店、减开支或推迟项目时，都可说“出于经济原因”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to ask about the reason for an action, event, or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于询问某个行为、事件或情况的原因，相当于“为什么”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża biex tistaqsi x'inhi r-raġuni għal azzjoni, ġrajja jew sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为什么；用于询问原因。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma li biha tistaqsi għar-raġuni li għaliha xi ħaġa saret jew ġrat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use għala when you ask for the reason something happens or someone does something.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega għala l-proġett ma tlestiex fil-ħin.
formal.en: The report explains why the project was not completed on time.
formal.zh: 报告解释了项目为什么没有按时完成。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għala wasalt tard illum? Mark: Għax tlift il-karozza tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you arrive late today? Mark: Because I missed the bus.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你今天为什么迟到了？Mark：因为我没赶上公交车。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你今天为什么迟到了？
messages.en: Why did you arrive late today?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 因为我没赶上公交车。
messages.en: Because I missed the bus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għala 放进问答卡片：“为什么迟到？”用 għala 提问，再用 għax 引出“因为”，成对练习更好记。

gloss_zh: 漠不关心；满不在乎的态度

teaching_sense.en_definition: An attitude of not caring about something or showing concern for it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事不在意、不关心的态度，常含有对本应重视之事置之不理的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attitudni ta' nuqqas ta' interess jew ħsieb dwar xi ħaġa, speċjalment meta wieħed suppost jagħtiha kas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 漠不关心；对某事缺乏兴趣、关切或重视的态度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' interess jew tħassib dwar xi ħaġa, li jidher meta persuna ma tagħtihiex kas.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone shows għalabibiżmu, they behave as though something does not matter or deserve their attention.

formal.mt: L-għalabibiżmu lejn il-ħtiġijiet tar-residenti wassal għal ħafna ilmenti.
formal.en: Indifference towards the residents' needs led to many complaints.
formal.zh: 对居民需求的漠视引发了许多投诉。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għedtlu li għandna bżonn l-għajnuna, u lanqas wieġeb. Toni: Dan għalabibiżmu. Għandu jagħti kas.
colloquial.en: Rita: I told him we need help, and he didn't even reply. Toni: That's indifference. He ought to care.
colloquial.zh: Rita：我告诉他我们需要帮忙，他竟然连回答都没有。Toni：这就是漠不关心。他应该重视一下。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għedtlu li għandna bżonn l-għajnuna, u lanqas wieġeb.
messages.mt_standard: Għedtlu li għandna bżonn l-għajnuna, u lanqas wieġeb.
messages.zh: 我告诉他我们需要帮忙，他竟然连回答都没有。
messages.en: I told him we need help, and he didn't even reply.

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.zh: 这就是漠不关心。他应该重视一下。
messages.en: That's indifference. He ought to care.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大家请求帮忙，一个人却耸肩不理；把这个“满不在乎”的场景与 għalabibiżmu 联系起来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Happening suddenly and unexpectedly, without advance warning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容事情毫无预兆、出乎意料地突然发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jseħħ f'daqqa u bla mistenni, mingħajr ebda twissija minn qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 突然；毫无预兆、出乎意料地发生。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jiġri f'daqqa waħda, mingħajr ma jkun mistenni jew imħabbar minn qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happens għalarrieda, it happens suddenly when you are not expecting it.

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, id-dawl intefa għalarrieda u d-diskussjoni waqfet għal ftit minuti.
formal.en: During the meeting, the lights suddenly went out and the discussion stopped for a few minutes.
formal.zh: 会议期间，灯突然熄灭，讨论中断了几分钟。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għala waqaft għalarrieda? David: Qattus qabeż quddiemi, u ma ridtx nirfsu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you stop suddenly? David: A cat jumped in front of me, and I didn't want to step on it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么突然停下来？David：一只猫跳到我面前，我不想踩到它。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么突然停下来？
messages.en: Why did you stop suddenly?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qattus qabeż quddiemi, u ma ridtx nirfsu.
messages.mt_standard: Qattus qabeż quddiemi, u ma ridtx nirfsu.
messages.zh: 一只猫跳到我面前，我不想踩到它。
messages.en: A cat jumped in front of me, and I didn't want to step on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象走路时一只猫突然跳到面前，你立刻停步；用这个毫无预兆的瞬间记住 għalarrieda 的“突然”。

gloss_zh: 不加思索地；可能表示一起、如同一体；同心诚意地一起

teaching_sense.en_definition: To do something without giving it thought.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不经过思考便做某事；不加思索地行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tagħmel xi ħaġa bla ma taħseb dwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不加思索地做某事；行动时没有考虑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li tagħmel xi ħaġa mingħajr ma taħseb dwar dak li tkun qed tagħmel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this sense, għalenija describes doing something without thinking about it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可能表示如同一体地、一起；此义的确定性尚未明确。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tista' tfisser li persuni jkunu jew jaġixxu flimkien bħallikieku kienu ħaġa waħda, iżda din it-tifsira mhijiex ċerta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This tentative sense may describe people acting together as a single united group.

sense_translations.en_definition: together in good faith ... flimkien b'qalb waħda.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 怀着真诚共同的心意一起行动；诚心诚意、同心协力地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li persuni jaġixxu flimkien b'qalb waħda u b'intenzjonijiet sinċieri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this sense, people act together with sincere intentions and a shared purpose.

collocations.en: the use of 'għalenija' in a sentence

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, 'għalenija' tiġi spjegata fis-sens ta' 'bla ħsieb'. It-tifsira 'flimkien b'qalb waħda' tiġi diskussa separatament.
formal.en: In this lesson, 'għalenija' is explained in the sense of 'without thought'. The meaning 'together with one heart' is discussed separately.
formal.zh: 本课先讲解 għalenija 的“不加思索”义，再单独讨论其“同心一起”的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: 'Għalenija' hawn tfisser 'bla ħsieb'? Mark: Iva, f'dan l-eżerċizzju. Imma għandha wkoll it-tifsira 'flimkien b'qalb waħda'.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does 'għalenija' mean 'without thought' here? Mark: Yes, in this exercise. But it also has the meaning 'together with one heart'.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 għalenija 是“不加思索”的意思吗？马克：是的，在这道练习里是这个意思。不过它也有“同心一起”的含义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 għalenija 是“不加思索”的意思吗？
messages.en: Does 'għalenija' mean 'without thought' here?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, f'dan l-eżerċizzju. Imma għandha wkoll it-tifsira 'flimkien b'qalb waħda'.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, f'dan l-eżerċizzju. Imma għandha wkoll it-tifsira 'flimkien b'qalb waħda'.
messages.zh: 是的，在这道练习里是这个意思。不过它也有“同心一起”的含义。
messages.en: Yes, in this exercise. But it also has the meaning 'together with one heart'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 għalenija 制作分义卡：一面画“不经思考就行动”，另一面画“众人同心”；“一起、如同一体”旁保留问号，提醒自己不要混淆不同义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a male person, as a recipient or beneficiary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某位男性是接受者或受益者，即“给他”或“为他”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tindika raġel jew tifel bħala l-persuna li tirċievi xi ħaġa jew li għaliha ssir xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为他；给他，指某位男性是接受者或受益者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li xi ħaġa tkun maħsuba għal raġel jew tifel, jew issir għall-benefiċċju tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is għalih, it is intended for him or done for his benefit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与人保持距离的；不主动亲近他人、显得疏离的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jżomm id-distanza minn nies oħra u ma jitħallatx wisq magħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone described this way keeps a social distance and does not readily mix with others.

formal.mt: Il-pakkett huwa għalih u għandu jingħata lilu personalment meta jasal fl-uffiċċju.
formal.en: The package is for him and should be handed to him personally when he arrives at the office.
formal.zh: 这个包裹是给他的，应在他到达办公室时亲手交给他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ir-rigal għal min hu? Mark: Għal Pawlu. Maja: U dan il-ktieb ukoll għalih? Mark: Iva, iħobb jaqra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is this gift for? Mark: For Pawlu. Maja: And is this book for him too? Mark: Yes, he loves reading.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份礼物是给谁的？马克：给保罗的。玛雅：这本书也是给他的吗？马克：是的，他喜欢阅读。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这份礼物是给谁的？
messages.en: Who is this gift for?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 给保罗的。
messages.en: For Pawlu.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书也是给他的吗？
messages.en: And is this book for him too?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，他喜欢阅读。
messages.en: Yes, he loves reading.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把礼物递向一位男性，说 għalih“给他”；再用 jibqa' għalih 的独处画面记住疏离义，靠语境区分两种含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For me, as the person receiving or benefiting from something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示说话者本人是接受者或受益者，即“给我”或“为我”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tindika lill-persuna li qed titkellem bħala dik li tirċievi xi ħaġa jew tibbenefika minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为我；给我，表示说话者是接受者或受益者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li xi ħaġa tkun maħsuba għall-persuna li qed titkellem jew issir għall-benefiċċju tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is għalija, I am the person it is intended for or meant to benefit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给我的；用于说明某物的接受者是说话者，例如“那份礼物是给我的”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fl-espressjoni 'dak ir-rigal għalija', tindika li r-rigal huwa maħsub għall-persuna li qed titkellem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this example, għalija identifies the speaker as the intended recipient of the gift.

formal.mt: Jekk tasal ittra għalija waqt li nkun barra, nitlobkom iżżommuha fl-uffiċċju sakemm nerġa' lura.
formal.en: If a letter for me arrives while I am away, please keep it in the office until I return.
formal.zh: 如果我外出期间有给我的信件寄到，请将其保存在办公室，等我回来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kejk għalija? Mark: Iva, għamiltu għalik. Maja: Grazzi! Se naqsam biċċa miegħek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this cake for me? Mark: Yes, I made it for you. Maja: Thanks! I'll share a piece with you.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个蛋糕是给我的吗？马克：是的，我为你做的。玛雅：谢谢！我会分一块给你。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个蛋糕是给我的吗？
messages.en: Is this cake for me?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我为你做的。
messages.en: Yes, I made it for you.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谢谢！我会分一块给你。
messages.en: Thanks! I'll share a piece with you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象收到礼物时指着自己问 għalija“给我的吗”；与指向他的 għalih 配对记忆，用手势牢牢记住接受者。

gloss_zh: 给你们；为你们；对你们而言

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression referring to two or more people as the recipients or beneficiaries of something, or as those whose perspective is considered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事物是给你们、为你们准备的，或表示从你们的角度来看；指两个或更多听话人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li xi ħaġa hi maħsuba għan-nies li qed tkellimhom, li huma aktar minn persuna waħda, jew li tirreferi għall-perspettiva tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给你们、为你们或对你们而言，指向两个或更多听话人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintuża meta xi ħaġa tingħata jew tkun maħsuba għal aktar minn persuna waħda li qed tkellimhom, jew meta titqies il-perspettiva tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use għalikom when something is intended for the people you are addressing, or when you refer to their perspective as a group.

formal.mt: Dan il-materjal tħejja għalikom biex jgħinkom tifhmu aħjar is-suġġett.
formal.en: This material was prepared for you all to help you understand the subject better.
formal.zh: 这份材料是为你们准备的，旨在帮助你们更好地理解这个主题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ġibt xi frott għalikom. Mark: Grazzi! Nistgħu nieħdu ftit issa?
colloquial.en: Lara: I brought some fruit for you all. Mark: Thanks! Can we have some now?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我给你们带了些水果。马克：谢谢！我们现在可以吃一点吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (老师)
messages.zh: 我给你们带了些水果。
messages.en: I brought some fruit for you all.

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 谢谢！我们现在可以吃一点吗？
messages.en: Thanks! Can we have some now?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师把一篮水果递给全班，说 għalikom；把整词和“给你们大家”一起记，注意对象是复数。

gloss_zh: 为我们；给我们；对我们而言

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression indicating that something is intended for us, benefits us, or is considered from our perspective.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事物是为我们安排、给我们使用或使我们受益的，也可表示从我们的角度而言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li xi ħaġa hi maħsuba għalina jew għall-ġid tagħna, jew li xi ħaġa titqies mill-perspettiva tagħna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为我们、给我们，或从我们的角度而言。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintuża biex turi li xi ħaġa hi maħsuba għall-kelliem u għal persuna jew persuni oħra miegħu, jew li tirreferi għall-perspettiva tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use għalina to indicate that something is intended for you and others in your group, or matters from your group's perspective.

formal.mt: Huwa importanti għalina li kull student ikollu aċċess għall-materjal tat-tagħlim.
formal.en: It is important to us that every student has access to the learning material.
formal.zh: 每位学生都能获取学习材料，这对我们很重要。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Hemm mejda għalina? Pawlu: Iva, żammejt mejda ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is there a table for us? Pawlu: Yes, I reserved a table by the window.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：有给我们的桌子吗？保罗：有，我订了一张靠窗的桌子。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 有给我们的桌子吗？
messages.en: Is there a table for us?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，我订了一张靠窗的桌子。
messages.en: Yes, I reserved a table by the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象你指着自己和同伴预订的桌子说 għalina，把整词记成“给我们”，和指向听众的“给你们”区分。

gloss_zh: 叙利亚飞廉（Notobasis syriaca，一种蓟类植物）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thistle belonging to the species Notobasis syriaca.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Notobasis syriaca 的叙利亚飞廉，是一种蓟类植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta bix-xewk tal-ispeċi Notobasis syriaca.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 叙利亚飞廉，学名 Notobasis syriaca，属于蓟类植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' pjanta bix-xewk magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Notobasis syriaca.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An għallis is a thistle of the species Notobasis syriaca, rather than a general name for every kind of thistle.

collocations.en: the spines of the Notobasis syriaca thistle

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-pjanta ġiet identifikata bħala għallis, bl-isem xjentifiku Notobasis syriaca.
formal.en: In the report, the plant was identified as għallis, with the scientific name Notobasis syriaca.
formal.zh: 报告将这株植物鉴定为叙利亚飞廉，其学名为 Notobasis syriaca。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Din il-pjanta x'jisimha? Ġużeppi: Din għallis. Oqgħod attenta għax għandha x-xewk.
colloquial.en: Marta: What is this plant called? Ġużeppi: This is a Notobasis syriaca thistle. Be careful, because it has spines.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这种植物叫什么？朱塞佩：这是叙利亚飞廉。小心，它有刺。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 这种植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant called?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (园艺老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din għallis. Oqgħod attenta għax għandha x-xewk.
messages.mt_standard: Din għallis. Oqgħod attenta għax għandha x-xewk.
messages.zh: 这是叙利亚飞廉。小心，它有刺。
messages.en: This is a Notobasis syriaca thistle. Be careful, because it has spines.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给带刺植物的图片贴上 għallis 和 Notobasis syriaca 两张标签，记住它指这一特定物种，不泛指所有蓟。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression stating that a female person closed her mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示一位女性已经闭上了嘴；在说话的情境中，也可表示她停止了说话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tgħid li persuna femminili għalqet ħalqha; f'kuntest ta' diskors tista' tindika li waqfet titkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 她闭上了嘴；若语境涉及交谈，可理解为她停止了说话。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi azzjoni li diġà seħħet, meta persuna femminili għalqet ħalqha, u tista' tindika wkoll li waqfet titkellem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a woman or girl għalqet ħalqha, she closed her mouth and, in a speaking context, may have stopped talking.

collocations.en: she closed her mouth and listened

formal.mt: Wara li spiċċat titkellem, Marija għalqet ħalqha u semgħet it-tweġiba tal-għalliema.
formal.en: After she finished speaking, Marija closed her mouth and listened to the teacher's answer.
formal.zh: 玛丽亚说完后闭上了嘴，听老师回答。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'għamlet Sara meta beda jitkellem Mark? Lara: Għalqet ħalqha u ħallietu jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Anna: What did Sara do when Mark started speaking? Lara: She closed her mouth and let him speak.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克开始说话时，萨拉做了什么？拉拉：她闭上了嘴，让他说。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għamlet Sara meta beda jitkellem Mark?
messages.mt_standard: X'għamlet Sara meta beda jitkellem Mark?
messages.zh: 马克开始说话时，萨拉做了什么？
messages.en: What did Sara do when Mark started speaking?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 她闭上了嘴，让他说。
messages.en: She closed her mouth and let him speak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句配成三格画面：“她—闭上了—自己的嘴”。记住 għalqet ħalqha 表示已经发生的动作，不是命令别人闭嘴。

gloss_zh: 我们的家、我们的住所；我们曾在这里居住

teaching_sense.en_definition: The home or dwelling place belonging to or used by us.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 我们居住的家或住所，侧重作为共同生活地点的居所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dar jew il-post fejn noqogħdu u li nqisuh bħala d-dar tagħna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我们的家；我们居住的地方或住所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bħala nom, din il-kelma tirreferi għad-dar tagħna jew għall-post li fih ngħixu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Our home is the place where we live and which we regard as our own dwelling.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我们过去曾在这里居住。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bħala verb, din il-kelma tfisser li aħna konna noqogħdu f'dan il-post fi żmien li għadda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If we lived here in the past, this place was our home during an earlier period.

collocations.en: we lived here for many years
collocations.zh: 我们曾在这里住了很多年

formal.mt: Għamarna hawn għal għaxar snin qabel ma morna noqogħdu f'belt oħra.
formal.en: We lived here for ten years before moving to another town.
formal.zh: 我们曾在这里住了十年，后来搬到了另一座城镇。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din hi d-dar fejn kontu toqogħdu? Pawlu: Iva, għamarna hawn meta konna żgħar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this the house where you used to live? Pawlu: Yes, we lived here when we were young.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这就是你们以前住的房子吗？保罗：是的，我们小时候住在这里。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din hi d-dar fejn kontu toqogħdu?
messages.mt_standard: Din hi d-dar fejn kontu toqogħdu?
messages.zh: 这就是你们以前住的房子吗？
messages.en: Is this the house where you used to live?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għamarna hawn meta konna żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għamarna hawn meta konna żgħar.
messages.zh: 是的，我们小时候住在这里。
messages.en: Yes, we lived here when we were young.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张句子卡分开记同形词：一张写“这是我们的家”，对应名词；另一张写“我们曾住在这里”，对应过去的居住行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hard substance formed from fossilized tree resin, often yellow or brown, that is used in jewellery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由树脂形成的化石状硬质材料，常呈黄色或棕色，可用于制作首饰，即琥珀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza iebsa magħmula minn raża tas-siġar li ffossilizzat, ħafna drabi safra jew kannella, u li tintuża fil-ġojjellerija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 琥珀；由树脂形成的化石状材料，通常呈黄色至棕色，常用于首饰。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għambar huwa raża tas-siġar li twebbset u ffossilizzat, ġeneralment ta' lewn isfar jew kannella, u jintuża biex isiru ornamenti u ġojjelli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Amber is hardened fossilized tree resin that is often polished and made into beads or other jewellery.

formal.mt: Fil-vetrina tal-mużew hemm biċċa għambar b'insett ippreservat ġo fiha.
formal.en: The museum display case contains a piece of amber with an insect preserved inside it.
formal.zh: 博物馆的展柜里有一块琥珀，里面保存着一只昆虫。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Minn xiex hi magħmula din il-ġiżirana? Rita: Mill-għambar. Jogħġobni ħafna l-kulur tagħha.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is this necklace made of? Rita: Amber. I really like its colour.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这条项链是什么做的？丽塔：琥珀做的。我很喜欢它的颜色。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn xiex hi magħmula din il-ġiżirana?
messages.mt_standard: Minn xiex hi magħmula din il-ġiżirana?
messages.zh: 这条项链是什么做的？
messages.en: What is this necklace made of?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 琥珀做的。我很喜欢它的颜色。
messages.en: Amber. I really like its colour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 għambar 就想象一条金棕色琥珀项链，再想象展柜里包着小昆虫的琥珀；把首饰和材料这两个画面连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a liquid or mixture thicker and less runny.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使液体或混合物变得更加浓稠，不再那么稀或容易流动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel likwidu jew taħlita aktar ħoxna u inqas fluwida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使液体或混合物变稠，增加其浓稠程度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din l-espressjoni tfisser li tagħmel likwidu jew taħlita aktar ħoxna, pereżempju billi żżid id-dqiq jew tħalli parti mill-ilma tevapora.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you thicken a liquid or mixture, you make it less runny and give it a heavier consistency.

formal.mt: Il-kok żied ftit dqiq u għamel il-brodu aktar sfiq qabel ma servieh.
formal.en: The cook added a little flour and thickened the broth before serving it.
formal.zh: 厨师加了少许面粉，把汤汁调得更浓稠后才端上桌。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-brodu jidher aktar sfiq illum. Toni: Iva, żidt ftit dqiq. Dak għamel il-brodu aktar sfiq.
colloquial.en: Sara: The broth looks thicker today. Toni: Yes, I added a little flour. That made the broth thicker.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今天的汤汁看起来更浓稠。托尼：是的，我加了少许面粉。这样汤汁就变稠了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 今天的汤汁看起来更浓稠。
messages.en: The broth looks thicker today.

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żidt ftit dqiq. Dak għamel il-brodu aktar sfiq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żidt ftit dqiq. Dak għamel il-brodu aktar sfiq.
messages.zh: 是的，我加了少许面粉。这样汤汁就变稠了。
messages.en: Yes, I added a little flour. That made the broth thicker.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给稀汤加入一点面粉，搅拌后汤汁变稠：用“加入材料—浓稠度增加”的动作链记住整个表达，并留意 sfiq 随所描述名词变成 sfiqa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To risk money or something else on an uncertain result, or make an agreement based on a prediction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 就尚未确定的结果打赌，约定输赢后付出金钱或其他东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirriskja flus jew xi ħaġa oħra fuq riżultat mhux ċert, jew jagħmel ftehim ma' xi ħadd dwar min għandu raġun fi tbassir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某个不确定的结果下注，或与人约定以输赢决定付出什么。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel ftehim li fih jirbaħ jew jitlef flus jew xi ħaġa oħra skont ir-riżultat ta' avveniment jew tbassir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you bet on an outcome, you risk money or something else on whether that outcome occurs.

collocations.en: made a bet with his friend

formal.mt: Mark għamel imħatra ta' ħames ewro ma' ħabibu li t-tim tiegħu kien se jirbaħ il-logħba.
formal.en: Mark bet his friend five euros that his team would win the match.
formal.zh: Mark 和朋友打赌五欧元，赌自己的球队会赢得比赛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark għamel imħatra miegħek fuq il-logħba? Pawlu: Iva, min jitlef iħallas il-kafè!
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Mark make a bet with you on the match? Pawlu: Yes, whoever loses pays for the coffee!
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 跟你就这场比赛打赌了吗？Pawlu：对，谁输了谁请喝咖啡！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark għamel imħatra miegħek fuq il-logħba?
messages.mt_standard: Mark għamel imħatra miegħek fuq il-logħba?
messages.zh: Mark 跟你就这场比赛打赌了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark make a bet with you on the match?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，谁输了谁请喝咖啡！
messages.en: Yes, whoever loses pays for the coffee!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友赛前约定“输了请喝咖啡”，用这个小场景记住整个短语。再把“跟谁赌”和“赌多少”作为两种搭配练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pass urine out of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将尿液排出体外，即排尿或小便。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ l-awrina minn ġismu meta jmur jagħmel il-bżonnijiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排出尿液；小便。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jgħaddi l-awrina mill-bużżieqa tal-awrina għal barra mill-ġisem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a person urinates, urine passes from their bladder out of their body.

formal.mt: Il-pazjent għamel l-awrina qabel l-eżami u mbagħad irritorna fil-kamra tal-istennija.
formal.en: The patient urinated before the examination and then returned to the waiting room.
formal.zh: 患者在检查前排了尿，然后回到候诊室。

colloquial.mt: Sara: It-tifel għamel l-awrina qabel tlaqna? David: Iva, mar it-tojlit eżatt qabel ħriġna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did the boy pee before we left? David: Yes, he went to the toilet just before we went out.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们出发前，孩子小便了吗？David：小便了，他就在我们出门前去了厕所。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.zh: 我们出发前，孩子小便了吗？
messages.en: Did the boy pee before we left?

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, mar it-tojlit eżatt qabel ħriġna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, mar it-tojlit eżatt qabel ħriġna.
messages.zh: 小便了，他就在我们出门前去了厕所。
messages.en: Yes, he went to the toilet just before we went out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“出门前先去厕所小便”的日常画面记忆整个短语，并把 l-awrina 与“尿液”对应起来；整组表达说的是排尿这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To travel by asking passing drivers to give you a free lift.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向路过的司机请求免费搭乘，以这种方式前往目的地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jivvjaġġa billi jitlob lis-sewwieqa li jkunu għaddejjin jagħtuh rikba bla ħlas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在路边向过往车辆请求免费搭乘；搭便车旅行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jitlob rikba bla ħlas mingħand sewwieqa li jkunu għaddejjin u jivvjaġġa b'dan il-mod.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you hitchhike, you travel by asking passing drivers to take you along without charging you.

formal.mt: Wara li tilef l-aħħar karozza tal-linja, l-istudent għamel l-awtostop biex jasal id-dar.
formal.en: After missing the last bus, the student hitchhiked home.
formal.zh: 错过末班公交车后，这名学生搭便车回了家。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif wasal id-dar Mark ilbieraħ? Luqa: Għamel l-awtostop, u sewwieq tah rikba sa ħdejn daru.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did Mark get home yesterday? Luqa: He hitchhiked, and a driver gave him a lift to near his house.
colloquial.zh: Nina：Mark 昨天怎么回家的？Luqa：他搭了便车，一位司机把他送到了家附近。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 昨天怎么回家的？
messages.en: How did Mark get home yesterday?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamel l-awtostop, u sewwieq tah rikba sa ħdejn daru.
messages.mt_standard: Għamel l-awtostop, u sewwieq tah rikba sa ħdejn daru.
messages.zh: 他搭了便车，一位司机把他送到了家附近。
messages.en: He hitchhiked, and a driver gave him a lift to near his house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象路边招手、司机停车、顺路载你一程的连续画面，用它记住“搭便车”。练习时接上目的地，把整个短语和行程一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a stitch in fabric, or to express a particular point in a discussion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用针线在布料上缝一针；也可指在讨论中提出某个观点或要点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħjata bil-labra u l-ħajt, jew jesprimi idea jew argument waqt diskussjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用针线缝一针，使布料连接或固定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jgħaddi labra bil-ħajt minn ġod-drapp biex jgħaqqad jew iżomm biċċiet tad-drapp flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone stitches, they pass a needle and thread through fabric to join or secure it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在谈话、讨论或论证中提出一个明确的观点或要点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jesprimi idea jew argument partikolari biex jiġbed l-attenzjoni għal xi ħaġa waqt taħdita jew diskussjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone makes a point, they express a particular idea or argument for others to consider.

collocations.en: made a stitch with the needle
made a stitch at the edge of the fabric
made an important point in the discussion
collocations.zh: 在讨论中提出了一个重要观点

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, ir-riċerkatur għamel punt importanti dwar il-ħtieġa li tinġabar aktar informazzjoni.
formal.en: In his report, the researcher made an important point about the need to collect more information.
formal.zh: 研究人员在报告中提出了一个重要观点：需要收集更多信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min waħħal din il-biċċa drapp? Pawlu: Ħija għamel punt bil-labra biex iżommha f'postha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who attached this piece of fabric? Pawlu: My brother made a stitch with the needle to hold it in place.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这块布是谁固定上的？保罗：我哥哥用针缝了一针，把它固定住了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这块布是谁固定上的？
messages.en: Who attached this piece of fabric?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija għamel punt bil-labra biex iżommha f'postha.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija għamel punt bil-labra biex iżommha f'postha.
messages.zh: 我哥哥用针缝了一针，把它固定住了。
messages.en: My brother made a stitch with the needle to hold it in place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个场景配对记忆：针线旁是“缝一针”，讨论桌旁是“提出一个观点”；依靠语境选择意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To nod one's head as a signal, for example to show agreement or acknowledgment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过点头发出信号，例如表示同意、知晓或回应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċaqlaq rasu biex jagħti sinjal, pereżempju biex juri li jaqbel jew li fehem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 点了点头，以表示同意、知晓或向他人示意。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċaqlaq rasu biex juri li jaqbel, li fehem jew li ried jagħti sinjal lil xi ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone nodded, they moved their head to show agreement, acknowledgment, or another signal.

collocations.mt: għamel sinjal b'rasu biex juri li jaqbel
għamel sinjal b'rasu mingħajr ma tkellem

formal.mt: Wara li sema' l-proposta, id-direttur għamel sinjal b'rasu biex juri li jaqbel.
formal.en: After hearing the proposal, the director nodded to show his agreement.
formal.zh: 听完提案后，主管点头表示同意。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Staqsejtu jekk riedx jiġi magħna? Mark: Iva, għamel sinjal b'rasu u mar iġib il-ġakketta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you ask him whether he wanted to come with us? Mark: Yes, he nodded and went to get his jacket.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你问他想不想和我们一起去了吗？马克：问了，他点了点头，就去拿外套了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你问他想不想和我们一起去了吗？
messages.en: Did you ask him whether he wanted to come with us?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għamel sinjal b'rasu u mar iġib il-ġakketta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għamel sinjal b'rasu u mar iġib il-ġakketta.
messages.zh: 问了，他点了点头，就去拿外套了。
messages.en: Yes, he nodded and went to get his jacket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象别人问你是否同意，你不用开口，只点一下头；把整句与“用头发出信号”的动作一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pretend to be in a particular state or to behave as though something were true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 假装自己处于某种状态，或表现得仿佛某件并非事实的事情是真的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jippretendi li jinsab f'xi stat jew iġib ruħu bħallikieku xi ħaġa kienet vera meta ma tkunx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过行为或表现装出某种状态，使人以为这种状态是真实的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Juri bil-mod kif iġib ruħu li jinsab f'ċerta kundizzjoni jew li xi ħaġa hija vera, għalkemm fil-fatt mhux hekk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone simulates a condition, they behave as though they have it even though they do not.

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju tat-taħriġ, l-attur għamel tabirruħu marid sabiex l-istudenti jipprattikaw kif jistaqsu lill-pazjent dwar is-sintomi.
formal.en: During the training exercise, the actor simulated being ill so that the students could practise asking a patient about symptoms.
formal.zh: 在培训练习中，演员扮作病人，让学生练习询问患者的症状。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ħuk ma weġibx meta sejjaħtlu? Nina: Għamel tabirruħu rieqed għax ma riedx iqum.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why didn't your brother answer when you called him? Nina: He pretended to be asleep because he didn't want to get up.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你叫你弟弟时，他为什么不回答？妮娜：他不想起床，就假装睡着了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħuk ma weġibx meta sejjaħtlu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħuk ma weġibx meta sejjaħtlu?
messages.zh: 你叫你弟弟时，他为什么不回答？
messages.en: Why didn't your brother answer when you called him?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamel tabirruħu rieqed għax ma riedx iqum.
messages.mt_standard: Għamel tabirruħu rieqed għax ma riedx iqum.
messages.zh: 他不想起床，就假装睡着了。
messages.en: He pretended to be asleep because he didn't want to get up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住一个装睡的小场景：人其实醒着，却闭眼不回应；把整个短语与“表现出来的状态并不真实”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To vouch for something, guarantee an obligation, or provide the money needed to pay for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某事的真实性或可靠性作保，担保某项义务得到履行，或拿出资金支付某项开支。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jassigura li xi ħaġa hija vera jew ta' min joqgħod fuqha, jiggarantixxi li obbligu jitwettaq, jew jipprovdi l-flus biex titħallas xi spiża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某事的真实性、品质或可靠性作出保证。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħti assigurazzjoni li xi ħaġa hija vera, ta' kwalità tajba jew ta' min joqgħod fuqha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone warrants something, they give an assurance that it is true, reliable, or of an acceptable quality.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 承担担保责任，保证某项承诺、付款或其他义务得到履行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jieħu r-responsabbiltà li wegħda tinżamm, ħlas isir jew obbligu ieħor jitwettaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone guarantees an obligation, they accept responsibility for ensuring that it is fulfilled.

sense_translations.en_definition: to put up the money for
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拿出所需资金，为某项活动、购买或开支付款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jipprovdi l-flus meħtieġa biex titħallas attività, xirja jew spiża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone puts up the money for something, they provide the funds needed to pay for it.

collocations.en: vouched for the quality of the work

collocations.zh: 为兄弟的债务提供担保

collocations.en: put up the money for the travel expenses

formal.mt: Biex l-attività setgħet issir, l-isponsor għamel tajjeb għall-ispejjeż kollha tal-organizzazzjoni.
formal.en: To enable the event to take place, the sponsor provided the money for all the costs of organising it.
formal.zh: 为使活动能够举行，赞助方出资支付了全部筹办费用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif irnexxielu ħuk jieħu s-self? Pawlu: Missieri għamel tajjeb għalih u wiegħed li jħallas jekk ħija ma jkunx jista'.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did your brother manage to get the loan? Pawlu: My father acted as his guarantor and promised to pay if my brother couldn't.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你哥哥是怎么贷到款的？保罗：我父亲为他作了担保，答应如果哥哥还不了，就由他来还。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥是怎么贷到款的？
messages.en: How did your brother manage to get the loan?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri għamel tajjeb għalih u wiegħed li jħallas jekk ħija ma jkunx jista'.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri għamel tajjeb għalih u wiegħed li jħallas jekk ħija ma jkunx jista'.
messages.zh: 我父亲为他作了担保，答应如果哥哥还不了，就由他来还。
messages.en: My father acted as his guarantor and promised to pay if my brother couldn't.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面区分义项：为质量拍胸脯是“作保”，为债务签担保书是“担保”，拿钱付旅费是“出资支付”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To officially decide what punishment a person found guilty should receive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由法官或法院对被判有罪的人正式裁定刑罚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeċiedi uffiċjalment, bħala mħallef jew qorti, il-piena li għandha tingħata lil persuna misjuba ħatja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对被判有罪的人判处刑罚。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħti deċiżjoni uffiċjali dwar il-piena ta' persuna li tkun instabet ħatja ta' reat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a judge sentences someone, the judge officially decides what punishment that person must receive.

collocations.en: passed sentence in accordance with the law

formal.mt: Wara li sema' l-provi kollha, l-imħallef għamel ħaqq mill-akkużat u kkundannah għal sentejn ħabs.
formal.en: After hearing all the evidence, the judge sentenced the accused to two years in prison.
formal.zh: 听取全部证据后，法官判处被告两年监禁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-imħallef diġà għamel ħaqq mill-akkużat? Mark: Iva, tah sentejn ħabs.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the judge sentenced the accused yet? Mark: Yes, he gave him two years in prison.
colloquial.zh: Maja：法官已经对被告判刑了吗？Mark：是的，判了他两年监禁。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 法官已经对被告判刑了吗？
messages.en: Has the judge sentenced the accused yet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，判了他两年监禁。
messages.en: Yes, he gave him two years in prison.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语放进法庭画面：法官听完证据，宣布刑罚。连着“法官、被告、判几年”一起记，就能抓住这里的“判刑”义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take a short, leisurely walk; this expression is in the past tense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 悠闲地散一会儿步或走一小段路；此处为过去时表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mar għal mixja qasira u bil-mod, għall-mistrieħ jew għall-pjaċir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悠闲地散步，通常只走一小段路。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mar jimxi għal ftit ħin, mingħajr għaġla u għall-pjaċir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone takes a stroll, they walk slowly and comfortably for pleasure.

collocations.en: took a short stroll by the sea
took a short stroll after the meal

formal.mt: Wara l-laqgħa, id-direttur għamel żewġ passi fil-ġnien biex jistrieħ ftit.
formal.en: After the meeting, the director took a short stroll in the garden to relax for a while.
formal.zh: 会议结束后，主任在花园里散了一会儿步，放松一下。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar Pawlu wara l-ikel? Mark: Għamel żewġ passi ħdejn il-baħar u mbagħad ġie lura.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did Pawlu go after the meal? Mark: He took a short stroll by the sea and then came back.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 吃完饭去哪儿了？Mark：他到海边散了一会儿步，然后就回来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 吃完饭去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Pawlu go after the meal?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamel żewġ passi ħdejn il-baħar u mbagħad ġie lura.
messages.mt_standard: Għamel żewġ passi ħdejn il-baħar u mbagħad ġie lura.
messages.zh: 他到海边散了一会儿步，然后就回来了。
messages.en: He took a short stroll by the sea and then came back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句与“饭后出去走走”的画面绑定记忆；这里表达悠闲散步，不必理解成严格只走两步。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Gentle songs sung to help babies or young children fall asleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为帮助婴幼儿入睡而轻柔演唱的歌曲；此词为复数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kanzunetti ħelwin u kalmi li jitkantaw lit-trabi jew lit-tfal żgħar biex jgħinuhom jorqdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻柔舒缓、用来哄婴儿或幼童入睡的歌曲，指多首摇篮曲。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kanzunetti b'ritmu kalm u ħoss ħelu li jitkantaw biex iserrħu lit-trabi jew lit-tfal żgħar u jgħinuhom jorqdu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Lullabies are gentle songs that people sing to babies or young children to help them sleep.

formal.mt: Il-ġabra tinkludi għamjiet tradizzjonali li l-ġenituri kienu jkantaw lit-tfal qabel l-irqad.
formal.en: The collection includes traditional lullabies that parents used to sing to their children before bedtime.
formal.zh: 这部选集收录了父母过去在孩子睡前演唱的传统摇篮曲。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif tgħinha torqod lit-tarbija? Lina: Inkantalha xi għamjiet b'leħen baxx.
colloquial.en: Sara: How do you help the baby fall asleep? Lina: I sing her some lullabies in a soft voice.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你怎么哄宝宝入睡？Lina：我会轻声给她唱几首摇篮曲。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么哄宝宝入睡？
messages.en: How do you help the baby fall asleep?

messages.speaker: Lina (母亲)
messages.zh: 我会轻声给她唱几首摇篮曲。
messages.en: I sing her some lullabies in a soft voice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象睡前轻声唱歌哄宝宝的场景，把 għamjiet 与“几首摇篮曲”一起记，注意这里是复数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to say that rain fell at a particular time in the past.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示过去某个时候下了雨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex jingħad li niżlet ix-xita f'ħin jew f'perjodu fil-passat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下雨；此表达具体表示过去下了雨。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Niżel ilma mis-sħab lejn l-art f'għamla ta' qtar; f'din l-espressjoni, dan seħħ fil-passat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When it rains, drops of water fall from clouds to the ground.

formal.mt: Il-bieraħ għamlet ix-xita matul il-lejl, u għalhekk l-attività ta' filgħodu saret ġewwa.
formal.en: It rained during the night yesterday, so the morning activity was held indoors.
formal.zh: 昨天夜里下了雨，因此上午的活动改在室内举行。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex l-art għadha mxarrba? Maja: Għamlet ix-xita dalgħodu, qabel ma qomt.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is the ground still wet? Maja: It rained this morning, before you got up.
colloquial.zh: Mark：地面怎么还湿着？Maja：今天早上你起床之前下雨了。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 地面怎么还湿着？
messages.en: Why is the ground still wet?

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamlet ix-xita dalgħodu, qabel ma qomt.
messages.mt_standard: Għamlet ix-xita dalgħodu, qabel ma qomt.
messages.zh: 今天早上你起床之前下雨了。
messages.en: It rained this morning, before you got up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到湿地面，回想“刚才下雨了”，把 għamlet ix-xita 整块记作过去发生的下雨事件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A Spanish sparrow, a small bird belonging to the sparrow group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 西班牙麻雀，一种属于麻雀类的小型鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur żgħir tat-tip tal-għasafar tal-bejt, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala Spanish sparrow.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 西班牙麻雀，麻雀类的一种小型鸟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għasfur żgħir li jappartjeni għall-grupp tal-għasafar tal-bejt u li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ Spanish sparrow.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A Spanish sparrow is a small bird belonging to the sparrow group.

collocations.en: a Spanish sparrow on a branch
collocations.zh: 枝头上的一只西班牙麻雀

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar, l-istudenti raw għammiel tal-bejt fuq fergħa.
formal.en: During the birdwatching activity, the students saw a Spanish sparrow on a branch.
formal.zh: 在观鸟活动中，学生们看到枝头上有一只西班牙麻雀。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak l-għammiel tal-bejt fuq il-fergħa! | Pawlu: Rajtu! Ejja nosservawh minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that Spanish sparrow on the branch! | Pawlu: I see it! Let's watch it from here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看枝头上那只西班牙麻雀！ | Pawlu：看到了！我们就在这里观察它吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak l-għammiel tal-bejt fuq il-fergħa!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak l-għammiel tal-bejt fuq il-fergħa!
messages.zh: 看枝头上那只西班牙麻雀！
messages.en: Look at that Spanish sparrow on the branch!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了！我们就在这里观察它吧。
messages.en: I see it! Let's watch it from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上一张西班牙麻雀停在枝头的图来记；每次指图说出全称，避免只记住其中一个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to produce abundant growth or offspring, especially describing land that supports crops well.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够旺盛生长、繁衍或产出丰富成果的；尤其用于描述适合庄稼生长的肥沃土地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jipproduċi ħafna jew jagħti l-ħajja lil ħafna frieħ, speċjalment meta jingħad għal raba' fejn l-uċuħ jikbru tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肥沃的，能使作物良好生长并有较多产出的；也可指具有繁殖能力的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu l-kapaċità li jipproduċi jew jirriproduċi, u li, meta jirreferi għal raba', jgħin lill-pjanti jikbru u jagħtu ħsad tajjeb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Land that is fertile supports healthy plant growth and can produce good crops.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-wied bħala għammieli, b'art tajba għat-tkabbir tal-uċuħ.
formal.en: The report describes the valley as fertile, with land well suited to growing crops.
formal.zh: 报告将这片山谷描述为肥沃之地，其土地适合种植作物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ir-raba' jidher għammieli. Pawlu: Iva, il-ħxejjex jikbru tajjeb hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: This farmland looks fertile. Pawlu: Yes, vegetables grow well here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这片农田看起来很肥沃。Pawlu：是啊，蔬菜在这里长得很好。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 这片农田看起来很肥沃。
messages.en: This farmland looks fertile.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.zh: 是啊，蔬菜在这里长得很好。
messages.en: Yes, vegetables grow well here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一片蔬菜茂盛、收成丰富的农田，把 raba' għammieli 作为“肥沃农田”的完整搭配来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Stratus cloud, which forms a low, fairly uniform layer across the sky.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 层云，通常在低空形成较均匀云层的云。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' sħab baxx li jifforma saff pjuttost uniformi fis-sema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 层云，呈较均匀层状分布的低云。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' sħab li jkun baxx u jinfirex bħala saff pjuttost uniformi fis-sema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Stratus cloud is low cloud that spreads across the sky in a fairly uniform layer.

formal.mt: L-osservazzjonijiet ta' filgħodu juru saff ta' għammiem baxx fuq iż-żona.
formal.en: The morning observations show a layer of low stratus cloud over the area.
formal.zh: 早晨的观测显示，该地区上空有一层低空层云。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak is-sħab li jidher bħal saff wieħed? | Mark: Dak għammiem; illum qed jgħatti ħafna mis-sema.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that cloud that looks like one continuous layer? | Mark: That's stratus cloud; it's covering much of the sky today.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那种看起来连成一层的云是什么？ | Mark：那是层云，今天遮住了大半片天空。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak is-sħab li jidher bħal saff wieħed?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak is-sħab li jidher bħal saff wieħed?
messages.zh: 那种看起来连成一层的云是什么？
messages.en: What is that cloud that looks like one continuous layer?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak għammiem; illum qed jgħatti ħafna mis-sema.
messages.mt_standard: Dak għammiem; illum qed jgħatti ħafna mis-sema.
messages.zh: 那是层云，今天遮住了大半片天空。
messages.en: That's stratus cloud; it's covering much of the sky today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象天空铺着一张平整的灰色毯子，把 għammiem 与这种成层铺开的云景一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: During the calendar year immediately before the current year.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 去年，即当前年份之前的那个公历年。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Matul is-sena li ġiet eżatt qabel is-sena attwali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 去年；在当前年份的前一年。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fis-sena li għaddiet, jiġifieri s-sena immedjatament qabel dik attwali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happened last year, it happened during the calendar year before the current one.

formal.mt: Għamnewwel, l-iskola organizzat kors ġdid tal-Malti għall-adulti.
formal.en: Last year, the school organized a new Maltese course for adults.
formal.zh: 去年，这所学校为成年人开设了一门新的马耳他语课程。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Meta bdejt titgħallem il-Malti? | David: Għamnewwel, u għadni mmur għal-lezzjonijiet kull ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: When did you start learning Maltese? | David: Last year, and I still go to lessons every week.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你什么时候开始学马耳他语的？ | David：去年开始的，现在仍然每周去上课。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你什么时候开始学马耳他语的？
messages.en: When did you start learning Maltese?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamnewwel, u għadni mmur għal-lezzjonijiet kull ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Għamnewwel, u għadni mmur għal-lezzjonijiet kull ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 去年开始的，现在仍然每周去上课。
messages.en: Last year, and I still go to lessons every week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历上先圈出今年，再向前翻一个年份，把 għamnewwel 写在那一页，记成“去年”而非“过去十二个月”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: On behalf of a person or group, as their representative.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 代表某人或某个群体，以其名义说话或办事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bħala rappreżentant ta' persuna jew ta' grupp, meta wieħed jitkellem jew jaġixxi għalihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于“代表……、以……的名义”的表达，表示替某人或某个群体发言或行动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li xi ħadd qed jitkellem jew jaġixxi bħala rappreżentant ta' persuna jew ta' grupp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you speak or act on someone's behalf, you represent that person in what you say or do.

collocations.en: I speak on behalf of my colleagues
I write on behalf of Marija

formal.mt: Qed nikteb għan-nom ta' sħabi biex nirringrazzjakom tal-għajnuna li tajtuna.
formal.en: I am writing on behalf of my colleagues to thank you for the help you gave us.
formal.zh: 我谨代表同事们致信，感谢你们给予我们的帮助。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se titkellem għan-nom ta' min fil-laqgħa? David: Għan-nom ta' sħabi; huma talbuni nwassal l-ideat tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who will you speak on behalf of at the meeting? David: My colleagues; they asked me to share their ideas.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你要在会上代表谁发言？David：代表我的同事们；他们请我转达他们的想法。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Se titkellem għan-nom ta' min fil-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Se titkellem għan-nom ta' min fil-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 你要在会上代表谁发言？
messages.en: Who will you speak on behalf of at the meeting?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għan-nom ta' sħabi; huma talbuni nwassal l-ideat tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Għan-nom ta' sħabi; huma talbuni nwassal l-ideat tagħhom.
messages.zh: 代表我的同事们；他们请我转达他们的想法。
messages.en: My colleagues; they asked me to share their ideas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għan-nom ta' 整块记成“代表……”，想象自己拿着同事的发言稿；后面接的人或群体就是你所代表的对象。

gloss_zh: 她有；应当做的事（名词义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expresses that a female person possesses something or has a particular quality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“她有”，用于说明女性拥有某物或具有某种特征。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tesprimi li persuna femminili għandha xi ħaġa jew xi kwalità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 她有；表示女性拥有某物或具有某种特征。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Forma li tindika li mara jew tifla għandha xi ħaġa jew xi karatteristika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to say that a female person possesses something or has a particular quality.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 应当做的事；被视为义务或符合期待的事情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li persuna tqis li għandha tagħmel minħabba dmir jew aspettattiva.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A should is something a person feels obliged or expected to do.

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju 'Marija għanda esperjenza fit-tagħlim', il-forma 'għanda' tesprimi li Marija għandha din l-esperjenza.
formal.en: In the example 'Marija has teaching experience', the form 'għanda' expresses that Marija has this experience.
formal.zh: 在例句“Marija 有教学经验”中，għanda 表示 Marija 具有这种经验。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Sara għanda l-ktieb li għandna bżonn? | Mark: Iva, u tista' ġġibu magħha għada.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does Sara have the book we need? | Mark: Yes, and she can bring it with her tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Sara 有我们需要的那本书吗？ | Mark：有，她明天可以带来。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Sara għanda l-ktieb li għandna bżonn?
messages.mt_standard: Sara għandha l-ktieb li għandna bżonn?
messages.zh: Sara 有我们需要的那本书吗？
messages.en: Does Sara have the book we need?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u tista' ġġibu magħha għada.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u tista' ġġibu magħha għada.
messages.zh: 有，她明天可以带来。
messages.en: Yes, and she can bring it with her tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两张卡片记忆：动词卡画“她手里有一本书”，名词卡写“一件应当做的事”；用不同画面区分两个词性和意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: They became wealthy or acquired substantial wealth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 他们或她们变得富有，拥有了较多财富。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Huma saru sinjuri jew kisbu ħafna ġid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他们或她们变得富有了。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huma saru sinjuri u kellhom ħafna aktar flus jew ġid minn qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If people got rich, they acquired enough money or possessions to become wealthy.

formal.mt: Is-sidien għanew wara snin ta' kummerċ ma' pajjiżi oħra.
formal.en: The owners became wealthy after years of trading with other countries.
formal.zh: 这些业主经过多年与其他国家开展贸易后，变得富有了。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif għanew dawk it-tnejn? Pawlu: In-negozju tagħhom mar tajjeb ħafna.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did those two get rich? Pawlu: Their business did very well.
colloquial.zh: Marija：那两个人是怎么富起来的？Pawlu：他们的生意做得非常好。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 那两个人是怎么富起来的？
messages.en: How did those two get rich?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们的生意做得非常好。
messages.en: Their business did very well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għanew 和“他们以前没这么富，现在富起来了”的前后对比画面一起记，突出复数人物和已经发生的变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Musical compositions with words that are sung.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有歌词、供人演唱的音乐作品，指多首歌曲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompożizzjonijiet mużikali bi kliem li jitkanta, bħal dawk li nisimgħu f'kunċert jew inkantaw flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 歌曲；带有歌词、供人演唱的音乐作品的复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċiet ta' mużika bi kliem li jitkanta minn persuna waħda jew minn grupp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Songs are pieces of music whose words are sung by one or more people.

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-kunċert jinkludi għanjiet tradizzjonali Maltin interpretati mill-kor tal-iskola.
formal.en: The concert programme includes traditional Maltese songs performed by the school choir.
formal.zh: 音乐会节目包括由学校合唱团演唱的马耳他传统歌曲。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Liema għanjiet se nkantaw illejla? Mark: Ejja nibdew b'dawk li nafu lkoll.
colloquial.en: Anna: Which songs are we going to sing tonight? Mark: Let's start with the ones we all know.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我们今晚要唱哪些歌？Mark：先唱大家都会的那些吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们今晚要唱哪些歌？
messages.en: Which songs are we going to sing tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nibdew b'dawk li nafu lkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nibdew b'dawk li nafu lkoll.
messages.zh: 先唱大家都会的那些吧。
messages.en: Let's start with the ones we all know.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għanjiet 想成播放列表里的一首首歌曲，记住这里表示多首，搭配“传统歌曲”和“唱歌”一起练习。

gloss_zh: 毫无价值的；长满海葱的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Worthless; in a separate sense, full of squill plants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可以形容事物毫无价值；另一个独立义项形容地方长满海葱这种植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma għandu ebda valur; f'tifsira oħra, li hu mimli pjanti tal-għansar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毫无价值的；没有用处或不值得重视的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma għandu ebda valur jew li ma jiswa għal xejn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is worthless has no value or serves no useful purpose.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长满海葱的；遍布海葱这种植物的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li fih jikbru ħafna pjanti tal-għansar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A place described as full of squills has many squill plants growing in it.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-qasam bħala għansli, jiġifieri mimli pjanti tal-għansar.
formal.en: The report describes the field as full of squills, meaning that many squill plants grow there.
formal.zh: 报告用 għansli 形容这块田地，意思是那里长满了海葱。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dan l-oġġett għansli? Luqa: Iva, ma jiswa għal xejn; lanqas jaħdem.
colloquial.en: Marta: Is this object worthless? Luqa: Yes, it's of no use; it doesn't even work.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这个东西毫无价值吗？Luqa：是啊，一点用也没有，连运转都不行。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个东西毫无价值吗？
messages.en: Is this object worthless?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma jiswa għal xejn; lanqas jaħdem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma jiswa għal xejn; lanqas jaħdem.
messages.zh: 是啊，一点用也没有，连运转都不行。
messages.en: Yes, it's of no use; it doesn't even work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 għansli 配两张独立记忆卡：一张画毫无价值的废物，另一张画长满海葱的田地；按上下文选义，不把两个意思互相推导。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Using clever tricks or deception to achieve an aim.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了达到目的而耍心机或使用欺骗手段的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juża l-makakkerija jew il-qerq biex jilħaq l-għan tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狡猾而善于欺骗的；会通过耍心机达到目的的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jaġixxi b'makakkerija u jqarraq b'ħaddieħor biex jikseb dak li jrid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is cunning and deceitful uses clever tricks to mislead other people.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, in-negozjant għaqquxi jqarraq bil-klijenti biex iżid il-profitt tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the cunning trader deceives his customers to increase his profit.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个诡诈的商人欺骗顾客，以增加自己的利润。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tafdah lil dak ir-raġel? Mark: Le, huwa għaqquxi u diġà qarraq bija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you trust that man? Mark: No, he is deceitful and has already tricked me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你信任那个男人吗？马克：不信，他很诡诈，已经骗过我了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你信任那个男人吗？
messages.en: Do you trust that man?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa għaqquxi u diġà qarraq bija.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa għaqquxi u diġà qarraq bija.
messages.zh: 不信，他很诡诈，已经骗过我了。
messages.en: No, he is deceitful and has already tricked me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għaqquxi 和“商人耍心机骗人”的场景一起记，突出狡猾与欺骗，别只记成聪明。

gloss_zh: 使产生轻微快感；使感到愉悦的刺激

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce a light feeling of pleasure or excitement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给予轻微刺激，使人产生快感或兴奋感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqajjem sensazzjoni ħafifa ta' pjaċir jew eċċitament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过轻微刺激使人产生愉悦或兴奋的感觉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jistimula lil xi ħadd b'mod ħafif u jqajjem fih sensazzjoni ta' pjaċir jew eċċitament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something titillates you, it gives you a slight feeling of pleasure or excitement.

formal.mt: Il-mess ħafif tar-rix għargħax il-ġilda u qajjem sensazzjoni ta' pjaċir.
formal.en: The light touch of the feather titillated the skin and produced a pleasurable sensation.
formal.zh: 羽毛的轻柔触碰刺激了皮肤，带来一阵轻微的快感。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tbissimt meta messek ir-rix? Mark: Għargħax il-ġilda tiegħi; kienet sensazzjoni pjaċevoli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you smile when the feather touched you? Mark: It titillated my skin; it felt pleasant.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：羽毛碰到你的时候，你为什么笑了？马克：它碰得我皮肤有点酥痒，感觉挺舒服。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 羽毛碰到你的时候，你为什么笑了？
messages.en: Why did you smile when the feather touched you?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għargħax il-ġilda tiegħi; kienet sensazzjoni pjaċevoli.
messages.mt_standard: Għargħax il-ġilda tiegħi; kienet sensazzjoni pjaċevoli.
messages.zh: 它碰得我皮肤有点酥痒，感觉挺舒服。
messages.en: It titillated my skin; it felt pleasant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“羽毛轻触皮肤，带来微微快感”的画面记 għargħax，把轻微刺激和愉悦感觉连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clouds that have a soft, gentle appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外观看起来柔软、轻绵的云。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sħab li għandu dehra ratba u ħafifa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 看上去柔软轻绵的云。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sħab b'dehra ratba, li jagħti l-impressjoni ta' xi ħaġa ħafifa u delikata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Soft clouds are clouds whose appearance suggests a gentle, delicate texture.

formal.mt: Filgħodu, għarixa bajda dehret fuq l-għoljiet taħt id-dawl tax-xemx.
formal.en: In the morning, soft white clouds appeared above the hills in the sunlight.
formal.zh: 清晨，柔软轻绵的白云在阳光下出现在山丘上方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dik l-għarixa fis-sema! Mark: Iva, tidher qisha tajjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at those soft clouds in the sky! Mark: Yes, they look like cotton wool.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看天空中那些轻绵的云！马克：是啊，看起来像棉花。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看天空中那些轻绵的云！
messages.en: Look at those soft clouds in the sky!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，看起来像棉花。
messages.en: Yes, they look like cotton wool.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 għarixa 就想象天空里像棉花一样轻绵的云，用视觉上的柔软感帮助记忆。

gloss_zh: 词义未明（所给释义无法解读）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning cannot be established from the supplied gloss.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 材料将此词标为名词，但所给释义无法解读，因此无法据此确定具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira tiegħu ma tistax tiġi stabbilita mill-glossa mogħtija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义为无法解读的字符串，不能据此确定此名词的含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa mogħtija hija sensiela ta' karattri li ma tistax tinftiehem u ma tippermettix li tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira tan-nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss is unintelligible, so this noun's meaning cannot be reliably explained.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'għark' hija mniżżla bħala nom, iżda l-glossa mogħtija ma tippermettix li tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The word 'għark' is listed as a noun, but the supplied gloss does not allow its meaning to be established.
formal.zh: “għark”被列为名词，但所给释义无法用于确定其含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'għark'? Mark: Ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti minn din il-glossa; nafu biss li hija mniżżla bħala nom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'għark' mean? Mark: We cannot be sure from this gloss; we only know that it is listed as a noun.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“għark”这个词是什么意思？马克：凭这条释义无法确定；我们只知道它被列为名词。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: “għark”这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'għark' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti minn din il-glossa; nafu biss li hija mniżżla bħala nom.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti minn din il-glossa; nafu biss li hija mniżżla bħala nom.
messages.zh: 凭这条释义无法确定；我们只知道它被列为名词。
messages.en: We cannot be sure from this gloss; we only know that it is listed as a noun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 għark 做一张“名词、词义待核”的卡片，先记准确拼写，避免把无法解读的释义编成具体含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The position of a man or boy who is kneeling on his knees.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指男性双膝着地、跪着的姿势，常用于描述跪下或保持跪姿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pożizzjoni ta' raġel jew tifel li jkun bil-ġenbejn tiegħu fuq irkopptejh mal-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跪下；处于双膝着地的跪姿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' raġel jew tifel meta jinżel fuq irkopptejh u jżommhom mal-art.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a man is għarkopptejh, he is kneeling with his knees on the ground.

collocations.en: he went down on his knees

formal.mt: Il-voluntier niżel għarkopptejh ħdejn it-tifel biex ikellmu bil-kalma.
formal.en: The volunteer knelt beside the boy to speak to him calmly.
formal.zh: 志愿者在男孩身旁跪下来，平静地和他说话。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu qiegħed għarkopptejh? Lara: Qed ifittex iċ-ċavetta taħt is-sufan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Pawlu on his knees? Lara: He's looking for the key under the sofa.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 为什么跪着？Lara：他在找沙发下面的钥匙。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 为什么跪着？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu on his knees?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他在找沙发下面的钥匙。
messages.en: He's looking for the key under the sofa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人双膝着地找钥匙：niżel 表示跪下来，baqa' 表示继续跪着，用两个动作搭配记住跪姿。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In an imploring manner that expresses an earnest plea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以恳切、苦苦哀求的方式表达请求，强调请求者的恳求态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li juri talba ħerqana ħafna, bħallikieku wieħed qed jitlob fuq irkopptejh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哀求地；以苦苦恳求的方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod imploranti, b'talba ħerqana ħafna biex xi ħadd jaċċetta jew jagħmel xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who asks għarkupptejh makes an earnest and imploring request.

collocations.en: he implored someone to forgive him

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel talab għarkupptejh biex jingħata ċans ieħor.
formal.en: In the story, the man pleaded earnestly to be given another chance.
formal.zh: 故事中，那名男子苦苦哀求，希望再获得一次机会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif talabha biex tibqa'? Lara: Talabha għarkupptejh, imma hi xorta telqet.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did he ask her to stay? Lara: He begged her, but she still left.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他是怎么求她留下的？Lara：他苦苦哀求她，但她还是走了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他是怎么求她留下的？
messages.en: How did he ask her to stay?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Talabha għarkupptejh, imma hi xorta telqet.
messages.mt_standard: Talabha għarkupptejh, imma hi xorta telqet.
messages.zh: 他苦苦哀求她，但她还是走了。
messages.en: He begged her, but she still left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“求你再给一次机会”的语气朗读 talab għarkupptejh，把整组表达与苦苦哀求的场景绑定记忆。

gloss_zh: 突然；毫无预警地，常见于 għall-għarrieda

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sudden or unexpected occurrence, taught through the expression għall-għarrieda, meaning suddenly or without warning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示突然、出乎意料或没有预警的发生方式，教学中主要学习短语 għall-għarrieda，意为“突然地”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża fl-espressjoni għall-għarrieda biex turi li xi ħaġa sseħħ f'daqqa jew bla twissija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 突然的；突如其来的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li xi ħaġa tiġri f'daqqa, mingħajr ma tkun mistennija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sudden event happens quickly and is not expected beforehand.

sense_translations.en_definition: without warning (usually used as part of the expression 'għall-għarrieda' meaning 'suddenly')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 毫无预警地；通常用于短语 għall-għarrieda，表示“突然地”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fl-espressjoni għall-għarrieda, tfisser li xi ħaġa sseħħ bla twissija jew sinjal minn qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happens għall-għarrieda, it happens without any advance warning.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa ntemmet għall-għarrieda meta nqata' d-dawl.
formal.en: The meeting ended abruptly when the power went out.
formal.zh: 停电时，会议突然结束了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tlaqt għall-għarrieda lbieraħ? Pawlu: Ċemplitli ommi u kelli mmur id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you leave so suddenly yesterday? Pawlu: My mother called me, and I had to go home.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你昨天为什么突然走了？Pawlu：我妈妈给我打了电话，我得回家。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你昨天为什么突然走了？
messages.en: Why did you leave so suddenly yesterday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċemplitli ommi u kelli mmur id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Ċemplitli ommi u kelli mmur id-dar.
messages.zh: 我妈妈给我打了电话，我得回家。
messages.en: My mother called me, and I had to go home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għall-għarrieda 整组记成“突然地”：想象会议中灯一下熄灭，借助毫无预警的画面记住用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A kingfisher, a bird that catches fish for food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 翠鸟，一种捕食鱼类的鸟，常在水边活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur li jaqbad il-ħut għall-ikel u li spiss jinstab qrib l-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 翠鸟，常在水边捕食鱼类的鸟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' għasfur li jgħix qrib l-ilma u jaqbad il-ħut biex jiekol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A kingfisher is a bird that catches fish in or near water.

collocations.mt: għasfur ta' San Martin ħdejn ix-xmara
għasfur ta' San Martin jaqbad ħuta

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, l-istudenti raw għasfur ta' San Martin jaqbad ħuta fix-xmara.
formal.en: During the observation, the students saw a kingfisher catch a fish in the river.
formal.zh: 观察期间，学生们看见一只翠鸟在河里捕到了一条鱼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt dak l-għasfur ħdejn l-ilma? Pawlu: Iva, dak għasfur ta' San Martin. Għadu kemm qabad ħuta!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see that bird beside the water? Pawlu: Yes, that's a kingfisher. It just caught a fish!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看到水边那只鸟了吗？Pawlu：看到了，那是翠鸟。它刚捕到一条鱼！

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟伙伴)
messages.zh: 你看到水边那只鸟了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that bird beside the water?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观鸟伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak għasfur ta' San Martin. Għadu kemm qabad ħuta!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak għasfur ta' San Martin. Għadu kemm qabad ħuta!
messages.zh: 看到了，那是翠鸟。它刚捕到一条鱼！
messages.en: Yes, that's a kingfisher. It just caught a fish!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għasfur ta' San Martin 作为完整鸟名记住，配上一只鸟从水中叼起小鱼的画面，对应中文“翠鸟”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A building or office where police officers work and members of the public can report incidents.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 警察办公、处理警务并接受公众报案的场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini jew uffiċċju fejn jaħdmu l-pulizija u fejn in-nies jistgħu jagħmlu rapport dwar xi inċident.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 警察办公并接受公众报案的警察局或派出所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post fejn jaħdmu l-pulizija u fejn il-pubbliku jista' jmur biex jagħmel rapport jew jitlob l-għajnuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A police station is a building where police officers work and people can report incidents or ask for help.

formal.mt: Iċ-ċittadin mar l-għassa tal-pulizija biex jagħmel rapport dwar is-serq.
formal.en: The citizen went to the police station to report the theft.
formal.zh: 这位市民前往警察局报案，反映失窃情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn nista' nirrapporta s-serq? Mark: Tista' tmur l-għassa tal-pulizija ħdejn il-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where can I report the theft? Mark: You can go to the police station near the square.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我可以去哪里报失窃案？马克：你可以去广场附近的警察局。

messages.speaker: Maja (报案人)
messages.zh: 我可以去哪里报失窃案？
messages.en: Where can I report the theft?

messages.speaker: Mark (路人)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tmur l-għassa tal-pulizija ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tmur l-għassa tal-pulizija ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.zh: 你可以去广场附近的警察局。
messages.en: You can go to the police station near the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组和“走进警察局报案”的画面一起记忆；看到 tal-pulizija，就联想到警察办公的场所。

gloss_zh: 自己的事（用于“管好你自己的事”等表达）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Your own business or concerns, as used in an expression telling someone not to interfere.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指你自己的事情或应当关注的事务，用于劝告或要求别人不要干涉的表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li għandu x'jaqsam miegħek, fl-espressjoni 'ara għasstek', li tintuża biex tgħid lil xi ħadd ma jindaħalx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于“管好你自己的事”一类表达，表示要求对方不要干涉别人的事情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma użata fl-espressjoni 'ara għasstek' biex tgħid lil persuna tieħu ħsieb l-affarijiet tagħha u ma tindaħalx f'dawk ta' ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this expression, the word refers to someone's own concerns when they are being told to stop interfering.

collocations.en: mind your own business and do not interfere
collocations.zh: 管好你自己的事，别插手

formal.mt: L-espressjoni 'ara għasstek' tista' tintuża biex titlob lil xi ħadd ma jindaħalx, iżda tista' tinstema' iebsa.
formal.en: The expression 'ara għasstek' can be used to ask someone not to interfere, but it can sound harsh.
formal.zh: 表达 ara għasstek 可以用来要求别人不要干涉，但语气可能显得生硬。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex qed taqra dawk il-messaġġi? Maja: Ara għasstek, Mark! Huma privati. Mark: Sewwa, ma nistaqsikx aktar.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why are you reading those messages? Maja: Mind your own business, Mark! They are private. Mark: All right, I will stop asking.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么在看那些消息？玛雅：管好你自己的事，马克！这是私人消息。马克：好吧，我不再问了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在看那些消息？
messages.en: Why are you reading those messages?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 管好你自己的事，马克！这是私人消息。
messages.en: Mind your own business, Mark! They are private.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好吧，我不再问了。
messages.en: All right, I will stop asking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 连同 ara għasstek 整句记成“管好你自己的事”；想象有人护住私人消息，提醒自己这句话可能语气较冲。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sudden, involuntary burst of air through the nose and mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 空气突然、不由自主地从鼻子和嘴喷出的动作，即喷嚏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħruġ f'daqqa ta' arja mill-imnieħer u mill-ħalq, mingħajr ma l-persuna tagħżel li tagħmlu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喷嚏；空气突然、不由自主地从鼻子和嘴喷出的动作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reazzjoni tal-ġisem li fiha l-arja toħroġ f'daqqa mill-imnieħer u mill-ħalq, ħafna drabi bi ħoss.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sneeze is a sudden burst of air from your nose and mouth that you do not deliberately produce.

collocations.zh: 一个响亮而有力的喷嚏

formal.mt: Għatsa qawwija interrompiet il-qari għal mument.
formal.en: A powerful sneeze interrupted the reading for a moment.
formal.zh: 一个响亮的喷嚏让朗读暂时中断了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għatsa qawwija! Trid maktur? Mark: Iva, grazzi. Għandi wieħed fil-basket, imma ma nistax insibu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What a loud sneeze! Do you want a tissue? Mark: Yes, thanks. I have one in my bag, but I cannot find it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：好响的喷嚏！要纸巾吗？马克：要，谢谢。我包里有一张，但找不到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 好响的喷嚏！要纸巾吗？
messages.en: What a loud sneeze! Do you want a tissue?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi. Għandi wieħed fil-basket, imma ma nistax insibu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Għandi wieħed fil-basket, imma ma nistax insibu.
messages.zh: 要，谢谢。我包里有一张，但找不到。
messages.en: Yes, thanks. I have one in my bag, but I cannot find it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għatsa 和“打一个喷嚏、马上找纸巾”的连续画面绑定；再用 għatsa wara oħra 记住“喷嚏一个接一个”。

gloss_zh: 床罩；床上覆盖物（所给释义存疑）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Provisionally, a covering placed over a bed; the supplied meaning is marked as uncertain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 暂按覆盖在床上的床罩或覆盖物理解；所给词义带有疑问标记，尚未确认。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod proviżorju, għata li titqiegħed fuq sodda; it-tifsira mogħtija għal din il-kelma hija mmarkata bħala mhux ċerta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可能指床罩或床上覆盖物；原释义中的问号表示这一对应关系尚未确定。
