sense_translations.mt_definition: Possibbilment għata li titqiegħed fuq sodda, iżda din it-tifsira għadha mhix ikkonfermata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss tentatively identifies this word as a covering for a bed, but that meaning remains uncertain.

collocations.en: a clean bedcover, provisionally assuming the supplied meaning
collocations.zh: 干净的床罩（暂按所给存疑词义构成的练习搭配）

collocations.en: a bedcover on the bed, provisionally assuming the supplied meaning
collocations.zh: 床上的床罩（暂按所给存疑词义构成的练习搭配）

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-kelma 'għaxja' tintuża b'mod proviżorju għal għata tas-sodda, iżda din it-tifsira għad trid tiġi kkonfermata.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'għaxja' is used provisionally for a bedcover, but this meaning still needs confirmation.
formal.zh: 本练习暂用 għaxja 表示床罩，但这一词义仍需确认。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawnhekk, 'għaxja' tfisser għata tas-sodda? Mark: F'dan l-eżerċizzju qed nużawha hekk, iżda t-tifsira għadha mhix ċerta. Maja: Sewwa, se nżomm il-marka tal-mistoqsija fin-noti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does 'għaxja' mean a bedcover here? Mark: We are using it that way in this exercise, but the meaning is still uncertain. Maja: All right, I will keep the question mark in my notes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里 għaxja 是床罩的意思吗？马克：本练习暂时这样使用，但这个词义还不确定。玛雅：好的，我会在笔记里保留问号。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里 għaxja 是床罩的意思吗？
messages.en: Does 'għaxja' mean a bedcover here?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan l-eżerċizzju qed nużawha hekk, iżda t-tifsira għadha mhix ċerta.
messages.mt_standard: F'dan l-eżerċizzju qed nużawha hekk, iżda t-tifsira għadha mhix ċerta.
messages.zh: 本练习暂时这样使用，但这个词义还不确定。
messages.en: We are using it that way in this exercise, but the meaning is still uncertain.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, se nżomm il-marka tal-mistoqsija fin-noti.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, se nżomm il-marka tal-mistoqsija fin-noti.
messages.zh: 好的，我会在笔记里保留问号。
messages.en: All right, I will keep the question mark in my notes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在记忆卡上画一张盖着床罩的床，并在 għaxja 旁保留大问号；画面只帮助暂记，问号提醒词义尚待确认。

gloss_zh: 令人愉悦的；令人喜爱的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Giving pleasure or delight to someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人感到愉快、欣喜或喜爱的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti pjaċir jew iqanqal sens ta' ferħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人愉快、欣喜或喜爱的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jqanqal pjaċir u jagħmel lil min jesperjenzah iħossu ferħan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something delightful gives you pleasure and makes you feel happy.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人感到愉悦或十分喜欢的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jogħġob ħafna u jagħti sens ta' pjaċir jew ferħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You describe something as delightful when you find it very pleasant.

formal.mt: Il-ġnien huwa post għaxqan fejn il-viżitaturi jistgħu jistrieħu fid-dell tas-siġar.
formal.en: The garden is a delightful place where visitors can rest in the shade of the trees.
formal.zh: 这座花园是个令人愉悦的地方，游客可以在树荫下休息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Jogħġbok dan il-post? Mark: Iva, huwa għaxqan! Ejja noqogħdu hawn ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you like this place? Mark: Yes, it's delightful! Let's stay here for a while.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你喜欢这个地方吗？Mark：喜欢，真让人愉快！我们在这里待一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这个地方吗？
messages.en: Do you like this place?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa għaxqan! Ejja noqogħdu hawn ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa għaxqan! Ejja noqogħdu hawn ftit.
messages.zh: 喜欢，真让人愉快！我们在这里待一会儿吧。
messages.en: Yes, it's delightful! Let's stay here for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għaxqan 和树荫下令人愉快的花园画面联系起来，整块记住 post għaxqan，表示“令人愉悦的地方”。

gloss_zh: 带来愉悦的；令人欣喜的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing someone to feel pleasure or delight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够引起愉悦、欣喜或喜爱之情的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqanqal pjaċir jew ferħ f'min jarah, jisimgħu jew jesperjenzah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引起愉悦或欣喜之情的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jqajjem sens ta' pjaċir jew ferħ f'persuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described this way causes a person to feel pleasure or delight.

formal.mt: Il-ħoss għaxqi tal-vjolin mela s-sala u qanqal tbissima fuq wiċċ is-semmiegħa.
formal.en: The delightful sound of the violin filled the hall and brought smiles to the listeners' faces.
formal.zh: 小提琴令人愉悦的声音回荡在大厅里，让听众脸上露出了笑容。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Isma' ftit dan il-ħoss tal-flawt. Pawlu: Kemm hu għaxqi! Nixtieq nerġa' nisimgħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Listen to this flute sound for a moment. Pawlu: How delightful it is! I'd like to hear it again.
colloquial.zh: Lara：听一下这段长笛的声音。Pawlu：真悦耳！我想再听一遍。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 听一下这段长笛的声音。
messages.en: Listen to this flute sound for a moment.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu għaxqi! Nixtieq nerġa' nisimgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu għaxqi! Nixtieq nerġa' nisimgħu.
messages.zh: 真悦耳！我想再听一遍。
messages.en: How delightful it is! I'd like to hear it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听见悦耳的长笛声后露出笑容，把 għaxqi 记成“让人产生愉悦感的”，并连读 ħoss għaxqi。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small mark on the skin, understood as a mole or a freckle according to context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 皮肤上的小斑点，依语境可指痣或雀斑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marka żgħira fuq il-ġilda li, skont il-kuntest, tkun għazza jew tebgħa ta' nemex.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 痣；皮肤上通常颜色较深的小点或小突起。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Marka żgħira fuq il-ġilda, ġeneralment aktar skura mill-ġilda ta' madwarha, li tista' tkun ċatta jew xi ftit imqabbża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mole is a small mark on your skin that is usually darker than the surrounding skin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雀斑；皮肤上细小、扁平的浅褐色斑点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tebgħa żgħira, ċatta u ta' lewn kannella ċar fuq il-ġilda, li tkun parti min-nemex.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A freckle is a small flat light brown spot on someone's skin.

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-persuna, l-awtur isemmi għazz żgħir fuq il-ħaddejn tax-xellug.
formal.en: In the description of the person, the author mentions a small mole on the left cheek.
formal.zh: 在人物描写中，作者提到了左脸颊上的一颗小痣。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hi oħtok f'dan ir-ritratt? Lara: Dik bil-għazz ħdejn xofftejha, fuq ix-xellug.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which one is your sister in this photo? Lara: The one on the left with the mole beside her lips.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这张照片里哪位是你姐姐？Lara：左边嘴唇旁有颗痣的那位。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这张照片里哪位是你姐姐？
messages.en: Which one is your sister in this photo?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik bil-għazz ħdejn xofftejha, fuq ix-xellug.
messages.mt_standard: Dik bil-għazz ħdejn xofftejha, fuq ix-xellug.
messages.zh: 左边嘴唇旁有颗痣的那位。
messages.en: The one on the left with the mole beside her lips.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在词卡上画一张脸，用深色小点标痣、浅褐小点标雀斑；两种图都配 għazz，再用上下文区分具体含义。

gloss_zh: 爱挑剔的女人；对小事过分计较的女人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woman who makes excessive complaints or demands about small details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指对细小的事情过分挑剔、计较，或经常为此抱怨的女人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara li tkun diffiċli biex tissodisfaha u li tilmenta jew tagħmel ħafna talbiet dwar dettalji żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱挑剔、对小事过分计较的女人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mara li tagħti importanza żejda lil affarijiet żgħar u li diffiċli tkun kuntenta b'dak li jsir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fussy woman is difficult to please because she is excessively concerned about small details.

collocations.en: a fussy woman who complains about everything
collocations.zh: 一个什么都要抱怨的挑剔女人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ġara tidher bħala għaġba li tilmenta dwar kull dettall tat-tħejjijiet għall-festa.
formal.en: In the story, the neighbour is portrayed as a fussy woman who complains about every detail of the preparations for the celebration.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这位女邻居被描写成一个爱挑剔的女人，对庆祝活动筹备中的每个细节都要抱怨。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex tgħid li hi għaġba? Luqa: Għax dejjem issib xi ħaġa żgħira fuq xiex tilmenta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you call her a fussy woman? Luqa: Because she always finds some little thing to complain about.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么说她是个爱挑剔的女人？卢卡：因为她总能找出一点小事来抱怨。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说她是个爱挑剔的女人？
messages.en: Why do you call her a fussy woman?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem issib xi ħaġa żgħira fuq xiex tilmenta.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem issib xi ħaġa żgħira fuq xiex tilmenta.
messages.zh: 因为她总能找出一点小事来抱怨。
messages.en: Because she always finds some little thing to complain about.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事里一位连餐巾摆放都要反复挑剔的女人，用这个人物画面记住本条所给的 għaġba 义项。

gloss_zh: 用于制作 ftira、尚未静置满四小时的面团

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dough for ftira that has not rested for the full four hours needed to make Maltese bread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于制作马耳他扁面包 ftira、尚未完成制作马耳他面包所需的整整四小时静置的面团。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaġina għall-ftira li tkun għadha ma tħallietx tistrieħ għall-erba' sigħat sħaħ meħtieġa biex isir il-ħobż Malti.

sense_translations.en_definition: ftira dough, piece of dough that has not been left to rest for the full 4 hours needed to create Maltese bread
sense_translations.zh_definition: 制作 ftira 的面团；尚未静置满制作马耳他面包所需的四小时的一块面团。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għaġina għall-ftira, jew biċċa għaġina li tkun għadha ma tħallietx tistrieħ għall-erba' sigħat sħaħ meħtieġa biex isir il-ħobż Malti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Għaġinodu is dough for ftira that has not yet completed the full four hours of resting needed to make Maltese bread.

collocations.en: a piece of ftira dough that has not completed its resting time
collocations.zh: 一块尚未完成静置的 ftira 面团

collocations.en: to leave the insufficiently rested ftira dough to rest
collocations.zh: 让尚未静置充分的 ftira 面团继续静置

formal.mt: Fir-riċetta, il-kelma għaġinodu tirreferi għall-għaġina tal-ftira li tkun għadha ma striħitx għall-erba' sigħat sħaħ.
formal.en: In the recipe, the word għaġinodu refers to ftira dough that has not yet rested for the full four hours.
formal.zh: 在这份食谱中，għaġinodu 指尚未静置满四小时的 ftira 面团。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-għaġinodu ilu jistrieħ sagħtejn biss. Pawlu: Mela ħallih jistrieħ sagħtejn oħra biex jagħlaq l-erba' sigħat.
colloquial.en: Maja: This għaġinodu has only been resting for two hours. Pawlu: Then leave it to rest for another two hours to complete the four hours.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这份尚未静置充分的 ftira 面团才放了两小时。Pawlu：那就再放两小时，凑满四小时。

messages.speaker: Maja (烘焙学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-għaġinodu ilu jistrieħ sagħtejn biss.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-għaġinodu ilu jistrieħ sagħtejn biss.
messages.zh: 这份尚未静置充分的 ftira 面团才放了两小时。
messages.en: This għaġinodu has only been resting for two hours.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (烘焙老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ħallih jistrieħ sagħtejn oħra biex jagħlaq l-erba' sigħat.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ħallih jistrieħ sagħtejn oħra biex jagħlaq l-erba' sigħat.
messages.zh: 那就再放两小时，凑满四小时。
messages.en: Then leave it to rest for another two hours to complete the four hours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面团旁的四小时计时器还没走完，用“静置未满四小时的 ftira 面团”这一画面记住 għaġinodu。

gloss_zh: 极年老或衰弱的人；蜘蛛蟹

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very old or decrepit person; also, a spider crab.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指年纪极大或身体衰弱的人；也可指蜘蛛蟹，两个义项须结合语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna xiħa ħafna jew fi stat ta' dgħufija kbira; il-kelma tintuża wkoll għal tip ta' granċ magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala spider crab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 年纪极大或身体衰弱、机能衰退的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun xiħa ħafna jew li tkun fi stat ta' dgħufija kbira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An għaġuża is a person who is very old or whose physical condition has become weak and worn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜘蛛蟹，一类外形让人联想到蜘蛛的蟹。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' granċ li għandu dehra li tfakkar f'brimba u li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ spider crab.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An għaġuża is a spider crab, a kind of crab whose appearance resembles that of a spider.

collocations.zh: 一位身体衰弱的高龄老人

collocations.en: a spider crab in the aquarium

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-għaġuża timxi bil-mod u teħtieġ l-għajnuna biex titla' t-taraġ.
formal.en: In the story, the very old person walks slowly and needs help climbing the stairs.
formal.zh: 故事中，这位高龄老人走路缓慢，上楼梯时需要帮助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak il-granċ fl-istampa? Pawlu: Dik għaġuża. L-istess kelma tista' tfisser ukoll persuna xiħa ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that crab in the picture? Pawlu: That is a spider crab, an għaġuża. The same word can also mean a very old person.
colloquial.zh: Maja：图片里那是什么蟹？Pawlu：那是蜘蛛蟹，叫 għaġuża。同一个词也可以指年纪极大的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 图片里那是什么蟹？
messages.en: What is that crab in the picture?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik għaġuża. L-istess kelma tista' tfisser ukoll persuna xiħa ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Dik għaġuża. L-istess kelma tista' tfisser ukoll persuna xiħa ħafna.
messages.zh: 那是蜘蛛蟹，叫 għaġuża。同一个词也可以指年纪极大的人。
messages.en: That is a spider crab, an għaġuża. The same word can also mean a very old person.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 għaġuża 制作双面记忆卡：一面画高龄衰弱者，一面画蜘蛛蟹；读句子时先看是在说人还是在说蟹。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who belongs to the Hebrew people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于希伯来民族的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel parti mill-poplu Għebrej.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 希伯来人；希伯来民族的一员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Membru tal-poplu Għebrej.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A Hebrew is a person who belongs to the Hebrew people.

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont isegwi l-ħajja ta' Għebrej żagħżugħ u r-relazzjoni tiegħu mal-familja.
formal.en: The story follows the life of a young Hebrew and his relationship with his family.
formal.zh: 这个故事讲述了一位年轻希伯来人的生活及其与家人的关系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu l-karattru ewlieni ta' dan ir-rakkont? Mark: Huwa Għebrej żagħżugħ li qed ifittex lil ħuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is the main character in this story? Mark: He is a young Hebrew who is looking for his brother.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个故事的主角是谁？Mark：他是一位正在寻找兄弟的年轻希伯来人。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu l-karattru ewlieni ta' dan ir-rakkont?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu l-karattru ewlieni ta' dan ir-rakkont?
messages.zh: 这个故事的主角是谁？
messages.en: Who is the main character in this story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa Għebrej żagħżugħ li qed ifittex lil ħuh.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa Għebrej żagħżugħ li qed ifittex lil ħuh.
messages.zh: 他是一位正在寻找兄弟的年轻希伯来人。
messages.en: He is a young Hebrew who is looking for his brother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Għebrej 写在故事人物卡的“民族身份”栏，旁边配中文“希伯来人”，用具体人物帮助记住这里的名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression conveying that a male speaker said something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示一名男性说话者说过某些话的表达，对应“他说”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li raġel qal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他说；表示一名男性说话者说过某些话。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din l-espressjoni tindika li raġel qal xi kliem jew esprima xi ħsieb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This expression conveys that a male speaker said something.

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tat-traduzzjoni, l-espressjoni 'għeda' tingħata bit-tifsira 'hu qal'.
formal.en: In the translation exercise, the expression 'għeda' is given the meaning 'he said'.
formal.zh: 在翻译练习中，“għeda”这一表达的意思给作“他说”。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser 'għeda' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Mark: Tfisser 'hu qal'. Lina: Mela qed nirrapportaw kliem xi ħadd.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does 'għeda' mean in this exercise? Mark: It means 'he said'. Lina: So we are reporting someone's words.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这个练习里的“għeda”是什么意思？马克：意思是“他说”。莉娜：那么我们是在转述某个人的话。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 这个练习里的“għeda”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'għeda' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 意思是“他说”。
messages.en: It means 'he said'.

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela qed nirrapportaw kliem xi ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Mela qed nirrapportaw kliem xi ħadd.
messages.zh: 那么我们是在转述某个人的话。
messages.en: So we are reporting someone's words.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“għeda”与男性人物旁的“他说”对话框配对记忆，重点记住转述话语的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Evil supernatural beings described as demons or devils in stories and beliefs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 故事或信仰中被称为恶魔、魔鬼的邪恶超自然生物；此词为复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlejjaq sopranaturali ħżiena li jissemmew fl-istejjer jew fit-twemmin u jitqiesu bħala xjaten.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恶魔；魔鬼，指故事或信仰中的邪恶超自然生物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għefieret huma ħlejjaq sopranaturali ħżiena li fl-istejjer jew fit-twemmin ibeżżgħu lin-nies jew jagħmlulhom il-ħsara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Demons or devils are evil supernatural beings that appear in stories or religious beliefs.

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, l-għefieret jgħixu f'kastell abbandunat u jbeżżgħu lil kull min jidħol fih.
formal.en: In the story, demons live in an abandoned castle and frighten anyone who enters it.
formal.zh: 故事中，恶魔住在一座废弃的城堡里，吓唬所有进入城堡的人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-film fih l-għefieret? Pawlu: Iva, imma huma parti mill-istorja biss. Sara: Tajjeb, narawh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are there demons in this film? Pawlu: Yes, but they are only part of the story. Sara: All right, let's watch it together.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这部电影里有恶魔吗？保罗：有，不过只是故事里的角色。萨拉：好吧，我们一起看。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这部电影里有恶魔吗？
messages.en: Are there demons in this film?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma huma parti mill-istorja biss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma huma parti mill-istorja biss.
messages.zh: 有，不过只是故事里的角色。
messages.en: Yes, but they are only part of the story.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 好吧，我们一起看。
messages.en: All right, let's watch it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象恐怖故事里一群恶魔躲在古堡中，把这个群体画面与“għefieret”联系起来。

exact_key: għeluq tan-negozju tas-suq ta' ġurnata bil-quddiem
gloss_zh: 日前市场交易关闸；日前市场交易截止时间

teaching_sense.en_definition: The closing of trading, or its deadline, in a market where transactions are arranged a day in advance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提前一天安排交易的市场停止接受交易申报这一关闸事件，或该事件对应的截止时刻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-waqfien tal-aċċettazzjoni ta' offerti fis-suq li fih it-tranżazzjonijiet jiġu miftiehma ġurnata minn qabel, jew il-ħin stabbilit għal dan il-waqfien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 日前市场交易关闸，指该市场停止接受交易申报的事件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mument meta s-suq li fih it-tranżazzjonijiet jiġu miftiehma ġurnata minn qabel jieqaf jaċċetta offerti għal dik is-sessjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Day ahead market gate closure occurs when the market stops accepting trading submissions for the relevant session.

sense_translations.en_definition: day ahead market gate closure time
sense_translations.zh_definition: 日前市场交易关闸时间，即该市场停止接受交易申报的规定截止时刻。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħin stabbilit li fih jintemm il-perjodu għall-preżentazzjoni ta' offerti fis-suq li fih it-tranżazzjonijiet jiġu miftiehma ġurnata minn qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The day ahead market gate closure time is the specified deadline for submitting trades to that market.

collocations.mt: qabel l-għeluq tan-negozju tas-suq ta' ġurnata bil-quddiem
collocations.en: before day ahead market gate closure
collocations.zh: 在日前市场交易关闸之前

collocations.mt: il-ħin tal-għeluq tan-negozju tas-suq ta' ġurnata bil-quddiem
collocations.en: the day ahead market gate closure time
collocations.zh: 日前市场交易关闸时间

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom jippreżentaw l-offerti tagħhom qabel l-għeluq tan-negozju tas-suq ta' ġurnata bil-quddiem, skont il-ħin indikat fl-avviż.
formal.en: Participants must submit their offers before day ahead market gate closure, in accordance with the time stated in the notice.
formal.zh: 参与者必须按照通知所列时间，在日前市场交易关闸之前提交报价。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Iċċekkjajt il-ħin tal-għeluq tan-negozju tas-suq ta' ġurnata bil-quddiem? Mark: Iva, għad għandna għaxar minuti. Anna: Mela nibagħtu l-offerti issa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Have you checked the day ahead market gate closure time? Mark: Yes, we still have ten minutes. Anna: Then let's send the offers now.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你核对过日前市场交易关闸时间了吗？马克：核对过了，我们还有十分钟。安娜：那现在就提交报价吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (交易员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iċċekkjajt il-ħin tal-għeluq tan-negozju tas-suq ta' ġurnata bil-quddiem?
messages.mt_standard: Iċċekkjajt il-ħin tal-għeluq tan-negozju tas-suq ta' ġurnata bil-quddiem?
messages.zh: 你核对过日前市场交易关闸时间了吗？
messages.en: Have you checked the day ahead market gate closure time?

messages.speaker: Mark (交易同事)
messages.zh: 核对过了，我们还有十分钟。
messages.en: Yes, we still have ten minutes.

messages.speaker: Anna (交易员)
messages.zh: 那现在就提交报价吧。
messages.en: Then let's send the offers now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象“提前一天交易”的市场窗口按时关闸：关闸动作对应第一个义项，钟表上的截止时刻对应第二个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deeds or actions that someone has carried out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某人已经做出的行为或事情，可指值得赞扬或应受批评的所作所为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-affarijiet li persuna tkun għamlet, kemm jekk tajbin kif ukoll jekk ħżiena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行为；事迹；某人实际做过的事情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-azzjonijiet jew l-affarijiet li xi ħadd ikun għamel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone's deeds are the things they have done, especially when these actions are being judged.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat faħħar l-għemejjel tajba tal-voluntiera li għenu lill-familji fil-bżonn.
formal.en: The committee praised the good deeds of the volunteers who helped families in need.
formal.zh: 委员会赞扬了帮助困难家庭的志愿者们的善行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex kulħadd jitkellem tajjeb fuq Pawlu? Lara: Minħabba l-għemejjel tajba tiegħu; dejjem jgħin lil min ikollu bżonn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does everyone speak well of Pawlu? Lara: Because of his good deeds; he always helps anyone in need.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么大家都说保罗好？拉拉：因为他做了很多好事；谁有需要，他总会帮忙。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kulħadd jitkellem tajjeb fuq Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kulħadd jitkellem tajjeb fuq Pawlu?
messages.zh: 为什么大家都说保罗好？
messages.en: Why does everyone speak well of Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-għemejjel tajba tiegħu; dejjem jgħin lil min ikollu bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-għemejjel tajba tiegħu; dejjem jgħin lil min ikollu bżonn.
messages.zh: 因为他做了很多好事；谁有需要，他总会帮忙。
messages.en: Because of his good deeds; he always helps anyone in need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għemejjel 想成一本记录所作所为的行动簿：写下帮助别人，就是 għemejjel tajba；写下伤害别人，就是 għemejjel ħżiena。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In the year immediately before the present year or another year being discussed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在今年或所谈论的某一年之前的那一年，即去年或前一年。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fis-sena ta' qabel is-sena preżenti jew qabel sena oħra li tkun qed tissemma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在前一年；在所指年份紧接着之前的那一年。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fis-sena li tiġi eżatt qabel is-sena li wieħed ikun qed jirreferi għaliha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happened the previous year, it happened in the year immediately before the year being referred to.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在上一年；在当前或上下文所指年份之前的那一年。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sena qabel is-sena preżenti jew qabel sena oħra msemmija fil-kuntest.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happened the year before, it took place one year earlier than the year understood from the context.

collocations.en: in the summer of the previous year

formal.mt: Għemnewwel, il-librerija organizzat għaxar laqgħat għall-qarrejja; din is-sena organizzat tnax.
formal.en: Last year, the library organized ten meetings for readers; this year it organized twelve.
formal.zh: 去年，图书馆为读者举办了十场交流会；今年举办了十二场。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Mort Għawdex għemnewwel? Nina: Iva, mort fis-sajf, u nixtieq nerġa' mmur din is-sena.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did you go to Gozo last year? Nina: Yes, I went in summer, and I would like to go again this year.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你去年去戈佐岛了吗？妮娜：去了，夏天去的，今年我还想再去。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你去年去戈佐岛了吗？
messages.en: Did you go to Gozo last year?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, mort fis-sajf, u nixtieq nerġa' mmur din is-sena.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, mort fis-sajf, u nixtieq nerġa' mmur din is-sena.
messages.zh: 去了，夏天去的，今年我还想再去。
messages.en: Yes, I went in summer, and I would like to go again this year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历上圈出今年，再向前退一年，把那一格标成 għemnewwel；读故事时则从故事所说的年份向前退一年。

gloss_zh: 乡村式传统头罩；faldetta 头罩的复数称呼

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rustic head coverings known as faldettas, referred to in the plural.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指称为 faldetta 的乡村式传统头罩；此词为复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għata tar-ras ta' tip rurali magħrufa bħala faldetti; il-kelma tintuża fil-plural.

sense_translations.zh_definition: faldetta 式乡村头罩，复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Faldetti, jiġifieri għata tar-ras ta' tip rurali; din hija forma fil-plural.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The plural word refers to rustic head coverings known as faldettas.

collocations.en: a collection of faldetta head coverings
collocations.zh: 一批 faldetta 头罩藏品

formal.mt: Il-katalgu tal-wirja jinkludi ritratti ta' għenienel u deskrizzjoni ta' kull wieħed minnhom.
formal.en: The exhibition catalogue includes photographs of faldetta head coverings and a description of each one.
formal.zh: 展览图录收录了 faldetta 头罩的照片，并逐件附有说明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhuma dawk fir-ritratt? Toni: Dawk huma għenienel, tip ta' għata tar-ras magħruf ukoll bħala faldetti.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are those in the photograph? Toni: Those are għenienel, a type of head covering also known as faldettas.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里的那些是什么？托尼：那些是 għenienel，一种也称作 faldetta 的头罩。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 照片里的那些是什么？
messages.en: What are those in the photograph?

messages.speaker: Toni (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawk huma għenienel, tip ta' għata tar-ras magħruf ukoll bħala faldetti.
messages.mt_standard: Dawk huma għenienel, tip ta' għata tar-ras magħruf ukoll bħala faldetti.
messages.zh: 那些是 għenienel，一种也称作 faldetta 的头罩。
messages.en: Those are għenienel, a type of head covering also known as faldettas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象展柜里并排摆着几件传统头罩，在整排上方贴上 għenienel；用“几件头罩”的画面提醒自己，这是复数称呼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A goat that is one year old, called għenieqa or għaniqa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 年龄为一岁的山羊，可用 għenieqa 或 għaniqa 表示。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mogħża li għandha sena; tista' tissejjaħ għenieqa jew għaniqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一岁的山羊。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mogħża ta' sena, imsejħa għenieqa jew għaniqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An għenieqa or għaniqa is a goat that is one year old.

formal.mt: Ir-reġistru tar-razzett jindika li din il-mogħża għandha sena u għalhekk tissejjaħ għenieqa jew għaniqa.
formal.en: The farm register indicates that this goat is one year old and is therefore called għenieqa or għaniqa.
formal.zh: 农场登记簿注明，这只山羊一岁，因此可称为 għenieqa 或 għaniqa。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm għandha żmien din il-mogħża? Pawlu: Għandha sena; ngħidulha għenieqa jew għaniqa.
colloquial.en: Lara: How old is this goat? Pawlu: She is one year old; we call her għenieqa or għaniqa.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这只山羊多大了？保罗：一岁；我们叫它 għenieqa 或 għaniqa。

messages.speaker: Lara (农场访客)
messages.zh: 这只山羊多大了？
messages.en: How old is this goat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (饲养员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandha sena; ngħidulha għenieqa jew għaniqa.
messages.mt_standard: Għandha sena; ngħidulha għenieqa jew għaniqa.
messages.zh: 一岁；我们叫它 għenieqa 或 għaniqa。
messages.en: She is one year old; we call her għenieqa or għaniqa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只山羊旁边立着写有数字“一”的生日牌，牌上并列写着 għenieqa 和 għaniqa；两种写法都联系到“一岁山羊”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To live together with another person, especially a partner, in the same home.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一个人住在同一住所并共同生活，尤指与伴侣同居。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħix fl-istess dar ma' persuna oħra, speċjalment ma' sieħeb jew sieħba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与他人共同居住生活，尤指与伴侣同居。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jgħix flimkien ma' persuna oħra fl-istess dar, speċjalment f'relazzjoni ta' koppja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone cohabits with another person, they share a home and live together, especially as partners.

collocations.zh: 与他的伴侣共同生活过

collocations.mt: għex ma' sieħbu għal diversi snin
collocations.en: lived with his partner for several years
collocations.zh: 与他的伴侣共同生活了好几年

formal.mt: Qabel iż-żwieġ, Daniel għex ma' sieħbu għal tliet snin.
formal.en: Before their marriage, Daniel lived with his partner for three years.
formal.zh: 结婚前，丹尼尔与他的伴侣同居了三年。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Daniel għex ma' sieħbu qabel iż-żwieġ? Lara: Iva, għex miegħu għal tliet snin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Daniel live with his partner before their marriage? Lara: Yes, he lived with him for three years.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：丹尼尔结婚前和他的伴侣同居过吗？拉拉：是的，他们一起生活了三年。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Daniel għex ma' sieħbu qabel iż-żwieġ?
messages.mt_standard: Daniel għex ma' sieħbu qabel iż-żwieġ?
messages.zh: 丹尼尔结婚前和他的伴侣同居过吗？
messages.en: Did Daniel live with his partner before their marriage?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għex miegħu għal tliet snin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għex miegħu għal tliet snin.
messages.zh: 是的，他们一起生活了三年。
messages.en: Yes, he lived with him for three years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词放进“两人共住一屋”的画面中记忆：għex ma' 后面接共同生活的人，例句里的三年帮助记住已经发生的共同生活。

gloss_zh: 奇观；奇妙的事物；令人惊叹的事情

teaching_sense.en_definition: Things or events that cause great surprise and admiration because they are extraordinary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因非同寻常而令人惊讶、赞叹的事物或事件，如奇观或奇妙之事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Affarijiet jew ġrajjiet straordinarji li jqajmu stagħġib u ammirazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奇观；奇妙之事；令人惊叹或赞赏的非凡事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għeġubijiet huma affarijiet jew ġrajjiet mhux tas-soltu li jġiegħlu lin-nies jistagħġbu u jħossu ammirazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Wonders are extraordinary things or events that make people feel surprise and admiration.

collocations.zh: 创造奇迹；产生惊人的效果

formal.mt: Il-wirja tippreżenta l-għeġubijiet tan-natura permezz ta' ritratti ta' muntanji, għerien u annimali rari.
formal.en: The exhibition presents the wonders of nature through photographs of mountains, caves, and rare animals.
formal.zh: 展览通过山脉、洞穴和珍稀动物的照片，展现大自然的奇观。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt ir-ritratti tal-għar? X'għeġubijiet! David: Iva, dawk il-forom fil-blat huma tal-għaġeb. Maja: Nixtieq narahom mill-qrib.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you seen the photos of the cave? What wonders! David: Yes, those shapes in the rock are amazing. Maja: I'd like to see them up close.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看过那个洞穴的照片了吗？真是奇观！戴维：看过，岩石里的那些形状太神奇了。玛雅：我想近距离看看。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看过那个洞穴的照片了吗？真是奇观！
messages.en: Have you seen the photos of the cave? What wonders!

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dawk il-forom fil-blat huma tal-għaġeb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dawk il-forom fil-blat huma tal-għaġeb.
messages.zh: 看过，岩石里的那些形状太神奇了。
messages.en: Yes, those shapes in the rock are amazing.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想近距离看看。
messages.en: I'd like to see them up close.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“għeġubijiet”配上自然奇观相册：每翻一页都惊叹一次，记住它表示令人赞叹的事物。

exact_key: għodda li tintuża biex tagħfas is-saba' l-kbir
gloss_zh: 拇指夹刑具；拇指螺旋夹

teaching_sense.en_definition: A screw-operated instrument used to compress a person's thumb as a form of torture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种通过旋紧螺杆挤压人的拇指、用来施加酷刑的器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'kamin li tintuża biex tagħfas il-kbir tal-id ta' persuna bħala forma ta' tortura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过螺杆夹紧并挤压拇指的刑具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strumenti ta' tortura b'kamin li jagħfsu l-kbir tal-id u jikkawżaw uġigħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Thumb-screws are instruments that compress a person's thumbs by means of screws to inflict pain.

collocations.mt: għodda li tintuża biex tagħfas is-saba' l-kbir bħala forma ta' tortura
collocations.en: an instrument used to compress the thumb as a form of torture
collocations.zh: 用挤压拇指来施加酷刑的器具

collocations.mt: wirja dwar għodda li tintuża biex tagħfas is-saba' l-kbir
collocations.en: an exhibition about a thumbscrew instrument
collocations.zh: 关于拇指夹刑具的展览

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi għodda li tintuża biex tagħfas is-saba' l-kbir u jispjega l-funzjoni tagħha bħala strument ta' tortura.
formal.en: The catalogue describes an instrument used to compress the thumb and explains its function as an instrument of torture.
formal.zh: 目录介绍了一种用于挤压拇指的器具，并解释了它作为刑具的用途。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik fil-vetrina? Mark: Hija għodda li tintuża biex tagħfas is-saba' l-kbir. It-tikketta tgħid li hija strument ta' tortura.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that in the display case? Mark: It is an instrument used to compress the thumb. The label says it is an instrument of torture.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：展柜里那个是什么？马克：那是用来挤压拇指的器具。标签上说它是一种刑具。

messages.speaker: Maja (博物馆参观者)
messages.zh: 展柜里那个是什么？
messages.en: What is that in the display case?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija għodda li tintuża biex tagħfas is-saba' l-kbir. It-tikketta tgħid li hija strument ta' tortura.
messages.mt_standard: Hija għodda li tintuża biex tagħfas is-saba' l-kbir. It-tikketta tgħid li hija strument ta' tortura.
messages.zh: 那是用来挤压拇指的器具。标签上说它是一种刑具。
messages.en: It is an instrument used to compress the thumb. The label says it is an instrument of torture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“器具—用来—挤压—拇指”的顺序分块记忆整句，再把它与博物馆刑具展柜的画面联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The central or most essential part of something, including the main point of an idea or argument.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事物居于中心或最为重要的部分，也指思想、论证等的核心要旨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ċentrali jew l-aktar essenzjali ta' xi ħaġa, jew il-punt ewlieni ta' idea jew argument.

sense_translations.en_definition: the core, nucleus, or heart of something
sense_translations.zh_definition: 某事物的中心、核心或最本质的部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iċ-ċentru jew il-parti fundamentali ta' xi ħaġa, li fiha jinsab dak li hu l-aktar importanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The core of something is its central or most essential part, on which its character or meaning depends.

collocations.en: the central point of the argument

formal.mt: L-għofol tal-argument huwa li kull student għandu jkollu aċċess għall-istess opportunitajiet ta' tagħlim.
formal.en: The central point of the argument is that every student should have access to the same learning opportunities.
formal.zh: 这一论证的核心是，每个学生都应享有同等的学习机会。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu l-għofol tal-problema? Mark: Li m'għandniex biżżejjed ħin biex inlestu kollox.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is the heart of the problem? Mark: That we do not have enough time to finish everything.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：问题的核心是什么？马克：我们没有足够的时间完成所有事情。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 问题的核心是什么？
messages.en: What is the heart of the problem?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Li m'għandniex biżżejjed ħin biex inlestu kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Li m'għandniex biżżejjed ħin biex inlestu kollox.
messages.zh: 我们没有足够的时间完成所有事情。
messages.en: That we do not have enough time to finish everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一篇长论证逐层剥开，最后只留下正中央的一句话；这句最重要的话就是 għofol，帮助联记“核心、要旨”。

gloss_zh: 荆棘；有刺的悬钩子类灌木

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thorny shrub with long, tangled stems.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种枝条较长、相互缠绕且带刺的灌木，通常指悬钩子类植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arbuxxell bix-xewk li għandu friegħi twal u mħabblin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 荆棘；枝条缠绕、带刺的悬钩子类灌木。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arbuxxell li għandu friegħi twal bix-xewk li jitħabblu ma' xulxin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bramble is a thorny shrub whose long stems often become tangled together.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema neħħew l-għolliq li kien qed jagħlaq il-mogħdija.
formal.en: The workers removed the bramble that was blocking the path.
formal.zh: 工人们清除了堵住小路的荆棘。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Oqgħod attent għall-għolliq ħdejn il-ħajt. Mark: Rajtu, se ngħaddi min-naħa l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Watch out for the bramble beside the wall. Mark: I've seen it; I'll go around the other side.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：小心墙边的荆棘。马克：看到了，我从另一边绕过去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 小心墙边的荆棘。
messages.en: Watch out for the bramble beside the wall.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，我从另一边绕过去。
messages.en: I've seen it; I'll go around the other side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għolliq 和「小路旁缠成一团的带刺灌木」画面联系起来，看到它就想到需要绕行的荆棘。

gloss_zh: 荆棘；有刺的悬钩子类灌木

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thorny shrub whose long stems can form a tangled mass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种长有尖刺、枝条容易缠绕成团的灌木，通常指悬钩子类植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arbuxxell bix-xewk li l-friegħi twal tiegħu jistgħu jitħabblu u jiffurmaw massa densa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 荆棘；带刺且枝条容易缠结的悬钩子类灌木。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta arbuxxellija bix-xewk u bi friegħi twal li jistgħu jitħabblu ma' xulxin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bramble is a shrub with prickly stems that can grow into a tangled mass.

formal.mt: Waqt it-tindif tal-ġnien, il-ġardinar qata' l-għolliqa li kienet kibret ħdejn il-bieb.
formal.en: While clearing the garden, the gardener cut down the bramble that had grown beside the gate.
formal.zh: 清理花园时，园丁砍除了长在园门旁的荆棘。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tilbes l-ingwanti? Pawlu: Se naqta' l-għolliqa, u ma rridx inweġġa' jdejja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you putting on gloves? Pawlu: I'm going to cut down the bramble, and I don't want to hurt my hands.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么戴手套？保罗：我要砍除那株荆棘，不想弄伤手。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 你为什么戴手套？
messages.en: Why are you putting on gloves?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Se naqta' l-għolliqa, u ma rridx inweġġa' jdejja.
messages.mt_standard: Se naqta' l-għolliqa, u ma rridx inweġġa' jdejja.
messages.zh: 我要砍除那株荆棘，不想弄伤手。
messages.en: I'm going to cut down the bramble, and I don't want to hurt my hands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 għolliqa 时，想象园丁戴着厚手套处理带刺灌木；用「手套防刺」这个场景记住荆棘义。

gloss_zh: 困倦的人；昏昏欲睡的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is sleepy or drowsy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到困倦、想睡觉或难以保持清醒的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun bin-ngħas u ssibha diffiċli biex tibqa' mqajma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 困倦的人；处于昏昏欲睡状态的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tħoss il-bżonn li torqod u ma tkunx għalkollox attenta minħabba n-ngħas.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sleepy person feels a need to sleep and may find it difficult to stay alert.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-għonos baqa' bilqiegħda ħdejn it-tieqa waqt li l-oħrajn komplew jitkellmu.
formal.en: In the story, the sleepy person remained seated by the window while the others continued talking.
formal.zh: 故事里，那个昏昏欲睡的人一直坐在窗边，其他人则继续交谈。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu l-għonos tagħna? Toni: Għadu fis-sodda; se mmur inqajmu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where's our sleepyhead? Toni: He's still in bed; I'll go and wake him.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：咱们那个瞌睡虫在哪里？托尼：还在床上呢，我去叫醒他。

messages.speaker: Lara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 咱们那个瞌睡虫在哪里？
messages.en: Where's our sleepyhead?

messages.speaker: Toni (哥哥)
messages.zh: 还在床上呢，我去叫醒他。
messages.en: He's still in bed; I'll go and wake him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għonos 记成故事里那个眼皮下垂、坐着也想睡的人；本条按名词记「困倦的人」。

exact_key: għoti ta' kuntratt bl-iktar prezz baxx offrut
gloss_zh: 按最低报价自动授予合同

teaching_sense.en_definition: The automatic award of a contract on the basis of the lowest price offered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依据所提交的最低报价，自动决定合同归属的授予方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti awtomatiku ta' kuntratt abbażi tal-iktar prezz baxx li jkun ġie offrut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自动授标；此处指依据最低报价自动授予合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess li fih kuntratt jingħata awtomatikament lil min ikun offra l-iktar prezz baxx.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An automatic award occurs when a contract is assigned on the basis of the lowest price offered.

collocations.mt: il-prinċipju tal-għoti ta' kuntratt bl-iktar prezz baxx offrut
collocations.en: the principle of automatically awarding a contract on the basis of the lowest price offered
collocations.zh: 按最低报价自动授予合同的原则

collocations.mt: l-użu tal-għoti ta' kuntratt bl-iktar prezz baxx offrut
collocations.en: the use of automatic contract award based on the lowest price offered
collocations.zh: 采用按最低报价自动授予合同的方式

formal.mt: Id-dokument ta' taħriġ jispjega l-għoti ta' kuntratt bl-iktar prezz baxx offrut permezz ta' eżempju bi tliet offerti.
formal.en: The training document explains automatic contract award based on the lowest price offered through an example involving three bids.
formal.zh: 培训文件通过一个包含三份报价的例子，说明按最低报价自动授予合同的方式。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'ifisser għoti ta' kuntratt bl-iktar prezz baxx offrut? David: F'dan l-eżempju, il-kuntratt jingħata awtomatikament lil min joffri l-inqas prezz.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does automatic contract award based on the lowest price offered mean? David: In this example, the contract automatically goes to whoever offers the lowest price.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：按最低报价自动授予合同是什么意思？戴维：在这个例子中，谁报的价格最低，合同就自动授予谁。

messages.speaker: Marija (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ifisser għoti ta' kuntratt bl-iktar prezz baxx offrut?
messages.mt_standard: X'ifisser għoti ta' kuntratt bl-iktar prezz baxx offrut?
messages.zh: 按最低报价自动授予合同是什么意思？
messages.en: What does automatic contract award based on the lowest price offered mean?

messages.speaker: David (培训讲师)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan l-eżempju, il-kuntratt jingħata awtomatikament lil min joffri l-inqas prezz.
messages.mt_standard: F'dan l-eżempju, il-kuntratt jingħata awtomatikament lil min joffri l-inqas prezz.
messages.zh: 在这个例子中，谁报的价格最低，合同就自动授予谁。
messages.en: In this example, the contract automatically goes to whoever offers the lowest price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按短语分块记忆：għoti 是授予，ta' kuntratt 是合同的，bl-iktar prezz baxx offrut 是按所报最低价；连成「最低报价自动获授合同」。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of making services available to people or organisations that need them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向有需要的个人或机构提供服务的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li biha jiġu pprovduti servizzi lil persuni jew organizzazzjonijiet li jkollhom bżonnhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 服务提供，即安排并实施面向服务对象的服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-organizzazzjoni u t-twettiq ta' servizzi għall-persuni jew l-organizzazzjonijiet li jużawhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The provision of services is the activity of making particular services available to those who need them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 服务供应，即由供应方向接受方提供所需服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li bih fornitur jipprovdi servizzi lil persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tirċevihom.

colloquial.en: Lara: What does this centre do? Mark: It handles the provision of services to older people, such as help at home.

gloss_zh: 合同授予；合同交付承办

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of assigning a contract to a person or organisation to carry out the agreed work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将合同授予某个人或机构，由其承担约定工作的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih kuntratt jiġi assenjat lil persuna jew organizzazzjoni biex twettaq ix-xogħol miftiehem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合同授予，即选定并正式确定合同承接方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għażla u l-ħatra ta' persuna jew organizzazzjoni biex tingħata l-kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The award of the contract is the decision that a particular person or organisation will receive it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将合同交由特定承接方办理，以安排所需工作或供应。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-assenjazzjoni ta' kuntratt lil fornitur jew kuntrattur biex jipprovdi dak li jkun miftiehem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The placing of the contract involves arranging for a particular supplier or contractor to undertake the agreed work.

collocations.en: the award of the contract to the selected company
collocations.zh: 将合同授予选定的公司

collocations.en: a delay in awarding the contract

formal.mt: L-għoti tal-kuntratt se jitħabbar wara l-evalwazzjoni tal-offerti.
formal.en: The award of the contract will be announced after the tenders have been evaluated.
formal.zh: 评估投标文件后，将公布合同授予结果。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Meta se nkunu nafu min ħa l-kuntratt? Pawlu: Għada; l-għoti tal-kuntratt se jitħabbar filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Marta: When will we know who got the contract? Pawlu: Tomorrow; the award of the contract will be announced in the morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我们什么时候能知道谁拿到了合同？保罗：明天；上午会公布合同授予结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression indicating that something pleased you or that you liked it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事物让你感到喜欢或满意的表达；在问句中可用于询问你是否喜欢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li xi ħaġa kienet ta' gost għalik jew li kont kuntent biha, u li tista' tintuża f'mistoqsija dwar dan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你喜欢某事物，或觉得某事物令人满意。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li turi li xi ħaġa kienet pjaċevoli għalik jew li ħalliet impressjoni tajba fuqek.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This expression indicates that something pleased you and can also be used to ask whether you liked it.

formal.mt: Fil-kwestjonarju, wieġeb il-mistoqsija: 'Għoġbok il-kors li għadek kif lestejt?'
formal.en: In the questionnaire, answer the question: 'Did you like the course you have just completed?'
formal.zh: 请在问卷中回答这个问题：“你喜欢刚刚完成的课程吗？”

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għoġbok il-film tal-bieraħ? Mark: Iva, għoġobni ħafna, speċjalment it-tmiem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you like yesterday's film? Mark: Yes, I liked it a lot, especially the ending.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢昨天那部电影吗？马克：喜欢，我很喜欢，尤其是结尾。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢昨天那部电影吗？
messages.en: Did you like yesterday's film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 喜欢，我很喜欢，尤其是结尾。
messages.en: Yes, I liked it a lot, especially the ending.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Għoġbok il-film? 当作散场后问朋友的整句来记：“刚才的电影你喜欢吗？”用具体场景固定“你喜欢”的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To value someone or something deeply and treat them or it with care and affection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 深切重视某人或某物，并以关爱和珍惜的态度对待。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti valur kbir lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa u tittrattahom b'imħabba u b'għożża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 珍爱、珍惜某人或某物，因其对自己重要而用心爱护。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tħobb u tapprezza ħafna lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa u tieħu ħsiebhom b'attenzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you cherish someone or something, you value them deeply and treat them with affection and care.

formal.mt: Għożż il-wirt kulturali ta' pajjiżek u għaddih lill-ġenerazzjonijiet li ġejjin.
formal.en: Cherish your country's cultural heritage and pass it on to future generations.
formal.zh: 珍爱你祖国的文化遗产，并将其传承给后代。

colloquial.mt: Nina: In-nanna tatni dan iċ-ċurkett. Marija: Għożż dan ir-rigal; hu tifkira sabiħa tagħha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Grandma gave me this ring. Marija: Cherish this gift; it is a lovely reminder of her.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：奶奶把这枚戒指送给了我。玛丽娅：好好珍惜这份礼物；它能让你美好地想起她。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)

messages.mt_standard: Għożż dan ir-rigal; hu tifkira sabiħa tagħha.
messages.zh: 好好珍惜这份礼物；它能让你美好地想起她。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression locating something at the final part or closing point of an event, sequence, or object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事发生在一个活动、次序或事物的末尾；例句用 fl-aħħar 表达所给的“在末尾”这一含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li xi ħaġa tinsab jew isseħħ fl-aħħar parti ta' oġġett, sekwenza jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某事物的末尾，或在某个过程结束的时候。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fl-aħħar parti ta' xi ħaġa jew fil-ħin meta attività tkun qed tintemm.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This expression places something in the final part or at the closing point of something else.

collocations.en: at the end of the meeting
at the end of the book

formal.mt: Id-deċiżjoni tħabbret fl-aħħar tal-laqgħa.
formal.en: The decision was announced at the end of the meeting.
formal.zh: 这项决定在会议结束时公布。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn insib it-tweġibiet? Lara: Fl-aħħar tal-ktieb, wara l-aħħar eżerċizzju.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where can I find the answers? Lara: At the end of the book, after the last exercise.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我在哪里能找到答案？Lara：在书的末尾，最后一道练习后面。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“在末尾”画成一本翻到最后一页的书，再联想会议结束的时刻；用例句中的 fl-aħħar 将这两个场景串起来记忆。

sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaġra f'dan is-sens hija ġebla prezzjuża jew ġawhra, bħal djamant.

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being alive, or the experience and course of a person's existence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 活着的状态，即生命；也可指一个人所经历的人生或生活。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat li tkun ħaj, jew l-esperjenzi u ż-żmien li jgħaddi minnhom bniedem matul l-eżistenza tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生命，即活着的状态；也指人生或一个人的生活经历。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħajja hija l-istat li tkun ħaj, u tista' tirreferi wkoll għall-mod kif persuna tgħix u għall-esperjenzi tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Life is the state of being alive or the experiences a person has during their existence.

formal.mt: Il-ktieb jiddeskrivi l-ħajja ta' kuljum tal-familja u l-bidliet li għaddiet minnhom matul is-snin.

messages.en: Watch out, there's dog poop in front of you!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (遛狗者)
messages.zh: 看到了。你有袋子吗？我把它捡起来。
messages.en: I saw it. Do you have a bag so I can pick it up?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，给你一个。
messages.en: Yes, here's one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 harra 放进遛狗后拿袋子清理的画面里记忆：需要捡起来的是便便，不是普通垃圾。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A carob tree, which bears long pods containing seeds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 角豆树，一种结有长形豆荚、荚内含种子的树。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siġra li tagħmel imżiewed twal li fihom iż-żerriegħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 角豆树；此处指树本身。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Siġra li l-frott tagħha jkun f'għamla ta' mżiewed twal biż-żerriegħa ġewwa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A carob tree is a tree that produces long pods with seeds inside them.

formal.mt: Fil-ġnien hemm harrub kbir li jagħti d-dell lill-bank ta' taħtu.
formal.en: There is a large carob tree in the garden that shades the bench beneath it.
formal.zh: 花园里有一棵高大的角豆树，为树下的长椅遮阴。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn se noqogħdu nistrieħu? Toni: Taħt il-harrub, ħdejn dak il-bank. Nina: Tajjeb, hemm ħafna dell hemm.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where shall we sit and rest? Toni: Under the carob tree, beside that bench. Nina: Good, there's plenty of shade there.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们坐在哪里休息？Toni：角豆树下，就在那张长椅旁。Nina：好，那里树荫很足。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们坐在哪里休息？
messages.en: Where shall we sit and rest?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 角豆树下，就在那张长椅旁。
messages.en: Under the carob tree, beside that bench.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，那里树荫很足。
messages.en: Good, there's plenty of shade there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 harrub 时想象一棵挂着长豆荚、树下可以乘凉的角豆树，把这个词与整棵树的形象绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun presented as 'haruf', with no meaning specified in the supplied material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料中列作名词的 haruf；材料未提供可确定其含义的释义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom mogħti bħala 'haruf' li t-tifsira tiegħu mhix spjegata fil-materjal ipprovdut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义仅重复 haruf，未说明该名词的具体含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nom li għalih il-materjal jirrepeti biss il-forma 'haruf', mingħajr ma jagħti tifsira ċara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry repeats 'haruf' without explaining what this noun means.

formal.mt: Il-materjal jelenka 'haruf' bħala nom, iżda ma jipprovdix definizzjoni li tiċċara t-tifsira tiegħu.
formal.en: The material lists 'haruf' as a noun but does not provide a definition that clarifies its meaning.
formal.zh: 材料将“haruf”列为名词，但未提供能够说明其含义的定义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'haruf' hawn? Mark: Ma nafx; il-lista tirrepeti biss l-istess kelma. Maja: Mela nħallu t-tifsira miftuħa sakemm ikollna aktar tagħrif.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'haruf' mean here? Mark: I don't know; the list only repeats the same word. Maja: Then let's leave the meaning open until we have more information.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的“haruf”是什么意思？Mark：我不知道，词表只是重复了同一个词。Maja：那就等有更多资料后再确定它的含义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的“haruf”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'haruf' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx; il-lista tirrepeti biss l-istess kelma.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx; il-lista tirrepeti biss l-istess kelma.
messages.zh: 我不知道，词表只是重复了同一个词。
messages.en: I don't know; the list only repeats the same word.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nħallu t-tifsira miftuħa sakemm ikollna aktar tagħrif.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nħallu t-tifsira miftuħa sakemm ikollna aktar tagħrif.
messages.zh: 那就等有更多资料后再确定它的含义。
messages.en: Then let's leave the meaning open until we have more information.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 haruf 写在一张带问号的词卡上：先记住拼写和名词身份，释义留待材料补全，避免用猜测形成错误联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short trip away from home, usually for pleasure or recreation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常为休闲或娱乐而进行的短途外出活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żjara jew vjaġġ qasir barra mid-dar, normalment biex wieħed jieħu gost jew jistrieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出游，通常指为游玩或放松而安排的短途外出。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attività li fiha persuna jew grupp joħroġ għal ftit ħin biex iżur post jew jieħu gost.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An outing is a short trip that people make for enjoyment, often together with friends or family.

formal.mt: L-iskola se torganizza harġa fil-kampanja biex l-istudenti josservaw il-pjanti.
formal.en: The school will organize an outing in the countryside so that students can observe the plants.
formal.zh: 学校将组织一次乡间出游，让学生观察植物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi għal harġa magħna l-Ħadd? Mark: Iva! Fejn se mmorru? Maja: Se nqattgħu ftit ħin ħdejn il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like to come on an outing with us on Sunday? Mark: Yes! Where are we going? Maja: We're going to spend some time by the sea.
colloquial.zh: Maja：星期日想和我们一起出去玩吗？Mark：想！我们去哪里？Maja：我们去海边待一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi għal harġa magħna l-Ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi għal harġa magħna l-Ħadd?
messages.zh: 星期日想和我们一起出去玩吗？
messages.en: Would you like to come on an outing with us on Sunday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 想！我们去哪里？
messages.en: Yes! Where are we going?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nqattgħu ftit ħin ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Se nqattgħu ftit ħin ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.zh: 我们去海边待一会儿。
messages.en: We're going to spend some time by the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 harġa 和日历上画着海边的小格子联系起来：约好时间，短暂外出游玩，就是一次出游。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose business is selling candles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以出售蜡烛为业的商人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tbigħ ix-xemgħat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经营蜡烛买卖的人；蜡烛商。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha negozju tal-bejgħ tax-xemgħat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A chandler is someone whose business involves selling candles.

collocations.en: to buy candles from a chandler

formal.mt: Għall-attività ta' filgħaxija, il-kumitat xtara x-xemgħat mingħand hatab lokali.
formal.en: For the evening event, the committee bought the candles from a local chandler.
formal.zh: 为筹备晚间活动，委员会向当地一位蜡烛商购买了蜡烛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn nixtru x-xemgħat għall-mejda? Mark: Hemm hatab ħdejn is-suq. Nistgħu mmorru għandu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we buy the candles for the table? Mark: There is a chandler near the market. We can go to his shop.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们去哪里买摆在桌上的蜡烛？Mark：市场附近有位蜡烛商。我们可以去他的店。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们去哪里买摆在桌上的蜡烛？
messages.en: Where shall we buy the candles for the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm hatab ħdejn is-suq. Nistgħu mmorru għandu.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm hatab ħdejn is-suq. Nistgħu mmorru għandu.
messages.zh: 市场附近有位蜡烛商。我们可以去他的店。
messages.en: There is a chandler near the market. We can go to his shop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hatab 写在想象中的蜡烛店老板胸牌上，连同“买蜡烛找谁”这个问题一起记，突出它指卖蜡烛的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A length of wood used as a stick.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一根可供手持或使用的木制棍棒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa injam twila u dejqa li tista' tintuża biex wieħed iżomm jew iċaqlaq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 细长的木制棍棒；木棍。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa injam twila u dejqa li tintuża bħala bastun jew għal xogħol ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A wooden stick is a long, narrow piece of wood used for various practical purposes.

collocations.en: to hold a wooden stick in one's hand

formal.mt: Waqt l-attività, l-għalliem uża hatar twil biex juri l-fond tal-ilma.
formal.en: During the activity, the teacher used a long wooden stick to show the depth of the water.
formal.zh: 活动期间，老师用一根长木棍展示水的深度。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ballun daħal taħt il-bank. Kif se noħorġuh? Pawlu: Għandi hatar twil. Nistgħu nużawh biex niġbdu l-ballun lejna.
colloquial.en: Lara: The ball went under the bench. How shall we get it out? Pawlu: I have a long wooden stick. We can use it to pull the ball towards us.
colloquial.zh: Lara：球滚到长凳下面了。我们怎么把它弄出来？Pawlu：我有一根长木棍。我们可以用它把球拨过来。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ballun daħal taħt il-bank. Kif se noħorġuh?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ballun daħal taħt il-bank. Kif se noħorġuh?
messages.zh: 球滚到长凳下面了。我们怎么把它弄出来？
messages.en: The ball went under the bench. How shall we get it out?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi hatar twil. Nistgħu nużawh biex niġbdu l-ballun lejna.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi hatar twil. Nistgħu nużawh biex niġbdu l-ballun lejna.
messages.zh: 我有一根长木棍。我们可以用它把球拨过来。
messages.en: I have a long wooden stick. We can use it to pull the ball towards us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根写着 hatar 的长木棍，正把长凳下的球拨出来；用这个动作记住它是木棍，并非某种特定工具。

gloss_zh: 姻亲兄弟；配偶的兄弟或姐妹的丈夫

teaching_sense.en_definition: A brother of your spouse or the husband of your sibling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由婚姻关系形成的男性亲属，指配偶的兄弟或自己姐妹的丈夫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġel li jkun ħu żewġek jew martek, jew ir-raġel ta' oħtok.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 配偶的兄弟或自己姐妹的丈夫，如大伯子、小叔子、内兄、内弟、姐夫或妹夫。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Raġel li hu marbut miegħek biż-żwieġ għax ikun ħu żewġek jew martek, jew għax ikun miżżewweġ lil oħtok.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your brother in law is your spouse's brother or the man married to your sibling.

formal.mt: Il-hatni tiegħi, ir-raġel ta' oħti, għen lill-familja torganizza l-laqgħa.
formal.en: My brother-in-law, my sister's husband, helped the family organize the gathering.
formal.zh: 我的姐夫，也就是我姐姐的丈夫，帮助家里组织了这次聚会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ħdejn oħtok? Mark: Dak il-hatni tiegħi, ir-raġel ta' oħti. Jismu David.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that next to your sister? Mark: That is my brother-in-law, my sister's husband. His name is David.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你姐姐旁边那个人是谁？Mark：那是我姐夫，也就是我姐姐的丈夫。他叫 David。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你姐姐旁边那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that next to your sister?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-hatni tiegħi, ir-raġel ta' oħti. Jismu David.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-hatni tiegħi, ir-raġel ta' oħti. Jismu David.
messages.zh: 那是我姐夫，也就是我姐姐的丈夫。他叫 David。
messages.en: That is my brother-in-law, my sister's husband. His name is David.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一张小家庭关系图，把 hatni 标在“姐姐的丈夫”和“配偶的兄弟”旁；中文称谓要随具体关系选择，不能固定译成哥哥。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unable to produce crops, offspring, or new growth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不能长出作物或新生植物的；也可指不能生育的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jipproduċix għelejjel jew tkabbir ġdid, jew li ma jistax ikollu wlied.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 土地贫瘠而不长作物的；生物不能生育或繁殖的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jagħtix għelejjel jew ma jsostnix tkabbir ta' pjanti, jew li ma jistax jipproduċi wlied.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something barren cannot produce crops, support new growth, or produce offspring.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-terren bħala hawli, għax ma jikbru fih ebda għelejjel.
formal.en: The report describes the land as barren because no crops grow there.
formal.zh: 报告将这片土地描述为贫瘠之地，因为那里长不出任何作物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex m'hemm xejn jikber f'dak il-post? Pawlu: It-terren hu hawli. Lanqas il-ħaxix ma jikber hemm.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is nothing growing in that place? Pawlu: The land is barren. Even grass does not grow there.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那个地方为什么什么都不长？Pawlu：土地很贫瘠。那里连草都长不出来。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex m'hemm xejn jikber f'dak il-post?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex m'hemm xejn jikber f'dak il-post?
messages.zh: 那个地方为什么什么都不长？
messages.en: Why is nothing growing in that place?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-terren hu hawli. Lanqas il-ħaxix ma jikber hemm.
messages.mt_standard: It-terren hu hawli. Lanqas il-ħaxix ma jikber hemm.
messages.zh: 土地很贫瘠。那里连草都长不出来。
messages.en: The land is barren. Even grass does not grow there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hawli 配上一幅连草都长不出的土地画面，记住核心是“无法生长或繁育”；用于土地时译“贫瘠”，用于生育能力时译“不育”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At this particular place, close to the speaker or indicated by the speaker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在这里，指说话人附近或说话人明确指出的具体地点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'dan il-post partikolari, qrib min qed jitkellem jew indikat minnu.

sense_translations.en_definition: here (proximal demonstrative referring to a specific place)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 这里；用于指示靠近说话人或当前明确指出的具体地点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Avverbju li jindika dan il-post partikolari, qrib min qed jitkellem jew fejn ikun qed jipponta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use hawnhekk to indicate the particular place where you are or the nearby place you are pointing to.

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, ikteb ismek hawnhekk u ffirma taħtu.
formal.en: Please write your name here and sign underneath it.
formal.zh: 请在这里写上姓名，并在下方签名。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġi l-borża? Lara: Poġġiha hawnhekk, ħdejn is-siġġu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I put the bag? Lara: Put it here, next to the chair.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我把包放在哪里？Lara：放在这里，椅子旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我把包放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put the bag?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 放在这里，椅子旁边。
messages.en: Put it here, next to the chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时用手指向脚边，再说 hawnhekk，把整个词与“就在这里”的具体位置绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cheating or sexual intercourse outside marriage, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按语境指欺骗、作弊，或婚姻之外的性行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qerq jew relazzjonijiet sesswali barra ż-żwieġ, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺骗、作弊；也指婚姻之外的性行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imġiba li tinvolvi qerq, jew relazzjonijiet sesswali barra ż-żwieġ; it-tifsira tiddependi mill-kuntest.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ħaxi refers to cheating or to sexual intercourse outside marriage, with the intended meaning depending on the context.

formal.mt: F'din is-silta, il-kelma 'ħaxi' tirreferi għall-qerq; f'kuntest ieħor tista' tirreferi għal relazzjonijiet sesswali barra ż-żwieġ.
formal.en: In this passage, the word 'ħaxi' refers to cheating; in another context it can refer to sexual relations outside marriage.
formal.zh: 在这段文字中，ħaxi 指欺骗；在其他语境中，它也可以指婚姻之外的性关系。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi tfisser 'ħaxi' hawn? Lara: Hawn tfisser qerq. F'kuntest ieħor jista' jkollha tifsira sesswali.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does 'ħaxi' mean here? Lara: Here it means cheating. In another context it can have a sexual meaning.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这里的 ħaxi 是什么意思？Lara：这里指欺骗。在其他语境中，它可能有性方面的含义。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 这里的 ħaxi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ħaxi' mean here?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser qerq. F'kuntest ieħor jista' jkollha tifsira sesswali.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser qerq. F'kuntest ieħor jista' jkollha tifsira sesswali.
messages.zh: 这里指欺骗。在其他语境中，它可能有性方面的含义。
messages.en: Here it means cheating. In another context it can have a sexual meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħaxi 记成需要查看上下文的双义词：一张卡写“欺骗”，另一张卡写“婚外性行为”，读句子时再选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Vegetables considered together as food for cooking or eating.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蔬菜，指供烹调或食用的各类蔬菜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanti jew partijiet minnhom, bħal weraq u għeruq, li jintużaw bħala ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蔬菜；作为食物食用的植物或其可食部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanti jew partijiet li jittieklu minnhom, bħal karrotti, kaboċċi u spinaċi, meqjusa flimkien bħala ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ħaxix is vegetables such as carrots, cabbage, and spinach that people prepare or eat as food.

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, aħsel il-ħaxix u aqtagħha f'biċċiet żgħar qabel issajjarha.
formal.en: For this recipe, wash the vegetables and cut them into small pieces before cooking them.
formal.zh: 制作这道菜时，先把蔬菜洗净并切成小块，再进行烹调。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se nsajru llejla? Mark: Nagħmlu soppa tal-ħaxix. Għandna karrotti u patata.
colloquial.en: Maja: What shall we cook tonight? Mark: Let's make vegetable soup. We have carrots and potatoes.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今晚我们做什么？Mark：做蔬菜汤吧。我们有胡萝卜和土豆。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 今晚我们做什么？
messages.en: What shall we cook tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħmlu soppa tal-ħaxix. Għandna karrotti u patata.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħmlu soppa tal-ħaxix. Għandna karrotti u patata.
messages.zh: 做蔬菜汤吧。我们有胡萝卜和土豆。
messages.en: Let's make vegetable soup. We have carrots and potatoes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象购物篮里装满胡萝卜、卷心菜和菠菜，用 ħaxix 一词给整篮蔬菜贴标签，再连读 ħaxix frisk。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A common winter weed that produces yellow flowers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种冬季常见、开黄色花朵的杂草。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxixa ħażina komuni li tikber fix-xitwa u tagħmel fjuri sofor.

sense_translations.en_definition: Common winter weed with yellow flowers
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种冬季常见的杂草，开黄色花朵。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaxixa ħażina li tinstab ta' spiss fix-xitwa u li tingħaraf mill-fjuri sofor tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ħaxixa Ingliża is a common weed found in winter that can be recognized by its yellow flowers.

collocations.en: the yellow flowers of this winter weed
collocations.zh: 这种冬季杂草的黄色花朵

formal.mt: Fix-xitwa, l-istudenti osservaw il-ħaxixa Ingliża u ddeskrivew il-fjuri sofor tagħha.
formal.en: In winter, the students observed the weed called ħaxixa Ingliża and described its yellow flowers.
formal.zh: 冬季，学生们观察了名为 ħaxixa Ingliża 的杂草，并描述了它的黄色花朵。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jisimha din il-ħaxixa bil-fjuri sofor? Pawlu: Din hi l-ħaxixa Ingliża. Taraha ta' spiss fix-xitwa.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this weed with yellow flowers called? Pawlu: It's called ħaxixa Ingliża. You often see it in winter.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这种开黄花的杂草叫什么？Pawlu：它叫 ħaxixa Ingliża。冬天经常能看到。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这种开黄花的杂草叫什么？
messages.en: What is this weed with yellow flowers called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din hi l-ħaxixa Ingliża. Taraha ta' spiss fix-xitwa.
messages.mt_standard: Din hi l-ħaxixa Ingliża. Taraha ta' spiss fix-xitwa.
messages.zh: 它叫 ħaxixa Ingliża。冬天经常能看到。
messages.en: It's called ħaxixa Ingliża. You often see it in winter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħaxixa Ingliża 整体记成一张冬季黄花杂草的识别卡，用“冬季、常见、黄花”三个提示回忆词义。

gloss_zh: 朋友们（所给义项的英文释义损坏）

teaching_sense.en_definition: People you know well, like, and enjoy spending time with.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 朋友们；彼此熟悉、相互喜欢并愿意一起相处的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuni li tafhom sew, li tħobb tqatta' l-ħin magħhom u li magħhom għandek relazzjoni ta' ħbiberija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所给英文释义“dd\d”无法辨识，不能据此可靠确定这一义项的具体含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa mogħtija, 'dd\d', mhijiex ċara u ma tippermettix li t-tifsira ta' dan is-sens tiġi identifikata b'mod affidabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss is unreadable, so this particular sense cannot be reliably identified.

formal.mt: L-attività tipprovdi opportunità biex il-parteċipanti jagħmlu ħbieb ġodda.
formal.en: The activity provides an opportunity for participants to make new friends.
formal.zh: 这项活动为参与者提供了结交新朋友的机会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma' min sejjer il-baħar? Mark: Sejjer ma' xi ħbieb. Trid tiġi magħna?
colloquial.en: Maja: Who are you going to the beach with? Mark: I'm going with some friends. Do you want to come with us?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要和谁去海边？马克：我要和几个朋友去。你想跟我们一起去吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要和谁去海边？
messages.en: Who are you going to the beach with?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejjer ma' xi ħbieb. Trid tiġi magħna?
messages.mt_standard: Sejjer ma' xi ħbieb. Trid tiġi magħna?
messages.zh: 我要和几个朋友去。你想跟我们一起去吗？
messages.en: I'm going with some friends. Do you want to come with us?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“ma' xi ħbieb＝和几个朋友一起”整块记忆，想象周末相约去海边；所给英文义项释义已损坏，不用乱码推导词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used to affirm a prayer or wish, meaning that you hope it will be so.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于回应或结束祈祷、祝愿的感叹语，表示赞同并希望所说的事情实现，相当于“阿门”或“愿如此”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex wieħed jafferma talba jew xewqa u juri li jixtieq li dak li ntqal iseħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阿门；用于祈祷或祝愿之后，表示认同并祈愿所说的事情实现。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni ta' qbil u tama, li tingħad wara talba jew xewqa biex wieħed juri li jixtieq li dak li ntqal iseħħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You say this after a prayer or wish to express agreement and the hope that it will come true.

formal.mt: Jalla din is-sena ġġib is-saħħa u l-paċi lill-familji kollha. Hekk ikun.
formal.en: May this year bring health and peace to all families. Amen.
formal.zh: 愿这一年为所有家庭带来健康与和平。阿门。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Jalla kollox imur tajjeb għada. Pawlu: Hekk ikun! Ilna nistennew din il-ġurnata.
colloquial.en: Rita: May everything go well tomorrow. Pawlu: Amen to that! We've been waiting for this day for a long time.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：但愿明天一切顺利。保罗：愿如此！我们盼这一天盼了很久。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 但愿明天一切顺利。
messages.en: May everything go well tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hekk ikun! Ilna nistennew din il-ġurnata.
messages.mt_standard: Hekk ikun! Ilna nistennew din il-ġurnata.
messages.zh: 愿如此！我们盼这一天盼了很久。
messages.en: Amen to that! We've been waiting for this day for a long time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象别人说完一个美好祝愿，你接一句“愿如此”：把 hekk ikun 整体记成祈愿后的回应语。

gloss_zh: 一般般；马马虎虎；还过得去

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a passable but not particularly good state, especially in health or general circumstances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示身体状况或整体情况尚可，但并不好，常用于回答“最近怎么样”，相当于“一般般”或“还过得去”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li juri li s-saħħa jew il-qagħda ġenerali ta' persuna hija aċċettabbli, iżda mhijiex tajba ħafna.

sense_translations.en_definition: so-and-so (an expression suggesting one's health or general situation is passable, but not excellent)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一般般；马马虎虎；表示健康或整体处境还过得去，但算不上很好。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li turi li persuna tinsab f'qagħda jew fi stat ta' saħħa li mhuwiex ħażin wisq, iżda lanqas tajjeb ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you describe your health or situation this way, you mean that it is acceptable but not particularly good.

formal.mt: Fit-tweġiba tiegħu għall-istħarriġ, il-parteċipant kiteb: 'Bħalissa nħossni hekk u hekk.'
formal.en: In his response to the survey, the participant wrote: 'At present, I feel so-so.'
formal.zh: 这位参与者在调查答卷中写道：“目前我感觉一般般。”

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif int illum? Toni: Hekk u hekk. Għadni ftit għajjien.
colloquial.en: Sara: How are you today? Toni: So-so. I'm still a little tired.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今天怎么样？托尼：一般般，还是有点累。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天怎么样？
messages.en: How are you today?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hekk u hekk. Għadni ftit għajjien.
messages.mt_standard: Hekk u hekk. Għadni ftit għajjien.
messages.zh: 一般般，还是有点累。
messages.en: So-so. I'm still a little tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把重复的 hekk 想象成手掌左右轻摆，表示“不好不坏、一般般”；别人问近况时，可整句回答 Hekk u hekk。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A greeting expressed by saying 'hello' when meeting someone or beginning a conversation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 见面或开始交谈时说出的“你好”这一问候语，也可指这样的一声招呼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tislima magħmula bil-kelma 'hello', li tingħad meta tiltaqa' ma' xi ħadd jew tibda konverżazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: “你好”这一问候语；见面或开始交谈时说出的一声招呼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kelma 'Hello' meqjusa bħala tislima li tingħad meta persuna tiltaqa' ma' xi ħadd jew tibda titkellem miegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hello is a greeting you give when you meet someone or begin speaking to them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嗨；你好；早上好；用于向人打招呼的问候表达。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni ta' tislima li tintuża meta wieħed jiltaqa' ma' persuna oħra, b'tifsira bħal 'hi', 'hello' jew 'l-għodwa t-tajba'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to greet someone when you meet them or start a conversation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一声“你好”；用“hello”说出的问候或招呼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tislima li persuna tagħti lil oħra billi tgħid il-kelma 'hello' fil-bidu ta' laqgħa jew konverżazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hello is an act of greeting another person by saying the word 'hello'.

collocations.en: to start a conversation with hello

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom jibdew id-djalogu bit-tislima 'Hello'.
formal.en: In the exercise, students should begin the dialogue with the greeting 'Hello'.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，学生应以问候语“Hello”开始对话。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hello, Sam! Kif int? Sam: Hello, Lara! Tajjeb, grazzi. U int?
colloquial.en: Lara: Hello, Sam! How are you? Sam: Hello, Lara! I'm well, thanks. And you?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你好，萨姆！你怎么样？萨姆：你好，拉拉！我很好，谢谢。你呢？

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你好，萨姆！你怎么样？
messages.en: Hello, Sam! How are you?

messages.speaker: Sam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hello, Lara! Tajjeb, grazzi. U int?
messages.mt_standard: Hello, Lara! Tajjeb, grazzi. U int?
messages.zh: 你好，拉拉！我很好，谢谢。你呢？
messages.en: Hello, Lara! I'm well, thanks. And you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hello 想成见面时挥手说的一声“你好”；直接招呼别人时用问候表达，谈论“这一声招呼”时按名词理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give you assistance with a task, problem, or need; this supplied English phrase can be expressed in Maltese as 'ngħinek'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在任务、困难或需求方面给你帮助；所给词条是英语短语，马耳他语可用 ngħinek 表达“我帮助你”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frażi bl-Ingliż li tfisser li xi ħadd jagħtik l-għajnuna biex tagħmel xi ħaġa jew issolvi problema; bil-Malti, 'ngħinek' tesprimi li jiena nagħti l-għajnuna lilek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 帮助你，为你提供协助。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħtik l-għajnuna f'xogħol, f'diffikultà jew f'xi ħaġa li għandek bżonn tagħmel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone offers to help you, they offer assistance with something you need to do.

formal.mt: Jekk għandek diffikultà biex timla l-formola, nista' ngħinek pass pass.
formal.en: If you have difficulty completing the form, I can help you step by step.
formal.zh: 如果你填写表格有困难，我可以一步一步地帮助你。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' ngħinek b'dan l-eżerċizzju? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Ma nifhimx l-ewwel mistoqsija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I help you with this exercise? Mark: Yes, please. I don't understand the first question.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我可以帮你做这道练习吗？Mark：可以，麻烦你了。我不明白第一道题。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 我可以帮你做这道练习吗？
messages.en: Can I help you with this exercise?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Ma nifhimx l-ewwel mistoqsija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Ma nifhimx l-ewwel mistoqsija.
messages.zh: 可以，麻烦你了。我不明白第一道题。
messages.en: Yes, please. I don't understand the first question.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 help you 与“帮助你”的场景绑定，再整句记忆 Nista' ngħinek?，想象同学主动过来帮你解题。

gloss_zh: 美丽的；漂亮的（所给释义；名词用法未说明）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry supplied with the meaning 'Beautiful', referring to an attractive appearance; the packet does not explain its classification as a noun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给词条的释义为“美丽的、漂亮的”，涉及外观令人赏心悦目；保留资料指定的名词标签，但资料未解释其名词用法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata li fil-pakkett tingħata t-tifsira 'Beautiful', jiġifieri sabiħ jew sabiħa fid-dehra; il-pakkett ma jispjegax l-użu tagħha bħala nom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 美丽的，漂亮的，外观令人赏心悦目的；这是资料提供的释义，所标名词用法未获说明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Skont it-tifsira mogħtija fil-pakkett, sabiħ jew sabiħa fid-dehra u li jogħġob jew togħġob lill-għajn; ma jingħatax eżempju li juri użu bħala nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss describes someone or something whose appearance is attractive and pleasing to look at.

collocations.zh: 为 helwin 提供的释义

formal.mt: Il-pakkett jagħti 'Beautiful' bħala t-tifsira ta' 'helwin', iżda ma jipprovdix eżempju tal-użu tagħha bħala nom.
formal.en: The packet gives 'Beautiful' as the meaning of 'helwin', but provides no example of its use as a noun.
formal.zh: 资料将 helwin 释为“美丽的”，但没有提供其作为名词使用的例句。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'helwin' f'din il-lista? Mark: Il-lista tagħti 'Beautiful', imma ma turix kif tintuża bħala nom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'helwin' mean in this list? Mark: The list gives 'Beautiful', but doesn't show how it is used as a noun.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这张表里的 helwin 是什么意思？Mark：表中给的是“美丽的”，但没有说明它怎么用作名词。

messages.mt_standard: Il-lista tagħti 'Beautiful', imma ma turix kif tintuża bħala nom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 helwin 写在风景图片旁，关联资料中的“美丽的”；另加“名词用法待核”便签，避免把标签当成已掌握的语法。

gloss_zh: 词义未明；来源附有错误接受说明

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry whose meaning is not established in the packet; its source note says 'I do not know' and mentions acceptance as a mistake in today's Kelma.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 资料未确立词义的词条；原注表示“不知道”，并说明它在当日 Kelma 中被作为错误接受。名词标签按资料保留。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata li l-pakkett ma jagħtihiex tifsira stabbilita; in-nota tgħid 'Ma nafx' u ssemmi li ġiet aċċettata bħala żball fil-Kelma tal-lum. It-tikketta ta' nom tinżamm kif ingħatat.

sense_translations.en_definition: Ma nafx. (It was accepted as a mistake on today's Kelma)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 原注为：“我不知道。（它在今天的 Kelma 中被作为错误接受。）”这是对词条状态的说明，并未给出 hemda 的确定词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: In-nota tindika li min ta l-informazzjoni ma jafx it-tifsira u li l-entrata ġiet aċċettata bħala żball fil-Kelma tal-lum; ma tistabbilixxix x'tfisser 'hemda'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This source note reports uncertainty and an acceptance error, so it does not establish a meaning for the entry.

formal.mt: Fl-istudju ta' din il-lista, 'hemda' għandha tinżamm bħala entrata b'tifsira mhux stabbilita, għax in-nota tirrapporta inċertezza u żball.
formal.en: When studying this list, 'hemda' should be retained as an entry with an unestablished meaning, because the note reports uncertainty and an error.
formal.zh: 学习这张词表时，应将 hemda 保留为词义未定的条目，因为原注表达了不确定性并提及错误。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Allura 'hemda' tfisser 'Ma nafx'? Mark: Le, 'Ma nafx' hija n-nota ta' min ta l-informazzjoni; it-tifsira tal-entrata għadha mhix ċara.
colloquial.en: Maja: So does 'hemda' mean 'I don't know'? Mark: No, 'I don't know' is the contributor's note; the entry's meaning is still unclear.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那么 hemda 的意思就是“我不知道”吗？Mark：不是，“我不知道”是提供信息者的注释；这个词条的意思仍不清楚。
