messages.zh: 那么 hemda 的意思就是“我不知道”吗？
messages.en: So does 'hemda' mean 'I don't know'?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, 'Ma nafx' hija n-nota ta' min ta l-informazzjoni; it-tifsira tal-entrata għadha mhix ċara.
messages.mt_standard: Le, 'Ma nafx' hija n-nota ta' min ta l-informazzjoni; it-tifsira tal-entrata għadha mhix ċara.
messages.zh: 不是，“我不知道”是提供信息者的注释；这个词条的意思仍不清楚。

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 hemda 配一张问号卡，记住“注释说不知道，词义仍待核”；不要把注释里的 Ma nafx 背成这个词的翻译。

gloss_zh: 词义未提供；原释义仅重复词形

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry classified as a noun whose supplied gloss only repeats 'Hemla', leaving its meaning unspecified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 资料标为名词的词条；所给释义仅重复 Hemla，没有提供可确定其意义的解释。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata kklassifikata bħala nom li t-tifsira mogħtija għaliha tirrepeti biss 'Hemla', mingħajr ma tispjega xi tfisser.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义仅为 Hemla，与词条本身重复；资料没有提供实际词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kelma 'Hemla' tidher ukoll bħala t-tifsira tal-entrata, iżda din ir-ripetizzjoni ma tagħti ebda spjegazzjoni tat-tifsira tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss repeats the entry itself and therefore provides no explanation of what it means.

collocations.en: an explanation of the meaning of 'hemla'
collocations.zh: 对 hemla 词义的解释

formal.mt: L-entrata 'hemla' teħtieġ spjegazzjoni oħra, peress li t-tifsira mogħtija tirrepeti biss l-istess kelma.
formal.en: The entry 'hemla' requires a further explanation, since the supplied gloss only repeats the same word.

gloss_zh: 神志昏乱的；爱反复思量的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes someone who is delirious, or someone who tends to turn matters over repeatedly in thought.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人神志昏乱，或形容人习惯反复琢磨事情；这两个义项需要根据语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li tkun f'delirju, jew persuna li għandha t-tendenza taħseb fit-tul u ripetutament dwar l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神志昏乱的；处于谵妄状态的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun f'delirju u ma jkunx jista' jaħseb jew jifhem b'mod ċar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is delirious is confused and unable to think clearly.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱反复思量的；倾向于长时间琢磨事情的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jerġa' jaħseb dwar l-istess affarijiet u jqishom fit-tul.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone described this way tends to consider matters repeatedly and at length.

collocations.en: a man who tends to mull things over
collocations.zh: 一个爱长时间琢磨事情的男人

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi lill-pazjent bħala hewdieni u jgħid li ma setax iwieġeb il-mistoqsijiet b'mod ċar.
formal.en: The report describes the patient as delirious and says that he could not answer the questions clearly.
formal.zh: 报告将该病人描述为神志昏乱，并指出他无法清楚地回答问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu għadu ma għażilx? Rita: Hu hewdieni; jerġa' jaħseb fuq kull għażla qabel jiddeċiedi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why hasn't Pawlu chosen yet? Rita: He tends to mull things over; he thinks through every option again before deciding.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu怎么还没选好？Rita：他爱反复琢磨，做决定前每个选项都要再想一遍。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu怎么还没选好？
messages.en: Why hasn't Pawlu chosen yet?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu hewdieni; jerġa' jaħseb fuq kull għażla qabel jiddeċiedi.
messages.mt_standard: Hu hewdieni; jerġa' jaħseb fuq kull għażla qabel jiddeċiedi.
messages.zh: 他爱反复琢磨，做决定前每个选项都要再想一遍。
messages.en: He tends to mull things over; he thinks through every option again before deciding.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面分别记忆：病人神志混乱，对应第一义；朋友拿不定主意、反复思量，对应第二义。不要把两个意思混为一谈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The brother of the man or boy being referred to, expressed in Maltese as ħuh.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指正在谈论的男性的兄弟，即他的哥哥或弟弟；马耳他语用 ħuh 表达，词本身不区分年长或年幼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħu r-raġel jew tat-tifel li jkun qed jissemma, mingħajr ma jiġi speċifikat jekk huwiex ikbar jew iżgħar minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他的兄弟，即他的哥哥或弟弟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna maskili li għandha mill-inqas ġenitur wieħed komuni mar-raġel jew mat-tifel li jkun qed jissemma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: His brother is a male sibling of the man or boy being discussed.

formal.mt: Pawlu attenda ċ-ċerimonja flimkien ma' ħuh il-kbir.
formal.en: Pawlu attended the ceremony with his older brother.
formal.zh: Pawlu和他的哥哥一起出席了典礼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ħdejn Pawlu? Rita: Dak ħuh iż-żgħir. Jismu Mark.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that next to Pawlu? Rita: That's his younger brother. His name is Mark.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu旁边那个人是谁？Rita：那是他的弟弟，叫Mark。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu旁边那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that next to Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是他的弟弟，叫Mark。
messages.en: That's his younger brother. His name is Mark.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħuh 整体记作“他的兄弟”，脑中画两兄弟合照；需要区分哥哥、弟弟时，再分别联系 il-kbir 和 iż-żgħir。

gloss_zh: hlewwa（所给资料标为动词，未提供具体动作义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form identified as a verb in the supplied material, which does not specify the action it denotes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给资料中标作动词的形式 hlewwa；资料没有解释其具体动作义，因此本条仅练习词形识别和释义查询。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma mniżżla bħala verb fil-materjal mogħti, iżda mingħajr definizzjoni tal-azzjoni li tesprimi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义仅重复 hlewwa，未说明这个所标动词表示什么动作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-materjal jirrepeti biss il-forma hlewwa u ma jispjegax it-tifsira tagħha bħala verb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry identifies this form as a verb but does not explain its meaning.

formal.mt: Il-lista tikklassifika 'hlewwa' bħala verb, iżda ma tipprovdix definizzjoni; għalhekk, it-tifsira trid tiġi ċċarata qabel ma jintuża f'eżempju.
formal.en: The list classifies 'hlewwa' as a verb but provides no definition; its meaning therefore needs clarification before it is used in an example.
formal.zh: 词表将“hlewwa”归为动词，但没有提供定义；因此，在用它造句之前，需要先明确其含义。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'hlewwa' f'din il-lista? Mark: Hawn imniżżel bħala verb, imma t-tifsira mhix spjegata. Ejja nistaqsu lill-għalliema.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'hlewwa' mean in this list? Mark: It's listed here as a verb, but the meaning isn't explained. Let's ask the teacher.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这张词表里的“hlewwa”是什么意思？Mark：这里把它标作动词，但没解释意思。我们问问老师吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这张词表里的“hlewwa”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'hlewwa' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn imniżżel bħala verb, imma t-tifsira mhix spjegata. Ejja nistaqsu lill-għalliema.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn imniżżel bħala verb, imma t-tifsira mhix spjegata. Ejja nistaqsu lill-għalliema.
messages.zh: 这里把它标作动词，但没解释意思。我们问问老师吧。
messages.en: It's listed here as a verb, but the meaning isn't explained. Let's ask the teacher.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 hlewwa 做一张待补义词卡：正面保留原词形，背面写“资料标作动词，动作义待明确”；先记已知信息，避免凭拼写猜义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A frightening or deeply unpleasant dream.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 睡眠中令人恐惧或非常不安的梦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħolma li tqanqal biża' jew tħalli sens qawwi ta' skumdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 噩梦；使人恐惧或不安的梦。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħolma tal-biża' li tista' ġġiegħel lil min joħlom iqum imbeżża'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you have a nightmare, you experience a frightening or very unpleasant dream while sleeping.

formal.mt: It-tifel qal li kellu hmar il-lejl u li għalhekk qam imbeżża'.
formal.en: The boy said that he had had a nightmare and had therefore woken up frightened.
formal.zh: 男孩说自己做了噩梦，因此惊醒了。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex qomt daqshekk kmieni? Pawlu: Kelli hmar il-lejl u ma stajtx nerġa' norqod. Marta: Trid tgħidli x'ġara fil-ħolma?
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did you wake up so early? Pawlu: I had a nightmare and couldn't get back to sleep. Marta: Would you like to tell me what happened in the dream?
colloquial.zh: Marta：你怎么这么早就醒了？Pawlu：我做了噩梦，后来就睡不着了。Marta：你想跟我说说梦里发生了什么吗？

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么这么早就醒了？
messages.en: Why did you wake up so early?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli hmar il-lejl u ma stajtx nerġa' norqod.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli hmar il-lejl u ma stajtx nerġa' norqod.
messages.zh: 我做了噩梦，后来就睡不着了。
messages.en: I had a nightmare and couldn't get back to sleep.

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想跟我说说梦里发生了什么吗？
messages.en: Would you like to tell me what happened in the dream?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与“夜里做噩梦，醒来心还慌”的场景绑定记忆，不拆词推测含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bread, a food made by baking dough containing flour and water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面包，一种用面粉和水等制成面团后烘烤而成的食物；本条词性标记为 x。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikel magħmul minn għaġina bid-dqiq u l-ilma, li mbagħad tinħema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面包；由面团烘烤制成的食物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikel li jsir billi tinħema għaġina magħmula bid-dqiq u l-ilma, ħafna drabi bil-ħmira wkoll.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Bread is a food made from flour and water mixed into dough and baked.

formal.mt: Mal-ikla ġie servut hobs frisk flimkien maż-żejt taż-żebbuġa.
formal.en: Fresh bread was served with the meal, together with olive oil.
formal.zh: 用餐时供应了新鲜面包和橄榄油。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid biċċa hobs mas-soppa? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Lara: Hawn, għadu frisk.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like a piece of bread with your soup? Mark: Yes, please. Lara: Here you are; it's still fresh.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你要一块面包配汤吗？Mark：好的，谢谢。Lara：给你，还很新鲜。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要一块面包配汤吗？
messages.en: Would you like a piece of bread with your soup?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢。
messages.en: Yes, please.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 给你，还很新鲜。
messages.en: Here you are; it's still fresh.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“新鲜面包配一碗汤”的餐桌画面记住 hobs，再连读 biċċa hobs，记住“一块面包”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose specific meaning is not established by the available gloss.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个具体所指尚未明确的名词；现有释义仅重复词形，无法据此确定中文义项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira speċifika tiegħu mhijiex ċara, għax il-glossa tirrepeti biss l-istess kelma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具体含义未明确；释义与词形相同，尚不能确定其所指。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nom mogħti mingħajr spjegazzjoni tat-tifsira tiegħu, billi l-glossa hija l-istess bħall-kelma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This noun has no independently explained meaning here, because its gloss simply repeats the headword.

collocations.en: the meaning of the word hobza
an example using the word hobza
collocations.zh: 使用 hobza 这个词的例句

formal.mt: Qabel ma tintuża l-kelma hobza f'eżerċizzju, għandha tiġi ċċarata t-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: Before the word hobza is used in an exercise, its meaning should be clarified.
formal.zh: 在练习中使用 hobza 这个词之前，应先明确其含义。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi tfisser il-kelma hobza? David: It-tifsira għadha mhix ċara hawn. Anna: Allura nħalluha bħala kelma biex niċċarawha.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does the word hobza mean? David: Its meaning isn't clear here yet. Anna: Then let's keep it as a word to clarify.
colloquial.zh: Anna：hobza 这个词是什么意思？David：这里还没有明确它的含义。Anna：那我们先把它记作待明确的词。

messages.zh: hobza 这个词是什么意思？

messages.mt_standard: Allura nħalluha bħala kelma biex niċċarawha.

gloss_zh: 具体词义未明确；释义为 thuliha

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun glossed as thuliha, whose specific referent remains unclear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 释义写作 thuliha 的名词；该释义未得到进一步解释，具体所指尚不能确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom bil-glossa thuliha, iżda mingħajr spjegazzjoni li tiċċara għal xiex jirreferi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 释义为 thuliha；由于该释义本身含义未明，无法确定准确中文对应词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nom li għandu l-glossa thuliha, li t-tifsira tagħha mhijiex spjegata biżżejjed biex jiġi identifikat ir-referent.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This noun is glossed as thuliha, but that unexplained label does not establish a clear meaning.

an explanation of the word horra
collocations.zh: 对 horra 这个词的解释

formal.zh: horra 的释义写作 thuliha，但要翻译这个词，还需要更明确的解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An informal expression used to greet someone or attract their attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于向对方打招呼或引起对方注意的非正式表达，此处取“嗨、你好”的意思。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni informali li tintuża biex issellem lil xi ħadd jew tiġbed l-attenzjoni tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嗨；喂；用于非正式地向人打招呼或引起注意。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tislima informali jew sejħa qasira li tintuża biex tibda kuntatt ma' persuna jew tiġbed l-attenzjoni tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression when greeting someone informally or trying to attract their attention.

collocations.en: start a conversation with 'How are you'

collocations.mt: issellem lil ħabib bi 'How are you'
collocations.en: greet a friend with 'How are you'
collocations.zh: 用“How are you”向朋友打招呼

formal.mt: F'dan id-djalogu, il-kelliem juża 'How are you' bħala tislima informali.
formal.en: In this dialogue, the speaker uses 'How are you' as an informal greeting.
formal.zh: 在这段对话中，说话者用“How are you”作非正式招呼语。

colloquial.mt: Maja: How are you, Sara! Sara: Ħej, Maja! X'aħbarijiet?
colloquial.en: Maja: Hey, Sara! Sara: Hey, Maja! What's new?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：嗨，萨拉！萨拉：嗨，玛雅！最近有什么新鲜事？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 嗨，萨拉！
messages.en: Hey, Sara!

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 嗨，玛雅！最近有什么新鲜事？
messages.en: Hey, Maja! What's new?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进朋友见面挥手的画面中，本词条先记“嗨、你好”的招呼功能。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Schoolwork that a teacher asks students to complete outside lesson time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 教师布置给学生、要求在课堂教学时间之外完成的学习任务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol tal-iskola li għalliem jagħti lill-istudenti biex jagħmluh barra mill-ħin tal-lezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 家庭作业；教师要求学生在课后完成的练习或其他学习任务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Eżerċizzji jew ħidmiet oħra tal-iskola li l-istudenti jridu jlestu wara l-lezzjoni, ħafna drabi d-dar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Homework is work that teachers give students to complete outside their lessons, often at home.

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom ilestu l-howmwerk qabel il-lezzjoni ta' għada.
formal.en: Students should finish their homework before tomorrow's lesson.
formal.zh: 学生应在明天上课之前完成家庭作业。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Lestejt il-howmwerk? Ben: Għadni le. Fadalli żewġ eżerċizzji.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you finished your homework? Ben: Not yet. I have two exercises left.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的作业做完了吗？本：还没有。我还剩两道练习。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你的作业做完了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished your homework?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 还没有。我还剩两道练习。
messages.en: Not yet. I have two exercises left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象放学后打开练习本，把 howmwerk 与“课后要完成的作业”一起记忆。

gloss_zh: Hrar（具体含义未明的名词标签）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun label whose specific referent cannot be identified without further context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 写作 Hrar 的名词标签；其具体指称需要更多上下文才能确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom miktub 'Hrar' li jeħtieġ aktar kuntest biex ikun jista' jiġi identifikat dak li jirreferi għalih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Hrar；目前无法确定具体指称，阅读时应保留原写法并结合上下文理解。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kelma 'Hrar' bħala nom, li t-tifsira speċifika tiegħu ma tistax tiġi stabbilita mingħajr aktar kuntest.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Hrar is a noun label whose specific meaning requires further context before it can be explained accurately.

formal.mt: Biex nispjegaw it-tifsira ta' 'Hrar' b'mod preċiż, irridu naraw il-kuntest li fih tidher il-kelma.
formal.en: To explain the meaning of 'Hrar' accurately, we need to examine the context in which the word appears.
formal.zh: 要准确解释“Hrar”的含义，我们需要查看这个词出现的上下文。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'Hrar' hawn? Pawlu: M'iniex ċert. Ejja naqraw is-sentenza kollha.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does the word 'Hrar' mean here? Pawlu: I'm not sure. Let's read the whole sentence.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：“Hrar”这个词在这里是什么意思？保罗：我不确定。我们把整句话读一下吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: “Hrar”这个词在这里是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'Hrar' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: M'iniex ċert. Ejja naqraw is-sentenza kollha.
messages.mt_standard: M'iniex ċert. Ejja naqraw is-sentenza kollha.
messages.zh: 我不确定。我们把整句话读一下吧。
messages.en: I'm not sure. Let's read the whole sentence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 Hrar 配一张“等待上下文”的记忆卡，先记字形，不把猜测当作词义。

gloss_zh: HRID（对应 BOQ，具体所指未明）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun label corresponding to BOQ, whose specific referent requires further context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 写作 HRID、与 BOQ 对应的名词标签；具体所指需要结合上下文确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom miktub 'HRID' li jikkorrispondi għal 'BOQ', iżda jeħtieġ aktar kuntest biex ikun ċar dak li jirreferi għalih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: BOQ；此处为 HRID 的对应表达，具体指称及完整形式尚不能确定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-forma 'BOQ' bħala t-tifsira korrispondenti ta' 'HRID', mingħajr biżżejjed kuntest biex jiġu ddeterminati r-referent speċifiku u l-forma sħiħa tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: HRID corresponds to the label BOQ, but further context is needed to establish exactly what it denotes.

formal.mt: Il-forma 'HRID' tikkorrispondi għal 'BOQ'; biex nispjegaw x'tindika b'mod preċiż, neħtieġu aktar kuntest.
formal.en: The form 'HRID' corresponds to 'BOQ'; to explain precisely what it denotes, we need further context.
formal.zh: “HRID”这一写法对应“BOQ”；要准确说明它指什么，还需要更多上下文。

colloquial.mt: Marta: 'HRID' hawn tfisser 'BOQ'? David: Iva, imma għandna bżonn aktar kuntest biex nifhmu x'inhu eżatt.
colloquial.en: Marta: Does 'HRID' mean 'BOQ' here? David: Yes, but we need more context to understand exactly what it is.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这里的“HRID”是“BOQ”的意思吗？戴维：是的，但我们需要更多上下文，才能弄清它具体是什么。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的“HRID”是“BOQ”的意思吗？
messages.en: Does 'HRID' mean 'BOQ' here?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għandna bżonn aktar kuntest biex nifhmu x'inhu eżatt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għandna bżonn aktar kuntest biex nifhmu x'inhu eżatt.
messages.zh: 是的，但我们需要更多上下文，才能弄清它具体是什么。
messages.en: Yes, but we need more context to understand exactly what it is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 HRID 与 BOQ 写在记忆卡两面，只记已知对应关系，完整含义留待上下文确认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The mental activity of considering ideas, questions, or possible actions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在头脑中考虑想法、分析问题或斟酌行动的思维活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività tal-moħħ meta wieħed iqis ideat, janalizza mistoqsijiet jew jikkunsidra x'jista' jagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 思考，即运用头脑考虑、分析或判断的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih wieħed juża moħħu biex jikkunsidra xi ħaġa, janalizzaha jew jasal għal ġudizzju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Thinking is the mental activity of considering something carefully or trying to understand it.

formal.mt: Il-ħsieb kritiku jgħin lill-istudenti jevalwaw l-informazzjoni qabel jaslu għal konklużjoni.
formal.en: Critical thinking helps students evaluate information before reaching a conclusion.
formal.zh: 批判性思维有助于学生在得出结论之前评估信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-eżerċizzju jeħtieġ ftit ħsieb. Mark: Iva, ejja naħsbu flimkien qabel inwieġbu.
colloquial.en: Maja: This exercise needs a bit of thinking. Mark: Yes, let's think together before we answer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这道练习需要动点脑筋。马克：是啊，我们一起想一想再回答。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这道练习需要动点脑筋。
messages.en: This exercise needs a bit of thinking.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja naħsbu flimkien qabel inwieġbu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja naħsbu flimkien qabel inwieġbu.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们一起想一想再回答。
messages.en: Yes, let's think together before we answer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与“答题前先动脑”的画面联系起来，重点记住它表示思考这一活动；再用“批判性思维”和“深入思考”两个搭配巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A situation in which something is necessary or required.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事物为满足生活、行动或特定目的而不可缺少的需要或必要性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bżonn ta' xi ħaġa għax tkun meħtieġa għall-ħajja, għal azzjoni jew biex jintlaħaq għan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某事物的需要，或某事物必须具备、提供或完成的必要性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-bżonn li wieħed ikollu xi ħaġa jew li ssir xi ħaġa għax tkun meħtieġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A need is a situation in which something is necessary for a person, an activity, or a particular purpose.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza l-ħtieġa ta' aktar taħriġ għall-għalliema.
formal.en: The report emphasizes the need for more training for teachers.
formal.zh: 报告强调有必要为教师提供更多培训。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm ħtieġa li mmorru llum? Pawlu: Iva, għada l-ħanut ikun magħluq.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there a need for us to go today? Pawlu: Yes, the shop will be closed tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们有必要今天去吗？保罗：有，商店明天不开门。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们有必要今天去吗？
messages.en: Is there a need for us to go today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，商店明天不开门。
messages.en: Yes, the shop will be closed tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象清单上圈出的必需品，用“确实需要、必须具备”来记这个词；搭配“迫切的需要”，可以强化它所表达的必要性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The lines of hair above the eyes that help give the face its expression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长在两只眼睛上方、能够随表情变化而移动的两道毛发，即眉毛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żewġ strixxi ta' xagħar fuq l-għajnejn li jgħinu biex juru l-espressjoni tal-wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 两只眼睛上方的两道眉毛，常随惊讶、疑惑等面部表情而抬起或皱紧。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ix-xagħar li jikber f'żewġ strixxi fuq l-għajnejn u li jista' jitla' jew jinġabar flimkien meta tinbidel l-espressjoni tal-wiċċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your eyebrows are the two lines of hair above your eyes that move when you change your expression.

formal.mt: L-artist ta attenzjoni lill-għajnejn u lill-ħuġbejn meta pinġa l-wiċċ.
formal.en: The artist paid attention to the eyes and eyebrows when painting the face.
formal.zh: 画家在描绘面部时，着重刻画了眼睛和眉毛。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tgħolli ħuġbejk? Pawlu: Għax ma kontx qed nistenna dik l-aħbar!
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you raising your eyebrows? Pawlu: Because I wasn't expecting that news!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么扬起眉毛？保罗：因为我没想到会听到那个消息！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么扬起眉毛？
messages.en: Why are you raising your eyebrows?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ma kontx qed nistenna dik l-aħbar!
messages.mt_standard: Għax ma kontx qed nistenna dik l-aħbar!
messages.zh: 因为我没想到会听到那个消息！
messages.en: Because I wasn't expecting that news!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听到意外消息时两道眉毛同时扬起，把这个词与眼睛上方的两道毛发联系起来；再用“浓眉”和“扬眉”两个搭配加深记忆。

gloss_zh: hurrieq（名词，所给资料未说明词义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning is not specified in the supplied material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给资料中列出的一个名词，具体含义尚未说明；学习时应暂时保留原词，不猜测其所指。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li jidher fil-materjal mogħti, iżda li t-tifsira tiegħu mhijiex spjegata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: hurrieq；原释义仅重复词形，未提供可确定的中文含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma elenkata bħala nom, li l-ispjegazzjoni mogħtija tagħha tirrepeti biss il-kelma nnifisha mingħajr ma tiċċara t-tifsira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry identifies hurrieq as a noun but gives no explanation of what it means.

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, hurrieq huwa elenkat bħala nom, iżda t-tifsira tiegħu mhijiex speċifikata.
formal.en: In this list, hurrieq is listed as a noun, but its meaning is not specified.
formal.zh: 在这份词表中，hurrieq 被列为名词，但其含义没有说明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma hurrieq? Mark: Ma nafx; hawnhekk hemm il-kelma biss, mingħajr spjegazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word hurrieq mean? Mark: I don't know; only the word is given here, without an explanation.
colloquial.zh: Maja：hurrieq 这个词是什么意思？Mark：我不知道；这里只给出了词形，没有解释。

messages.zh: hurrieq 这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word hurrieq mean?

messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx; hawnhekk hemm il-kelma biss, mingħajr spjegazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx; hawnhekk hemm il-kelma biss, mingħajr spjegazzjoni.

messages.en: I don't know; only the word is given here, without an explanation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hurrieq 放在标有“名词，词义待补”的学习卡上，先记词形与词性，避免用猜测填补释义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An imaginary sea creature with a woman's upper body and a fish's tail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 传说中生活在海里的虚构生物，上半身为女性形象，下半身为鱼尾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlejqa immaġinarja tal-baħar li għandha l-parti ta' fuq ta' ġisimha bħal ta' mara u denb ta' ħuta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 美人鱼；传说中上半身为女性、下半身为鱼尾的海中生物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħlejqa tal-leġġendi li tgħix fil-baħar u li għandha l-parti ta' fuq ta' ġisimha bħal ta' mara u l-parti t'isfel bħal denb ta' ħuta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mermaid is an imaginary sea creature whose upper body is that of a woman and whose lower body is a fish's tail.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-huta tidher ħdejn il-blat u tkanta lill-baħrin li jkunu għaddejjin.
formal.en: In the story, the mermaid appears beside the rocks and sings to passing sailors.
formal.zh: 在故事里，美人鱼出现在岩石旁，向经过的水手歌唱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed tpinġi? Mark: Huta minn storja, b'wiċċ ta' mara u denb ta' ħuta.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you drawing? Mark: A mermaid from a story, with a woman's face and a fish's tail.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在画什么？Mark：故事里的一条美人鱼，有女人的脸和鱼的尾巴。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在画什么？
messages.en: What are you drawing?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huta minn storja, b'wiċċ ta' mara u denb ta' ħuta.
messages.mt_standard: Huta minn storja, b'wiċċ ta' mara u denb ta' ħuta.
messages.zh: 故事里的一条美人鱼，有女人的脸和鱼的尾巴。
messages.en: A mermaid from a story, with a woman's face and a fish's tail.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词条给定的义项，把 huta 与童话中的美人鱼图像配对：上身是女性，下身是鱼尾，用整幅画面记住含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The soft parts on either side of the face, below the eyes and beside the mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于脸部两侧、眼睛下方和嘴巴旁边的柔软部位，即双颊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-partijiet rotob fuq iż-żewġ naħat tal-wiċċ, taħt l-għajnejn u ħdejn il-ħalq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脸部左右两侧的面颊，位于眼睛下方、嘴巴两旁。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iż-żewġ partijiet tal-wiċċ magħrufa bħala l-ħaddejn, li jinsabu taħt l-għajnejn u fuq iż-żewġ naħat tal-ħalq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your cheeks are the soft areas on the two sides of your face, below your eyes.

formal.mt: Fl-istampa, it-tifel għandu ħaddejn ħomor u tbissima kbira.
formal.en: In the picture, the boy has red cheeks and a broad smile.
formal.zh: 图片中的男孩双颊通红，笑容灿烂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek ħaddejk ħomor! Mark: Għadni kif dħalt mill-kesħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Your cheeks are red! Mark: I've just come in from the cold.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的脸颊好红啊！马克：我刚从寒冷的室外进来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的脸颊好红啊！
messages.en: Your cheeks are red!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我刚从寒冷的室外进来。
messages.en: I've just come in from the cold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用双手轻轻贴住脸部两侧，再想象冬天冻红的双颊；把本条释义与这个左右成对的部位联系起来，记住英语用复数 cheeks。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The prediction of an event or condition before it happens.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对尚未发生的事件或未来情况作出的预测。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tbassir ta' ġrajja jew sitwazzjoni qabel ma sseħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预先判断或说出将来可能发生的事情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħid minn qabel x'taħseb li se jiġri fil-futur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone predicts something, they say what they think will happen in the future.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport ibassar żieda fid-domanda għall-ilma matul is-sajf.
formal.en: The report predicts an increase in demand for water during the summer.
formal.zh: 报告预测，夏季的用水需求将会增加。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ibassar it-temp għal għada? Mark: Jidher li se tagħmel ix-xita, mela ħu umbrella.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the weather forecast predict for tomorrow? Mark: It looks like it will rain, so take an umbrella.
colloquial.zh: Maja：天气预报说明天天气会怎样？Mark：看起来会下雨，所以带把伞吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 天气预报说明天天气会怎样？
messages.en: What does the weather forecast predict for tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jidher li se tagħmel ix-xita, mela ħu umbrella.
messages.mt_standard: Jidher li se tagħmel ix-xita, mela ħu umbrella.
messages.zh: 看起来会下雨，所以带把伞吧。
messages.en: It looks like it will rain, so take an umbrella.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进天气预报画面中记忆：今天先说出明天可能发生什么，就是“预测”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To treat a dead body with substances that help preserve it and delay decay.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用防腐物质处理遗体，以延缓腐败并保存遗体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittratta ġisem mejjet b'sustanzi li jgħinu biex jippreservawh u jdewmu t-taħsir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对遗体进行防腐处理，使其较长时间保持原状。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jipprepara ġisem mejjet b'sustanzi apposta biex jippreservah u jdewwem it-taħsir tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone embalms a dead body, they treat it with substances that delay decay and help preserve it.

formal.mt: L-ispeċjalista ibbalzma l-ġisem biex idewwem it-taħsir tiegħu.
formal.en: The specialist embalmed the body to delay its decay.
formal.zh: 专业人员给遗体作了防腐处理，以延缓其腐败。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser li xi ħadd ibbalzma ġisem? Mark: Ifisser li ttrattah b'sustanzi apposta biex jippreservah.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does it mean to say that someone embalmed a body? Mark: It means they treated it with special substances to preserve it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：说某人给遗体作了防腐处理，是什么意思？Mark：就是说用专门的物质处理遗体，使其得以保存。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser li xi ħadd ibbalzma ġisem?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser li xi ħadd ibbalzma ġisem?
messages.zh: 说某人给遗体作了防腐处理，是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean to say that someone embalmed a body?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li ttrattah b'sustanzi apposta biex jippreservah.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li ttrattah b'sustanzi apposta biex jippreservah.
messages.zh: 就是说用专门的物质处理遗体，使其得以保存。
messages.en: It means they treated it with special substances to preserve it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“遗体、专用物质、延缓腐败”三个画面串联记忆，抓住它表示防腐处理这一动作。

gloss_zh: 手机银行；移动银行服务

teaching_sense.en_definition: The use of a mobile phone to access banking services and manage money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过手机使用银行服务、查询账户或办理转账等业务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu tal-mowbajl biex wieħed jaċċessa servizzi bankarji, jiċċekkja l-kontijiet jew jagħmel trasferimenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 移动银行业务，即通过手机访问和使用银行服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Servizzi bankarji li wieħed jaċċessa permezz tal-mowbajl biex jiċċekkja l-kont tiegħu jew jagħmel tranżazzjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: M-banking is the use of a mobile phone to check accounts and carry out banking transactions.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手机银行服务，指使用手机查询银行账户、转账或办理其他银行业务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-użu ta' servizzi bankarji fuq il-mowbajl, bħall-iċċekkjar tal-bilanċ u t-trasferiment tal-flus.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mobile banking allows you to use banking services on your phone, such as checking your balance or transferring money.

formal.mt: L-ibbankjar bil-mowbajl jippermetti lill-klijenti jiċċekkjaw il-bilanċ tal-kont tagħhom u jagħmlu trasferimenti permezz tat-telefon.
formal.en: Mobile banking allows customers to check their account balance and make transfers using their phone.
formal.zh: 手机银行让客户能够通过手机查询账户余额和办理转账。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tmur il-bank biex tibgħatli l-flus? Mark: Le, nuża l-ibbankjar bil-mowbajl u nibgħathomlok minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you need to go to the bank to send me the money? Mark: No, I'll use mobile banking and send it to you from here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你得去银行才能把钱转给我吗？Mark：不用，我用手机银行，在这里就能转给你。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tmur il-bank biex tibgħatli l-flus?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tmur il-bank biex tibgħatli l-flus?
messages.zh: 你得去银行才能把钱转给我吗？
messages.en: Do you need to go to the bank to send me the money?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nuża l-ibbankjar bil-mowbajl u nibgħathomlok minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nuża l-ibbankjar bil-mowbajl u nibgħathomlok minn hawn.
messages.zh: 不用，我用手机银行，在这里就能转给你。
messages.en: No, I'll use mobile banking and send it to you from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词想成“手机里的银行柜台”：打开手机就能查余额、办转账，帮助记住手机银行这一含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having something as a foundation, source, or reason.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以某事物作为基础、来源或依据的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu xi ħaġa bħala bażi, sors jew raġuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以某事物为基础或依据的；根据某事物形成的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu xi ħaġa bħala l-bażi tiegħu jew li ġie żviluppat skont informazzjoni jew materjal partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is based on a particular thing, that thing provides its foundation, source, or supporting information.

formal.mt: Dan ir-rapport huwa bbażat fuq dejta miġbura minn tliet skejjel.
formal.en: This report is based on data collected from three schools.
formal.zh: 这份报告以从三所学校收集的数据为依据。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-film huwa bbażat fuq storja vera? Mark: Iva, imma xi dettalji nbidlu għall-film.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this film based on a true story? Mark: Yes, but some details were changed for the film.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这部电影是根据真实故事改编的吗？Mark：是的，不过拍成电影时改动了一些细节。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-film huwa bbażat fuq storja vera?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-film huwa bbażat fuq storja vera?
messages.zh: 这部电影是根据真实故事改编的吗？
messages.en: Is this film based on a true story?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma xi dettalji nbidlu għall-film.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma xi dettalji nbidlu għall-film.
messages.zh: 是的，不过拍成电影时改动了一些细节。
messages.en: Yes, but some details were changed for the film.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“事实”想成托住报告的底座，连同 ibbażat fuq 一起记：报告建立在什么依据之上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Treated to remove colour or make something whiter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过漂白处理，原有颜色被去除或变得更白的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġie trattat biex jitneħħielu l-kulur jew biex isir aktar abjad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经过漂白处理而褪色或变白的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġie trattat bi prodott li jneħħi l-kulur jew jagħmlu aktar abjad.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is bleached has been treated to remove its colour or make it whiter.

formal.mt: Id-drapp ibbliċjat għandu jinħasel skont l-istruzzjonijiet fuq it-tikketta.
formal.en: The bleached fabric should be washed according to the instructions on the label.
formal.zh: 漂白过的布料应按照标签上的说明清洗。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dan ix-xugaman sar daqshekk abjad? Nina: Għax ġie ibbliċjat waqt il-ħasil.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why has this towel become so white? Nina: Because it was bleached during the wash.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这条毛巾怎么变得这么白？妮娜：因为洗的时候漂白过了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan ix-xugaman sar daqshekk abjad?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan ix-xugaman sar daqshekk abjad?
messages.zh: 这条毛巾怎么变得这么白？
messages.en: Why has this towel become so white?

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 因为洗的时候漂白过了。
messages.en: Because it was bleached during the wash.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ibbliċjat 和一条漂白后变白的毛巾一起记：它描述的是物品已经漂白过的状态。

gloss_zh: 抵制；以拒绝购买、使用或参与表示抗议

teaching_sense.en_definition: To refuse to buy, use, or take part in something as a form of protest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为表达抗议而拒绝购买、使用某物，或拒绝参与某项活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tirrifjuta li tixtri jew tuża xi ħaġa, jew li tieħu sehem f'attività, bħala forma ta' protesta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过拒绝购买、使用、往来或参与来表示抗议或施加压力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tirrifjuta li tixtri prodotti, tuża servizzi jew tieħu sehem f'attivitajiet sabiex tesprimi protesta jew tagħmel pressjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you boycott a company, product, or event, you deliberately refuse to support it as a way of protesting.

collocations.zh: 以拒绝出席的方式抵制了会议

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ibbojkottja l-laqgħa bi protesta kontra d-deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The committee boycotted the meeting in protest against the decision.
formal.zh: 委员会以拒绝出席会议的方式抗议该决定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu ma ġiex għall-avveniment? Toni: Ibbojkottja l-avveniment għax ma qabilx mad-deċiżjoni tal-organizzaturi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't Pawlu come to the event? Toni: He boycotted the event because he disagreed with the organisers' decision.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么没来参加活动？托尼：他不赞同组织者的决定，所以抵制了这次活动。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么没来参加活动？
messages.en: Why didn't Pawlu come to the event?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ibbojkottja l-avveniment għax ma qabilx mad-deċiżjoni tal-organizzaturi.
messages.mt_standard: Ibbojkottja l-avveniment għax ma qabilx mad-deċiżjoni tal-organizzaturi.
messages.zh: 他不赞同组织者的决定，所以抵制了这次活动。
messages.en: He boycotted the event because he disagreed with the organisers' decision.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 ibbojkottja 的抗议画面：不买产品、不用服务、不参加活动，用拒绝支持来表达反对。

gloss_zh: 申请专利；为产品或其他创造取得专利保护的行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of applying for and obtaining patent protection for a product or other creation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为产品或其他创造申请并取得专利保护的过程或行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih issir applikazzjoni għal privattiva u tinkiseb protezzjoni għal prodott jew ħolqien ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 申请并取得专利保护的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih tintalab u tinkiseb privattiva biex tipproteġi invenzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Patenting is the process of applying for and obtaining a patent to protect an invention.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of patenting a product or other creation
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某项产品或其他创造申请并取得专利的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li bih tintalab u tinkiseb privattiva għal prodott jew ħolqien ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The patenting of a product or other creation involves taking the steps needed to obtain patent protection for it.

collocations.zh: 申请并取得专利的过程

collocations.en: the patenting of a new product
collocations.zh: 为新产品申请并取得专利

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-istadji ewlenin tal-ibbrevettar tal-prodott il-ġdid.
formal.en: The report describes the main stages of patenting the new product.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了为这项新产品申请并取得专利的主要阶段。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'se tiddiskutu fil-laqgħa ta' għada? Mark: L-ibbrevettar tal-prodott il-ġdid, speċjalment il-ħin u l-ispejjeż.
colloquial.en: Sara: What will you discuss at tomorrow's meeting? Mark: Patenting the new product, especially the time and costs involved.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你们明天开会要讨论什么？马克：为新产品申请专利的事，尤其是所需时间和费用。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你们明天开会要讨论什么？
messages.en: What will you discuss at tomorrow's meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (产品负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ibbrevettar tal-prodott il-ġdid, speċjalment il-ħin u l-ispejjeż.
messages.mt_standard: L-ibbrevettar tal-prodott il-ġdid, speċjalment il-ħin u l-ispejjeż.
messages.zh: 为新产品申请专利的事，尤其是所需时间和费用。
messages.en: Patenting the new product, especially the time and costs involved.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ibbrevettar 想成从新发明走向专利保护的一整段流程；这个名词着重表示申请和取得专利这件事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give off or reflect bright light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出或反射明亮的光，呈现闪耀的样子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joħroġ jew jirrifletti dawl qawwi u jidher ileqq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出或反射光线；闪耀。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jagħti jew jirrifletti d-dawl b'mod li jidher qawwi u ileqq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When something shines, it gives off light or reflects light brightly.

formal.mt: Il-kristall ibbrilla meta d-dawl tax-xemx għadda mit-tieqa.
formal.en: The crystal shone when sunlight came through the window.
formal.zh: 阳光透过窗户照进来时，水晶闪耀起来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt kif ibbrilla ċ-ċurkett fix-xemx? Nina: Iva, malli ressaqt idi ħdejn it-tieqa!
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see how the ring shone in the sun? Nina: Yes, as soon as I moved my hand near the window!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看到戒指在阳光下闪耀的样子了吗？妮娜：看到了，我一把手移到窗边，它就亮起来了！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到戒指在阳光下闪耀的样子了吗？
messages.en: Did you see how the ring shone in the sun?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, malli ressaqt idi ħdejn it-tieqa!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, malli ressaqt idi ħdejn it-tieqa!
messages.zh: 看到了，我一把手移到窗边，它就亮起来了！
messages.en: Yes, as soon as I moved my hand near the window!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ibbrilla 和戒指移到窗边后闪出亮光的画面一起记，重点抓住发光、反光和闪耀的视觉感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To arrange in advance to reserve a room, seat, or service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提前安排并保留房间、座位或某项服务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel arranġament minn qabel biex tirriżerva kamra, post jew servizz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预订；提前安排并保留所需的房间、座位或服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tirriżerva kamra, post jew servizz minn qabel biex ikun disponibbli għalik fil-ħin mixtieq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you book a room, seat, or service, you arrange in advance for it to be available when you need it.

formal.mt: Ibbukja kamra fil-lukanda qabel il-wasla tiegħek biex tiżgura li jkollok fejn toqgħod.
formal.en: Book a hotel room before your arrival to ensure that you have somewhere to stay.
formal.zh: 请在抵达前预订酒店房间，以确保有地方住宿。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ibbukja mejda għal tnejn għal għada filgħaxija. Mark: F'liema ħin? Maja: Fit-tmienja, jekk hemm post.
colloquial.en: Maja: Book a table for two for tomorrow evening. Mark: At what time? Maja: At eight, if there is availability.
colloquial.zh: Maja：订一张明晚的双人桌吧。Mark：几点？Maja：八点，如果还有位子的话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ibbukja mejda għal tnejn għal għada filgħaxija.
messages.mt_standard: Ibbukja mejda għal tnejn għal għada filgħaxija.
messages.zh: 订一张明晚的双人桌吧。
messages.en: Book a table for two for tomorrow evening.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 几点？
messages.en: At what time?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 八点，如果还有位子的话。
messages.en: At eight, if there is availability.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ibbukja 和“提前留位”一起记：脑中画出酒店房间或餐桌被写上姓名的画面，再练习 ibbukja kamra。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make an advance reservation for a place, ticket, or service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提前预订某个位置、票券或服务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel riżervazzjoni minn qabel għal post, biljett jew servizz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预订；预先安排取得所需的位置、票券或服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmel arranġament minn qabel biex tikseb post, biljett jew servizz fil-ħin li jkollok bżonnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you book something, you arrange beforehand to have a particular place, ticket, or service available to you.

formal.mt: Ibbukkja post għall-konferenza qabel il-Ġimgħa, peress li n-numru ta' postijiet huwa limitat.
formal.en: Reserve a place at the conference before Friday, as the number of places is limited.
formal.zh: 由于名额有限，请在星期五之前预订会议席位。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ibbukkja żewġ biljetti għaċ-ċinema għal-lejla. Pawlu: Għal liema film? Lara: Għall-kummiedja li tibda fid-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Book two cinema tickets for tonight. Pawlu: For which film? Lara: For the comedy that starts at nine.
colloquial.zh: Lara：订两张今晚的电影票吧。Pawlu：哪部电影？Lara：九点开始的那部喜剧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 订两张今晚的电影票吧。
messages.en: Book two cinema tickets for tonight.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 哪部电影？
messages.en: For which film?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 九点开始的那部喜剧。
messages.en: For the comedy that starts at nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ibbukkja 放进“订票”场景记忆：看到两个 k，就想象并排的两张电影票；这是帮助记拼写的联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To send a document or piece of work to someone for consideration or processing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将文件或作业交给有关人员，以供审阅、评估或办理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tibgħat dokument jew xogħol lil persuna jew istituzzjoni biex jiġi eżaminat, evalwat jew ipproċessat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提交；将申请、文件或作品递交给有关人员或机构处理、审阅。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tippreżenta jew tibgħat applikazzjoni, dokument jew xogħol lill-persuna jew lill-istituzzjoni responsabbli biex teżaminah jew tipproċessah.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you submit a document or piece of work, you send it to the appropriate person or organization for consideration.

formal.mt: Ibgħat l-applikazzjoni flimkien mad-dokumenti meħtieġa lill-uffiċċju responsabbli qabel it-terminu.
formal.en: Submit the application together with the required documents to the responsible office before the deadline.
formal.zh: 请在截止日期之前，将申请连同所需文件提交给负责的办公室。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ibgħat ix-xogħol lill-għalliema llum. Ben: Nista' nibagħtu wara l-ikel? Sara: Iva, imma qabel il-ħamsa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Submit the assignment to the teacher today. Ben: Can I submit it after lunch? Sara: Yes, but before five.
colloquial.zh: Sara：今天把作业交给老师。Ben：我午饭后交可以吗？Sara：可以，但要在五点之前。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 今天把作业交给老师。
messages.en: Submit the assignment to the teacher today.

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 我午饭后交可以吗？
messages.en: Can I submit it after lunch?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 可以，但要在五点之前。
messages.en: Yes, but before five.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ibgħat 时想象点击“提交”按钮，把申请或作业送到接收人手中；连着练习 ibgħat l-applikazzjoni。

gloss_zh: 无尾的动物；没有尾巴者

teaching_sense.en_definition: An animal that has no tail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指没有尾巴的动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal li m'għandux denb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无尾的动物；指没有尾巴的个体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal li huwa mingħajr denb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tailless animal is one that does not have a tail.

collocations.zh: 一只没有尾巴的小动物

collocations.en: the care of the tailless animal

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, l-ibtar jidher ħdejn annimal ieħor li għandu denb twil.
formal.en: In the photograph, the tailless animal appears beside another animal that has a long tail.
formal.zh: 照片中，那只无尾动物位于另一只长尾动物旁边。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt l-ibtar ħdejn il-bieb? Toni: Qed tgħid għall-annimal mingħajr denb? Nina: Iva, dak li qiegħed ħdejn il-borma.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you see the tailless animal by the door? Toni: Do you mean the animal without a tail? Nina: Yes, the one beside the plant pot.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你看到门边那只无尾动物了吗？Toni：你是说那只没有尾巴的动物吗？Nina：对，就是花盆旁边那只。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到门边那只无尾动物了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the tailless animal by the door?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是说那只没有尾巴的动物吗？
messages.en: Do you mean the animal without a tail?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak li qiegħed ħdejn il-borma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak li qiegħed ħdejn il-borma.
messages.zh: 对，就是花盆旁边那只。
messages.en: Yes, the one beside the plant pot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ibtar 当作“无尾者”的名词来记：画两只动物，只给其中一只画尾巴，再把 ibtar 标在没有尾巴的那只下面。

gloss_zh: 德韦拉（戈佐岛沿海地名）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Id-Dwejra is the name of a location along the coastline of Gozo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: Id-Dwejra 是戈佐岛沿海一处地点的名称，中文可音译为“德韦拉”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-Dwejra huwa l-isem ta' post tul il-kosta ta' Għawdex.

sense_translations.en_definition: Name of a location along the Gozo coastline.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 戈佐岛沿海一处地点的名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem ta' post li jinsab tul il-kosta ta' Għawdex.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Id-Dwejra names a particular location along the coastline of Gozo.

formal.mt: Il-grupp se jżur id-Dwejra biex josserva l-kosta ta' Għawdex.
formal.en: The group will visit Id-Dwejra to observe the coastline of Gozo.
formal.zh: 该小组将前往德韦拉，观察戈佐岛的海岸。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Immorru d-Dwejra għada? Mark: Iva, nixtieq nara l-kosta hemmhekk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we go to Id-Dwejra tomorrow? Mark: Yes, I'd like to see the coastline there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们明天去德韦拉好吗？Mark：好，我想看看那里的海岸。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天去德韦拉好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go to Id-Dwejra tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我想看看那里的海岸。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to see the coastline there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Id-Dwejra 当作地图上的专名来记：在戈佐岛海岸画一个点，旁边标上“德韦拉”，把拼写、地点和海岸画面连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun listed in the form 'idahaqni', whose specific meaning is unspecified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以 idahaqni 这一形式列出的名词，其具体含义尚未注明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom mogħti fil-forma 'idahaqni' li t-tifsira speċifika tiegħu mhijiex indikata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: idahaqni：名词条目，具体词义未注明，不能据此确定其中文对应词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nom fil-forma 'idahaqni' li ma għandux tifsira speċifika indikata u għalhekk jeħtieġ kjarifika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The noun 'idahaqni' has no specified meaning here, so a precise translation cannot be established.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'idahaqni' teħtieġ definizzjoni ċara qabel ma tingħata traduzzjoni preċiża għaliha.
formal.en: The word 'idahaqni' requires a clear definition before a precise translation can be given.
formal.zh: “idahaqni”这个词需要先有清晰的释义，才能给出准确翻译。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'idahaqni'? — Mark: Ma nafx it-tifsira tagħha. Ejja niċċekkjawha qabel nużawha.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the word 'idahaqni' mean? — Mark: I don't know its meaning. Let's check it before we use it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：“idahaqni”这个词是什么意思？——马克：我不知道它的含义。我们先查清楚再用吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: “idahaqni”这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'idahaqni' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx it-tifsira tagħha. Ejja niċċekkjawha qabel nużawha.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx it-tifsira tagħha. Ejja niċċekkjawha qabel nużawha.
messages.zh: 我不知道它的含义。我们先查清楚再用吧。
messages.en: I don't know its meaning. Let's check it before we use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 idahaqni 写在“名词，词义待核实”的学习卡上，先记准确字形，等释义明确后再关联具体画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling sick in the stomach, as though one might vomit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胃里不舒服，感到恶心，好像可能要呕吐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss skumdità fl-istonku u sensazzjoni li jista' jirremetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胃部不适、感到恶心而想吐的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jħoss l-istonku mqalleb u jkollu sensazzjoni li jista' jirremetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you feel queasy, your stomach feels unsettled and you may feel like vomiting.

collocations.en: The movement of the boat makes me feel queasy.
collocations.zh: 船的晃动让我感到恶心。

formal.mt: Il-moviment kontinwu tad-dgħajsa idardar l-istonku ta' xi passiġġieri.
formal.en: The constant movement of the boat makes some passengers feel queasy.
formal.zh: 船只持续晃动，使一些乘客感到反胃。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex m'intix tiekol? Mark: Il-moviment tad-dgħajsa idardarni. Se nistenna ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why aren't you eating? Mark: The movement of the boat makes me feel queasy. I'll wait a little.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么不吃东西？马克：船晃得我有点恶心。我等一会儿再吃。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么不吃东西？
messages.en: Why aren't you eating?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-moviment tad-dgħajsa idardarni. Se nistenna ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Il-moviment tad-dgħajsa idardarni. Se nistenna ftit.
messages.zh: 船晃得我有点恶心。我等一会儿再吃。
messages.en: The movement of the boat makes me feel queasy. I'll wait a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和坐船时胃里翻腾的画面联系起来：船一晃，就反胃；用具体身体感受记住“恶心、想吐”。

gloss_zh: 大摇大摆地走；神气活现地走

teaching_sense.en_definition: To walk in an exaggeratedly confident way that shows pride or self-importance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以夸张、自信或自以为了不起的姿态走路，显得大摇大摆、神气活现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Timxi b'mod li juri kunfidenza esaġerata jew sens li inti importanti ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大摇大摆地走，以夸张的自信姿态显示自己的得意或重要。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Timxi b'kunfidenza esaġerata u b'atteġġjament li juri kemm taħseb li inti importanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone swaggers, they walk with exaggerated confidence that displays pride or self-importance.

collocations.zh: 在众人面前大摇大摆地走

collocations.en: swaggered with his head held high

formal.mt: Wara li rebaħ il-kompetizzjoni, iż-żagħżugħ iddaqqaq quddiem il-pubbliku b'rasu merfugħa.
formal.en: After winning the competition, the young man swaggered in front of the audience with his head held high.
formal.zh: 赢得比赛后，这名年轻人昂着头，在观众面前神气活现地走过。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt kif Mark iddaqqaq meta daħal? Lara: Iva, qisu kien l-aktar persuna importanti fil-kamra!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see how Mark swaggered when he came in? Lara: Yes, as if he were the most important person in the room!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到马克进来时那副大摇大摆的样子了吗？拉拉：看到了，好像他是屋里最重要的人似的！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt kif Mark iddaqqaq meta daħal?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt kif Mark iddaqqaq meta daħal?
messages.zh: 你看到马克进来时那副大摇大摆的样子了吗？
messages.en: Did you see how Mark swaggered when he came in?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qisu kien l-aktar persuna importanti fil-kamra!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qisu kien l-aktar persuna importanti fil-kamra!
messages.zh: 看到了，好像他是屋里最重要的人似的！
messages.en: Yes, as if he were the most important person in the room!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人获胜后昂头挺胸、大步走进房间；把夸张的走路姿态与“神气活现、大摇大摆”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take longer than necessary before acting or continuing with something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行动或继续做事之前拖拖拉拉，花费超过必要的时间，造成耽搁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tieħu aktar ħin milli meħtieġ qabel taġixxi jew tkompli tagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拖延、耽搁，未及时行动或继续进行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iddum aktar milli meħtieġ biex tibda jew tkompli azzjoni, u b'hekk tħalliha għal aktar tard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you delay, you take extra time before doing something or continuing with it.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipant iddawwar qabel telaq mid-dar u għalhekk wasal wara li bdiet il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The participant delayed before leaving home and therefore arrived after the meeting had started.
formal.zh: 这名参会者离家前有所拖延，因此到达时会议已经开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu Mark? Il-film dalwaqt jibda. Lara: Ċempilli. Iddawwar fit-triq, imma dalwaqt jasal.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where's Mark? The film is about to start. Lara: He called me. He got delayed on the way, but he'll be here soon.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克在哪儿？电影快开始了。拉拉：他给我打过电话。他在路上耽搁了，不过很快就到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu Mark? Il-film dalwaqt jibda.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu Mark? Il-film dalwaqt jibda.
messages.zh: 马克在哪儿？电影快开始了。
messages.en: Where's Mark? The film is about to start.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċempilli. Iddawwar fit-triq, imma dalwaqt jasal.
messages.mt_standard: Ċempilli. Iddawwar fit-triq, imma dalwaqt jasal.
messages.zh: 他给我打过电话。他在路上耽搁了，不过很快就到。
messages.en: He called me. He got delayed on the way, but he'll be here soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“本来该出发，却磨蹭到迟到”的小故事记忆；重点抓住时间被拖过去、事情没有及时进行的感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give time or effort to a particular purpose, or formally offer a work in someone's honour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把时间或精力投入某个目标，或正式将作品题献给某人以表达敬意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti l-ħin jew l-isforz tiegħek għal għan partikolari, jew toffri xogħol lil xi ħadd bħala ġieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把时间、精力等奉献或投入某事；将作品题献给某人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħti ħin jew sforz għal xi ħaġa partikolari, jew toffri ktieb jew xogħol ieħor lil xi ħadd bħala sinjal ta' rispett jew affezzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you dedicate something, you give it to a particular purpose or offer it in someone's honour.

collocations.en: dedicated the book to his mother

formal.mt: L-awtur iddedika l-ktieb lil ommu bħala sinjal ta' gratitudni għall-appoġġ tagħha.
formal.en: The author dedicated the book to his mother as a sign of gratitude for her support.
formal.zh: 作者将这本书题献给母亲，以感谢她的支持。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar l-eżami ta' Mark? Lara: Tajjeb ħafna! Iddedika ħafna ħin għall-istudju din il-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Mark's exam go? Lara: Very well! He dedicated a lot of time to studying this week.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克考得怎么样？拉拉：很好！他这周花了很多时间学习。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 马克考得怎么样？
messages.en: How did Mark's exam go?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna! Iddedika ħafna ħin għall-istudju din il-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna! Iddedika ħafna ħin għall-istudju din il-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 很好！他这周花了很多时间学习。
messages.en: Very well! He dedicated a lot of time to studying this week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个画面并排记：把时间交给学习，把书的题献页留给母亲；两者都体现把某样东西郑重地给予特定对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To support someone or something against criticism, attack, or harm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某人或某事抵御批评、攻击或伤害，表示辩护或保护。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Twieġeb għall-kritika kontra persuna jew idea, jew tħares lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa minn attakk jew ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某人、观点或行为辩护，回应针对它的指责或质疑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tressaq argumenti jew provi biex twieġeb għall-kritika jew għall-akkużi kontra persuna, idea jew azzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you defend someone or something, you give reasons or evidence to support them against criticism or accusations.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 保护某人或某物，使其免受攻击、危险或伤害。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tħares lil persuna jew lil xi ħaġa biex ma ssirilhiex ħsara jew biex ma tintlaqatx minn attakk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you protect someone or something, you act to keep them safe from danger, attack, or harm.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, ir-riċerkatur iddefenda l-konklużjonijiet tiegħu billi ppreżenta aktar provi.
formal.en: In his report, the researcher defended his conclusions by presenting further evidence.
formal.zh: 研究人员在报告中提出了更多证据，为自己的结论辩护。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark tkellem waqt il-laqgħa? Lara: Iddefenda lil sieħbu meta l-oħrajn ikkritikawh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark speak during the meeting? Lara: He defended his friend when the others criticized him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 为什么在会上发言？Lara：其他人批评他的朋友时，他为朋友作了辩护。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么在会上发言？
messages.en: Why did Mark speak during the meeting?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iddefenda lil sieħbu meta l-oħrajn ikkritikawh.
messages.mt_standard: Iddefenda lil sieħbu meta l-oħrajn ikkritikawh.
messages.zh: 其他人批评他的朋友时，他为朋友作了辩护。
messages.en: He defended his friend when the others criticized him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它联想成“站出来挡住”：挡住指责是辩护，挡住攻击是保护，用同一个动作串起两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enter a place or involve oneself in a situation without being invited or wanted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未经邀请或不受欢迎地进入某处，或插手他人的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tidħol f'post jew tinvolvi ruħek f'affarijiet ta' ħaddieħor mingħajr stedina jew meta l-preżenza tiegħek mhix mixtieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未经允许或不合时宜地闯入、介入，打扰他人的空间、谈话或事务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tidħol fi spazju, f'konverżazzjoni jew f'affarijiet ta' ħaddieħor mingħajr ma tkun mistieden, b'mod li jdejjaq jew ifixkel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you intrude, you enter a place or involve yourself in someone's affairs when your presence or involvement is unwelcome.

formal.mt: Waqt id-diskussjoni privata, persuna mhux mistiedna daħlet fil-kamra u ddeffset fil-konverżazzjoni.
formal.en: During the private discussion, an uninvited person entered the room and intruded into the conversation.
formal.zh: 在私人讨论期间，一名未受邀请的人走进房间，擅自插入了谈话。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex waqaft titkellem? Mark: Għax Pawlu ddeffes fil-konverżazzjoni tagħna u beda jistaqsi mistoqsijiet personali.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you stop talking? Mark: Because Pawlu intruded into our conversation and started asking personal questions.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你怎么不说了？Mark：因为 Pawlu 擅自插进我们的谈话，还开始问私人问题。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么不说了？
messages.en: Why did you stop talking?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Pawlu ddeffes fil-konverżazzjoni tagħna u beda jistaqsi mistoqsijiet personali.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Pawlu ddeffes fil-konverżazzjoni tagħna u beda jistaqsi mistoqsijiet personali.
messages.zh: 因为 Pawlu 擅自插进我们的谈话，还开始问私人问题。
messages.en: Because Pawlu intruded into our conversation and started asking personal questions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两人正在私聊，第三个人硬挤进来：记住“未经邀请地挤进空间或事务”，就能联想到闯入和插手。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression meaning that the speaker has become fed up with something or tired of doing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示说话者已经对某事感到厌烦、厌倦或受够了，通常不是指身体疲劳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li biha l-kelliem jgħid li xi ħaġa bdiet iddejqu jew li xeba' jagħmilha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 厌倦……；对……感到厌烦。该词形用于表达“我厌倦了”或“我受够了”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintuża biex il-kelliem jesprimi li xeba' minn xi ħaġa jew li ma jridx jibqa' jagħmel l-istess attività għax qed iddejqu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you say this, you mean that you have become bored or annoyed with something and do not want it to continue.

collocations.en: I'm fed up with the noise.

formal.mt: Iddejaqt nirċievi l-istess tweġiba mingħajr ebda spjegazzjoni dwar id-dewmien.
formal.en: I have grown tired of receiving the same reply without any explanation for the delay.
formal.zh: 我已厌倦反复收到同样的答复，而对方始终没有解释延误的原因。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tibqa' hawn ftit ieħor? Mark: Le, iddejaqt nistenna. Ejja mmorru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to stay here a little longer? Mark: No, I'm tired of waiting. Let's go.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你想在这里再待一会儿吗？Mark：不想，我等烦了。我们走吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想在这里再待一会儿吗？
messages.en: Do you want to stay here a little longer?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不想，我等烦了。我们走吧。
messages.en: No, I'm tired of waiting. Let's go.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句“Iddejaqt nistenna”记成“我等烦了”，联想反复看表的表情，重点记心理厌烦，而非身体劳累。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a wound or sore to become infected and develop pus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指伤口或疮处发生感染并化脓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta ferita jew ġerħa tiġi infettata u tibda tiġbor il-materja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指伤口、疮等感染后化脓或溃烂。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jingħad għal ferita jew ġerħa li tiġi infettata u li fiha tibda tinġabar il-materja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a wound festers, it becomes infected and develops pus instead of healing properly.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi ferita li bdiet tiddenna ftit jiem wara l-korriment.
formal.en: The report describes a wound that began to fester a few days after the injury.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一处在受伤数日后开始化脓的伤口。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ferita fieqet? Mark: Le, bdiet tiddenna, u mort għand it-tabib.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the wound healed? Mark: No, it started to fester, and I went to the doctor.
colloquial.zh: Maja：伤口好了吗？Mark：没有，开始化脓了，我去看了医生。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 伤口好了吗？
messages.en: Has the wound healed?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, bdiet tiddenna, u mort għand it-tabib.
messages.mt_standard: Le, bdiet tiddenna, u mort għand it-tabib.
messages.zh: 没有，开始化脓了，我去看了医生。
messages.en: No, it started to fester, and I went to the doctor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“伤口开始化脓”的画面里记忆，固定联想 ferita（伤口）与 tiddenna（化脓）的搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To publicly condemn something wrong or formally report wrongdoing to an authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公开指责不当行为，或向有关机构正式举报违法、违规或滥用行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikkundanna pubblikament xi ħaġa ħażina jew jirrapporta għemil ħażin lill-awtoritajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公开谴责不当行为，或向有关当局举报某人的不法行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jesprimi kundanna pubblika għal għemil ħażin jew jagħmel rapport dwaru lill-awtoritajiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone denounces an action or a person, they publicly condemn the wrongdoing or formally report it to an authority.

collocations.en: reported the abuse to the police
collocations.zh: 向警方举报了虐待行为

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, il-kumitat iddenunzja l-korruzzjoni u talab investigazzjoni indipendenti.
formal.en: In its report, the committee denounced corruption and called for an independent investigation.
formal.zh: 委员会在报告中谴责了腐败行为，并要求开展独立调查。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark mar għand il-pulizija? Lara: Għax iddenunzja l-abbuż li ra fuq il-post tax-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark go to the police? Lara: Because he reported the abuse he saw at work.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么去找警方？拉拉：因为他举报了自己在工作场所看到的虐待行为。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么去找警方？
messages.en: Why did Mark go to the police?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax iddenunzja l-abbuż li ra fuq il-post tax-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Għax iddenunzja l-abbuż li ra fuq il-post tax-xogħol.
messages.zh: 因为他举报了自己在工作场所看到的虐待行为。
messages.en: Because he reported the abuse he saw at work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进两个画面记忆：在公开报告里谴责腐败，在警察局里举报虐待。共同点都是把不当行为明确揭露出来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To rely on someone or something, or to be determined by a particular condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依靠某人或某物获得支持，或由某项条件决定是否发生及其结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jistrieħ fuq xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa għall-għajnuna, jew ikun marbut ma' kundizzjoni li tiddetermina r-riżultat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依赖某人或某物；事情的发生或结果取决于某种条件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikollu bżonn l-għajnuna jew l-appoġġ ta' xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew ikollu riżultat li jinbidel skont ċerta kundizzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something depends on another person, thing, or condition, they need its support or are affected by what happens to it.

formal.mt: Is-suċċess tal-proġett iddependa fuq il-kooperazzjoni bejn l-għalliema u l-ġenituri.
formal.en: The success of the project depended on cooperation between teachers and parents.
formal.zh: 该项目的成功取决于教师与家长之间的合作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għada mmorru l-baħar? Mark: Jiddependi mit-temp. Jekk tagħmel ix-xita, nibqgħu d-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we go to the seaside tomorrow? Mark: It depends on the weather. If it rains, we'll stay home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们明天去海边吗？马克：要看天气。如果下雨，我们就待在家里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天去海边吗？
messages.en: Shall we go to the seaside tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiddependi mit-temp. Jekk tagħmel ix-xita, nibqgħu d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Jiddependi mit-temp. Jekk tagħmel ix-xita, nibqgħu d-dar.
messages.zh: 要看天气。如果下雨，我们就待在家里。
messages.en: It depends on the weather. If it rains, we'll stay home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“能不能去海边，要看天气”来记取决于，再用“需要家人帮助”来记依赖；两个场景都强调另一方会影响结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put money into an account or place something somewhere for safekeeping.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把钱存入账户，或把物品放到某处保管。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed flus f'kont jew iħalli xi ħaġa f'post fejn tinżamm b'mod sigur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将钱款存入账户，或将物品交存、放置于某处保管。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ipoġġi somma flus f'kont bankarju jew iqiegħed xi ħaġa f'post magħżul biex tinżamm hemm.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you deposit money or an object, you put it into an account or leave it in a particular place for safekeeping.

collocations.en: deposited the money in the bank
deposited a sum into the account
collocations.zh: 往账户里存入了一笔钱

formal.mt: It-teżorier iddepozita d-donazzjonijiet fil-kont tal-għaqda u żamm l-irċevuta.
formal.en: The treasurer deposited the donations into the association's account and kept the receipt.
formal.zh: 财务主管把捐款存入协会账户，并保留了收据。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn huma l-flus li ġbarna? Mark: Pawlu iddepozita l-flus fil-bank dalgħodu. L-irċevuta qiegħda hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the money we collected? Mark: Pawlu deposited the money in the bank this morning. The receipt is here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们筹到的钱在哪里？马克：保罗今天早上把钱存进银行了。收据在这里。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动志愿者)
messages.zh: 我们筹到的钱在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the money we collected?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu iddepozita l-flus fil-bank dalgħodu. L-irċevuta qiegħda hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu iddepozita l-flus fil-bank dalgħodu. L-irċevuta qiegħda hawn.
messages.zh: 保罗今天早上把钱存进银行了。收据在这里。
messages.en: Pawlu deposited the money in the bank this morning. The receipt is here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把筹来的钱交到银行，账户余额增加，手上拿回收据；用“钱进入账户”的动作牢牢记住存入这一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To guide or control an activity, including leading a performance or making a film.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指导或统筹一项活动，也指指挥演出或执导电影。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imexxi u jiggwida attività jew xogħol artistiku billi jagħti struzzjonijiet lil dawk li jieħdu sehem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指导、指挥某项活动，或作为导演执导电影、戏剧等作品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikun responsabbli mit-tmexxija ta' attività, film jew dramm u jgħid lill-parteċipanti kif għandu jsir ix-xogħol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone directs an activity or a production, they guide the people involved and make decisions about how the work is carried out.

formal.mt: Id-direttur idderieġa film qasir dwar il-ħajja ta' kuljum f'raħal Malti.
formal.en: The director directed a short film about everyday life in a Maltese village.
formal.zh: 这位导演执导了一部讲述马耳他村庄日常生活的短片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min idderieġa d-dramm tal-iskola? Mark: L-għalliem tagħna. Għenna nifhmu l-karattri u kif għandna nimxu fuq il-palk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who directed the school play? Mark: Our teacher. He helped us understand the characters and how to move on stage.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：学校的那部戏是谁执导的？马克：我们的老师。他帮助我们理解角色，也教我们怎样在舞台上走位。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 学校的那部戏是谁执导的？
messages.en: Who directed the school play?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għalliem tagħna. Għenna nifhmu l-karattri u kif għandna nimxu fuq il-palk.
messages.mt_standard: L-għalliem tagħna. Għenna nifhmu l-karattri u kif għandna nimxu fuq il-palk.
messages.zh: 我们的老师。他帮助我们理解角色，也教我们怎样在舞台上走位。
messages.en: Our teacher. He helped us understand the characters and how to move on stage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象导演站在舞台前，指导演员理解角色并安排走位；抓住“带领大家把作品完成”的画面，联记指导、指挥和执导。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To say words aloud so that another person can write them down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把文字逐字或分段念出来，让别人记录或听写。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid kliem b'leħen għoli biex persuna oħra tkun tista' tiktbu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 口述文字，让他人写下来。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jgħid test jew messaġġ b'leħen għoli biex xi ħadd ieħor jiktbu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone dictates a text, they say its words aloud so that another person can write them down.

collocations.zh: 口述了一封信供人记录
念了一个句子让人听写

formal.mt: L-għalliem iddetta paragrafu qasir, u l-istudenti kitbuh fil-pitazzi tagħhom.
formal.en: The teacher dictated a short paragraph, and the students wrote it in their exercise books.
formal.zh: 老师念了一小段文字，学生们把它写在自己的练习本上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamiltu fil-lezzjoni llum? Toni: L-għalliem iddetta ħames sentenzi, u aħna ktibniehom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did you do in class today? Toni: The teacher dictated five sentences, and we wrote them down.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们今天上课做了什么？托尼：老师念了五个句子，我们把它们写了下来。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你们今天上课做了什么？
messages.en: What did you do in class today?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għalliem iddetta ħames sentenzi, u aħna ktibniehom.
messages.mt_standard: L-għalliem iddetta ħames sentenzi, u aħna ktibniehom.
messages.zh: 老师念了五个句子，我们把它们写了下来。
messages.en: The teacher dictated five sentences, and we wrote them down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iddetta 放进听写课堂的画面：老师开口念，学生动笔写，用“一人说、另一人记”记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enjoy yourself while taking part in an activity or spending time with others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在活动、聚会或与他人相处时感到愉快，玩得开心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu gost waqt attività jew waqt li jqatta' ħin ma' nies oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 享受活动或相处的乐趣，玩得开心。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iqatta' ħin pjaċevoli u jieħu gost b'dak li jkun qed jagħmel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone has fun, they enjoy what they are doing and spend their time pleasantly.

formal.mt: Matul il-jum tal-attivitajiet, kull tifel iddeverta bil-logħob u ħa sehem fix-xogħol tal-grupp.
formal.en: During the activity day, every boy had fun playing games and took part in the group work.
formal.zh: 在活动日中，每个男孩都玩游戏玩得很开心，并参与了小组活动。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif mar ħuk fil-festa? Mark: Iddeverta ħafna! Lagħab u żifen ma' sħabu.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did your brother get on at the party? Mark: He had a lot of fun! He played and danced with his friends.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你弟弟在聚会上怎么样？马克：他玩得可开心了！他和朋友们一起玩，还一起跳舞。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你弟弟在聚会上怎么样？
messages.en: How did your brother get on at the party?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iddeverta ħafna! Lagħab u żifen ma' sħabu.
messages.mt_standard: Iddeverta ħafna! Lagħab u żifen ma' sħabu.
messages.zh: 他玩得可开心了！他和朋友们一起玩，还一起跳舞。
messages.en: He had a lot of fun! He played and danced with his friends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iddeverta 配上一张聚会笑脸：玩游戏、跳舞、和朋友相聚，把整幅“玩得开心”的画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To eat something quickly and eagerly, often because you are very hungry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 快速而急切地吃掉食物，通常表现出十分饥饿或食欲旺盛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiekol xi ħaġa malajr u b'ħerqa kbira, ħafna drabi għax ikun bil-ġuħ ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狼吞虎咽地吃掉；快速而贪婪地吞食。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiekol l-ikel b'għaġla u b'aptit kbir sakemm jispiċċah.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone devours food, they eat it quickly and eagerly, usually because they are very hungry.

collocations.zh: 狼吞虎咽地吃完了整顿饭
三两口吃掉了一块蛋糕

formal.mt: Wara mixja twila fil-kampanja, it-tifel iddevora l-ikla kollha fi ftit minuti.
formal.en: After a long walk in the countryside, the boy devoured the whole meal in a few minutes.
formal.zh: 在乡间走了很长一段路后，男孩几分钟就狼吞虎咽地吃完了整顿饭。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn hu s-sandwiċ li ħallejt fuq il-mejda? Pawlu: Ħija iddevora kollox! Kien bil-ġuħ ħafna.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is the sandwich I left on the table? Pawlu: My brother devoured the whole thing! He was very hungry.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我放在桌上的三明治呢？保罗：我弟弟狼吞虎咽地全吃了！他当时饿极了。

messages.speaker: Anna (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu s-sandwiċ li ħallejt fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu s-sandwiċ li ħallejt fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 我放在桌上的三明治呢？
messages.en: Where is the sandwich I left on the table?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija iddevora kollox! Kien bil-ġuħ ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija iddevora kollox! Kien bil-ġuħ ħafna.
messages.zh: 我弟弟狼吞虎咽地全吃了！他当时饿极了。
messages.en: My brother devoured the whole thing! He was very hungry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 iddevora 时想象一盘饭转眼见底：重点是“吃得又快又急”，比普通的“吃”更有狼吞虎咽的画面感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To laugh at someone or something in a way that expresses disrespect or contempt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带着不尊重或轻蔑的态度取笑某人或某事，使其显得可笑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddi lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa biż-żmien b'mod li juri nuqqas ta' rispett jew disprezz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以轻蔑的言语或笑声嘲弄、讥笑某人或某事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Juri disprezz lejn persuna jew ħaġa billi jidħak biha jew jagħmel kummenti li jġibuha għaċ-ċajt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone derides a person or an idea, they mock them in a way that shows contempt.

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, membru tal-kumitat iddieħak bil-proposta mingħajr ma spjega għaliex ma qabilx magħha.
formal.en: During the meeting, a committee member derided the proposal without explaining why he disagreed with it.
formal.zh: 会议期间，一名委员会成员讥笑了这项提议，却没有解释自己为何不赞同它。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex int imdejqa? Nina: Mark iddieħak bija quddiem kulħadd meta għamilt żball.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you upset? Nina: Mark mocked me in front of everyone when I made a mistake.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么不开心？妮娜：我犯了个错误，马克就当着大家的面嘲笑我。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不开心？
messages.en: Why are you upset?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark iddieħak bija quddiem kulħadd meta għamilt żball.
messages.mt_standard: Mark iddieħak bija quddiem kulħadd meta għamilt żball.
messages.zh: 我犯了个错误，马克就当着大家的面嘲笑我。
messages.en: Mark mocked me in front of everyone when I made a mistake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iddieħak 记成带刺的笑声：有人出错，旁人轻蔑地取笑；连同 b'sieħbu 一起记住“嘲笑谁”的表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To announce something clearly or officially, give a formal judgment, or state information explicitly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清楚或正式地宣布某事、作出宣告或裁定，或明确陈述信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħabbar xi ħaġa b'mod ċar jew uffiċjali, jagħti deċiżjoni formali, jew jistqarr informazzjoni b'mod espliċitu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宣布；公开或正式表明某项事实、决定或立场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iħabbar fatt, deċiżjoni jew pożizzjoni b'mod pubbliku jew uffiċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone declares something, they announce it openly or officially so that others know their position or decision.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宣告；正式作出某种判断或裁定，例如宣告某人有罪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħti ġudizzju jew deċiżjoni formali dwar persuna jew sitwazzjoni, bħal meta jiddikjara lil xi ħadd ħati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an authority pronounces someone guilty, it formally gives that judgment about the person.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 陈述；用明确的话表达某项事实、意见或信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jesprimi fatt, opinjoni jew informazzjoni bi kliem ċar u espliċitu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you state something, you express it clearly in speech or writing.

collocations.zh: 表示自己已经准备好了

formal.mt: Id-direttur iddikjara li l-proġett kien lest u li r-rapport finali kien se jiġi ppubblikat l-għada.
formal.en: The director stated that the project was complete and that the final report would be published the following day.
formal.zh: 主任表示，项目已经完成，最终报告将于次日公布。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min rebaħ il-kompetizzjoni? Mark: Il-ġurija ddikjarat lil Pawlu rebbieħ. Sara: Mela se nifirħulu meta narawh!
colloquial.en: Sara: Who won the competition? Mark: The jury declared Pawlu the winner. Sara: Then we will congratulate him when we see him!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁赢了比赛？马克：评审团宣布保罗获胜。萨拉：那我们见到他时要祝贺他！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁赢了比赛？
messages.en: Who won the competition?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 评审团宣布保罗获胜。
messages.en: The jury declared Pawlu the winner.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们见到他时要祝贺他！
messages.en: Then we will congratulate him when we see him!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iddikjara 想成“郑重说清楚”：政府宣布、法官宣告、个人陈述。这里的 pronounce 对应正式宣告，可用“宣告有罪”帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To control the direction in which a vehicle or vessel moves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 控制车辆或船只的行进方向，使其朝某个方向前进。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikkontrolla d-direzzjoni li fiha timxi vettura jew dgħajsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 操纵车辆或船只的方向；掌舵，使其驶向某处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imexxi vettura jew dgħajsa fid-direzzjoni mixtieqa billi jikkontrolla r-rota tal-istering jew it-tmun.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone steers a vehicle or boat, they control the direction in which it travels.

collocations.en: steered the boat towards the harbour
steered the car to the left

formal.mt: Il-kaptan iddirieġa d-dgħajsa lejn il-port u żammha 'l bogħod mill-blat.
formal.en: The captain steered the boat towards the harbour and kept it away from the rocks.
formal.zh: 船长掌舵驶向港口，并让船避开礁石。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif evitajtu dik il-blata? Toni: Il-kaptan iddirieġa d-dgħajsa lejn il-lemin fil-ħin.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did you avoid that rock? Toni: The captain steered the boat to the right in time.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你们怎么避开那块礁石的？托尼：船长及时掌舵，让船向右转了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们怎么避开那块礁石的？
messages.en: How did you avoid that rock?

messages.speaker: Toni (乘船的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kaptan iddirieġa d-dgħajsa lejn il-lemin fil-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kaptan iddirieġa d-dgħajsa lejn il-lemin fil-ħin.
messages.zh: 船长及时掌舵，让船向右转了。
