messages.en: The captain steered the boat to the right in time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 iddirieġa 时想象双手转动方向盘或船舵，让交通工具改变方向；再用 lejn il-port（朝港口）固定“驶向”的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To plan how something will look or work, or to create a picture using lines.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规划某物的外观、结构或功能，或用线条画出图像。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ifassal kif xi ħaġa se tidher jew taħdem, jew joħloq stampa permezz ta' linji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设计；规划某物的外观、结构或运作方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ifassal il-forma, l-istruttura jew il-mod kif se taħdem xi ħaġa qabel ma tinħoloq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you design something, you plan its appearance, structure, or operation before it is made.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 画；用铅笔、钢笔等工具描绘图像。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Joħloq stampa billi jagħmel linji fuq karta jew fuq wiċċ ieħor b'għodda bħal lapes jew pinna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you draw something, you make a picture of it using lines made with a pencil, pen, or similar tool.

formal.mt: Id-disinjatur iddisinja siġġu ġdid b'dahar għoli u saqajn tal-injam għall-kamra tal-qari.
formal.en: The designer designed a new chair with a high back and wooden legs for the reading room.
formal.zh: 设计师为阅览室设计了一把高靠背、木制椅腿的新椅子。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min iddisinja din il-fjura fuq il-karta? Luqa: Ħija. Uża lapes biss! Marija: Kemm hi sabiħa!
colloquial.en: Marija: Who drew this flower on the paper? Luqa: My brother. He only used a pencil! Marija: It is so beautiful!
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：纸上的这朵花是谁画的？卢卡：我哥哥。他只用了一支铅笔！玛丽娅：真漂亮！

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min iddisinja din il-fjura fuq il-karta?
messages.mt_standard: Min iddisinja din il-fjura fuq il-karta?
messages.zh: 纸上的这朵花是谁画的？
messages.en: Who drew this flower on the paper?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 我哥哥。他只用了一支铅笔！
messages.en: My brother. He only used a pencil!

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 真漂亮！
messages.en: It is so beautiful!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用同一支铅笔串起 iddisinja 的两个义项：先规划椅子的样式是“设计”，再在纸上描出花朵是“画”；靠宾语和语境区分。

gloss_zh: 经过设计的；带图案的；绘制的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Planned or created with a particular form or purpose, decorated with a pattern, or represented in a drawing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按特定形式或用途设计的，也可指带有图案的或通过绘画绘制的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magħmul skont pjan għal forma jew għan partikolari, imżejjen b'disinn, jew irrappreżentat fi tpinġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经过规划和设计、具有特定形式或用途的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ippjanat u maħluq biex ikollu forma partikolari jew jaqdi għan speċifiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is designed has been planned and created to have a particular appearance or serve a particular purpose.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表面带有装饰图案或纹样的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu disinn dekorattiv fuq il-wiċċ tiegħu, bħal fjuri, linji jew forom oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is patterned has a decorative design of shapes, lines, or other figures on its surface.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过画线等方式绘制出来的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Irrappreżentat fuq karta jew wiċċ ieħor permezz ta' linji u forom imfassla bl-idejn jew b'għodda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is drawn has been represented by making lines and shapes on paper or another surface.

formal.mt: Il-bini l-ġdid huwa ddisinjat biex ikun aċċessibbli għal kulħadd.
formal.en: The new building is designed to be accessible to everyone.
formal.zh: 这座新建筑的设计旨在让所有人都能无障碍使用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-mejda huwa ddisinjat apposta għal din il-kamra? Mark: Iva, biex joqgħod eżatt taħt it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this table specially designed for this room? Mark: Yes, to fit exactly under the window.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这张桌子是专门为这个房间设计的吗？Mark：是的，为了让它正好放在窗户下面。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-mejda huwa ddisinjat apposta għal din il-kamra?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-mejda huwa ddisinjat apposta għal din il-kamra?
messages.zh: 这张桌子是专门为这个房间设计的吗？
messages.en: Is this table specially designed for this room?

messages.speaker: Mark (家具设计师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, biex joqgħod eżatt taħt it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, biex joqgħod eżatt taħt it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 是的，为了让它正好放在窗户下面。
messages.en: Yes, to fit exactly under the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进三个画面记忆：设计好的建筑、带花纹的布料、铅笔绘出的图。共同线索是看得见的设计或图形。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To treat a person or group unfairly because of a characteristic such as age, sex, or origin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因年龄、性别或出身等个人或群体特征而不公平地对待某人或某一群体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittratta persuna jew grupp b'mod inġust minħabba karatteristika bħall-età, is-sess jew l-oriġini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 基于某种个人或群体特征给予不公平待遇；歧视。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jittratta lil xi ħadd b'mod inqas favorevoli minn ħaddieħor minħabba karatteristika personali jew tal-grupp tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone discriminates against a person or group, they treat them unfairly because of a characteristic such as age, sex, or origin.

collocations.en: discriminated on the grounds of age

formal.mt: Ir-rapport ikkonkluda li min iħaddem iddiskrimina kontra l-applikant minħabba l-età tiegħu.
formal.en: The report concluded that the employer discriminated against the applicant because of his age.
formal.zh: 报告认定，雇主因该申请人的年龄而对其实施了歧视。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Paul ilmenta dwar il-maniġer? Toni: Qal li l-maniġer iddiskrimina kontrih minħabba l-età tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Paul complain about the manager? Toni: He said the manager discriminated against him because of his age.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Paul为什么投诉经理？Toni：他说经理因为他的年龄而歧视他。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: Paul为什么投诉经理？
messages.en: Why did Paul complain about the manager?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qal li l-maniġer iddiskrimina kontrih minħabba l-età tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Qal li l-maniġer iddiskrimina kontrih minħabba l-età tiegħu.
messages.zh: 他说经理因为他的年龄而歧视他。
messages.en: He said the manager discriminated against him because of his age.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同样合格的两名求职者，其中一人只因年龄被拒绝；用这个不公平待遇的场景记住“歧视”。

gloss_zh: 他感到后悔；他感到遗憾

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel sorry about something that happened or about something one did or failed to do.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对已经发生的事情，或自己做过、未做的事情感到后悔或遗憾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss dispjaċir għal xi ħaġa li ġrat, għal xi ħaġa li għamel, jew għal xi ħaġa li naqas milli jagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对已经发生的事或自己的行为感到后悔、惋惜或遗憾。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iħoss dispjaċir dwar ġrajja jew azzjoni u jixtieq li l-affarijiet kienu ġraw b'mod differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone regrets something, they feel sorry that it happened or wish they had acted differently.

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, Paul spjega li ddispjaċih li ma setax jattendi l-laqgħa.
formal.en: In his letter, Paul explained that he regretted being unable to attend the meeting.
formal.zh: Paul在信中解释说，他对无法出席会议感到遗憾。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Paul iddispjaċih għal dak li qal? Toni: Iva, u talabni skuża dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Paul regret what he said? Toni: Yes, and he apologized to me this morning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Paul后悔自己说过的话了吗？Toni：后悔了，而且他今天早上向我道歉了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Paul iddispjaċih għal dak li qal?
messages.mt_standard: Paul iddispjaċih għal dak li qal?
messages.zh: Paul后悔自己说过的话了吗？
messages.en: Did Paul regret what he said?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 后悔了，而且他今天早上向我道歉了。
messages.en: Yes, and he apologized to me this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象Paul说错话后回想刚才的场面，心里希望能够重来；用“他后悔了”整句记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause displeasure or sorrow, or to feel regret about something that happened.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人感到不悦或悲伤，或对发生过的事情感到后悔、遗憾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqajjem nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon jew niket f'xi ħadd, jew iħoss dispjaċir għal xi ħaġa li ġrat.

sense_translations.en_definition: to displease, to cause sorrow, to regret
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人不高兴或感到悲伤；也指对某事感到后悔或遗憾。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon jew niket, jew iħoss hu stess dispjaċir dwar xi ġrajja jew azzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something displeases someone or causes sorrow, it makes them unhappy; if someone regrets something, they feel sorry that it happened.

collocations.zh: 为发生的事情感到难过或遗憾

formal.mt: Fl-istqarrija tiegħu, id-direttur qal li kien iddispjaċut għall-iżball u wiegħed li jieħu passi biex jirranġah.
formal.en: In his statement, the director said that he was sorry about the mistake and promised to take steps to correct it.
formal.zh: 主任在声明中表示，他对这个错误感到抱歉，并承诺采取措施加以纠正。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Jien iddispjaċut li wasalt tard. Maja: Tinkwetax, għadna kemm wasalna aħna wkoll.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm sorry I arrived late. Maja: Don't worry, we've only just arrived too.
colloquial.zh: Mark：抱歉，我来晚了。Maja：别担心，我们也刚到。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 抱歉，我来晚了。
messages.en: I'm sorry I arrived late.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tinkwetax, għadna kemm wasalna aħna wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Tinkwetax, għadna kemm wasalna aħna wkoll.
messages.zh: 别担心，我们也刚到。
messages.en: Don't worry, we've only just arrived too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把记忆放在迟到后道歉的场景里：说出“Jien iddispjaċut”，同时联想心里的难过、遗憾和歉意。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dispose of something or decide what should be done about a matter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处置或处理某物，或就某件事情作出决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jeħles minn xi ħaġa billi jiddisponi minnha, jew jieħu deċiżjoni dwar x'għandu jsir f'xi kwistjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 处置、清除或处理不再需要的物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jeħles minn oġġett jew materjal li ma jkunx għadu meħtieġ billi jagħżel mod kif jitneħħa jew jiġi ttrattat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone disposes of something, they get rid of it because it is no longer needed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 就某件事作出决定，确定应采取的安排或做法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jieħu deċiżjoni dwar kwistjoni u jistabbilixxi x'għandu jsir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone decides on a matter, they determine what should be done about it.

collocations.en: decided on the use of the building

formal.mt: Il-laboratorju iddispona mill-materjal li ma kienx għadu meħtieġ skont il-proċedura stabbilita.
formal.en: The laboratory disposed of the material that was no longer needed according to the established procedure.
formal.zh: 实验室按照既定程序处置了不再需要的材料。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Id-direttur iddispona dwar liema sala se nużaw? Pawlu: Iva, iddeċieda li nużaw is-sala ż-żgħira.
colloquial.en: Marija: Has the director decided which room we will use? Pawlu: Yes, he decided that we should use the small room.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：主任决定我们用哪个房间了吗？保罗：决定了，他说我们用小房间。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-direttur iddispona dwar liema sala se nużaw?
messages.mt_standard: Id-direttur iddispona dwar liema sala se nużaw?
messages.zh: 主任决定我们用哪个房间了吗？
messages.en: Has the director decided which room we will use?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iddeċieda li nużaw is-sala ż-żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iddeċieda li nużaw is-sala ż-żgħira.
messages.zh: 决定了，他说我们用小房间。
messages.en: Yes, he decided that we should use the small room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记忆：处理一袋废物是“处置”，确定房间用途是“决定”；学习时分别搭配具体物品和待决事项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lose hope because a situation seems impossible to improve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因为觉得情况无法改善而失去希望、陷入绝望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef it-tama għax iħoss li sitwazzjoni ma tistax titjieb jew li ma hemmx soluzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某种处境失去希望，感到绝望。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jitlef it-tama u jħoss li ma jista' jsir xejn biex is-sitwazzjoni titjieb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone despairs, they lose hope because they believe that their situation cannot improve.

collocations.en: despaired when he lost his job

formal.mt: Wara diversi tentattivi bla suċċess, ir-riċerkatur iddispra, iżda l-appoġġ tat-tim għenu jerġa' jsib it-tama.
formal.en: After several unsuccessful attempts, the researcher despaired, but the team's support helped him regain hope.
formal.zh: 多次尝试失败后，这位研究人员陷入了绝望，但团队的支持帮助他重新找到了希望。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif ħassu Mark meta tilef xogħlu? Nina: Għall-ewwel iddispra, imma issa reġa' beda jfittex xogħol.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did Mark feel when he lost his job? Nina: At first he despaired, but now he has started looking for work again.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克失业时是什么感受？妮娜：他起初很绝望，但现在又开始找工作了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħassu Mark meta tilef xogħlu?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħassu Mark meta tilef xogħlu?
messages.zh: 马克失业时是什么感受？
messages.en: How did Mark feel when he lost his job?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-ewwel iddispra, imma issa reġa' beda jfittex xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-ewwel iddispra, imma issa reġa' beda jfittex xogħol.
messages.zh: 他起初很绝望，但现在又开始找工作了。
messages.en: At first he despaired, but now he has started looking for work again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把希望想成一盏灯：灯光熄灭、人觉得再无办法时，就是这个词表达的“绝望”；重点记住失去希望的心理状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To regard someone or something with contempt, or reject them with contempt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某事怀有鄙视，或带着轻蔑加以拒绝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħares lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa b'disprezz, jew jirrifjuta lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa b'disprezz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鄙视、看不起某人或某事，认为其不值得尊重。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iqis lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa bħala li ma jistħoqqlux rispett u jħoss disprezz lejh.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone despises a person or thing, they regard them as unworthy of respect.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻蔑地拒绝某人的提议、帮助、示好或其他给予。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jirrifjuta offerta, għajnuna jew turija ta' affezzjoni b'mod li juri disprezz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone spurns an offer or someone's affection, they reject it in a contemptuous way.

formal.mt: Il-kittieb iddisprezza l-ipokrezija ta' dawk li tkellmu dwar il-ġustizzja iżda aġixxew b'mod inġust.
formal.en: The writer despised the hypocrisy of those who spoke about justice but acted unjustly.
formal.zh: 这位作家鄙视那些口谈正义、行为却不公的人所表现出的虚伪。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Luqa aċċetta l-għajnuna tiegħek? Mark: Le, iddisprezza l-offerta tiegħi u qal li ma kellu bżonn lil ħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Luqa accept your help? Mark: No, he spurned my offer and said he did not need anyone.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：卢卡接受你的帮助了吗？马克：没有，他轻蔑地拒绝了我的提议，还说他不需要任何人。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 卢卡接受你的帮助了吗？
messages.en: Did Luqa accept your help?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, iddisprezza l-offerta tiegħi u qal li ma kellu bżonn lil ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Le, iddisprezza l-offerta tiegħi u qal li ma kellu bżonn lil ħadd.
messages.zh: 没有，他轻蔑地拒绝了我的提议，还说他不需要任何人。
messages.en: No, he spurned my offer and said he did not need anyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人先露出轻蔑的眼神，再把别人递来的帮助推开：眼神对应“鄙视”，推开的动作对应“轻蔑地拒绝”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To separate or purify a liquid by turning it into vapour and then cooling the vapour back into liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过加热使液体汽化，再冷却蒸气使其凝结，从而分离或提纯液体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jifred jew jippurifika likwidu billi jsaħħnu biex isir fwar u mbagħad ikessaħ il-fwar biex jerġa' jsir likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蒸馏；使液体汽化后再冷凝，以分离或提纯其中的成分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isaħħan likwidu biex jinbidel fi fwar u mbagħad ikessaħ il-fwar biex jiġbor likwidu separat jew aktar pur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone distils a liquid, they heat it into vapour and cool that vapour to obtain a separated or purer liquid.

formal.mt: It-tekniku iddistilla l-ilma mielaħ u ġabar il-likwidu li nkiseb wara li kessaħ il-fwar.
formal.en: The technician distilled the salt water and collected the liquid obtained after cooling the vapour.
formal.zh: 技术员蒸馏了盐水，并收集了蒸气冷却后得到的液体。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'għamel l-għalliem bl-ilma mielaħ? Ben: Iddistilla l-ilma; ġabar il-fwar u kessħu sakemm reġa' sar likwidu.
colloquial.en: Anna: What did the teacher do with the salt water? Ben: He distilled the water; he collected the vapour and cooled it until it became liquid again.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：老师对盐水做了什么？本：他把水蒸馏了，收集蒸气，再冷却到它重新变成液体。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 老师对盐水做了什么？
messages.en: What did the teacher do with the salt water?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iddistilla l-ilma; ġabar il-fwar u kessħu sakemm reġa' sar likwidu.
messages.mt_standard: Iddistilla l-ilma; ġabar il-fwar u kessħu sakemm reġa' sar likwidu.
messages.zh: 他把水蒸馏了，收集蒸气，再冷却到它重新变成液体。
messages.en: He distilled the water; he collected the vapour and cooled it until it became liquid again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“液体受热、蒸气上升、遇冷成滴”三个连续画面记忆蒸馏；看到这个词，就回想蒸气重新变成液体的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To recognize or show the difference between two things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 辨认或说明两个事物之间的差异，将它们区分开来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħraf jew juri d-differenza bejn żewġ affarijiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: he distinguished/to make a difference between two objects
sense_translations.zh_definition: 他区分了两个物体；辨认或指出两个物体之间的差异。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għaraf jew wera d-differenza bejn żewġ oġġetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone distinguishes between two objects, they recognize or explain the differences that separate them.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, ir-riċerkatur iddistngwa bejn iż-żewġ oġġetti billi ddeskriva l-forma u l-kulur ta' kull wieħed.
formal.en: In his report, the researcher distinguished between the two objects by describing the shape and colour of each.
formal.zh: 研究人员在报告中通过描述两个物体各自的形状和颜色，将它们区分开来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn iż-żewġ ċwievet jidhru l-istess. Mark: Pawlu iddistngwa bejniethom mill-ewwel; waħda hija itwal mill-oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: These two keys look the same. Mark: Paul distinguished between them straight away; one is longer than the other.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这两把钥匙看起来一样。马克：保罗一下就分清了；一把比另一把长。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这两把钥匙看起来一样。
messages.en: These two keys look the same.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu iddistngwa bejniethom mill-ewwel; waħda hija itwal mill-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu iddistngwa bejniethom mill-ewwel; waħda hija itwal mill-oħra.
messages.zh: 保罗一下就分清了；一把比另一把长。
messages.en: Paul distinguished between them straight away; one is longer than the other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把两把相似钥匙并排比较，找出长短差异；用“看出不同、分清两者”的画面记住这个词，并联记表示“在两者之间”的 bejn。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give or deliver things to several people or places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品分发给不同的人，或配送到不同的地点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti jew iwassal affarijiet lil diversi persuni jew f'diversi postijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将物品分发给多人，或分配、配送到多个地点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iqassam affarijiet lil diversi persuni jew iwassalhom f'diversi postijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone distributes things, they give or deliver them to a number of people or places.

formal.mt: Il-voluntier iddistribwixxa l-pakketti tal-ikel lill-familji li kienu qed jistennew fiċ-ċentru.
formal.en: The volunteer distributed the food parcels to the families who were waiting at the centre.
formal.zh: 志愿者把食品包分发给了在中心等候的家庭。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn huma l-biljetti għall-kunċert? Mark: Pawlu iddistribwixxa l-biljetti lbieraħ. Tiegħek ħallejtu fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are the concert tickets? Mark: Paul distributed the tickets yesterday. I left yours on the table.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：音乐会的票在哪里？马克：保罗昨天把票分发了。我把你的那张放在桌上了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 音乐会的票在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the concert tickets?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu iddistribwixxa l-biljetti lbieraħ. Tiegħek ħallejtu fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu iddistribwixxa l-biljetti lbieraħ. Tiegħek ħallejtu fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 保罗昨天把票分发了。我把你的那张放在桌上了。
messages.en: Paul distributed the tickets yesterday. I left yours on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象志愿者拿着一箱食品，逐份交给排队的人；把“从一处交到多人手中”的动作与这个词绑定，记住它表示分发、分配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To damage something so severely that it no longer exists or cannot be used.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 严重破坏某物，使它不复存在或无法继续使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jeqred xi ħaġa jew jagħmlilha ħsara tant kbira li ma tibqax teżisti jew ma tkunx tista' tintuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摧毁或彻底毁坏某物，使其不复存在或无法使用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jeqred xi ħaġa jew jagħmlilha ħsara kbira ħafna, b'mod li ma tibqax teżisti jew ma tkunx tista' tintuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something destroys an object or a place, it damages it so badly that it no longer exists or can no longer be used.

formal.mt: In-nar iddistruġġa l-maħżen u l-prodotti kollha li kienu maħżuna fih.
formal.en: The fire destroyed the warehouse and all the products stored inside it.
formal.zh: 大火摧毁了仓库及其内部存放的所有产品。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tixtri telefon ġdid? Mark: Il-kelb iddistruġġa t-telefon tiegħi. Gidmu, u issa ma jaħdimx.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you buying a new phone? Mark: The dog destroyed my phone. It bit it, and now it doesn't work.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么要买新手机？马克：狗把我的手机毁了。它咬了手机，现在手机不能用了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么要买新手机？
messages.en: Why are you buying a new phone?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kelb iddistruġġa t-telefon tiegħi. Gidmu, u issa ma jaħdimx.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kelb iddistruġġa t-telefon tiegħi. Gidmu, u issa ma jaħdimx.
messages.zh: 狗把我的手机毁了。它咬了手机，现在手机不能用了。
messages.en: The dog destroyed my phone. It bit it, and now it doesn't work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一部被狗咬坏、完全无法使用的手机；把“坏到不能再用”的结果与这个词绑定，帮助记牢它表示摧毁或严重毁坏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To separate something into parts or groups, or to calculate how many times one number fits into another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把整体分成若干部分或组；在数学中，计算一个数包含多少个另一个数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqsam xi ħaġa f'partijiet jew fi gruppi, jew jikkalkula kemm-il darba numru jidħol f'numru ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物划分成若干部分或组；在数学中进行除法运算。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jaqsam xi ħaġa f'żewġ partijiet jew aktar, jew jagħmel operazzjoni matematika biex isib kemm-il darba numru jidħol f'ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you divide something, you separate it into parts or groups; in mathematics, you calculate how many times one number fits into another.

collocations.zh: 把全班分成了若干小组

formal.mt: L-għalliem iddivida l-klassi fi tliet gruppi u ta kompitu differenti lil kull grupp.
formal.en: The teacher divided the class into three groups and gave each group a different task.
formal.zh: 老师把全班分成三个小组，并给每组布置了不同的任务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif se naqsmu l-kejk bejn sitta? Mark: Pawlu diġà iddivida l-kejk f'sitt biċċiet indaqs. Ħu waħda!
colloquial.en: Maja: How are we going to share the cake among six people? Mark: Paul has already divided the cake into six equal pieces. Take one!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：蛋糕要怎么分给六个人？马克：保罗已经把蛋糕分成六块一样大的了。拿一块吧！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se naqsmu l-kejk bejn sitta?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se naqsmu l-kejk bejn sitta?
messages.zh: 蛋糕要怎么分给六个人？
messages.en: How are we going to share the cake among six people?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu diġà iddivida l-kejk f'sitt biċċiet indaqs. Ħu waħda!
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu diġà iddivida l-kejk f'sitt biċċiet indaqs. Ħu waħda!
messages.zh: 保罗已经把蛋糕分成六块一样大的了。拿一块吧！
messages.en: Paul has already divided the cake into six equal pieces. Take one!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个完整蛋糕被切成六块，从“整体变成部分”记住划分义；再联想十二块蛋糕每三块一组，连接到数学中的除法义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To break down food in the body so that its nutrients can be absorbed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在体内分解食物，使其中的营养物质能够被吸收。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikisser l-ikel fil-ġisem sabiex is-sustanzi nutrittivi tiegħu jkunu jistgħu jiġu assorbiti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消化；在体内分解吃下的食物，以便吸收营养。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikisser l-ikel li jkun kiel f'sustanzi li l-ġisem jista' jassorbi u juża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a person digests food, their body breaks it down so that nutrients can be absorbed.

collocations.zh: 消化了一顿难消化的大餐

formal.mt: Il-pazjent iddiġerixxa l-ikla mingħajr diffikultà u ma ħass l-ebda skumdità wara.
formal.en: The patient digested the meal without difficulty and felt no discomfort afterwards.
formal.zh: 患者顺利消化了这顿饭，之后没有感到任何不适。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif inhu Pawlu wara dik l-ikla kbira? Luqa: Iddiġerixxa l-ikel u issa jħossu aħjar.
colloquial.en: Marija: How is Pawlu after that big meal? Luqa: He has digested the food and feels better now.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：保罗吃完那顿大餐后怎么样了？卢卡：他已经消化了，现在感觉好多了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhu Pawlu wara dik l-ikla kbira?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhu Pawlu wara dik l-ikla kbira?
messages.zh: 保罗吃完那顿大餐后怎么样了？
messages.en: How is Pawlu after that big meal?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iddiġerixxa l-ikel u issa jħossu aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Iddiġerixxa l-ikel u issa jħossu aħjar.
messages.zh: 他已经消化了，现在感觉好多了。
messages.en: He has digested the food and feels better now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iddiġerixxa 和“吃下食物、身体分解、吸收营养”连成画面，借 l-ikel（食物）这个搭配记住“消化”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To get or obtain something that one needs or wants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 获得自己需要或想要的东西，常用于表示设法弄到某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kiseb xi ħaġa li kellu bżonn jew li xtaq, xi drabi wara xi sforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 获得某物，使之归自己拥有或使用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kiseb xi ħaġa u sar jista' jużaha jew iżommha bħala tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you acquire something, you get it and it becomes available for you to own or use.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 取得所需或所求的东西。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Irnexxielu jikseb xi ħaġa li kellu bżonn jew li kien qed ifittex.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you obtain something, you succeed in getting what you need or have been looking for.

formal.mt: Wara diversi tentattivi, l-istudent iddobba kopja tal-ktieb meħtieġ għall-kors.
formal.en: After several attempts, the student managed to obtain a copy of the book required for the course.
formal.zh: 经过多次尝试，这名学生终于弄到了课程所需书籍的一本副本。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadek bla biljett għall-kunċert? Mark: Le, ħija iddobba wieħed għalija lbieraħ!
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you still without a ticket for the concert? Mark: No, my brother managed to get one for me yesterday!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你还没弄到音乐会的票吗？马克：弄到了，我哥哥昨天帮我弄到了一张！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还没弄到音乐会的票吗？
messages.en: Are you still without a ticket for the concert?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ħija iddobba wieħed għalija lbieraħ!
messages.mt_standard: Le, ħija iddobba wieħed għalija lbieraħ!
messages.zh: 弄到了，我哥哥昨天帮我弄到了一张！
messages.en: No, my brother managed to get one for me yesterday!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“终于弄到票”的情景记忆：先有所需，再设法获得，重点是东西到手。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To provide a person or institution with a quality, ability, or resources.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 赋予人某种品质或能力，或为机构提供资源。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta lil persuna jew lil istituzzjoni kwalità, ħila jew riżorsi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赋予某人品质或才能，或向某机构提供资金等资源。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ta lil xi ħadd kwalità jew talent, jew ipprovda istituzzjoni bi flus jew b'riżorsi oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something endows a person or institution with something, they give them a particular quality, ability, or resources.

collocations.en: endowed the artist with musical talent
collocations.zh: 赋予了这位艺术家音乐才华

formal.mt: Il-benefattur iddota l-fondazzjoni b'fondi biex tappoġġja l-edukazzjoni tat-tfal.
formal.en: The benefactor endowed the foundation with funds to support children's education.
formal.zh: 这位捐助者为基金会提供了资金，以支持儿童教育。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif se tħallas il-fondazzjoni għall-boroż ta' studju? Pawlu: Negozjant iddotaha b'fondi apposta għalihom.
colloquial.en: Marta: How will the foundation pay for the scholarships? Pawlu: A businessman endowed it with funds specifically for them.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：基金会拿什么钱来支付奖学金？保罗：一位商人给它提供了专门用于奖学金的资金。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se tħallas il-fondazzjoni għall-boroż ta' studju?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se tħallas il-fondazzjoni għall-boroż ta' studju?
messages.zh: 基金会拿什么钱来支付奖学金？
messages.en: How will the foundation pay for the scholarships?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 一位商人给它提供了专门用于奖学金的资金。
messages.en: A businessman endowed it with funds specifically for them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“赋予”串起两个画面：赋予艺术家才华，给予基金会资源；记住获得的是能力或支持。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something straight or put it into a straight position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使弯曲的东西变直，或把歪斜的东西摆正。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel xi ħaġa dritta jew poġġieha f'pożizzjoni dritta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把弯曲或歪斜的东西弄直、摆正，也可指挺直身体部位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għamel dritt oġġett li kien mgħawweġ jew imxaqleb, jew ġab parti tal-ġisem f'pożizzjoni dritta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you straighten something, you make it straight or move it into a straight position.

formal.mt: It-tekniku iddritta l-wajer mgħawweġ qabel ma waħħlu mal-apparat.
formal.en: The technician straightened the bent wire before attaching it to the device.
formal.zh: 技术员先把弯曲的金属丝弄直，再把它接到设备上。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min iddritta l-kwadru? Kien imxaqleb dalgħodu. Ben: Jien! Issa jidher ħafna aħjar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who straightened the picture? It was crooked this morning. Ben: I did! It looks much better now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁把画框摆正了？今天早上它还是歪的。本：我摆的！现在看着好多了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min iddritta l-kwadru? Kien imxaqleb dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Min iddritta l-kwadru? Kien imxaqleb dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 谁把画框摆正了？今天早上它还是歪的。
messages.en: Who straightened the picture? It was crooked this morning.

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 我摆的！现在看着好多了。
messages.en: I did! It looks much better now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中播放“弯变直、歪变正”的动作：拉直金属丝、摆正画框、挺直后背都能帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel uncertain about something, suspect a possibility, or hesitate over a decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对事情的真实性或可靠性存疑，猜测某种情况可能存在，或在决定时犹豫动摇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma kienx ċert minn xi ħaġa, issuspetta li seta' kien hemm xi problema, jew eżita qabel ma ddeċieda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某事是否真实、正确或可靠持怀疑态度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ma kienx ċert jekk xi ħaġa kinitx vera, korretta jew ta' min joqgħod fuqha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you doubt something, you are uncertain whether it is true, correct, or reliable.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在证据尚不充分时，怀疑某种情况存在或某件事发生过。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaseb li xi ħaġa setgħet kienet vera jew seħħet, mingħajr ma kellu prova biżżejjed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you suspect something, you think it may be true or may have happened, although you do not have enough proof.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在选择、决心或信念上犹豫不定、发生动摇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Eżita dwar għażla jew deċiżjoni, jew ma baqax sod fil-fehma tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you waver, you become uncertain about a choice or less firm in a decision or belief.

collocations.en: doubted the accuracy of the report
suspected that there was an error

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur iddubita mill-eżattezza tar-riżultati u talab li l-kalkoli jiġu vverifikati.
formal.en: The researcher doubted the accuracy of the results and requested that the calculations be checked.
formal.zh: 研究人员对结果的准确性产生了怀疑，并要求核查计算过程。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex Samwel ma aċċettax mill-ewwel? Luqa: Iddubita ftit għax ix-xogħol kien 'il bogħod, imma fl-aħħar aċċetta.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why didn't Samwel accept straight away? Luqa: He wavered a little because the job was far away, but he accepted in the end.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：萨姆韦尔为什么没有马上答应？卢卡：他因为工作地点太远而犹豫了一下，不过最后还是答应了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 萨姆韦尔为什么没有马上答应？
messages.en: Why didn't Samwel accept straight away?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iddubita ftit għax ix-xogħol kien 'il bogħod, imma fl-aħħar aċċetta.
messages.mt_standard: Iddubita ftit għax ix-xogħol kien 'il bogħod, imma fl-aħħar aċċetta.
messages.zh: 他因为工作地点太远而犹豫了一下，不过最后还是答应了。
messages.en: He wavered a little because the job was far away, but he accepted in the end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个“不确定”记义：不确定真假是怀疑，觉得可能有事是猜疑，拿不定主意是动摇。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An ideal is a standard of excellence or a goal that someone hopes to achieve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指一个人希望实现的美好目标，或认为值得追求的完善标准。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ideal huwa għan jew livell ta' perfezzjoni li persuna tixtieq tilħaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 理想；作为追求目标的美好状态或完善标准。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għan mixtieq jew mudell ta' perfezzjoni li wieħed jipprova jilħaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An ideal is a goal or standard that you consider worth striving to achieve.

collocations.en: the ideal of a just society

formal.mt: L-ideal ta' soċjetà ġusta għandu jiggwida d-deċiżjonijiet tagħna.
formal.en: The ideal of a just society should guide our decisions.
formal.zh: 建立公正社会的理想应当指引我们的决策。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu l-ideal tiegħek? Pawlu: Li kulħadd ikollu ċans jitgħallem.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is your ideal? Pawlu: For everyone to have a chance to learn.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你的理想是什么？Pawlu：让每个人都有学习的机会。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的理想是什么？
messages.en: What is your ideal?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 让每个人都有学习的机会。
messages.en: For everyone to have a chance to learn.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把名词 ideal 和“我心中想实现的目标”绑在一起记，再用 ideal personali“个人理想”提醒自己这里讲的是一个理想目标。

gloss_zh: 你的手；在你手中（用于 f'idejk）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Idejk refers to your hands and occurs in expressions describing something held in your hands.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指对话对象的双手；在 f'idejk 等表达中，表示某物在你手中或由你拿着。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idejk huma l-idejn tiegħek; fl-espressjoni f'idejk, il-kelma tindika li xi ħaġa tinsab fl-idejn tiegħek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在你手中；由你拿着。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li xi ħaġa tinsab fl-idejn tiegħek jew li qed iżżommha int.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is in your hand, you are holding it.

collocations.en: hold the book in your hands

formal.mt: Matul l-eżerċizzju, żomm il-ballun f'idejk u segwi l-istruzzjonijiet.
formal.en: During the exercise, hold the ball in your hands and follow the instructions.
formal.zh: 练习时，请用双手拿住球，并按照指示操作。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'għandek f'idejk? Toni: Għandi l-ktieb li tlabtni nġib.
colloquial.en: Rita: What have you got in your hands? Toni: I've got the book you asked me to bring.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你手里拿着什么？Toni：拿着你让我带来的那本书。

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.zh: 你手里拿着什么？
messages.en: What have you got in your hands?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.zh: 拿着你让我带来的那本书。
messages.en: I've got the book you asked me to bring.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人指着你手里的书问话：把 idejk 记成“你的双手”，再把整个 f'idejk 记成“在你手中”，用拿书的动作帮助区分。

gloss_zh: 令你厌烦；乏味得让你不耐烦

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something tedious makes you feel bored or impatient because it is dull, repetitive, or prolonged.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事枯燥、重复或持续太久，使你感到厌烦或不耐烦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindika li xi ħaġa ġġiegħlek tħoss dwejjaq jew titlef il-paċenzja għax tkun monotona, ripetittiva jew twila wisq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乏味而令人厌烦的，尤其因内容重复或持续太久而使人不耐烦。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jġiegħlek tħoss dwejjaq minħabba nuqqas ta' interess, ripetizzjoni jew tul żejjed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something tedious bores you because it is repetitive, uninteresting, or takes too long.

collocations.en: becomes tedious for you after a while
collocations.zh: 过一会儿就让你感到乏味

formal.mt: Jekk dan l-eżerċizzju idejqek minħabba r-ripetizzjoni, ħu pawża qasira qabel tkompli.
formal.en: If this exercise becomes tedious for you because of the repetition, take a short break before continuing.
formal.zh: 如果这项练习因反复重复而让你感到厌烦，请稍作休息再继续。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-eżerċizzju idejqek? Mark: Iva, għax irrid nagħmel l-istess ħaġa ħafna drabi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you find this exercise tedious? Mark: Yes, because I have to do the same thing many times.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你觉得这项练习很乏味吗？Mark：是啊，因为我得把同一件事做很多遍。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你觉得这项练习很乏味吗？
messages.en: Do you find this exercise tedious?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax irrid nagħmel l-istess ħaġa ħafna drabi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax irrid nagħmel l-istess ħaġa ħafna drabi.
messages.zh: 是啊，因为我得把同一件事做很多遍。
messages.en: Yes, because I have to do the same thing many times.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把同一道练习重复做很多遍，越做越不耐烦；把这个感受与 idejqek 连起来，记住它表达“乏味得令你厌烦”。

gloss_zh: 已识别的；已确认身份的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Recognized or established as a particular person or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身份、名称或具体性质已经得到辨认或确认的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li l-identità tiegħu jew x'inhu jkun ġie magħruf jew ikkonfermat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已被辨认出或已确认身份、名称或性质的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie rikonoxxut jew li l-identità tiegħu tkun ġiet stabbilita.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is identified, their identity or what they are has been established.

formal.mt: Ir-riskju identifikat fir-rapport jeħtieġ miżuri ta' prevenzjoni.
formal.en: The risk identified in the report requires preventive measures.
formal.zh: 报告中已识别的风险需要采取预防措施。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-bagalja tiegħi għadha ma nstabitx? Mark: Instabet, u sidha ġie identifikat permezz tat-tikketta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has my suitcase still not been found? Mark: It has been found, and its owner has been identified through the label.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我的行李箱还没找到吗？马克：找到了，而且已经通过标签确认了失主身份。

messages.speaker: Maja (旅客)
messages.zh: 我的行李箱还没找到吗？
messages.en: Has my suitcase still not been found?

messages.speaker: Mark (失物招领处职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Instabet, u sidha ġie identifikat permezz tat-tikketta.
messages.mt_standard: Instabet, u sidha ġie identifikat permezz tat-tikketta.
messages.zh: 找到了，而且已经通过标签确认了失主身份。
messages.en: It has been found, and its owner has been identified through the label.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它和“认出来后贴上确认标签”的画面联系起来：重点是身份已经确认。搭配阴性名词 persuna 时，注意例句中的 identifikata。

gloss_zh: 行为定向广告；行为定向投放

teaching_sense.en_definition: The use of information about people's behaviour to select advertisements or the audiences who receive them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用人们的浏览、点击等行为信息，选择向其展示的广告或确定广告受众的做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu ta' informazzjoni dwar l-imġiba tan-nies, bħal liema paġni jżuru jew fuq xiex jikklikkjaw, biex jintgħażlu r-reklami jew l-udjenzi tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行为定向广告，即根据用户行为信息选择并展示的广告或相应广告做法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reklamar li fih ir-reklami jintgħażlu u jintwerew skont informazzjoni dwar l-imġiba tal-utenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Behavioural advertising is advertising in which the advertisements shown to people are selected using information about their behaviour.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行为定向投放，即依据用户行为信息确定广告受众并选择投放对象的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jintgħażlu n-nies li għandhom jaraw reklam abbażi ta' informazzjoni dwar l-imġiba tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Behavioural targeting is the process of using information about people's behaviour to decide who should receive particular advertisements.

collocations.zh: 基于行为定向投放的广告

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif l-identifikazzjoni tal-imġiba tintuża biex jintgħażlu reklami skont il-paġni li jżuru l-utenti.
formal.en: The report explains how behavioural targeting is used to select advertisements according to the pages users visit.
formal.zh: 报告解释了如何利用行为定向投放，根据用户访问的页面选择广告。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed nara tant reklami taż-żraben? Pawlu: Jista' jkun minħabba l-identifikazzjoni tal-imġiba, għax dan l-aħħar fittixt żraben fuq l-internet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why am I seeing so many shoe adverts? Pawlu: It could be because of behavioural targeting, since you recently searched for shoes online.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么我总看到这么多鞋子的广告？保罗：可能是因为行为定向投放，因为你最近在网上搜过鞋子。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed nara tant reklami taż-żraben?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed nara tant reklami taż-żraben?
messages.zh: 为什么我总看到这么多鞋子的广告？
messages.en: Why am I seeing so many shoe adverts?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jista' jkun minħabba l-identifikazzjoni tal-imġiba, għax dan l-aħħar fittixt żraben fuq l-internet.
messages.mt_standard: Jista' jkun minħabba l-identifikazzjoni tal-imġiba, għax dan l-aħħar fittixt żraben fuq l-internet.
messages.zh: 可能是因为行为定向投放，因为你最近在网上搜过鞋子。
messages.en: It could be because of behavioural targeting, since you recently searched for shoes online.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“搜过鞋子，随后看到鞋子广告”的连续画面记忆：advertising 侧重呈现的广告，targeting 侧重依据行为选择投放对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of giving treatment to help a person recover or a wound heal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给予治疗或护理，以帮助病人康复或伤口愈合这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' kura lil persuna marida jew lil ferita biex il-persuna tfiq jew il-ferita tagħlaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 医治，使病人康复或使伤口愈合。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħti l-kura meħtieġa lil persuna jew lil ferita sabiex il-persuna tfiq jew il-ferita tagħlaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: To cure someone is to give treatment that helps them recover from an illness or injury.

formal.mt: It-tabib idewwi l-ferita u jispjega lill-pazjent kif għandu jżommha nadifa.
formal.en: The doctor treats the wound and explains to the patient how to keep it clean.
formal.zh: 医生医治伤口，并向病人解释应如何保持伤口清洁。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jieħu ħsieb in-nannu llum? Marija: Se jiġi t-tabib biex idewwi l-ferita f'siequ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is going to look after Grandpa today? Marija: The doctor is coming to treat the wound on his foot.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天谁来照顾爷爷？玛丽亚：医生会来给他医治脚上的伤口。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb in-nannu llum?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb in-nannu llum?
messages.zh: 今天谁来照顾爷爷？
messages.en: Who is going to look after Grandpa today?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Se jiġi t-tabib biex idewwi l-ferita f'siequ.
messages.mt_standard: Se jiġi t-tabib biex idewwi l-ferita f'siequ.
messages.zh: 医生会来给他医治脚上的伤口。
messages.en: The doctor is coming to treat the wound on his foot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 idewwi 放进“医生清理伤口、进行治疗、帮助愈合”的画面记忆，并连读 idewwi ferita，建立“医治伤口”的搭配联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fixed expression whose meaning cannot usually be understood from the meanings of its individual words.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 意义通常不能仅根据各个词的字面意思推知的固定表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni fissa li t-tifsira tagħha normalment ma tistax tinftiehem biss mit-tifsiriet tal-kliem li jifformaha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 习语或惯用语，指具有约定俗成的整体意义、通常不能逐词按字面理解的固定表达。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Grupp ta' kliem b'tifsira stabbilita li normalment tkun differenti minn dik li wieħed jifhem jekk jieħu kull kelma waħedha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An idiom is a fixed expression whose overall meaning is usually different from the literal meanings of its individual words.

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jispjegaw it-tifsira tal-idjoma u jużawha f'sentenza li turi li fehmuha.
formal.en: Students should explain the meaning of the idiom and use it in a sentence that shows they have understood it.
formal.zh: 学生应解释这条习语的含义，并用一个句子表明自己已经理解了它。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' nittraduċi din l-espressjoni kelma b'kelma? Luqa: Aħjar le, għax hija idjoma; ħares lejn it-tifsira kollha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I translate this expression word for word? Luqa: Better not, because it is an idiom; look at its overall meaning.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个表达可以逐词翻译吗？卢卡：最好不要，因为它是一条习语；要看它的整体意思。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nittraduċi din l-espressjoni kelma b'kelma?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nittraduċi din l-espressjoni kelma b'kelma?
messages.zh: 这个表达可以逐词翻译吗？
messages.en: Can I translate this expression word for word?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar le, għax hija idjoma; ħares lejn it-tifsira kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar le, għax hija idjoma; ħares lejn it-tifsira kollha.
messages.zh: 最好不要，因为它是一条习语；要看它的整体意思。
messages.en: Better not, because it is an idiom; look at its overall meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一条 idjoma 想成一个完整的词语包裹：理解时先看整包表达的含义，避免拆开后逐词硬译。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be slow in doing something or take a long time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做某事缓慢，或需要较长时间才能完成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu ħafna ħin biex jagħmel jew itemm xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迟缓的；行动或回应有所迟延的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jieħu ħafna ħin biex jaġixxi jew biex iwieġeb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is tardy is slow to act or takes longer than expected.

collocations.en: take a long time to arrive

formal.mt: Il-fornitur idum biex iwieġeb għall-mistoqsijiet, u dan idewwem ix-xogħol.
formal.en: The supplier is slow to answer questions, and this delays the work.
formal.zh: 供应商迟迟才回复问题，这拖慢了工作进度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu dejjem idum biex iwieġeb? Rita: Ċempillu; forsi għadu ma rax il-messaġġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Pawlu always so slow to reply? Rita: Call him; perhaps he hasn't seen the message yet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么总是迟迟不回复？丽塔：给他打电话吧，他可能还没看到消息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu dejjem idum biex iwieġeb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu dejjem idum biex iwieġeb?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么总是迟迟不回复？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu always so slow to reply?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċempillu; forsi għadu ma rax il-messaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Ċempillu; forsi għadu ma rax il-messaġġ.
messages.zh: 给他打电话吧，他可能还没看到消息。
messages.en: Call him; perhaps he hasn't seen the message yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 idum 放进“等回复”的画面里记：idum biex iwieġeb，就是回复要等很久。

gloss_zh: 周边地区；附近一带；所在一带

teaching_sense.en_definition: The surrounding area or the locality where someone or something is situated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某人或某物所在的一带，或某个地点周围的地区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-inħawi ta' madwar post jew iż-żona fejn jinsab xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所在一带；附近或周围的地区。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-inħawi jew in-naħat fejn jinsab xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew dawk ta' madwar post partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The whereabouts or surrounding locality is the area in which someone or something can be found.

collocations.en: in the area around the town

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi t-toroq u l-bini fl-idwar tal-belt.
formal.en: The study describes the roads and buildings in the area around the town.
formal.zh: 这项研究描述了城镇周边一带的道路和建筑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taf lil xi ħadd minn dawk l-idwar? Pawlu: Iva, ħabib tiegħi joqgħod hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you know anyone from that area? Pawlu: Yes, a friend of mine lives there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你认识那一带的人吗？保罗：认识，我的一个朋友住在那里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf lil xi ħadd minn dawk l-idwar?
messages.mt_standard: Taf lil xi ħadd minn dawk l-idwar?
messages.zh: 你认识那一带的人吗？
messages.en: Do you know anyone from that area?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 认识，我的一个朋友住在那里。
messages.en: Yes, a friend of mine lives there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 idwar 想成地图上圈起的“附近一带”，用 fl-idwar tal-belt 记住城镇周边的范围。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a serious mistake in an action, decision, or piece of work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在行动、决定或工作中犯下较为严重的错误。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel żball serju f'azzjoni, f'deċiżjoni jew f'xi xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 犯下会明显影响结果的重大错误。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għamel żball importanti li jista' jkollu effett serju fuq ir-riżultat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone makes a decision or performs a task and makes a significant mistake, they do something seriously wrong that can affect the outcome.

collocations.en: made a serious mistake in the calculations
collocations.zh: 在计算中出现严重失误

collocations.en: made a serious mistake in his decision
collocations.zh: 在自己的决定上犯了重大错误

formal.mt: Il-kontabilist iffawlja fil-kalkoli, u għalhekk il-kumpanija kellha terġa' tħejji r-rapport finanzjarju.
formal.en: The accountant made a serious mistake in the calculations, so the company had to prepare the financial report again.
formal.zh: 会计在计算中出现了严重失误，因此公司不得不重新编制财务报告。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Paul iffawlja meta bagħat il-fajl il-ħażin lill-klijent. David: Iva, issa jrid jibgħat il-fajl it-tajjeb u jispjega l-iżball.
colloquial.en: Marta: Paul made a serious mistake when he sent the wrong file to the client. David: Yes, now he needs to send the correct file and explain the mistake.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗把错误的文件发给了客户，这次失误很严重。戴维：是啊，他现在得把正确文件发过去，并说明这个错误。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Paul iffawlja meta bagħat il-fajl il-ħażin lill-klijent.
messages.mt_standard: Paul iffawlja meta bagħat il-fajl il-ħażin lill-klijent.
messages.zh: 保罗把错误的文件发给了客户，这次失误很严重。
messages.en: Paul made a serious mistake when he sent the wrong file to the client.

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa jrid jibgħat il-fajl it-tajjeb u jispjega l-iżball.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa jrid jibgħat il-fajl it-tajjeb u jispjega l-iżball.
messages.zh: 是啊，他现在得把正确文件发过去，并说明这个错误。
messages.en: Yes, now he needs to send the correct file and explain the mistake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iffawlja 联想到“错发关键文件、必须补救”的画面，记住它强调较严重的失误。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To confront someone or deal with a problem or difficult situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面对某人，或正视并处理问题及困难处境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiltaqa' ma' persuna jew ma' sitwazzjoni diffiċli u jittratta magħha direttament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面对某人或某种处境；正视并应对问题。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jittratta direttament ma' persuna, problema jew diffikultà li jkollu quddiemu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you face someone or something difficult, you meet them directly or deal with the difficulty.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat iffaċja problema serja u talab parir qabel ħa deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The committee faced a serious problem and sought advice before making a decision.
formal.zh: 委员会面对一个严重问题，在作出决定前征求了意见。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Nippreferi ma naħsibx dwar din il-problema. Maja: Iffaċja l-problema llum, u nistgħu nfittxu soluzzjoni flimkien.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: I'd rather not think about this problem. Maja: Face the problem today, and we can look for a solution together.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：我宁愿不去想这个问题。玛雅：今天就面对这个问题吧，我们可以一起找解决办法。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nippreferi ma naħsibx dwar din il-problema.
messages.mt_standard: Nippreferi ma naħsibx dwar din il-problema.
messages.zh: 我宁愿不去想这个问题。
messages.en: I'd rather not think about this problem.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iffaċja l-problema llum, u nistgħu nfittxu soluzzjoni flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iffaċja l-problema llum, u nistgħu nfittxu soluzzjoni flimkien.
messages.zh: 今天就面对这个问题吧，我们可以一起找解决办法。
messages.en: Face the problem today, and we can look for a solution together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 iffaċja r-realtà 联想“睁眼正视现实”；抄写本词条时注意保留原有的一个 ċ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To deal directly with a person, problem, or difficult situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 直接面对某人、问题或困难处境，并加以处理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittratta direttament ma' persuna, problema jew sitwazzjoni diffiċli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面对或正视某人、问题或困难处境。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikun quddiem persuna jew sitwazzjoni u jittratta magħha direttament, anki meta tkun diffiċli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you face a problem or difficult situation, you confront it and deal with it directly.

formal.mt: It-tim iffaċċja diffikultajiet fil-bidu tal-proġett, iżda sab soluzzjonijiet xierqa.
formal.en: The team faced difficulties at the beginning of the project but found suitable solutions.
formal.zh: 团队在项目初期遇到了困难，但找到了合适的解决办法。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ma nafx kif se nsolvi din il-problema. Mark: Iffaċċja l-problema pass pass; jien ngħinek.
colloquial.en: Rita: I don't know how I'm going to solve this problem. Mark: Face the problem one step at a time; I'll help you.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我不知道该怎么解决这个问题。马克：一步一步面对这个问题吧，我会帮你。

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx kif se nsolvi din il-problema.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx kif se nsolvi din il-problema.
messages.zh: 我不知道该怎么解决这个问题。
messages.en: I don't know how I'm going to solve this problem.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iffaċċja l-problema pass pass; jien ngħinek.
messages.mt_standard: Iffaċċja l-problema pass pass; jien ngħinek.
messages.zh: 一步一步面对这个问题吧，我会帮你。
messages.en: Face the problem one step at a time; I'll help you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iffaċċja 配上“站到问题面前”的画面，用 iffaċċja problema 整组记住“面对问题”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To write your name on a document to identify yourself or show your agreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在文件上写下自己的姓名，以确认身份或表示同意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kiteb ismu fuq dokument biex jikkonferma l-identità tiegħu jew juri li jaqbel ma' dak li hemm miktub.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在文件等上面签名，通常用于确认、认可或表示同意。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Poġġa l-firma tiegħu fuq dokument biex jikkonfermah, japprovah jew juri li jaqbel miegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you sign a document, you write your name on it to identify yourself or show that you agree to its contents.

formal.mt: Id-direttur iffirma l-kuntratt wara li qara l-kundizzjonijiet kollha.
formal.en: The director signed the contract after reading all the terms.
formal.zh: 董事在阅读全部条款后签署了合同。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Missierek iffirma l-formola għall-ħarġa tal-iskola? Nina: Iva, iffirmaha dalgħodu. Qiegħda fil-basket tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did your father sign the form for the school outing? Nina: Yes, he signed it this morning. It's in my bag.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你爸爸在学校出游的表格上签名了吗？妮娜：签了，他今天早上签的。表格在我的包里。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你爸爸在学校出游的表格上签名了吗？
messages.en: Did your father sign the form for the school outing?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iffirmaha dalgħodu. Qiegħda fil-basket tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iffirmaha dalgħodu. Qiegħda fil-basket tiegħi.
messages.zh: 签了，他今天早上签的。表格在我的包里。
messages.en: Yes, he signed it this morning. It's in my bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿笔在合同末尾写姓名，把 iffirma 与“落笔签名、确认同意”的动作绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To gather in large numbers or fill a place with many people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 许多人聚集在一起，或使某个地方挤满人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inġabar flimkien ma' ħafna nies oħra jew mela post b'għadd kbir ta' nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 成群聚集或涌向某处，形成密集的人群。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Inġabar jew mar f'post flimkien ma' għadd kbir ta' nies oħra, u fforma folla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If people throng a place, they gather there or move into it in large numbers.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挤入或挤满某处，使可用空间变得拥挤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mela post b'tant nies li l-ispazju sar dejjaq u kien diffiċli li wieħed jiċċaqlaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If people crowd a place, they fill it so closely that there is little space left to move.

formal.mt: Mijiet ta' nies iffollaw il-pjazza għaċ-ċerimonja, u l-organizzaturi żammew passaġġ miftuħ għall-emerġenzi.
formal.en: Hundreds of people thronged the square for the ceremony, and the organizers kept a passage open for emergencies.
formal.zh: 数百人为参加典礼聚集在广场上，组织者保留了一条应急通道。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma dħalniex mill-bieb prinċipali? Mark: In-nies iffollaw id-daħla. Ejja nużaw il-bieb tal-ġenb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why didn't we go in through the main door? Mark: People crowded the entrance. Let's use the side door.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们为什么没从正门进去？马克：人群把入口挤满了。我们走侧门吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们为什么没从正门进去？
messages.en: Why didn't we go in through the main door?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nies iffollaw id-daħla. Ejja nużaw il-bieb tal-ġenb.
messages.mt_standard: In-nies iffollaw id-daħla. Ejja nużaw il-bieb tal-ġenb.
messages.zh: 人群把入口挤满了。我们走侧门吧。
messages.en: People crowded the entrance. Let's use the side door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个连续画面记 iffolla：先是人群涌向广场，再是入口被挤满，分别对应聚集和拥挤。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To strengthen a place by adding walls or other defensive structures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过增建城墙或其他防御设施来加固某处，提高其抵御攻击的能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Saħħaħ post billi żied swar jew strutturi oħra ta' difiża biex ikun aktar protett minn attakk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加固某处或加强其防御，使其更能抵御攻击。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għamel post aktar b'saħħtu u aktar diffiċli biex jiġi attakkat billi bena jew saħħaħ id-difiżi tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you fortify a place, you strengthen its defences so that it is harder for an enemy to attack or capture.

formal.mt: Fil-mudell tal-proġett, it-tim iffortifika l-belt b'sur addizzjonali u żewġ torrijiet ħdejn id-daħla.
formal.en: In the project model, the team fortified the town with an additional defensive wall and two towers near the entrance.
formal.zh: 在项目模型中，团队通过增设一道防御墙，并在入口附近设置两座塔楼，加强了城镇的防御。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif ipproteġa l-kastell tiegħu Leo fil-logħba? Ben: Iffortifika l-kastell b'ħitan ogħla u poġġa għassiesa ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did Leo protect his castle in the game? Ben: He fortified the castle with higher walls and placed guards near the gate.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：利奥在游戏里是怎么保护自己的城堡的？本：他用更高的围墙加固了城堡，还在大门附近安排了守卫。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ipproteġa l-kastell tiegħu Leo fil-logħba?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ipproteġa l-kastell tiegħu Leo fil-logħba?
messages.zh: 利奥在游戏里是怎么保护自己的城堡的？
messages.en: How did Leo protect his castle in the game?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iffortifika l-kastell b'ħitan ogħla u poġġa għassiesa ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iffortifika l-kastell b'ħitan ogħla u poġġa għassiesa ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 他用更高的围墙加固了城堡，还在大门附近安排了守卫。
messages.en: He fortified the castle with higher walls and placed guards near the gate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iffortifika 配上“城堡加高围墙、入口增设塔楼”的画面，记住核心意思是加强防御。

gloss_zh: 设有防御工事的；加固防守的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Protected against attack by strong walls, barriers, or other defensive structures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过坚固的城墙、屏障或其他防御设施加强保护，以抵御攻击的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imsaħħaħ b'ħitan, ostakli jew strutturi oħra ta' difiża biex ikun protett kontra attakk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设有城墙、屏障等防御工事以抵御攻击的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post iffortifikat ikun imsaħħaħ b'ħitan jew b'mezzi oħra ta' difiża kontra attakki.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fortified place has strong walls or other defences that help protect it against attack.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi raħal iffortifikat b'ħitan għoljin u bieb ewlieni wieħed.
formal.en: The report describes a fortified village with high walls and one main gate.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一座设有高墙和一个主要城门的防御村庄。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ir-raħal kien iffortifikat? Pawlu: Iva, ara kemm huma ħoxnin il-ħitan ta' madwaru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was this village fortified? Pawlu: Yes, look how thick the walls around it are.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个村庄以前设有防御工事吗？Pawlu：是的，你看周围的墙有多厚。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 这个村庄以前设有防御工事吗？
messages.en: Was this village fortified?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara kemm huma ħoxnin il-ħitan ta' madwaru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara kemm huma ħoxnin il-ħitan ta' madwaru.
messages.zh: 是的，你看周围的墙有多厚。
messages.en: Yes, look how thick the walls around it are.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iffortifikat 和“村庄被厚厚城墙围住”的画面绑定记忆；它描述已经加强防御的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To avoid spending or using more money, time, or other resources than necessary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 减少本来需要花费的金钱、时间或其他资源，将其省下来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Naqqas l-ammont ta' flus, ħin jew riżorsi oħra li jintefqu jew jintużaw.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 节省或省下原本可能花费的金钱、时间等。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tonfoq jew tuża inqas flus, ħin jew riżorsi oħra milli kont tonfoq jew tuża kieku għamilt għażla differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you save money or time, you use less of it than you otherwise would.

formal.mt: L-uffiċċju iffranka l-flus billi naqqas l-istampar ta' dokumenti.
formal.en: The office saved money by reducing the printing of documents.
formal.zh: 办公室通过减少文件打印节省了开支。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex ħadt l-ikel miegħek? Lara: Biex niffranka ftit flus minflok nixtri l-ikel kuljum.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did you bring food with you? Lara: To save a little money instead of buying food every day.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你为什么自己带了吃的？Lara：为了省点钱，不用每天都买饭。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么自己带了吃的？
messages.en: Why did you bring food with you?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex niffranka ftit flus minflok nixtri l-ikel kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Biex niffranka ftit flus minflok nixtri l-ikel kuljum.
messages.zh: 为了省点钱，不用每天都买饭。
messages.en: To save a little money instead of buying food every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 iffranka 的“省下来”画面：自己带饭，钱包里的钱留下来；换成时间，也同样可以节省。

gloss_zh: 使凉爽；使清爽、恢复精神

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something cooler, or to make someone feel fresh and comfortable again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变得凉爽，或使人重新感到清爽舒适、恢复精神。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel xi ħaġa aktar friska, jew għen lil xi ħadd jerġa' jħossu frisk u komdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使温度降低；使变得凉爽。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmel xi ħaġa inqas sħuna sabiex issir aktar friska.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something cools a room or an object, it makes its temperature lower.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人重新感到清爽舒适；使恢复精神。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħin lil xi ħadd jerġa' jħossu frisk u komdu wara sħana jew għeja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something refreshes you, it makes you feel more comfortable and lively after heat or tiredness.

formal.mt: Ir-riħ ta' filgħaxija iffriska l-kamra, u wara l-mixja twila Pawlu iffriska ruħu billi ħasel wiċċu b'ilma frisk.
formal.en: The evening breeze cooled the room, and after the long walk Pawlu refreshed himself by washing his face with cool water.
formal.zh: 晚风使房间凉爽起来，而长途步行后，Pawlu 用凉水洗脸，让自己清爽了一下。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ftaħt it-tieqa? Mark: Biex niffriska l-kamra. Imbagħad naħsel wiċċi biex niffriska ruħi wkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you open the window? Mark: To cool the room. Then I'll wash my face to refresh myself too.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么打开窗户？Mark：让房间凉快一点。然后我也洗洗脸，让自己清爽一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么打开窗户？
messages.en: Why did you open the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex niffriska l-kamra. Imbagħad naħsel wiċċi biex niffriska ruħi wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Biex niffriska l-kamra. Imbagħad naħsel wiċċi biex niffriska ruħi wkoll.
messages.zh: 让房间凉快一点。然后我也洗洗脸，让自己清爽一下。
messages.en: To cool the room. Then I'll wash my face to refresh myself too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个连续画面记 iffriska：开窗让房间凉爽，洗脸让自己清爽；分别对应降温和恢复精神。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become solid because of cold, or to make something frozen by cooling it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因低温而凝固、结冰，或通过降温使某物冻结、冷冻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sar solidu minħabba l-kesħa, jew għamel xi ħaġa ffriżata billi kessaħha ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因低温而冻结、结冰；使某物冻结或将其冷冻。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Issir solidu minħabba l-kesħa, jew tkessaħ xi ħaġa sakemm tiffriża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When something freezes or you freeze it, it becomes solid or frozen because its temperature is very low.

formal.mt: Il-kok iffriża l-porzjonijiet tas-soppa f'kontenituri separati biex jużahom aktar tard.
formal.en: The cook froze the portions of soup in separate containers for later use.
formal.zh: 厨师把分装的汤放在不同容器中冷冻，以便日后使用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamilt bil-bqija tas-soppa? Mark: Iffriżajtha f'żewġ kontenituri, biex ikollna għal ġurnata oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did you do with the rest of the soup? Mark: I froze it in two containers so we'll have some for another day.
colloquial.zh: Lara：剩下的汤你怎么处理了？Mark：我分成两盒冷冻了，这样改天还有得喝。

messages.speaker: Lara (妻子)
messages.zh: 剩下的汤你怎么处理了？
messages.en: What did you do with the rest of the soup?

messages.speaker: Mark (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Iffriżajtha f'żewġ kontenituri, biex ikollna għal ġurnata oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iffriżajtha f'żewġ kontenituri, biex ikollna għal ġurnata oħra.
messages.zh: 我分成两盒冷冻了，这样改天还有得喝。
messages.en: I froze it in two containers so we'll have some for another day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iffriża 绑定到“水变冰、汤冻硬”的画面；记忆重点是低温造成冻结，而不只是感觉凉快。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Containing so many people that little free space remains.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某处人很多，剩余活动空间很少的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih ikun hemm ħafna nies u ftit spazju fejn wieħed jista' jiċċaqlaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拥挤的；因聚集了很多人而缺少空余空间的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi post li jkun mimli b'ħafna nies, b'mod li ma jibqax ħafna spazju liberu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a place is crowded, it contains so many people that there is little room to move.

formal.mt: It-teatru kien iffullat, u l-organizzaturi talbu lill-udjenza biex iżżomm il-passaġġi ħielsa.
formal.en: The theatre was crowded, and the organisers asked the audience to keep the aisles clear.
formal.zh: 剧院里挤满了人，组织者要求观众保持过道畅通。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ħanut iffullat wisq. Mark: Ejja niġu lura aktar tard, meta jkun hemm inqas nies.
colloquial.en: Maja: This shop is too crowded. Mark: Let's come back later, when there are fewer people.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这家店太挤了。马克：我们晚点再来吧，那时候人少一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这家店太挤了。
messages.en: This shop is too crowded.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja niġu lura aktar tard, meta jkun hemm inqas nies.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja niġu lura aktar tard, meta jkun hemm inqas nies.
messages.zh: 我们晚点再来吧，那时候人少一点。
messages.en: Let's come back later, when there are fewer people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iffullat 和高峰时挤满乘客的公交车画面一起记：重点是人多到活动空间很小。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having been brought into existence or given a particular shape or structure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经形成、组建完成，或已被赋予某种形状、结构的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun inħoloq jew ingħata forma jew struttura partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已形成的；已组建的；已具有某种形状或结构的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tkun diġà nħolqot, ġiet organizzata jew ingħatat forma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is formed has been brought into existence or given a particular shape or structure.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat iffurmat reċentement se jeżamina l-proposti u jħejji rapport għall-kunsill.
formal.en: The recently formed committee will examine the proposals and prepare a report for the council.
formal.zh: 最近组建的委员会将审议这些提案，并为议会编写报告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-grupp diġà ġie ffurmat? Pawlu: Iva, ġie ffurmat ilbieraħ, u diġà għandna ħames membri.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has the group already been formed? Pawlu: Yes, it was formed yesterday, and we already have five members.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：小组已经组建好了吗？保罗：是的，昨天组建好了，我们已经有五名成员。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 小组已经组建好了吗？
messages.en: Has the group already been formed?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġie ffurmat ilbieraħ, u diġà għandna ħames membri.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġie ffurmat ilbieraħ, u diġà għandna ħames membri.
messages.zh: 是的，昨天组建好了，我们已经有五名成员。
messages.en: Yes, it was formed yesterday, and we already have five members.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iffurmat 想成拼图已经拼成形，或小组已经组建好；用“形成后的状态”串联两个场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To say something amusing or speak without serious intent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说逗趣的话，或以不认真的方式说话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid xi ħaġa biex idaħħaq jew jitkellem mingħajr intenzjoni serja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开玩笑；说些逗趣或不应当真的话。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jgħid kliem biex idaħħaq lil ħaddieħor jew jitkellem mingħajr ma jkun qed jgħid xi ħaġa bis-serjetà.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you joke, you say something to amuse people or without intending it seriously.

formal.mt: Fil-bidu tad-diskors, il-kelliem iċċajta dwar it-temp biex joħloq atmosfera aktar rilassata.
formal.en: At the beginning of the speech, the speaker joked about the weather to create a more relaxed atmosphere.
formal.zh: 演讲开始时，发言人拿天气开了个玩笑，让气氛轻松一些。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex daħaq kulħadd? Toni: Għax Pawlu iċċajta dwar kemm domna nistennew il-karozza tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did everyone laugh? Toni: Because Pawlu joked about how long we had waited for the bus.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：大家为什么都笑了？托尼：因为保罗拿我们等公交车等了那么久这件事开了个玩笑。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 大家为什么都笑了？
messages.en: Why did everyone laugh?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Pawlu iċċajta dwar kemm domna nistennew il-karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Pawlu iċċajta dwar kemm domna nistennew il-karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 因为保罗拿我们等公交车等了那么久这件事开了个玩笑。
messages.en: Because Pawlu joked about how long we had waited for the bus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iċċajta 和朋友说笑的画面一起记：一句话逗得大家笑，就是“开玩笑”；再用 dwar 连接玩笑的话题。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover a road, path, or other ground surface with stone or another hard material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用石块或其他坚硬材料铺设道路、小径或地面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiksi triq, mogħdija jew wiċċ tal-art bil-ġebel jew b'materjal iebes ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用石块等坚硬材料铺砌道路或地面。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iqiegħed ġebel jew materjal iebes ieħor fuq triq, mogħdija jew art biex jifforma wiċċ miksi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone paves an area, they cover its surface with stone or another hard material.

formal.mt: Il-kuntrattur iċċanga l-mogħdija bil-ġebel biex ir-residenti jkunu jistgħu jużawha aktar faċilment.
formal.en: The contractor paved the path with stone so that residents could use it more easily.
formal.zh: 承包商用石块铺砌了小径，方便居民通行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min iċċanga l-bitħa? Mark: Bennej li nafu; uża ġebel ċatt biex inkunu nistgħu nimxu aħjar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who paved the courtyard? Mark: A builder we know; he used flat stones so we could walk more easily.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：是谁铺的院子？马克：我们认识的一位建筑工人；他用了平整的石块，让我们走起来更方便。

messages.speaker: Sara (住户)
messages.zh: 是谁铺的院子？
messages.en: Who paved the courtyard?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Bennej li nafu; uża ġebel ċatt biex inkunu nistgħu nimxu aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Bennej li nafu; uża ġebel ċatt biex inkunu nistgħu nimxu aħjar.
messages.zh: 我们认识的一位建筑工人；他用了平整的石块，让我们走起来更方便。
messages.en: A builder we know; he used flat stones so we could walk more easily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 iċċanga 时想象工人把石块一块块铺满院子：动作是“铺砌”，后面接道路或院子，再用 bil-ġebel 表示“用石块”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A description of someone as very calm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某人非常平静、十分镇定的描述。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Deskrizzjoni ta' xi ħadd li jkun kalm ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常平静；十分镇定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Deskrizzjoni ta' persuna li tkun kalma ħafna u ma turi ebda aġitazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone described in this way is very calm and shows little agitation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常平静；十分镇定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Deskrizzjoni li tindika li xi ħadd ikun kalm ħafna u ma jidhirx aġitat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This describes someone who remains very calm without showing signs of agitation.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-kelma 'iċċassat' tingħata t-tifsira 'kalm ħafna'; l-istudenti għandhom jorbtuha ma' sitwazzjoni ta' kalma.
formal.en: In this exercise, the word 'iċċassat' is given the meaning 'very calm'; students should associate it with a situation involving calmness.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，“iċċassat”的给定含义是“非常平静”；学生应把它与平静的情境联系起来。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser 'iċċassat' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Pawlu: Hawn tfisser 'kalm ħafna'. Aħseb f'xi ħadd li jibqa' kalm waqt li l-oħrajn jinkwetaw.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does 'iċċassat' mean in this exercise? Pawlu: Here it means 'very calm'. Think of someone who stays calm while others worry.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这道练习里的“iċċassat”是什么意思？保罗：这里是“非常平静”的意思。想象别人都在担心时，一个人仍然很镇定。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 这道练习里的“iċċassat”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'iċċassat' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser 'kalm ħafna'. Aħseb f'xi ħadd li jibqa' kalm waqt li l-oħrajn jinkwetaw.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser 'kalm ħafna'. Aħseb f'xi ħadd li jibqa' kalm waqt li l-oħrajn jinkwetaw.
messages.zh: 这里是“非常平静”的意思。想象别人都在担心时，一个人仍然很镇定。
messages.en: Here it means 'very calm'. Think of someone who stays calm while others worry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词条给定释义记忆：把 iċċassat 写在一张“非常镇定”的人物卡片上，想象周围人着急而他神情平静；不要据此猜测词根。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To examine something to find out whether it is correct or in a satisfactory condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 查看或核对某事物，确认其是否正确或状态是否正常。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jeżamina xi ħaġa biex jara jekk hijiex korretta jew f'kundizzjoni tajba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 检查或核对，以确认内容正确、情况属实或状态正常。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iħares lejn xi ħaġa jew jeżaminaha biex jikkonferma li hija korretta, vera jew f'kundizzjoni xierqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you check something, you examine it to make sure it is correct or satisfactory.

formal.mt: Qabel bagħat ir-rapport, l-impjegat iċċekkja d-dati u ċ-ċifri kollha biex jiżgura li kienu korretti.
formal.en: Before sending the report, the employee checked all the dates and figures to ensure that they were correct.
formal.zh: 发送报告前，员工核对了所有日期和数字，确保内容准确。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi ħadd iċċekkja l-ħin tal-ferrovija? David: Iva, jien. Titlaq fid-disgħa, allura għandna ftit ħin.
colloquial.en: Anna: Has anyone checked the train time? David: Yes, I have. It leaves at nine, so we have a little time.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：有人查过火车的发车时间吗？戴维：有，我查过。九点发车，所以我们还有一点时间。

messages.speaker: Anna (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 有人查过火车的发车时间吗？
messages.en: Has anyone checked the train time?

messages.speaker: David (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien. Titlaq fid-disgħa, allura għandna ftit ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien. Titlaq fid-disgħa, allura għandna ftit ħin.
messages.zh: 有，我查过。九点发车，所以我们还有一点时间。
messages.en: Yes, I have. It leaves at nine, so we have a little time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iċċekkja 与“逐项检查后打勾”的动作绑定：核对日期、查看时刻、检查刹车，都围绕“确认是否正确或正常”这一核心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To mark a happy event or an important occasion with special activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过聚会、仪式或其他特别活动，庆祝喜事或重要时刻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ifakkar ġrajja sabiħa jew okkażjoni importanti b'festa, ċerimonja jew attivitajiet speċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以特别活动庆祝喜事、成就或重要日子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel festa jew jieħu sehem f'attivitajiet speċjali biex ifakkar ġrajja sabiħa jew okkażjoni importanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone celebrates an occasion, they mark it by doing something special or enjoyable.

formal.mt: Il-klabb iċċelebera l-ħamsin anniversarju tiegħu b'ċerimonja għall-membri u l-familji tagħhom.
formal.en: The club celebrated its fiftieth anniversary with a ceremony for its members and their families.
formal.zh: 该俱乐部举行仪式，与会员及其家属共同庆祝成立五十周年。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif iċċelebera għeluq sninu Pawlu? Lara: Mar jiekol mal-ħbieb u mbagħad qasmu kejk.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Pawlu celebrate his birthday? Lara: He went out to eat with friends, and then they shared a cake.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗是怎么庆祝生日的？拉拉：他和朋友出去吃饭，然后大家一起分了蛋糕。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗是怎么庆祝生日的？
messages.en: How did Pawlu celebrate his birthday?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mar jiekol mal-ħbieb u mbagħad qasmu kejk.
messages.mt_standard: Mar jiekol mal-ħbieb u mbagħad qasmu kejk.
messages.zh: 他和朋友出去吃饭，然后大家一起分了蛋糕。
messages.en: He went out to eat with friends, and then they shared a cake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和生日蛋糕、朋友聚餐的画面一起记：看到 iċċelebera，就想到为喜事举行庆祝活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express happiness about a special event by holding or joining a celebration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过举办或参加庆祝活动，表达对特别事件、喜事或成就的喜悦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri l-ferħ tiegħu għal ġrajja speċjali jew suċċess billi jagħmel festa jew jieħu sehem f'ċelebrazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为喜事、成就或重要日子举办或参加庆祝活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ifakkar okkażjoni importanti jew jifraħ għal suċċess permezz ta' festa, laqgħa jew attività speċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you celebrate an event or achievement, you do something special to show your happiness about it.

formal.mt: Ir-raħal iċċelebra l-ftuħ tal-librerija l-ġdida b'ġurnata ta' qari u attivitajiet għat-tfal.
formal.en: The village celebrated the opening of the new library with a day of reading and activities for children.
formal.zh: 村里举办了一整天的阅读和儿童活动，庆祝新图书馆开放。

colloquial.mt: Mark: It-tim iċċelebra r-rebħa lbieraħ? Nina: Iva, il-plejers kollha marru jieklu flimkien wara l-logħba.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did the team celebrate the victory yesterday? Nina: Yes, all the players went out to eat together after the match.
colloquial.zh: 马克：球队昨天庆祝胜利了吗？妮娜：庆祝了，比赛后所有球员都一起出去吃饭。

messages.speaker: Mark (球迷)
messages.zh: 球队昨天庆祝胜利了吗？
messages.en: Did the team celebrate the victory yesterday?

messages.speaker: Nina (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-plejers kollha marru jieklu flimkien wara l-logħba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-plejers kollha marru jieklu flimkien wara l-logħba.
messages.zh: 庆祝了，比赛后所有球员都一起出去吃饭。
messages.en: Yes, all the players went out to eat together after the match.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“赢球后全队聚餐庆祝”来记 iċċelebra；把它与 r-rebħa（胜利）成组朗读，记住庆祝某件喜事的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express strong disapproval of someone or something, or to examine material and remove or restrict parts of it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可表示对某人或某事作出严厉批评或谴责，也可表示审查材料并删去或限制其中的内容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jesprimi diżapprovazzjoni qawwija lejn persuna jew għemil, jew jeżamina materjal u jneħħi jew jillimita partijiet minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某人或其行为表示强烈不满，予以严厉批评或正式谴责。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jesprimi diżapprovazzjoni qawwija jew kundanna, spiss b'mod formali, lejn persuna jew l-għemil tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an authority censures someone, it formally expresses strong disapproval of that person's actions.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 审查文章、影片或其他材料，并删去、屏蔽或禁止其中被认为不宜传播的内容。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jeżamina kitba, film jew materjal ieħor u jneħħi jew jipprojbixxi partijiet meqjusa mhux xierqa għall-pubblikazzjoni jew għall-wiri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone censors material, they examine it and remove or prohibit content they consider unacceptable.

collocations.zh: 审查并删禁了影片中的部分内容

formal.mt: Il-kumitat iċċensura lill-uffiċjal talli uża kliem offensiv waqt il-laqgħa u talab apoloġija bil-miktub.
formal.en: The committee censured the official for using offensive language during the meeting and requested a written apology.
formal.zh: 委员会谴责该官员在会议期间使用冒犯性言辞，并要求其书面道歉。
