colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex hemm xena nieqsa mill-film? David: Iċ-ċensur iċċensura dik il-parti u talab li titneħħa qabel il-wiri.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is there a scene missing from the film? David: The censor censored that part and asked for it to be removed before the screening.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么这部电影少了一个场景？戴维：审查员审查后禁了那一段，要求在放映前删去。

messages.speaker: Sara (观众)
messages.zh: 为什么这部电影少了一个场景？
messages.en: Why is there a scene missing from the film?

messages.speaker: David (影院工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iċ-ċensur iċċensura dik il-parti u talab li titneħħa qabel il-wiri.
messages.mt_standard: Iċ-ċensur iċċensura dik il-parti u talab li titneħħa qabel il-wiri.
messages.zh: 审查员审查后禁了那一段，要求在放映前删去。
messages.en: The censor censored that part and asked for it to be removed before the screening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两幅图来区分义项：委员会批评官员对应“谴责”，审查员删去电影片段对应“审查删禁”；遇到 iċċensura，要结合对象和上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have an informal conversation with someone over the internet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过互联网与别人轻松交谈或交换即时消息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitkellem b'mod informali ma' xi ħadd permezz tal-internet jew jiskambja messaġġi miegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过互联网与他人聊天，进行非正式交谈或即时消息交流。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikollu konverżazzjoni informali ma' persuna oħra fuq l-internet, pereżempju billi jiskambja messaġġi magħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When people chat online, they use the internet to have an informal conversation with each other.

formal.mt: Wara l-lezzjoni, l-istudent iċċettja ma' sħabu fuq il-pjattaforma tal-kors biex jaqsam ideat dwar il-proġett.
formal.en: After the lesson, the student chatted online with his classmates on the course platform to share ideas about the project.
formal.zh: 下课后，这名学生在课程平台上与同学聊天，交流有关项目的想法。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ma' min iċċettja Mark ilbieraħ filgħaxija? Pawlu: Ma' ħabib li jgħix barra; damu siegħa jibagħtu messaġġi lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who did Mark chat with online yesterday evening? Pawlu: With a friend who lives abroad; they spent an hour messaging each other.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克昨晚和谁在网上聊天？保罗：和一位住在国外的朋友，他们互发消息聊了一个小时。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' min iċċettja Mark ilbieraħ filgħaxija?
messages.mt_standard: Ma' min iċċettja Mark ilbieraħ filgħaxija?
messages.zh: 马克昨晚和谁在网上聊天？
messages.en: Who did Mark chat with online yesterday evening?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' ħabib li jgħix barra; damu siegħa jibagħtu messaġġi lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Ma' ħabib li jgħix barra; damu siegħa jibagħtu messaġġi lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 和一位住在国外的朋友，他们互发消息聊了一个小时。
messages.en: With a friend who lives abroad; they spent an hour messaging each other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手机聊天窗口里消息一来一回，把 iċċettja 和“网上聊天”绑定；再连同 mal-ħbieb（和朋友们）一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be or form a boundary around someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于某人或某物四周，或在其周围形成包围。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun jew jifforma madwar persuna jew ħaġa, b'mod li jdawwarha minn kull naħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 包围；围住；处于某人或某物的四周。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikun madwar persuna, post jew ħaġa, jew jifforma ċirku jew konfini madwarhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something surrounds a person or place, it is situated all around them.

formal.mt: Ħajt għoli jiċċirkonda l-ġnien u jipproteġi l-pjanti mir-riħ.
formal.en: A high wall surrounds the garden and protects the plants from the wind.
formal.zh: 一道高墙环绕着花园，保护植物免受风吹。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nistgħu nidħlu fil-ġnien minn hawn? — Mark: Le, il-ħajt jiċċirkonda l-ġnien kollu. Il-bieb qiegħed fuq in-naħa l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can we enter the garden from here? — Mark: No, the wall surrounds the whole garden. The gate is on the other side.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们能从这里进花园吗？——马克：不能，围墙围住了整个花园。大门在另一边。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们能从这里进花园吗？
messages.en: Can we enter the garden from here?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-ħajt jiċċirkonda l-ġnien kollu. Il-bieb qiegħed fuq in-naħa l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-ħajt jiċċirkonda l-ġnien kollu. Il-bieb qiegħed fuq in-naħa l-oħra.
messages.zh: 不能，围墙围住了整个花园。大门在另一边。
messages.en: No, the wall surrounds the whole garden. The gate is on the other side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象花园四周都有围墙，把 iċċirkonda 与“从四面围住”的画面一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move around or pass between people or places, or to cause something to do so.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在不同地点或人之间流动、传播，也指使某物流通或供人传阅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċċaqlaq minn post għal ieħor jew jgħaddi bejn in-nies, jew iqiegħed xi ħaġa f'dan il-moviment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流通；循环流动；在人群中传播或传阅；使流通。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jgħaddi minn persuna għal oħra jew minn post għal ieħor, jew iġiegħel xi ħaġa tgħaddi b'dan il-mod.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When something circulates, it moves around or passes between people, and someone can also cause it to do this.

formal.mt: L-uffiċċju se jiċċirkula d-dokument fost il-membri kollha qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The office will circulate the document among all members before the meeting.
formal.zh: 办公室将在会议前把文件发给全体成员传阅。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Niftaħ it-tieqa? Hawn ħafna sħana. — Pawlu: Iva, hekk l-arja tkun tista' tiċċirkula aħjar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Shall I open the window? It's very hot in here. — Pawlu: Yes, that will let the air circulate better.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我把窗户打开好吗？这里很热。——保罗：好，这样空气就能更好地流通。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 我把窗户打开好吗？这里很热。
messages.en: Shall I open the window? It's very hot in here.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk l-arja tkun tista' tiċċirkula aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk l-arja tkun tista' tiċċirkula aħjar.
messages.zh: 好，这样空气就能更好地流通。
messages.en: Yes, that will let the air circulate better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把文件在人与人之间传阅、空气在房间里流动并列想象，记住 iċċirkula 的“流通”核心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To refer to a source as support or to repeat someone's words.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提及资料来源以提供依据，或引用他人说过、写过的话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isemmi sors biex isostni stqarrija jew jirrepeti kliem li qal jew kiteb ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引证；援引资料来源、事例等，作为论述的依据。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isemmi sors, studju jew eżempju bħala prova jew bħala appoġġ għal dak li jgħid jew jikteb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you cite a source or example, you mention it to support what you are saying.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引用；引述他人说过或写过的原话。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jirrepeti l-kliem eżatt li persuna oħra tkun qalet jew kitbet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you quote someone, you repeat the exact words that they have spoken or written.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tagħha, ir-riċerkatriċi tiċċita żewġ studji biex issostni l-konklużjoni tagħha.
formal.en: In her report, the researcher cites two studies to support her conclusion.
formal.zh: 研究人员在报告中引证了两项研究，以支持自己的结论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi niċċita l-kliem eżatt tal-awtur? — David: Iva, u semmi wkoll is-sors biex inkunu nafu minn fejn ġie.
colloquial.en: Maja: Should I quote the author's exact words? — David: Yes, and mention the source too so we know where they came from.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我应该引用作者的原话吗？——戴维：应该，也要注明来源，这样我们才知道这些话出自哪里。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 我应该引用作者的原话吗？
messages.en: Should I quote the author's exact words?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u semmi wkoll is-sors biex inkunu nafu minn fejn ġie.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u semmi wkoll is-sors biex inkunu nafu minn fejn ġie.
messages.zh: 应该，也要注明来源，这样我们才知道这些话出自哪里。
messages.en: Yes, and mention the source too so we know where they came from.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张学习卡区分：提到研究作为依据是“引证”，照录作者原话是“引述”，两者都可对应 iċċita。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Large natural elevations of the land, considered as more than one mountain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 多座高出周围地面的天然山体，表示复数的山。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għoljiet naturali kbar u għoljin ħafna, jiġifieri aktar minn muntanja waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 山的复数；多座山或群山。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mases naturali kbar ta' art u blat li jitilgħu ħafna 'l fuq mill-art ta' madwarhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mountains are very high natural areas of land that rise above the surrounding countryside.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-iġbla għoljin u l-widien fondi li jiffurmaw il-pajsaġġ tar-reġjun.
formal.en: The report describes the high mountains and deep valleys that make up the region's landscape.
formal.zh: 报告描述了构成该地区地貌的高山与深谷。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara dawk l-iġbla! Kemm huma għoljin! Samwel: Iva, ejja nieqfu hawn u nieħdu ritratt tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at those mountains! They're so high! Samwel: Yes, let's stop here and take a photo of them.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看那些山！真高啊！塞缪尔：是啊，我们在这里停一下，给它们拍张照吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (旅行同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dawk l-iġbla! Kemm huma għoljin!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dawk l-iġbla! Kemm huma għoljin!
messages.zh: 看那些山！真高啊！
messages.en: Look at those mountains! They're so high!

messages.speaker: Samwel (旅行同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nieqfu hawn u nieħdu ritratt tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nieqfu hawn u nieħdu ritratt tagħhom.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们在这里停一下，给它们拍张照吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's stop here and take a photo of them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 iġbla 时画出连续几座山峰，并在旁边写“群山”：用多座山的画面牢牢记住复数意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression saying that he compels her to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示他强迫或迫使她做某事的表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tfisser li hu jġiegħel lilha tagħmel xi ħaġa, anki jekk hi ma tkunx trid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他强迫她；他使她不得不做某事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li raġel juża pressjoni jew setgħa biex mara tagħmel xi ħaġa kontra r-rieda tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If he forces her to do something, he makes her do it even though she does not want to.

formal.mt: Skont l-ilment, il-maniġer iġegħelha taħdem sigħat żejda kontra r-rieda tagħha.
formal.en: According to the complaint, the manager forces her to work extra hours against her will.
formal.zh: 根据投诉，经理违背她的意愿，强迫她加班。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Sara għadha fl-uffiċċju? Lara: Il-maniġer iġegħelha tibqa', għalkemm hi trid tmur id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Sara still at the office? Lara: The manager forces her to stay, although she wants to go home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：萨拉怎么还在办公室？拉拉：经理强迫她留下，尽管她想回家。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 萨拉怎么还在办公室？
messages.en: Why is Sara still at the office?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-maniġer iġegħelha tibqa', għalkemm hi trid tmur id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Il-maniġer iġegħelha tibqa', għalkemm hi trid tmur id-dar.
messages.zh: 经理强迫她留下，尽管她想回家。
messages.en: The manager forces her to stay, although she wants to go home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iġegħelha 整体配上“他→强迫→她”的箭头图，再接“工作”或“留下”，记清施力者和承受者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A toilet or room where people go to relieve themselves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人大小便使用的厕所或卫生间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post jew kamra fejn persuna tmur biex tagħmel il-bżonnijiet tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供人大小便使用的厕所或卫生间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post jew kamra mgħammra biex in-nies ikunu jistgħu jagħmlu l-bżonnijiet tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A toilet is a place where people go to relieve themselves.

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi huma mitluba jħallu l-iġenika nadifa wara l-użu.
formal.en: Visitors are requested to leave the toilet clean after use.
formal.zh: 请访客在使用后保持厕所清洁。

colloquial.mt: Mei: Skużi, fejn hi l-iġenika? Rita: Fl-aħħar tal-kuritur, fuq ix-xellug.
colloquial.en: Mei: Excuse me, where is the toilet? Rita: At the end of the corridor, on the left.
colloquial.zh: 美：不好意思，厕所在哪里？丽塔：在走廊尽头，左手边。

messages.speaker: Mei (访客)
messages.zh: 不好意思，厕所在哪里？
messages.en: Excuse me, where is the toilet?

messages.speaker: Rita (接待员)
messages.zh: 在走廊尽头，左手边。
messages.en: At the end of the corridor, on the left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iġenika 与“走廊尽头的厕所”画面绑定，再整句练习 Fejn hi l-iġenika?，记住询问厕所位置的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To negotiate over a price in an attempt to obtain a better deal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为争取更有利的价格而与对方反复商议，即讨价还价。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tinnegozja ma' xi ħadd dwar il-prezz biex tipprova tikseb prezz aktar favorevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 就价格与对方讨价还价，试图争取更有利的成交条件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiddiskuti l-prezz ma' bejjiegħ jew xerrej u tibqa' tinnegozja biex tasal għal ftehim aktar favorevoli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you haggle, you negotiate over a price to try to obtain a better deal.

formal.mt: Ix-xerrej iġġebbed mal-bejjiegħ fuq il-prezz tal-mejda sakemm qablu fuq mitt ewro.
formal.en: The buyer haggled with the seller over the price of the table until they agreed on one hundred euros.
formal.zh: 买家就桌子的价格与卖家讨价还价，直到双方同意以一百欧元成交。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Iġġebbidt mal-bejjiegħ fuq il-prezz? Lara: Iva, u fl-aħħar aċċetta tletin ewro.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did you haggle with the seller over the price? Lara: Yes, and in the end he accepted thirty euros.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你跟卖家讲价了吗？拉拉：讲了，他最后接受了三十欧元。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你跟卖家讲价了吗？
messages.en: Did you haggle with the seller over the price?

messages.speaker: Lara (购物者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u fl-aħħar aċċetta tletin ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u fl-aħħar aċċetta tletin ewro.
messages.zh: 讲了，他最后接受了三十欧元。
messages.en: Yes, and in the end he accepted thirty euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象买卖双方围着价格来回商量，把 iġġebbed 记成“讲价”；搭配 fuq il-prezz 一起记，明确商议的是价格。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce something or cause something to come into existence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生某种事物，或使原本没有的事物形成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tipproduċi xi ħaġa jew tikkawża li tinħoloq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产生、生成或引起某种结果，如电力、信息或兴趣。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tipproduċi xi ħaġa, bħall-elettriku jew l-informazzjoni, jew tikkawża riżultat bħall-interess.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something generates a result, it produces that result or causes it to arise.

formal.mt: Is-sistema tuża l-enerġija tax-xemx biex tiġġenera l-elettriku għall-bini.
formal.en: The system uses solar energy to generate electricity for the building.
formal.zh: 该系统利用太阳能为这栋建筑发电。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-filmat tiegħek iġġenera ħafna interess! Sam: Iva, ħafna nies bagħtuli mistoqsijiet dwaru.
colloquial.en: Nina: Your video generated a lot of interest! Sam: Yes, lots of people sent me questions about it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你的视频引起了很大的兴趣！萨姆：是啊，很多人发消息来问我相关问题。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的视频引起了很大的兴趣！
messages.en: Your video generated a lot of interest!

messages.speaker: Sam (视频创作者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħafna nies bagħtuli mistoqsijiet dwaru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħafna nies bagħtuli mistoqsijiet dwaru.
messages.zh: 是啊，很多人发消息来问我相关问题。
messages.en: Yes, lots of people sent me questions about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“太阳能产生电力、视频引起兴趣”两幅画面记 iġġenera：既能产生具体事物，也能引起抽象结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move around an area without a fixed route, sometimes quietly while looking for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有固定路线地四处走动；也可指为寻找某物而悄悄游荡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Timxi minn post għal ieħor mingħajr rotta fissa, xi drabi bil-kwiet waqt li tkun qed tfittex xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为寻找某物或机会而悄悄地四处游荡、潜行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiċċaqlaq bil-kwiet minn post għal ieħor f'żona waqt li tfittex xi ħaġa jew opportunità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a person or animal prowls, they move quietly around an area while looking for something.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 没有明确目的地或固定路线地漫游、闲逛。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Timxi minn post għal ieħor mingħajr destinazzjoni ċara jew rotta ppjanata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you wander, you move from place to place without a fixed route or clear destination.

collocations.en: to prowl quietly around the house

formal.mt: Il-gwardjan osserva raġel jiġġerra bil-kwiet madwar il-maħżen magħluq u jħares mit-twieqi.
formal.en: The guard observed a man prowling quietly around the closed warehouse and looking through the windows.
formal.zh: 警卫看到一名男子在已关闭的仓库周围悄悄游荡，并透过窗户向内张望。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamilt wara l-ikla? Ben: Qgħadt niġġerra fit-toroq tal-belt, bla destinazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did you do after lunch? Ben: I spent some time wandering through the city streets without a destination.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：午饭后你做了什么？本：我在城里的街道上随意逛了一阵，没有特别的目的地。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 午饭后你做了什么？
messages.en: What did you do after lunch?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qgħadt niġġerra fit-toroq tal-belt, bla destinazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Qgħadt niġġerra fit-toroq tal-belt, bla destinazzjoni.
messages.zh: 我在城里的街道上随意逛了一阵，没有特别的目的地。
messages.en: I spent some time wandering through the city streets without a destination.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iġġerra 配上两幅走动画面：悄悄寻找东西时是“潜行游荡”，没有目的地时是“闲逛”；用上下文区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave means to act in a particular way, especially towards other people or in a social situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以某种方式行事或表现，尤其指在与人相处或社会场合中的举止。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaġixxi b'ċertu mod, speċjalment ma' nies oħra jew f'sitwazzjoni soċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表现；以某种方式行事，或在他人面前表现出某种举止。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jaġixxi jew iġib ruħu b'mod partikolari f'sitwazzjoni jew fir-relazzjonijiet tiegħu ma' nies oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone behaves in a particular way, they act in that way towards other people or in a particular situation.

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara fil-mużew, l-istudent ġab ruħu b'rispett lejn il-gwida u l-viżitaturi l-oħra.
formal.en: During the museum visit, the student behaved respectfully towards the guide and the other visitors.
formal.zh: 参观博物馆期间，这名学生对导览员和其他参观者都表现得很有礼貌。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif ġab ruħu Leo fil-festa? Mark: Ġab ruħu tajjeb ħafna u għen ukoll biex inaddfu.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did Leo behave at the party? Mark: He behaved very well and also helped with the cleaning.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：利奥在聚会上表现怎么样？马克：他表现得很好，还帮忙打扫了。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 利奥在聚会上表现怎么样？
messages.en: How did Leo behave at the party?

messages.speaker: Mark (聚会主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġab ruħu tajjeb ħafna u għen ukoll biex inaddfu.
messages.mt_standard: Ġab ruħu tajjeb ħafna u għen ukoll biex inaddfu.
messages.zh: 他表现得很好，还帮忙打扫了。
messages.en: He behaved very well and also helped with the cleaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġab ruħu 作为整体记成“他当时表现如何”：接 tajjeb 是表现好，接 ħażin 是表现差，用同一场景对比记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An ashtray is a small container for ash and cigarette ends.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来盛放烟灰和烟蒂的小容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent żgħir li jintuża biex jitqiegħdu fih l-irmied u l-fdalijiet tas-sigaretti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烟灰缸；用来盛放烟灰和烟蒂的容器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reċipjent li fih persuna tqiegħed l-irmied tas-sigaretti u l-fdalijiet tagħhom waqt jew wara t-tipjip.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An ashtray is a small container in which people put cigarette ash and cigarette ends.

formal.mt: Il-persunal għandu jbattal il-ġabbar l-irmied u jnaddfu kuljum.
formal.en: Staff must empty the ashtray and clean it every day.
formal.zh: 工作人员必须每天倒空并清洗烟灰缸。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn inpoġġi l-ġabbar l-irmied? Pawlu: Ħallih fuq il-mejda ta' barra, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where should I put the ashtray? Pawlu: Leave it on the outdoor table, please.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：烟灰缸放在哪里？保罗：请把它放在外面的桌子上。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 烟灰缸放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put the ashtray?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallih fuq il-mejda ta' barra, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallih fuq il-mejda ta' barra, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请把它放在外面的桌子上。
messages.en: Leave it on the outdoor table, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġabbar l-irmied 整体配上一只盛着烟灰和烟蒂的小缸来记，再用“倒空烟灰缸”的动作巩固意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A database is an organized collection of information that can be stored, searched, and updated electronically.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按一定结构组织、可通过电子方式存储、查询和更新的信息集合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġabra organizzata ta' informazzjoni li tinħażen elettronikament u li tista' titfittex u tiġi aġġornata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 数据库；以有组织的方式存储、便于查询和更新的电子信息集合。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' data maħżuna u organizzata f'sistema elettronika sabiex l-informazzjoni tkun tista' tinstab, tintuża u tiġi aġġornata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A database is an organized collection of information held electronically so that people or programs can find and update it.

formal.mt: L-impjegati għandhom jaġġornaw il-ġabradata tal-klijenti meta jinbidlu d-dettalji ta' kuntatt tagħhom.
formal.en: Employees must update the customer database when customers' contact details change.
formal.zh: 客户的联系方式发生变化时，员工必须更新客户数据库。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn insib in-numru tat-telefon tal-klijent? David: Fittex fil-ġabradata. Aġġornajtha dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where can I find the customer's phone number? David: Look in the database. I updated it this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：在哪里能找到客户的电话号码？戴维：查一下数据库。我今天早上更新过了。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 在哪里能找到客户的电话号码？
messages.en: Where can I find the customer's phone number?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.zh: 查一下数据库。我今天早上更新过了。
messages.en: Look in the database. I updated it this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġabradata 想成电脑里排列整齐的资料柜：需要电话号码就查询，资料改变就更新，用这两个动作记住“数据库”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who forces someone else to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 迫使别人做某事的人，尤其指不顾对方意愿而施加强制的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġiegħel lil ħaddieħor jagħmel xi ħaġa kontra r-rieda tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: one who compels s.o. to do s.th.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 迫使他人做某事的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġiegħel lil persuna oħra tagħmel xi ħaġa, anki jekk din ma tkunx trid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ġagħiel is someone who makes another person do something against their will.

collocations.en: a merciless person who forces others to act
collocations.zh: 毫不留情地强迫他人的人

collocations.en: to resist the person forcing one to act
collocations.zh: 反抗强迫自己做事的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ġagħiel juża t-theddid biex iġiegħel lir-raħħala jaħdmu għalih.
formal.en: In the story, the coercer uses threats to force the villagers to work for him.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个强迫他人的人用威胁迫使村民为他干活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tridx taħdem miegħu? Toni: Għax hu ġagħiel; dejjem iġegħelni nagħmel affarijiet li ma rridx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you want to work with him? Toni: Because he forces people to do things; he's always making me do things I don't want to do.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么不想和他一起工作？Toni：因为他爱强迫别人，总逼我做不想做的事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不想和他一起工作？
messages.en: Why don't you want to work with him?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu ġagħiel; dejjem iġegħelni nagħmel affarijiet li ma rridx.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu ġagħiel; dejjem iġegħelni nagħmel affarijiet li ma rridx.
messages.zh: 因为他爱强迫别人，总逼我做不想做的事。
messages.en: Because he forces people to do things; he's always making me do things I don't want to do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġagħiel 配上一个逼别人干活的人物画面，重点记住它指施加强迫的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wild animal of the dog family that hunts small animals and also eats carrion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种犬科野生动物，会捕食小动物，也会吃动物尸体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal selvaġġ mill-familja tal-klieb li jikkaċċa annimali żgħar u jiekol ukoll il-fdalijiet ta' annimali mejta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胡狼，犬科野生动物，既捕食小动物，也食用腐肉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal selvaġġ li jagħmel parti mill-familja tal-klieb u li jiekol annimali żgħar kif ukoll laħam ta' annimali mejta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A jackal is a wild member of the dog family that eats small animals and carrion.

formal.mt: Id-dokumentarju juri ġakall ifittex l-ikel qrib ix-xmara.
formal.en: The documentary shows a jackal looking for food near the river.
formal.zh: 这部纪录片展示了一只胡狼在河边觅食的情景。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dak kelb fir-ritratt? Mark: Le, dak ġakall. Ħadt ir-ritratt waqt is-safari.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is that a dog in the photo? Mark: No, that's a jackal. I took the photo during the safari.
colloquial.zh: Sara：照片里那是狗吗？Mark：不是，那是胡狼。我参加野生动物观赏之旅时拍的。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 照片里那是狗吗？
messages.en: Is that a dog in the photo?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dak ġakall. Ħadt ir-ritratt waqt is-safari.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dak ġakall. Ħadt ir-ritratt waqt is-safari.
messages.zh: 不是，那是胡狼。我参加野生动物观赏之旅时拍的。
messages.en: No, that's a jackal. I took the photo during the safari.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġakall 和英语 jackal 配对朗读，再联想野外觅食的胡狼画面；这只是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An outer garment with sleeves that covers the upper body and usually opens at the front.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿在上身的有袖外衣，通常前面开襟，一般指夹克或短外套。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilbies ta' barra bil-kmiem li jgħatti l-parti ta' fuq tal-ġisem u li normalment jinfetaħ minn quddiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夹克或短外套，指穿在上身、通常前面开襟的有袖外衣。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa lbies bil-kmiem li tintlibes fuq ħwejjeġ oħra biex tgħatti l-parti ta' fuq tal-ġisem, u li ġeneralment tinfetaħ minn quddiem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A jacket is an outer piece of clothing with sleeves, usually worn over other clothes on the upper body.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom iġibu ġakketta sħuna, għax parti miż-żjara se ssir barra.
formal.en: Participants should bring a warm jacket because part of the visit will take place outdoors.
formal.zh: 参加者应带一件保暖外套，因为部分参观活动将在室外进行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se nieħu ġakketta miegħi? Omm: Iva, ħudha. Illejla se jkun il-bard.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall I take a jacket with me? Mum: Yes, take it. It's going to be cold tonight.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我要带件外套吗？妈妈：要，带上吧。今晚会冷。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 我要带件外套吗？
messages.en: Shall I take a jacket with me?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħudha. Illejla se jkun il-bard.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħudha. Illejla se jkun il-bard.
messages.zh: 要，带上吧。今晚会冷。
messages.en: Yes, take it. It's going to be cold tonight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 ġakketta 就想象出门前拿起夹克，并用 jilbes ġakketta 记住“穿外套”的搭配。

gloss_zh: 高可视性外套；醒目安全外套

teaching_sense.en_definition: A brightly coloured safety jacket designed to make its wearer easy to see, often with reflective material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为使穿着者容易被看见而设计的鲜艳安全外套，通常带有反光材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġakketta tas-sigurtà b'kulur jgħajjat, spiss b'materjal li jirrifletti d-dawl, magħmula biex min jilbisha jidher faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 高可视性安全外套，通过鲜艳颜色以及通常配有的反光材料，使穿着者更容易被看见。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġakketta b'kuluri li jidhru sew u ħafna drabi b'materjal riflettiv, li tintlibes biex persuna tkun aktar viżibbli għall-oħrajn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A high-visibility jacket is a safety garment that uses bright colours and often reflective material to make the wearer easier to see.

collocations.mt: ġakketta ta' viżibilità għolja bi strixxi riflettivi
collocations.en: a high-visibility jacket with reflective strips
collocations.zh: 带反光条的高可视性外套

formal.mt: Skont l-istruzzjonijiet tas-sit, kull viżitatur għandu jilbes ġakketta ta' viżibilità għolja qabel jidħol fiż-żona tax-xogħol.
formal.en: According to the site instructions, every visitor must wear a high-visibility jacket before entering the work area.
formal.zh: 根据现场说明，每位访客进入作业区域前都必须穿上高可视性安全外套。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' nidħol issa? Rita: L-ewwel ilbes din il-ġakketta ta' viżibilità għolja, biex is-sewwieqa jarawk sew.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can I go in now? Rita: First put on this high-visibility jacket so the drivers can see you clearly.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我现在可以进去了吗？Rita：先穿上这件高可视性安全外套，让司机能清楚地看见你。

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.zh: 我现在可以进去了吗？
messages.en: Can I go in now?

messages.speaker: Rita (现场工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel ilbes din il-ġakketta ta' viżibilità għolja, biex is-sewwieqa jarawk sew.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel ilbes din il-ġakketta ta' viżibilità għolja, biex is-sewwieqa jarawk sew.
messages.zh: 先穿上这件高可视性安全外套，让司机能清楚地看见你。
messages.en: First put on this high-visibility jacket so the drivers can see you clearly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分组记忆：ġakketta 是外套，viżibilità 是可视性，għolja 表示高；联想让司机一眼看见的鲜艳安全外套。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Short devotional prayers that can be said briefly during daily activities or communal worship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可在日常生活或集体祈祷中简短念诵的祷词；此词表示复数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Talbiet qosra li jingħadu fil-ħajja ta' kuljum jew waqt it-talb flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 简短的虔敬祷词，常用于随时表达祈求、赞颂或信赖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Talbiet qosra li bihom wieħed jesprimi talba, tifħir jew fiduċja f'Alla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Gacolateries are brief devotional prayers that people say to express a request, praise, or trust in God.

collocations.en: a collection of short devotional prayers

formal.mt: Il-ktejjeb fih ġabra ta' ġakolatorji għall-użu personali waqt il-jum.
formal.en: The booklet contains a collection of short devotional prayers for personal use during the day.
formal.zh: 这本小册子收录了一组供个人在白天念诵的简短祷词。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Nistgħu ngħidu xi ġakolatorji qabel nibdew? Pawlu: Iva, imbagħad nibdew il-laqgħa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Can we say a few short prayers before we start? Pawlu: Yes, then we can begin the meeting.
colloquial.zh: Marija：开始之前，我们可以念几句简短祷词吗？Pawlu：可以，然后我们就开始聚会。

messages.speaker: Marija (聚会参加者)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu ngħidu xi ġakolatorji qabel nibdew?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu ngħidu xi ġakolatorji qabel nibdew?
messages.zh: 开始之前，我们可以念几句简短祷词吗？
messages.en: Can we say a few short prayers before we start?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (聚会组织者)
messages.zh: 可以，然后我们就开始聚会。
messages.en: Yes, then we can begin the meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġakolatorji 想成祷词卡片上的几句短祈祷，记住它指多条简短祷词，可与 ngħidu 一起练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to introduce a known fact or circumstance that provides the reason for a statement, decision, or action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于引出已知事实或情况，说明某项陈述、决定或行动的理由，相当于“既然”或“鉴于”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża biex tintroduċi fatt jew ċirkustanza li tagħti r-raġuni għal stqarrija, deċiżjoni jew azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 既然；因为，用于引出作为理由的事实，而非表示时间起点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintroduċi fatt li jservi bħala raġuni għal dak li jingħad fil-bqija tas-sentenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this word to introduce a fact that explains why something is true or should happen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 既然；考虑到某个双方已知或显而易见的情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintroduċi sitwazzjoni magħrufa jew ċara li fuqha wieħed jibbaża dak li jgħid jew jiddeċiedi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression when a known or obvious situation gives you a reason for saying or doing something.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鉴于；考虑到，用于说明作出判断或决定所依据的情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Turi li fatt jew ċirkustanza qed jitqiesu bħala bażi għal ġudizzju jew deċiżjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to show that a circumstance has been considered when reaching a judgment or decision.

formal.mt: Ġaladarba d-dokumenti kollha waslu fil-ħin, il-kumitat jista' jibda l-evalwazzjoni.
formal.en: Since all the documents arrived on time, the committee can begin the evaluation.
formal.zh: 鉴于所有文件均已按时送达，委员会可以开始评估。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Illum għandi ftit ħin liberu. Mark: Ġaladarba għandek ħin, trid tiġi timxi miegħi?
colloquial.en: Lara: I've got some free time today. Mark: Seeing as you have time, would you like to go for a walk with me?
colloquial.zh: Lara：我今天有一点空闲时间。Mark：既然你有时间，要不要和我一起去散步？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今天有一点空闲时间。
messages.en: I've got some free time today.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġaladarba għandek ħin, trid tiġi timxi miegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Ġaladarba għandek ħin, trid tiġi timxi miegħi?
messages.zh: 既然你有时间，要不要和我一起去散步？
messages.en: Seeing as you have time, would you like to go for a walk with me?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġaladarba 放在“已知事实→下一步决定”的箭头前，按“既然有这个情况，就这样做”来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who grows plants and looks after a garden, either as a job or for pleasure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 种植植物、照料花园的人，可以是以此为业的园丁，也可以是园艺爱好者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħawwel u tieħu ħsieb il-pjanti u l-ġnien, bħala xogħol jew bħala passatemp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 园丁；负责种植植物和养护花园的人，也可指从事园艺的爱好者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem fil-ġnien billi tħawwel, issaqqi, tiżbor u tagħmel xogħol ieħor għall-kura tal-pjanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A gardener is someone who grows plants and looks after a garden, either professionally or as a hobby.

formal.mt: L-iskola impjegat ġardinar biex jieħu ħsieb is-siġar, il-fjuri u l-ħaxix fil-bitħa.
formal.en: The school employed a gardener to look after the trees, flowers, and grass in the schoolyard.
formal.zh: 学校雇用了一名园丁，负责照料校园里的树木、花卉和草坪。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Taf lil xi ġardinar tajjeb? Joseph: Iva, il-ġardinar tagħna jiġi kull ġimgħa u jieħu ħsieb il-pjanti kollha.
colloquial.en: Rita: Do you know a good gardener? Joseph: Yes, our gardener comes every week and looks after all the plants.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你认识手艺好的园丁吗？Joseph：认识，我们的园丁每周都来，照料所有植物。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.zh: 你认识手艺好的园丁吗？
messages.en: Do you know a good gardener?

messages.speaker: Joseph (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ġardinar tagħna jiġi kull ġimgħa u jieħu ħsieb il-pjanti kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ġardinar tagħna jiġi kull ġimgħa u jieħu ħsieb il-pjanti kollha.
messages.zh: 认识，我们的园丁每周都来，照料所有植物。
messages.en: Yes, our gardener comes every week and looks after all the plants.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġardinar 配上一位手拿浇水壶的人，记成“园丁这个人”；再与表示园艺活动的 ġardinaġġ 成对复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of growing plants and caring for a garden.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 种植花草等植物并照料花园的活动，包括栽种、浇水和修剪等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività tat-tħawwil u t-tkabbir tal-pjanti u tal-kura ta' ġnien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 园艺活动，即种植植物并进行花园养护。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xogħol li jinvolvi t-tħawwil, it-tisqija u l-kura tal-pjanti fi ġnien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Gardening is the activity of growing plants and doing the work needed to care for a garden.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 园艺，指栽培花园植物和维护花园的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attività li biha wieħed ikabbar pjanti u jieħu ħsieb ġnien biex il-pjanti jibqgħu f'kundizzjoni tajba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Gardening involves planting and looking after flowers or other plants, usually as work or a leisure activity.

formal.mt: Il-kors fil-ġardinaġġ jgħallem lill-parteċipanti kif iħawlu, isaqq u jieħdu ħsieb il-pjanti.
formal.en: The gardening course teaches participants how to plant, water, and care for plants.
formal.zh: 这门园艺课程教授参加者如何栽种、浇水和照料植物。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'tagħmel fil-ħin liberu? David: Inħobb il-ġardinaġġ; bħalissa qed inkabbar il-ħabaq fil-qsari.
colloquial.en: Anna: What do you do in your free time? David: I enjoy gardening; at the moment I'm growing basil in pots.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你空闲时做什么？David：我喜欢园艺；最近正在花盆里种罗勒。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你空闲时做什么？
messages.en: What do you do in your free time?

messages.speaker: David (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Inħobb il-ġardinaġġ; bħalissa qed inkabbar il-ħabaq fil-qsari.
messages.mt_standard: Inħobb il-ġardinaġġ; bħalissa qed inkabbar il-ħabaq fil-qsari.
messages.zh: 我喜欢园艺；最近正在花盆里种罗勒。
messages.en: I enjoy gardening; at the moment I'm growing basil in pots.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 ġardinaġġ，就想象栽花、浇水、修剪的一连串活动；用“园艺这件事”与“园丁这个人”作对照记忆。

gloss_zh: 一种名为 White Wall Rocket 的花卉

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flowering plant known in English as White Wall Rocket.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种花卉，英文名称为 White Wall Rocket。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' pjanta tal-fjuri magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala White Wall Rocket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种花卉，英文名为 White Wall Rocket。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-fjuri li bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ White Wall Rocket.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ġarġir is the name of a flowering plant known in English as White Wall Rocket.

collocations.en: the flowers of White Wall Rocket

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt tidher pjanta tal-ġarġir, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala White Wall Rocket.
formal.en: The photograph shows a ġarġir plant, known in English as White Wall Rocket.
formal.zh: 照片中是一株 ġarġir，英文名为 White Wall Rocket。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Lara: Din ġarġir. Bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ White Wall Rocket.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this plant called? Lara: This is ġarġir. In English, it is called White Wall Rocket.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这种植物叫什么？Lara：这是 ġarġir，英文叫 White Wall Rocket。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这种植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant called?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din ġarġir. Bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ White Wall Rocket.
messages.mt_standard: Din ġarġir. Bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ White Wall Rocket.
messages.zh: 这是 ġarġir，英文叫 White Wall Rocket。
messages.en: This is ġarġir. In English, it is called White Wall Rocket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġarġir 写在花卉图片下，再配上 White Wall Rocket；用“看图说花名”的方式记住整个词，不把它拆成词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A jewel or precious stone used or valued as an ornament.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为饰物或因其珍贵而受到重视的珠宝、宝石。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett prezzjuż ta' tiżjin jew ħaġra prezzjuża li tista' tintuża f'ġojjell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 珠宝；珍贵的装饰物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett prezzjuż li jintlibes jew jinżamm bħala tiżjin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A jewel is a valuable object worn or kept as an ornament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宝石；可用于制作珠宝的珍贵石料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaġra prezzjuża li tista' tintuża biex iżżejjen ġojjell.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A precious stone is a valuable stone that can be used in jewellery.

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi ċurkett b'ġawhra żgħira fiċ-ċentru.
formal.en: The catalogue describes a ring with a small gemstone at its centre.
formal.zh: 目录介绍了一枚中央嵌有小宝石的戒指。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara kemm hi sabiħa l-ġawhra f'dan iċ-ċurkett! Mark: Iva, imma nippreferi ġawhra iżgħar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look how beautiful the gemstone in this ring is! Mark: Yes, but I prefer a smaller gemstone.
colloquial.zh: Nina：看，这枚戒指上的宝石多漂亮！Mark：是啊，不过我更喜欢小一点的宝石。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hi sabiħa l-ġawhra f'dan iċ-ċurkett!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hi sabiħa l-ġawhra f'dan iċ-ċurkett!
messages.zh: 看，这枚戒指上的宝石多漂亮！
messages.en: Look how beautiful the gemstone in this ring is!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，不过我更喜欢小一点的宝石。
messages.en: Yes, but I prefer a smaller gemstone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一枚戒指中央闪着宝石，给它贴上 ġawhra 标签；再把“整件珠宝”和“其中的宝石”两个义项并排记忆。

gloss_zh: 过于软弱、温吞或行动迟缓的人；传统上用热牛奶浸湿的面包敷料

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression for someone who is excessively soft, calm, or slow to act; also a traditional bread-and-hot-milk poultice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于称呼过于软弱、温吞或行动迟缓的人的说法；也指传统上用热牛奶浸湿、用于舒缓皮肤不适的面包敷料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma għal persuna ratba żżejjed, kalma żżejjed jew li taġixxi bil-mod wisq; tfisser ukoll biċċa ħobż mgħaddsa f'ħalib sħun, tradizzjonalment użata bħala kataplażma biex ittaffi problemi tal-ġilda.

sense_translations.en_definition: an expression used for sb. who is excessively soft, calm or slow in their actions
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于称呼过于软弱、温吞，或行动过分迟缓的人的说法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża għal xi ħadd li jkun artab żżejjed, kalm żżejjed jew bil-mod wisq f'dak li jagħmel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is described as a ġbara, they are considered excessively soft, calm, or slow in their actions.

sense_translations.en_definition: a piece of bread dipped in hot milk, traditionally used as a poultice to soothe skin ailments
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一块浸过热牛奶的面包，传统上作为敷料用于舒缓皮肤不适。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa ħobż mgħaddsa f'ħalib sħun, li tradizzjonalment kienet tintuża bħala kataplażma biex ittaffi problemi tal-ġilda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ġbara is a piece of bread dipped in hot milk and traditionally used as a poultice for skin ailments.

formal.mt: F'dan it-test dwar prattiki tradizzjonali, il-kelma ġbara tirreferi għal biċċa ħobż mgħaddsa f'ħalib sħun u użata bħala kataplażma għall-ġilda.
formal.en: In this text about traditional practices, the word ġbara refers to a piece of bread dipped in hot milk and used as a skin poultice.
formal.zh: 在这篇介绍传统做法的文章中，ġbara 指一块浸过热牛奶、用作皮肤敷料的面包。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ejja, tkunx ġbara! Se nitilfu l-karozza tal-linja. Pawlu: Ġej, ġej! Qed nieħu l-basket.
colloquial.en: Sara: Come on, don't be so slow! We're going to miss the bus. Pawlu: I'm coming, I'm coming! I'm getting the bag.
colloquial.zh: Sara：快点，别慢吞吞的！我们要赶不上公交车了。Pawlu：来了，来了！我在拿包。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja, tkunx ġbara! Se nitilfu l-karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja, tkunx ġbara! Se nitilfu l-karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 快点，别慢吞吞的！我们要赶不上公交车了。
messages.en: Come on, don't be so slow! We're going to miss the bus.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 来了，来了！我在拿包。
messages.en: I'm coming, I'm coming! I'm getting the bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 ġbara 画两张学习卡：一张是被催促的慢吞吞的人，另一张是浸热牛奶的面包敷料。两幅画对应两个义项，只作记忆联想，不推断词源关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: My mind, where I think, understand, and remember things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 我的头脑或心思，即我进行思考、理解和记忆的心智。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moħħ tiegħi, li bih naħseb, nifhem u niftakar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我的头脑；我的心思。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-moħħ tiegħi bħala l-kapaċità li biha naħseb, nifhem u niftakar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: My mind is the part of me with which I think, understand, and remember things.

formal.mt: Wara li qrajt ir-rapport, baqgħet mistoqsija waħda f'ġbini.
formal.en: After I read the report, one question remained in my mind.
formal.zh: 读完报告后，我脑海中仍留着一个问题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dik il-kanzunetta għadha f'ġbini! Mark: Forsi jekk tisma' oħra, tieqaf taħseb fiha.
colloquial.en: Lara: That song is still in my mind! Mark: Maybe if you listen to another one, you'll stop thinking about it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那首歌还在我脑海里！Mark：也许听另一首，你就不会一直想着它了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那首歌还在我脑海里！
messages.en: That song is still in my mind!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi jekk tisma' oħra, tieqaf taħseb fiha.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi jekk tisma' oħra, tieqaf taħseb fiha.
messages.zh: 也许听另一首，你就不会一直想着它了。
messages.en: Maybe if you listen to another one, you'll stop thinking about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġbini 整体记成“我的头脑”，想象自己的脑海里回响着一首歌；再用 f'ġbini 对应“在我脑海中”巩固搭配。

gloss_zh: 对本企业而言的新创新

teaching_sense.en_definition: A category of innovation that is new to a particular firm, even if it already exists in the market.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指对某一家企业而言是首次引入的创新，即使市场上已经存在同类产品、服务或做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kategorija ta' innovazzjoni li tkun ġdida għal impriża partikolari, anki jekk prodotti, servizzi jew prattiki simili jkunu diġà jeżistu fis-suq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 企业首次引入的创新；新颖性以该企业此前是否采用或提供过为判断范围。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kategorija ta' innovazzjoni li impriża tadotta jew toffri għall-ewwel darba, għalkemm tista' tkun diġà disponibbli fis-suq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An innovation described as new-to-firm is being introduced by a particular firm for the first time, although other firms may already use or offer it.

collocations.en: a product that is new to the firm
collocations.zh: 对该企业而言的新产品

collocations.en: a service that is new to the firm
collocations.zh: 该企业首次提供的服务

formal.mt: Il-prodott huwa ġdid għall-impriża, iżda diġà jinbiegħ minn kumpaniji oħra fis-suq.
formal.en: The product is new to the firm, but other companies already sell it in the market.
formal.zh: 该产品对本企业而言是新的，但市场上已有其他公司销售同类产品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan is-servizz huwa ġdid għas-suq? Mark: Le, huwa ġdid għall-impriża tagħna biss; kumpaniji oħra diġà joffruh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this service new to the market? Mark: No, it is only new to our firm; other companies already offer it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这项服务是市场上首次出现的吗？马克：不是，只是我们企业第一次提供；其他公司已经有这项服务了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 这项服务是市场上首次出现的吗？
messages.en: Is this service new to the market?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa ġdid għall-impriża tagħna biss; kumpaniji oħra diġà joffruh.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa ġdid għall-impriża tagħna biss; kumpaniji oħra diġà joffruh.
messages.zh: 不是，只是我们企业第一次提供；其他公司已经有这项服务了。
messages.en: No, it is only new to our firm; other companies already offer it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把判断范围画成一家企业的小圈：圈内第一次出现就算新，圈外市场可能早已有。用“本企业首次”记住整个表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A category of innovation that is being introduced into a particular market for the first time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指在某一特定市场中首次推出的创新，其新颖性以该市场此前是否已有同类产品、服务或做法为判断范围。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kategorija ta' innovazzjoni li tidħol għall-ewwel darba f'suq partikolari, fejn prodotti, servizzi jew prattiki bħalha ma kinux disponibbli qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 首次进入某一市场的创新；对该市场而言是新的，不一定是全球首次出现。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kategorija ta' innovazzjoni li tiġi introdotta għall-ewwel darba f'suq partikolari, anki jekk tkun diġà teżisti fi swieq oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An innovation described as new-to-market is being offered in a particular market for the first time, even if it already exists elsewhere.

collocations.en: a product that is new to the market
collocations.zh: 在该市场首次推出的产品

collocations.en: a service that is new to the local market
collocations.zh: 在本地市场首次推出的服务

formal.mt: Dan is-servizz huwa ġdid għas-suq lokali, għalkemm ilu disponibbli f'pajjiżi oħra.
formal.en: This service is new to the local market, although it has been available in other countries for some time.
formal.zh: 这项服务在本地市场属于首次推出，但在其他国家已经提供了一段时间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex tgħidu li dan il-prodott huwa ġdid għas-suq? Pawlu: Għax hawn għadu ħadd ma jbigħ prodott bħalu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you say this product is new to the market? Pawlu: Because nobody here sells a product like it yet.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么你们说这款产品对市场而言是新的？保罗：因为这里还没有人销售同类产品。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħidu li dan il-prodott huwa ġdid għas-suq?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħidu li dan il-prodott huwa ġdid għas-suq?
messages.zh: 为什么你们说这款产品对市场而言是新的？
messages.en: Why do you say this product is new to the market?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (销售员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hawn għadu ħadd ma jbigħ prodott bħalu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hawn għadu ħadd ma jbigħ prodott bħalu.
messages.zh: 因为这里还没有人销售同类产品。
messages.en: Because nobody here sells a product like it yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象整座市场的大圈：圈内此前没有同类产品，今天首次出现。用“这个市场第一次见”记忆，别自动理解成全球首创。

gloss_zh: 迫使；在例句中表示“迫使了我们”

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone do something through pressure, necessity, or a lack of choice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过压力、客观需要或使人别无选择而让某人做某事；本词形在所给例句中表示“迫使了我们”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jagħmel xi ħaġa minħabba pressjoni jew ħtieġa, jew għax ma jkollux għażla oħra; fl-eżempji mogħtija, il-forma tfisser li xi ħaġa ġiegħlet lilna nagħmlu xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强迫或迫使某人采取行动，使其没有实际选择余地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġġiegħel lil persuna tagħmel xi ħaġa permezz ta' pressjoni jew minħabba ċirkostanzi li ma jħallulhiex għażla oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something forces a person to act, they make that person do something through pressure or circumstances that leave little choice.

collocations.en: forced us to change the plan

formal.mt: In-nuqqas ta' materjal ġegħelna nwaqqfu x-xogħol għal jumejn.
formal.en: The shortage of material forced us to stop work for two days.
formal.zh: 材料短缺迫使我们停工两天。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex mortu lura d-dar? Ninu: It-temp ħażin ġegħelna nbiddlu l-pjan.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you go back home? Ninu: The bad weather forced us to change the plan.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你们为什么回家了？尼努：恶劣天气迫使我们改变了计划。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们为什么回家了？
messages.en: Why did you go back home?

messages.speaker: Ninu (朋友)
messages.zh: 恶劣天气迫使我们改变了计划。
messages.en: The bad weather forced us to change the plan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“坏天气迫使我们改计划”的完整画面：在例句里把 ġegħelna 整体对应“迫使了我们”，再接具体被迫做的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A restriction or condition that limits what someone can do or choose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 限制一个人能够采取哪些行动或作出哪些选择的条件、规定或客观因素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Restrizzjoni jew kundizzjoni li tillimita dak li persuna tista' tagħmel jew l-għażliet li jista' jkollha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 约束或限制因素，缩小行动、决策或选择的可行范围。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fattur, regola jew kundizzjoni li tnaqqas il-libertà ta' azzjoni jew tillimita l-għażliet disponibbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A constraint is a rule, condition, or circumstance that limits what you can do or which choices are available to you.

formal.mt: Il-baġit limitat huwa ġegħila finanzjarja li tnaqqas l-għażliet disponibbli għall-proġett.
formal.en: The limited budget is a financial constraint that reduces the options available for the project.
formal.zh: 有限的预算构成财务约束，减少了项目可采用的方案。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Nistgħu nagħżlu kwalunkwe sala? Toni: Għandna ġegħila waħda: il-kera ma tistax taqbeż il-mitejn ewro.
colloquial.en: Rita: Can we choose any venue? Toni: We have one constraint: the rental cost cannot exceed two hundred euros.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我们可以随便选场地吗？托尼：有一个限制条件：租金不能超过两百欧元。

messages.speaker: Rita (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 我们可以随便选场地吗？
messages.en: Can we choose any venue?

messages.speaker: Toni (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna ġegħila waħda: il-kera ma tistax taqbeż il-mitejn ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna ġegħila waħda: il-kera ma tistax taqbeż il-mitejn ewro.
messages.zh: 有一个限制条件：租金不能超过两百欧元。
messages.en: We have one constraint: the rental cost cannot exceed two hundred euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġegħila 想成选项周围的一道边界：预算、规定或条件把部分选择挡在外面。记住“限制选择的条件”这一名词概念。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In religious belief, a place of punishment after death.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宗教信仰中人死后受惩罚的地方，即地狱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post ta' kastig wara l-mewt skont it-twemmin reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地狱；宗教信仰中死后受惩罚的地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post fejn, skont it-twemmin reliġjuż, il-ħżiena jbatu kastig wara l-mewt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In religious belief, hell is a place where wicked people suffer punishment after death.

formal.mt: It-test reliġjuż jiddeskrivi l-ġehenna bħala post ta' kastig wara l-mewt.
formal.en: The religious text describes hell as a place of punishment after death.
formal.zh: 这篇宗教文本将地狱描述为死后受惩罚的地方。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser il-kelma ġehenna f'dan il-ktieb? Pawlu: Tfisser post ta' kastig wara l-mewt, skont it-twemmin reliġjuż.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does the word ġehenna mean in this book? Pawlu: It means a place of punishment after death, according to religious belief.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这本书里的ġehenna是什么意思？保罗：它指宗教信仰中人死后受惩罚的地方。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma ġehenna f'dan il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma ġehenna f'dan il-ktieb?
messages.zh: 这本书里的ġehenna是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word ġehenna mean in this book?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser post ta' kastig wara l-mewt, skont it-twemmin reliġjuż.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser post ta' kastig wara l-mewt, skont it-twemmin reliġjuż.
messages.zh: 它指宗教信仰中人死后受惩罚的地方。
messages.en: It means a place of punishment after death, according to religious belief.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġehenna与“地狱之火”的画面一起记，看到这个词就联想宗教中的死后惩罚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Gelatin used to set food, or a soft jelly made with it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使食物凝固的明胶，也指用它制成的柔软果冻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza li tintuża biex l-ikel jagħqad, jew deżerta ratba magħmula biha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 明胶；用于使食物凝固的蛋白质材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sustanza magħmula minn proteini tal-annimali li tintuża biex l-ikel jagħqad.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Gelatin is a substance obtained from animal proteins and used to make food set.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 果冻；通常带有甜味和水果风味的柔软凝胶状食品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikel ħelu, artab u magħqud, ħafna drabi b'togħma ta' frott, li jsir bil-ġelatina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Jelly is a soft, sweet food that is made to set and is often flavoured with fruit.

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob li l-ġelatina tinħall fl-ilma sħun qabel ma tiżdied mat-taħlita.
formal.en: The recipe requires the gelatin to be dissolved in hot water before it is added to the mixture.
formal.zh: 食谱要求先将明胶溶于热水，再加入混合物中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ftit ġelatina tal-frawli wara l-ikel? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Inħobbha kiesħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like some strawberry jelly after the meal? Mark: Yes, please. I like it cold.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：饭后想吃点草莓果冻吗？马克：好的，谢谢。我喜欢吃凉的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid ftit ġelatina tal-frawli wara l-ikel?
messages.mt_standard: Trid ftit ġelatina tal-frawli wara l-ikel?
messages.zh: 饭后想吃点草莓果冻吗？
messages.en: Would you like some strawberry jelly after the meal?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢。我喜欢吃凉的。
messages.en: Yes, please. I like it cold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用厨房里的两个阶段记ġelatina：配料盒中是明胶，凝固装杯后是果冻。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To collect things or bring them together in one place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将分散的东西收集起来或集中到一处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiġbor affarijiet minn postijiet differenti u tqegħedhom flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收集；把分散的物品或钱款等聚拢起来。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiġbor flimkien affarijiet jew flus li jkunu għand persuni differenti jew f'postijiet differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you collect things, you gather them from different people or places and bring them together.

formal.mt: Il-voluntier ġema' l-kotba mingħand ir-residenti u ħadhom fil-librerija.
formal.en: The volunteer collected the books from the residents and took them to the library.
formal.zh: 志愿者从居民那里收集了书籍，并将它们送到图书馆。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min ġema' l-flus għar-rigal? Mark: Pawlu ġema' l-flus mingħand kulħadd dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who collected the money for the present? Mark: Pawlu collected the money from everyone this morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁收了买礼物的钱？马克：保罗今天早上向大家收齐了钱。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 谁收了买礼物的钱？
messages.en: Who collected the money for the present?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu ġema' l-flus mingħand kulħadd dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu ġema' l-flus mingħand kulħadd dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 保罗今天早上向大家收齐了钱。
messages.en: Pawlu collected the money from everyone this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记ġema时想象把散开的书一本本收进箱子，用“分散变集中”的动作帮助记住“收集”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A precious stone, especially one used in jewellery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 珍贵的石头，尤指用于制作首饰的宝石。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaġra prezzjuża li tintuża l-aktar biex iżżejjen il-ġojjelli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宝石；因美观或稀有而珍贵、常用于首饰的石头。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaġra prezzjuża apprezzata għas-sbuħija jew għar-rarità tagħha u spiss użata fil-ġojjelli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A gem is a valuable stone that is admired for its beauty and often used in jewellery.

formal.mt: Il-ġojjellier eżamina l-ġemma bir-reqqa qabel ma poġġieha fiċ-ċurkett.
formal.en: The jeweller examined the gem carefully before placing it in the ring.
formal.zh: 珠宝匠仔细检查了宝石，然后才将它镶入戒指。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-ġemma fiċ-ċurkett hija vera? Lara: Iva, il-ġojjellier ikkonferma li hija ġemma naturali.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this gem in the ring real? Lara: Yes, the jeweller confirmed that it is a natural gem.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：戒指上的这颗宝石是真的吗？拉拉：是的，珠宝匠确认它是一颗天然宝石。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 戒指上的这颗宝石是真的吗？
messages.en: Is this gem in the ring real?

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ġojjellier ikkonferma li hija ġemma naturali.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ġojjellier ikkonferma li hija ġemma naturali.
messages.zh: 是的，珠宝匠确认它是一颗天然宝石。
messages.en: Yes, the jeweller confirmed that it is a natural gem.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġemma写在一张画着戒指和宝石的词卡上，并圈出双写的mm，帮助记住拼写和“宝石”义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Blackening something by depositing soot on it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容会使烟炱附着在物体表面、将其熏黑的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jsewwed xi ħaġa billi jħalli n-nugrufun fuqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使物体沾上烟炱而变黑的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jagħmel xi ħaġa sewda billi jiksiha bin-nugrufun.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is described as ġemmiedi blackens objects by leaving soot on their surfaces.

collocations.en: smoke that blackens surfaces with soot
collocations.zh: 会把物体表面熏黑的烟

formal.mt: Id-duħħan ġemmiedi li ħareġ mill-fuklar ħalla saff iswed fuq il-ħajt.
formal.en: The soot-blackening smoke from the fireplace left a black layer on the wall.
formal.zh: 壁炉冒出的烟把墙面熏黑，留下了一层黑色烟炱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ħajt sar iswed? Pawlu: Minħabba d-duħħan ġemmiedi tal-fuklar. Irridu nnaddfuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why has the wall turned black? Pawlu: Because of the soot-blackening smoke from the fireplace. We need to clean it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：墙怎么变黑了？保罗：壁炉的烟把它熏黑了。我们得把墙擦干净。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 墙怎么变黑了？
messages.en: Why has the wall turned black?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba d-duħħan ġemmiedi tal-fuklar. Irridu nnaddfuh.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba d-duħħan ġemmiedi tal-fuklar. Irridu nnaddfuh.
messages.zh: 壁炉的烟把它熏黑了。我们得把墙擦干净。
messages.en: Because of the soot-blackening smoke from the fireplace. We need to clean it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象白墙被炉烟熏出一层黑灰，把 ġemmiedi 与“烟炱附着、表面变黑”的画面联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The study of family origins, descent, and relationships across generations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究家族起源、世代传承以及成员之间亲属关系的学问。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istudju tal-oriġini tal-familji, tan-nisel tagħhom u tar-rabtiet bejn il-membri tagħhom minn ġenerazzjoni għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 家谱学；通过家族记录等资料研究祖先、血缘传承及亲属关系的学问。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-istudju tal-antenati u tan-nisel ta' familja permezz ta' dokumenti u tagħrif dwar ir-rabtiet tal-parentela.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Genealogy is the study of families, their ancestors, and the relationships connecting people across generations.

formal.mt: Ir-riċerka fil-ġeneoloġija tuża dokumenti tat-twelid u taż-żwieġ biex tistabbilixxi r-rabtiet bejn il-ġenerazzjonijiet.
formal.en: Research in genealogy uses birth and marriage records to establish relationships between generations.
formal.zh: 家族谱系研究利用出生和婚姻记录，确定不同世代之间的亲属关系。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tfittex dawn id-dokumenti tal-familja? Mark: Qed nistudja l-ġeneoloġija u rrid insir naf min kienu l-antenati tagħna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you looking for these family documents? Mark: I'm studying genealogy and want to find out who our ancestors were.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么在找这些家族文件？马克：我在研究家谱，想了解我们的祖先是谁。

messages.speaker: Lara (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tfittex dawn id-dokumenti tal-familja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tfittex dawn id-dokumenti tal-familja?
messages.zh: 你为什么在找这些家族文件？
messages.en: Why are you looking for these family documents?

messages.speaker: Mark (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nistudja l-ġeneoloġija u rrid insir naf min kienu l-antenati tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nistudja l-ġeneoloġija u rrid insir naf min kienu l-antenati tagħna.
messages.zh: 我在研究家谱，想了解我们的祖先是谁。
messages.en: I'm studying genealogy and want to find out who our ancestors were.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġeneoloġija 写在家谱树旁边：从自己向上追到父母、祖父母，再用记录连接各代，记住“家谱学”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Produced or brought into existence by a process, activity, or system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由某种过程、活动或系统产生或生成的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun inħoloq jew ġie prodott permezz ta' proċess, attività jew sistema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经过某种过程或由某种来源产生、生成的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie prodott jew maħluq minn xi ħaġa jew bħala riżultat ta' proċess.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is generated is produced by a particular process, activity, or source.

collocations.zh: 利用太阳光产生的电力

formal.mt: Ir-rapport ġenerat awtomatikament mis-sistema jinkludi sommarju tal-bejgħ ta' kull xahar.
formal.en: The report automatically generated by the system includes a summary of sales for each month.
formal.zh: 系统自动生成的报告包含每个月的销售汇总。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan ir-rapport ktibtu int? David: Le, huwa ġenerat awtomatikament mis-sistema. Jien biss iċċekkjajt iċ-ċifri.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you write this report? David: No, it's generated automatically by the system. I only checked the figures.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这份报告是你写的吗？戴维：不是，是系统自动生成的。我只是核对了数字。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 这份报告是你写的吗？
messages.en: Did you write this report?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa ġenerat awtomatikament mis-sistema. Jien biss iċċekkjajt iċ-ċifri.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa ġenerat awtomatikament mis-sistema. Jien biss iċċekkjajt iċ-ċifri.
messages.zh: 不是，是系统自动生成的。我只是核对了数字。
messages.en: No, it's generated automatically by the system. I only checked the figures.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġenerat 与英语 generated 配对记忆：想象点击按钮后报告出现，抓住“由某个过程生成”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a whole type or group rather than a particular individual example.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 适用于某一整类事物、并非专指其中某个具体对象的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jirreferi għal tip jew grupp sħiħ ta' affarijiet u mhux għal eżempju wieħed partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通用的；概括某一类别而不指向某个特定成员或具体实例的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu tifsira jew użu ġenerali għal kategorija sħiħa u ma jindikax xi ħaġa speċifika waħda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is generic applies to a whole class or group rather than one particular example.

formal.mt: F'dan id-dokument, it-terminu ġeneriku 'vettura' jinkludi karozzi, xarabanks u trakkijiet.
formal.en: In this document, the generic term 'vehicle' includes cars, buses, and trucks.
formal.zh: 在本文件中，“车辆”这一统称包括汽车、公共汽车和卡车。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandek mudell għal din l-ittra? Luqa: Iva, għandi mudell ġeneriku. Tista' tibdel l-isem u d-dettalji skont il-bżonn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you have a template for this letter? Luqa: Yes, I have a generic template. You can change the name and details as needed.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你有这封信的模板吗？卢卡：有，我有一个通用模板。你可以按需要修改姓名和具体内容。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 你有这封信的模板吗？
messages.en: Do you have a template for this letter?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi mudell ġeneriku. Tista' tibdel l-isem u d-dettalji skont il-bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi mudell ġeneriku. Tista' tibdel l-isem u d-dettalji skont il-bżonn.
messages.zh: 有，我有一个通用模板。你可以按需要修改姓名和具体内容。
messages.en: Yes, I have a generic template. You can change the name and details as needed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġeneriku 与英语 generic 配对，想象一张可供许多人填写的空白模板，记住“适用于一类对象、通用的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of willingly giving help, money, time, or other things to others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 乐意给予他人帮助、金钱、时间或其他事物的慷慨品质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' min jagħti għajnuna, flus, ħin jew affarijiet oħra minn qalbu lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 慷慨；乐意与他人分享财物、时间或帮助的品质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' persuna li tkun lesta tagħti minn dak li għandha biex tgħin lil ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Generosity is the willingness to give other people money, time, help, or things without expecting something in return.

formal.mt: Il-ġenerożità tar-residenti għenet lill-iskola tixtri kotba ġodda għall-istudenti.
formal.en: The residents' generosity helped the school buy new books for the students.
formal.zh: 居民们的慷慨帮助学校为学生购买了新书。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ġibt xi ikel għalik ukoll. Pawlu: Grazzi tal-ġenerożità tiegħek! Lara: Ejja nieklu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Lara: I brought some food for you too. Pawlu: Thank you for your generosity! Lara: Let's eat together.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我也给你带了些吃的。保罗：谢谢你这么大方！拉拉：我们一起吃吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我也给你带了些吃的。
messages.en: I brought some food for you too.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 谢谢你这么大方！
messages.en: Thank you for your generosity!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们一起吃吧。
messages.en: Let's eat together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“感谢你的慷慨”这一场景记忆：ġenerożità 指慷慨这种品质，ġeneruż 则用来形容慷慨的人。

gloss_zh: 体裁；属（生物分类）；性别或语法性

teaching_sense.en_definition: A category used to classify artistic works, living organisms, or gender, including grammatical gender.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于分类的名词，可指艺术作品的体裁、生物分类中的属，或性别及语法性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kategorija li tista' tindika tip ta' xogħol artistiku, grupp fil-klassifikazzjoni tal-ħlejjaq ħajjin, jew sess jew kategorija grammatikali bħall-maskil u l-femminil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体裁；文学、音乐、电影等艺术作品按风格或内容划分的类别。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kategorija ta' xogħlijiet letterarji, mużikali, ċinematografiċi jew artistiċi li għandhom karatteristiċi komuni fl-istil jew fil-kontenut.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A genre is a category of artistic works that share features of style, form, or subject matter.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 属；生物分类中位于科之下、种之上的分类等级或该等级的类群。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Grupp fil-klassifikazzjoni bijoloġika li jinsab taħt il-familja u jiġbor fih speċi relatati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A genus is a biological classification group below a family that contains closely related species.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 性别；也指语法性，即某些语言中名词等所属的阳性、阴性等语法类别。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kategorija marbuta mas-sess jew mal-identità tal-persuna; fil-grammatika, kategorija bħall-maskil u l-femminil li fiha jiġu kklassifikati n-nomi u li tista' taffettwa l-qbil ta' kliem ieħor magħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Gender can refer to categories associated with sex or identity, or to grammatical classes such as masculine and feminine.

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tar-rumanz, l-istudenti għandhom jidentifikaw il-ġeneru letterarju tiegħu u jispjegaw il-karatteristiċi ewlenin tiegħu.
formal.en: In their analysis of the novel, students should identify its literary genre and explain its main characteristics.
formal.zh: 分析这部小说时，学生应指出其文学体裁，并解释其主要特征。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Liema ġeneru ta' films jogħġbok? David: Il-kummiedji. U lilek? Marta: Jien inħobb il-films tal-biża'.
colloquial.en: Marta: What genre of films do you like? David: Comedies. And you? Marta: I like horror films.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你喜欢什么类型的电影？戴维：喜剧片。你呢？玛尔塔：我喜欢恐怖片。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢什么类型的电影？
messages.en: What genre of films do you like?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 喜剧片。你呢？
messages.en: Comedies. And you?

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 我喜欢恐怖片。
messages.en: I like horror films.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个分类抽屉记住 ġeneru：电影放“体裁”，生物放“属”，语言放“语法性”；遇到这个词先看它在给什么分类。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Willing to give others money, time, help, or more than they expect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 愿意给予他人金钱、时间或帮助的；给予大方的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun lest jagħti flus, ħin jew għajnuna minn qalbu lil ħaddieħor, jew li jagħti aktar milli jkun mistenni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 慷慨的；乐意与他人分享财物、时间或帮助的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jagħti minn dak li għandu lil ħaddieħor minn qalbu u mingħajr ma jistenna xi ħaġa lura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is generous willingly gives other people money, time, help, or things without expecting repayment.

formal.mt: Il-voluntier kien ġeneruż bil-ħin tiegħu u għen lill-istudenti jippreparaw għall-eżamijiet.
formal.en: The volunteer was generous with his time and helped the students prepare for their exams.
formal.zh: 这位志愿者乐意付出自己的时间，帮助学生准备考试。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Illum jien se nħallas il-kafè. Mark: Grazzi, imma ħallast int l-aħħar darba wkoll! Sara: Tinkwetax. Mark: Kemm int ġeneruża!
colloquial.en: Sara: I'll pay for the coffee today. Mark: Thanks, but you paid last time too! Sara: Don't worry. Mark: You're so generous!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今天咖啡我来付钱。马克：谢谢，可上次也是你付的！萨拉：别在意。马克：你真大方！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天咖啡我来付钱。
messages.en: I'll pay for the coffee today.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, imma ħallast int l-aħħar darba wkoll!
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, imma ħallast int l-aħħar darba wkoll!
messages.zh: 谢谢，可上次也是你付的！
messages.en: Thanks, but you paid last time too!

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 别在意。
messages.en: Don't worry.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你真大方！
messages.en: You're so generous!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友主动请你喝咖啡，你说“真大方”：形容男性用 ġeneruż，形容女性用 ġeneruża，把人物和词尾一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The people who are a child's mother or father, whether by birth or adoption.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 父母；作为孩子母亲或父亲的人，包括亲生父母或养父母。此词为复数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-persuni li huma l-omm jew il-missier ta' wild, bit-twelid jew bl-adozzjoni; din hija forma fil-plural.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 父母；孩子的母亲和父亲，也可统指多位孩子的家长。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-omm u l-missier ta' wild, jew l-ommijiet u l-missirijiet ta' aktar minn wild wieħed, kemm jekk bit-twelid kif ukoll jekk bl-adozzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your parents are the people who are your mother or father, whether through birth or adoption.

formal.mt: Il-ġenituri huma mistiedna għal laqgħa fl-iskola nhar il-Ġimgħa biex jiddiskutu l-progress tat-tfal tagħhom.
formal.en: Parents are invited to a meeting at the school on Friday to discuss their children's progress.
formal.zh: 学校邀请家长于星期五到校开会，讨论孩子们的学习进展。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Se tiġi magħna għada? Luqa: Ma nistax; se niekol mal-ġenituri tiegħi. Nina: Tajjeb, selli għalihom!
colloquial.en: Nina: Are you coming with us tomorrow? Luqa: I can't; I'm having a meal with my parents. Nina: Okay, say hello to them for me!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你明天和我们一起去吗？卢卡：去不了，我要和父母一起吃饭。妮娜：好，替我向他们问好！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天和我们一起去吗？
messages.en: Are you coming with us tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nistax; se niekol mal-ġenituri tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nistax; se niekol mal-ġenituri tiegħi.
messages.zh: 去不了，我要和父母一起吃饭。
messages.en: I can't; I'm having a meal with my parents.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，替我向他们问好！
messages.en: Okay, say hello to them for me!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 il-ġenituri tiegħi 整块记成“我的父母”，联想一家人围桌吃饭；看到 ġenituri 就提醒自己这是复数，要用“他们”的概念理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person with exceptional intellectual or creative ability, or the exceptional ability itself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在智力或创造力方面具有非凡才能的人，也可指这种非凡才智。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġenju huwa persuna b'ħila intellettwali jew kreattiva straordinarja; il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għal din il-ħila.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有超凡智力或创造才能的人；也指这种超凡才能。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġenju huwa xi ħadd b'kapaċità straordinarja biex jaħseb, joħloq jew isolvi problemi, jew il-kapaċità straordinarja nnifisha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A genius is someone who has exceptionally great intellectual or creative ability.

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddeskrivi lill-kompożitur bħala ġenju mużikali u janalizza l-oriġinalità tax-xogħlijiet tiegħu.
formal.en: The article describes the composer as a musical genius and analyses the originality of his works.
formal.zh: 这篇文章将这位作曲家描述为音乐天才，并分析了其作品的独创性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sibt it-tweġiba daqshekk malajr? Int ġenju! Mark: Le, rajt problema bħal din qabel.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you find the answer so quickly? You're a genius! Mark: No, I've seen a problem like this before.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么这么快就找到答案了？你真是个天才！Mark：没有啦，我以前见过类似的题。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sibt it-tweġiba daqshekk malajr? Int ġenju!
messages.mt_standard: Kif sibt it-tweġiba daqshekk malajr? Int ġenju!
messages.zh: 你怎么这么快就找到答案了？你真是个天才！
messages.en: How did you find the answer so quickly? You're a genius!

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, rajt problema bħal din qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Le, rajt problema bħal din qabel.
messages.zh: 没有啦，我以前见过类似的题。
messages.en: No, I've seen a problem like this before.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġenju和轻松解出难题的同学联系起来，记住它既能称赞一个人是天才，也能表示非凡才智。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone who is kind treats other people with care, consideration, and friendliness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人待人友善、体贴，能够关心他人的感受和需要。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna ġentili tittratta lill-oħrajn b'qalb tajba, b'rispett u b'attenzjoni għall-bżonnijiet tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 待人和善、体贴，关心他人的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta persuna tkun ġentili, turi qalb tajba u tqis is-sentimenti u l-bżonnijiet ta' nies oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is kind behaves in a caring and considerate way towards other people.

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tagħha, il-pazjenta rringrazzjat lill-infermier talli kien ġentili magħha matul il-kura.
formal.en: In her letter, the patient thanked the nurse for being kind to her during her treatment.
formal.zh: 这位女患者在信中感谢护士在治疗期间对她的体贴照顾。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Grazzi talli għentni nġorr il-basktijiet. Int ġentili ħafna! Pawlu: Ta' xejn! Kienu jidhru tqal.
colloquial.en: Sara: Thanks for helping me carry the bags. You're very kind! Pawlu: You're welcome! They looked heavy.
colloquial.zh: Sara：谢谢你帮我提袋子。你真体贴！Pawlu：不客气！那些袋子看起来挺重的。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi talli għentni nġorr il-basktijiet. Int ġentili ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi talli għentni nġorr il-basktijiet. Int ġentili ħafna!
messages.zh: 谢谢你帮我提袋子。你真体贴！
messages.en: Thanks for helping me carry the bags. You're very kind!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 不客气！那些袋子看起来挺重的。
messages.en: You're welcome! They looked heavy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象邻居主动帮你提重袋子的情景，用Int ġentili ħafna表达“你真体贴”，把词义和具体善举一起记。

gloss_zh: 真正的；货真价实的；真诚的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something genuine is really what it claims to be, and a genuine feeling is sincerely felt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示事物确实如其所称、并非仿冒，也表示感情或态度真实而真诚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa ġenwina tkun tassew dak li jingħad li hi; sentiment ġenwin ikun wieħed sinċier u mhux taparsi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 确实如其所称的；真实可靠、并非假冒或仿制的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett jew prodott ġenwin ikun tassew dak li jingħad li hu, u ma jkunx falz jew imitazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is genuine is really what it appears or claims to be.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 真实的；确实存在或发自内心、并非假装的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sentiment jew interess ġenwin ikun jeżisti tassew u joħroġ mill-qalb, aktar milli jkun muri biss għal għan ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A feeling described as true is sincerely experienced and is not merely pretended.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jikkonferma li l-oġġett eżaminat huwa ġenwin u mhux imitazzjoni moderna.
formal.en: The report confirms that the object examined is genuine and is not a modern imitation.
formal.zh: 报告确认，受检物品是真品，并非现代仿制品。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taħseb li Mark qed jistaqsi biss biex ikun edukat? Nina: Le, għandu interess ġenwin fix-xogħol tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you think Mark is only asking to be polite? Nina: No, he has a genuine interest in your work.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你觉得Mark只是出于礼貌才问的吗？Nina：不是，他对你的工作确实很感兴趣。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li Mark qed jistaqsi biss biex ikun edukat?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li Mark qed jistaqsi biss biex ikun edukat?
messages.zh: 你觉得Mark只是出于礼貌才问的吗？
messages.en: Do you think Mark is only asking to be polite?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għandu interess ġenwin fix-xogħol tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għandu interess ġenwin fix-xogħol tiegħek.
messages.zh: 不是，他对你的工作确实很感兴趣。
messages.en: No, he has a genuine interest in your work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“商品是真的，兴趣也是真的”串联ġenwin的用法：修饰产品强调真品，修饰感情强调真诚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the Earth's rocks, structure, and the processes that form and change them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与地球的岩石、构造及其形成和变化过程有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li hu ġeoloġiku għandu x'jaqsam mal-blat, mal-istruttura tad-Dinja u mal-proċessi li jsawruhom u jbiddluhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涉及地球的岩石、构造、形成历史及变化过程的；属于地质学的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa ġeoloġika tkun marbuta mal-istudju tal-blat u tal-istruttura tad-Dinja, kif ukoll mal-istorja u mal-bidliet tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Geological means relating to the Earth's rocks, structure, and the processes that have shaped them.

formal.mt: L-istudju ġeoloġiku jiddeskrivi s-saffi tal-blat fiż-żona u jispjega kif iffurmaw.
formal.en: The geological study describes the rock layers in the area and explains how they formed.
formal.zh: 这项地质研究描述了该地区的岩层，并解释了它们的形成过程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ġibt din il-mappa magħna? Toni: Hija mappa ġeoloġika. Turina x'tipi ta' blat hemm hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you bring this map with us? Toni: It's a geological map. It shows us what types of rock there are here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么带上这张地图？Toni：这是地质图，能告诉我们这里有哪些种类的岩石。

messages.speaker: Maja (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 你为什么带上这张地图？
messages.en: Why did you bring this map with us?

messages.speaker: Toni (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija mappa ġeoloġika. Turina x'tipi ta' blat hemm hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Hija mappa ġeoloġika. Turina x'tipi ta' blat hemm hawn.
messages.zh: 这是地质图，能告诉我们这里有哪些种类的岩石。
messages.en: It's a geological map. It shows us what types of rock there are here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġeoloġiku和一幅标出不同岩层的地质图联系起来；学studju ġeoloġiku时想研究，学mappa ġeoloġika时想地图。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Georgia, a country in the Caucasus region.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 格鲁吉亚，位于高加索地区的一个国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fir-reġjun tal-Kawkasu li jismu Ġeorġja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 格鲁吉亚，指高加索地区的国家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-isem ta' pajjiż fir-reġjun tal-Kawkasu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Georgia is a country located in the Caucasus region.

formal.mt: Dan ir-rapport jippreżenta informazzjoni ġenerali dwar il-Ġeorġja u l-kultura tagħha.
formal.en: This report presents general information about Georgia and its culture.
formal.zh: 本报告介绍格鲁吉亚及其文化的基本情况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn sejjer għal btala? Mark: Se mmur il-Ġeorġja. Lara: Kemm se ddum hemm? Mark: Ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I'm going to Georgia. Lara: How long will you stay there? Mark: A week.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你要去哪里度假？马克：我要去格鲁吉亚。拉拉：你会在那里待多久？马克：一周。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要去格鲁吉亚。
messages.en: I'm going to Georgia.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你会在那里待多久？
messages.en: How long will you stay there?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 一周。
