sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tbigħ il-ħelu, skont interpretazzjoni possibbli li fil-materjal mogħti hija ppreżentata b'dubju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ħabbażiż may refer to someone who sells sweets, but the supplied definition presents this meaning as uncertain.

formal.mt: Il-kelma ħabbażiż tista' tirreferi għal persuna li tbigħ il-ħelu, iżda din it-tifsira tingħata b'punt ta' mistoqsija.
formal.en: The word ħabbażiż may refer to a person who sells sweets, but this meaning is given with a question mark.
formal.zh: ħabbażiż 可能指卖甜食的人，但这一释义后面带有问号。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħabbażiż ifisser xi ħadd li jbigħ il-ħelu? Mark: Jista' jkun, imma hemm punt ta' mistoqsija ħdejn it-tifsira.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does ħabbażiż mean someone who sells sweets? Mark: It might, but there's a question mark beside the definition.
colloquial.zh: Maja：ħabbażiż 的意思是卖甜食的人吗？Mark：可能是，不过释义旁边有一个问号。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħabbażiż ifisser xi ħadd li jbigħ il-ħelu?
messages.mt_standard: Ħabbażiż ifisser xi ħadd li jbigħ il-ħelu?
messages.zh: ħabbażiż 的意思是卖甜食的人吗？
messages.en: Does ħabbażiż mean someone who sells sweets?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jista' jkun, imma hemm punt ta' mistoqsija ħdejn it-tifsira.
messages.mt_standard: Jista' jkun, imma hemm punt ta' mistoqsija ħdejn it-tifsira.
messages.zh: 可能是，不过释义旁边有一个问号。
messages.en: It might, but there's a question mark beside the definition.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħabbażiż 暂时配上一位卖甜食的人，并在图旁画上醒目的问号：人物帮助记住候选含义，问号提醒释义仍待确认。

gloss_zh: 法寻硬币；四分之一便士硬币（复数）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small coins, each worth one quarter of a penny.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指多枚法寻硬币，每枚面值为四分之一便士。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħabbiet huma muniti li kull waħda minnhom tiswa kwart ta' penny.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法寻硬币的复数，指每枚面值为四分之一便士的硬币。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħabbiet huma muniti żgħar li kull waħda għandha valur ta' kwart ta' penny.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Farthings are small coins that each have a value of one quarter of a penny.

formal.mt: Il-katalogu jinkludi deskrizzjoni tal-ħabbiet fil-ġabra tal-mużew.
formal.en: The catalogue includes a description of the farthings in the museum's collection.
formal.zh: 目录中载有对博物馆所藏法寻硬币的介绍。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhuma dawn il-muniti żgħar? Toni: Dawn ħabbiet; kull waħda tiswa kwart ta' penny. Maja: Mela żewġ ħabbiet jiswew nofs penny.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are these little coins? Toni: These are farthings; each is worth a quarter of a penny. Maja: So two farthings are worth half a penny.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些小硬币是什么？托尼：这些是法寻硬币，每枚值四分之一便士。玛雅：那么两枚就是半便士。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 这些小硬币是什么？
messages.en: What are these little coins?

messages.speaker: Toni (博物馆讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn ħabbiet; kull waħda tiswa kwart ta' penny.
messages.mt_standard: Dawn ħabbiet; kull waħda tiswa kwart ta' penny.
messages.zh: 这些是法寻硬币，每枚值四分之一便士。
messages.en: These are farthings; each is worth a quarter of a penny.

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela żewġ ħabbiet jiswew nofs penny.
messages.mt_standard: Mela żewġ ħabbiet jiswew nofs penny.
messages.zh: 那么两枚法寻硬币就是半便士。
messages.en: So two farthings are worth half a penny.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画四枚小硬币拼成一便士，把 ħabbiet 写在旁边；用多枚硬币的画面同时记住词义和复数。

gloss_zh: 使筋疲力尽；使疲惫不堪

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone extremely tired by using up their energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人因精力耗尽而极度疲倦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaddel ifisser għamel lil xi ħadd għajjien ħafna, tant li kważi ma fadallu ebda saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人精疲力竭，累得几乎没有力气。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaddel ifisser ġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss għeja kbira wara sforz jew attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an activity exhausts someone, it makes them extremely tired and leaves them with very little energy.

formal.mt: Ix-xogħol fiżiku matul il-ġurnata ħaddel lill-ħaddiema, li kellhom bżonn jistrieħu.
formal.en: The physical work throughout the day exhausted the workers, who needed to rest.
formal.zh: 一整天的体力劳动使工人们筋疲力尽，需要休息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex kulħadd għajjien daqshekk? Mark: It-taħriġ tal-lum ħaddel lit-tim kollu. Sara: Mela ejjew nistrieħu ftit.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is everyone so tired? Mark: Today's training exhausted the whole team. Sara: Then let's rest for a while.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么大家都这么累？马克：今天的训练把整个团队都累坏了。萨拉：那我们休息一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (队员)
messages.zh: 为什么大家都这么累？
messages.en: Why is everyone so tired?

messages.speaker: Mark (教练)
messages.zh: 今天的训练把整个团队都累坏了。
messages.en: Today's training exhausted the whole team.

messages.speaker: Sara (队员)
messages.zh: 那我们休息一会儿吧。
messages.en: Then let's rest for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħaddel 配上一幅训练后全队瘫坐休息的图，记住它表示某件事把人累得没有力气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put your arms around someone to show affection or give comfort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用双臂抱住某人，以表达亲爱或给予安慰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħadden ifisser dawwar dirgħajh ma' xi ħadd biex jurih imħabba jew jagħtih faraġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拥抱某人，用双臂将对方搂住。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħadden ifisser żamm lil xi ħadd bejn dirgħajh bħala ġest ta' mħabba, ferħ jew faraġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you embrace someone, you put your arms around them to show affection or offer comfort.

formal.mt: Meta wasal id-dar wara l-vjaġġ, Pawlu ħadden lil ommu b'ferħ kbir.
formal.en: When he arrived home after the journey, Pawlu embraced his mother with great joy.
formal.zh: 旅途结束回到家后，保罗满心欢喜地拥抱了母亲。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel missierek meta rak? Lara: Ħadden lili u lil ħija malli dħalna. Maja: Kemm hu sabiħ li terġgħu tkunu flimkien!
colloquial.en: Maja: What did your father do when he saw you? Lara: He embraced me and my brother as soon as we came in. Maja: How lovely that you're together again!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你爸爸看见你时做了什么？拉拉：我们一进门，他就拥抱了我和我兄弟。玛雅：你们又团聚了，真好！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爸爸看见你时做了什么？
messages.en: What did your father do when he saw you?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħadden lili u lil ħija malli dħalna.
messages.mt_standard: Ħadden lili u lil ħija malli dħalna.
messages.zh: 我们一进门，他就拥抱了我和我兄弟。
messages.en: He embraced me and my brother as soon as we came in.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu sabiħ li terġgħu tkunu flimkien!
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu sabiħ li terġgħu tkunu flimkien!
messages.zh: 你们又团聚了，真好！
messages.en: How lovely that you're together again!

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 ħadden 就想象回家时张开双臂拥抱家人的动作，用身体动作记住“拥抱、搂住”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose work is to construct buildings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以建造房屋或其他建筑物为工作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħadiem huwa persuna li xogħolha hu li tibni djar jew binjiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑工人，指从事房屋或其他建筑物建造工作的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħadiem huwa persuna li taħdem fil-kostruzzjoni u tibni djar jew strutturi oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A builder is a person whose job involves constructing houses or other buildings.

formal.mt: Għall-bini tal-ħajt il-ġdid, il-familja għażlet ħadiem b'esperjenza.
formal.en: The family chose an experienced builder to construct the new wall.
formal.zh: 这家人选了一位经验丰富的建筑工人来砌新墙。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min se jibni l-ħajt tal-ġnien? Toni: Għandna ħadiem tas-sengħa; jibda nhar it-Tnejn. Nina: Tajjeb, allura nħejju l-post qabel jiġi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is going to build the garden wall? Toni: We have a skilled builder; he starts on Monday. Nina: Good, then let's prepare the area before he comes.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁来砌花园的围墙？托尼：我们找了一位手艺好的建筑工人，他星期一开工。妮娜：好，那我们在他来之前把地方准备好。

messages.speaker: Nina (房主)
messages.zh: 谁来砌花园的围墙？
messages.en: Who is going to build the garden wall?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna ħadiem tas-sengħa; jibda nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna ħadiem tas-sengħa; jibda nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.zh: 我们找了一位手艺好的建筑工人，他星期一开工。
messages.en: We have a skilled builder; he starts on Monday.

messages.speaker: Nina (房主)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, allura nħejju l-post qabel jiġi.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, allura nħejju l-post qabel jiġi.
messages.zh: 好，那我们在他来之前把地方准备好。
messages.en: Good, then let's prepare the area before he comes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħadiem 写在一幅戴安全帽、拿工具砌墙的人物图旁，用“建房子的人”这个画面记住职业含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very low clouds that bring rain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位置非常低、会带来降雨的云层。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sħab baxx ħafna li jġib ix-xita.

sense_translations.en_definition: very low clouds that bring rain
sense_translations.zh_definition: 会带来降雨的极低云层。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sħab li jkun baxx ħafna fis-sema u li jġib miegħu x-xita.
sense_translations.en_explanation: These are clouds that lie very low in the sky and bring rain.

collocations.en: very low rain-bearing clouds over the hills
collocations.zh: 山丘上空带雨的极低云层

formal.mt: Matul il-mixja edukattiva, l-istudenti osservaw il-ħajbura fuq l-għoljiet u ftit wara bdiet nieżla x-xita.
formal.en: During the educational walk, the students observed very low rain-bearing clouds over the hills, and shortly afterwards it began to rain.
formal.zh: 在教学步行活动中，学生们观察到山丘上空带雨的极低云层，不久后便下起了雨。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dik il-ħajbura fuq l-għolja! Ben: Iva, se nieħu l-umbrella miegħi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at those very low rain clouds over the hill! Ben: Yes, I'll take my umbrella with me.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看山丘上那片压得很低的雨云！本：嗯，我要把伞带上。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看山丘上那片压得很低的雨云！
messages.en: Look at those very low rain clouds over the hill!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 嗯，我要把伞带上。
messages.en: Yes, I'll take my umbrella with me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“低云压着山丘，出门带上雨伞”的画面；这个词同时突出云层极低和带来降雨两个特点。

gloss_zh: 人们的生活；人们的生命

teaching_sense.en_definition: Human lives, including people's existence and the ways they experience everyday life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指人的生命，也可指人们日常生活的经历、方式和处境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħajja tan-nies, kemm bħala l-eżistenza tagħhom kif ukoll bħala l-esperjenzi u l-kundizzjonijiet tal-għajxien tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人们的生命或生活，包括他们的生存状态与日常经历。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-eżistenza tan-nies u dak li jgħaddu minnu fil-ħajja tagħhom ta' kuljum.
sense_translations.en_explanation: People's lives are their existence and the experiences and circumstances that shape how they live.

formal.mt: L-aċċess għal ilma nadif itejjeb ħajjet il-bniedem.
formal.en: Access to clean water improves people's lives.
formal.zh: 能够获得洁净的水可以改善人们的生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li l-mowbajl biddel ħajjet il-bniedem? Mark: Iva, illum nistgħu nitkellmu mal-familja minn kullimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think mobile phones have changed people's lives? Mark: Yes, today we can talk to our families from anywhere.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得手机改变了人们的生活吗？马克：是啊，如今我们在哪里都能和家人通话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li l-mowbajl biddel ħajjet il-bniedem?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li l-mowbajl biddel ħajjet il-bniedem?
messages.zh: 你觉得手机改变了人们的生活吗？
messages.en: Do you think mobile phones have changed people's lives?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum nistgħu nitkellmu mal-familja minn kullimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum nistgħu nitkellmu mal-familja minn kullimkien.
messages.zh: 是啊，如今我们在哪里都能和家人通话。
messages.en: Yes, today we can talk to our families from anywhere.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语联想成一幅人们生活的画面：谈改善时想到生活，谈保护时想到生命。

gloss_zh: 干砌石墙；用散石垒成的乡间石墙

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wall built from loose stones fitted together without mortar, especially in the countryside.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由散石相互堆砌、不使用砂浆黏合而成的墙，尤指乡间的这种石墙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħajt mibni b'ġebel imqiegħed fuq xulxin mingħajr mehrież, speċjalment fil-kampanja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用不规则石块堆砌而成的石墙；此处指干砌石墙。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħajt magħmul minn ġebel ta' qisien u forom differenti, imqiegħed fuq xulxin mingħajr mehrież.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rubble wall is a wall made from irregular stones fitted together, here without mortar.

sense_translations.en_definition: country wall built out of loose stone
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在乡间用散石堆砌而成、不以砂浆黏合的石墙。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħajt fil-kampanja mibni b'ġebel maħlul li jitqiegħed fuq xulxin mingħajr mehrież biex jifforma ħajt stabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This is a countryside wall built by arranging loose stones together without using mortar.

formal.mt: Il-pjan jipprevedi t-tiswija ta' ħajt tas-sejjieħ tul il-mogħdija.
formal.en: The plan provides for the repair of a dry-stone wall along the path.
formal.zh: 该计划安排修补小路沿线的一道干砌石墙。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt il-ħajt tas-sejjieħ ħdejn l-għalqa? Pawlu: Iva, waqa' xi ġebel. Irridu nsewwuh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see the dry-stone wall beside the field? Pawlu: Yes, some stones have fallen. We need to repair it.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你看到田地旁那道干砌石墙了吗？保罗：看到了，有些石头掉下来了。我们得修一修。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 你看到田地旁那道干砌石墙了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the dry-stone wall beside the field?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, waqa' xi ġebel. Irridu nsewwuh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, waqa' xi ġebel. Irridu nsewwuh.
messages.zh: 看到了，有些石头掉下来了。我们得修一修。
messages.en: Yes, some stones have fallen. We need to repair it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象田边一块块石头直接垒成墙的画面，把整个短语记成乡间干砌石墙。

gloss_zh: 哈尔法尔，马耳他南部的一个地区

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ħal Far is the name of an area in the south of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: Ħal Far 是马耳他南部一个地区的名称，中文可音译为哈尔法尔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħal Far huwa l-isem ta' żona fin-Nofsinhar ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Area in the south of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 哈尔法尔，位于马耳他南部的一个地区。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħal Far huwa żona li tinsab fin-Nofsinhar ta' Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ħal Far is an area located in the southern part of Malta.

formal.mt: Iż-żjara ta' studju se ssir Ħal Far nhar il-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: The study visit will take place in Ħal Far on Friday.
formal.zh: 考察活动将于星期五在哈尔法尔进行。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn sejjer dalgħodu? Mark: Sejjer Ħal Far għax għandi laqgħa hemm.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where are you going this morning? Mark: I'm going to Ħal Far because I have a meeting there.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你今天早上要去哪里？马克：我要去哈尔法尔，因为我在那里有个会。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 你今天早上要去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going this morning?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejjer Ħal Far għax għandi laqgħa hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Sejjer Ħal Far għax għandi laqgħa hemm.
messages.zh: 我要去哈尔法尔，因为我在那里有个会。
messages.en: I'm going to Ħal Far because I have a meeting there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把哈尔法尔放在想象地图的南部，连着朗读 Ħal Far，并记住名称中间有空格。

gloss_zh: 哈尔阿沙克，马耳他南部的村庄

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ħal Għaxaq is the name of a village in the south of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 哈尔阿沙克，位于马耳他南部的一个村庄的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħal Għaxaq huwa l-isem ta' raħal fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Village in the south of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 哈尔阿沙克，位于马耳他南部的村庄。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħal Għaxaq huwa raħal li jinsab fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ħal Għaxaq is a village situated in the southern part of Malta.

collocations.zh: 到哈尔阿沙克的一次访问

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir f'Ħal Għaxaq, raħal fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in Ħal Għaxaq, a village in the south of Malta.
formal.zh: 会议将在马耳他南部的哈尔阿沙克村举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn toqgħod? Mark: Noqgħod f'Ħal Għaxaq. Maja: Huwa fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta? Mark: Iva.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where do you live? Mark: I live in Ħal Għaxaq. Maja: Is it in the south of Malta? Mark: Yes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你住在哪里？马克：我住在哈尔阿沙克。玛雅：是在马耳他南部吗？马克：是的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你住在哪里？
messages.en: Where do you live?

messages.speaker: Mark (居民)
messages.zh: 我住在哈尔阿沙克。
messages.en: I live in Ħal Għaxaq.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 是在马耳他南部吗？
messages.en: Is it in the south of Malta?

messages.speaker: Mark (居民)
messages.zh: 是的。
messages.en: Yes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ħal Għaxaq 整体当作地名记忆，配上“马耳他南部村庄”的地图标签，再用 f'Ħal Għaxaq 练习表达“在哈尔阿沙克”。

gloss_zh: 哈尔利亚，马耳他中部地区的村庄

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ħal Lija is the name of a village in Malta's central region.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 哈尔利亚，位于马耳他中部地区的一个村庄的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħal Lija huwa l-isem ta' raħal fir-reġjun ċentrali ta' Malta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哈尔利亚，位于马耳他中部地区的村庄。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħal Lija huwa raħal li jinsab fir-reġjun ċentrali ta' Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ħal Lija is a village situated in the central region of Malta.

collocations.zh: 到哈尔利亚的一次访问

formal.mt: Il-kors se jsir f'Ħal Lija, raħal fir-reġjun ċentrali ta' Malta.
formal.en: The course will take place in Ħal Lija, a village in Malta's central region.
formal.zh: 课程将在马耳他中部地区的哈尔利亚村举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu għada? Mark: F'Ħal Lija. Maja: Dak raħal fiċ-ċentru ta' Malta? Mark: Iva, hemmhekk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are we meeting tomorrow? Mark: In Ħal Lija. Maja: Is that a village in central Malta? Mark: Yes, that's the place.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们明天在哪里见面？马克：在哈尔利亚。玛雅：那是马耳他中部的一个村庄吗？马克：是的，就是那里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天在哪里见面？
messages.en: Where are we meeting tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在哈尔利亚。
messages.en: In Ħal Lija.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是马耳他中部的一个村庄吗？
messages.en: Is that a village in central Malta?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，就是那里。
messages.en: Yes, that's the place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ħal Lija 整体写在“马耳他中部”的地图卡片上，再用“明天在哈尔利亚见面”的场景练习 f'Ħal Lija，帮助同时记住地名和位置表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ħal Luqa is the name of a town in the south of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: Ħal Luqa 是马耳他南部城镇卢卡的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħal Luqa huwa isem ta' belt fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Town in the south of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 卢卡，位于马耳他南部的一座城镇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħal Luqa huwa belt li tinsab fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ħal Luqa is a town situated in the southern part of Malta.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir f'Ħal Luqa nhar it-Tnejn filgħodu.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in Ħal Luqa on Monday morning.
formal.zh: 会议将于星期一上午在卢卡举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejjer illum? Mark: Sejjer Ħal Luqa biex niltaqa' ma' ħabib.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going today? Mark: I'm going to Ħal Luqa to meet a friend.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你今天要去哪里？Mark：我要去卢卡见一个朋友。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天要去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejjer Ħal Luqa biex niltaqa' ma' ħabib.
messages.mt_standard: Sejjer Ħal Luqa biex niltaqa' ma' ħabib.
messages.zh: 我要去卢卡见一个朋友。
messages.en: I'm going to Ħal Luqa to meet a friend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ħal Luqa 整体记作地名“卢卡”，再用“住在 f'Ħal Luqa、前往 Ħal Luqa”两幅生活画面巩固记忆。

gloss_zh: 塔尔欣（马耳他南部城镇）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ħal Tarxien is the name of a town in the south of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: Ħal Tarxien 是马耳他南部城镇塔尔欣的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħal Tarxien huwa isem ta' belt fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: town in the south of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 塔尔欣，位于马耳他南部的一座城镇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħal Tarxien huwa belt li tinsab fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ħal Tarxien is a town situated in the southern part of Malta.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti se jiltaqgħu f'Ħal Tarxien qabel tibda ż-żjara.
formal.en: The participants will meet in Ħal Tarxien before the visit begins.
formal.zh: 参加者将在参观开始前于塔尔欣集合。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid iżżur Ħal Tarxien għada? Paul: Iva, nistgħu mmorru filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like to visit Ħal Tarxien tomorrow? Paul: Yes, we can go in the morning.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你明天想去塔尔欣看看吗？Paul：想，我们可以上午去。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天想去塔尔欣看看吗？
messages.en: Would you like to visit Ħal Tarxien tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Paul (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，我们可以上午去。
messages.en: Yes, we can go in the morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ħal Tarxien 整体记作“塔尔欣”，想象与朋友约好明早到访，用完整地名配合出行情景反复练习。

gloss_zh: 巴尔灿，马耳他中部的一座城镇

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ħal-Balzan is the name of a town in the central region of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: Ħal-Balzan 是马耳他中部一座城镇的名称，中文可音译为巴尔灿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħal-Balzan huwa l-isem ta' lokalità fir-reġjun ċentrali ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: town in the central region of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 巴尔灿，位于马耳他中部的一座城镇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħal-Balzan huwa lokalità li tinsab fir-reġjun ċentrali ta' Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ħal-Balzan is a town situated in the central region of Malta.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir Ħal-Balzan nhar it-Tnejn filgħodu.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in Ħal-Balzan on Monday morning.
formal.zh: 会议将于星期一上午在巴尔灿举行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn toqgħod? Daniel: Noqgħod Ħal-Balzan. Trid tiġi għal kafè s-Sibt?
colloquial.en: Sara: Where do you live? Daniel: I live in Ħal-Balzan. Would you like to come over for coffee on Saturday?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你住在哪里？丹尼尔：我住在巴尔灿。星期六想过来喝杯咖啡吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你住在哪里？
messages.en: Where do you live?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Noqgħod Ħal-Balzan. Trid tiġi għal kafè s-Sibt?
messages.mt_standard: Noqgħod Ħal-Balzan. Trid tiġi għal kafè s-Sibt?
messages.zh: 我住在巴尔灿。星期六想过来喝杯咖啡吗？
messages.en: I live in Ħal-Balzan. Would you like to come over for coffee on Saturday?

cognitive_memory_aid: 在想象的马耳他地图中部写上巴尔灿，再配读 Ħal-Balzan，用位置帮助记住地名。

gloss_zh: 容忍；姑息；对不当行为不予追究

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tolerate wrongdoing or allow it to pass without criticism or action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容忍或姑息错误、不当行为，没有提出批评或采取处理措施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tittollera żball jew imġiba ħażina mingħajr ma tikkritikahom jew tieħu azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容忍或姑息不当行为，对其不加谴责或不予追究。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li taċċetta jew tittollera mġiba ħażina mingħajr ma tikkundannaha jew tieħu azzjoni kontriha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone condones wrongdoing, they accept or tolerate it without expressing disapproval or taking action.

collocations.zh: 对一个小错误未予追究

collocations.en: condoned the breach of the rules
collocations.zh: 姑息了违反规则的行为

formal.mt: Il-maniġer ħalla jgħaddi l-ksur tar-regoli mingħajr ma ħa azzjoni kontra l-impjegat.
formal.en: The manager condoned the breach of the rules without taking action against the employee.
formal.zh: 经理姑息了违反规则的行为，没有对该员工采取处理措施。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kap ħalla jgħaddi dak l-iżball? Mark: Iva, din id-darba ma qal xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the boss let that mistake slide? Mark: Yes, this time he said nothing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：老板对那个错误就这么算了吗？马克：是啊，这次他什么也没说。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 老板对那个错误就这么算了吗？
messages.en: Did the boss let that mistake slide?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, din id-darba ma qal xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, din id-darba ma qal xejn.
messages.zh: 是啊，这次他什么也没说。
messages.en: Yes, this time he said nothing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个错误从眼前过去，负责人却没有制止或追究；用这个画面把 ħalla jgħaddi 与“姑息、放过”联系起来，例句中的形式表示过去的行为。

gloss_zh: 腾出地方；搬离并交出场所

teaching_sense.en_definition: To leave a place so that it is no longer occupied by you and becomes available for others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 离开原先占用的地方，将其腾空或交出，使他人可以使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li titlaq minn post li kont tokkupa u tħallih vojt jew disponibbli għal ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 搬离或离开所占用的场所，将其腾出。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tieqaf tokkupa post billi titlaq minnu u tħallih disponibbli għal ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone vacates a place, they leave it so that it becomes available for someone else to use.

collocations.zh: 在中午之前腾出了场所

formal.mt: Il-kerrej ħalla l-post fid-data miftiehma u ta ċ-ċwievet lis-sid.
formal.en: The tenant vacated the premises on the agreed date and gave the keys to the landlord.
formal.zh: 租客在约定日期搬离了房屋，并将钥匙交给房东。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kerrej ħalla l-post? Mark: Iva, u diġà ta ċ-ċwievet lura.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the tenant vacated the place? Mark: Yes, and he has already returned the keys.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：租客已经搬走、把地方腾出来了吗？马克：是的，而且他已经归还钥匙了。

messages.speaker: Maja (房东)
messages.zh: 租客已经搬走、把地方腾出来了吗？
messages.en: Has the tenant vacated the place?

messages.speaker: Mark (房屋管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u diġà ta ċ-ċwievet lura.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u diġà ta ċ-ċwievet lura.
messages.zh: 是的，而且他已经归还钥匙了。
messages.en: Yes, and he has already returned the keys.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħalla l-post 配上“搬走行李、交还钥匙、腾出房间”的连续画面，记住这里强调结束占用；例句中的形式表示已经腾出了地方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone who is ħaltejn feels unwilling or hesitant about doing something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人对做某事不太情愿，或因犹豫而不愿立即行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li ma jkunx jixtieq jagħmel xi ħaġa jew li joqgħod lura milli jagħmilha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不情愿的；对做某事有所犹豫、缺乏意愿的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li ma tkunx lesta tagħmel xi ħaġa minn jeddha jew li toqgħod lura għax ma tkunx trid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is reluctant, they are unwilling or hesitant to do something.

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant kien ħaltejn biex jaċċetta l-proposta mingħajr aktar tagħrif.
formal.en: The representative was reluctant to accept the proposal without further information.
formal.zh: 在没有更多资料的情况下，该代表不太愿意接受这项提议。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Se taċċetta l-istedina? Mark: Għadni ħaltejn biex naċċetta; ma naf lil ħadd hemm.
colloquial.en: Anna: Are you going to accept the invitation? Mark: I'm still reluctant to accept; I don't know anyone there.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你打算接受邀请吗？Mark：我还是有点不情愿；那里的人我一个也不认识。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算接受邀请吗？
messages.en: Are you going to accept the invitation?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ħaltejn biex naċċetta; ma naf lil ħadd hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ħaltejn biex naċċetta; ma naf lil ħadd hemm.
messages.zh: 我还是有点不情愿；那里的人我一个也不认识。
messages.en: I'm still reluctant to accept; I don't know anyone there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ħaltejn 时，想象收到邀请却迟迟不答应的人；把这种“不太愿意”的心情与 ħaltejn biex naċċetta 一起记。

gloss_zh: 粗俗的东西；粗鄙的言行

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ħamallata is something, such as a remark or an act, that is considered crude or vulgar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被认为粗俗或粗鄙的东西，也可指这类言语或行为，带有贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħamallata hija xi ħaġa, bħal kumment jew għemil, li titqies baxxa, vulgari jew bla manjieri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗俗或粗鄙的事物、言语或行为，通常表示说话者的贬斥。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħamallata hija ħaġa jew azzjoni meqjusa vulgari, baxxa jew nieqsa minn manjieri tajbin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you describe something as a ħamallata, you consider it crude or vulgar.

collocations.en: to do something crude or vulgar
to say something crude or vulgar

formal.mt: Fir-reċensjoni, il-kritiku ddeskriva ċ-ċajta bħala ħamallata li ma kinitx xierqa għall-okkażjoni.
formal.en: In the review, the critic described the joke as something vulgar that was unsuitable for the occasion.
formal.zh: 评论中，评论者将这个笑话形容为不适合该场合的粗俗内容。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma għoġbitekx iċ-ċajta? Paul: Għax kienet ħamallata; ma kienx hemm għalfejn jgħidha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't you like the joke? Paul: Because it was vulgar; there was no need for him to tell it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么不喜欢那个笑话？Paul：因为它很粗俗；他根本没必要讲。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不喜欢那个笑话？
messages.en: Why didn't you like the joke?

messages.speaker: Paul (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kienet ħamallata; ma kienx hemm għalfejn jgħidha.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kienet ħamallata; ma kienx hemm għalfejn jgħidha.
messages.zh: 因为它很粗俗；他根本没必要讲。
messages.en: Because it was vulgar; there was no need for him to tell it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħamallata 联想到一个让听众皱眉的粗俗笑话，记住它是给粗俗事物或言行下评价的名词，并带有贬义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The colour red, considered as a colour in its own right.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 红色，指作为一种颜色的红。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħambra hija l-kulur aħmar, meqjus bħala kulur fih innifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 红色；红这种颜色。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħambra hija l-kulur aħmar, bħall-kulur tad-demm.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Red is the colour of blood and of many ripe tomatoes.

formal.mt: L-artist uża l-ħambra biex jiġbed l-attenzjoni lejn iċ-ċentru tal-pittura.
formal.en: The artist used red to draw attention to the centre of the painting.
formal.zh: 画家用红色将观者的注意力引向画面中心。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema kulur trid għall-isfond? Rita: Irrid sfumatura ta' ħambra, għax inħobb l-aħmar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What colour do you want for the background? Rita: I want a shade of red, because I like red.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想用什么颜色做背景？丽塔：我想用一种红色色调，因为我喜欢红色。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想用什么颜色做背景？
messages.en: What colour do you want for the background?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid sfumatura ta' ħambra, għax inħobb l-aħmar.
messages.mt_standard: Irrid sfumatura ta' ħambra, għax inħobb l-aħmar.
messages.zh: 我想用一种红色色调，因为我喜欢红色。
messages.en: I want a shade of red, because I like red.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħambra 写在红色色卡上，看到色卡就读词，建立词形与红色的直接联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mourning dove, a bird whose soft call sounds mournful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 哀鸽，一种叫声柔和、听起来带有哀伤感的鸽类鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħamiema tal-luttu hija għasfur tat-tip tal-ħamiem li għandu għajta ratba li tinstema' mnikkta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哀鸽，一种以柔和而似哀鸣的叫声为特点的鸽类鸟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħamiema tal-luttu hija tip ta' ħamiema magħrufa għall-għajta ratba tagħha li tinstema' bħal ilment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mourning dove is a dove whose soft call has a sad, mournful sound.

collocations.en: the call of the mourning dove
a mourning dove on a branch

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar, l-istudenti raw ħamiema tal-luttu fuq fergħa u semgħu l-għajta tagħha.
formal.en: During the birdwatching activity, the students saw a mourning dove on a branch and heard its call.
formal.zh: 在观鸟活动中，学生们看见树枝上有一只哀鸽，并听到了它的叫声。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa? Pawlu: Dik ħamiema tal-luttu. Isma' l-għajta tagħha!
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that bird on the branch? Pawlu: That is a mourning dove. Listen to its call!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：树枝上那是什么鸟？保罗：那是一只哀鸽。听听它的叫声！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 树枝上那是什么鸟？
messages.en: What is that bird on the branch?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik ħamiema tal-luttu. Isma' l-għajta tagħha!
messages.mt_standard: Dik ħamiema tal-luttu. Isma' l-għajta tagħha!
messages.zh: 那是一只哀鸽。听听它的叫声！
messages.en: That is a mourning dove. Listen to its call!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组与一只轻声哀鸣的鸽子配图记忆，借助声音场景记住鸟名“哀鸽”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a physical or mental disability that can affect everyday activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有身体或精神方面的残疾，日常活动可能因此受到影响的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħandikappat jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li għandu diżabilità fiżika jew mentali li tista' taffettwa l-attivitajiet ta' kuljum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有残疾的，指有身体或精神方面的残疾。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna ħandikappata hija persuna li għandha diżabilità fiżika jew mentali li tista' tillimita ċerti attivitajiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is disabled has a physical or mental disability that may affect their daily activities.

formal.mt: L-istudent ħandikappat talab li l-materjal tal-kors ikun disponibbli f'format aċċessibbli.
formal.en: The disabled student requested that the course material be available in an accessible format.
formal.zh: 这名有残疾的学生要求提供无障碍格式的课程材料。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Jien ħandikappat u nuża siġġu tar-roti. Hemm lift hawn? Sara: Iva, il-lift qiegħed ħdejn ir-riċeviment.
colloquial.en: Mark: I am disabled and use a wheelchair. Is there a lift here? Sara: Yes, the lift is beside reception.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我有残疾，使用轮椅。这里有电梯吗？萨拉：有，电梯就在接待处旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien ħandikappat u nuża siġġu tar-roti. Hemm lift hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Jien ħandikappat u nuża siġġu tar-roti. Hemm lift hawn?
messages.zh: 我有残疾，使用轮椅。这里有电梯吗？
messages.en: I am disabled and use a wheelchair. Is there a lift here?

messages.speaker: Sara (接待员)
messages.zh: 有，电梯就在接待处旁边。
messages.en: Yes, the lift is beside reception.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħandikappat 放进询问无障碍设施的场景中记忆；同时对照 student ħandikappat 和 persuna ħandikappata 的词尾。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shop where books are sold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出售书籍的商店。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħanut fejn jinbiegħu kotba ta' diversi tipi u dwar suġġetti differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 书店；供人选购书籍的商店。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħanut fejn in-nies jistgħu jagħżlu u jixtru l-kotba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bookstore is a shop where people go to browse and buy books.

formal.mt: L-istudenti jistgħu jixtru l-kotba meħtieġa għall-kors mill-ħanut tal-kotba ħdejn l-università.
formal.en: Students can buy the books required for the course from the bookstore near the university.
formal.zh: 学生可以在大学附近的书店购买课程所需的书籍。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xtrajt dan il-ktieb mill-ħanut tal-kotba? Sara: Iva, u hemmhekk sibt ukoll dizzjunarju tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did you buy this book from the bookstore? Sara: Yes, and I also found a good dictionary there.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这本书是你在书店买的吗？萨拉：是的，我还在那里找到了一本不错的词典。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 这本书是你在书店买的吗？
messages.en: Did you buy this book from the bookstore?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u hemmhekk sibt ukoll dizzjunarju tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u hemmhekk sibt ukoll dizzjunarju tajjeb.
messages.zh: 是的，我还在那里找到了一本不错的词典。
messages.en: Yes, and I also found a good dictionary there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħanut 想成一家商店，再把货架装满 kotba（书籍）；看到 ħanut tal-kotba，就联想到进书店翻书、买词典的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shop where sweets and other confectionery are sold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出售糖果及其他甜食的商店。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħanut fejn jinbiegħu l-ħelu u prodotti oħra ħelwin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 糖果店；出售糖果和其他甜食的商店。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħanut li jbigħ il-ħelu, bħaċ-ċikkulata u l-karamelli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A confectionery is a shop where you can buy sweets, chocolates, and similar treats.

formal.mt: Il-ħanut tal-ħelu joffri għażla ta' ċikkulata u karamelli għal okkażjonijiet speċjali.
formal.en: The sweet shop offers a selection of chocolates and sweets for special occasions.
formal.zh: 这家糖果店提供适合特殊场合的各式巧克力和糖果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm ħanut tal-ħelu fil-qrib? Nixtieq nixtri ftit ħelu. Lara: Iva, hemm wieħed ħdejn il-pjazza. Nistgħu mmorru flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there a sweet shop nearby? I'd like to buy some sweets. Lara: Yes, there's one next to the square. We can go together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：附近有糖果店吗？我想买点糖果。拉拉：有，广场旁边就有一家。我们可以一起去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ħanut tal-ħelu fil-qrib? Nixtieq nixtri ftit ħelu.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ħanut tal-ħelu fil-qrib? Nixtieq nixtri ftit ħelu.
messages.zh: 附近有糖果店吗？我想买点糖果。
messages.en: Is there a sweet shop nearby? I'd like to buy some sweets.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm wieħed ħdejn il-pjazza. Nistgħu mmorru flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm wieħed ħdejn il-pjazza. Nistgħu mmorru flimkien.
messages.zh: 有，广场旁边就有一家。我们可以一起去。
messages.en: Yes, there's one next to the square. We can go together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħanut 想成一家商店，再给橱窗摆满 ħelu（糖果、甜食）；看到 ħanut tal-ħelu，就联想到走进糖果店挑巧克力的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shop that sells tools and materials for household repairs and maintenance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出售工具及房屋维修、保养所需材料的商店。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħanut li jbigħ għodod u materjal għat-tiswijiet u għall-manutenzjoni tad-dar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 五金店；出售工具和日常维修材料的商店。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħanut fejn jinbiegħu għodod u materjal li jintużaw biex isiru tiswijiet fid-dar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hardware store is a shop where you can buy tools and materials for repairing and maintaining your home.

collocations.en: buy tools from a hardware store

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem xtara martell u kaxxa viti mill-ħanut taż-żebgħa biex isewwi l-bieb.
formal.en: The worker bought a hammer and a box of screws from the hardware store to repair the door.
formal.zh: 工人从五金店买了一把锤子和一盒螺丝，用来修门。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn nista' nixtri martell? Mark: Mill-ħanut taż-żebgħa ħdejn il-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where can I buy a hammer? Mark: From the hardware store next to the square.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我在哪里可以买到锤子？马克：广场旁边的五金店就有。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在哪里可以买到锤子？
messages.en: Where can I buy a hammer?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 广场旁边的五金店就有。
messages.en: From the hardware store next to the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组与“去五金店买锤子和螺丝”的画面绑定，再用购买工具的例句反复练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adult female pig.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成年雌性猪，即母猪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħanżir ta' sess femminili li jkun laħaq l-età adulta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 母猪；成年的雌性猪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħanżir femminili adult li jista' jwelled u jredda' l-qżieqeż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sow is an adult female pig, especially one kept on a farm to produce piglets.

formal.mt: Il-bidwi żamm il-ħanżira u l-qżieqeż tagħha f'post nadif u sħun.
formal.en: The farmer kept the sow and her piglets in a clean, warm place.
formal.zh: 农民把母猪和它的小猪安置在一个干净、温暖的地方。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hi l-ħanżira? Pawlu: Hemm, ħdejn il-qżieqeż tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the sow? Pawlu: Over there, next to her piglets.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：母猪在哪里？保罗：在那边，就在它的小猪旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (农场访客)
messages.zh: 母猪在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the sow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.zh: 在那边，就在它的小猪旁边。
messages.en: Over there, next to her piglets.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象农场里一头母猪带着一群小猪，把 ħanżira 与“成年雌性猪”的画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A brief greeting corresponding to English 'hi'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示见面时简短招呼的用语，对应英语的“hi”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tislima qasira li tintuża meta tiltaqa' ma' xi ħadd, bħall-kelma Ingliża 'hi'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嗨；用于向人打招呼的简短问候语。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma qasira ta' tislima li biha ssellem lil xi ħadd meta tiltaqa' miegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A greeting of this kind is a short expression used when you meet or acknowledge someone.

collocations.en: the use of 'ħarag' as a greeting

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-kelma 'ħarag' għandha t-tifsira tat-tislima Ingliża 'hi'.
formal.en: In this exercise, the word 'ħarag' has the meaning of the English greeting 'hi'.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，“ħarag”的含义对应英语招呼语“hi”。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'ħarag' hawn? Mark: Hawn tfisser tislima qasira, bħal 'hi' bl-Ingliż.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ħarag' mean here? Mark: Here it means a short greeting, like 'hi' in English.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的“ħarag”是什么意思？马克：这里指简短的招呼语，就像英语的“hi”。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的“ħarag”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ħarag' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser tislima qasira, bħal 'hi' bl-Ingliż.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser tislima qasira, bħal 'hi' bl-Ingliż.
messages.zh: 这里指简短的招呼语，就像英语的“hi”。
messages.en: Here it means a short greeting, like 'hi' in English.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本条给定词义，把 ħarag 写在挥手问好的图旁，联想中文“嗨”和英语 hi。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fish that is very small in size.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体形非常小的鱼；此处不限定具体鱼种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta li tkun żgħira ħafna fid-daqs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体形极小的鱼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħuta ta' daqs żgħir ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fish described this way is particularly small in size.

collocations.en: a very small fish near the shore
a very small fish in shallow water
collocations.zh: 浅水中的一条极小的鱼

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-kosta, l-istudent ra ħarbux jgħum fl-ilma baxx ħdejn ix-xatt.
formal.en: While observing the coast, the student saw a very small fish swimming in the shallow water near the shore.
formal.zh: 观察海岸时，学生看到一条极小的鱼在岸边的浅水中游动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak il-ħarbux ħdejn il-blata! Mark: Rajtu! Kemm hu żgħir!
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that tiny fish beside the rock! Mark: I see it! It's so small!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看岩石旁边那条小小的鱼！马克：看到了！它可真小！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看岩石旁边那条小小的鱼！
messages.en: Look at that tiny fish beside the rock!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了！它可真小！
messages.en: I see it! It's so small!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象浅水里一条小得需要凑近才看清的鱼，把 ħarbux 和“极小的鱼”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To look fixedly at someone or something for some time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把目光持续停留在某人或某物上，目不转睛地看。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħares fiss lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa għal xi żmien mingħajr ma jwarrab ħarstu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盯着某人或某物看，目光长时间不移开。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iżomm ħarstu fissa fuq xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa għal xi żmien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you stare at someone or something, you look at them fixedly for some time.

formal.mt: Wara li qara l-aħbar, ir-raġel ħares ċass lejn l-iskrin għal diversi sekondi mingħajr ma tkellem.
formal.en: After reading the news, the man stared at the screen for several seconds without speaking.
formal.zh: 读完消息后，男子盯着屏幕看了好几秒，没有说话。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu ħares ċass lejn il-bieb? Rita: Kien qed jistenna lil oħtu tidħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu stare at the door? Rita: He was waiting for his sister to come in.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么一直盯着门看？丽塔：他在等他姐姐或妹妹进来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu ħares ċass lejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu ħares ċass lejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么一直盯着门看？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu stare at the door?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien qed jistenna lil oħtu tidħol.
messages.mt_standard: Kien qed jistenna lil oħtu tidħol.
messages.zh: 他在等他姐姐或妹妹进来。
messages.en: He was waiting for his sister to come in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象目光像被固定在屏幕上一样移不开，用这个画面记住 ħares ċass 的“盯着看”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Skin damage caused by too much exposure to sunlight, often producing redness and pain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 皮肤因过度暴露于阳光而受到的损伤，常表现为发红和疼痛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsara fil-ġilda kkawżata minn espożizzjoni żejda għax-xemx, li spiss iġġib ħmura u wġigħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阳光过度照射造成的皮肤损伤，通常伴有红肿或疼痛。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li fiha l-ġilda ssir ħamra jew tweġġa' wara li tkun esposta żżejjed għax-xemx.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sunburn is damage to your skin caused by spending too much time in the sun.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport irreġistra każ ta' ħarqa tax-xemx wara attività twila fil-beraħ.
formal.en: The report recorded a case of sunburn following a lengthy outdoor activity.
formal.zh: 报告记录了一例在长时间户外活动后出现的晒伤。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex għandek spallejk ħomor? Luqa: Għandi ħarqa tax-xemx. Ilbieraħ domt wisq fuq il-bajja.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are your shoulders red? Luqa: I've got sunburn. I spent too long at the beach yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你的肩膀为什么红了？卢卡：我晒伤了。昨天在海滩待得太久了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的肩膀为什么红了？
messages.en: Why are your shoulders red?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ħarqa tax-xemx. Ilbieraħ domt wisq fuq il-bajja.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ħarqa tax-xemx. Ilbieraħ domt wisq fuq il-bajja.
messages.zh: 我晒伤了。昨天在海滩待得太久了。
messages.en: I've got sunburn. I spent too long at the beach yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把海滩、烈日和发红的肩膀连成一幅画面，用整个短语记住“晒伤”这一皮肤状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who protects someone or watches over a person or place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责保护某人，或照看某人、看守某个场所的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tipproteġi lil xi ħadd jew li tieħu ħsieb is-sigurtà ta' persuna jew ta' post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 保护他人、使其免受伤害的守护者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tħares lil xi ħadd mill-periklu u tieħu ħsieb il-protezzjoni tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A guardian is someone who protects another person and helps keep them safe.

sense_translations.en_definition: someone who watches over a place or person
sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责留意某个场所或某人的情况、保障其安全的看守人或照看者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li żżomm għajnejha fuq post jew fuq xi ħadd biex tiżgura s-sigurtà u tinduna b'xi problema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who watches over a place or person pays attention to their safety and notices possible problems.

collocations.en: a person who watches over the building

formal.mt: Il-ħarries tal-bini jissorvelja d-daħla u jirrapporta kull problema lill-amministrazzjoni.
formal.en: The person watching over the building monitors the entrance and reports any problems to the administration.
formal.zh: 建筑物的看守人负责留意入口情况，并向管理部门报告任何问题。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min joqgħod hawn billejl? Toni: Il-ħarries. Hu jieħu ħsieb il-bini sakemm nerġgħu niftħu filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who stays here at night? Toni: The guard. He watches over the building until we open again in the morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：晚上谁留在这里？托尼：看守人。他会照看这栋楼，直到我们早上重新开门。

messages.speaker: Sara (新员工)
messages.zh: 晚上谁留在这里？
messages.en: Who stays here at night?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħarries. Hu jieħu ħsieb il-bini sakemm nerġgħu niftħu filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħarries. Hu jieħu ħsieb il-bini sakemm nerġgħu niftħu filgħodu.
messages.zh: 看守人。他会照看这栋楼，直到我们早上重新开门。
messages.en: The guard. He watches over the building until we open again in the morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象夜里有人留在门口守护大家：保护人时记“守护者”，照看场所时记“看守人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particular edition of a newspaper published on a particular date.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 报纸在某个日期出版的一期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Edizzjoni partikolari ta' ġurnal ippubblikata f'data speċifika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 报纸按出版日期区分的某一期。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Waħda mill-edizzjonijiet ta' ġurnal, identifikata bid-data tal-pubblikazzjoni tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An issue of a newspaper is the edition published on a particular date.

collocations.en: the latest issue of a newspaper
an issue of a local newspaper

formal.mt: Il-librerija żammet ħarġa ta' ġurnal lokali bħala dokument tal-avvenimenti ta' dak il-jum.
formal.en: The library kept an issue of a local newspaper as a record of that day's events.
formal.zh: 图书馆保存了一期地方报纸，作为当天事件的记录。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek il-ħarġa tal-ġurnal tal-bieraħ? Mark: Iva, qiegħda fuq il-mejda. Tista' teħodha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have yesterday's issue of the newspaper? Mark: Yes, it's on the table. You can take it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有昨天那期报纸吗？马克：有，在桌上。你可以拿走。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有昨天那期报纸吗？
messages.en: Do you have yesterday's issue of the newspaper?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħda fuq il-mejda. Tista' teħodha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħda fuq il-mejda. Tista' teħodha.
messages.zh: 有，在桌上。你可以拿走。
messages.en: Yes, it's on the table. You can take it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象报纸上印着出版日期：这个短语指按日期区分的“一期报纸”，把整组词和日期一起记。

gloss_zh: 账单金额过高带来的震惊

teaching_sense.en_definition: The shock someone experiences when a bill is much higher than expected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 收到账单时，因应付金额远高于预期而产生的震惊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħasda li persuna tieħu meta tirċievi kont b'ammont ħafna ogħla milli kienet tistenna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因账单金额出乎意料地高而产生的震惊。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reazzjoni ta' sorpriża u tħassib meta l-ammont ta' kont ikun ferm ogħla milli kien mistenni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Bill shock is the surprise and concern you feel when a bill is much higher than you expected.

collocations.en: shock at an unexpectedly high electricity bill
collocations.zh: 被意外高昂的电费账单吓一跳
避免因账单金额过高而吃惊

formal.mt: Biex tevita ħasda bil-kont, iċċekkja l-prezz totali tas-servizz qabel tikkonferma l-ordni.
formal.en: To avoid bill shock, check the total price of the service before confirming the order.
formal.zh: 为避免收到账单时被金额吓到，请在确认订单前核实服务总价。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħadt ħasda bil-kont tad-dawl! Mark: Kemm ġie? Maja: Kważi d-doppju tax-xahar li għadda.
colloquial.en: Maja: The electricity bill gave me a shock! Mark: How much was it? Maja: Almost twice as much as last month.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电费账单吓了我一跳！马克：多少钱？玛雅：差不多是上个月的两倍。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 电费账单吓了我一跳！
messages.en: The electricity bill gave me a shock!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 多少钱？
messages.en: How much was it?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 差不多是上个月的两倍。
messages.en: Almost twice as much as last month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开电费账单，看到金额翻倍而瞪大眼睛，把整个短语记成“账单吓一跳”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel someone's absence and wish that they were still present.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某人不在身边而感到失落、想念对方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħass in-nuqqas ta' persuna li ma kinitx preżenti u xtaq li tkun miegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 想念不在身边的人，因对方的离开或缺席而感到失落。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħass in-nuqqas ta' xi ħadd li kien 'il bogħod jew li ma baqax preżenti f'ħajtu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone misses another person, they feel sad about that person's absence and wish they were together.

formal.mt: Wara li ħabibu mar jgħix barra minn Malta, Pawlu ħass it-telfa tiegħu, speċjalment fi tmiem il-ġimgħa.
formal.en: After his friend moved abroad, Pawlu missed him, especially at weekends.
formal.zh: 朋友搬到国外生活后，保罗很想念他，尤其是在周末。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif kien Pawlu wara li telaq ħuh? Nina: Ħass it-telfa tiegħu ħafna. Lara: Mela nistednuh joħroġ magħna.
colloquial.en: Lara: How was Pawlu after his brother left? Nina: He missed him very much. Lara: Then let's invite him out with us.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：保罗的兄弟离开后，他怎么样？妮娜：他非常想念对方。劳拉：那我们邀请他一起出去吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kien Pawlu wara li telaq ħuh?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kien Pawlu wara li telaq ħuh?
messages.zh: 保罗的兄弟离开后，他怎么样？
messages.en: How was Pawlu after his brother left?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 他非常想念对方。
messages.en: He missed him very much.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们邀请他一起出去吧。
messages.en: Then let's invite him out with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友离开后留下的空椅子，用“看见空位就想念”来记住这个表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The fleshy back part of the body that a person sits on.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人体背面下方、坐下时承托身体的臀部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti mlaħħma ta' wara tal-ġisem li persuna toqgħod bilqiegħda fuqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 屁股；臀部，即坐下时接触座面的身体部位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-warrani ta' persuna, jiġifieri l-parti ta' wara tal-ġisem li tistrieħ fuq is-siġġu meta toqgħod bilqiegħda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your butt is the fleshy part at the back of your body that you sit on.

formal.mt: Meta persuna toqgħod bilqiegħda għal ħin twil, kuxxin jista' jgħin biex inaqqas il-pressjoni fuq il-ħawħgħb.
formal.en: When someone sits for a long time, a cushion can help reduce pressure on their buttocks.
formal.zh: 长时间坐着时，坐垫可以帮助减轻臀部承受的压力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed toqgħod bilwieqfa? Mark: Għandi uġigħ fil-ħawħgħb wara li qgħadt fuq dak il-bank iebes. Maja: Ħu dan il-kuxxin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you standing? Mark: My butt hurts after sitting on that hard bench. Maja: Take this cushion.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么站着？马克：坐了那条硬长凳之后，我屁股疼。玛雅：拿这个坐垫吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么站着？
messages.en: Why are you standing?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi uġigħ fil-ħawħgħb wara li qgħadt fuq dak il-bank iebes.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi uġigħ fil-ħawħgħb wara li qgħadt fuq dak il-bank iebes.
messages.zh: 坐了那条硬长凳之后，我屁股疼。
messages.en: My butt hurts after sitting on that hard bench.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)

messages.en: Take this cushion.

gloss_zh: 像桃子的；与桃有关的；形容肛交参与者的（常含贬意）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Resembling peaches in appearance or another quality, or relating to peaches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在外观、气味等特征上像桃子的，或与桃有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jixbah il-ħawħ f'xi karatteristika, bħall-kulur jew ir-riħa, jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ħawħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 像桃子的，或与桃有关的；可描述颜色、气味等特征。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu xi karatteristika li tixbah lil tal-ħawħ, jew li hu marbut mal-ħawħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described this way resembles peaches in some quality or has a connection with peaches.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于形容被称为肛交参与者的人，常带有贬损意味。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi persuna bħala waħda li tipprattika s-sess anali, spiss b'tifsira dispreġġjattiva.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When applied to a person in this sense, the word characterizes them as engaging in anal sex, often disparagingly.

formal.mt: Id-disinjatur għażel lewn ħawħi għall-ħitan biex jagħti lill-kamra dehra sħuna u ratba.
formal.en: The designer chose a peach-like shade for the walls to give the room a warm, soft appearance.
formal.zh: 设计师为墙面选择了桃色的色调，让房间显得温暖柔和。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema lewn tippreferi għall-kamra? Lara: Dan il-lewn ħawħi jogħġobni ħafna. Sara: Iva, jidher sabiħ ħdejn il-purtieri bojod.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which shade do you prefer for the room? Lara: I really like this peach-like shade. Sara: Yes, it looks lovely next to the white curtains.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：房间用哪种色调你更喜欢？劳拉：我很喜欢这个桃色的色调。萨拉：是啊，配上白色窗帘很好看。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 房间用哪种色调你更喜欢？
messages.en: Which shade do you prefer for the room?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 我很喜欢这个桃色的色调。
messages.en: I really like this peach-like shade.

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jidher sabiħ ħdejn il-purtieri bojod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jidher sabiħ ħdejn il-purtieri bojod.
messages.zh: 是啊，配上白色窗帘很好看。
messages.en: Yes, it looks lovely next to the white curtains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把桃色墙面和桃子香气画在第一张词义卡上；涉及人的另一义另做卡片，按语境分开记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Plants growing where they are not wanted, especially among cultivated plants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长在不希望其生长的地方，尤其是栽培植物之间的杂草。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanti li jikbru fejn ma jkunux mixtieqa, speċjalment qalb il-pjanti kkultivati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长在田地、花园等处，需要清除的杂草。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħaxix ħażin huwa pjanti li jikbru f'postijiet fejn ma jkunux mixtieqa u li jistgħu jfixklu t-tkabbir tal-pjanti kkultivati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Weeds are plants that grow where they are not wanted, often among flowers or crops.

formal.mt: Il-ġardinara neħħew il-ħaxix ħażin minn madwar is-siġar żgħar biex dawn ikunu jistgħu jikbru aħjar.
formal.en: The gardeners removed the weeds from around the young trees so that the trees could grow better.
formal.zh: 园丁清除了小树周围的杂草，让小树能够长得更好。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed taqla' dawk il-pjanti? Pawlu: Dak ħaxix ħażin. Irrid inneħħih minn qalb il-fjuri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you pulling out those plants? Pawlu: Those are weeds. I want to remove them from among the flowers.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么在拔那些植物？Pawlu：那些是杂草。我想把它们从花丛里清除掉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在拔那些植物？
messages.en: Why are you pulling out those plants?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ħaxix ħażin. Irrid inneħħih minn qalb il-fjuri.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ħaxix ħażin. Irrid inneħħih minn qalb il-fjuri.
messages.zh: 那些是杂草。我想把它们从花丛里清除掉。
messages.en: Those are weeds. I want to remove them from among the flowers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与花丛中需要拔掉的杂草画面绑定，练习说“拔除杂草”来记住它。

gloss_zh: 育肥者；使动物长膘的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes something fatter, for example by feeding livestock.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变肥的人，例如通过喂养使牲畜长膘的育肥者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ssemmen xi ħaġa, pereżempju billi titma' l-bhejjem biex jiżdiedu fil-piż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物变肥的人；例如负责喂养牲畜，使其增重长膘的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaxxien huwa xi ħadd li jġiegħel lil xi ħaġa tissemmen, bħal persuna li titma' l-bhejjem biex dawn jiżdiedu fil-piż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fattener is someone who makes something fatter, for example by feeding animals so that they gain weight.

formal.mt: Il-ħaxxien tal-bhejjem jagħżel l-għalf u jsegwi ż-żieda fil-piż tal-annimali.
formal.en: The livestock fattener selects the feed and monitors the animals' weight gain.
formal.zh: 牲畜育肥者选择饲料，并监测动物的增重情况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'xogħol jagħmel Ġużeppi fir-razzett? Mark: Jaħdem bħala ħaxxien tal-bhejjem. Jitmagħhom biex jiżdiedu fil-piż.
colloquial.en: Sara: What work does Ġużeppi do on the farm? Mark: He works as a livestock fattener. He feeds the animals so that they gain weight.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Ġużeppi在农场做什么工作？Mark：他负责牲畜育肥，给动物喂食，让它们增重。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Ġużeppi在农场做什么工作？
messages.en: What work does Ġużeppi do on the farm?

messages.speaker: Mark (农场工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Jaħdem bħala ħaxxien tal-bhejjem. Jitmagħhom biex jiżdiedu fil-piż.
messages.mt_standard: Jaħdem bħala ħaxxien tal-bhejjem. Jitmagħhom biex jiżdiedu fil-piż.
messages.zh: 他负责牲畜育肥，给动物喂食，让它们增重。
messages.en: He works as a livestock fattener. He feeds the animals so that they gain weight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位每天配饲料、给牲畜称体重的育肥者，把这个人的工作画面与词形一起记住。

gloss_zh: 谜语；令人费解的问题，谜题

teaching_sense.en_definition: A question or problem whose answer must be discovered through careful thought.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 需要通过思考、推理或理解暗示才能找到答案的谜语或谜题。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mistoqsija jew problema li trid taħseb sew dwarha biex issib it-tweġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谜语：以暗示或巧妙措辞提出、让人猜出答案的问题。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mistoqsija magħmula bi kliem li jagħti ħjiel mingħajr ma jikxef it-tweġiba, biex min jismagħha jipprova jaqtagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A riddle is a question that uses clues or unusual wording to make you guess its answer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谜题；需要仔细思考或推理才能解决的难题。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Problema jew sitwazzjoni li mhix faċli biex tifhimha u li teħtieġ ħsieb biex issib soluzzjoni għaliha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A puzzle is a problem or confusing situation that requires careful thought to understand or solve.

formal.mt: L-għalliema ppreżentat ħaġa moħġaġa lill-istudenti u talbithom jispjegaw kif waslu għat-tweġiba.
formal.en: The teacher presented the students with a riddle and asked them to explain how they reached the answer.
formal.zh: 老师给学生们出了一道谜语，并要求他们解释自己是怎样得出答案的。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid nipprova ngħidlek ħaġa moħġaġa? Ben: Iva, imma tagħtinix it-tweġiba mill-ewwel!
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall I try giving you a riddle? Ben: Yes, but don't give me the answer straight away!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：要不要我给你出个谜语？本：好啊，不过别马上告诉我答案！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 要不要我给你出个谜语？
messages.en: Shall I try giving you a riddle?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 好啊，不过别马上告诉我答案！
messages.en: Yes, but don't give me the answer straight away!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和“猜谜”场景一起记：一个人出题，另一个人动脑找答案；既可指谜语，也可指费解的谜题。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small green plant without flowers that often grows in soft patches in damp places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种没有花的小型绿色植物，常在潮湿处成片生长，形成柔软的覆盖层。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta żgħira ħadra mingħajr fjuri li spiss tikber f'saffi rotob f'postijiet niedja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苔藓；常在潮湿的石头、树干或地面上成片生长的小型无花绿色植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħażiż huwa pjanta żgħira ħadra mingħajr fjuri li tikber f'postijiet niedja, bħal fuq il-ġebel, iz-zkuk tas-siġar jew l-art.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Moss is a small green plant without flowers that often forms soft patches on damp surfaces.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苔藓；常在潮湿表面形成柔软绿色覆盖层的小型无花植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħażiż huwa pjanta żgħira bla fjuri li spiss tifforma saff aħdar u artab fuq uċuħ niedja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Moss is a small flowerless plant that commonly grows in green patches on damp ground, rocks, or tree trunks.

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw saff ta' ħażiż fuq il-ġebel niedi ħdejn in-nixxiegħa.
formal.en: The students observed a layer of moss on the damp stones beside the stream.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了溪流旁潮湿石头上的一层苔藓。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak l-aħdar fuq il-ġebla? Toni: Dak ħażiż. Ara kemm hu artab!
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that green stuff on the stone? Toni: That's moss. Look how soft it is!
colloquial.zh: Lara：石头上那些绿色的东西是什么？Toni：那是苔藓。你看，多柔软啊！

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)

messages.en: What is that green stuff on the stone?

messages.mt_standard: Dak ħażiż. Ara kemm hu artab!
messages.zh: 那是苔藓。你看，多柔软啊！
messages.en: That's moss. Look how soft it is!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ħażiż想成湿石头上的绿色软地毯，用“潮湿、绿色、柔软”三个画面提示记住苔藓。

gloss_zh: 货物临时储存；货物暂存

teaching_sense.en_definition: The keeping of goods in a place for a limited period before they are moved or used.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在货物转运或使用之前，将其在某处存放一段有限时间的临时储存。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żamma ta' merkanzija f'post għal żmien limitat qabel ma tiġi ttrasportata jew użata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 货物的临时储存，即在后续运输、交付或使用前暂时保管货物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħażna temporanja hija ż-żamma ta' merkanzija għal perjodu limitat sakemm tkun tista' tintbagħat, titwassal jew tintuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Temporary storage of goods is the keeping of goods somewhere for a limited time before they are moved, delivered, or used.

collocations.zh: 供临时储存使用的空间

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija kriet maħżen għall-ħażna temporanja tal-merkanzija sakemm jitlesta t-trasport lejn il-ħwienet.
formal.en: The company rented a warehouse for temporary storage of the goods until transport to the shops could be completed.
formal.zh: 公司租用了一座仓库，暂存货物，直至完成向各商店的运输。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn se npoġġu dawn il-kaxxi sal-Ġimgħa? David: Hemm spazju għall-ħażna temporanja fil-maħżen. Nistgħu nħalluhom hemm.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where are we going to put these boxes until Friday? David: There's space for temporary storage in the warehouse. We can leave them there.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这些箱子到星期五之前放在哪里？David：仓库里有临时存放的空间。我们可以把它们放在那里。

messages.speaker: Nina (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se npoġġu dawn il-kaxxi sal-Ġimgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se npoġġu dawn il-kaxxi sal-Ġimgħa?
messages.zh: 这些箱子到星期五之前放在哪里？
messages.en: Where are we going to put these boxes until Friday?

messages.speaker: David (仓库管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm spazju għall-ħażna temporanja fil-maħżen. Nistgħu nħalluhom hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm spazju għall-ħażna temporanja fil-maħżen. Nistgħu nħalluhom hemm.
messages.zh: 仓库里有临时存放的空间。我们可以把它们放在那里。
messages.en: There's space for temporary storage in the warehouse. We can leave them there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象货箱贴着“暂存至周五”的标签：ħażna提示储存，temporanja提示临时，合起来记作货物暂存。

gloss_zh: 货物临时存放；货物临时仓储

teaching_sense.en_definition: The storage of goods for a limited period before they are moved or otherwise dealt with.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在货物被转运或作其他处理之前，将其存放一段有限时间的安排或活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żamma tal-merkanzija f'post għal żmien limitat qabel ma tiġi ttrasportata jew tingħata destinazzjoni oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 货物在转运或作其他处理之前的临时存放。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħażna tal-merkanzija għal perjodu qasir jew limitat sakemm tkun tista' titmexxa jew tiġi ttrattata mod ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Temporary storage of goods is an arrangement in which goods are kept somewhere for a limited time before being moved or otherwise dealt with.

collocations.en: space for the temporary storage of goods
collocations.zh: 供货物临时存放的空间

collocations.en: the cost of the temporary storage of goods

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija għandha tipprovdi spazju adattat għall-ħażna temporanja tal-merkanzija sakemm jasal it-trasport.
formal.en: The company must provide suitable space for the temporary storage of goods until transport arrives.
formal.zh: 公司必须提供适合临时存放货物的空间，直到运输车辆到达。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandkom spazju għall-ħażna temporanja tal-merkanzija? Rita: Iva, nistgħu nżommu l-kaxxi hawn sa għada.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have space for the temporary storage of goods? Rita: Yes, we can keep the boxes here until tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你们有临时存放货物的地方吗？Rita：有，我们可以把这些箱子存放在这里，直到明天。
