messages.zh: 你们有临时存放货物的地方吗？
messages.en: Do you have space for the temporary storage of goods?

messages.speaker: Rita (仓库职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nistgħu nżommu l-kaxxi hawn sa għada.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nistgħu nżommu l-kaxxi hawn sa għada.
messages.zh: 有，我们可以把这些箱子存放在这里，直到明天。
messages.en: Yes, we can keep the boxes here until tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短语分成三块记：ħażna 是存放，temporanja 表示临时，tal-merkanzija 指货物的；想象货箱只在仓库过一夜。

gloss_zh: 束带；给……穿得厚实；支撑加固

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fasten a belt or similar covering around someone, dress someone heavily, or make something firm with support.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给人围束腰带等物；给人穿上厚重衣物；或通过支撑使某物稳固。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rabat ċinturin jew xi ħaġa simili madwar il-ġisem ta' xi ħadd, libbes lil xi ħadd ħwejjeġ tqal, jew saħħaħ xi ħaġa b'appoġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用腰带或类似物围束身体或腰部。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rabat jew dawwar ċinturin jew xi ħaġa simili madwar il-qadd jew il-ġisem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you gird someone, you fasten a belt or a similar item around their waist or body.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某人穿上厚重衣物，或穿上多层衣服。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Libbes lil xi ħadd ħwejjeġ ħoxnin jew ħafna saffi ta' ħwejjeġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you dress someone heavily, you put thick clothes or several layers of clothing on them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过支撑或加固使某物保持稳固。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Saħħaħ jew żamm xi ħaġa soda permezz ta' appoġġ biex ma tiċċaqlaqx jew ma ċċedix.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you brace something, you support it firmly so that it does not move or give way.

collocations.en: he girded his waist with a belt
he dressed the boy in thick clothes
collocations.zh: 他给男孩穿上了厚衣服

formal.mt: Qabel il-wirja, l-attur ħażżem qaddu b'ċinturin wiesa' li kien jagħmel parti mill-kostum.
formal.en: Before the performance, the actor girded his waist with a wide belt that formed part of the costume.
formal.zh: 演出前，演员用一条作为戏服组成部分的宽腰带束住腰部。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex it-tifel liebes daqshekk? Lara: Missieru ħażżem lit-tifel b'ħwejjeġ ħoxnin għax barra hemm ħafna bard.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the boy wearing so much? Lara: His father dressed him in thick clothes because it is very cold outside.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这孩子怎么穿了这么多？Lara：他爸爸给他穿上了厚衣服，因为外面很冷。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这孩子怎么穿了这么多？
messages.en: Why is the boy wearing so much?

messages.speaker: Lara (孩子的母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieru ħażżem lit-tifel b'ħwejjeġ ħoxnin għax barra hemm ħafna bard.
messages.mt_standard: Missieru ħażżem lit-tifel b'ħwejjeġ ħoxnin għax barra hemm ħafna bard.
messages.zh: 他爸爸给他穿上了厚衣服，因为外面很冷。
messages.en: His father dressed him in thick clothes because it is very cold outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面分别记义：腰带束住腰、厚衣裹住人、支架撑稳物。这只是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: He concealed her or it so that other people could not see or find her or it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示他把某位女性或某个以阴性形式指代的事物藏起来，使别人看不见或找不到。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Huwa poġġa lilha jew xi ħaġa msemmija fil-femminil f'post fejn ħaddieħor ma setax jaraha jew isibha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他把她或它藏起来了；宾语可以是女性，也可以是语法上为阴性的事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huwa żamm lilha jew xi ħaġa fil-femminil mistura biex ħaddieħor ma jarahiex jew ma jsibhiex.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If he hid her or it, he put that person or thing somewhere other people could not easily see or find.

collocations.en: he hid her/it in the drawer
collocations.zh: 他把她／它藏在抽屉里；此处通常指物品

collocations.en: he hid her/it behind the door

formal.mt: Wara li qara l-ittra, ħbieha fil-kexxun biex ħadd ma jsibha.
formal.en: After reading the letter, he hid it in the drawer so that nobody would find it.
formal.zh: 读完信后，他把信藏在抽屉里，以免有人找到。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi ċ-ċavetta? Mark: Pawlu ħbieha taħt il-ktieb. Maja: Issa sibtha!
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the key? Mark: Pawlu hid it under the book. Maja: I've found it now!
colloquial.zh: Maja：钥匙在哪里？Mark：Pawlu 把它藏在书下面了。Maja：现在我找到了！

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 钥匙在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the key?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 把它藏在书下面了。
messages.en: Pawlu hid it under the book.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 现在我找到了！
messages.en: I've found it now!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħbieha 整体记成“他藏了她／它”。用阴性名词 ċavetta（钥匙）造句，提醒自己这里的“它”也可以指物品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Your bosom or breast, especially the area against your chest where you hold someone or something close.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 你的胸部或胸前，尤其指将人或物贴近胸口抱住时的怀中位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' quddiem ta' sidrek, speċjalment il-post fejn iżżomm lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa qrib tiegħek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你的胸部、胸前；在抱持语境中指你的怀中。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sidrek jew il-parti ta' quddiem ta' ġismek fejn tista' tħaddan lil xi ħadd jew iżżomm xi ħaġa qrib.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your bosom or breast is the front of your chest, especially when someone or something is held close against it.

collocations.en: in your bosom; in your embrace
hold the baby against your chest

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, l-omm tgħid lil bintha: 'Meta żżomm it-tarbija f'ħdanek, kellimha b'leħen ħelu.'
formal.en: In the story, the mother tells her daughter: 'When you hold the baby in your arms against your chest, speak to her gently.'
formal.zh: 故事中，母亲对女儿说：“你把宝宝抱在怀里时，要温柔地跟她说话。”

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tarbija raqdet f'ħdanek? Mark: Iva, għadha kemm għalqet għajnejha. Lara: Ħalliha tistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has the baby fallen asleep against your chest? Mark: Yes, she has just closed her eyes. Lara: Let her rest for a little while.
colloquial.zh: Lara：宝宝在你怀里睡着了吗？Mark：是的，她刚刚闭上眼睛。Lara：让她休息一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (孩子的母亲)
messages.zh: 宝宝在你怀里睡着了吗？
messages.en: Has the baby fallen asleep against your chest?

messages.speaker: Mark (孩子的父亲)
messages.zh: 是的，她刚刚闭上眼睛。
messages.en: Yes, she has just closed her eyes.

messages.speaker: Lara (孩子的母亲)
messages.zh: 让她休息一会儿吧。
messages.en: Let her rest for a little while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人指着你的胸前说 ħdanek，再把宝宝放进你怀里；将“你的胸前”和“你的怀中”连成同一个画面来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device worn over the ears for listening to sound privately.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戴在耳朵上，用于个人收听声音的设备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jintlibes fuq il-widnejn biex persuna tisma' l-ħoss mingħajr ma jinstema' minn kulħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 戴在耳朵上收听音乐、语音等声音的耳机。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat li jintlibes fuq il-widnejn u jwassal il-ħoss direttament lil min ikun qed jużah.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Headphones are a device you wear over your ears so that you can listen to sound privately.

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju tas-smigħ, kull student għandu juża l-ħedfown biex jisma' r-reġistrazzjoni b'mod ċar.
formal.en: During the listening exercise, each student should use headphones to hear the recording clearly.
formal.zh: 进行听力练习时，每位学生都应使用耳机，以便清楚地听到录音。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-ħedfown tiegħi? Mark: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-kompjuter. Maja: Grazzi! Se nisma' ftit mużika.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are my headphones? Mark: On the table, next to the computer. Maja: Thanks! I'm going to listen to some music.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我的耳机在哪里？Mark：在桌上，电脑旁边。Maja：谢谢！我要听一会儿音乐。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的耳机在哪里？
messages.en: Where are my headphones?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在桌上，电脑旁边。
messages.en: On the table, next to the computer.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谢谢！我要听一会儿音乐。
messages.en: Thanks! I'm going to listen to some music.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħedfown 和“戴上耳机听音乐”的动作一起记，配合 nilbes il-ħedfown 反复练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A light at the front of a vehicle that illuminates the road ahead.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 装在车辆前部，用于照亮前方道路的灯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fanal fuq quddiem ta' vettura li jdawwal it-triq quddiemha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 车辆前部用于照亮前方道路的前照灯。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fanal imwaħħal fuq quddiem ta' vettura biex is-sewwieq ikun jista' jara t-triq fid-dlam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A headlight is a light at the front of a vehicle that helps the driver see the road ahead.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, il-mekkanik sab li l-ħedlajt tax-xellug ma kienx qed jaħdem u kellu bżonn tiswija.
formal.en: During the inspection, the mechanic found that the left headlight was not working and needed repair.
formal.zh: 检查时，修车师傅发现左侧车前灯无法正常工作，需要修理。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ħedlajt tal-lemin mhux jixgħel. Pawlu: Ħa niċċekkjah qabel titlaq. Lara: Grazzi, għax dalwaqt jidlam.
colloquial.en: Lara: The right headlight isn't coming on. Pawlu: Let me check it before you leave. Lara: Thanks, because it'll be dark soon.
colloquial.zh: Lara：右边的车前灯不亮。Pawlu：你走之前，我来检查一下。Lara：谢谢，因为天很快就黑了。

messages.speaker: Lara (车主)
messages.zh: 右边的车前灯不亮。
messages.en: The right headlight isn't coming on.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (修车师傅)
messages.zh: 你走之前，我来检查一下。
messages.en: Let me check it before you leave.

messages.speaker: Lara (车主)
messages.zh: 谢谢，因为天很快就黑了。
messages.en: Thanks, because it'll be dark soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ħedlajt 时想象汽车前方照亮道路的光束，再用“打开车前灯”这个动作巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone what they want or allow their wishes too readily, especially a child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 过于轻易地满足某人的愿望或顺着其要求，尤指迁就、纵容孩子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta lil xi ħadd, speċjalment tifel jew tifla, dak li ried jew ħallieh jagħmel li jrid b'mod żejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迁就或纵容某人，例如过分满足孩子的要求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Issodisfa x-xewqat ta' xi ħadd, bħal tifel jew tifla, b'mod żejjed jew mingħajr ma jagħmillu biżżejjed limiti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you indulge someone, especially a child, you readily satisfy their wishes even when firmer limits would be appropriate.

formal.mt: Il-missier ħejjem iżżejjed lil ibnu billi dejjem tah dak kollu li talab, anki meta t-talbiet ma kinux raġonevoli.
formal.en: The father indulged his son too much by always giving him everything he asked for, even when his requests were unreasonable.
formal.zh: 这位父亲过分纵容儿子，总是满足他的一切要求，即使那些要求并不合理。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex it-tifel qed jitlob ġugarell ieħor? Toni: In-nannu ħejjem lit-tifel u xtralu kull ma ried. Rita: Issa rridu nispjegawlu li ma jistax dejjem jieħu kollox.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is the boy asking for another toy? Toni: His grandfather indulged him and bought him everything he wanted. Rita: Now we need to explain that he can't always have everything.
colloquial.zh: Rita：孩子怎么又要玩具了？Toni：爷爷太迁就他了，他想要什么就给他买什么。Rita：现在我们得向他解释，他不能总是什么都要得到。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex it-tifel qed jitlob ġugarell ieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex it-tifel qed jitlob ġugarell ieħor?
messages.zh: 孩子怎么又要玩具了？
messages.en: Why is the boy asking for another toy?

messages.speaker: Toni (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nannu ħejjem lit-tifel u xtralu kull ma ried.
messages.mt_standard: In-nannu ħejjem lit-tifel u xtralu kull ma ried.
messages.zh: 爷爷太迁就他了，他想要什么就给他买什么。
messages.en: His grandfather indulged him and bought him everything he wanted.

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa rridu nispjegawlu li ma jistax dejjem jieħu kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Issa rridu nispjegawlu li ma jistax dejjem jieħu kollox.
messages.zh: 现在我们得向他解释，他不能总是什么都要得到。
messages.en: Now we need to explain that he can't always have everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħejjem 放进“孩子一提要求，大人就答应”的画面中，记住这里强调迁就或纵容。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To get rid of something unwanted or become free from a burden.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 摆脱不需要的事物或负担，或将其清除。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa xi ħaġa mhux mixtieqa jew sar ħieles minn piż jew problema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摆脱、除去不想要的事物，使自己不再受其困扰。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Neħħa minn fuqu jew minn post xi ħaġa mhux mixtieqa, jew ma baqax ibati minn problema jew piż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you get rid of something, you remove it or free yourself from its unwanted presence or effects.

collocations.zh: 清除了杂乱堆积的东西

formal.mt: L-uffiċċju ħeles mill-imbarazz billi bagħat il-karti li ma kinux għadhom meħtieġa għar-riċiklaġġ.
formal.en: The office got rid of the clutter by sending papers that were no longer needed for recycling.
formal.zh: 办公室将不再需要的纸张送去回收，清除了杂乱堆积的东西。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark fl-aħħar ħeles minn dik il-problema bil-kompjuter? Lara: Iva, it-tekniku sewwieh ilbieraħ. Maja: Mela issa jista' jerġa' jaħdem bil-kwiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has Mark finally got rid of that computer problem? Lara: Yes, the technician fixed it yesterday. Maja: Then he can get back to work without the hassle.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 终于摆脱那个电脑问题了吗？Lara：是的，技术员昨天把电脑修好了。Maja：那他现在可以安心继续工作了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark fl-aħħar ħeles minn dik il-problema bil-kompjuter?
messages.mt_standard: Mark fl-aħħar ħeles minn dik il-problema bil-kompjuter?
messages.zh: Mark 终于摆脱那个电脑问题了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark finally got rid of that computer problem?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 是的，技术员昨天把电脑修好了。
messages.en: Yes, the technician fixed it yesterday.

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela issa jista' jerġa' jaħdem bil-kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Mela issa jista' jerġa' jaħdem bil-kwiet.
messages.zh: 那他现在可以安心继续工作了。
messages.en: Then he can get back to work without the hassle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħeles minn 整组记成“摆脱某物”，练习时在 minn 后接要摆脱的问题或负担，想象卸下重担的感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cook food in an oven using heat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把食物放在烤箱中，利用热力将其烤熟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sajjar ikel fil-forn permezz tas-sħana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在烤箱中烘烤食物，使其熟透。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sajjar ikel, bħal ħobż jew kejk, billi poġġieh fil-forn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone bakes food, they cook it in an oven.

collocations.en: baked the bread in the oven
baked a cake in the oven
collocations.zh: 在烤箱中烤了一个蛋糕

formal.mt: Il-furnar ħema l-ħobż fil-forn sakemm il-qoxra saret dehbija.
formal.en: The baker baked the bread in the oven until the crust turned golden.
formal.zh: 面包师把面包放在烤箱中烘烤，直到外皮变成金黄色。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ħema dan il-kejk? Pawlu: Missieri ħema l-kejk fil-forn dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who baked this cake? Pawlu: My father baked the cake in the oven this morning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个蛋糕是谁烤的？Pawlu：我爸爸今天早上用烤箱烤的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个蛋糕是谁烤的？
messages.en: Who baked this cake?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我爸爸今天早上用烤箱烤了这个蛋糕。
messages.en: My father baked the cake in the oven this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和“面包进烤箱”的画面一起记：ħema 表示烤了，fil-forn 表示在烤箱里；用“爸爸早上烤了蛋糕”的完整句巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state in which there is no sound or nobody is speaking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有声音或没有人说话的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat li fih ma jinstema' ebda ħoss jew ħadd ma jkun qed jitkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 寂静；没有声响或没有人说话的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: In-nuqqas ta' ħsejjes jew ta' taħdit f'post jew f'mument partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Silence is a state in which no sound is heard or no one is speaking.

formal.mt: Wara li ntemm id-diskors, fis-sala waqgħet ħemda sħiħa.
formal.en: After the speech ended, complete silence fell over the hall.
formal.zh: 演讲结束后，大厅里陷入了一片寂静。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ħemda hawn illum! Mark: Iva, kulħadd ħareġ u jien qed naqra.
colloquial.en: Sara: It's so quiet here today! Mark: Yes, everyone has gone out and I'm reading.
colloquial.zh: Sara：今天这里真安静啊！Mark：是啊，大家都出去了，我正在看书。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 今天这里真安静啊！
messages.en: It's so quiet here today!

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kulħadd ħareġ u jien qed naqra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kulħadd ħareġ u jien qed naqra.
messages.zh: 是啊，大家都出去了，我正在看书。
messages.en: Yes, everyone has gone out and I'm reading.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象演讲结束后，全场暂时没有一点声音，把这个状态标成 ħemda；再用“打破寂静”这个搭配记住它是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A low vocal sound made without singing words, often with the lips closed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不唱出歌词、常闭着嘴发出的低声哼唱或哼鸣声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss baxx magħmul bil-vuċi mingħajr kliem, ħafna drabi bix-xufftejn magħluqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哼鸣；不发出歌词的低声哼唱。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħoss li persuna tagħmel meta tgħaddi melodija bil-vuċi mingħajr kliem, spiss b'ħalqha magħluq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Humming is the low sound someone makes when they sing a tune without words.

formal.mt: Matul l-eżerċizzju tal-mużika, l-għalliema semgħet il-ħenir tal-istudenti qabel ma bdew ikantaw il-kliem.
formal.en: During the music exercise, the teacher listened to the students' humming before they began singing the words.
formal.zh: 音乐练习时，老师先听学生们哼唱，然后他们才开始唱出歌词。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed nisma' ħenir baxx. Int qed tkanta? Nina: Iva, qed inkanta l-melodija mingħajr kliem.
colloquial.en: Lara: I can hear soft humming. Are you singing? Nina: Yes, I'm singing the tune without words.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我听到轻轻的哼唱声。是你在唱吗？Nina：是啊，我在哼旋律，没有唱歌词。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nisma' ħenir baxx. Int qed tkanta?
messages.mt_standard: Qed nisma' ħenir baxx. Int qed tkanta?
messages.zh: 我听到轻轻的哼唱声。是你在唱吗？
messages.en: I can hear soft humming. Are you singing?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed inkanta l-melodija mingħajr kliem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed inkanta l-melodija mingħajr kliem.
messages.zh: 是啊，我在哼旋律，没有唱歌词。
messages.en: Yes, I'm singing the tune without words.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先闭嘴轻轻哼一段熟悉的旋律，再把这种声音叫作 ħenir；记忆重点是“有旋律、无歌词”的哼唱声。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small hole or hollow in a surface or material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体表面或材料中的小洞、小孔或小凹坑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Toqba jew ħofra ta' daqs żgħir f'wiċċ jew f'materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小洞；表面或材料中尺寸较小的孔洞或凹坑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fetħa jew ħofra żgħira f'xi ħaġa, bħal ħajt jew l-art.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A small hole is a little opening or hollow in the surface of something.

collocations.en: a small hole in the wall

formal.mt: Iż-żerriegħa tqiegħdet f'ħfajra fl-art u ġiet mgħottija b'saff irqiq ta' ħamrija.
formal.en: The seed was placed in a small hole in the ground and covered with a thin layer of soil.
formal.zh: 种子被放进地上的一个小坑里，再盖上一层薄土。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġi din iż-żerriegħa? Pawlu: Agħmel ħfajra fil-ħamrija u poġġiha hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I put this seed? Pawlu: Make a small hole in the soil and put it there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这颗种子该放在哪里？Pawlu：在土里挖个小坑，把它放进去。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺初学者)
messages.zh: 这颗种子该放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this seed?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħmel ħfajra fil-ħamrija u poġġiha hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Agħmel ħfajra fil-ħamrija u poġġiha hemm.
messages.zh: 在土里挖个小坑，把它放进去。
messages.en: Make a small hole in the soil and put it there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用手指在花盆土里按出一个刚好容纳种子的小坑，把它标成 ħfajra；抓住“小小的孔洞或凹坑”这个画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Work or effort directed towards completing a task or achieving a result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为完成任务或取得成果而进行的工作、劳动或努力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol jew l-isforz li jsir biex jitwettaq kompitu jew jintlaħaq riżultat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为完成某项任务而进行的工作或付出的努力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attività jew sforz li persuna jew grupp jagħmel biex iwettaq kompitu jew jilħaq għan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Work is the activity or effort that someone puts into completing a task or achieving a particular result.

formal.mt: Il-ħidma tat-tim wasslet għat-tlestija tal-proġett fil-ħin.
formal.en: The team's work led to the project being completed on time.
formal.zh: 团队的工作使项目得以按时完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejra l-ħidma fuq il-proġett? Mark: Sejra tajjeb, imma għad għandna ħafna x'nagħmlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is the work on the project going? Mark: It's going well, but we still have a lot to do.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：项目的工作进展怎么样？马克：进展不错，不过我们还有很多事情要做。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 项目的工作进展怎么样？
messages.en: How is the work on the project going?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejra tajjeb, imma għad għandna ħafna x'nagħmlu.
messages.mt_standard: Sejra tajjeb, imma għad għandna ħafna x'nagħmlu.
messages.zh: 进展不错，不过我们还有很多事情要做。
messages.en: It's going well, but we still have a lot to do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħidma 放进“团队一起完成项目”的画面中记忆：重点是实际进行的工作和付出的努力，搭配 ħidma f'tim 一起练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The time needed for a frequency to recover after a change or disturbance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 频率发生变化或受到扰动后，恢复所需要的时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħin meħtieġ biex il-frekwenza tirkupra wara bidla jew disturb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 频率在变化或扰动后恢复所需的时间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-perjodu ta' żmien li jkun meħtieġ biex il-frekwenza tirkupra wara li tkun inbidlet jew ġiet affettwata minn disturb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The time to recover frequency is the period needed for a frequency to recover after it has changed or been disturbed.

collocations.en: measurement of the time needed for frequency recovery
a reduction in the time needed for frequency recovery

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li l-ħin għall-irkupru tal-frekwenza kien ta' għaxar sekondi wara d-disturb.
formal.en: The report indicates that the time needed for frequency recovery was ten seconds after the disturbance.
formal.zh: 报告指出，扰动后频率恢复所需的时间为十秒。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm kien il-ħin għall-irkupru tal-frekwenza f'dan it-test? Mark: Għaxar sekondi. Fit-test ta' qabel kien itwal.
colloquial.en: Maja: How long did frequency recovery take in this test? Mark: Ten seconds. It took longer in the previous test.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这次测试中频率恢复用了多长时间？马克：十秒。上一次测试用的时间更长。

messages.speaker: Maja (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm kien il-ħin għall-irkupru tal-frekwenza f'dan it-test?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm kien il-ħin għall-irkupru tal-frekwenza f'dan it-test?
messages.zh: 这次测试中频率恢复用了多长时间？
messages.en: How long did frequency recovery take in this test?

messages.speaker: Mark (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaxar sekondi. Fit-test ta' qabel kien itwal.
messages.mt_standard: Għaxar sekondi. Fit-test ta' qabel kien itwal.
messages.zh: 十秒。上一次测试用的时间更长。
messages.en: Ten seconds. It took longer in the previous test.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“时间 ħin—恢复 irkupru—频率 frekwenza”三个意义块记忆，想象频率受扰后开始计时，恢复时停表；这是学习画面，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The time needed to restore a frequency to its previous or required level.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使频率恢复到先前水平或规定水平所需要的时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħin meħtieġ biex il-frekwenza terġa' tinġieb għal-livell ta' qabel jew għal-livell meħtieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将频率恢复到先前水平或要求水平所需的时间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-perjodu ta' żmien meħtieġ biex il-frekwenza terġa' tinġieb għal-livell li kellha qabel jew għal-livell mixtieq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The time to restore frequency is the period needed to bring a frequency back to its previous or required level.

collocations.en: measurement of the time needed to restore frequency
collocations.zh: 频率恢复所需时间的测量

collocations.en: a reduction in the time needed to restore frequency
collocations.zh: 使频率恢复所需时间的缩短

formal.mt: Matul il-prova, il-ħin għar-restawr tal-frekwenza għal-livell meħtieġ kien ta' tmien sekondi.
formal.en: During the trial, the time needed to restore the frequency to the required level was eight seconds.
formal.zh: 试验期间，使频率恢复到规定水平所需的时间为八秒。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Irnexxielna nnaqqsu l-ħin għar-restawr tal-frekwenza? Mark: Iva, issa nieħdu tmien sekondi biex inġibuha lura għal-livell meħtieġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did we manage to reduce the time needed to restore frequency? Mark: Yes, we now take eight seconds to bring it back to the required level.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们成功缩短使频率恢复所需的时间了吗？马克：是的，现在用八秒就能把频率恢复到规定水平。

messages.speaker: Maja (工程师)
messages.zh: 我们成功缩短使频率恢复所需的时间了吗？
messages.en: Did we manage to reduce the time needed to restore frequency?

messages.speaker: Mark (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa nieħdu tmien sekondi biex inġibuha lura għal-livell meħtieġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa nieħdu tmien sekondi biex inġibuha lura għal-livell meħtieġ.
messages.zh: 是的，现在用八秒就能把频率恢复到规定水平。
messages.en: Yes, we now take eight seconds to bring it back to the required level.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词和“把频率调回规定水平，同时看秒表”的画面绑定；用“使频率恢复所需时间”复述，帮助记住 restawr 在本词条中的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The time required for a device or system to become fully activated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设备或系统达到完全激活状态所需要的时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħin meħtieġ biex apparat jew sistema jsir attiv għalkollox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设备或系统从开始激活到达到完全激活状态所需的时间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-perjodu ta' żmien mill-bidu tal-attivazzjoni sakemm apparat jew sistema jkun attiv għalkollox.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Full activation time is the period required for a device or system to reach a fully activated state.

collocations.zh: 系统完全激活所需的时间

formal.mt: Il-ħin ta' attivazzjoni totali tas-sistema jitkejjel mill-bidu tal-attivazzjoni sakemm is-sistema tkun attiva għalkollox.
formal.en: The system's full activation time is measured from the start of activation until the system is fully active.
formal.zh: 系统完全激活所需的时间，从激活开始计量，直到系统完全处于激活状态为止。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm hu l-ħin ta' attivazzjoni totali ta' dan l-apparat? Mark: Ħames sekondi. Wara jkun attiv għalkollox.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the full activation time of this device? Mark: Five seconds. After that, it is fully active.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个设备完全激活需要多长时间？马克：五秒。之后它就完全处于激活状态了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu l-ħin ta' attivazzjoni totali ta' dan l-apparat?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu l-ħin ta' attivazzjoni totali ta' dan l-apparat?
messages.zh: 这个设备完全激活需要多长时间？
messages.en: What is the full activation time of this device?

messages.speaker: Mark (培训员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħames sekondi. Wara jkun attiv għalkollox.
messages.mt_standard: Ħames sekondi. Wara jkun attiv għalkollox.
messages.zh: 五秒。之后它就完全处于激活状态了。
messages.en: Five seconds. After that, it is fully active.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“时间 ħin—激活 attivazzjoni—完全 totali”串联记忆：想象按下激活键后看秒表，直到设备完全激活才停表。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The maximum time within which an electrical fault must be cleared for the system to remain stable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为使电力系统保持稳定，必须在其内切除故障的最长允许时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-limitu ta' żmien li fih trid titneħħa ħsara f'sistema tal-elettriku biex is-sistema tibqa' stabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 故障临界切除时间，即电力系统为保持稳定而允许故障持续的最长时间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan huwa l-itwal żmien li ħsara f'sistema tal-elettriku tista' ddum qabel ma trid titneħħa biex tinżamm l-istabbiltà tas-sistema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The critical fault clearing time is the longest period an electrical fault can persist before clearing it would no longer preserve system stability.

collocations.mt: jikkalkula l-ħin tal-ikklerjar ta' ħsara kruċjali
collocations.en: calculate the critical fault clearing time
collocations.zh: 计算故障临界切除时间

collocations.mt: jaqbeż il-ħin tal-ikklerjar ta' ħsara kruċjali
collocations.en: exceed the critical fault clearing time
collocations.zh: 超过故障临界切除时间

formal.mt: L-inġinier ikkalkula l-ħin tal-ikklerjar ta' ħsara kruċjali biex jevalwa jekk is-sistema tibqax stabbli wara li titneħħa l-ħsara.
formal.en: The engineer calculated the critical fault clearing time to assess whether the system would remain stable after the fault was cleared.
formal.zh: 工程师计算了故障临界切除时间，以评估故障切除后系统能否保持稳定。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'jiġri jekk inneħħu l-ħsara tard wisq? Lara: Is-sistema tista' titlef l-istabbiltà. Għalhekk irridu nkunu nafu l-ħin tal-ikklerjar ta' ħsara kruċjali.
colloquial.en: Mark: What happens if we clear the fault too late? Lara: The system may lose stability. That's why we need to know the critical fault clearing time.
colloquial.zh: 马克：如果我们太晚才切除故障，会怎样？拉拉：系统可能会失去稳定。所以我们需要知道故障临界切除时间。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġri jekk inneħħu l-ħsara tard wisq?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġri jekk inneħħu l-ħsara tard wisq?
messages.zh: 如果我们太晚才切除故障，会怎样？
messages.en: What happens if we clear the fault too late?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sistema tista' titlef l-istabbiltà. Għalhekk irridu nkunu nafu l-ħin tal-ikklerjar ta' ħsara kruċjali.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sistema tista' titlef l-istabbiltà. Għalhekk irridu nkunu nafu l-ħin tal-ikklerjar ta' ħsara kruċjali.
messages.zh: 系统可能会失去稳定。所以我们需要知道故障临界切除时间。
messages.en: The system may lose stability. That's why we need to know the critical fault clearing time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个长词组配上“故障处理倒计时”的画面：关键是最迟何时必须切除故障，才能保持系统稳定；按整个术语记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device that produces heat to warm a room, water, or another substance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生热量、用于使房间、水或其他物质升温的设备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jipproduċi s-sħana biex isaħħan kamra, ilma jew xi sustanza oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加热器；用于取暖或使水等物质升温的装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħiter huwa apparat li jagħti s-sħana u jintuża biex isaħħan spazju, ilma jew materjal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A heater is a device that supplies heat to warm a room, water, or another material.

formal.mt: Il-ħiter isaħħan il-kamra qabel ma jaslu l-istudenti għall-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The heater warms the room before the students arrive for the lesson.
formal.zh: 取暖器在学生到达上课前为房间供暖。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed inħoss il-bard. Nista' nixgħel il-ħiter? Pawlu: Iva, ixegħlu. Il-kamra għadha kiesħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm feeling cold. Can I switch on the heater? Pawlu: Yes, switch it on. The room is still cold.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我觉得冷。可以打开取暖器吗？保罗：可以，打开吧。房间里还很冷。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inħoss il-bard. Nista' nixgħel il-ħiter?
messages.mt_standard: Qed inħoss il-bard. Nista' nixgħel il-ħiter?
messages.zh: 我觉得冷。可以打开取暖器吗？
messages.en: I'm feeling cold. Can I switch on the heater?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 可以，打开吧。房间里还很冷。
messages.en: Yes, switch it on. The room is still cold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象冬天回家后打开取暖器，把 ħiter 与“设备发热、房间变暖”的画面绑定，再连读 tixgħel il-ħiter，记住实际用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A long vegetable with green skin and watery flesh, often eaten raw in salads.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种通常外皮绿色、果肉水分充足的长形蔬菜，常用于沙拉或生食。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxixa tawwalija b'qoxra ħadra u laħam b'ħafna ilma, li spiss tittiekel nejja fl-insalata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黄瓜，一种通常呈长形、外皮绿色、果肉多汁且常供生食的蔬菜。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħjara hija ħaxixa twila b'qoxra ħadra u laħam frisk mimli ilma, li tista' tittiekel nejja jew titqatta' fl-insalata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cucumber is a long green vegetable with watery flesh that people often eat raw or add to salads.

formal.mt: Għal din l-insalata, aħsel ħjara friska, qattagħha flieli u żidha mat-tadam.
formal.en: For this salad, wash a fresh cucumber, cut it into slices, and add it to the tomatoes.
formal.zh: 制作这道沙拉时，洗净一根新鲜黄瓜，将其切片，再加入番茄中。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandna ħjara għall-insalata? Omm: Iva, hemm waħda fil-friġġ. Aħsilha u qattagħha flieli.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do we have a cucumber for the salad? Mum: Yes, there's one in the fridge. Wash it and cut it into slices.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们有做沙拉用的黄瓜吗？妈妈：有，冰箱里有一根。把它洗净，再切成片。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 我们有做沙拉用的黄瓜吗？
messages.en: Do we have a cucumber for the salad?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm waħda fil-friġġ. Aħsilha u qattagħha flieli.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm waħda fil-friġġ. Aħsilha u qattagħha flieli.
messages.zh: 有，冰箱里有一根。把它洗净，再切成片。
messages.en: Yes, there's one in the fridge. Wash it and cut it into slices.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħjara 配上一根绿色黄瓜的图片，练说 ħjara friska“新鲜黄瓜”；再用 waħda“一个”的阴性形式回答，连同名词的阴性一起记。

gloss_zh: 首付款；预付的部分款项

teaching_sense.en_definition: An initial payment covering part of a purchase price, with the remaining amount paid later.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 购买时先支付的一部分价款，其余款项随后支付。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlas inizjali li jkopri parti mill-prezz ta' xirja, filwaqt li l-bqija jitħallas aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 首付款；在购买开始时预先支付、计入总价的一部分款项，余额以后支付。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħlas akkont huwa ammont li jitħallas bil-quddiem bħala parti mill-prezz kollu ta' xirja, bil-bqija jitħallas aktar tard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A down payment is an initial sum paid towards a purchase, with the rest of the price paid later.

formal.mt: Il-klijent għamel ħlas akkont meta ordna l-għamara, u ħallas il-bqija mal-kunsinna.
formal.en: The customer made a down payment when ordering the furniture and paid the balance on delivery.
formal.zh: 顾客订购家具时支付了首付款，并在交货时付清余款。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm hu l-ħlas akkont għal dan is-sufan? Rita: Mitejn ewro, u tista' tħallas il-bqija mal-kunsinna.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much is the down payment for this sofa? Rita: Two hundred euros, and you can pay the balance on delivery.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这张沙发的首付款是多少？丽塔：两百欧元，余款可以在交货时支付。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu l-ħlas akkont għal dan is-sufan?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu l-ħlas akkont għal dan is-sufan?
messages.zh: 这张沙发的首付款是多少？
messages.en: How much is the down payment for this sofa?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mitejn ewro, u tista' tħallas il-bqija mal-kunsinna.
messages.mt_standard: Mitejn ewro, u tista' tħallas il-bqija mal-kunsinna.
messages.zh: 两百欧元，余款可以在交货时支付。
messages.en: Two hundred euros, and you can pay the balance on delivery.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把总价画成一条长条，先涂上一小段并标注 ħlas akkont，剩下部分标注“以后付”；用“先付一部分，随后付余额”的顺序记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A payment made electronically rather than with physical cash.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过电子方式完成的付款，而非使用现金付款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlas li jsir b'mezz elettroniku minflok bi flus kontanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子支付；以电子方式进行的付款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħlas li jsir permezz ta' sistema elettronika mingħajr ma jingħataw flus kontanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An e-payment is a payment made using an electronic system instead of physical cash.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子付款；通过电子系统转移款项以完成支付。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Trasferiment ta' flus permezz ta' sistema elettronika biex jitħallas ammont dovut.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An electronic payment occurs when money is transferred electronically to pay for something.

formal.mt: Jekk tagħmel ħlas elettroniku, jekk jogħġbok żomm il-konferma tal-ħlas għar-rekords tiegħek.
formal.en: If you make an electronic payment, please keep the payment confirmation for your records.
formal.zh: 如果您使用电子支付，请保留付款确认信息以备查阅。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' nagħmel ħlas elettroniku? Rita: Iva, tista' tħallas bil-kard.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can I make an electronic payment? Rita: Yes, you can pay by card.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我可以用电子支付吗？丽塔：可以，你可以刷卡付款。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 我可以用电子支付吗？
messages.en: Can I make an electronic payment?

messages.speaker: Rita (收银员)
messages.zh: 可以，你可以刷卡付款。
messages.en: Yes, you can pay by card.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħlas 记作“付款”，再用 elettroniku 联想“电子的”；想象刷卡后屏幕显示付款成功，记住整个短语。

gloss_zh: 关税退还；退还已缴关税

teaching_sense.en_definition: The refund of customs duty that has already been paid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将已经缴纳的关税退还给付款人的款项或行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti lura lil min ħallas ta' dazju li jkun diġà tħallas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偿还；将欠款或已收取的款项付还。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għoti lura ta' flus li jkunu ġew mislufa jew imħallsa qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A repayment is money paid back after it was previously borrowed or paid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 退还关税；将此前已经缴纳的关税付还。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għoti lura ta' flus li jkunu tħallsu qabel bħala dazju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A repayment of duty returns money that was previously paid as customs duty.

collocations.en: a request for a refund of customs duty
approval of the customs duty refund

formal.mt: L-importatur ressaq talba għal ħlas lura tad-dazju u hemeż kopja tal-irċevuta oriġinali.
formal.en: The importer submitted a request for a refund of customs duty and attached a copy of the original receipt.
formal.zh: 进口商提交了关税退款申请，并附上了原始收据的副本。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Wasal il-ħlas lura tad-dazju? Pawlu: Iva, il-flus daħlu fil-kont dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has the customs duty refund arrived? Pawlu: Yes, the money went into the account this morning.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：关税退款到账了吗？保罗：到了，钱今天早上进账了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 关税退款到账了吗？
messages.en: Has the customs duty refund arrived?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (财务同事)
messages.zh: 到了，钱今天早上进账了。
messages.en: Yes, the money went into the account this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“付款 ħlas—回来 lura—关税 tad-dazju”串成画面：已经交出去的关税又回到自己的账户，就是关税退还。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period of approximately two weeks, literally fifteen days in this Maltese expression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 约两周的一段时间；该马耳他语短语字面表示十五天。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu ta' ħmistax-il jum, jiġifieri madwar ġimagħtejn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 两周，即十四天；对应的马耳他语短语字面表示十五天，涉及确切日期时应区分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Perjodu ta' ġimagħtejn, jiġifieri erbatax-il jum; l-espressjoni Maltija mogħtija, meħuda litteralment, tfisser ħmistax-il jum.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fortnight is a period of two weeks, although the supplied Maltese expression literally specifies fifteen days.

formal.mt: Il-wirja se tibqa' miftuħa għal ħmistax-il ġurnata, mill-ewwel sal-ħmistax ta' Ġunju.
formal.en: The exhibition will remain open for fifteen days, from the first to the fifteenth of June.
formal.zh: 展览将从六月一日开放至六月十五日，持续十五天。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għal kemm żmien se tibqa' Għawdex? Nina: Għal ħmistax-il ġurnata. Għandi bżonn ftit mistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: How long are you staying in Gozo? Nina: For fifteen days. I need a bit of rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要在戈佐岛待多久？妮娜：十五天。我需要休息一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal kemm żmien se tibqa' Għawdex?
messages.mt_standard: Għal kemm żmien se tibqa' Għawdex?
messages.zh: 你要在戈佐岛待多久？
messages.en: How long are you staying in Gozo?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal ħmistax-il ġurnata. Għandi bżonn ftit mistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għal ħmistax-il ġurnata. Għandi bżonn ftit mistrieħ.
messages.zh: 十五天。我需要休息一下。
messages.en: For fifteen days. I need a bit of rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上圈出十五格，记住 ħmistax-il ġurnata 的字面天数；英语 fortnight 严格是十四天，安排日期时要核对。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The father of someone's husband or wife.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 配偶的父亲；妻子的父亲称岳父，丈夫的父亲称公公。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-missier tar-raġel jew tal-mara li persuna tkun miżżewġa lilha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 配偶的父亲，即岳父或公公。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-missier tal-konjuġi ta' persuna, jiġifieri missier żewġha jew missier martu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone's father-in-law is the father of their husband or wife.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, David irringrazzja lil ħmu għall-għajnuna li tah waqt il-proġett.
formal.en: In his report, David thanked his father-in-law for the help he had given him during the project.
formal.zh: 戴维在报告中感谢岳父在项目期间给予他的帮助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejjer David? Mark: Sejjer għand ħmu għall-ikel. Maja: Mela narawh aktar tard.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is David going? Mark: He's going to his father-in-law's for a meal. Maja: Then we'll see him later.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：戴维要去哪里？马克：他要去岳父家吃饭。玛雅：那我们晚点再见他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 戴维要去哪里？
messages.en: Where is David going?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他要去岳父家吃饭。
messages.en: He's going to his father-in-law's for a meal.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们晚点再见他。
messages.en: Then we'll see him later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一张简单家庭图：从自己连到配偶，再向上连到配偶的父亲，把 ħmu 放在那个位置，记住岳父或公公这一关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The flat, sharp cutting parts of tools.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 工具中扁平而锋利、用于切割的部分，指多个刀片或刃片。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-partijiet ċatti u jaqtgħu ta' għodod, li jintużaw biex jaqtgħu materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刀片；工具中用于切割的锋利刃片，复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Partijiet ċatti ta' għodod b'tarf li jaqta', użati biex jaqtgħu materjal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The blades of tools are their sharp cutting parts.

formal.mt: Qabel ma tbiddel il-ħnejjet, aqra l-istruzzjonijiet dwar l-użu tal-għodda.
formal.en: Before replacing the blades, read the instructions for using the tool.
formal.zh: 更换刀片之前，请阅读工具的使用说明。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dawn il-ħnejjet għadhom jaqtgħu? Pawlu: Iva, oqgħod attent meta tmisshom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are these blades still sharp? Pawlu: Yes, be careful when touching them.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些刀片还锋利吗？保罗：是的，碰它们的时候小心。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 这些刀片还锋利吗？
messages.en: Are these blades still sharp?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 是的，碰它们的时候小心。
messages.en: Yes, be careful when touching them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħnejjet 和工具盒里并排放着的几片锋利刀片联系起来，用“一组刀片”的画面记住其复数含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Two whole loaves of bread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两个完整的面包，通常按条或个计数，而不是指两片面包。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żewġ ħobżiet sħaħ, aktar milli żewġ flieli tal-ħobż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 两个完整的面包；两条面包，不是两片面包。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żewġ ħobżiet sħaħ li jistgħu jinxtraw jew jinqasmu fi flieli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you buy ħobżejn, you buy two whole loaves of bread.

formal.mt: Għall-ikla tal-grupp, inxtraw ħobżejn friski mill-forn tar-raħal.
formal.en: Two fresh loaves were bought from the village bakery for the group's meal.
formal.zh: 为准备团体用餐，人们从村里的面包店买了两个新鲜面包。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kemm se nġib ħobż għall-ikla? Ġużeppi: Ġib ħobżejn, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Marija: How much bread should I get for the meal? Ġużeppi: Get two loaves, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这顿饭我要买多少面包？朱塞佩：请买两个面包。

messages.speaker: Marija (家人)
messages.zh: 这顿饭我要买多少面包？
messages.en: How much bread should I get for the meal?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (家人)
messages.zh: 请买两个面包。
messages.en: Get two loaves, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象购物袋里并排装着两个完整面包，把 ħobżejn 和“两整个”绑定记忆，避免误记成两片面包。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Considering something as a whole, including how its parts are connected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从整体出发考虑事物及其各部分之间联系的，而不只关注个别方面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqis xi ħaġa bħala ħaġa sħiħa u jagħti kas tar-rabtiet bejn il-partijiet tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 整体的；综合考虑事物各方面及其相互联系的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jikkunsidra l-aspetti differenti ta' xi ħaġa flimkien u r-relazzjonijiet bejniethom bħala parti minn ħaġa sħiħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A holistic approach considers all parts of something and how they relate to one another.

formal.mt: Il-programm jadotta approċċ ħolistiku li jqis flimkien it-tagħlim, ir-relazzjonijiet soċjali u l-benesseri tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The programme adopts a holistic approach that considers students' learning, social relationships and well-being together.
formal.zh: 该项目采用整体性方法，将学生的学习、社会关系和身心福祉结合起来考虑。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se nħarsu biss lejn il-marki? David: Le, irridu approċċ ħolistiku: naraw ukoll kif qed iħossuhom l-istudenti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are we only going to look at grades? David: No, we need a holistic approach: we should also see how the students are feeling.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们只看成绩吗？戴维：不，我们需要整体考虑，也看看学生们的感受。

messages.speaker: Sara (教师)
messages.zh: 我们只看成绩吗？
messages.en: Are we only going to look at grades?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, irridu approċċ ħolistiku: naraw ukoll kif qed iħossuhom l-istudenti.
messages.mt_standard: Le, irridu approċċ ħolistiku: naraw ukoll kif qed iħossuhom l-istudenti.
messages.zh: 不，我们需要整体考虑，也看看学生们的感受。
messages.en: No, we need a holistic approach: we should also see how the students are feeling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象评估学生时把成绩、感受和人际关系放进同一幅图中，用“各部分连起来看整体”记住 ħolistiku。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dream is an experience imagined during sleep or something you strongly hope to achieve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 梦指睡眠中想象出的经历，也可指强烈希望实现的梦想。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħolma hija esperjenza immaġinata waqt l-irqad jew xi ħaġa li persuna tixtieq ħafna li twettaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 梦，指睡眠中出现的情景或经历；也可指希望实现的梦想。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħolma hija ġrajja jew xena li persuna timmaġina waqt l-irqad, jew xewqa kbira li tittama li twettaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dream is something you experience in your imagination while asleep, or something you deeply hope to achieve.

formal.mt: L-għan tal-proġett huwa li jgħin liż-żgħażagħ iwettqu l-ħolma tagħhom li jistudjaw barra minn Malta.
formal.en: The aim of the project is to help young people fulfil their dream of studying outside Malta.
formal.zh: 该项目旨在帮助年轻人实现到马耳他以外求学的梦想。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ilbieraħ kelli ħolma sabiħa. Mark: X'ġara fiha? Maja: Kont qed intir fuq il-baħar!
colloquial.en: Maja: I had a beautiful dream last night. Mark: What happened in it? Maja: I was flying over the sea!
colloquial.zh: Maja：我昨晚做了一个美梦。Mark：梦里发生了什么？Maja：我在海面上飞翔！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我昨晚做了一个美梦。
messages.en: I had a beautiful dream last night.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 梦里发生了什么？
messages.en: What happened in it?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在海面上飞翔！
messages.en: I was flying over the sea!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħolma 连到两幅画面：闭眼时做美梦，睁眼后为梦想努力；用 ħolma sabiħa 记住“美梦”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A chasm or a slope in the landscape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地形中的深壑或斜坡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħondoq huwa xaqq fond fl-art jew biċċa art imżerżqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 深壑、深裂谷；也可指倾斜的坡地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħondoq huwa fetħa fonda fl-art, jew art li tinżel b'inklinazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ħondoq is a deep opening in the ground or a stretch of sloping land.

collocations.en: at the edge of the chasm

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi ħondoq fond bejn iż-żewġ għoljiet.
formal.en: The map shows a deep chasm between the two hills.
formal.zh: 地图显示两座山丘之间有一道深壑。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dak il-ħondoq! Pawlu: Iva, jidher fond ħafna. Lara: Ejja nibqgħu fuq il-mogħdija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that chasm! Pawlu: Yes, it looks very deep. Lara: Let's stay on the path.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看那道深壑！Pawlu：是啊，看起来很深。Lara：我们还是沿着小路走吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (徒步伙伴)
messages.zh: 看那道深壑！
messages.en: Look at that chasm!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (徒步伙伴)
messages.zh: 是啊，看起来很深。
messages.en: Yes, it looks very deep.

messages.speaker: Lara (徒步伙伴)
messages.zh: 我们还是沿着小路走吧。
messages.en: Let's stay on the path.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上向下凹陷的深壑与倾斜的坡地，把 ħondoq 放进地形画面；搭配 fond 先记牢“深壑”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose precise meaning is not established here.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个具体词义尚未明确的名词，暂不赋予确定的中文释义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħorġ huwa nom li t-tifsira preċiża tiegħu għadha mhix magħrufa hawn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义未知；此处不能确定该名词具体指称什么。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan in-nom mhix magħrufa hawn, u għalhekk ma jistax jingħata referent preċiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The meaning of this noun is currently unspecified, so a precise interpretation cannot be given.

formal.mt: L-istudent għandu jivverifika t-tifsira tal-kelma 'ħorġ' qabel jużaha f'sentenza.
formal.en: The student should verify the meaning of the word 'ħorġ' before using it in a sentence.
formal.zh: 学生应先核实“ħorġ”的含义，再将它用于句子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'ħorġ'? Mark: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja nfittxu t-tifsira tagħha. Maja: Tajjeb, imbagħad niktbu eżempju.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ħorġ' mean? Mark: I don't know yet. Let's look up its meaning. Maja: All right, then we'll write an example.
colloquial.zh: Maja：“ħorġ”是什么意思？Mark：我还不知道。我们查一下它的意思吧。Maja：好，然后我们再写一个例句。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: “ħorġ”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ħorġ' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja nfittxu t-tifsira tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja nfittxu t-tifsira tagħha.
messages.zh: 我还不知道。我们查一下它的意思吧。
messages.en: I don't know yet. Let's look up its meaning.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 好，然后我们再写一个例句。
messages.en: All right, then we'll write an example.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħorġ 做一张“名词、词义待查”的卡片，先认清 ħ 和 ġ 的字形；不要把“未知”误记成这个词本身的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The horizontal ledge at the bottom of a window.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 窗户底部的水平台面，可以用于放置小物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-wiċċ orizzontali fil-qiegħ ta' tieqa, fejn jistgħu jitqiegħdu oġġetti żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 窗台，即窗户底部水平伸出的台面。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-parti orizzontali fil-qiegħ ta' tieqa li tifforma xifer jew wiċċ fejn jista' jitqiegħed xi oġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A window-sill is the horizontal ledge at the bottom of a window.

formal.mt: Meta tnaddaf il-ħoġor ta' tieqa, neħħi l-oġġetti kollha u imsaħ il-wiċċ b'ċarruta niedja.
formal.en: When cleaning a window-sill, remove all objects and wipe the surface with a damp cloth.
formal.zh: 清洁窗台时，先移走所有物品，再用湿布擦拭台面。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn inpoġġi din il-pjanta? Mark: Fuq il-ħoġor ta' tieqa, fejn hemm ħafna dawl.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where should I put this plant? Mark: On a window-sill, where there is plenty of light.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这盆植物放在哪里？马克：放在光线充足的窗台上。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 这盆植物放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this plant?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-ħoġor ta' tieqa, fejn hemm ħafna dawl.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-ħoġor ta' tieqa, fejn hemm ħafna dawl.
messages.zh: 放在光线充足的窗台上。
messages.en: On a window-sill, where there is plenty of light.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语 ħoġor ta' tieqa 配上一盆摆在窗户下方台面上的绿植，用“窗下放花的平台”记住窗台。

gloss_zh: 破旧的；寒酸的（形容词）；名词具体所指未明

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun associated with shabbiness, whose specific referent is not established here.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与破旧、寒酸这一含义相关的名词，但具体指称的人或事物尚不明确。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħożoż huwa nom marbut ma' dehra mikula jew traskurata, iżda hawn mhuwiex ċar x'jindika eżatt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 名词用法与破旧、寒酸有关，但具体所指尚不明确。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bħala nom, ħożoż huwa marbut ma' xi ħaġa mikula jew traskurata, iżda r-referent preċiż tiegħu mhuwiex magħruf hawn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The noun is associated with shabbiness, although its specific referent is not established here.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破旧的、显得寒酸的，指因磨损或缺乏照料而外观欠佳。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bħala aġġettiv, ħożoż jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tidher mikula jew traskurata minħabba l-użu jew in-nuqqas ta' kura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as shabby looks worn or poorly cared for.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ħwejjeġ bħala ħożoż minħabba l-użu fit-tul u n-nuqqas ta' kura.
formal.en: The report describes the clothes as shabby because of prolonged use and a lack of care.
formal.zh: 报告称，这些衣服因长期使用且缺乏保养而显得破旧。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dawn il-ħwejjeġ jidhru ħożoż. Maja: Iva, imma għadhom tajbin għax-xogħol fil-ġnien. Lara: Mela nżommhom għal dak.
colloquial.en: Lara: These clothes look shabby. Maja: Yes, but they're still good for gardening. Lara: Then I'll keep them for that.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这些衣服看起来很破旧。Maja：是啊，但做园艺活时还可以穿。Lara：那我就留着干那个用吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些衣服看起来很破旧。
messages.en: These clothes look shabby.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għadhom tajbin għax-xogħol fil-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għadhom tajbin għax-xogħol fil-ġnien.
messages.zh: 是啊，但做园艺活时还可以穿。
messages.en: Yes, but they're still good for gardening.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我就留着干那个用吧。
messages.en: Then I'll keep them for that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 ħwejjeġ ħożoż 联想磨旧的衣服，记住形容词“破旧的”；另给名词用法留一栏，具体所指待明确，避免混淆词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Traditional stories passed down among people, often involving imaginary characters or events.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在人们之间代代流传的传统故事，常包含虚构的人物或事件；此词为复数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stejjer tradizzjonali li jgħaddu minn ġenerazzjoni għal oħra u li spiss jinkludu karattri jew ġrajjiet immaġinarji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在民间代代流传的传统故事，常带有想象性情节。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stejjer li jkunu għaddew minn ġenerazzjoni għal oħra fost in-nies, spiss b'ġrajjiet immaġinarji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Folktales are traditional stories that people pass down through generations, often by telling them aloud.

formal.mt: Din il-ġabra ta' ħrejjef Maltin tintuża fil-klassi biex l-istudenti jsiru jafu stejjer tradizzjonali.
formal.en: This collection of Maltese folktales is used in class to introduce students to traditional stories.
formal.zh: 这部马耳他民间故事集用于课堂，帮助学生了解传统故事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi nistgħu naqraw illejla? Nannu: Għandi ktieb tal-ħrejjef. Nagħżlu storja minnu?
colloquial.en: Maja: What can we read tonight? Grandfather: I have a book of folktales. Shall we choose a story from it?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们今晚可以读什么？爷爷：我有一本民间故事书。我们从里面选一个故事好吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.zh: 我们今晚可以读什么？
messages.en: What can we read tonight?

messages.speaker: Nannu (爷爷)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ktieb tal-ħrejjef. Nagħżlu storja minnu?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ktieb tal-ħrejjef. Nagħżlu storja minnu?
messages.zh: 我有一本民间故事书。我们从里面选一个故事好吗？
messages.en: I have a book of folktales. Shall we choose a story from it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“爷爷讲的一串民间故事”联系起来，记住它表示复数的故事，而不是单独一篇。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bill of quantities listing the work items and quantities needed for a construction project.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 列明建筑工程各项工作及其数量、用于报价和成本核算的工程量清单。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument li jelenka x-xogħlijiet u l-kwantitajiet meħtieġa għal proġett ta' kostruzzjoni, sabiex jitħejjew l-offerti u jiġu kkalkulati l-ispejjeż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工程量清单，即列出工程各项工作及相应数量、供报价和核算使用的文件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Lista dettaljata tax-xogħlijiet u tal-kwantitajiet fi proġett ta' kostruzzjoni, li tintuża bħala bażi għall-offerti u għall-kalkolu tal-ispejjeż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A BOQ is a document that lists construction work items and their quantities so that contractors can prepare prices.

collocations.en: preparation of the bill of quantities

formal.mt: Il-kuntrattur għandu jivverifika l-kwantitajiet fil-ħrid qabel ma jissottometti l-offerta tiegħu.
formal.en: The contractor must verify the quantities in the bill of quantities before submitting his tender.
formal.zh: 承包商须在提交投标报价前核实工程量清单中的数量。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek il-ħrid tal-proġett? Rita: Iva, nibgħathulek issa biex tkun tista' tħejji l-prezzijiet.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have the project's bill of quantities? Rita: Yes, I'll send it to you now so you can prepare the prices.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你有这个项目的工程量清单吗？丽塔：有，我现在发给你，你就可以准备报价了。

messages.speaker: Mark (承包商)
messages.zh: 你有这个项目的工程量清单吗？
messages.en: Do you have the project's bill of quantities?

messages.speaker: Rita (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nibgħathulek issa biex tkun tista' tħejji l-prezzijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nibgħathulek issa biex tkun tista' tħejji l-prezzijiet.
messages.zh: 有，我现在发给你，你就可以准备报价了。
messages.en: Yes, I'll send it to you now so you can prepare the prices.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħrid 放进“工程师列数量、承包商填报价”的画面中，整词对应工程量清单来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A burning discomfort felt behind the breastbone or in the upper stomach area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胸骨后方或上腹部出现的灼烧不适感，通常称为烧心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' ħruq jew skumdità wara l-għadma tas-sider jew fil-parti ta' fuq taż-żaqq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胸骨后或上腹部的灼热不适感，即烧心。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Skumdità li tinħass bħala ħruq wara l-għadma tas-sider jew fil-parti ta' fuq taż-żaqq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Heartburn is an uncomfortable burning feeling in your chest or upper stomach area.

formal.mt: Il-pazjent irrapporta ħruq fl-istonku wara l-ikla ta' filgħaxija.
formal.en: The patient reported heartburn after the evening meal.
formal.zh: 患者报告晚饭后出现烧心症状。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi ħruq fl-istonku wara li kilt. Mark: Dan jiġrilek spiss? Lara: Le, illum biss.
colloquial.en: Lara: I've got heartburn after eating. Mark: Does this happen to you often? Lara: No, just today.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：我吃完东西后有点烧心。马克：你经常这样吗？劳拉：没有，就今天这样。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ħruq fl-istonku wara li kilt.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ħruq fl-istonku wara li kilt.
messages.zh: 我吃完东西后有点烧心。
messages.en: I've got heartburn after eating.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你经常这样吗？
messages.en: Does this happen to you often?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，就今天这样。
messages.en: No, just today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“饭后胸口或上腹像有灼烧感”的画面记住整个词组，对应中文的“烧心”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exit provided for leaving a building or vehicle quickly during an emergency.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发生紧急情况时，供人迅速离开建筑物或交通工具的出口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħruġ maħsub biex in-nies ikunu jistgħu joħorġu malajr minn bini jew vettura f'każ ta' emerġenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在紧急情况下供人疏散离开的专用出口。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħruġ apposta li jintuża biex in-nies jitilqu minn post meta jkun hemm emerġenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An emergency exit is a designated way out that people can use to leave a place quickly when there is danger.

formal.mt: Il-ħruġ t'emerġenza għandu jinżamm ħieles minn kull ostaklu.
formal.en: The emergency exit must be kept clear of all obstructions.
formal.zh: 紧急出口必须保持畅通，不得有任何障碍物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-ħruġ t'emerġenza? Pawlu: Hemmhekk, ħdejn it-taraġ, taħt is-sinjal aħdar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the emergency exit? Pawlu: Over there, next to the stairs, under the green sign.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：紧急出口在哪里？保罗：在那边，楼梯旁边，绿色标志下面。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 紧急出口在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the emergency exit?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemmhekk, ħdejn it-taraġ, taħt is-sinjal aħdar.
messages.mt_standard: Hemmhekk, ħdejn it-taraġ, taħt is-sinjal aħdar.
messages.zh: 在那边，楼梯旁边，绿色标志下面。
messages.en: Over there, next to the stairs, under the green sign.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组与绿色逃生标志一起记忆：看到标志，就想到“紧急时从这里出去”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movement of money out of a person's or organization's available funds, especially through payments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人或机构因付款等原因而发生的现金或资金向外流动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment ta' flus 'il barra mill-fondi ta' persuna jew organizzazzjoni, speċjalment meta jsiru ħlasijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 现金或资金因支付等活动而流出个人或机构的过程或金额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Flus li joħorġu mill-fondi ta' persuna jew organizzazzjoni minħabba ħlasijiet jew tranżazzjonijiet oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cash outflow occurs when money leaves a person's or organization's funds, for example when a payment is made.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri żieda fil-ħruġ ta' flus minħabba ħlasijiet lill-fornituri.
formal.en: The report shows an increase in cash outflow due to payments to suppliers.
formal.zh: 报告显示，向供应商付款导致现金流出增加。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex fadal inqas flus fil-kont dan ix-xahar? Mark: Kellna ħruġ ta' flus akbar għax ħallasna l-kera u xtrajna tagħmir ġdid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there less money left in the account this month? Mark: We had a larger cash outflow because we paid the rent and bought new equipment.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么这个月账户里剩的钱更少了？马克：因为我们付了租金，还买了新设备，现金流出比较多。

messages.speaker: Maja (生意合伙人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex fadal inqas flus fil-kont dan ix-xahar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex fadal inqas flus fil-kont dan ix-xahar?
messages.zh: 为什么这个月账户里剩的钱更少了？
messages.en: Why is there less money left in the account this month?

messages.speaker: Mark (生意合伙人)
messages.mt_spoken: Kellna ħruġ ta' flus akbar għax ħallasna l-kera u xtrajna tagħmir ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Kellna ħruġ ta' flus akbar għax ħallasna l-kera u xtrajna tagħmir ġdid.
messages.zh: 因为我们付了租金，还买了新设备，现金流出比较多。
messages.en: We had a larger cash outflow because we paid the rent and bought new equipment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象账户旁有一个向外的箭头，箭头上放着钱；把整个短语记成“钱往外流”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movement of goods out of a warehouse, storage area, or other premises.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 货物从仓库、储存区或其他场所向外运出的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment ta' merkanzija 'l barra minn maħżen, żona ta' ħażna jew post ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 货物离开仓库或其他场所，即货物出库或运出。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-merkanzija titlaq minn maħżen jew minn post ieħor fejn tkun tinsab.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The exit of goods occurs when goods leave the premises where they have been kept or handled.

collocations.en: the movement of goods out of the warehouse
recording the movement of goods out

formal.mt: Kull ħruġ ta' merkanzija mill-maħżen għandu jiġi rreġistrat bid-data u l-kwantità.
formal.en: Every movement of goods out of the warehouse must be recorded with the date and quantity.
formal.zh: 每次货物出库都必须登记日期和数量。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-ħruġ ta' merkanzija tal-lum tlesta? Pawlu: Għad fadal żewġ kaxxi. It-trakk jasal għalihom wara nofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Rita: Have today's goods all gone out? Paul: There are still two boxes left. The truck will come for them this afternoon.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：今天的货物都出库了吗？保罗：还剩两箱。卡车今天下午来取。

messages.speaker: Rita (仓库主管)
messages.zh: 今天的货物都出库了吗？
messages.en: Have today's goods all gone out?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (仓库员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad fadal żewġ kaxxi. It-trakk jasal għalihom wara nofsinhar.
messages.mt_standard: Għad fadal żewġ kaxxi. It-trakk jasal għalihom wara nofsinhar.
messages.zh: 还剩两箱。卡车今天下午来取。
messages.en: There are still two boxes left. The truck will come for them this afternoon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几箱货物沿着向外的箭头离开仓库；把整个短语与“货物出库”的场景绑定记忆。

gloss_zh: 受保护措施覆盖的故障

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fault described as secured or covered within a specified protection arrangement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在特定保护安排中，被描述为已获保障或受到保护措施覆盖的故障。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsara deskritta bħala koperta jew imħarsa fil-qafas ta' arranġament speċifikat ta' protezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在所述保护安排下获得保障或覆盖的故障；具体保障范围由相关语境确定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħsara li titqies koperta minn arranġament ta' protezzjoni, bil-firxa tal-kopertura tiddependi mill-kuntest speċifikat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A secured fault is a fault described as covered by a protection arrangement whose scope is specified in the relevant context.

collocations.en: a fault covered by the protective measures
a fault classified as secured according to the documentation
collocations.zh: 按文档归为受保障范围内的故障

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juża t-terminu 'ħsara koperta' u jispeċifika l-miżuri ta' protezzjoni li japplikaw għaliha.
formal.en: The report uses the term 'secured fault' and specifies the protective measures that apply to it.
formal.zh: 报告使用了“受保护措施覆盖的故障”这一术语，并明确说明适用的保护措施。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Hawn miktub 'ħsara koperta'. Xi jfisser eżatt? Toni: Irridu naraw liema protezzjoni jispeċifika d-dokument.
colloquial.en: Nina: It says 'secured fault' here. What exactly does that mean? Toni: We need to check what protection the document specifies.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这里写着“受保护措施覆盖的故障”。具体是什么意思？托尼：我们得看看文档规定了哪些保护措施。

messages.speaker: Nina (实习技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub 'ħsara koperta'. Xi jfisser eżatt?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub 'ħsara koperta'. Xi jfisser eżatt?
messages.zh: 这里写着“受保护措施覆盖的故障”。具体是什么意思？
messages.en: It says 'secured fault' here. What exactly does that mean?

messages.speaker: Toni (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Irridu naraw liema protezzjoni jispeċifika d-dokument.
messages.mt_standard: Irridu naraw liema protezzjoni jispeċifika d-dokument.
messages.zh: 我们得看看文档规定了哪些保护措施。
messages.en: We need to check what protection the document specifies.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故障清单上盖着一张保护范围表：先记“故障受到覆盖”，再根据文档确认覆盖内容。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fault in which multiple components or channels are affected in the same way by a shared cause.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 多个部件或通道因共同原因而以相同方式受到影响的故障。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsara li fiha diversi komponenti jew kanali jiġu affettwati bl-istess mod minn kawża komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由共同原因使多个部件或通道以相同方式发生异常的共模故障。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħsara kkawżata minn fattur komuni li jaffettwa diversi komponenti jew kanali bl-istess mod.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A common mode fault occurs when a shared cause makes several components or channels develop the same kind of fault.

collocations.mt: riskju ta' ħsara ta' modalità komuni
collocations.en: risk of a common mode fault

collocations.mt: analiżi ta' ħsara ta' modalità komuni
collocations.en: analysis of a common mode fault

formal.mt: L-analiżi identifikat ħsara ta' modalità komuni: l-istess sors tal-elettriku difettuż affettwa ż-żewġ kanali bl-istess mod.
formal.en: The analysis identified a common mode fault: the same faulty power source affected both channels in the same way.
formal.zh: 分析发现了一起共模故障：同一个有缺陷的电源以相同方式影响了两个通道。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Iż-żewġ kanali qed juru l-istess problema. Jista' jkun hemm ħsara ta' modalità komuni? David: Iva, ejja niċċekkjaw is-sors tal-elettriku li jużaw it-tnejn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Both channels are showing the same problem. Could there be a common mode fault? David: Yes, let's check the power source they both use.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：两个通道都出现了同样的问题。会不会是共模故障？戴维：有可能，我们检查一下它们共用的电源吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iż-żewġ kanali qed juru l-istess problema. Jista' jkun hemm ħsara ta' modalità komuni?
messages.mt_standard: Iż-żewġ kanali qed juru l-istess problema. Jista' jkun hemm ħsara ta' modalità komuni?
messages.zh: 两个通道都出现了同样的问题。会不会是共模故障？
messages.en: Both channels are showing the same problem. Could there be a common mode fault?

messages.speaker: David (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja niċċekkjaw is-sors tal-elettriku li jużaw it-tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja niċċekkjaw is-sors tal-elettriku li jużaw it-tnejn.
messages.zh: 有可能，我们检查一下它们共用的电源吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's check the power source they both use.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“两路设备，同一原因，同样出错”的画面，把整个词组与“共模故障”对应起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The emotions and personal feelings that someone experiences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人所体验到的情绪、感受或内心情感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-emozzjonijiet u s-sentimenti li persuna tesperjenza ġewwa fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人的内心感受、情绪或情感。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħsus huma s-sentimenti u l-emozzjonijiet li persuna tħoss f'sitwazzjonijiet differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your feelings are the emotions you experience in response to people, events, or thoughts.

formal.mt: F'din l-ittra, l-awtriċi tesprimi l-ħsus tagħha dwar it-tluq minn darha.
formal.en: In this letter, the author expresses her feelings about leaving her home.
formal.zh: 在这封信中，作者表达了她离开家园时的感受。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi ħsus imħallta dwar dan il-vjaġġ. Pawlu: Għidli x'qed tħoss; nista' nisma'.
colloquial.en: Maja: I have mixed feelings about this trip. Pawlu: Tell me how you're feeling; I can listen.
colloquial.zh: Maja：对于这次旅行，我的心情很复杂。Pawlu：告诉我你的感受吧，我可以听你说。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ħsus imħallta dwar dan il-vjaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ħsus imħallta dwar dan il-vjaġġ.
messages.zh: 对于这次旅行，我的心情很复杂。
messages.en: I have mixed feelings about this trip.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 告诉我你的感受吧，我可以听你说。
messages.en: Tell me how you're feeling; I can listen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħsus 放进“表达感受”和“隐藏感受”两个相反场景，联想心里同时装着喜悦、担忧等多种情绪来记忆。

gloss_zh: 款项拨付需求；拨付款项所需资金

teaching_sense.en_definition: The funding requirements associated with paying out money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为拨付或支付款项而产生的资金需求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħtiġijiet ta' fondi biex ikunu jistgħu jsiru pagamenti jew jinħarġu flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拨付或支付款项时所涉及的资金需求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħtiġijiet ta' fondi marbuta mal-ħruġ ta' flus għal pagamenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Disbursement needs are the funding requirements that arise when money must be paid out.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为拨付或支付款项而需要资金这一需求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħtieġa li jkun hemm fondi disponibbli biex ikunu jistgħu jinħarġu flus jew isiru pagamenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This sense refers to a need for available funds so that payments can be made.

collocations.zh: 确定款项拨付的资金需求
满足款项拨付的资金需求

formal.mt: Ir-rapport finanzjarju jidentifika l-ħtiġijiet tal-iżborż għax-xahar li ġej u l-fondi meħtieġa biex jiġu koperti.
formal.en: The financial report identifies next month's disbursement needs and the funds required to cover them.
formal.zh: 财务报告列明下个月的款项拨付需求，以及满足这些需求所需的资金。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għad irridu niċċekkjaw il-ħtiġijiet tal-iżborż għal din il-ġimgħa. Mark: Tajjeb, ejja naraw kemm għandna bżonn flus għall-pagamenti.
colloquial.en: Lara: We still need to check this week's disbursement needs. Mark: All right, let's see how much money we need for the payments.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们还得核查本周的款项拨付需求。Mark：好，我们看看支付这些款项需要多少钱。

messages.speaker: Lara (财务主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad irridu niċċekkjaw il-ħtiġijiet tal-iżborż għal din il-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Għad irridu niċċekkjaw il-ħtiġijiet tal-iżborż għal din il-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 我们还得核查本周的款项拨付需求。
messages.en: We still need to check this week's disbursement needs.

messages.speaker: Mark (财务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, ejja naraw kemm għandna bżonn flus għall-pagamenti.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, ejja naraw kemm għandna bżonn flus għall-pagamenti.
messages.zh: 好，我们看看支付这些款项需要多少钱。
messages.en: All right, let's see how much money we need for the payments.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象财务人员先列出待付款项，再计算要准备多少钱；把整个短语作为“拨款需要多少资金”的名词表达来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An individual fish, an animal that lives in water and has gills and fins.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一条鱼，即生活在水中、用鳃呼吸并有鳍的动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal li jgħix fl-ilma, jieħu n-nifs bil-garġi u għandu x-xewk biex jgħum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鱼，指一条生活在水中、用鳃呼吸的鱼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħuta hija annimal li jgħix fl-ilma u juża l-garġi biex jieħu n-nifs u x-xewk biex jgħum.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fish is an animal that lives in water and uses gills to breathe and fins to swim.

formal.mt: Matul l-osservazzjoni, l-istudenti raw ħuta żgħira tgħum bejn il-blat.
formal.en: During the observation, the students saw a small fish swimming among the rocks.
formal.zh: 在观察过程中，学生们看到一条小鱼在岩石之间游动。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara dik il-ħuta ħdejn il-blat! Adam: Rajtha! Għandha kuluri sbieħ ħafna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at that fish near the rocks! Adam: I saw it! It has such beautiful colours.
colloquial.zh: Nina：看岩石旁边的那条鱼！Adam：我看到了！它的颜色真漂亮。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 看岩石旁边的那条鱼！
messages.en: Look at that fish near the rocks!

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看到了！它的颜色真漂亮。
messages.en: I saw it! It has such beautiful colours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指着水里清楚可数的一条鱼，边指边说 ħuta；再把“大鱼”和“小鱼”的画面配着短语一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clothes worn next to the body underneath outer clothing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿在外衣里面、通常贴身穿着的衣物，如内裤、背心或胸罩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħwejjeġ li jintlibsu taħt il-ħwejjeġ ta' barra, ġeneralment direttament mal-ġilda, bħal qliezet ta' taħt, flokkijiet ta' taħt u reċipetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿在外衣里面的内层衣物，统称内衣或贴身衣物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħwejjeġ li jintlibsu bħala saff ta' ġewwa taħt il-ħwejjeġ ta' barra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Underclothing consists of garments that you wear beneath your outer clothes, usually next to your skin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 内衣，指内裤、胸罩、贴身背心等穿在外衣里面的衣物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħwejjeġ bħal qliezet ta' taħt, reċipetti u flokkijiet ta' taħt li jintlibsu taħt il-ħwejjeġ l-oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Underwear is clothing such as underpants, bras, and vests that you wear underneath your other clothes.

formal.mt: Il-lista għall-vjaġġ tinkludi ħwejjeġ ta' taħt nodfa għal kull jum.
formal.en: The packing list includes clean underwear for each day.
formal.zh: 旅行打包清单包括每天换穿的干净内衣。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn poġġejt il-ħwejjeġ ta' taħt nodfa? Marija: Fil-kexxun ta' fuq, ħdejn il-kalzetti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did you put the clean underwear? Marija: In the top drawer, next to the socks.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你把干净的内衣放在哪里了？Marija：最上面的抽屉里，就在袜子旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn poġġejt il-ħwejjeġ ta' taħt nodfa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn poġġejt il-ħwejjeġ ta' taħt nodfa?
messages.zh: 你把干净的内衣放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the clean underwear?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 最上面的抽屉里，就在袜子旁边。
messages.en: In the top drawer, next to the socks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用穿衣顺序记忆：先穿贴身内衣，再穿外面的衣服；把 ħwejjeġ ta' taħt 与“里面那一层衣物”的画面固定配对。
